From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String.
Open Scope string_scope.
From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.

(* ---------- 1. typed has no rule for runtime values ---------- *)
Lemma typed_val_absurd Γ v t : typed Γ (Val v) t -> False.
Proof. intros H. inversion H. Qed.

(* Concrete: the well-typed identity function steps to an untypable value. *)
Lemma typed_id : typed ∅ (Fun "x" (Var "x")) (FunT Lin UnitT UnitT).
Proof.
  eapply Fun_typed with (Γ' := {[ "x" := UnitT ]}).
  - unfold env_bind. split; [reflexivity|]. intros t' H. simpl in H. discriminate.
  - intros _. intros x t Hx. simpl in Hx. destruct (decide ("x"%string = x)); subst; [inversion Hx; constructor|].
    inversion Hx.
  - eapply Var_typed. exists ∅. split; [reflexivity|]. intros x t Hx. done.
Qed.

Lemma id_steps_val : pure_step (Fun "x" (Var "x")) (Val (FunV "x" (Var "x"))).
Proof. apply Fun_step. Qed.

Lemma not_typed_funv : forall t, typed ∅ (Val (FunV "x" (Var "x"))) t -> False.
Proof. intros t H. apply typed_val_absurd in H. exact H. Qed.

(* ---------- 2. Inversion lemmas ---------- *)
Lemma typed_unit_inv Γ : typed Γ Unit UnitT -> env_unr Γ.
Proof. intros H. inversion H. subst. assumption. Qed.

Lemma typed_fun_inv Γ x e t :
  typed Γ (Fun x e) t ->
  exists l t1 t2 Γ', t = FunT l t1 t2 /\ env_bind Γ' x t1 Γ /\
     (l = Unr -> env_unr Γ) /\ typed Γ' e t2.
Proof.
  intros H. inversion H; subst; eauto 8.
Qed.

Lemma typed_app_inv Γ e1 e2 t :
  typed Γ (App e1 e2) t ->
  exists l t1 t2 Γ1 Γ2, env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 /\
     typed Γ1 e1 (FunT l t1 t2) /\ typed Γ2 e2 t1 /\ t = t2.
Proof.
  intros H. inversion H; subst; eauto 10.
Qed.

Lemma typed_pair_inv Γ e1 e2 t :
  typed Γ (Pair e1 e2) t ->
  exists t1 t2 Γ1 Γ2, env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 /\ t = PairT t1 t2 /\
     typed Γ1 e1 t1 /\ typed Γ2 e2 t2.
Proof.
  intros H. inversion H; subst; eauto 10.
Qed.
=== Barrier.v ===
From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String.
Open Scope string_scope.
From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.
From stdpp Require Import gmap.
From scratch2 Require Import Helper.

Local Notation E := (gmap string type).

Lemma env_unr_empty : env_unr (∅ : E).
Proof. apply env_unr_conv_back. apply env_unr'_empty. Qed.

Lemma env_unr_singleton (x : string) (t : type) :
  unr t -> env_unr (<[x := t]> (∅ : E)).
Proof.
  intros Hu. apply env_unr_conv_back. apply env_unr'_singleton. exact Hu.
Qed.

Lemma env_split_empty_empty : env_split (∅ : E) ∅ ∅.
Proof. apply env_split_conv_back. apply env_split'_empty_empty. Qed.

Lemma env_split_self_empty (Γ : E) : env_split Γ Γ ∅.
Proof. apply env_split_conv_back. apply env_split'_self_empty. Qed.

(* The continuation used in the program from the investigation. *)
Definition fork_body : expr :=
  Fun "k" (App (App (Var "k") Unit) Unit).

Definition prog : expr :=
  App (ForkBarrier fork_body) (Fun "x" Unit).

Lemma fork_body_typed :
  typed (∅ : E) fork_body
        (FunT Lin (FunT Lin UnitT (FunT Lin UnitT UnitT)) UnitT).
Proof.
  unfold fork_body.
  eapply Fun_typed with
    (Γ' := <["k" := FunT Lin UnitT (FunT Lin UnitT UnitT)]> ∅)
    (t1 := FunT Lin UnitT (FunT Lin UnitT UnitT))
    (t2 := UnitT) (l := Lin).
  - unfold env_bind. split.
    + reflexivity.
    + intros t' Ht'. exfalso. exact (lookup_empty_Some _ _ Ht').
  - intros Hl. discriminate Hl.
  - eapply App_typed with
      (Γ1 := <["k" := FunT Lin UnitT (FunT Lin UnitT UnitT)]> ∅)
      (Γ2 := ∅) (t1 := UnitT) (t2 := UnitT) (l := Lin).
    + apply env_split_self_empty.
    + eapply App_typed with
        (Γ1 := <["k" := FunT Lin UnitT (FunT Lin UnitT UnitT)]> ∅)
        (Γ2 := ∅) (t1 := UnitT)
        (t2 := FunT Lin UnitT UnitT) (l := Lin).
      * apply env_split_self_empty.
      * apply Var_typed. exists (∅ : E). split.
        -- reflexivity.
        -- apply env_unr_empty.
      * apply Unit_typed. apply env_unr_empty.
    + apply Unit_typed. apply env_unr_empty.
Qed.

(* The parent's endpoint has type [FunT Lin t1 t2] with t1 = UnitT -> UnitT
   and t2 = UnitT. *)
Lemma prog_fork_typed :
  typed (∅ : E) (ForkBarrier fork_body)
        (FunT Lin (FunT Lin UnitT UnitT) UnitT).
Proof. apply Fork_typed. apply fork_body_typed. Qed.

Lemma prog_typed : typed (∅ : E) prog UnitT.
Proof.
  unfold prog.
  eapply App_typed with (Γ1 := ∅) (Γ2 := ∅)
                       (t1 := FunT Lin UnitT UnitT) (t2 := UnitT) (l := Lin).
  - apply env_split_empty_empty.
  - apply prog_fork_typed.
  - eapply Fun_typed with (Γ' := <["x" := UnitT]> ∅)
                          (t1 := UnitT) (t2 := UnitT) (l := Lin).
    + unfold env_bind. split.
      * reflexivity.
      * intros t' Ht'. exfalso. exact (lookup_empty_Some _ _ Ht').
    + intros Hl. discriminate Hl.
    + apply Unit_typed. apply env_unr_singleton. apply Unit_unr.
Qed.

(* The two ends of one barrier are typed with swapped function types. *)
Lemma fork_continuation_typing Γ s body t1 t2 :
  typed Γ (ForkBarrier (Fun s body)) (FunT Lin t1 t2) ->

From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String.
From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.
From stdpp Require Import gmap.

(* Everything at the unfolded map type, so that all typeclass instances
   agree inside our lemmas. *)
Local Notation E := (gmap string type).

Definition env_unr' (Γ : E) := ∀ x t, Γ !! x = Some t -> unr t.
Definition disj' (Γ1 Γ2 : E) :=
  ∀ i t1 t2, Γ1 !! i = Some t1 -> Γ2 !! i = Some t2 -> t1 = t2 ∧ unr t1.
Definition env_bind' (Γ' : E) (x : string) (t : type) (Γ : E) :=
  Γ' = <[x:=t]> Γ ∧ ∀ t', Γ !! x = Some t' -> unr t'.
Definition env_var' (Γ : E) (x : string) (t : type) :=
  ∃ Γ', Γ = <[x:=t]> Γ' ∧ env_unr' Γ'.
Definition env_split' (Γ Γ1 Γ2 : E) := Γ = Γ1 ∪ Γ2 ∧ disj' Γ1 Γ2.

Lemma env_unr_conv (Γ : E) : env_unr Γ -> env_unr' Γ.
Proof. intros H. exact H. Qed.
Lemma env_unr_conv_back (Γ : E) : env_unr' Γ -> env_unr Γ.
Proof. intros H. exact H. Qed.
Lemma disj_conv (Γ1 Γ2 : E) : disj Γ1 Γ2 -> disj' Γ1 Γ2.
Proof. intros H. exact H. Qed.
Lemma env_split_conv (Γ Γ1 Γ2 : E) : env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 -> env_split' Γ Γ1 Γ2.
Proof. intros H. exact H. Qed.
Lemma env_bind_conv (Γ' : E) x t Γ : env_bind Γ' x t Γ -> env_bind' Γ' x t Γ.
Proof. intros H. exact H. Qed.
Lemma env_var_conv (Γ : E) x t : env_var Γ x t -> env_var' Γ x t.
Proof. intros H. exact H. Qed.

Lemma lk_union (m1 m2 : E) y : (m1 ∪ m2) !! y = m1 !! y ∪ m2 !! y.
Proof. apply lookup_union. Qed.
Lemma lk_delete (m : E) x y :
  (delete x m) !! y = (if decide (x = y) then None else m !! y).
Proof. apply lookup_delete. Qed.
Lemma lk_delete_eq (m : E) x : (delete x m) !! x = None.
Proof. rewrite lk_delete. destruct (decide (x=x)); [reflexivity|done]. Qed.
Lemma lk_delete_ne (m : E) x y : x <> y -> (delete x m) !! y = m !! y.
Proof. intro H. rewrite lk_delete. destruct (decide (x=y)); [done|reflexivity]. Qed.
Lemma lk_insert (m : E) x y v :
  (<[x:=v]> m) !! y = (if decide (x = y) then Some v else m !! y).
Proof. apply lookup_insert. Qed.
Lemma lk_insert_eq (m : E) x v : (<[x:=v]> m) !! x = Some v.
Proof. rewrite lk_insert. destruct (decide (x=x)); [reflexivity|done]. Qed.
Lemma lk_insert_ne (m : E) x y v : x <> y -> (<[x:=v]> m) !! y = m !! y.
Proof. intro H. rewrite lk_insert. destruct (decide (x=y)); [done|reflexivity]. Qed.

Lemma delete_none (m : E) x : m !! x = None -> delete x m = m.
Proof. intros H. apply map_eq. intro y.
  destruct (decide (x = y)).
  - subst. rewrite lk_delete_eq. symmetry. exact H.
  - rewrite (lk_delete_ne m x y); [reflexivity|done]. Qed.

Lemma union_none (m1 m2 : E) x :
  (m1 ∪ m2) !! x = None -> m1 !! x = None ∧ m2 !! x = None.
Proof. apply lookup_union_None_1. Qed.
Lemma union_none_l (m1 m2 : E) x : (m1 ∪ m2) !! x = None -> m1 !! x = None.
Proof. intro H. exact (proj1 (union_none _ _ _ H)). Qed.
Lemma union_none_r (m1 m2 : E) x : (m1 ∪ m2) !! x = None -> m2 !! x = None.
Proof. intro H. exact (proj2 (union_none _ _ _ H)). Qed.

Lemma env_unr'_delete (Γ : E) x : env_unr' Γ -> env_unr' (delete x Γ).
Proof.
  unfold env_unr'. intros H y t Hy.
  assert (Hy' : Γ !! y = Some t).
  { destruct (decide (x = y)).
    - subst. rewrite lk_delete_eq in Hy. discriminate.
    - rewrite (lk_delete_ne Γ x y) in Hy; [exact Hy|done]. }
  apply (H y t). exact Hy'.
Qed.

Lemma env_unr'_insert_restrict (Γ : E) x t :
  Γ !! x = None -> env_unr' (<[x:=t]> Γ) -> env_unr' Γ.
Proof.
  unfold env_unr'. intros Hx H y ty Hy.
  assert (Hxy : x <> y). { intro E. subst. rewrite Hx in Hy. discriminate. }
  assert (Hy' : (<[x:=t]> Γ) !! y = Some ty).
  { rewrite (lk_insert_ne Γ x y t); [exact Hy|exact Hxy]. }
  apply (H y ty). exact Hy'.
Qed.

Lemma delete_union_E (m1 m2 : E) x : delete x (m1 ∪ m2) = delete x m1 ∪ delete x m2.
Proof. apply delete_union. Qed.

Lemma delete_insert_eq_E (m : E) x v : delete x (<[x:=v]> m) = delete x m.
Proof. apply delete_insert_eq. Qed.
Lemma delete_insert_ne_E (m : E) x y v :
  x <> y -> delete x (<[y:=v]> m) = <[y:=v]> (delete x m).
Proof. apply delete_insert_ne. Qed.
Lemma insert_delete_eq_E (m : E) x v : <[x:=v]> (delete x m) = <[x:=v]> m.
Proof. apply insert_delete_eq. Qed.
Lemma insert_insert_eq_E (m : E) x u v : <[x:=u]> (<[x:=v]> m) = <[x:=u]> m.
Proof. apply insert_insert_eq. Qed.
Lemma insert_insert_ne_E (m : E) x y u v :
  x <> y -> <[x:=u]> (<[y:=v]> m) = <[y:=v]> (<[x:=u]> m).
Proof. apply insert_insert_ne. Qed.
Lemma insert_delete_id_E (m : E) x v : m !! x = Some v -> <[x:=v]> (delete x m) = m.
Proof. apply insert_delete_id. Qed.

Lemma lk_union_some_l (m1 m2 : E) x t : m1 !! x = Some t -> (m1 ∪ m2) !! x = Some t.
Proof. intro H. rewrite lk_union. rewrite H. rewrite union_Some_l. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma lk_union_some_r (m1 m2 : E) x t :
  m2 !! x = Some t -> exists t', (m1 ∪ m2) !! x = Some t'.
Proof. intro H. rewrite lk_union. destruct (m1 !! x) as [t0|].
  - exists t0. rewrite union_Some_l. reflexivity.
  - exists t. cbn. rewrite H. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma lk_union_some_l_exists (m1 m2 : E) x t :
  m1 !! x = Some t -> exists t', (m1 ∪ m2) !! x = Some t'.
Proof. intro H. exists t. apply lk_union_some_l. exact H. Qed.

Lemma env_split'_delete (Δ Γ1 Γ2 : E) x :
  env_split' Δ Γ1 Γ2 ->
  env_split' (delete x Δ) (delete x Γ1) (delete x Γ2).
Proof.
  intros [He Hd]. split.
  - rewrite He. apply delete_union_E.
  - unfold disj'. intros y ty1 ty2 Hy1 Hy2.
    destruct (decide (x = y)) as [E1|E1].
    + subst. rewrite lk_delete_eq in Hy1. discriminate.
    + rewrite (lk_delete_ne Γ1 x y) in Hy1. rewrite (lk_delete_ne Γ2 x y) in Hy2.
      exact (Hd y ty1 ty2 Hy1 Hy2).
      all: exact E1.
Qed.

(* Union lookup on the right, when the two maps agree on overlapping keys
   (this is exactly the [disj] discipline of the linear typing). *)
Lemma lk_union_some_r_eq (Γ1 Γ2 : E) x t :
  (∀ t1 t2, Γ1 !! x = Some t1 -> Γ2 !! x = Some t2 -> t1 = t2) ->
  Γ2 !! x = Some t -> (Γ1 ∪ Γ2) !! x = Some t.
Proof.
  intros Hd H2. rewrite lk_union.
  destruct (Γ1 !! x) as [t1|] eqn:E1.
  - rewrite union_Some_l.
    assert (t1 = t) as -> by (apply (Hd t1 t eq_refl H2)).
    reflexivity.
  - rewrite H2. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma lk_empty_E (x : string) : (∅ : E) !! x = None.
Proof. apply lookup_empty. Qed.

Lemma env_unr'_empty : env_unr' (∅ : E).
Proof.
  unfold env_unr'. intros x t H. exfalso. exact (lookup_empty_Some x t H).
Qed.

Lemma env_unr'_singleton (x : string) (t : type) :
  unr t -> env_unr' (<[x := t]> (∅ : E)).
Proof.
  intros Hu y ty Hy.
  destruct (decide (x = y)) as [Ey|Ey].
  - subst y. rewrite lk_insert_eq in Hy. injection Hy as ->. exact Hu.
  - rewrite (lk_insert_ne (∅ : E) x y t) in Hy; [ | exact Ey].
    exfalso. exact (lookup_empty_Some y ty Hy).
Qed.

Lemma disj'_empty_l (Γ : E) : disj' (∅ : E) Γ.
Proof.
  unfold disj'. intros i t1 t2 H1 H2. exfalso.
  exact (lookup_empty_Some i t1 H1).
Qed.

Lemma disj'_empty_r (Γ : E) : disj' Γ (∅ : E).
Proof.
  unfold disj'. intros i t1 t2 H1 H2. exfalso.
  exact (lookup_empty_Some i t2 H2).
Qed.

Lemma env_split_conv_back (Γ Γ1 Γ2 : E) : env_split' Γ Γ1 Γ2 -> env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2.
Proof. intros H. exact H. Qed.

Lemma env_split'_empty_empty : env_split' (∅ : E) ∅ ∅.
Proof.
  split.
  - apply map_eq_iff. intro i. rewrite lk_union.
    rewrite lk_empty_E. reflexivity.
  - apply disj'_empty_l.
Qed.

Lemma env_split'_self_empty (Γ : E) : env_split' Γ Γ ∅.
Proof.
  split.
  - apply map_eq_iff. intro i. rewrite lk_union. rewrite lk_empty_E.
    destruct (Γ !! i); reflexivity.
  - apply disj'_empty_r.
Qed.

  Fun "k" (App (App (Var "k") Unit) Unit).

Proof. intros H. exact H. Qed.

## 2. Reconstructed capability/token runtime typing and invariant

### Capability accounting (verified, `/tmp/scratch3/tokens.v`)

Encoding: a live token is `(lock_id, lockcap)`. Required `EqDecision`/`Countable` for `lockownership`, `lockstate` (manual `inj_countable` via nat encodings; no instances exist in stdpp).

```coq
Definition cap_weight (c : lockcap) : nat := match c.1 with Owner => 0 | Client => 1 end.
Definition cap_open  (c : lockcap) : nat := match c.2 with Opened => 1 | Closed => 0 end.
Definition cap_owner (c : lockcap) : nat := match c.1 with Owner => 1 | Client => 0 end.
Definition tok := (nat * lockcap)%type.

Definition num_open   n T := multiplicity (n,(Owner,Opened)) T + multiplicity (n,(Client,Opened)) T.
Definition num_owner  n T := multiplicity (n,(Owner,Opened)) T + multiplicity (n,(Owner,Closed)) T.
Definition num_client n T := multiplicity (n,(Client,Opened)) T + multiplicity (n,(Client,Closed)) T.

Definition lock_tokens_ok n r o T : Prop :=
  num_owner n T = 1 /\
  num_client n T = r /\
  match o with None => num_open n T = 1 | Some _ => num_open n T = 0 end.
```

Semantics of the cap lattice (my reading, confirmed by the split arithmetic):
- Exactly one `Owner` token per live lock; `Client` tokens count the lock's `refcnt`.
- If the lock object stores `Some v`, all tokens are `Closed`; if `None`, exactly one token is `Opened` (the holder who must `Release`).

`ForkLock` consumes token `l1` and produces `l2` (child) + `l3` (parent result), matching `lockcap_split l1 l2 l3`.

### Runtime typing shape (reconstruction, not implemented)

```coq
(* Lock table entry: payload type + refcount + contents *)
Record lockinfo := { li_ty : type; li_refcnt : nat; li_val : option val }.
(* Barrier table: the two endpoint types t1,t2; BarrierV n is usable at
   FunT Lin t1 t2 in one thread and FunT Lin t2 t1 in the other. *)
Record barinfo := { bi_t1 : type; bi_t2 : type }.

(* A configuration typing packages:
   - lock table Δ matching all Lock objects,
   - barrier table Β matching all Barrier objects,
   - a global token multiset T,
   - a runtime typing derivation for every thread at UnitT, and for every
     stored lock payload at its payload type, associating its lock tokens. *)
```

The per-occurrence cap problem (syntax `LockV n` carries no cap; the cap is in its type) means the runtime judgment must carry tokens as an **output/annotation**, e.g. `rtyped Β Γ e t Π` / `rvtyped Β v t Π`, with `Π` the multiset of `(n,cap)` tokens held by the (closed) value, and `Π` combined by `⊎` at application/constructor splits. This is the only formulation I found that lets `LockV n : LockT cap t` be typed at different caps in different threads. I could not complete this judgment.

### Global reachability invariant (reconstructed shape)

```coq
Definition cfg_wf (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  ∃ (Δ : gmap nat lockinfo) (Β : gmap nat barinfo) (T : gmultiset tok),
    (* lock/barrier tables exactly match the objects *)
    ... /\
    (* threads are runtime-typed at UnitT; payloads at li_ty *)
    ... /\
    (* token accounting: for every lock n, lock_tokens_ok n refcnt o T *)
    ... .

Definition reach_invariant (ρ : cfg) (r : nat -> nat) (M : nat) : Prop :=
  cfg_wf ρ /\
  refs_live ρ /\
  progress_or_wait ρ /\
  rank_ok ρ r M.
```

where (all definitions verified in `/tmp/scratch3/reach_core_full.v` and `refs_lemmas.v`):

```coq
Definition progress_or_wait ρ :=
  ∀ i, ρ !! i ≠ None -> can_step ρ i ∨ ∃ j, waiting ρ i j.

Definition wait_targets_live ρ :=
  ∀ i e j, ρ !! i = Some (Thread e) -> expr_waiting e j -> ρ !! j ≠ None.

Definition rank_ok ρ r M :=
  (∀ i, r i ≤ M) ∧ (∀ i j, waiting ρ i j -> r i < r j).

Definition wait_wf ρ := well_founded (fun j i => waiting ρ i j).

Definition refs_live ρ :=
  (∀ i e j, ρ!!i = Some (Thread e) -> j ∈ expr_refs e -> ρ!!j ≠ None) /\
  (∀ n r v j, ρ!!n = Some (Lock r (Some v)) -> j ∈ val_refs v -> ρ!!j ≠ None).
```

Rationale for the rank: reachability is propagated *against* `waiting`; ranking `r i < r j` along `waiting ρ i j` makes the relation well-founded, so reachability of a `can_step` seed propagates back along finite increasing-rank chains. ```

```coq
  ∀ Γ ee t, typed Γ (k ee) t ->

```

## 4. Step-preservation case analysis (reconstructed, not machine-checked)

For each `local_step`, the invariant must be re-established:

- **Pure_step** (`beta`, constructor, match, etc.): context typing gives the hole type; substitution/linearity preserves the reference multiset (unrestricted substitutions carry no lock tokens, so no duplication of resources). Rank edges through the thread are re-attached to the reduct.
- **Exit_step**: thread at `Val UnitV` has `expr_refs = ∅`; removing it orphans nothing.
- **Fork_step**: fresh barrier `n`; both parent `k (BarrierV n)` and child `App (Val v) (BarrierV n)` reference `n`. If a referencing thread is not blocked on `n`, `waiting n thread` gives `n` reachability by containment; if the parent is blocked on it, the child still references it and is not blocked on it. `n` can be ranked below both endpoints.
- **Sync_step**: removes the barrier and installs `v2`/`v1` into the two endpoints; linearity/`refs_live` guarantees no third reference to the barrier. Objects referenced by the swapped values move by containment between the two threads.
- **NewLock_step**: new lock `n` has token `(n,(Owner,Closed))` in the creator thread and payload `v`; objects referenced by `v` move from containment in the thread to containment in `n`, while `n` is contained in the thread (two `Waiting_reachable` hops).
- **ForkLock_step**: `lockcap_split_weight/open/owner` give the token update (`refcnt` +1, one Owner preserved, Opened count preserved); the child references `LockV n` and is not head-waiting on `n` (freshness/type disjointness of barrier vs lock ids), so `n` stays contained in a reachable, non-blocked thread.
- **Acquire_step**: `(lo,Closed)` becomes `(lo,Opened)`; `Some v -> None`; payload tokens move from the lock's containment to the acquiring thread's containment; `num_open` goes 0→1.
- **Release_step**: reverse; `Opened -> Closed`, `None -> Some`.
- **Wait_step**: consumes the sole `(Owner,Closed)`; `refcnt = 0` forces no Client tokens, so the lock is unreferenced elsewhere and can be removed; payload moves into the waiting thread.
- **Drop_step**: consumes one `(Client,Closed)` and decrements `refcnt`; the lock remains referenced by its Owner/Opened token.

## 5. Honest assessment

The full theorem `typed_full_reachability` is **not reconstructible offline** from my memory within this task. What is verified here is the combinatorial core (rank/well-founded waiting ⇒ full reachability, reference/context lemmas, capability-split arithmetic, initial-typing impossibility facts). The missing large pieces are:
1. a complete runtime/store typing for `BarrierV`/`LockV` with token annotations (including substitution and weakening),
2. preservation of that typing and of `refs_live`/`progress_or_wait`/`rank_ok` across all ten `local_step` cases,
3. the split-aware context lemma (statement identified, proof incomplete).

No complete proof is claimed, and no `Admitted`/`Axiom` was used in any file listed as verified.

From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.
From stdpp Require Import gmap gmultiset.

Definition cap_weight (c : lockcap) : nat :=
  match c.1 with Owner => 0 | Client => 1 end.
Definition cap_open (c : lockcap) : nat :=
  match c.2 with Opened => 1 | Closed => 0 end.
Definition cap_owner (c : lockcap) : nat :=
  match c.1 with Owner => 1 | Client => 0 end.

Lemma lockcap_split_weight l1 l2 l3 :
  lockcap_split l1 l2 l3 ->
  cap_weight l2 + cap_weight l3 = S (cap_weight l1).
Proof.
  intros [Ho Hs].
  destruct l1 as [o1 s1], l2 as [o2 s2], l3 as [o3 s3].
  cbn in *. inversion Ho; subst; inversion Hs; subst; cbn; reflexivity.
Qed.

  cap_open l2 + cap_open l3 = cap_open l1.
Proof.
  intros [Ho Hs].
  destruct l1 as [o1 s1], l2 as [o2 s2], l3 as [o3 s3].
  cbn in *. inversion Ho; subst; inversion Hs; subst; cbn; reflexivity.
Qed.

From Stdlib Require Import Classical_Prop.
Open Scope string_scope.

(* ---------- cfg-specific lookup lemmas ---------- *)
Lemma cfg_empty_lookup (k : nat) : (∅ : cfg) !! k = None.
Proof. unfold cfg. apply lookup_empty. Qed.
Lemma cfg_singleton_lookup i j (o:obj) : ({[i:=o]}:cfg)!!j = if decide (i=j) then Some o else None.
Proof. unfold cfg. apply lookup_singleton. Qed.
Lemma cfg_insert_lookup (m:cfg) i j o : (<[i:=o]>m)!!j = if decide (i=j) then Some o else m!!j.
Proof. unfold cfg. apply lookup_insert. Qed.
Lemma cfg_delete_lookup (m:cfg) i j : (delete i m)!!j = if decide (i=j) then None else m!!j.
Proof. unfold cfg. apply lookup_delete. Qed.
Lemma cfg_union_lookup (m1 m2:cfg) j : (m1 ∪ m2)!!j = m1!!j ∪ m2!!j.
Proof. unfold cfg. apply lookup_union. Qed.
Lemma cfg_multi_lookup2 i n a c k :
  ({[i:=a; n:=c]}:cfg)!!k =
  (if decide (i=k) then Some a else if decide (n=k) then Some c else None).
Proof.
  unfold cfg. repeat rewrite lookup_insert. rewrite lookup_singleton. reflexivity.
Qed.
Lemma cfg_multi_lookup3 i j n a b c k :
  ({[i:=a; j:=b; n:=c]}:cfg)!!k =
  (if decide (i=k) then Some a else if decide (j=k) then Some b else if decide (n=k) then Some c else None).
Proof.
  unfold cfg. repeat rewrite lookup_insert. rewrite lookup_singleton. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma cfg_singleton_delete_union (m:cfg) i o : m!!i = Some o -> ({[i:=o]} ∪ delete i m) = m.
Proof.
  intros H. apply map_eq. intro j. unfold cfg in *.
  rewrite cfg_union_lookup. rewrite cfg_singleton_lookup.
  destruct (decide (i=j)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite cfg_delete_lookup. destruct (decide (j=j)); [|done].
    rewrite union_Some_l. symmetry. exact H.
  - rewrite cfg_delete_lookup. destruct (decide (i=j)); [done|].
    apply option_union_left_id.
Qed.

Lemma cfg_disjoint_singleton_delete i (o:obj) (ρ:cfg) :
  ({[i:=o]}:cfg) ##ₘ delete i ρ.
Proof.
  apply map_disjoint_alt. intro k. rewrite cfg_singleton_lookup. rewrite cfg_delete_lookup.
  destruct (decide (i=k)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - destruct (decide (k=k)); [right; reflexivity|done].
  - destruct (decide (i=k)); [done|left; reflexivity].
Qed.

Lemma cfg_disjoint3_delete i j n a b c (ρ:cfg) :
  i <> j -> i <> n -> j <> n -> ρ!!j = None -> ρ!!n = None ->
  ({[i:=a; j:=b; n:=c]}:cfg) ##ₘ delete i ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hij Hin Hjn Hj Hn. apply map_disjoint_alt. intro k.
  rewrite cfg_multi_lookup3. rewrite cfg_delete_lookup.
  destruct (decide (i=k)) as [E|E].
  - subst. destruct (decide (i=i)); [right; reflexivity|done].
  - rewrite (cfg_delete_lookup ρ i k). destruct (decide (i=k)); [done|].
    destruct (decide (j=k)) as [Ej|Ej].
    + subst. right. exact Hj.
    + destruct (decide (n=k)) as [En|En].
      * subst. right. exact Hn.
      * left. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma cfg_disjoint2_delete i n a c (ρ:cfg) :
  i <> n -> ρ!!n = None ->
  ({[i:=a; n:=c]}:cfg) ##ₘ delete i ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hin Hn. apply map_disjoint_alt. intro k.
  rewrite cfg_multi_lookup2. rewrite cfg_delete_lookup.
  destruct (decide (i=k)) as [E|E].
  - subst. destruct (decide (i=i)); [right; reflexivity|done].
  - destruct (decide (i=k)); [done|].
    destruct (decide (n=k)) as [En|En].
    + subst. right. exact Hn.
    + left. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma cfg_union_empty_l (m:cfg) : (∅ : cfg) ∪ m = m.
Proof. apply map_eq. intro k. rewrite cfg_union_lookup. rewrite cfg_empty_lookup. reflexivity. Qed.

(* ---------- thread progress ---------- *)
Lemma thread_can_or_wait (L : gmap nat type) (ρ : cfg) i e :
  ρ !! i = Some (Thread e) ->
  wt L ∅ e UnitT ->
  can_step ρ i \/ exists j, waiting ρ i j.
Proof.
  intros Hi Hwt.
  destruct (progress_gen L ∅ e UnitT Hwt eq_refl) as
      [v [t Hcv] | k e0 e0' Hk Hps | k v Hk | k v Hk | e0 j Hw].
  - (* P_val : e = Val v, typed UnitT, so v = UnitV *)
    inversion Hwt; subst; clear Hwt.
    match goal with Hc : cv L v UnitT |- _ => apply cv_unit_inv in Hc end.
    subst v.
    left. exists (delete i ρ).
    rewrite <- (cfg_singleton_delete_union ρ i (Thread (Val UnitV)) Hi).
    eapply Frame_step.
    + apply cfg_disjoint_singleton_delete.
    + apply map_disjoint_empty_l.
    + apply Exit_step.
  - (* P_pure *)
    left. exists (delete i ρ).
    rewrite <- (cfg_singleton_delete_union ρ i (Thread (k e0)) Hi).
    eapply Frame_step.
    + apply cfg_disjoint_singleton_delete.
    + apply cfg_disjoint_singleton_delete.
    + eapply Pure_step; [exact Hk|exact Hps].
  - (* P_fork *)
    set (n := fresh (dom ρ)).
    set (j := fresh (dom ρ ∪ {[n]})).
    assert (Hn : ρ!!n = None) by (unfold n; apply not_elem_of_dom; apply is_fresh).
    assert (Hjf : j ∉ dom ρ ∪ {[n]}) by (unfold j; apply is_fresh).
    assert (Hj : ρ!!j = None) by (apply not_elem_of_dom; set_solver).
    assert (Hjn : j <> n) by (intro E; apply Hjf; subst; set_solver).
    assert (Hin : i <> n) by (intro E; subst; rewrite Hi in Hn; done).
    assert (Hij : i <> j) by (intro E; subst; rewrite Hi in Hj; done).
    left. exists ({[i := Thread (k (Val (BarrierV n)));
                        j := Thread (App (Val v) (Val (BarrierV n)));
                        n := Barrier]} ∪ delete i ρ).
    rewrite <- (cfg_singleton_delete_union ρ i (Thread (k (ForkBarrier (Val v)))) Hi).
    eapply Frame_step.
    + apply cfg_disjoint_singleton_delete.
    + apply cfg_disjoint3_delete; [exact Hij|exact Hin|exact Hjn|exact Hj|exact Hn].
    + eapply Fork_step; [exact Hij|exact Hin|exact Hjn|exact Hk].
  - (* P_newlock *)
    set (n := fresh (dom ρ)).
    assert (Hn : ρ!!n = None) by (unfold n; apply not_elem_of_dom; apply is_fresh).
    assert (Hin : i <> n) by (intro E; subst; rewrite Hi in Hn; done).
    left. exists ({[i := Thread (k (Val (LockV n)));
                        n := Lock 0 (Some v)]} ∪ delete i ρ).
    rewrite <- (cfg_singleton_delete_union ρ i (Thread (k (NewLock (Val v)))) Hi).
    eapply Frame_step.
    + apply cfg_disjoint_singleton_delete.
    + apply cfg_disjoint2_delete; [exact Hin|exact Hn].
    + eapply NewLock_step; [exact Hin|exact Hk].
  - (* P_wait *)
    right. exists j. left. exists e0. split; [exact Hi| exact Hw].
Qed.
EOF

ρ !! i = Some (Thread e) ->
  wt L ∅ e UnitT ->
  can_step ρ i \/ exists j, waiting ρ i j.
Proof.
  intros Hi Hwt.
  destruct (progress_gen L ∅ e UnitT Hwt eq_refl) as
      [v [t Hcv] | k e0 e0' Hk Hps | k v Hk | k v Hk | e0 j Hw].
  - (* P_val : e = Val v, typed UnitT, so v = UnitV *)
    inversion Hwt; subst; clear Hwt.
    match goal with Hc : cv L v UnitT |- _ => apply cv_unit_inv in Hc end.
    subst v.
    left. exists (delete i ρ).
    rewrite <- (cfg_singleton_delete_union ρ i (Thread (Val UnitV)) Hi) at 1.
    eapply Frame_step.
    + apply cfg_disjoint_singleton_delete.
    + apply map_disjoint_empty_l.
    + apply Exit_step.
  - (* P_pure *)
    left. exists (delete i ρ).
    rewrite <- (cfg_singleton_delete_union ρ i (Thread (k e0)) Hi) at 1.
    eapply Frame_step.
    + apply cfg_disjoint_singleton_delete.
    + apply cfg_disjoint_singleton_delete.
    + eapply Pure_step; [exact Hk|exact Hps].
  - (* P_fork *)
    set (n := fresh (dom ρ)).
    set (j := fresh (dom ρ ∪ {[n]})).
    assert (Hn : ρ!!n = None) by (unfold n; apply not_elem_of_dom; apply is_fresh).
    assert (Hjf : j ∉ dom ρ ∪ {[n]}) by (unfold j; apply is_fresh).
    assert (Hj : ρ!!j = None) by (apply not_elem_of_dom; set_solver).
    assert (Hjn : j <> n) by (intro E; apply Hjf; subst; set_solver).
    assert (Hin : i <> n) by (intro E; subst; rewrite Hi in Hn; done).
    assert (Hij : i <> j) by (intro E; subst; rewrite Hi in Hj; done).
    left. exists ({[i := Thread (k (Val (BarrierV n)));
                        j := Thread (App (Val v) (Val (BarrierV n)));
                        n := Barrier]} ∪ delete i ρ).
    rewrite <- (cfg_singleton_delete_union ρ i (Thread (k (ForkBarrier (Val v)))) Hi) at 1.
    eapply Frame_step.
    + apply cfg_disjoint_singleton_delete.
    + apply cfg_disjoint3_delete; [exact Hij|exact Hin|exact Hjn|exact Hj|exact Hn].
    + eapply Fork_step; [exact Hij|exact Hin|exact Hjn|exact Hk].
  - (* P_newlock *)
    set (n := fresh (dom ρ)).
    assert (Hn : ρ!!n = None) by (unfold n; apply not_elem_of_dom; apply is_fresh).
    assert (Hin : i <> n) by (intro E; subst; rewrite Hi in Hn; done).
    left. exists ({[i := Thread (k (Val (LockV n)));
                        n := Lock 0 (Some v)]} ∪ delete i ρ).
    rewrite <- (cfg_singleton_delete_union ρ i (Thread (k (NewLock (Val v)))) Hi) at 1.
    eapply Frame_step.
    + apply cfg_disjoint_singleton_delete.
    + apply cfg_disjoint2_delete; [exact Hin|exact Hn].
    + eapply NewLock_step; [exact Hin|exact Hk].
  - (* P_wait *)
    right. exists j. left. exists e0. split; [exact Hi| exact Hw].
Qed.

From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String.
From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.
From stdpp Require Import gmap gmultiset.
Open Scope string_scope.

(* Countability/EqDecision for parts of lockcap *)
#[global] Instance lockownership_eq_dec : EqDecision lockownership.
Proof. solve_decision. Defined.
#[global] Instance lockstate_eq_dec : EqDecision lockstate.
Proof. solve_decision. Defined.
Definition lo_to_nat (x : lockownership) : nat := match x with Owner => 0 | Client => 1 end.
Definition nat_to_lo (n : nat) : option lockownership :=
  match n with 0 => Some Owner | 1 => Some Client | _ => None end.
#[global] Instance lo_countable : Countable lockownership.
Proof. apply (inj_countable lo_to_nat nat_to_lo). intros []; reflexivity. Defined.
Definition ls_to_nat (x : lockstate) : nat := match x with Opened => 0 | Closed => 1 end.
Definition nat_to_ls (n : nat) : option lockstate :=
  match n with 0 => Some Opened | 1 => Some Closed | _ => None end.
#[global] Instance ls_countable : Countable lockstate.
Proof. apply (inj_countable ls_to_nat nat_to_ls). intros []; reflexivity. Defined.

Inductive token :=
  | TLock (n : nat) (c : lockcap)
  | TBar (n : nat) (b : bool).
#[global] Instance token_eq_dec : EqDecision token. Proof. solve_decision. Defined.
Definition tok_to_nat (t : token) : nat :=
  match t with
  | TLock n c => 2 * n + (match c.1 with Owner => 0 | Client => 1 end) * 2 + (match c.2 with Opened => 0 | Closed => 1 end)
  | TBar n b => 2 * n + 2 + (if b then 1 else 0)
  end.
Definition nat_to_tok (k : nat) : option token :=
  match k with
  | 0 => Some (TLock 0 (Owner,Opened))
  | 1 => Some (TLock 0 (Owner,Closed))
  | 2 => Some (TLock 0 (Client,Opened))
  | 3 => Some (TLock 0 (Client,Closed))
  | _ => None
  end.
(* We only need Countable token for gmultiset, not its exact encoding. *)
Section countable.
(* Use an injective encoding via a simpler scheme: encode token by a pair of nat and nat. *)
Definition tok_enc (t : token) : (nat * nat)%type :=
  match t with
  | TLock n c => (2*n, match c.1 with Owner => 0 | Client => 1 end * 2 + match c.2 with Opened => 0 | Closed => 1 end)
  | TBar n b => (2*n+1, if b then 1 else 0)
  end.
Definition tok_dec (p : (nat*nat)%type) : option token :=
  match p.1 with
  | O => None (* unused; impossible since TLock has even 2*n *)
  | S k =>
    let n := k / 2 in
    match Nat.even (S k), Nat.even p.2 with
    | true, true => Some (TBar n true)
    | true, false => Some (TBar n false)
    | false, true => Some (TLock ((S k)/2) (Owner,Opened))
    | false, false => Some (TLock ((S k)/2) (Owner,Closed))
    end
  end.
End countable.
(* Instead of a complicated countable instance, use a direct one via nat encoding by hand is
   error-prone; gmultiset only needs Countable. We use the fact that token is a finite
   combination of Countable types: encode as sum. *)
Definition token_to_sum (t : token) : (nat * lockcap) + (nat * bool) :=
  match t with TLock n c => inl (n,c) | TBar n b => inr (n,b) end.
Definition sum_to_token (s : (nat * lockcap) + (nat * bool)) : token :=
  match s with inl (n,c) => TLock n c | inr (n,b) => TBar n b end.
#[global] Instance token_countable : Countable token.
Proof.
  apply (inj_countable token_to_sum sum_to_token).
  intros []; reflexivity.
Defined.

Definition tset := gmultiset token.

Inductive rtyped (L : gmap nat type) (B : gmap nat (type * type)) :
  env -> tset -> expr -> type -> Prop :=
  | RVar Γ x t :
      env_var Γ x t ->
      rtyped L B Γ ∅ (Var x) t
  | RFun Γ Γ' x e t1 t2 l Ξ :
      env_bind Γ' x t1 Γ ->
      (l = Unr -> env_unr Γ) ->
      rtyped L B Γ' Ξ e t2 ->
      (l = Unr -> Ξ = ∅) ->
      rtyped L B Γ Ξ (Fun x e) (FunT l t1 t2)
  | RApp Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 l Ξ1 Ξ2 :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      rtyped L B Γ1 Ξ1 e1 (FunT l t1 t2) ->
      rtyped L B Γ2 Ξ2 e2 t1 ->
      rtyped L B Γ (Ξ1 ⊎ Ξ2) (App e1 e2) t2
  | RUnit Γ :
      env_unr Γ ->
      rtyped L B Γ ∅ Unit UnitT
  | RPair Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 Ξ1 Ξ2 :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      rtyped L B Γ1 Ξ1 e1 t1 ->
      rtyped L B Γ2 Ξ2 e2 t2 ->
      rtyped L B Γ (Ξ1 ⊎ Ξ2) (Pair e1 e2) (PairT t1 t2)
  | RLetPair Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 t Ξ1 Ξ2 :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      rtyped L B Γ1 Ξ1 e1 (PairT t1 t2) ->
      rtyped L B Γ2 Ξ2 e2 (FunT Lin t1 (FunT Lin t2 t)) ->
      rtyped L B Γ (Ξ1 ⊎ Ξ2) (LetPair e1 e2) t
  | RSum Γ n (ts : fin n -> type) i e Ξ :
      rtyped L B Γ Ξ e (ts i) ->
      rtyped L B Γ Ξ (Sum i e) (SumT n ts)
  | RMatchSum n Γ Γ1 Γ2 t (ts : fin n -> type) es e Ξ1 Ξ2 :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      (n = 0 -> env_unr Γ2) ->
      rtyped L B Γ1 Ξ1 e (SumT n ts) ->
      (forall i, rtyped L B Γ2 Ξ2 (es i) (FunT Lin (ts i) t)) ->
      rtyped L B Γ (Ξ1 ⊎ Ξ2) (MatchSum n e es) t
  | RFork Γ e t1 t2 Ξ :
      rtyped L B Γ Ξ e (FunT Lin (FunT Lin t2 t1) UnitT) ->
      rtyped L B Γ Ξ (ForkBarrier e) (FunT Lin t1 t2)
  | RNewLock Γ e t Ξ :
      rtyped L B Γ Ξ e t ->
      rtyped L B Γ Ξ (NewLock e) (LockT (Owner,Closed) t)
  | RForkLock Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t l1 l2 l3 Ξ1 Ξ2 :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      lockcap_split l1 l2 l3 ->
      rtyped L B Γ1 Ξ1 e1 (LockT l1 t) ->
      rtyped L B Γ2 Ξ2 e2 (FunT Lin (LockT l2 t) UnitT) ->
      rtyped L B Γ (Ξ1 ⊎ Ξ2) (ForkLock e1 e2) (LockT l3 t)
  | RAcquire Γ e t lo Ξ :
      rtyped L B Γ Ξ e (LockT (lo,Closed) t) ->
      rtyped L B Γ Ξ (Acquire e) (PairT (LockT (lo,Opened) t) t)
  | RRelease Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t lo Ξ1 Ξ2 :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      rtyped L B Γ1 Ξ1 e1 (LockT (lo,Opened) t) ->
      rtyped L B Γ2 Ξ2 e2 t ->
      rtyped L B Γ (Ξ1 ⊎ Ξ2) (Release e1 e2) (LockT (lo,Closed) t)
  | RWait Γ e t Ξ :
      rtyped L B Γ Ξ e (LockT (Owner,Closed) t) ->
      rtyped L B Γ Ξ (Wait e) t
  | RDrop Γ e t Ξ :
      rtyped L B Γ Ξ e (LockT (Client,Closed) t) ->
      rtyped L B Γ Ξ (Drop e) UnitT
  | RVal Γ v t Ξ :
      env_unr Γ ->
      rvtyped v t Ξ ->
      rtyped L B Γ Ξ (Val v) t
with rvtyped (L : gmap nat type) (B : gmap nat (type * type)) :
  val -> type -> tset -> Prop :=
  | RFunV x e t1 t2 l Ξ :
      rtyped L B (<[x:=t1]>∅) Ξ e t2 ->
      (l = Unr -> Ξ = ∅) ->
      rvtyped (FunV x e) (FunT l t1 t2) Ξ
  | RUnitV : rvtyped UnitV UnitT ∅
  | RPairV v1 v2 t1 t2 Ξ1 Ξ2 :
      rvtyped v1 t1 Ξ1 -> rvtyped v2 t2 Ξ2 ->
      rvtyped (PairV v1 v2) (PairT t1 t2) (Ξ1 ⊎ Ξ2)
  | RSumV n (ts : fin n -> type) i v Ξ :
      rvtyped v (ts i) Ξ ->
      rvtyped (SumV i v) (SumT n ts) Ξ
  | RLockV n lc t :
      L !! n = Some t ->
      rvtyped (LockV n) (LockT lc t) {[TLock n lc]}
  | RBarrierV_l n t1 t2 :
      B !! n = Some (t1,t2) ->
      rvtyped (BarrierV n) (FunT Lin t1 t2) {[TBar n true]}
  | RBarrierV_r n t1 t2 :
      B !! n = Some (t1,t2) ->
      rvtyped (BarrierV n) (FunT Lin t2 t1) {[TBar n false]}.

Check rtyped.
Check rvtyped.
EOF

39	Definition lockcap : Type := lockownership * lockstate.

41	Inductive lockownership_split : lockownership -> lockownership -> lockownership -> Prop :=

43	  | lo_split_2 : lockownership_split Owner Owner Client
44	  | lo_split_3 : lockownership_split Client Client Client.

48	  | ls_split_2 : lockstate_split Opened Opened Closed
49	  | ls_split_3 : lockstate_split Closed Closed Closed.
50	
51	Definition lockcap_split l1 l2 l3 :=
52	  lockownership_split l1.1 l2.1 l3.1 ∧ lockstate_split l1.2 l2.2 l3.2.
53	
54	CoInductive type :=
55	  | FunT : linearity -> type -> type -> type
56	  | UnitT : type
57	  | PairT : type -> type -> type
58	  | SumT n : (fin n -> type) -> type
59	  | LockT : lockcap -> type -> type.

61	CoInductive unr : type -> Prop :=
62	  | Fun_unr t1 t2 : unr (FunT Unr t1 t2)
63	  | Unit_unr : unr UnitT
64	  | Pair_unr t1 t2 : unr t1 -> unr t2 -> unr (PairT t1 t2)
65	  | Sum_unr n ts : (∀ i, unr (ts i)) -> unr (SumT n ts).

69	Definition env_unr (Γ : env) :=
70	  ∀ x t, Γ !! x = Some t -> unr t.

From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.

From Stdlib Require Import Classical_Prop Wellfounded Wf_nat Lia.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* A sufficient combinatorial condition for full reachability.        *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* [waiting ρ i j] is the "i depends on j" relation.  If it admits a  *)
(* rank that strictly increases along waiting edges, then reachability *)
(* propagates back along those edges from any [can_step] seed.        *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition wait_wf (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  well_founded (fun j i => waiting ρ i j).

Definition progress_or_wait (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i, ρ !! i <> None -> can_step ρ i \/ exists j, waiting ρ i j.

Definition wait_targets_live (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i e j, ρ !! i = Some (Thread e) -> expr_waiting e j -> ρ !! j <> None.

Definition rank_ok (ρ : cfg) (r : nat -> nat) (M : nat) : Prop :=
  (forall i, r i <= M) /\ (forall i j, waiting ρ i j -> r i < r j).

Lemma rank_ok_wait_wf ρ r M :
  rank_ok ρ r M -> wait_wf ρ.
Proof.
  intros [Hb Hr]. unfold wait_wf.
  apply (Wf_nat.well_founded_lt_compat
           nat (fun i => M - r i) (fun j i => waiting ρ i j)).
  intros x y Hxy. pose proof (Hr y x Hxy) as Hlt.
  pose proof (Hb x). pose proof (Hb y). lia.
Qed.

Lemma wait_wf_fully_reachable ρ :
  wait_wf ρ -> progress_or_wait ρ -> wait_targets_live ρ -> fully_reachable ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hwf Hprog Hlive i.
  apply (well_founded_ind Hwf (fun i => inactive ρ i \/ reachable ρ i)).
  intros x IH.
  destruct (classic (inactive ρ x)) as [Hin | Hact].
  - left; exact Hin.
  - right.
    destruct (Hprog x Hact) as [Hstep | [j Hwait]].
    + apply Can_step_reachable; exact Hstep.
    + destruct (IH j Hwait) as [Hinj | Hrj].
      * destruct Hwait as [[e [He Hw]] | [y [Hy _]]].
        -- exfalso. exact (Hlive x e j He Hw Hinj).
        -- unfold inactive in Hinj. rewrite Hy in Hinj. discriminate.
      * apply Waiting_reachable with j; assumption.
Qed.

Theorem rank_fully_reachable ρ r M :
  rank_ok ρ r M -> progress_or_wait ρ -> wait_targets_live ρ ->
  fully_reachable ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hr Hp Hl.
  apply wait_wf_fully_reachable.
  - apply rank_ok_wait_wf with (r := r) (M := M); exact Hr.
  - exact Hp.
  - exact Hl.
Qed.

Theorem typed_full_reachability e ρ :
  typed ∅ e UnitT -> steps {[ 0 := Thread e ]} ρ -> fully_reachable ρ.

For P to get both, B would need to send two caps over possibly two barrier exchanges with P (B is a ForkBarrier child of P, but that barrier was consumed by the first exchange; can B and P have a second barrier? P would need to create another barrier with B as the body, but B is already a thread; a ForkBarrier creates a *new* child, it can't target existing B. So only one exchange per parent-barrier child pair.)
Could B send a *value containing two caps* in one exchange? Yes! If B holds two caps for the same lock M, it can send a PairV containing both to P over the barrier (the exchange value type can be a pair of LockT). Then P receives both. Can B create/hold two caps for M? B creates M (Owner), then ForkLock M creates child C with a cap, B retains a cap. B has one cap; not two. ForkLock split gives one to B, one to C. B could acquire C's cap? C is ForkLock child, no upward channel. B could ForkLock M again: B has one cap l3; fork again, B retains l3', child C2 gets l2. Still B has one. Repeated forks never increase B's own cap count; each fork moves a new cap to a child while B keeps one. So B can't hold two caps for M. Could B hold caps for M through *acquiring*? Acquire returns the content, not another cap for M; the acquired pair contains one M cap (Opened) plus content. If content contains an M cap (self-referential lock), then B would have two; but creating a self-referential lock requires storing an M cap in M before acquiring, which consumes a cap and leaves... To create M with content containing another M cap, need two caps at creation: circular.
So maybe a single thread can never hold two capabilities for the same lock! If true, self-deadlock is impossible. Two-thread deadlock: thread A holds cap for L1 and waits L2; thread B holds cap for L2 and waits L1. Each thread holds one cap per lock, allowed. Can this arise? A and B are different children; communication tree might prevent cross-holding. The type system's tree may ensure a lock's capabilities form a tree rooted at the creator, and wait-for cycles would imply a cycle in the tree—impossible.

Each cap occurrence's location (thread/lock content) is a node; the tree is over caps, with root Owner. Transfers move a cap between locations but don't change the tree. Acquire/Release change states but not parent links. Wait/Drop consume leaves. Then a thread holding two caps for the same lock is possible in the tree (e.g., root and a descendant) if transferred; but transfers between threads are constrained. A deadlock cycle would require a cyclic waiting among tree nodes; maybe the tree depth gives a rank! - A thread waiting on lock n holds some other cap? The lock n's state is controlled by the cap of some holder; the waiter's rank vs holder's depth...

Each runtime LockV occurrence has a cap identity; syntax doesn't store it, but we can annotate/ghost it via a decoration relation. Again annotation work.

From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.

From Stdlib Require Import Classical_Prop Wellfounded Wf_nat Lia.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* A sufficient combinatorial condition for full reachability.        *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* [waiting ρ i j] is the "i depends on j" relation.  If it admits a  *)
(* rank that strictly increases along waiting edges, then reachability *)
(* propagates back along those edges from any [can_step] seed.        *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition wait_wf (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  well_founded (fun j i => waiting ρ i j).

Definition progress_or_wait (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i, ρ !! i <> None -> can_step ρ i \/ exists j, waiting ρ i j.

Definition wait_targets_live (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i e j, ρ !! i = Some (Thread e) -> expr_waiting e j -> ρ !! j <> None.

Definition rank_ok (ρ : cfg) (r : nat -> nat) (M : nat) : Prop :=
  (forall i, r i <= M) /\ (forall i j, waiting ρ i j -> r i < r j).

Lemma rank_ok_wait_wf ρ r M :
  rank_ok ρ r M -> wait_wf ρ.
Proof.
  intros [Hb Hr]. unfold wait_wf.
  apply (Wf_nat.well_founded_lt_compat
           nat (fun i => M - r i) (fun j i => waiting ρ i j)).
  intros x y Hxy. pose proof (Hr y x Hxy) as Hlt.
  pose proof (Hb x). pose proof (Hb y). lia.
Qed.

Lemma wait_wf_fully_reachable ρ :
  wait_wf ρ -> progress_or_wait ρ -> wait_targets_live ρ -> fully_reachable ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hwf Hprog Hlive i.
  apply (well_founded_ind Hwf (fun i => inactive ρ i \/ reachable ρ i)).
  intros x IH.
  destruct (classic (inactive ρ x)) as [Hin | Hact].
  - left; exact Hin.
  - right.
    destruct (Hprog x Hact) as [Hstep | [j Hwait]].
    + apply Can_step_reachable; exact Hstep.
    + destruct (IH j Hwait) as [Hinj | Hrj].
      * destruct Hwait as [[e [He Hw]] | [y [Hy _]]].
        -- exfalso. exact (Hlive x e j He Hw Hinj).
        -- unfold inactive in Hinj. rewrite Hy in Hinj. discriminate.
      * apply Waiting_reachable with j; assumption.
Qed.

Theorem rank_fully_reachable ρ r M :
  rank_ok ρ r M -> progress_or_wait ρ -> wait_targets_live ρ ->
  fully_reachable ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hr Hp Hl.
  apply wait_wf_fully_reachable.
  - apply rank_ok_wait_wf with (r := r) (M := M); exact Hr.
  - exact Hp.
  - exact Hl.
Qed.

Theorem typed_full_reachability e ρ :
  typed ∅ e UnitT -> steps {[ 0 := Thread e ]} ρ -> fully_reachable ρ.

(* rank that strictly increases along waiting edges, then reachability *)
(* propagates back along those edges from any [can_step] seed.        *)

Definition rank_ok (ρ : cfg) (r : nat -> nat) (M : nat) : Prop :=
  (forall i, r i <= M) /\ (forall i j, waiting ρ i j -> r i < r j).

  rank_ok ρ r M -> wait_wf ρ.

From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.

From Stdlib Require Import Classical_Prop Wellfounded Wf_nat Lia.
From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String Eqdep_dec.
Open Scope string_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Runtime typing for configurations.                                 *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* Source terms are Val-free, so [typed] cannot type configurations   *)
(* produced by reduction.  [wt] extends it with runtime values [cv].  *)
(* Values are environment-independent (they are closed).               *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Inductive wt (L : gmap nat type) : env -> expr -> type -> Prop :=
  | VarW Γ x t :
      env_var Γ x t ->
      wt L Γ (Var x) t
  | FunW Γ Γ' x e t1 t2 l :
      env_bind Γ' x t1 Γ ->
      (l = Unr -> env_unr Γ) ->
      wt L Γ' e t2 ->
      wt L Γ (Fun x e) (FunT l t1 t2)
  | AppW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 l :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (FunT l t1 t2) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 t1 ->
      wt L Γ (App e1 e2) t2
  | UnitW Γ :
      env_unr Γ ->
      wt L Γ Unit UnitT
  | PairW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 t1 ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 t2 ->
      wt L Γ (Pair e1 e2) (PairT t1 t2)
  | LetPairW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 t :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (PairT t1 t2) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 (FunT Lin t1 (FunT Lin t2 t)) ->
      wt L Γ (LetPair e1 e2) t
  | SumW Γ n (ts : fin n -> type) i e :
      wt L Γ e (ts i) ->
      wt L Γ (Sum i e) (SumT n ts)
  | MatchSumW n Γ Γ1 Γ2 t (ts : fin n -> type) es e :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      (n = 0 -> env_unr Γ2) ->
      wt L Γ1 e (SumT n ts) ->
      (forall i, wt L Γ2 (es i) (FunT Lin (ts i) t)) ->
      wt L Γ (MatchSum n e es) t
  | ForkW Γ e t1 t2 :
      wt L Γ e (FunT Lin (FunT Lin t2 t1) UnitT) ->
      wt L Γ (ForkBarrier e) (FunT Lin t1 t2)
  | NewLockW Γ e t :
      wt L Γ e t ->
      wt L Γ (NewLock e) (LockT (Owner,Closed) t)
  | ForkLockW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t l1 l2 l3 :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      lockcap_split l1 l2 l3 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (LockT l1 t) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 (FunT Lin (LockT l2 t) UnitT) ->
      wt L Γ (ForkLock e1 e2) (LockT l3 t)
  | AcquireW Γ e t lo :
      wt L Γ e (LockT (lo,Closed) t) ->
      wt L Γ (Acquire e) (PairT (LockT (lo,Opened) t) t)
  | ReleaseW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t lo :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (LockT (lo,Opened) t) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 t ->
      wt L Γ (Release e1 e2) (LockT (lo,Closed) t)
  | WaitW Γ e t :
      wt L Γ e (LockT (Owner,Closed) t) ->
      wt L Γ (Wait e) t
  | DropW Γ e t :
      wt L Γ e (LockT (Client,Closed) t) ->
      wt L Γ (Drop e) UnitT
  | ValW Γ v t :
      env_unr Γ ->
      cv L v t ->
      wt L Γ (Val v) t
with cv (L : gmap nat type) : val -> type -> Prop :=
  | FunVW x e t1 t2 l :
      wt L (<[ x := t1 ]> (∅ : env)) e t2 ->
      cv L (FunV x e) (FunT l t1 t2)
  | UnitVW : cv L UnitV UnitT
  | PairVW v1 v2 t1 t2 :
      cv L v1 t1 -> cv L v2 t2 ->
      cv L (PairV v1 v2) (PairT t1 t2)
  | SumVW n (ts : fin n -> type) i v :
      cv L v (ts i) ->
      cv L (SumV i v) (SumT n ts)
  | BarrierVW n t1 t2 :
      cv L (BarrierV n) (FunT Lin t1 t2)
  | LockVW n lc t :
      L !! n = Some t ->
      cv L (LockV n) (LockT lc t).

(* ---------- gmap / environment helpers ---------- *)

Lemma env_lookup_insert_same x (t : type) : (<[x:=t]>(∅ : env)) !! x = Some t.
Proof. unfold env in *. apply lookup_insert_eq. Qed.

Lemma env_lookup_insert_none x y (t : type) (Γ : env) : x <> y -> Γ !! y = None -> (<[x:=t]>Γ) !! y = None.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. intros Hne Hy.
  rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x y t Hne). done.
Qed.

Lemma env_unr_delete x (Γ : env) : env_unr Γ -> env_unr (delete x Γ).
Proof.
  intros H y t Hy. unfold env_unr in H. unfold env in *.
  destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_eq Γ y) in Hy. done.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ x y E) in Hy. apply H in Hy. done.
Qed.

Lemma env_unr_insert_lookup x (t : type) (Γ : env) :
  env_unr (<[x:=t]>Γ) -> unr t.
Proof. intros H. unfold env_unr in H. apply (H x t). unfold env. apply lookup_insert_eq. Qed.

Lemma env_union_empty_l (m : env) : ∅ ∪ m = m.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro x. rewrite lookup_union.
  assert (H : (∅ : gmap string type) !! x = None) by apply lookup_empty.
  rewrite H. destruct (m !! x); done.
Qed.

Lemma env_union_empty_r (m : env) : m ∪ ∅ = m.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro x. rewrite lookup_union.
  assert (H : (∅ : gmap string type) !! x = None) by apply lookup_empty.
  rewrite H. destruct (m !! x); done.
Qed.

Lemma env_split_empty (Γ1 Γ2 : env) : env_split ∅ Γ1 Γ2 -> Γ1 = ∅ /\ Γ2 = ∅.
Proof.
  unfold env in *.
  intros [Hun Hdis]. symmetry in Hun.
  apply map_positive_l in Hun as H1. subst Γ1.
  rewrite env_union_empty_l in Hun. subst Γ2. split; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma disj_delete x (Γ1 Γ2 : env) : disj Γ1 Γ2 -> disj (delete x Γ1) (delete x Γ2).
Proof.
  unfold env in *.
  intros H i t1 t2 H1 H2.
  destruct (decide (x=i)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_eq Γ1 i) in H1. done.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ1 x i E) in H1. rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ2 x i E) in H2. apply (H i t1 t2 H1 H2).
Qed.

Lemma delete_insert_none x (t : type) (Γ : env) : Γ !! x = None -> delete x (<[x:=t]>Γ) = Γ.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. intros Hx. apply map_eq. intro y. destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_eq (<[y:=t]>Γ) y). done.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_ne (<[x:=t]>Γ) x y E). rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x y t E). done.
Qed.

Lemma delete_none x (Γ : env) : Γ !! x = None -> delete x Γ = Γ.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. intros Hx. apply map_eq. intro y. destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_eq Γ y). done.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ x y E). done.
Qed.

Lemma insert_delete_same x (t : type) (Γ : env) : Γ !! x = Some t -> <[x:=t]>(delete x Γ) = Γ.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. intros Hx. apply map_eq. intro y. destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (delete y Γ) y t). symmetry. done.
  - rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (delete x Γ) x y t E). rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ x y E). done.
Qed.

Proof.
  unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro y. destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (<[y:=t1]>Γ) y t2). rewrite (lookup_insert_eq Γ y t2). done.
  - rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[x:=t1]>Γ) x y t2 E).
    rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x y t2 E).
    rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x y t1 E). done.
Qed.

Lemma insert_insert_comm x y (t1 t2 : type) (Γ : env) : x <> y ->
  <[x:=t1]>(<[y:=t2]>Γ) = <[y:=t2]>(<[x:=t1]>Γ).
Proof.
  intros Hne. unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro z.
  destruct (decide (z=x)) as [E1|E1].
  - subst z.
    destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E2|E2].
    + exfalso. apply Hne. done.
    + rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (<[y:=t2]>Γ) x t1).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[x:=t1]>Γ) y x t2 (fun H => E2 (eq_sym H))).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_eq Γ x t1). done.
  - destruct (decide (z=y)) as [E2|E2].
    + subst z.
      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[y:=t2]>Γ) x y t1 Hne).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_eq Γ y t2).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (<[x:=t1]>Γ) y t2). done.
    + rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[y:=t2]>Γ) x z t1 (fun H => E1 (eq_sym H))).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ y z t2 (fun H => E2 (eq_sym H))).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[x:=t1]>Γ) y z t2 (fun H => E2 (eq_sym H))).

From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.

From Stdlib Require Import Classical_Prop Wellfounded Wf_nat Lia.
From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String Eqdep_dec.
Open Scope string_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Runtime typing for configurations.                                 *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* Source terms are Val-free, so [typed] cannot type configurations   *)
(* produced by reduction.  [wt] extends it with runtime values [cv].  *)
(* Values are environment-independent (they are closed).               *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Inductive wt (L : gmap nat type) : env -> expr -> type -> Prop :=
  | VarW Γ x t :
      env_var Γ x t ->
      wt L Γ (Var x) t
  | FunW Γ Γ' x e t1 t2 l :
      env_bind Γ' x t1 Γ ->
      (l = Unr -> env_unr Γ) ->
      wt L Γ' e t2 ->
      wt L Γ (Fun x e) (FunT l t1 t2)
  | AppW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 l :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (FunT l t1 t2) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 t1 ->
      wt L Γ (App e1 e2) t2
  | UnitW Γ :
      env_unr Γ ->
      wt L Γ Unit UnitT
  | PairW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 t1 ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 t2 ->
      wt L Γ (Pair e1 e2) (PairT t1 t2)
  | LetPairW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 t :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (PairT t1 t2) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 (FunT Lin t1 (FunT Lin t2 t)) ->
      wt L Γ (LetPair e1 e2) t
  | SumW Γ n (ts : fin n -> type) i e :
      wt L Γ e (ts i) ->
      wt L Γ (Sum i e) (SumT n ts)
  | MatchSumW n Γ Γ1 Γ2 t (ts : fin n -> type) es e :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      (n = 0 -> env_unr Γ2) ->
      wt L Γ1 e (SumT n ts) ->
      (forall i, wt L Γ2 (es i) (FunT Lin (ts i) t)) ->
      wt L Γ (MatchSum n e es) t
  | ForkW Γ e t1 t2 :
      wt L Γ e (FunT Lin (FunT Lin t2 t1) UnitT) ->
      wt L Γ (ForkBarrier e) (FunT Lin t1 t2)
  | NewLockW Γ e t :
      wt L Γ e t ->
      wt L Γ (NewLock e) (LockT (Owner,Closed) t)
  | ForkLockW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t l1 l2 l3 :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      lockcap_split l1 l2 l3 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (LockT l1 t) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 (FunT Lin (LockT l2 t) UnitT) ->
      wt L Γ (ForkLock e1 e2) (LockT l3 t)
  | AcquireW Γ e t lo :
      wt L Γ e (LockT (lo,Closed) t) ->
      wt L Γ (Acquire e) (PairT (LockT (lo,Opened) t) t)
  | ReleaseW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t lo :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (LockT (lo,Opened) t) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 t ->
      wt L Γ (Release e1 e2) (LockT (lo,Closed) t)
  | WaitW Γ e t :
      wt L Γ e (LockT (Owner,Closed) t) ->
      wt L Γ (Wait e) t
  | DropW Γ e t :
      wt L Γ e (LockT (Client,Closed) t) ->
      wt L Γ (Drop e) UnitT
  | ValW Γ v t :
      env_unr Γ ->
      cv L v t ->
      wt L Γ (Val v) t
with cv (L : gmap nat type) : val -> type -> Prop :=
  | FunVW x e t1 t2 l :
      wt L (<[ x := t1 ]> (∅ : env)) e t2 ->
      cv L (FunV x e) (FunT l t1 t2)
  | UnitVW : cv L UnitV UnitT
  | PairVW v1 v2 t1 t2 :
      cv L v1 t1 -> cv L v2 t2 ->
      cv L (PairV v1 v2) (PairT t1 t2)
  | SumVW n (ts : fin n -> type) i v :
      cv L v (ts i) ->
      cv L (SumV i v) (SumT n ts)
  | BarrierVW n t1 t2 :
      cv L (BarrierV n) (FunT Lin t1 t2)
  | LockVW n lc t :
      L !! n = Some t ->
      cv L (LockV n) (LockT lc t).

(* ---------- gmap / environment helpers ---------- *)

Lemma env_lookup_insert_same x (t : type) : (<[x:=t]>(∅ : env)) !! x = Some t.
Proof. unfold env in *. apply lookup_insert_eq. Qed.

Lemma env_lookup_insert_none x y (t : type) (Γ : env) : x <> y -> Γ !! y = None -> (<[x:=t]>Γ) !! y = None.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. intros Hne Hy.
  rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x y t Hne). done.
Qed.

Lemma env_unr_delete x (Γ : env) : env_unr Γ -> env_unr (delete x Γ).
Proof.
  intros H y t Hy. unfold env_unr in H. unfold env in *.
  destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_eq Γ y) in Hy. done.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ x y E) in Hy. apply H in Hy. done.
Qed.

Lemma env_unr_insert_lookup x (t : type) (Γ : env) :
  env_unr (<[x:=t]>Γ) -> unr t.
Proof. intros H. unfold env_unr in H. apply (H x t). unfold env. apply lookup_insert_eq. Qed.

Lemma env_union_empty_l (m : env) : ∅ ∪ m = m.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro x. rewrite lookup_union.
  assert (H : (∅ : gmap string type) !! x = None) by apply lookup_empty.
  rewrite H. destruct (m !! x); done.
Qed.

Lemma env_union_empty_r (m : env) : m ∪ ∅ = m.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro x. rewrite lookup_union.
  assert (H : (∅ : gmap string type) !! x = None) by apply lookup_empty.
  rewrite H. destruct (m !! x); done.
Qed.

Lemma env_split_empty (Γ1 Γ2 : env) : env_split ∅ Γ1 Γ2 -> Γ1 = ∅ /\ Γ2 = ∅.
Proof.
  unfold env in *.
  intros [Hun Hdis]. symmetry in Hun.
  apply map_positive_l in Hun as H1. subst Γ1.
  rewrite env_union_empty_l in Hun. subst Γ2. split; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma disj_delete x (Γ1 Γ2 : env) : disj Γ1 Γ2 -> disj (delete x Γ1) (delete x Γ2).
Proof.
  unfold env in *.
  intros H i t1 t2 H1 H2.
  destruct (decide (x=i)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_eq Γ1 i) in H1. done.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ1 x i E) in H1. rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ2 x i E) in H2. apply (H i t1 t2 H1 H2).
Qed.

Lemma delete_insert_none x (t : type) (Γ : env) : Γ !! x = None -> delete x (<[x:=t]>Γ) = Γ.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. intros Hx. apply map_eq. intro y. destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_eq (<[y:=t]>Γ) y). done.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_ne (<[x:=t]>Γ) x y E). rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x y t E). done.
Qed.

Lemma delete_none x (Γ : env) : Γ !! x = None -> delete x Γ = Γ.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. intros Hx. apply map_eq. intro y. destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_eq Γ y). done.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ x y E). done.
Qed.

Lemma insert_delete_same x (t : type) (Γ : env) : Γ !! x = Some t -> <[x:=t]>(delete x Γ) = Γ.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. intros Hx. apply map_eq. intro y. destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (delete y Γ) y t). symmetry. done.
  - rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (delete x Γ) x y t E). rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ x y E). done.
Qed.

Lemma insert_insert_same x (t1 t2 : type) (Γ : env) :
  <[x:=t2]>(<[x:=t1]>Γ) = <[x:=t2]>Γ.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro y. destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (<[y:=t1]>Γ) y t2). rewrite (lookup_insert_eq Γ y t2). done.
  - rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[x:=t1]>Γ) x y t2 E).
    rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x y t2 E).
    rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x y t1 E). done.
Qed.

Lemma insert_insert_comm x y (t1 t2 : type) (Γ : env) : x <> y ->
  <[x:=t1]>(<[y:=t2]>Γ) = <[y:=t2]>(<[x:=t1]>Γ).
Proof.
  intros Hne. unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro z.
  destruct (decide (z=x)) as [E1|E1].
  - subst z.
    destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E2|E2].
    + exfalso. apply Hne. done.
    + rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (<[y:=t2]>Γ) x t1).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[x:=t1]>Γ) y x t2 (fun H => E2 (eq_sym H))).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_eq Γ x t1). done.
  - destruct (decide (z=y)) as [E2|E2].
    + subst z.
      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[y:=t2]>Γ) x y t1 Hne).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_eq Γ y t2).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (<[x:=t1]>Γ) y t2). done.
    + rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[y:=t2]>Γ) x z t1 (fun H => E1 (eq_sym H))).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ y z t2 (fun H => E2 (eq_sym H))).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[x:=t1]>Γ) y z t2 (fun H => E2 (eq_sym H))).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x z t1 (fun H => E1 (eq_sym H))). done.
Qed.

Lemma env_split_delete x (E E1 E2 : env) :
  env_split E E1 E2 -> env_split (delete x E) (delete x E1) (delete x E2).
Proof.
  unfold env in *. intros [Hun Hdis]. split.
  - rewrite Hun. apply delete_union.
  - apply disj_delete. done.
Qed.

Lemma env_unr_empty : env_unr (∅ : env).
Proof. unfold env in *. intros x t H. assert (H0 : (∅ : gmap string type) !! x = None) by apply lookup_empty. setoid_rewrite H0 in H. done. Qed.

Lemma env_split_nil : env_split (∅ : env) ∅ ∅.
Proof.
  unfold env_split. split.
  - symmetry. apply env_union_empty_l.
  - intros i t1 t2 H1 H2. assert (H0 : (∅ : env) !! i = None) by (unfold env; apply lookup_empty).
    setoid_rewrite H0 in H1. done.
Qed.

From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.

From Stdlib Require Import Classical_Prop Wellfounded Wf_nat Lia.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* A sufficient combinatorial condition for full reachability.        *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* [waiting ρ i j] is the "i depends on j" relation.  If it admits a  *)
(* rank that strictly increases along waiting edges, then reachability *)
(* propagates back along those edges from any [can_step] seed.        *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition wait_wf (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  well_founded (fun j i => waiting ρ i j).

Definition progress_or_wait (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i, ρ !! i <> None -> can_step ρ i \/ exists j, waiting ρ i j.

Definition wait_targets_live (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i e j, ρ !! i = Some (Thread e) -> expr_waiting e j -> ρ !! j <> None.

Definition rank_ok (ρ : cfg) (r : nat -> nat) (M : nat) : Prop :=
  (forall i, r i <= M) /\ (forall i j, waiting ρ i j -> r i < r j).

Lemma rank_ok_wait_wf ρ r M :
  rank_ok ρ r M -> wait_wf ρ.
Proof.
  intros [Hb Hr]. unfold wait_wf.
  apply (Wf_nat.well_founded_lt_compat
           nat (fun i => M - r i) (fun j i => waiting ρ i j)).
  intros x y Hxy. pose proof (Hr y x Hxy) as Hlt.
  pose proof (Hb x). pose proof (Hb y). lia.
Qed.

Lemma wait_wf_fully_reachable ρ :
  wait_wf ρ -> progress_or_wait ρ -> wait_targets_live ρ -> fully_reachable ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hwf Hprog Hlive i.
  apply (well_founded_ind Hwf (fun i => inactive ρ i \/ reachable ρ i)).
  intros x IH.
  destruct (classic (inactive ρ x)) as [Hin | Hact].
  - left; exact Hin.
  - right.
    destruct (Hprog x Hact) as [Hstep | [j Hwait]].
    + apply Can_step_reachable; exact Hstep.
    + destruct (IH j Hwait) as [Hinj | Hrj].
      * destruct Hwait as [[e [He Hw]] | [y [Hy _]]].
        -- exfalso. exact (Hlive x e j He Hw Hinj).
        -- unfold inactive in Hinj. rewrite Hy in Hinj. discriminate.
      * apply Waiting_reachable with j; assumption.
Qed.

Theorem rank_fully_reachable ρ r M :
  rank_ok ρ r M -> progress_or_wait ρ -> wait_targets_live ρ ->
  fully_reachable ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hr Hp Hl.
  apply wait_wf_fully_reachable.
  - apply rank_ok_wait_wf with (r := r) (M := M); exact Hr.
  - exact Hp.
  - exact Hl.
Qed.

Theorem typed_full_reachability e ρ :
  typed ∅ e UnitT -> steps {[ 0 := Thread e ]} ρ -> fully_reachable ρ.

From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Sufficient conditions for full reachability (constructive version). *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition wait_wf (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  well_founded (fun j i => waiting ρ i j).

Definition progress_or_wait (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i, ρ !! i <> None -> can_step ρ i \/ exists j, waiting ρ i j.

Definition wait_targets_live (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i e j, ρ !! i = Some (Thread e) -> expr_waiting e j -> ρ !! j <> None.

Definition rank_ok (ρ : cfg) (r : nat -> nat) (M : nat) : Prop :=
  (forall i, r i <= M) /\ (forall i j, waiting ρ i j -> r i < r j).

Lemma rank_ok_wait_wf ρ r M : rank_ok ρ r M -> wait_wf ρ.
Proof.
  intros [Hb Hr]. unfold wait_wf.
  apply (Wf_nat.well_founded_lt_compat
           nat (fun i => M - r i) (fun j i => waiting ρ i j)).
  intros x y Hxy. pose proof (Hr y x Hxy) as Hlt.
  pose proof (Hb x). pose proof (Hb y). lia.
Qed.

(* A constructive proof: [inactive] is decided by matching on the lookup. *)
Lemma wait_wf_fully_reachable ρ :
  wait_wf ρ -> progress_or_wait ρ -> wait_targets_live ρ -> fully_reachable ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hwf Hprog Hlive i.
  apply (well_founded_ind Hwf (fun i => inactive ρ i \/ reachable ρ i)).
  intros x IH.
  destruct (ρ !! x) as [y|] eqn:E.
  - right.
    assert (Hact : ρ !! x <> None) by congruence.
    destruct (Hprog x Hact) as [Hstep | [j Hwait]].
    + apply Can_step_reachable; exact Hstep.
    + destruct (IH j Hwait) as [Hinj | Hrj].
      * destruct Hwait as [[e [He Hw]] | [y' [Hy _]]].
        -- exfalso. exact (Hlive x e j He Hw Hinj).
        -- unfold inactive in Hinj. rewrite Hy in Hinj. discriminate.
      * apply Waiting_reachable with j; assumption.
  - left. exact E.
Qed.

Theorem rank_fully_reachable ρ r M :
  rank_ok ρ r M -> progress_or_wait ρ -> wait_targets_live ρ ->
  fully_reachable ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hr Hp Hl.
  apply wait_wf_fully_reachable.
  - apply rank_ok_wait_wf with (r := r) (M := M); exact Hr.
  - exact Hp.
  - exact Hl.
Qed.

Print Assumptions rank_fully_reachable.
Print Assumptions wait_wf_fully_reachable.
EOF

(* A weaker sufficient condition than a global rank: every live       *)

Definition wait_step (ρ : cfg) : nat -> nat -> Prop :=
  fun a b => waiting ρ a b.

Lemma reachable_of_wait_rtc ρ a b :
  rtc (wait_step ρ) a b -> reachable ρ b -> reachable ρ a.
Proof.
  intros H. induction H as [| x y z Hxy _ IH]; intros Hb.
  - exact Hb.
  - apply IH. apply Waiting_reachable with y; assumption.
Qed.

Definition seeded ρ : Prop :=
  forall i, ρ !! i <> None ->
    exists j, rtc (wait_step ρ) i j /\ can_step ρ j.

  apply expr_head_waiting_ref in Hh. exact Hh.

From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.
From Stdlib Require Import Relation_Operators.

Definition wait_step (ρ : cfg) : nat -> nat -> Prop :=
  fun a b => waiting ρ a b.

Lemma reachable_of_wait_rtc ρ a b :
  rtc (wait_step ρ) a b -> reachable ρ b -> reachable ρ a.
Proof.
  intros H. induction H as [| x y z Hxy _ IH]; intros Hb.
  - exact Hb.
  - apply Waiting_reachable with y.
    + exact Hxy.
    + apply IH; exact Hb.
Qed.

Definition seeded ρ : Prop :=
  forall i, ρ !! i <> None ->
    exists j, rtc (wait_step ρ) i j /\ can_step ρ j.

Lemma seeded_fully_reachable ρ : seeded ρ -> fully_reachable ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hseed i. destruct (ρ !! i) as [y|] eqn:E.
  - right. destruct (Hseed i ltac:(congruence)) as [j [Hpath Hstep]].
    apply (reachable_of_wait_rtc ρ i j Hpath).
    apply Can_step_reachable; exact Hstep.
  - left. exact E.
Qed.

(* A configuration with a genuine 2-cycle in [waiting], but which is
   nevertheless fully reachable because the cycle is seeded by a step. *)

Definition ex_cfg : cfg :=
  {[ 0 := Thread (Acquire (Val $ LockV 1));
     1 := Lock 0 (Some (LockV 2));
     2 := Lock 0 (Some (LockV 1)) ]}.

Lemma ex_wait_0_1 : waiting ex_cfg 0 1.
Proof.
  left. exists (Acquire (Val $ LockV 1)). split; [reflexivity|].
  exists id, (Acquire (Val $ LockV 1)). split; [constructor|].
  split; [reflexivity|constructor].
Qed.

Lemma ex_wait_1_2 : waiting ex_cfg 1 2.
Proof.
  right. exists (Lock 0 (Some (LockV 1))). split; [reflexivity|].
  split; [set_solver|]. intros e He. discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma ex_wait_2_1 : waiting ex_cfg 2 1.
Proof.
  right. exists (Lock 0 (Some (LockV 2))). split; [reflexivity|].
  split; [set_solver|]. intros e He. discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma ex_can_step_1 : can_step ex_cfg 1.
Proof.
  exists {[ 0 := Thread (Val $ PairV (LockV 1) (LockV 2));
            1 := Lock 0 None;
            2 := Lock 0 (Some (LockV 1)) ]}.
  eapply Frame_step with (ρ := {[ 0 := Thread (Acquire (Val $ LockV 1));
                                  1 := Lock 0 (Some (LockV 2)) ]})

  - rewrite !map_disjoint_singleton_l. repeat split; discriminate.
  - apply (Acquire_step (v := LockV 2) (k := id) (i := 0) (n := 1) (refcnt := 0)).
    + discriminate.
    + constructor.
Qed.

Lemma ex_seeded : seeded ex_cfg.
Proof.
  intros i Hi.
  destruct (decide (i = 0)) as [->|H0].
  - exists 1. split.

      * exact ex_wait_0_1.

      * exact ex_can_step_1.
Qed.

Theorem ex_fully_reachable : fully_reachable ex_cfg.
Proof. apply seeded_fully_reachable, ex_seeded. Qed.

Theorem ex_no_rank : forall r M, ~ rank_ok ex_cfg r M.
Proof.

Qed.

From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.
From stdpp Require Import gmap.

Definition wait_targets_live (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i e j, ρ !! i = Some (Thread e) -> expr_waiting e j -> ρ !! j <> None.

(* Every reference occurring in any live object points to a live location. *)
Definition refs_live (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i y, ρ !! i = Some y -> forall j, j ∈ obj_refs y -> ρ !! j <> None.

Lemma ctx1_expr_refs k :
  ctx1 k -> forall e, expr_refs e ⊆ expr_refs (k e).
Proof.
  intros Hk e j Hj.
  destruct Hk; simpl; set_solver.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_expr_refs k :
  ctx k -> forall e, expr_refs e ⊆ expr_refs (k e).
Proof.
  intros Hk. induction Hk as [| k1 k2 H1 H2 IH2]; simpl.
  - intros e j Hj. exact Hj.
  - intros e j Hj. apply (ctx1_expr_refs k1 H1). apply IH2. exact Hj.
Qed.

Lemma expr_head_waiting_ref j e :
  expr_head_waiting e j -> j ∈ expr_refs e.
Proof.
  intros H. induction H; simpl; set_solver.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_head_waiting_ref k e j :
  ctx k -> expr_head_waiting e j -> j ∈ expr_refs (k e).
Proof.
  intros Hk Hh. apply (ctx_expr_refs k Hk e).
  apply expr_head_waiting_ref in Hh. exact Hh.
Qed.

Lemma expr_waiting_ref e j : expr_waiting e j -> j ∈ expr_refs e.
Proof.
  intros [k [e' [Hk [He Hh]]]]. subst e.
  apply ctx_head_waiting_ref; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma refs_live_wait_targets_live ρ :
  refs_live ρ -> wait_targets_live ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hlive i e j He Hw.
  apply (Hlive i (Thread e) He j).
  apply expr_waiting_ref in Hw. exact Hw.
Qed.

From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.
From Stdlib Require Import Relation_Operators.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* A weaker sufficient condition than a global rank: every live       *)
(* location reaches, along finitely many waiting edges, some location *)
(* that can step.                                                     *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition wait_step (ρ : cfg) : nat -> nat -> Prop :=
  fun a b => waiting ρ a b.

Lemma reachable_of_wait_rtc ρ a b :
  rtc (wait_step ρ) a b -> reachable ρ b -> reachable ρ a.
Proof.
  intros H. induction H as [| x y z Hxy _ IH]; intros Hb.
  - exact Hb.
  - apply Waiting_reachable with y.
    + exact Hxy.
    + apply IH; exact Hb.
Qed.

Definition seeded ρ : Prop :=
  forall i, ρ !! i <> None ->
    exists j, rtc (wait_step ρ) i j /\ can_step ρ j.

Lemma seeded_fully_reachable ρ :
  seeded ρ -> fully_reachable ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hseed i. destruct (ρ !! i) as [y|] eqn:E.
  - right. destruct (Hseed i ltac:(congruence)) as [j [Hpath Hstep]].
    apply (reachable_of_wait_rtc ρ i j Hpath).
    apply Can_step_reachable; exact Hstep.
  - left. exact E.
Qed.

(* Every location is trivially seeded by can_step on itself. *)
Lemma all_can_step_fully_reachable ρ :
  (forall i, ρ !! i <> None -> can_step ρ i) -> fully_reachable ρ.
Proof.
  intros H. apply seeded_fully_reachable. intros i Hi.
  exists i. split; [constructor | apply H; exact Hi].
Qed.

Print Assumptions seeded_fully_reachable.

From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Sufficient conditions for full reachability (constructive version). *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition wait_wf (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  well_founded (fun j i => waiting ρ i j).

Definition progress_or_wait (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i, ρ !! i <> None -> can_step ρ i \/ exists j, waiting ρ i j.

Definition wait_targets_live (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i e j, ρ !! i = Some (Thread e) -> expr_waiting e j -> ρ !! j <> None.

Definition rank_ok (ρ : cfg) (r : nat -> nat) (M : nat) : Prop :=
  (forall i, r i <= M) /\ (forall i j, waiting ρ i j -> r i < r j).

Lemma rank_ok_wait_wf ρ r M : rank_ok ρ r M -> wait_wf ρ.
Proof.
  intros [Hb Hr]. unfold wait_wf.
  apply (Wf_nat.well_founded_lt_compat
           nat (fun i => M - r i) (fun j i => waiting ρ i j)).
  intros x y Hxy. pose proof (Hr y x Hxy) as Hlt.
  pose proof (Hb x). pose proof (Hb y). lia.
Qed.

(* A constructive proof: [inactive] is decided by matching on the lookup. *)
Lemma wait_wf_fully_reachable ρ :
  wait_wf ρ -> progress_or_wait ρ -> wait_targets_live ρ -> fully_reachable ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hwf Hprog Hlive i.
  apply (well_founded_ind Hwf (fun i => inactive ρ i \/ reachable ρ i)).
  intros x IH.
  destruct (ρ !! x) as [y|] eqn:E.
  - right.
    assert (Hact : ρ !! x <> None) by congruence.
    destruct (Hprog x Hact) as [Hstep | [j Hwait]].
    + apply Can_step_reachable; exact Hstep.
    + destruct (IH j Hwait) as [Hinj | Hrj].
      * destruct Hwait as [[e [He Hw]] | [y' [Hy _]]].
        -- exfalso. exact (Hlive x e j He Hw Hinj).
        -- unfold inactive in Hinj. rewrite Hy in Hinj. discriminate.
      * apply Waiting_reachable with j; assumption.
  - left. exact E.
Qed.

Theorem rank_fully_reachable ρ r M :
  rank_ok ρ r M -> progress_or_wait ρ -> wait_targets_live ρ ->
  fully_reachable ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hr Hp Hl.
  apply wait_wf_fully_reachable.
  - apply rank_ok_wait_wf with (r := r) (M := M); exact Hr.
  - exact Hp.
  - exact Hl.
Qed.

Print Assumptions rank_fully_reachable.
Print Assumptions wait_wf_fully_reachable.

Proof.

  exists id, (Acquire (Val $ LockV 1)). split; [constructor|].
  split; [reflexivity|constructor].
Qed.

Lemma ex_wait_1_2 : waiting ex_cfg 1 2.
Proof.

  split; [set_solver|]. intros e He. discriminate.

Lemma ex_wait_2_1 : waiting ex_cfg 2 1.

  destruct k as [|[|[|k]]].
  - compute. auto.

  - compute. auto.
  - right. rewrite lookup_singleton_ne; [reflexivity|discriminate].

  ##ₘ {[ 2 := Lock 0 (Some (LockV 1)) ]}.
Proof.
  apply (proj2 (map_disjoint_alt _ _)); intros k.
  destruct k as [|[|[|k]]].
  - compute. auto.
  - compute. auto.
  - compute. auto.

            1 := Lock 0 None;
            2 := Lock 0 (Some (LockV 1)) ]}.
  rewrite ex_cfg_eq.
  change (step 1 (A0 ∪ A1 ∪ A2)
    ({[ 0 := Thread (Val $ PairV (LockV 1) (LockV 2));

     ∪ {[ 2 := Lock 0 (Some (LockV 1)) ]})).
  eapply Frame_step with
    (ρ := A0 ∪ A1)
    (ρ' := {[ 0 := Thread (Val $ PairV (LockV 1) (LockV 2));

    (ρf := A2).
  - exact exd1.
  - exact exd2.
  - apply (Acquire_step (LockV 2) id 0 1 0).

Lemma ex_seeded : seeded ex_cfg.
Proof.
  intros i Hi.
  destruct i as [|[|[|i]]].
  - exists 1. split.
    + apply (rtc_l (wait_step ex_cfg) 0 1 1).

Proof. apply seeded_fully_reachable, ex_seeded. Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Sufficient conditions for full reachability (constructive version). *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition wait_wf (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  well_founded (fun j i => waiting ρ i j).

Definition progress_or_wait (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i, ρ !! i <> None -> can_step ρ i \/ exists j, waiting ρ i j.

Definition wait_targets_live (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i e j, ρ !! i = Some (Thread e) -> expr_waiting e j -> ρ !! j <> None.

Definition rank_ok (ρ : cfg) (r : nat -> nat) (M : nat) : Prop :=
  (forall i, r i <= M) /\ (forall i j, waiting ρ i j -> r i < r j).

Lemma rank_ok_wait_wf ρ r M : rank_ok ρ r M -> wait_wf ρ.
Proof.
  intros [Hb Hr]. unfold wait_wf.
  apply (Wf_nat.well_founded_lt_compat
           nat (fun i => M - r i) (fun j i => waiting ρ i j)).
  intros x y Hxy. pose proof (Hr y x Hxy) as Hlt.
  pose proof (Hb x). pose proof (Hb y). lia.
Qed.

(* A constructive proof: [inactive] is decided by matching on the lookup. *)
Lemma wait_wf_fully_reachable ρ :
  wait_wf ρ -> progress_or_wait ρ -> wait_targets_live ρ -> fully_reachable ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hwf Hprog Hlive i.
  apply (well_founded_ind Hwf (fun i => inactive ρ i \/ reachable ρ i)).
  intros x IH.
  destruct (ρ !! x) as [y|] eqn:E.
  - right.
    assert (Hact : ρ !! x <> None) by congruence.
    destruct (Hprog x Hact) as [Hstep | [j Hwait]].
    + apply Can_step_reachable; exact Hstep.
    + destruct (IH j Hwait) as [Hinj | Hrj].
      * destruct Hwait as [[e [He Hw]] | [y' [Hy _]]].
        -- exfalso. exact (Hlive x e j He Hw Hinj).
        -- unfold inactive in Hinj. rewrite Hy in Hinj. discriminate.
      * apply Waiting_reachable with j; assumption.
  - left. exact E.
Qed.

Theorem rank_fully_reachable ρ r M :
  rank_ok ρ r M -> progress_or_wait ρ -> wait_targets_live ρ ->
  fully_reachable ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hr Hp Hl.
  apply wait_wf_fully_reachable.
  - apply rank_ok_wait_wf with (r := r) (M := M); exact Hr.
  - exact Hp.

From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.

(* If no index can step, then no index is reachable.  [reachable] has no
   base case other than can_step, and its waiting constructor only appeals to
   a smaller reachable premise, so the induction closes immediately. *)

Lemma reachable_no_can_step ρ i :
  (forall k, ~ can_step ρ k) -> reachable ρ i -> False.
Proof.
  intros Hns Hr. induction Hr as [k Hc | i j Hw Hr IH].
  - exact (Hns k Hc).
  - exact IH.
Qed.

Lemma no_can_step_not_fully_reachable ρ :
  (forall k, ~ can_step ρ k) ->
  (exists k, ρ !! k <> None) ->
  ~ fully_reachable ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hns [k Hk] Hfr.
  destruct (Hfr k) as [Hin | Hr].
  - unfold inactive in Hin. exact (Hk Hin).
  - exact (reachable_no_can_step ρ k Hns Hr).
Qed.

(* Consequently, any configuration with a live but globally stuck object is a
   counterexample shape; the whole difficulty is producing such a [rho] from a
   closed, well-typed source term. *)
