From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String.
From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.

(* Elementary facts showing that the two-capability attack cannot be
   duplicated at the source level: linear lock types are never [unr], and an
   environment split therefore cannot let the same lock-typed variable occur
   on both sides. *)

Lemma unr_LockT l t : unr (LockT l t) -> False.
Proof. intros H. inversion H. Qed.

Lemma not_unr_lockcap l t : ~ unr (LockT l t).
Proof. intros H. exact (unr_LockT l t H). Qed.

Lemma disj_lock_both Γ1 Γ2 x l t :
  disj Γ1 Γ2 ->
  Γ1 !! x = Some (LockT l t) ->
  Γ2 !! x = Some (LockT l t) ->
  False.
Proof.
  intros Hd H1 H2.
  destruct (Hd x (LockT l t) (LockT l t) H1 H2) as [_ Hunr].
  exact (unr_LockT l t Hunr).
Qed.

Lemma env_split_lock_both Γ Γ1 Γ2 x l t :
  env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
  Γ1 !! x = Some (LockT l t) ->
  Γ2 !! x = Some (LockT l t) ->
  False.
Proof.
  intros [Hu Hd] H1 H2.
  exact (disj_lock_both Γ1 Γ2 x l t Hd H1 H2).
Qed.

(* Complete enumeration of the nine possible ForkLock splits. *)
Lemma lockcap_split_cases l1 l2 l3 :
  lockcap_split l1 l2 l3 ->
  (exists lo1 ls1 lo2 ls2 lo3 ls3,
      l1 = (lo1,ls1) /\ l2 = (lo2,ls2) /\ l3 = (lo3,ls3)
      /\ lockownership_split lo1 lo2 lo3
      /\ lockstate_split ls1 ls2 ls3).
Proof.
  intros H. unfold lockcap_split in H. destruct H as [Ho Hs].
  destruct l1 as [lo1 ls1]. destruct l2 as [lo2 ls2]. destruct l3 as [lo3 ls3].
  exists lo1, ls1, lo2, ls2, lo3, ls3. auto.
Qed.

Lemma env_var_lookup Γ x t : env_var Γ x t -> Γ !! x = Some t.
Proof.
  intros [Γ' [Heq _]]. rewrite Heq. apply lookup_insert_eq.
Qed.

From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.

From Stdlib Require Import Classical_Prop Wellfounded Wf_nat Lia.
From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String Eqdep_dec.
Open Scope string_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Runtime typing for configurations.                                 *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* Source terms are Val-free, so [typed] cannot type configurations   *)
(* produced by reduction.  [wt] extends it with runtime values [cv].  *)
(* Values are environment-independent (they are closed).               *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Inductive wt (L : gmap nat type) : env -> expr -> type -> Prop :=
  | VarW Γ x t :
      env_var Γ x t ->
      wt L Γ (Var x) t
  | FunW Γ Γ' x e t1 t2 l :
      env_bind Γ' x t1 Γ ->
      (l = Unr -> env_unr Γ) ->
      wt L Γ' e t2 ->
      wt L Γ (Fun x e) (FunT l t1 t2)
  | AppW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 l :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (FunT l t1 t2) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 t1 ->
      wt L Γ (App e1 e2) t2
  | UnitW Γ :
      env_unr Γ ->
      wt L Γ Unit UnitT
  | PairW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 t1 ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 t2 ->
      wt L Γ (Pair e1 e2) (PairT t1 t2)
  | LetPairW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 t :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (PairT t1 t2) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 (FunT Lin t1 (FunT Lin t2 t)) ->
      wt L Γ (LetPair e1 e2) t
  | SumW Γ n (ts : fin n -> type) i e :
      wt L Γ e (ts i) ->
      wt L Γ (Sum i e) (SumT n ts)
  | MatchSumW n Γ Γ1 Γ2 t (ts : fin n -> type) es e :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      (n = 0 -> env_unr Γ2) ->
      wt L Γ1 e (SumT n ts) ->
      (forall i, wt L Γ2 (es i) (FunT Lin (ts i) t)) ->
      wt L Γ (MatchSum n e es) t
  | ForkW Γ e t1 t2 :
      wt L Γ e (FunT Lin (FunT Lin t2 t1) UnitT) ->
      wt L Γ (ForkBarrier e) (FunT Lin t1 t2)
  | NewLockW Γ e t :
      wt L Γ e t ->
      wt L Γ (NewLock e) (LockT (Owner,Closed) t)
  | ForkLockW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t l1 l2 l3 :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      lockcap_split l1 l2 l3 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (LockT l1 t) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 (FunT Lin (LockT l2 t) UnitT) ->
      wt L Γ (ForkLock e1 e2) (LockT l3 t)
  | AcquireW Γ e t lo :
      wt L Γ e (LockT (lo,Closed) t) ->
      wt L Γ (Acquire e) (PairT (LockT (lo,Opened) t) t)
  | ReleaseW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t lo :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (LockT (lo,Opened) t) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 t ->
      wt L Γ (Release e1 e2) (LockT (lo,Closed) t)
  | WaitW Γ e t :
      wt L Γ e (LockT (Owner,Closed) t) ->
      wt L Γ (Wait e) t
  | DropW Γ e t :
      wt L Γ e (LockT (Client,Closed) t) ->
      wt L Γ (Drop e) UnitT
  | ValW Γ v t :
      env_unr Γ ->
      cv L v t ->
      wt L Γ (Val v) t
with cv (L : gmap nat type) : val -> type -> Prop :=
  | FunVW x e t1 t2 l :
      wt L (<[ x := t1 ]> (∅ : env)) e t2 ->
      cv L (FunV x e) (FunT l t1 t2)
  | UnitVW : cv L UnitV UnitT
  | PairVW v1 v2 t1 t2 :
      cv L v1 t1 -> cv L v2 t2 ->
      cv L (PairV v1 v2) (PairT t1 t2)
  | SumVW n (ts : fin n -> type) i v :
      cv L v (ts i) ->
      cv L (SumV i v) (SumT n ts)
  | BarrierVW n t1 t2 :
      cv L (BarrierV n) (FunT Lin t1 t2)
  | LockVW n lc t :
      L !! n = Some t ->
      cv L (LockV n) (LockT lc t).

(* ---------- gmap / environment helpers ---------- *)

Lemma env_lookup_insert_same x (t : type) : (<[x:=t]>(∅ : env)) !! x = Some t.
Proof. unfold env in *. apply lookup_insert_eq. Qed.

Lemma env_lookup_insert_none x y (t : type) (Γ : env) : x <> y -> Γ !! y = None -> (<[x:=t]>Γ) !! y = None.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. intros Hne Hy.
  rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x y t Hne). done.
Qed.

Lemma env_unr_delete x (Γ : env) : env_unr Γ -> env_unr (delete x Γ).
Proof.
  intros H y t Hy. unfold env_unr in H. unfold env in *.
  destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_eq Γ y) in Hy. done.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ x y E) in Hy. apply H in Hy. done.
Qed.

Lemma env_unr_insert_lookup x (t : type) (Γ : env) :
  env_unr (<[x:=t]>Γ) -> unr t.
Proof. intros H. unfold env_unr in H. apply (H x t). unfold env. apply lookup_insert_eq. Qed.

Lemma env_union_empty_l (m : env) : ∅ ∪ m = m.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro x. rewrite lookup_union.
  assert (H : (∅ : gmap string type) !! x = None) by apply lookup_empty.
  rewrite H. destruct (m !! x); done.
Qed.

Lemma env_union_empty_r (m : env) : m ∪ ∅ = m.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro x. rewrite lookup_union.
  assert (H : (∅ : gmap string type) !! x = None) by apply lookup_empty.
  rewrite H. destruct (m !! x); done.
Qed.

Lemma env_split_empty (Γ1 Γ2 : env) : env_split ∅ Γ1 Γ2 -> Γ1 = ∅ /\ Γ2 = ∅.
Proof.
  unfold env in *.
  intros [Hun Hdis]. symmetry in Hun.
  apply map_positive_l in Hun as H1. subst Γ1.
  rewrite env_union_empty_l in Hun. subst Γ2. split; reflexivity.
Qed.

Proof.

  intros H i t1 t2 H1 H2.
  destruct (decide (x=i)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_eq Γ1 i) in H1. done.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ1 x i E) in H1. rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ2 x i E) in H2. apply (H i t1 t2 H1 H2).
Qed.

Proof.
  unfold env in *. intros Hx. apply map_eq. intro y. destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_eq (<[y:=t]>Γ) y). done.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_ne (<[x:=t]>Γ) x y E). rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x y t E). done.
Qed.

Lemma delete_none x (Γ : env) : Γ !! x = None -> delete x Γ = Γ.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. intros Hx. apply map_eq. intro y. destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_eq Γ y). done.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ x y E). done.
Qed.

Lemma insert_delete_same x (t : type) (Γ : env) : Γ !! x = Some t -> <[x:=t]>(delete x Γ) = Γ.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. intros Hx. apply map_eq. intro y. destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (delete y Γ) y t). symmetry. done.
  - rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (delete x Γ) x y t E). rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ x y E). done.
Qed.

Lemma insert_insert_same x (t1 t2 : type) (Γ : env) :
  <[x:=t2]>(<[x:=t1]>Γ) = <[x:=t2]>Γ.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro y. destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (<[y:=t1]>Γ) y t2). rewrite (lookup_insert_eq Γ y t2). done.
  - rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[x:=t1]>Γ) x y t2 E).
    rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x y t2 E).
    rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x y t1 E). done.
Qed.

Lemma insert_insert_comm x y (t1 t2 : type) (Γ : env) : x <> y ->
  <[x:=t1]>(<[y:=t2]>Γ) = <[y:=t2]>(<[x:=t1]>Γ).
Proof.
  intros Hne. unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro z.
  destruct (decide (z=x)) as [E1|E1].
  - subst z.
    destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E2|E2].
    + exfalso. apply Hne. done.
    + rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (<[y:=t2]>Γ) x t1).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[x:=t1]>Γ) y x t2 (fun H => E2 (eq_sym H))).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_eq Γ x t1). done.
  - destruct (decide (z=y)) as [E2|E2].
    + subst z.
      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[y:=t2]>Γ) x y t1 Hne).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_eq Γ y t2).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (<[x:=t1]>Γ) y t2). done.
    + rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[y:=t2]>Γ) x z t1 (fun H => E1 (eq_sym H))).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ y z t2 (fun H => E2 (eq_sym H))).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[x:=t1]>Γ) y z t2 (fun H => E2 (eq_sym H))).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x z t1 (fun H => E1 (eq_sym H))). done.

  env_split E E1 E2 -> env_split (delete x E) (delete x E1) (delete x E2).
Proof.
  unfold env in *. intros [Hun Hdis]. split.
  - rewrite Hun. apply delete_union.
  - apply disj_delete. done.
Qed.

Lemma env_unr_empty : env_unr (∅ : env).
Proof. unfold env in *. intros x t H. assert (H0 : (∅ : gmap string type) !! x = None) by apply lookup_empty. setoid_rewrite H0 in H. done. Qed.

Lemma env_split_nil : env_split (∅ : env) ∅ ∅.
Proof.
  unfold env_split. split.
  - symmetry. apply env_union_empty_l.
  - intros i t1 t2 H1 H2. assert (H0 : (∅ : env) !! i = None) by (unfold env; apply lookup_empty).
    setoid_rewrite H0 in H1. done.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* A sufficient combinatorial condition for full reachability.        *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* [waiting ρ i j] is the "i depends on j" relation.  If it admits a  *)
(* rank that strictly increases along waiting edges, then reachability *)
(* propagates back along those edges from any [can_step] seed.        *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition wait_wf (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  well_founded (fun j i => waiting ρ i j).

Definition progress_or_wait (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i, ρ !! i <> None -> can_step ρ i \/ exists j, waiting ρ i j.

Definition wait_targets_live (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i e j, ρ !! i = Some (Thread e) -> expr_waiting e j -> ρ !! j <> None.

Definition rank_ok (ρ : cfg) (r : nat -> nat) (M : nat) : Prop :=
  (forall i, r i <= M) /\ (forall i j, waiting ρ i j -> r i < r j).

Lemma rank_ok_wait_wf ρ r M :
  rank_ok ρ r M -> wait_wf ρ.
Proof.
  intros [Hb Hr]. unfold wait_wf.
  apply (Wf_nat.well_founded_lt_compat
           nat (fun i => M - r i) (fun j i => waiting ρ i j)).
  intros x y Hxy. pose proof (Hr y x Hxy) as Hlt.
  pose proof (Hb x). pose proof (Hb y). lia.
Qed.

Lemma wait_wf_fully_reachable ρ :
  wait_wf ρ -> progress_or_wait ρ -> wait_targets_live ρ -> fully_reachable ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hwf Hprog Hlive i.
  apply (well_founded_ind Hwf (fun i => inactive ρ i \/ reachable ρ i)).
  intros x IH.
  destruct (classic (inactive ρ x)) as [Hin | Hact].
  - left; exact Hin.
  - right.
    destruct (Hprog x Hact) as [Hstep | [j Hwait]].
    + apply Can_step_reachable; exact Hstep.
    + destruct (IH j Hwait) as [Hinj | Hrj].
      * destruct Hwait as [[e [He Hw]] | [y [Hy _]]].
        -- exfalso. exact (Hlive x e j He Hw Hinj).
        -- unfold inactive in Hinj. rewrite Hy in Hinj. discriminate.
      * apply Waiting_reachable with j; assumption.
Qed.

Theorem rank_fully_reachable ρ r M :
  rank_ok ρ r M -> progress_or_wait ρ -> wait_targets_live ρ ->
  fully_reachable ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hr Hp Hl.
  apply wait_wf_fully_reachable.
  - apply rank_ok_wait_wf with (r := r) (M := M); exact Hr.
  - exact Hp.
  - exact Hl.
Qed.

Theorem typed_full_reachability e ρ :
  typed ∅ e UnitT -> steps {[ 0 := Thread e ]} ρ -> fully_reachable ρ.

From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.

From Stdlib Require Import Classical_Prop Wellfounded Wf_nat Lia.
From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String Eqdep_dec.
Open Scope string_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Runtime typing for configurations.                                 *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* Source terms are Val-free, so [typed] cannot type configurations   *)
(* produced by reduction.  [wt] extends it with runtime values [cv].  *)
(* Values are environment-independent (they are closed).               *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Inductive wt (L : gmap nat type) : env -> expr -> type -> Prop :=
  | VarW Γ x t :
      env_var Γ x t ->
      wt L Γ (Var x) t
  | FunW Γ Γ' x e t1 t2 l :
      env_bind Γ' x t1 Γ ->
      (l = Unr -> env_unr Γ) ->
      wt L Γ' e t2 ->
      wt L Γ (Fun x e) (FunT l t1 t2)
  | AppW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 l :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (FunT l t1 t2) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 t1 ->
      wt L Γ (App e1 e2) t2
  | UnitW Γ :
      env_unr Γ ->
      wt L Γ Unit UnitT
  | PairW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 t1 ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 t2 ->
      wt L Γ (Pair e1 e2) (PairT t1 t2)
  | LetPairW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 t :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (PairT t1 t2) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 (FunT Lin t1 (FunT Lin t2 t)) ->
      wt L Γ (LetPair e1 e2) t
  | SumW Γ n (ts : fin n -> type) i e :
      wt L Γ e (ts i) ->
      wt L Γ (Sum i e) (SumT n ts)
  | MatchSumW n Γ Γ1 Γ2 t (ts : fin n -> type) es e :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      (n = 0 -> env_unr Γ2) ->
      wt L Γ1 e (SumT n ts) ->
      (forall i, wt L Γ2 (es i) (FunT Lin (ts i) t)) ->
      wt L Γ (MatchSum n e es) t
  | ForkW Γ e t1 t2 :
      wt L Γ e (FunT Lin (FunT Lin t2 t1) UnitT) ->
      wt L Γ (ForkBarrier e) (FunT Lin t1 t2)
  | NewLockW Γ e t :
      wt L Γ e t ->
      wt L Γ (NewLock e) (LockT (Owner,Closed) t)
  | ForkLockW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t l1 l2 l3 :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      lockcap_split l1 l2 l3 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (LockT l1 t) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 (FunT Lin (LockT l2 t) UnitT) ->
      wt L Γ (ForkLock e1 e2) (LockT l3 t)
  | AcquireW Γ e t lo :
      wt L Γ e (LockT (lo,Closed) t) ->
      wt L Γ (Acquire e) (PairT (LockT (lo,Opened) t) t)
  | ReleaseW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t lo :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (LockT (lo,Opened) t) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 t ->
      wt L Γ (Release e1 e2) (LockT (lo,Closed) t)
  | WaitW Γ e t :
      wt L Γ e (LockT (Owner,Closed) t) ->
      wt L Γ (Wait e) t
  | DropW Γ e t :
      wt L Γ e (LockT (Client,Closed) t) ->
      wt L Γ (Drop e) UnitT
  | ValW Γ v t :
      env_unr Γ ->
      cv L v t ->
      wt L Γ (Val v) t
---

with cv (L : gmap nat type) : val -> type -> Prop :=
  | FunVW x e t1 t2 l :
      wt L (<[ x := t1 ]> (∅ : env)) e t2 ->
      cv L (FunV x e) (FunT l t1 t2)
  | UnitVW : cv L UnitV UnitT
  | PairVW v1 v2 t1 t2 :

  | SumVW n (ts : fin n -> type) i v :

  | LockVW n lc t :

(* ---------- gmap / environment helpers ---------- *)

Lemma env_lookup_insert_same x (t : type) : (<[x:=t]>(∅ : env)) !! x = Some t.
Proof. unfold env in *. apply lookup_insert_eq. Qed.

Lemma env_lookup_insert_none x y (t : type) (Γ : env) : x <> y -> Γ !! y = None -> (<[x:=t]>Γ) !! y = None.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. intros Hne Hy.
  rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x y t Hne). done.
Qed.

Lemma env_unr_delete x (Γ : env) : env_unr Γ -> env_unr (delete x Γ).
Proof.
  intros H y t Hy. unfold env_unr in H. unfold env in *.
  destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_eq Γ y) in Hy. done.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ x y E) in Hy. apply H in Hy. done.
Qed.

Lemma env_unr_insert_lookup x (t : type) (Γ : env) :
  env_unr (<[x:=t]>Γ) -> unr t.
Proof. intros H. unfold env_unr in H. apply (H x t). unfold env. apply lookup_insert_eq. Qed.

Lemma env_union_empty_l (m : env) : ∅ ∪ m = m.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro x. rewrite lookup_union.
  assert (H : (∅ : gmap string type) !! x = None) by apply lookup_empty.
  rewrite H. destruct (m !! x); done.
Qed.

Lemma env_union_empty_r (m : env) : m ∪ ∅ = m.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro x. rewrite lookup_union.
  assert (H : (∅ : gmap string type) !! x = None) by apply lookup_empty.
  rewrite H. destruct (m !! x); done.
Qed.

Lemma env_split_empty (Γ1 Γ2 : env) : env_split ∅ Γ1 Γ2 -> Γ1 = ∅ /\ Γ2 = ∅.
Proof.
  unfold env in *.
  intros [Hun Hdis]. symmetry in Hun.
  apply map_positive_l in Hun as H1. subst Γ1.
  rewrite env_union_empty_l in Hun. subst Γ2. split; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma disj_delete x (Γ1 Γ2 : env) : disj Γ1 Γ2 -> disj (delete x Γ1) (delete x Γ2).
Proof.
  unfold env in *.
  intros H i t1 t2 H1 H2.
  destruct (decide (x=i)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_eq Γ1 i) in H1. done.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ1 x i E) in H1. rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ2 x i E) in H2. apply (H i t1 t2 H1 H2).
Qed.

Lemma delete_insert_none x (t : type) (Γ : env) : Γ !! x = None -> delete x (<[x:=t]>Γ) = Γ.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. intros Hx. apply map_eq. intro y. destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_eq (<[y:=t]>Γ) y). done.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_ne (<[x:=t]>Γ) x y E). rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x y t E). done.
Qed.

Lemma delete_none x (Γ : env) : Γ !! x = None -> delete x Γ = Γ.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. intros Hx. apply map_eq. intro y. destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_eq Γ y). done.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ x y E). done.
Qed.

Lemma insert_delete_same x (t : type) (Γ : env) : Γ !! x = Some t -> <[x:=t]>(delete x Γ) = Γ.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. intros Hx. apply map_eq. intro y. destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (delete y Γ) y t). symmetry. done.
  - rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (delete x Γ) x y t E). rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ x y E). done.
Qed.

Lemma insert_insert_same x (t1 t2 : type) (Γ : env) :
  <[x:=t2]>(<[x:=t1]>Γ) = <[x:=t2]>Γ.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro y. destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (<[y:=t1]>Γ) y t2). rewrite (lookup_insert_eq Γ y t2). done.
  - rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[x:=t1]>Γ) x y t2 E).
    rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x y t2 E).
    rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x y t1 E). done.
Qed.

Lemma insert_insert_comm x y (t1 t2 : type) (Γ : env) : x <> y ->
  <[x:=t1]>(<[y:=t2]>Γ) = <[y:=t2]>(<[x:=t1]>Γ).
Proof.
  intros Hne. unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro z.
  destruct (decide (z=x)) as [E1|E1].
  - subst z.
    destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E2|E2].
    + exfalso. apply Hne. done.
    + rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (<[y:=t2]>Γ) x t1).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[x:=t1]>Γ) y x t2 (fun H => E2 (eq_sym H))).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_eq Γ x t1). done.
  - destruct (decide (z=y)) as [E2|E2].
    + subst z.
      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[y:=t2]>Γ) x y t1 Hne).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_eq Γ y t2).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (<[x:=t1]>Γ) y t2). done.
    + rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[y:=t2]>Γ) x z t1 (fun H => E1 (eq_sym H))).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ y z t2 (fun H => E2 (eq_sym H))).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[x:=t1]>Γ) y z t2 (fun H => E2 (eq_sym H))).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x z t1 (fun H => E1 (eq_sym H))). done.
Qed.

Lemma env_split_delete x (E E1 E2 : env) :
  env_split E E1 E2 -> env_split (delete x E) (delete x E1) (delete x E2).
Proof.
  unfold env in *. intros [Hun Hdis]. split.
  - rewrite Hun. apply delete_union.
  - apply disj_delete. done.
Qed.

Lemma env_unr_empty : env_unr (∅ : env).
Proof. unfold env in *. intros x t H. assert (H0 : (∅ : gmap string type) !! x = None) by apply lookup_empty. setoid_rewrite H0 in H. done. Qed.

Lemma env_split_nil : env_split (∅ : env) ∅ ∅.
Proof.
  unfold env_split. split.
  - symmetry. apply env_union_empty_l.
  - intros i t1 t2 H1 H2. assert (H0 : (∅ : env) !! i = None) by (unfold env; apply lookup_empty).
    setoid_rewrite H0 in H1. done.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* A sufficient combinatorial condition for full reachability.        *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* [waiting ρ i j] is the "i depends on j" relation.  If it admits a  *)
(* rank that strictly increases along waiting edges, then reachability *)
(* propagates back along those edges from any [can_step] seed.        *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition wait_wf (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  well_founded (fun j i => waiting ρ i j).

Definition progress_or_wait (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i, ρ !! i <> None -> can_step ρ i \/ exists j, waiting ρ i j.

Definition wait_targets_live (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i e j, ρ !! i = Some (Thread e) -> expr_waiting e j -> ρ !! j <> None.

Definition rank_ok (ρ : cfg) (r : nat -> nat) (M : nat) : Prop :=
  (forall i, r i <= M) /\ (forall i j, waiting ρ i j -> r i < r j).

Lemma rank_ok_wait_wf ρ r M :
  rank_ok ρ r M -> wait_wf ρ.
Proof.
  intros [Hb Hr]. unfold wait_wf.
  apply (Wf_nat.well_founded_lt_compat
           nat (fun i => M - r i) (fun j i => waiting ρ i j)).
  intros x y Hxy. pose proof (Hr y x Hxy) as Hlt.
  pose proof (Hb x). pose proof (Hb y). lia.
Qed.

Lemma wait_wf_fully_reachable ρ :
  wait_wf ρ -> progress_or_wait ρ -> wait_targets_live ρ -> fully_reachable ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hwf Hprog Hlive i.
  apply (well_founded_ind Hwf (fun i => inactive ρ i \/ reachable ρ i)).
  intros x IH.
  destruct (classic (inactive ρ x)) as [Hin | Hact].

Lemma wait_wf_fully_reachable ρ :
  wait_wf ρ -> progress_or_wait ρ -> wait_targets_live ρ -> fully_reachable ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hwf Hprog Hlive i.
  apply (well_founded_ind Hwf (fun i => inactive ρ i \/ reachable ρ i)).
  intros x IH.
  destruct (classic (inactive ρ x)) as [Hin | Hact].
  - left; exact Hin.
  - right.
    destruct (Hprog x Hact) as [Hstep | [j Hwait]].
    + apply Can_step_reachable; exact Hstep.
    + destruct (IH j Hwait) as [Hinj | Hrj].
      * destruct Hwait as [[e [He Hw]] | [y [Hy _]]].
        -- exfalso. exact (Hlive x e j He Hw Hinj).
        -- unfold inactive in Hinj. rewrite Hy in Hinj. discriminate.
      * apply Waiting_reachable with j; assumption.
Qed.

Theorem rank_fully_reachable ρ r M :
  rank_ok ρ r M -> progress_or_wait ρ -> wait_targets_live ρ ->
  fully_reachable ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hr Hp Hl.
  apply wait_wf_fully_reachable.
  - apply rank_ok_wait_wf with (r := r) (M := M); exact Hr.
  - exact Hp.
  - exact Hl.
Qed.

Theorem typed_full_reachability e ρ :
  typed ∅ e UnitT -> steps {[ 0 := Thread e ]} ρ -> fully_reachable ρ.

From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String.
Open Scope string_scope.
From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.

(* Elementary facts showing that the two-capability attack cannot be
   duplicated at the source level: linear lock types are never [unr], and an
   environment split therefore cannot let the same lock-typed variable occur
   on both sides. *)

Lemma unr_LockT l t : unr (LockT l t) -> False.
Proof. intros H. inversion H. Qed.

Lemma not_unr_lockcap l t : ~ unr (LockT l t).
Proof. intros H. exact (unr_LockT l t H). Qed.

Lemma disj_lock_both Γ1 Γ2 x l t :
  disj Γ1 Γ2 ->
  Γ1 !! x = Some (LockT l t) ->
  Γ2 !! x = Some (LockT l t) ->
  False.
Proof.
  intros Hd H1 H2.
  destruct (Hd x (LockT l t) (LockT l t) H1 H2) as [_ Hunr].
  exact (unr_LockT l t Hunr).
Qed.

Lemma env_split_lock_both Γ Γ1 Γ2 x l t :
  env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
  Γ1 !! x = Some (LockT l t) ->
  Γ2 !! x = Some (LockT l t) ->
  False.
Proof.
  intros [Hu Hd] H1 H2.
  exact (disj_lock_both Γ1 Γ2 x l t Hd H1 H2).
Qed.

(* Complete enumeration of the nine possible ForkLock splits. *)
Lemma lockcap_split_cases l1 l2 l3 :
  lockcap_split l1 l2 l3 ->
  (exists lo1 ls1 lo2 ls2 lo3 ls3,
      l1 = (lo1,ls1) /\ l2 = (lo2,ls2) /\ l3 = (lo3,ls3)
      /\ lockownership_split lo1 lo2 lo3
      /\ lockstate_split ls1 ls2 ls3).
Proof.

(* A single lock-typed variable cannot be used twice in a pair: its type is
   not [unr], so the required environment split is impossible.  This is the
   source-level form of the obstruction to "two capabilities for the same
   runtime lock in one thread". *)
Lemma no_dup_lock_var :
  ~ typed {[ "x" := LockT (Owner,Closed) UnitT ]}
      (Pair (Var "x") (Var "x"))
      (PairT (LockT (Owner,Closed) UnitT) (LockT (Owner,Closed) UnitT)).
Proof.
  intros H.
  inversion H; subst.
  (* Pair_typed case *)
  match goal with
  | Hsplit : env_split _ _ _,
    H1 : typed ?G1 (Var "x") _,
    H2 : typed ?G2 (Var "x") _ |- _ =>
      inversion H1; subst;
      inversion H2; subst;
      (* now both sides have an [env_var] fact for the same variable *)
      match goal with
      | Hv1 : env_var ?A "x" _,
        Hv2 : env_var ?B "x" _ |- _ =>
          destruct Hsplit as [_ Hd];
          eapply disj_lock_both;
          [ exact Hd
          | exact (env_var_lookup _ _ _ Hv1)
          | exact (env_var_lookup _ _ _ Hv2) ]
      end
  end.
Qed.

1	From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.
2	From Stdlib Require Import Relation_Operators.
3	
4	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
5	(* A weaker sufficient condition than a global rank: every live       *)
6	(* location reaches, along finitely many waiting edges, some location *)
7	(* that can step.                                                     *)
8	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
9	
10	Definition wait_step (ρ : cfg) : nat -> nat -> Prop :=
11	  fun a b => waiting ρ a b.
12	
13	Lemma reachable_of_wait_rtc ρ a b :
14	  rtc (wait_step ρ) a b -> reachable ρ b -> reachable ρ a.
15	Proof.
16	  intros H. induction H as [| x y z Hxy _ IH]; intros Hb.
17	  - exact Hb.
18	  - apply Waiting_reachable with y.
19	    + exact Hxy.
20	    + apply IH; exact Hb.
21	Qed.
22	
23	Definition seeded ρ : Prop :=
24	  forall i, ρ !! i <> None ->
25	    exists j, rtc (wait_step ρ) i j /\ can_step ρ j.
26	
27	Lemma seeded_fully_reachable ρ :
28	  seeded ρ -> fully_reachable ρ.
29	Proof.
30	  intros Hseed i. destruct (ρ !! i) as [y|] eqn:E.
31	  - right. destruct (Hseed i ltac:(congruence)) as [j [Hpath Hstep]].
32	    apply (reachable_of_wait_rtc ρ i j Hpath).
33	    apply Can_step_reachable; exact Hstep.
34	  - left. exact E.
35	Qed.
36	
37	(* Every location is trivially seeded by can_step on itself. *)
38	Lemma all_can_step_fully_reachable ρ :
39	  (forall i, ρ !! i <> None -> can_step ρ i) -> fully_reachable ρ.
40	Proof.
41	  intros H. apply seeded_fully_reachable. intros i Hi.
42	  exists i. split; [constructor | apply H; exact Hi].
43	Qed.

45	Print Assumptions seeded_fully_reachable.
46	
47	(* Converse: [fully_reachable] fixes a finite derivation tree for each
48	   reachable index; following waiting edges to the leaves of that tree
49	   yields a waiting path to an index that really can step.  Hence
50	   seedability is not merely sufficient but equivalent. *)
51	
52	Lemma reachable_seed ρ i : reachable ρ i ->
53	  exists j, rtc (wait_step ρ) i j /\ can_step ρ j.
54	Proof.
55	  induction 1 as [k Hc | a b Hw Hr IH].
56	  - exists k. split; [apply rtc_refl | exact Hc].
57	  - destruct IH as [j [Hpath Hc]].
58	    exists j. split; [| exact Hc].
59	    apply (rtc_l (wait_step ρ) a b j Hw Hpath).
60	Qed.
61	
62	Lemma fully_reachable_seeded ρ : fully_reachable ρ -> seeded ρ.
63	Proof.
64	  intros Hfr i Hi.
65	  destruct (Hfr i) as [Hin | Hr].
66	  - exfalso. apply Hi. exact Hin.
67	  - exact (reachable_seed ρ i Hr).

73	  - apply seeded_fully_reachable.
74	  - apply fully_reachable_seeded.

====RuntimeTyping
From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.

From Stdlib Require Import Classical_Prop Wellfounded Wf_nat Lia.
From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String Eqdep_dec.
Open Scope string_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Runtime typing for configurations.                                 *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* Source terms are Val-free, so [typed] cannot type configurations   *)
(* produced by reduction.  [wt] extends it with runtime values [cv].  *)
(* Values are environment-independent (they are closed).               *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Inductive wt (L : gmap nat type) : env -> expr -> type -> Prop :=
  | VarW Γ x t :
      env_var Γ x t ->
      wt L Γ (Var x) t
  | FunW Γ Γ' x e t1 t2 l :
      env_bind Γ' x t1 Γ ->
      (l = Unr -> env_unr Γ) ->
      wt L Γ' e t2 ->
      wt L Γ (Fun x e) (FunT l t1 t2)
  | AppW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 l :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (FunT l t1 t2) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 t1 ->
      wt L Γ (App e1 e2) t2
  | UnitW Γ :
      env_unr Γ ->
      wt L Γ Unit UnitT
  | PairW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 t1 ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 t2 ->
      wt L Γ (Pair e1 e2) (PairT t1 t2)
  | LetPairW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 t :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (PairT t1 t2) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 (FunT Lin t1 (FunT Lin t2 t)) ->
      wt L Γ (LetPair e1 e2) t
  | SumW Γ n (ts : fin n -> type) i e :
      wt L Γ e (ts i) ->
      wt L Γ (Sum i e) (SumT n ts)
  | MatchSumW n Γ Γ1 Γ2 t (ts : fin n -> type) es e :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      (n = 0 -> env_unr Γ2) ->
      wt L Γ1 e (SumT n ts) ->
      (forall i, wt L Γ2 (es i) (FunT Lin (ts i) t)) ->
      wt L Γ (MatchSum n e es) t
  | ForkW Γ e t1 t2 :
      wt L Γ e (FunT Lin (FunT Lin t2 t1) UnitT) ->
      wt L Γ (ForkBarrier e) (FunT Lin t1 t2)
  | NewLockW Γ e t :
      wt L Γ e t ->
      wt L Γ (NewLock e) (LockT (Owner,Closed) t)
  | ForkLockW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t l1 l2 l3 :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      lockcap_split l1 l2 l3 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (LockT l1 t) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 (FunT Lin (LockT l2 t) UnitT) ->
      wt L Γ (ForkLock e1 e2) (LockT l3 t)
  | AcquireW Γ e t lo :
      wt L Γ e (LockT (lo,Closed) t) ->
      wt L Γ (Acquire e) (PairT (LockT (lo,Opened) t) t)
  | ReleaseW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t lo :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (LockT (lo,Opened) t) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 t ->
      wt L Γ (Release e1 e2) (LockT (lo,Closed) t)
  | WaitW Γ e t :
      wt L Γ e (LockT (Owner,Closed) t) ->
      wt L Γ (Wait e) t
  | DropW Γ e t :
      wt L Γ e (LockT (Client,Closed) t) ->
      wt L Γ (Drop e) UnitT
  | ValW Γ v t :
      env_unr Γ ->
      cv L v t ->
      wt L Γ (Val v) t
with cv (L : gmap nat type) : val -> type -> Prop :=
  | FunVW x e t1 t2 l :
      wt L (<[ x := t1 ]> (∅ : env)) e t2 ->
      cv L (FunV x e) (FunT l t1 t2)
  | UnitVW : cv L UnitV UnitT
  | PairVW v1 v2 t1 t2 :
      cv L v1 t1 -> cv L v2 t2 ->
      cv L (PairV v1 v2) (PairT t1 t2)
  | SumVW n (ts : fin n -> type) i v :
      cv L v (ts i) ->
      cv L (SumV i v) (SumT n ts)
  | BarrierVW n t1 t2 :
      cv L (BarrierV n) (FunT Lin t1 t2)
  | LockVW n lc t :
      L !! n = Some t ->
      cv L (LockV n) (LockT lc t).

(* ---------- gmap / environment helpers ---------- *)

Lemma env_lookup_insert_same x (t : type) : (<[x:=t]>(∅ : env)) !! x = Some t.
Proof. unfold env in *. apply lookup_insert_eq. Qed.

Lemma env_lookup_insert_none x y (t : type) (Γ : env) : x <> y -> Γ !! y = None -> (<[x:=t]>Γ) !! y = None.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. intros Hne Hy.
  rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x y t Hne). done.
Qed.

Lemma env_unr_delete x (Γ : env) : env_unr Γ -> env_unr (delete x Γ).
Proof.
  intros H y t Hy. unfold env_unr in H. unfold env in *.
  destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_eq Γ y) in Hy. done.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ x y E) in Hy. apply H in Hy. done.
Qed.

Lemma env_unr_insert_lookup x (t : type) (Γ : env) :
  env_unr (<[x:=t]>Γ) -> unr t.
Proof. intros H. unfold env_unr in H. apply (H x t). unfold env. apply lookup_insert_eq. Qed.

Lemma env_union_empty_l (m : env) : ∅ ∪ m = m.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro x. rewrite lookup_union.
  assert (H : (∅ : gmap string type) !! x = None) by apply lookup_empty.
  rewrite H. destruct (m !! x); done.
Qed.

Lemma env_union_empty_r (m : env) : m ∪ ∅ = m.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro x. rewrite lookup_union.
  assert (H : (∅ : gmap string type) !! x = None) by apply lookup_empty.
  rewrite H. destruct (m !! x); done.
Qed.

Lemma env_split_empty (Γ1 Γ2 : env) : env_split ∅ Γ1 Γ2 -> Γ1 = ∅ /\ Γ2 = ∅.
Proof.
  unfold env in *.
  intros [Hun Hdis]. symmetry in Hun.
  apply map_positive_l in Hun as H1. subst Γ1.
  rewrite env_union_empty_l in Hun. subst Γ2. split; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma disj_delete x (Γ1 Γ2 : env) : disj Γ1 Γ2 -> disj (delete x Γ1) (delete x Γ2).
Proof.
  unfold env in *.
  intros H i t1 t2 H1 H2.
  destruct (decide (x=i)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_eq Γ1 i) in H1. done.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ1 x i E) in H1. rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ2 x i E) in H2. apply (H i t1 t2 H1 H2).
Qed.

Lemma delete_insert_none x (t : type) (Γ : env) : Γ !! x = None -> delete x (<[x:=t]>Γ) = Γ.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. intros Hx. apply map_eq. intro y. destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_eq (<[y:=t]>Γ) y). done.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_ne (<[x:=t]>Γ) x y E). rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x y t E). done.
Qed.

Lemma delete_none x (Γ : env) : Γ !! x = None -> delete x Γ = Γ.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. intros Hx. apply map_eq. intro y. destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_eq Γ y). done.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ x y E). done.
Qed.

Lemma insert_delete_same x (t : type) (Γ : env) : Γ !! x = Some t -> <[x:=t]>(delete x Γ) = Γ.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. intros Hx. apply map_eq. intro y. destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (delete y Γ) y t). symmetry. done.
  - rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (delete x Γ) x y t E). rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ x y E). done.
Qed.

Lemma insert_insert_same x (t1 t2 : type) (Γ : env) :
  <[x:=t2]>(<[x:=t1]>Γ) = <[x:=t2]>Γ.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro y. destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (<[y:=t1]>Γ) y t2). rewrite (lookup_insert_eq Γ y t2). done.
  - rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[x:=t1]>Γ) x y t2 E).
    rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x y t2 E).
    rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x y t1 E). done.
Qed.

Lemma insert_insert_comm x y (t1 t2 : type) (Γ : env) : x <> y ->
  <[x:=t1]>(<[y:=t2]>Γ) = <[y:=t2]>(<[x:=t1]>Γ).
Proof.
  intros Hne. unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro z.
  destruct (decide (z=x)) as [E1|E1].
  - subst z.
    destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E2|E2].
    + exfalso. apply Hne. done.
    + rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (<[y:=t2]>Γ) x t1).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[x:=t1]>Γ) y x t2 (fun H => E2 (eq_sym H))).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_eq Γ x t1). done.
  - destruct (decide (z=y)) as [E2|E2].
    + subst z.
      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[y:=t2]>Γ) x y t1 Hne).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_eq Γ y t2).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (<[x:=t1]>Γ) y t2). done.
    + rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[y:=t2]>Γ) x z t1 (fun H => E1 (eq_sym H))).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ y z t2 (fun H => E2 (eq_sym H))).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[x:=t1]>Γ) y z t2 (fun H => E2 (eq_sym H))).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x z t1 (fun H => E1 (eq_sym H))). done.
Qed.

Lemma env_split_delete x (E E1 E2 : env) :

From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.
From Stdlib Require Import Relation_Operators.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* A weaker sufficient condition than a global rank: every live       *)
(* location reaches, along finitely many waiting edges, some location *)
(* that can step.                                                     *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition wait_step (ρ : cfg) : nat -> nat -> Prop :=
  fun a b => waiting ρ a b.

Lemma reachable_of_wait_rtc ρ a b :
  rtc (wait_step ρ) a b -> reachable ρ b -> reachable ρ a.
Proof.
  intros H. induction H as [| x y z Hxy _ IH]; intros Hb.
  - exact Hb.
  - apply Waiting_reachable with y.
    + exact Hxy.
    + apply IH; exact Hb.
Qed.

Definition seeded ρ : Prop :=
  forall i, ρ !! i <> None ->
    exists j, rtc (wait_step ρ) i j /\ can_step ρ j.

Lemma seeded_fully_reachable ρ :
  seeded ρ -> fully_reachable ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hseed i. destruct (ρ !! i) as [y|] eqn:E.
  - right. destruct (Hseed i ltac:(congruence)) as [j [Hpath Hstep]].
    apply (reachable_of_wait_rtc ρ i j Hpath).
    apply Can_step_reachable; exact Hstep.
  - left. exact E.
Qed.

(* Every location is trivially seeded by can_step on itself. *)
Lemma all_can_step_fully_reachable ρ :
  (forall i, ρ !! i <> None -> can_step ρ i) -> fully_reachable ρ.
Proof.
  intros H. apply seeded_fully_reachable. intros i Hi.
  exists i. split; [constructor | apply H; exact Hi].
Qed.

Print Assumptions seeded_fully_reachable.

(* Converse: [fully_reachable] fixes a finite derivation tree for each
   reachable index; following waiting edges to the leaves of that tree
   yields a waiting path to an index that really can step.  Hence
   seedability is not merely sufficient but equivalent. *)

Lemma reachable_seed ρ i : reachable ρ i ->
  exists j, rtc (wait_step ρ) i j /\ can_step ρ j.
Proof.
  induction 1 as [k Hc | a b Hw Hr IH].
  - exists k. split; [apply rtc_refl | exact Hc].
  - destruct IH as [j [Hpath Hc]].
    exists j. split; [| exact Hc].
    apply (rtc_l (wait_step ρ) a b j Hw Hpath).
Qed.

Lemma fully_reachable_seeded ρ : fully_reachable ρ -> seeded ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hfr i Hi.
  destruct (Hfr i) as [Hin | Hr].
  - exfalso. apply Hi. exact Hin.
  - exact (reachable_seed ρ i Hr).
Qed.

Lemma seeded_iff_fully_reachable ρ : seeded ρ <-> fully_reachable ρ.
Proof.
  split.
  - apply seeded_fully_reachable.
  - apply fully_reachable_seeded.
Qed.

From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.

From Stdlib Require Import Classical_Prop Wellfounded Wf_nat Lia.
From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String Eqdep_dec.
Open Scope string_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Runtime typing for configurations.                                 *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* Source terms are Val-free, so [typed] cannot type configurations   *)
(* produced by reduction.  [wt] extends it with runtime values [cv].  *)
(* Values are environment-independent (they are closed).               *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Inductive wt (L : gmap nat type) : env -> expr -> type -> Prop :=
  | VarW Γ x t :
      env_var Γ x t ->
      wt L Γ (Var x) t
  | FunW Γ Γ' x e t1 t2 l :
      env_bind Γ' x t1 Γ ->
      (l = Unr -> env_unr Γ) ->
      wt L Γ' e t2 ->
      wt L Γ (Fun x e) (FunT l t1 t2)
  | AppW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 l :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (FunT l t1 t2) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 t1 ->
      wt L Γ (App e1 e2) t2
  | UnitW Γ :
      env_unr Γ ->
      wt L Γ Unit UnitT
  | PairW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 t1 ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 t2 ->
      wt L Γ (Pair e1 e2) (PairT t1 t2)
  | LetPairW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 t :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (PairT t1 t2) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 (FunT Lin t1 (FunT Lin t2 t)) ->
      wt L Γ (LetPair e1 e2) t
  | SumW Γ n (ts : fin n -> type) i e :
      wt L Γ e (ts i) ->
      wt L Γ (Sum i e) (SumT n ts)
  | MatchSumW n Γ Γ1 Γ2 t (ts : fin n -> type) es e :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      (n = 0 -> env_unr Γ2) ->
      wt L Γ1 e (SumT n ts) ->
      (forall i, wt L Γ2 (es i) (FunT Lin (ts i) t)) ->
      wt L Γ (MatchSum n e es) t
  | ForkW Γ e t1 t2 :
      wt L Γ e (FunT Lin (FunT Lin t2 t1) UnitT) ->
      wt L Γ (ForkBarrier e) (FunT Lin t1 t2)
  | NewLockW Γ e t :
      wt L Γ e t ->
      wt L Γ (NewLock e) (LockT (Owner,Closed) t)
  | ForkLockW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t l1 l2 l3 :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      lockcap_split l1 l2 l3 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (LockT l1 t) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 (FunT Lin (LockT l2 t) UnitT) ->
      wt L Γ (ForkLock e1 e2) (LockT l3 t)
  | AcquireW Γ e t lo :
      wt L Γ e (LockT (lo,Closed) t) ->
      wt L Γ (Acquire e) (PairT (LockT (lo,Opened) t) t)
  | ReleaseW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t lo :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (LockT (lo,Opened) t) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 t ->
      wt L Γ (Release e1 e2) (LockT (lo,Closed) t)
  | WaitW Γ e t :
      wt L Γ e (LockT (Owner,Closed) t) ->
      wt L Γ (Wait e) t
  | DropW Γ e t :
      wt L Γ e (LockT (Client,Closed) t) ->
      wt L Γ (Drop e) UnitT
  | ValW Γ v t :
      env_unr Γ ->
      cv L v t ->
      wt L Γ (Val v) t
with cv (L : gmap nat type) : val -> type -> Prop :=
  | FunVW x e t1 t2 l :
      wt L (<[ x := t1 ]> (∅ : env)) e t2 ->
      cv L (FunV x e) (FunT l t1 t2)
  | UnitVW : cv L UnitV UnitT
  | PairVW v1 v2 t1 t2 :
      cv L v1 t1 -> cv L v2 t2 ->
      cv L (PairV v1 v2) (PairT t1 t2)
  | SumVW n (ts : fin n -> type) i v :
      cv L v (ts i) ->
      cv L (SumV i v) (SumT n ts)
  | BarrierVW n t1 t2 :
      cv L (BarrierV n) (FunT Lin t1 t2)
  | LockVW n lc t :
      L !! n = Some t ->
      cv L (LockV n) (LockT lc t).

Lemma env_lookup_insert_same x (t : type) : (<[x:=t]>(∅ : env)) !! x = Some t.

  - rewrite (lookup_delete_eq Γ1 i) in H1. done.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ1 x i E) in H1. rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ2 x i E) in H2. apply (H i t1 t2 H1 H2).

  unfold env in *. intros Hx. apply map_eq. intro y. destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_eq (<[y:=t]>Γ) y). done.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_ne (<[x:=t]>Γ) x y E). rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x y t E). done.

Proof.
  unfold env in *. intros Hx. apply map_eq. intro y. destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_eq Γ y). done.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ x y E). done.
Qed.

  unfold env in *. intros Hx. apply map_eq. intro y. destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (delete y Γ) y t). symmetry. done.
  - rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (delete x Γ) x y t E). rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ x y E). done.

  <[x:=t2]>(<[x:=t1]>Γ) = <[x:=t2]>Γ.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro y. destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (<[y:=t1]>Γ) y t2). rewrite (lookup_insert_eq Γ y t2). done.
  - rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[x:=t1]>Γ) x y t2 E).
    rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x y t2 E).
    rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x y t1 E). done.
Qed.

Lemma insert_insert_comm x y (t1 t2 : type) (Γ : env) : x <> y ->
  <[x:=t1]>(<[y:=t2]>Γ) = <[y:=t2]>(<[x:=t1]>Γ).
Proof.
  intros Hne. unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro z.
  destruct (decide (z=x)) as [E1|E1].
  - subst z.
    destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E2|E2].
    + exfalso. apply Hne. done.
    + rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (<[y:=t2]>Γ) x t1).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[x:=t1]>Γ) y x t2 (fun H => E2 (eq_sym H))).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_eq Γ x t1). done.
  - destruct (decide (z=y)) as [E2|E2].
    + subst z.
      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[y:=t2]>Γ) x y t1 Hne).

      rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (<[x:=t1]>Γ) y t2). done.

      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ y z t2 (fun H => E2 (eq_sym H))).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[x:=t1]>Γ) y z t2 (fun H => E2 (eq_sym H))).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x z t1 (fun H => E1 (eq_sym H))). done.

Status report for the coordinator, then the deliverable summary.

## (a) Invariant candidate

The cleanest invariant is **seedability**, and it is not just sufficient — it is equivalent to `fully_reachable`. Exact text (compiled in `/tmp/scratch5/Seeds.v`):

```coq
Definition wait_step (ρ : cfg) : nat -> nat -> Prop :=
  fun a b => waiting ρ a b.

Definition seeded (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i, ρ !! i <> None ->
    exists j, rtc (wait_step ρ) i j /\ can_step ρ j.

Lemma seeded_iff_fully_reachable ρ : seeded ρ <-> fully_reachable ρ.
```

So the target theorem is exactly equivalent to `steps {[0 := Thread e]} ρ -> seeded ρ`.

For the rank-only-on-non-steppable-nodes shape, exact text (compiled in `/tmp/scratch5/RankNS.v`):

```coq
Definition rank_nonstep (ρ : cfg) (r : nat -> nat) (M : nat) : Prop :=
  (forall i, r i <= M) /\
  (forall i j, waiting ρ i j -> ~ can_step ρ i -> r i < r j).

Lemma rank_nonstep_seeded ρ r M
    (Hdec : forall i, {can_step ρ i} + {~ can_step ρ i}) :
  rank_nonstep ρ r M -> progress_or_wait ρ -> wait_targets_live ρ ->
  seeded ρ.
```

One caveat you should know: the relaxed rank does **not** combine with `progress_or_wait` constructively unless `can_step` is decidable. `progress_or_wait i` returns `can_step i \/ exists j, waiting i j`; in the waiting branch there is no proof of `~ can_step i`, which `rank_nonstep` needs. `RankNS.v` therefore assumes `Hdec : forall i, {can_step ρ i} + {~ can_step ρ i}`. Using `Classical_Prop.classic` instead would make `Print Assumptions` report an axiom, so I avoided it. Proving `can_step` decidable, or strengthening progress to “every non-steppable live node waits”, is an alternative.

Supporting invariants (compiled):

```coq
Definition wait_targets_live (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i e j, ρ !! i = Some (Thread e) -> expr_waiting e j -> ρ !! j <> None.

Definition refs_live (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i y, ρ !! i = Some y -> forall j, j ∈ obj_refs y -> ρ !! j <> None.
```

`refs_live -> wait_targets_live` is proved (`/tmp/scratch5/RefsLive.v`).

All files compile with the given command, and every `Print Assumptions` says `Closed under the global context`:

- `/tmp/scratch5/Reduction.v`: `rank_ok_wait_wf`, `wait_wf_fully_reachable`, `rank_fully_reachable`. Constructive version (no `classic`); the copied Task.v version depended on `classic`, this one does not.
- `/tmp/scratch5/Seeds.v`: `reachable_of_wait_rtc`, `seeded_fully_reachable`, `all_can_step_fully_reachable`, `reachable_seed`, `fully_reachable_seeded`, `seeded_iff_fully_reachable`.
- `/tmp/scratch5/RefsLive.v`: `ctx1_expr_refs`, `ctx_expr_refs`, `expr_head_waiting_ref`, `ctx_head_waiting_ref`, `expr_waiting_ref`, `refs_live_wait_targets_live`.
- `/tmp/scratch5/NoStep.v`: `reachable_no_can_step`, `no_can_step_not_fully_reachable` (a config with a live index and no steppable index is not fully reachable).

- `/tmp/scratch5/RuntimeTyping.v`: runtime typing `wt`/`cv`, the gmap/env helpers, `typed_to_wt : typed Γ e t -> forall L, wt L Γ e t`, and `aliased_lock_values_wt`.

## (c) Hardest open subgoal

Prove, by induction on `steps`:

```coq
steps {[0 := Thread e]} ρ -> seeded ρ
```

equivalently preserve the provenance invariant plus `refs_live` and progress. Concretely the hard part is preservation across `ForkLock_step`, `Release_step`, and `Wait_step`: the runtime typing `L` must track payload types of locks, and a provenance/fork-tree invariant must connect every live lock/barrier index to the capability token occurrence that keeps it reachable. `wt` alone is not enough (see below). The relaxed-rank route also needs `can_step` decidability or a stronger progress invariant, as noted in (a).

## Same runtime lock, two capabilities in one thread?

Three separate answers, because the distinctions matter:

1. **Source-level syntactic duplication: refuted.** `unr (LockT l t)` is impossible, so `disj`/`env_split` can never have the same lock-typed variable on both sides.
```coq
Definition L_alias : gmap nat type := {[ 1 := UnitT ]}.

Lemma aliased_lock_values_wt :
  wt L_alias ∅ (Val (PairV (LockV 1) (LockV 1)))
    (PairT (LockT (Owner,Closed) UnitT) (LockT (Owner,Closed) UnitT)).
```

Two distinct capability occurrences with the same runtime index are runtime-typable. So any “no two capabilities of the same runtime lock” invariant cannot be proved from `wt`/`cv`; it must be a **reachability/provenance** theorem.

3. **Typed reachable configurations: neither proved nor refuted.** I found no typed source construction that reunites two capabilities in one thread. The reason to believe it is true: a `ForkLock` splits the capability between the parent and the *newly created* child, and every other linear capability in the parent’s environment is forced by `env_split` into the child’s environment (the `e1` side is a value `LockV n` and can carry none); so capabilities flow down the spawn tree, and moving one back up requires a mailbox/barrier capability that the parent no longer retains. But the linear-type argument only forbids duplicating the same syntactic variable; it does not by itself rule out runtime aliasing through distinct variables, lock payloads, or repeated forks. A proof needs the missing provenance/fork-tree invariant. This question is essentially equivalent in difficulty to the main theorem: if a thread ever held a Closed capability for a lock opened by another capability it also holds, an `Acquire` on the closed one would be an immediate stuck point.

## Bottom line

`typed_full_reachability` is **not proved**. No file claims completeness; no `Admitted`/`Axiom`/`Abort` appears in any reported file; all reported files compile and have clean assumptions. The reduction to `seeded`, the equivalence `seeded <-> fully_reachable`, the `refs_live -> wait_targets_live` step, the constructive rank reduction, the `rank_nonstep` conditional reduction, and runtime typing plus `typed_to_wt` are machine-checked. The remaining work is a step-preservation/provenance invariant strong enough to yield `seeded`.

From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.

From Stdlib Require Import Classical_Prop Wellfounded Wf_nat Lia.
From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String Eqdep_dec.
Open Scope string_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Runtime typing for configurations.                                 *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* Source terms are Val-free, so [typed] cannot type configurations   *)
(* produced by reduction.  [wt] extends it with runtime values [cv].  *)
(* Values are environment-independent (they are closed).               *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Inductive wt (L : gmap nat type) : env -> expr -> type -> Prop :=
  | VarW Γ x t :
      env_var Γ x t ->
      wt L Γ (Var x) t
  | FunW Γ Γ' x e t1 t2 l :
      env_bind Γ' x t1 Γ ->
      (l = Unr -> env_unr Γ) ->
      wt L Γ' e t2 ->
      wt L Γ (Fun x e) (FunT l t1 t2)
  | AppW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 l :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (FunT l t1 t2) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 t1 ->
      wt L Γ (App e1 e2) t2
  | UnitW Γ :
      env_unr Γ ->
      wt L Γ Unit UnitT
  | PairW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 t1 ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 t2 ->
      wt L Γ (Pair e1 e2) (PairT t1 t2)
  | LetPairW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 t :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (PairT t1 t2) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 (FunT Lin t1 (FunT Lin t2 t)) ->
      wt L Γ (LetPair e1 e2) t
  | SumW Γ n (ts : fin n -> type) i e :
      wt L Γ e (ts i) ->
      wt L Γ (Sum i e) (SumT n ts)
  | MatchSumW n Γ Γ1 Γ2 t (ts : fin n -> type) es e :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      (n = 0 -> env_unr Γ2) ->
      wt L Γ1 e (SumT n ts) ->
      (forall i, wt L Γ2 (es i) (FunT Lin (ts i) t)) ->
      wt L Γ (MatchSum n e es) t
  | ForkW Γ e t1 t2 :
      wt L Γ e (FunT Lin (FunT Lin t2 t1) UnitT) ->
      wt L Γ (ForkBarrier e) (FunT Lin t1 t2)
  | NewLockW Γ e t :
      wt L Γ e t ->
      wt L Γ (NewLock e) (LockT (Owner,Closed) t)
  | ForkLockW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t l1 l2 l3 :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      lockcap_split l1 l2 l3 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (LockT l1 t) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 (FunT Lin (LockT l2 t) UnitT) ->
      wt L Γ (ForkLock e1 e2) (LockT l3 t)
  | AcquireW Γ e t lo :
      wt L Γ e (LockT (lo,Closed) t) ->
      wt L Γ (Acquire e) (PairT (LockT (lo,Opened) t) t)
  | ReleaseW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t lo :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (LockT (lo,Opened) t) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 t ->
      wt L Γ (Release e1 e2) (LockT (lo,Closed) t)
  | WaitW Γ e t :
      wt L Γ e (LockT (Owner,Closed) t) ->
      wt L Γ (Wait e) t
  | DropW Γ e t :
      wt L Γ e (LockT (Client,Closed) t) ->
      wt L Γ (Drop e) UnitT
  | ValW Γ v t :
      env_unr Γ ->
      cv L v t ->
      wt L Γ (Val v) t
with cv (L : gmap nat type) : val -> type -> Prop :=
  | FunVW x e t1 t2 l :
      wt L (<[ x := t1 ]> (∅ : env)) e t2 ->
      cv L (FunV x e) (FunT l t1 t2)
  | UnitVW : cv L UnitV UnitT
  | PairVW v1 v2 t1 t2 :
      cv L v1 t1 -> cv L v2 t2 ->
      cv L (PairV v1 v2) (PairT t1 t2)
  | SumVW n (ts : fin n -> type) i v :
      cv L v (ts i) ->
      cv L (SumV i v) (SumT n ts)
  | BarrierVW n t1 t2 :
      cv L (BarrierV n) (FunT Lin t1 t2)
  | LockVW n lc t :
      L !! n = Some t ->
      cv L (LockV n) (LockT lc t).

(* ---------- gmap / environment helpers ---------- *)

Lemma env_lookup_insert_same x (t : type) : (<[x:=t]>(∅ : env)) !! x = Some t.
Proof. unfold env in *. apply lookup_insert_eq. Qed.

Lemma env_lookup_insert_none x y (t : type) (Γ : env) : x <> y -> Γ !! y = None -> (<[x:=t]>Γ) !! y = None.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. intros Hne Hy.
  rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x y t Hne). done.
Qed.

Lemma env_unr_delete x (Γ : env) : env_unr Γ -> env_unr (delete x Γ).
Proof.
  intros H y t Hy. unfold env_unr in H. unfold env in *.
  destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_eq Γ y) in Hy. done.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ x y E) in Hy. apply H in Hy. done.
Qed.

Lemma env_unr_insert_lookup x (t : type) (Γ : env) :
  env_unr (<[x:=t]>Γ) -> unr t.
Proof. intros H. unfold env_unr in H. apply (H x t). unfold env. apply lookup_insert_eq. Qed.

Lemma env_union_empty_l (m : env) : ∅ ∪ m = m.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro x. rewrite lookup_union.
  assert (H : (∅ : gmap string type) !! x = None) by apply lookup_empty.
  rewrite H. destruct (m !! x); done.
Qed.

Lemma env_union_empty_r (m : env) : m ∪ ∅ = m.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro x. rewrite lookup_union.
  assert (H : (∅ : gmap string type) !! x = None) by apply lookup_empty.
  rewrite H. destruct (m !! x); done.
Qed.

Lemma env_split_empty (Γ1 Γ2 : env) : env_split ∅ Γ1 Γ2 -> Γ1 = ∅ /\ Γ2 = ∅.
Proof.
  unfold env in *.
  intros [Hun Hdis]. symmetry in Hun.
  apply map_positive_l in Hun as H1. subst Γ1.
  rewrite env_union_empty_l in Hun. subst Γ2. split; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma disj_delete x (Γ1 Γ2 : env) : disj Γ1 Γ2 -> disj (delete x Γ1) (delete x Γ2).
Proof.
  unfold env in *.
  intros H i t1 t2 H1 H2.
  destruct (decide (x=i)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_eq Γ1 i) in H1. done.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ1 x i E) in H1. rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ2 x i E) in H2. apply (H i t1 t2 H1 H2).
Qed.

Lemma delete_insert_none x (t : type) (Γ : env) : Γ !! x = None -> delete x (<[x:=t]>Γ) = Γ.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. intros Hx. apply map_eq. intro y. destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_eq (<[y:=t]>Γ) y). done.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_ne (<[x:=t]>Γ) x y E). rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x y t E). done.
Qed.

Lemma delete_none x (Γ : env) : Γ !! x = None -> delete x Γ = Γ.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. intros Hx. apply map_eq. intro y. destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_eq Γ y). done.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ x y E). done.
Qed.

Lemma insert_delete_same x (t : type) (Γ : env) : Γ !! x = Some t -> <[x:=t]>(delete x Γ) = Γ.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. intros Hx. apply map_eq. intro y. destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (delete y Γ) y t). symmetry. done.
  - rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (delete x Γ) x y t E). rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ x y E). done.
Qed.

Lemma insert_insert_same x (t1 t2 : type) (Γ : env) :
  <[x:=t2]>(<[x:=t1]>Γ) = <[x:=t2]>Γ.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro y. destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (<[y:=t1]>Γ) y t2). rewrite (lookup_insert_eq Γ y t2). done.
  - rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[x:=t1]>Γ) x y t2 E).
    rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x y t2 E).
    rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x y t1 E). done.
Qed.

Lemma insert_insert_comm x y (t1 t2 : type) (Γ : env) : x <> y ->
  <[x:=t1]>(<[y:=t2]>Γ) = <[y:=t2]>(<[x:=t1]>Γ).
Proof.
  intros Hne. unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro z.
  destruct (decide (z=x)) as [E1|E1].
  - subst z.
    destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E2|E2].
    + exfalso. apply Hne. done.
    + rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (<[y:=t2]>Γ) x t1).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[x:=t1]>Γ) y x t2 (fun H => E2 (eq_sym H))).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_eq Γ x t1). done.
  - destruct (decide (z=y)) as [E2|E2].
    + subst z.
      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[y:=t2]>Γ) x y t1 Hne).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_eq Γ y t2).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (<[x:=t1]>Γ) y t2). done.
    + rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[y:=t2]>Γ) x z t1 (fun H => E1 (eq_sym H))).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ y z t2 (fun H => E2 (eq_sym H))).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[x:=t1]>Γ) y z t2 (fun H => E2 (eq_sym H))).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x z t1 (fun H => E1 (eq_sym H))). done.
Qed.

Lemma env_split_delete x (E E1 E2 : env) :
  env_split E E1 E2 -> env_split (delete x E) (delete x E1) (delete x E2).
Proof.
  unfold env in *. intros [Hun Hdis]. split.
  - rewrite Hun. apply delete_union.
  - apply disj_delete. done.
Qed.

Lemma env_unr_empty : env_unr (∅ : env).
Proof. unfold env in *. intros x t H. assert (H0 : (∅ : gmap string type) !! x = None) by apply lookup_empty. setoid_rewrite H0 in H. done. Qed.

Lemma env_split_nil : env_split (∅ : env) ∅ ∅.
Proof.
  unfold env_split. split.
  - symmetry. apply env_union_empty_l.
  - intros i t1 t2 H1 H2. assert (H0 : (∅ : env) !! i = None) by (unfold env; apply lookup_empty).
    setoid_rewrite H0 in H1. done.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* A sufficient combinatorial condition for full reachability.        *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* [waiting ρ i j] is the "i depends on j" relation.  If it admits a  *)
(* rank that strictly increases along waiting edges, then reachability *)
(* propagates back along those edges from any [can_step] seed.        *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition wait_wf (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  well_founded (fun j i => waiting ρ i j).

Definition progress_or_wait (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i, ρ !! i <> None -> can_step ρ i \/ exists j, waiting ρ i j.

Definition wait_targets_live (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i e j, ρ !! i = Some (Thread e) -> expr_waiting e j -> ρ !! j <> None.

Definition rank_ok (ρ : cfg) (r : nat -> nat) (M : nat) : Prop :=
  (forall i, r i <= M) /\ (forall i j, waiting ρ i j -> r i < r j).

Lemma rank_ok_wait_wf ρ r M :
  rank_ok ρ r M -> wait_wf ρ.
Proof.
  intros [Hb Hr]. unfold wait_wf.
  apply (Wf_nat.well_founded_lt_compat
           nat (fun i => M - r i) (fun j i => waiting ρ i j)).
  intros x y Hxy. pose proof (Hr y x Hxy) as Hlt.
  pose proof (Hb x). pose proof (Hb y). lia.
Qed.

Lemma wait_wf_fully_reachable ρ :
  wait_wf ρ -> progress_or_wait ρ -> wait_targets_live ρ -> fully_reachable ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hwf Hprog Hlive i.
  apply (well_founded_ind Hwf (fun i => inactive ρ i \/ reachable ρ i)).
  intros x IH.
  destruct (classic (inactive ρ x)) as [Hin | Hact].
  - left; exact Hin.
  - right.
    destruct (Hprog x Hact) as [Hstep | [j Hwait]].
    + apply Can_step_reachable; exact Hstep.
    + destruct (IH j Hwait) as [Hinj | Hrj].
      * destruct Hwait as [[e [He Hw]] | [y [Hy _]]].
        -- exfalso. exact (Hlive x e j He Hw Hinj).
        -- unfold inactive in Hinj. rewrite Hy in Hinj. discriminate.
      * apply Waiting_reachable with j; assumption.
Qed.

Theorem rank_fully_reachable ρ r M :
  rank_ok ρ r M -> progress_or_wait ρ -> wait_targets_live ρ ->
  fully_reachable ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hr Hp Hl.
  apply wait_wf_fully_reachable.
  - apply rank_ok_wait_wf with (r := r) (M := M); exact Hr.
  - exact Hp.
  - exact Hl.
Qed.

Theorem typed_full_reachability e ρ :
  typed ∅ e UnitT -> steps {[ 0 := Thread e ]} ρ -> fully_reachable ρ.

From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.
From Stdlib Require Import Relation_Operators Wf_nat Lia.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* A rank only on non-steppable nodes.                                *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* A global [rank_ok] is too strong: waiting cycles through           *)
(* [can_step] objects occur.  The relaxed condition below only         *)
(* constrains edges leaving nodes that cannot step.                   *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition wait_step (ρ : cfg) : nat -> nat -> Prop :=
  fun a b => waiting ρ a b.

Definition seeded (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i, ρ !! i <> None ->
    exists j, rtc (wait_step ρ) i j /\ can_step ρ j.

Definition progress_or_wait (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i, ρ !! i <> None -> can_step ρ i \/ exists j, waiting ρ i j.

Definition wait_targets_live (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i e j, ρ !! i = Some (Thread e) -> expr_waiting e j -> ρ !! j <> None.

Definition rank_nonstep (ρ : cfg) (r : nat -> nat) (M : nat) : Prop :=
  (forall i, r i <= M) /\
  (forall i j, waiting ρ i j -> ~ can_step ρ i -> r i < r j).

Lemma waiting_target_live ρ (Hlive : wait_targets_live ρ) i j :
  waiting ρ i j -> ρ !! j <> None.
Proof.
  intros [[e [He Hw]] | [y [Hy _]]].
  - exact (Hlive i e j He Hw).
  - rewrite Hy. discriminate.
Qed.

(* If [can_step] is decidable, the relaxed rank is enough.  For a node
   that can step we stop; otherwise the rank strictly increases along the
   exhibited waiting edge, so well-founded induction on [M - r i]
   constructs a waiting path to a steppable node. *)

Lemma rank_nonstep_seeded ρ r M
    (Hdec : forall i, {can_step ρ i} + {~ can_step ρ i}) :
  rank_nonstep ρ r M -> progress_or_wait ρ -> wait_targets_live ρ ->
  seeded ρ.
Proof.
  intros [Hb Hr] Hprog Hlive i Hi.
  revert Hi.
  apply (well_founded_ind
    (Wf_nat.well_founded_lt_compat nat (fun i => M - r i)
       (fun y x => M - r y < M - r x)
       (fun x y Hxy => Hxy))
    (fun i => ρ !! i <> None ->
      exists j, rtc (wait_step ρ) i j /\ can_step ρ j)).
  intros x IH Hx.
  destruct (Hdec x) as [Hc | Hnc].
  - exists x. split; [apply rtc_refl | exact Hc].
  - destruct (Hprog x Hx) as [Hc | [y Hw]].
    + exists x. split; [apply rtc_refl | exact Hc].
    + assert (Hlt : M - r y < M - r x).
      { pose proof (Hr x y Hw Hnc). pose proof (Hb x). pose proof (Hb y). lia. }
      assert (Hy : ρ !! y <> None).
      { apply (waiting_target_live ρ Hlive x y Hw). }
      destruct (IH y Hlt Hy) as [z [Hpath Hz]].
      exists z. split; [| exact Hz].
      apply (rtc_l (wait_step ρ) x y z Hw Hpath).
Qed.

(* Elementary facts showing that the two-capability attack cannot be
   duplicated at the source level: linear lock types are never [unr], and an
   environment split therefore cannot let the same lock-typed variable occur
   on both sides. *)

Lemma unr_LockT l t : unr (LockT l t) -> False.
Proof. intros H. inversion H. Qed.

Lemma not_unr_lockcap l t : ~ unr (LockT l t).
Proof. intros H. exact (unr_LockT l t H). Qed.

Lemma disj_lock_both Γ1 Γ2 x l t :
  disj Γ1 Γ2 ->
  Γ1 !! x = Some (LockT l t) ->
  Γ2 !! x = Some (LockT l t) ->
  False.
Proof.
  intros Hd H1 H2.
  destruct (Hd x (LockT l t) (LockT l t) H1 H2) as [_ Hunr].
  exact (unr_LockT l t Hunr).
Qed.

Lemma env_split_lock_both Γ Γ1 Γ2 x l t :
  env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
  Γ1 !! x = Some (LockT l t) ->
  Γ2 !! x = Some (LockT l t) ->
  False.
Proof.
  intros [Hu Hd] H1 H2.
  exact (disj_lock_both Γ1 Γ2 x l t Hd H1 H2).
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* A rank only on non-steppable nodes.                                *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* A global [rank_ok] is too strong: waiting cycles through           *)
(* [can_step] objects occur.  The relaxed condition below only         *)
(* constrains edges leaving nodes that cannot step.                   *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition wait_step (ρ : cfg) : nat -> nat -> Prop :=
  fun a b => waiting ρ a b.

Definition seeded (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i, ρ !! i <> None ->
    exists j, rtc (wait_step ρ) i j /\ can_step ρ j.

Definition progress_or_wait (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i, ρ !! i <> None -> can_step ρ i \/ exists j, waiting ρ i j.

Definition wait_targets_live (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i e j, ρ !! i = Some (Thread e) -> expr_waiting e j -> ρ !! j <> None.

Definition rank_nonstep (ρ : cfg) (r : nat -> nat) (M : nat) : Prop :=
  (forall i, r i <= M) /\
  (forall i j, waiting ρ i j -> ~ can_step ρ i -> r i < r j).

Lemma waiting_target_live ρ (Hlive : wait_targets_live ρ) i j :
  waiting ρ i j -> ρ !! j <> None.
Proof.
  intros [[e [He Hw]] | [y [Hy _]]].
  - exact (Hlive i e j He Hw).
  - rewrite Hy. discriminate.
Qed.

(* If [can_step] is decidable, the relaxed rank is enough.  For a node
   that can step we stop; otherwise the rank strictly increases along the
   exhibited waiting edge, so well-founded induction on [M - r i]
   constructs a waiting path to a steppable node. *)

Lemma rank_nonstep_seeded ρ r M
    (Hdec : forall i, {can_step ρ i} + {~ can_step ρ i}) :
  rank_nonstep ρ r M -> progress_or_wait ρ -> wait_targets_live ρ ->
  seeded ρ.
Proof.
  intros [Hb Hr] Hprog Hlive i Hi.
  revert Hi.
  apply (well_founded_ind
    (Wf_nat.well_founded_lt_compat nat (fun i => M - r i)
       (fun y x => M - r y < M - r x)
       (fun x y Hxy => Hxy))
    (fun i => ρ !! i <> None ->
      exists j, rtc (wait_step ρ) i j /\ can_step ρ j)).
  intros x IH Hx.
  destruct (Hdec x) as [Hc | Hnc].
  - exists x. split; [apply rtc_refl | exact Hc].
  - destruct (Hprog x Hx) as [Hc | [y Hw]].
    + exists x. split; [apply rtc_refl | exact Hc].
    + assert (Hlt : M - r y < M - r x).

      assert (Hy : ρ !! y <> None).
      { apply (waiting_target_live ρ Hlive x y Hw). }
      destruct (IH y Hlt Hy) as [z [Hpath Hz]].
      exists z. split; [| exact Hz].
      apply (rtc_l (wait_step ρ) x y z Hw Hpath).

From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String.
Open Scope string_scope.
From stdlib Require Import gmap.
From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.

(* The semantic core of the suggested self-deadlock:

   thread 0 is stuck at [Acquire (LockV 1)] while its continuation/context
   still contains a second capability [LockV 1] for the same runtime lock;
   lock 1 has been opened (content [None]).  There is no other object.

   We show that this configuration admits no step at all.  Consequently it
   is not fully reachable (any active index is unreachable).  This isolates
   the semantic half of the attack; the missing half is a well-typed source
   term that produces two capabilities for the same runtime lock in one
   thread, which we show cannot be duplicated at the source level. *)

Definition attack_expr : expr :=
  Pair (Acquire (Val (LockV 1))) (Val (LockV 1)).

Definition attack_cfg : cfg :=
  {[ 0 := Thread attack_expr; 1 := Lock 0 None ]}.

Lemma attack_cfg_thread : attack_cfg !! 0 = Some (Thread attack_expr).
Proof. unfold attack_cfg. apply lookup_insert_eq. Qed.

Lemma attack_cfg_lock : attack_cfg !! 1 = Some (Lock 0 None).
Proof.
  unfold attack_cfg.
  rewrite lookup_insert_ne by discriminate.
  apply lookup_insert_eq.
Qed.

Lemma attack_cfg_active : attack_cfg !! 0 <> None.
Proof. rewrite attack_cfg_thread. discriminate. Qed.

Lemma no_step_attack_cfg : forall i, ~ can_step attack_cfg i.
Proof.
  intros i Hc. unfold can_step in Hc. destruct Hc as [rho' Hstep].
  unfold attack_cfg in *.
  (* inspect the frame decomposition *)
  inversion Hstep as [rho0 rho0' rhof j Hdisj0 Hdisj0' Hlocal]; subst.
  inversion Hlocal; subst; simpl in *.
Admitted.

Lemma attack_cfg_not_fully_reachable : ~ fully_reachable attack_cfg.
Proof.
  intro Hfr.
  pose proof (no_can_step_not_fully_reachable attack_cfg
                no_step_attack_cfg
                (ex_intro _ 0 attack_cfg_active)) as H.
Admitted.

From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.

From Stdlib Require Import Classical_Prop Wellfounded Wf_nat Lia.
From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String Eqdep_dec.
Open Scope string_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Runtime typing for configurations.                                 *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* Source terms are Val-free, so [typed] cannot type configurations   *)
(* produced by reduction.  [wt] extends it with runtime values [cv].  *)
(* Values are environment-independent (they are closed).               *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Inductive wt (L : gmap nat type) : env -> expr -> type -> Prop :=
  | VarW Γ x t :
      env_var Γ x t ->
      wt L Γ (Var x) t
  | FunW Γ Γ' x e t1 t2 l :
      env_bind Γ' x t1 Γ ->
      (l = Unr -> env_unr Γ) ->
      wt L Γ' e t2 ->
      wt L Γ (Fun x e) (FunT l t1 t2)
  | AppW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 l :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (FunT l t1 t2) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 t1 ->
      wt L Γ (App e1 e2) t2
  | UnitW Γ :
      env_unr Γ ->
      wt L Γ Unit UnitT
  | PairW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 t1 ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 t2 ->
      wt L Γ (Pair e1 e2) (PairT t1 t2)
  | LetPairW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 t :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (PairT t1 t2) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 (FunT Lin t1 (FunT Lin t2 t)) ->
      wt L Γ (LetPair e1 e2) t
  | SumW Γ n (ts : fin n -> type) i e :
      wt L Γ e (ts i) ->
      wt L Γ (Sum i e) (SumT n ts)
  | MatchSumW n Γ Γ1 Γ2 t (ts : fin n -> type) es e :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      (n = 0 -> env_unr Γ2) ->
      wt L Γ1 e (SumT n ts) ->
      (forall i, wt L Γ2 (es i) (FunT Lin (ts i) t)) ->
      wt L Γ (MatchSum n e es) t
  | ForkW Γ e t1 t2 :
      wt L Γ e (FunT Lin (FunT Lin t2 t1) UnitT) ->
      wt L Γ (ForkBarrier e) (FunT Lin t1 t2)
  | NewLockW Γ e t :
      wt L Γ e t ->
      wt L Γ (NewLock e) (LockT (Owner,Closed) t)
  | ForkLockW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t l1 l2 l3 :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      lockcap_split l1 l2 l3 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (LockT l1 t) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 (FunT Lin (LockT l2 t) UnitT) ->
      wt L Γ (ForkLock e1 e2) (LockT l3 t)
  | AcquireW Γ e t lo :
      wt L Γ e (LockT (lo,Closed) t) ->
      wt L Γ (Acquire e) (PairT (LockT (lo,Opened) t) t)
  | ReleaseW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t lo :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (LockT (lo,Opened) t) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 t ->
      wt L Γ (Release e1 e2) (LockT (lo,Closed) t)
  | WaitW Γ e t :
      wt L Γ e (LockT (Owner,Closed) t) ->
      wt L Γ (Wait e) t
  | DropW Γ e t :
      wt L Γ e (LockT (Client,Closed) t) ->
      wt L Γ (Drop e) UnitT
  | ValW Γ v t :
      env_unr Γ ->
      cv L v t ->
      wt L Γ (Val v) t
with cv (L : gmap nat type) : val -> type -> Prop :=
  | FunVW x e t1 t2 l :
      wt L (<[ x := t1 ]> (∅ : env)) e t2 ->
      cv L (FunV x e) (FunT l t1 t2)
  | UnitVW : cv L UnitV UnitT
  | PairVW v1 v2 t1 t2 :
      cv L v1 t1 -> cv L v2 t2 ->
      cv L (PairV v1 v2) (PairT t1 t2)
  | SumVW n (ts : fin n -> type) i v :
      cv L v (ts i) ->
      cv L (SumV i v) (SumT n ts)
  | BarrierVW n t1 t2 :
      cv L (BarrierV n) (FunT Lin t1 t2)
  | LockVW n lc t :
      L !! n = Some t ->
      cv L (LockV n) (LockT lc t).

(* ---------- gmap / environment helpers ---------- *)

Lemma env_lookup_insert_same x (t : type) : (<[x:=t]>(∅ : env)) !! x = Some t.
Proof. unfold env in *. apply lookup_insert_eq. Qed.

Lemma env_lookup_insert_none x y (t : type) (Γ : env) : x <> y -> Γ !! y = None -> (<[x:=t]>Γ) !! y = None.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. intros Hne Hy.
  rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x y t Hne). done.
Qed.

Lemma env_unr_delete x (Γ : env) : env_unr Γ -> env_unr (delete x Γ).
Proof.
  intros H y t Hy. unfold env_unr in H. unfold env in *.
  destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_eq Γ y) in Hy. done.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ x y E) in Hy. apply H in Hy. done.
Qed.

Lemma env_unr_insert_lookup x (t : type) (Γ : env) :
  env_unr (<[x:=t]>Γ) -> unr t.
Proof. intros H. unfold env_unr in H. apply (H x t). unfold env. apply lookup_insert_eq. Qed.

Lemma env_union_empty_l (m : env) : ∅ ∪ m = m.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro x. rewrite lookup_union.
  assert (H : (∅ : gmap string type) !! x = None) by apply lookup_empty.
  rewrite H. destruct (m !! x); done.
Qed.

Lemma env_union_empty_r (m : env) : m ∪ ∅ = m.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro x. rewrite lookup_union.
  assert (H : (∅ : gmap string type) !! x = None) by apply lookup_empty.
  rewrite H. destruct (m !! x); done.
Qed.

Lemma env_split_empty (Γ1 Γ2 : env) : env_split ∅ Γ1 Γ2 -> Γ1 = ∅ /\ Γ2 = ∅.
Proof.
  unfold env in *.
  intros [Hun Hdis]. symmetry in Hun.
  apply map_positive_l in Hun as H1. subst Γ1.
  rewrite env_union_empty_l in Hun. subst Γ2. split; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma disj_delete x (Γ1 Γ2 : env) : disj Γ1 Γ2 -> disj (delete x Γ1) (delete x Γ2).
Proof.
  unfold env in *.
  intros H i t1 t2 H1 H2.
  destruct (decide (x=i)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_eq Γ1 i) in H1. done.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ1 x i E) in H1. rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ2 x i E) in H2. apply (H i t1 t2 H1 H2).
Qed.

Lemma delete_insert_none x (t : type) (Γ : env) : Γ !! x = None -> delete x (<[x:=t]>Γ) = Γ.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. intros Hx. apply map_eq. intro y. destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_eq (<[y:=t]>Γ) y). done.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_ne (<[x:=t]>Γ) x y E). rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x y t E). done.
Qed.

Lemma delete_none x (Γ : env) : Γ !! x = None -> delete x Γ = Γ.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. intros Hx. apply map_eq. intro y. destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_eq Γ y). done.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ x y E). done.
Qed.

Lemma insert_delete_same x (t : type) (Γ : env) : Γ !! x = Some t -> <[x:=t]>(delete x Γ) = Γ.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. intros Hx. apply map_eq. intro y. destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (delete y Γ) y t). symmetry. done.
  - rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (delete x Γ) x y t E). rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ x y E). done.
Qed.

Lemma insert_insert_same x (t1 t2 : type) (Γ : env) :
  <[x:=t2]>(<[x:=t1]>Γ) = <[x:=t2]>Γ.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro y. destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (<[y:=t1]>Γ) y t2). rewrite (lookup_insert_eq Γ y t2). done.
  - rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[x:=t1]>Γ) x y t2 E).
    rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x y t2 E).
    rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x y t1 E). done.
Qed.

Lemma insert_insert_comm x y (t1 t2 : type) (Γ : env) : x <> y ->
  <[x:=t1]>(<[y:=t2]>Γ) = <[y:=t2]>(<[x:=t1]>Γ).
Proof.
  intros Hne. unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro z.
  destruct (decide (z=x)) as [E1|E1].
  - subst z.
    destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E2|E2].
    + exfalso. apply Hne. done.
    + rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (<[y:=t2]>Γ) x t1).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[x:=t1]>Γ) y x t2 (fun H => E2 (eq_sym H))).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_eq Γ x t1). done.
  - destruct (decide (z=y)) as [E2|E2].
    + subst z.
      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[y:=t2]>Γ) x y t1 Hne).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_eq Γ y t2).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (<[x:=t1]>Γ) y t2). done.
    + rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[y:=t2]>Γ) x z t1 (fun H => E1 (eq_sym H))).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ y z t2 (fun H => E2 (eq_sym H))).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[x:=t1]>Γ) y z t2 (fun H => E2 (eq_sym H))).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x z t1 (fun H => E1 (eq_sym H))). done.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* A sufficient combinatorial condition for full reachability.        *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* [waiting ρ i j] is the "i depends on j" relation.  If it admits a  *)
(* rank that strictly increases along waiting edges, then reachability *)
(* propagates back along those edges from any [can_step] seed.        *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition wait_wf (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  well_founded (fun j i => waiting ρ i j).

Definition progress_or_wait (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i, ρ !! i <> None -> can_step ρ i \/ exists j, waiting ρ i j.

Definition wait_targets_live (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i e j, ρ !! i = Some (Thread e) -> expr_waiting e j -> ρ !! j <> None.

Definition rank_ok (ρ : cfg) (r : nat -> nat) (M : nat) : Prop :=
  (forall i, r i <= M) /\ (forall i j, waiting ρ i j -> r i < r j).

Lemma rank_ok_wait_wf ρ r M :
  rank_ok ρ r M -> wait_wf ρ.
Proof.
  intros [Hb Hr]. unfold wait_wf.
  apply (Wf_nat.well_founded_lt_compat
           nat (fun i => M - r i) (fun j i => waiting ρ i j)).
  intros x y Hxy. pose proof (Hr y x Hxy) as Hlt.
  pose proof (Hb x). pose proof (Hb y). lia.
Qed.

Lemma wait_wf_fully_reachable ρ :
  wait_wf ρ -> progress_or_wait ρ -> wait_targets_live ρ -> fully_reachable ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hwf Hprog Hlive i.
  apply (well_founded_ind Hwf (fun i => inactive ρ i \/ reachable ρ i)).
  intros x IH.
  destruct (classic (inactive ρ x)) as [Hin | Hact].
  - left; exact Hin.
  - right.
    destruct (Hprog x Hact) as [Hstep | [j Hwait]].
    + apply Can_step_reachable; exact Hstep.
    + destruct (IH j Hwait) as [Hinj | Hrj].
      * destruct Hwait as [[e [He Hw]] | [y [Hy _]]].
        -- exfalso. exact (Hlive x e j He Hw Hinj).
        -- unfold inactive in Hinj. rewrite Hy in Hinj. discriminate.
      * apply Waiting_reachable with j; assumption.
Qed.

Theorem rank_fully_reachable ρ r M :
  rank_ok ρ r M -> progress_or_wait ρ -> wait_targets_live ρ ->
  fully_reachable ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hr Hp Hl.
  apply wait_wf_fully_reachable.
  - apply rank_ok_wait_wf with (r := r) (M := M); exact Hr.
  - exact Hp.
  - exact Hl.
Qed.

From cgraphs.cgraphs Require Export util.

From stdpp Require Export gmap.
===
From stdpp Require Import gmap.

From stdpp Require Export finite.

Fixpoint insert2 {T} (i : nat) (x : T) (xs : list T) : list T :=
  match i,xs with
  | 0,xs => x :: xs
  | S i',y :: xs => y :: insert2 i' x xs
  | S i',[] => [x]
  end.

Section disjoint.

Context `{Countable K}.

Context {V : Type}.

Definition disjoint (xs : list (gmap K V)) :=
    forall i j h1 h2,
        xs !! i = Some h1 -> xs !! j = Some h2 -> i ≠ j -> h1 ##ₘ h2.

End disjoint.

Definition fin_list {A} n (f : fin n -> A) : list A := vec_to_list (fun_to_vec f).

Definition fin_gset `{Countable A} n (f : fin n -> A) : gset A
  := list_to_set (fin_list n f).

Definition all_fin n := fin_gset n id.

Definition big_union `{Countable A} : gset (gset A) -> gset A := set_fold (∪) ∅.

Definition fin_union `{Countable A} n (f : fin n -> gset A) : gset A :=
  big_union (fin_gset n f).

Fixpoint list_to_mapi' {A} (xs : list A) (n : nat) : gmap nat A :=
  match xs with
  | [] => ∅
  | x::r => <[ n := x ]> (list_to_mapi' r (S n))
  end.

Definition list_to_mapi {A} (xs : list A) := list_to_mapi' xs 0.

Definition fin_gmap {T} n : (fin n -> T) -> gmap nat T := list_to_mapi ∘ fin_list n.
