From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.

From Stdlib Require Import Classical_Prop Wellfounded Wf_nat Lia.
From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String Eqdep_dec.
Open Scope string_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Runtime typing for configurations.                                 *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* Source terms are Val-free, so [typed] cannot type configurations   *)
(* produced by reduction.  [wt] extends it with runtime values [cv].  *)
(* Values are environment-independent (they are closed).               *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Inductive wt (L : gmap nat type) : env -> expr -> type -> Prop :=
  | VarW Γ x t :
      env_var Γ x t ->
      wt L Γ (Var x) t
  | FunW Γ Γ' x e t1 t2 l :
      env_bind Γ' x t1 Γ ->
      (l = Unr -> env_unr Γ) ->
      wt L Γ' e t2 ->
      wt L Γ (Fun x e) (FunT l t1 t2)
  | AppW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 l :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (FunT l t1 t2) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 t1 ->
      wt L Γ (App e1 e2) t2
  | UnitW Γ :
      env_unr Γ ->
      wt L Γ Unit UnitT
  | PairW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 t1 ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 t2 ->
      wt L Γ (Pair e1 e2) (PairT t1 t2)
  | LetPairW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 t :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (PairT t1 t2) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 (FunT Lin t1 (FunT Lin t2 t)) ->
      wt L Γ (LetPair e1 e2) t
  | SumW Γ n (ts : fin n -> type) i e :
      wt L Γ e (ts i) ->
      wt L Γ (Sum i e) (SumT n ts)
  | MatchSumW n Γ Γ1 Γ2 t (ts : fin n -> type) es e :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      (n = 0 -> env_unr Γ2) ->
      wt L Γ1 e (SumT n ts) ->
      (forall i, wt L Γ2 (es i) (FunT Lin (ts i) t)) ->
      wt L Γ (MatchSum n e es) t
  | ForkW Γ e t1 t2 :
      wt L Γ e (FunT Lin (FunT Lin t2 t1) UnitT) ->
      wt L Γ (ForkBarrier e) (FunT Lin t1 t2)
  | NewLockW Γ e t :
      wt L Γ e t ->
      wt L Γ (NewLock e) (LockT (Owner,Closed) t)
  | ForkLockW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t l1 l2 l3 :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      lockcap_split l1 l2 l3 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (LockT l1 t) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 (FunT Lin (LockT l2 t) UnitT) ->
      wt L Γ (ForkLock e1 e2) (LockT l3 t)
  | AcquireW Γ e t lo :
      wt L Γ e (LockT (lo,Closed) t) ->
      wt L Γ (Acquire e) (PairT (LockT (lo,Opened) t) t)
  | ReleaseW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t lo :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (LockT (lo,Opened) t) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 t ->
      wt L Γ (Release e1 e2) (LockT (lo,Closed) t)
  | WaitW Γ e t :
      wt L Γ e (LockT (Owner,Closed) t) ->
      wt L Γ (Wait e) t
  | DropW Γ e t :
      wt L Γ e (LockT (Client,Closed) t) ->
      wt L Γ (Drop e) UnitT
  | ValW Γ v t :
      env_unr Γ ->
      cv L v t ->
      wt L Γ (Val v) t
with cv (L : gmap nat type) : val -> type -> Prop :=
  | FunVW x e t1 t2 l :
      wt L (<[ x := t1 ]> (∅ : env)) e t2 ->
      cv L (FunV x e) (FunT l t1 t2)
  | UnitVW : cv L UnitV UnitT
  | PairVW v1 v2 t1 t2 :
      cv L v1 t1 -> cv L v2 t2 ->
      cv L (PairV v1 v2) (PairT t1 t2)
  | SumVW n (ts : fin n -> type) i v :
      cv L v (ts i) ->
      cv L (SumV i v) (SumT n ts)
  | BarrierVW n t1 t2 :
      cv L (BarrierV n) (FunT Lin t1 t2)
  | LockVW n lc t :
      L !! n = Some t ->
      cv L (LockV n) (LockT lc t).

(* ---------- gmap / environment helpers ---------- *)

Lemma env_lookup_insert_same x (t : type) : (<[x:=t]>(∅ : env)) !! x = Some t.
Proof. unfold env in *. apply lookup_insert_eq. Qed.

Lemma env_lookup_insert_none x y (t : type) (Γ : env) : x <> y -> Γ !! y = None -> (<[x:=t]>Γ) !! y = None.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. intros Hne Hy.
  rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x y t Hne). done.
Qed.

Lemma env_unr_delete x (Γ : env) : env_unr Γ -> env_unr (delete x Γ).
Proof.
  intros H y t Hy. unfold env_unr in H. unfold env in *.
  destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_eq Γ y) in Hy. done.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ x y E) in Hy. apply H in Hy. done.
Qed.

Lemma env_unr_insert_lookup x (t : type) (Γ : env) :
  env_unr (<[x:=t]>Γ) -> unr t.
Proof. intros H. unfold env_unr in H. apply (H x t). unfold env. apply lookup_insert_eq. Qed.

Lemma env_union_empty_l (m : env) : ∅ ∪ m = m.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro x. rewrite lookup_union.
  assert (H : (∅ : gmap string type) !! x = None) by apply lookup_empty.
  rewrite H. destruct (m !! x); done.
Qed.

Lemma env_union_empty_r (m : env) : m ∪ ∅ = m.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro x. rewrite lookup_union.
  assert (H : (∅ : gmap string type) !! x = None) by apply lookup_empty.
  rewrite H. destruct (m !! x); done.
Qed.

Lemma env_split_empty (Γ1 Γ2 : env) : env_split ∅ Γ1 Γ2 -> Γ1 = ∅ /\ Γ2 = ∅.
Proof.
  unfold env in *.
  intros [Hun Hdis]. symmetry in Hun.
  apply map_positive_l in Hun as H1. subst Γ1.
  rewrite env_union_empty_l in Hun. subst Γ2. split; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma disj_delete x (Γ1 Γ2 : env) : disj Γ1 Γ2 -> disj (delete x Γ1) (delete x Γ2).
Proof.
  unfold env in *.
  intros H i t1 t2 H1 H2.
  destruct (decide (x=i)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_eq Γ1 i) in H1. done.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ1 x i E) in H1. rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ2 x i E) in H2. apply (H i t1 t2 H1 H2).
Qed.

Lemma delete_insert_none x (t : type) (Γ : env) : Γ !! x = None -> delete x (<[x:=t]>Γ) = Γ.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. intros Hx. apply map_eq. intro y. destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_eq (<[y:=t]>Γ) y). done.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_ne (<[x:=t]>Γ) x y E). rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x y t E). done.
Qed.

Lemma delete_none x (Γ : env) : Γ !! x = None -> delete x Γ = Γ.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. intros Hx. apply map_eq. intro y. destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_eq Γ y). done.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ x y E). done.
Qed.

Lemma insert_delete_same x (t : type) (Γ : env) : Γ !! x = Some t -> <[x:=t]>(delete x Γ) = Γ.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. intros Hx. apply map_eq. intro y. destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (delete y Γ) y t). symmetry. done.
  - rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (delete x Γ) x y t E). rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ x y E). done.
Qed.

Lemma insert_insert_same x (t1 t2 : type) (Γ : env) :
  <[x:=t2]>(<[x:=t1]>Γ) = <[x:=t2]>Γ.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro y. destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (<[y:=t1]>Γ) y t2). rewrite (lookup_insert_eq Γ y t2). done.
  - rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[x:=t1]>Γ) x y t2 E).
    rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x y t2 E).
    rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x y t1 E). done.
Qed.

Lemma insert_insert_comm x y (t1 t2 : type) (Γ : env) : x <> y ->
  <[x:=t1]>(<[y:=t2]>Γ) = <[y:=t2]>(<[x:=t1]>Γ).
Proof.
  intros Hne. unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro z.
  destruct (decide (z=x)) as [E1|E1].
  - subst z.
    destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E2|E2].
    + exfalso. apply Hne. done.
    + rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (<[y:=t2]>Γ) x t1).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[x:=t1]>Γ) y x t2 (fun H => E2 (eq_sym H))).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_eq Γ x t1). done.
  - destruct (decide (z=y)) as [E2|E2].
    + subst z.
      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[y:=t2]>Γ) x y t1 Hne).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_eq Γ y t2).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (<[x:=t1]>Γ) y t2). done.
    + rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[y:=t2]>Γ) x z t1 (fun H => E1 (eq_sym H))).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ y z t2 (fun H => E2 (eq_sym H))).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[x:=t1]>Γ) y z t2 (fun H => E2 (eq_sym H))).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x z t1 (fun H => E1 (eq_sym H))). done.
Qed.

Lemma env_split_delete x (E E1 E2 : env) :
  env_split E E1 E2 -> env_split (delete x E) (delete x E1) (delete x E2).
Proof.
  unfold env in *. intros [Hun Hdis]. split.
  - rewrite Hun. apply delete_union.
  - apply disj_delete. done.
Qed.

Lemma env_unr_empty : env_unr (∅ : env).
Proof. unfold env in *. intros x t H. assert (H0 : (∅ : gmap string type) !! x = None) by apply lookup_empty. setoid_rewrite H0 in H. done. Qed.

Lemma env_split_nil : env_split (∅ : env) ∅ ∅.
Proof.
  unfold env_split. split.
  - symmetry. apply env_union_empty_l.
  - intros i t1 t2 H1 H2. assert (H0 : (∅ : env) !! i = None) by (unfold env; apply lookup_empty).
    setoid_rewrite H0 in H1. done.
Qed.

(* ---------- Source typing embeds in the runtime typing ---------- *)

Lemma typed_to_wt Γ e t (H : typed Γ e t) : forall L, wt L Γ e t.
Proof.
  induction H as
    [ Γ x t Hvar
    | Γ Γ' x e t1 t2 l Hb Hunr Hty IH
    | Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 l Hsplit Hty1 IH1 Hty2 IH2
    | Γ Hunr
    | Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 Hsplit Hty1 IH1 Hty2 IH2
    | Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 t Hsplit Hty1 IH1 Hty2 IH2
    | Γ n ts i e Hty IH
    | n Γ Γ1 Γ2 t ts es e Hsplit Hn Hty IH Hf IHf
    | Γ e t1 t2 Hty IH
    | Γ e t Hty IH
    | Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t l1 l2 l3 Hsplit Hcap Hty1 IH1 Hty2 IH2
    | Γ e t lo Hty IH
    | Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t lo Hsplit Hty1 IH1 Hty2 IH2
    | Γ e t Hty IH
    | Γ e t Hty IH ];
    intros L.
  - apply VarW; exact Hvar.
  - eapply FunW; [ exact Hb | exact Hunr | apply IH ].
  - eapply AppW; [ exact Hsplit | apply IH1 | apply IH2 ].
  - apply UnitW; exact Hunr.
  - eapply PairW; [ exact Hsplit | apply IH1 | apply IH2 ].
  - eapply LetPairW; [ exact Hsplit | apply IH1 | apply IH2 ].
  - eapply SumW; apply IH.
  - eapply MatchSumW; [ exact Hsplit | exact Hn | apply IH | intros i; apply (IHf i L) ].
  - eapply ForkW; apply IH.
  - eapply NewLockW; apply IH.
  - eapply ForkLockW; [ exact Hsplit | exact Hcap | apply IH1 | apply IH2 ].
  - eapply AcquireW; apply IH.
  - eapply ReleaseW; [ exact Hsplit | apply IH1 | apply IH2 ].
  - eapply WaitW; apply IH.
  - eapply DropW; apply IH.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* A sufficient combinatorial condition for full reachability.        *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* [waiting ρ i j] is the "i depends on j" relation.  If it admits a  *)
(* rank that strictly increases along waiting edges, then reachability *)
(* propagates back along those edges from any [can_step] seed.        *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition wait_wf (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  well_founded (fun j i => waiting ρ i j).

Definition progress_or_wait (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i, ρ !! i <> None -> can_step ρ i \/ exists j, waiting ρ i j.

Definition wait_targets_live (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i e j, ρ !! i = Some (Thread e) -> expr_waiting e j -> ρ !! j <> None.

Definition rank_ok (ρ : cfg) (r : nat -> nat) (M : nat) : Prop :=
  (forall i, r i <= M) /\ (forall i j, waiting ρ i j -> r i < r j).

Lemma rank_ok_wait_wf ρ r M :
  rank_ok ρ r M -> wait_wf ρ.
Proof.
  intros [Hb Hr]. unfold wait_wf.
  apply (Wf_nat.well_founded_lt_compat
           nat (fun i => M - r i) (fun j i => waiting ρ i j)).
  intros x y Hxy. pose proof (Hr y x Hxy) as Hlt.
  pose proof (Hb x). pose proof (Hb y). lia.
Qed.

Lemma wait_wf_fully_reachable ρ :
  wait_wf ρ -> progress_or_wait ρ -> wait_targets_live ρ -> fully_reachable ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hwf Hprog Hlive i.
  apply (well_founded_ind Hwf (fun i => inactive ρ i \/ reachable ρ i)).
  intros x IH.
  destruct (ρ !! x) as [y|] eqn:E.
  - right.
    assert (Hact : ρ !! x <> None) by congruence.
    destruct (Hprog x Hact) as [Hstep | [j Hwait]].
    + apply Can_step_reachable; exact Hstep.
    + destruct (IH j Hwait) as [Hinj | Hrj].
      * destruct Hwait as [[e [He Hw]] | [y' [Hy _]]].
        -- exfalso. exact (Hlive x e j He Hw Hinj).
        -- unfold inactive in Hinj. rewrite Hy in Hinj. discriminate.
      * apply Waiting_reachable with j; assumption.
  - left. exact E.
Qed.

Theorem rank_fully_reachable ρ r M :
  rank_ok ρ r M -> progress_or_wait ρ -> wait_targets_live ρ ->
  fully_reachable ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hr Hp Hl.
  apply wait_wf_fully_reachable.
  - apply rank_ok_wait_wf with (r := r) (M := M); exact Hr.
  - exact Hp.
  - exact Hl.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Seedability: the truly relevant combinatorial condition.           *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* A global rank is too strong: [waiting] may contain cycles that     *)
(* pass through objects which can step.  The correct condition is     *)
(* that every live location reaches, along finitely many waiting      *)
(* edges, some location that can step.                                *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition wait_step (ρ : cfg) : nat -> nat -> Prop :=
  fun a b => waiting ρ a b.

Definition seeded (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i, ρ !! i <> None ->
    exists j, rtc (wait_step ρ) i j /\ can_step ρ j.

Lemma reachable_of_wait_rtc ρ a b :
  rtc (wait_step ρ) a b -> reachable ρ b -> reachable ρ a.
Proof.
  intros H. induction H as [| x y z Hxy _ IH]; intros Hb.
  - exact Hb.
  - apply Waiting_reachable with y.
    + exact Hxy.
    + apply IH; exact Hb.
Qed.

Lemma seeded_fully_reachable ρ : seeded ρ -> fully_reachable ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hseed i. destruct (ρ !! i) as [y|] eqn:E.
  - right. destruct (Hseed i ltac:(congruence)) as [j [Hpath Hstep]].
    apply (reachable_of_wait_rtc ρ i j Hpath).
    apply Can_step_reachable; exact Hstep.
  - left. exact E.
Qed.

Lemma reachable_seed ρ i : reachable ρ i ->
  exists j, rtc (wait_step ρ) i j /\ can_step ρ j.
Proof.
  induction 1 as [k Hc | a b Hw Hr IH].
  - exists k. split; [apply rtc_refl | exact Hc].
  - destruct IH as [j [Hpath Hc]].
    exists j. split; [| exact Hc].
    apply (rtc_l (wait_step ρ) a b j Hw Hpath).
Qed.

Lemma fully_reachable_seeded ρ : fully_reachable ρ -> seeded ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hfr i Hi.
  destruct (Hfr i) as [Hin | Hr].
  - exfalso. apply Hi. exact Hin.
  - exact (reachable_seed ρ i Hr).
Qed.

Lemma seeded_iff_fully_reachable ρ : seeded ρ <-> fully_reachable ρ.
Proof.
  split.
  - apply seeded_fully_reachable.
  - apply fully_reachable_seeded.
Qed.

(* A configuration with a live location and no steppable location is
   certainly not fully reachable. *)
Lemma reachable_no_can_step ρ i :
  (forall k, ~ can_step ρ k) -> reachable ρ i -> False.
Proof.
  intros Hns Hr. induction Hr as [k Hc | i j Hw Hr IH].
  - exact (Hns k Hc).
  - exact IH.
Qed.

Lemma no_can_step_not_fully_reachable ρ :
  (forall k, ~ can_step ρ k) ->
  (exists k, ρ !! k <> None) ->
  ~ fully_reachable ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hns [k Hk] Hfr.
  destruct (Hfr k) as [Hin | Hr].
  - unfold inactive in Hin. exact (Hk Hin).
  - exact (reachable_no_can_step ρ k Hns Hr).
Qed.

(* A rank is only needed on the non-steppable locations.  This is the
   exact relaxation needed because waiting cycles through steppable
   locations are harmless. *)

Definition rank_nonstep (ρ : cfg) (r : nat -> nat) (M : nat) : Prop :=
  (forall i, r i <= M) /\
  (forall i j, waiting ρ i j -> ~ can_step ρ i -> r i < r j).

Lemma waiting_target_live ρ (Hlive : wait_targets_live ρ) i j :
  waiting ρ i j -> ρ !! j <> None.
Proof.
  intros [[e [He Hw]] | [y [Hy _]]].
  - exact (Hlive i e j He Hw).
  - rewrite Hy. discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma rank_nonstep_seeded ρ r M
    (Hdec : forall i, {can_step ρ i} + {~ can_step ρ i}) :
  rank_nonstep ρ r M -> progress_or_wait ρ -> wait_targets_live ρ ->
  seeded ρ.
Proof.
  intros [Hb Hr] Hprog Hlive i Hi.
  revert Hi.
  apply (well_founded_ind
    (Wf_nat.well_founded_lt_compat nat (fun i => M - r i)
       (fun y x => M - r y < M - r x)
       (fun x y Hxy => Hxy))
    (fun i => ρ !! i <> None ->
      exists j, rtc (wait_step ρ) i j /\ can_step ρ j)).
  intros x IH Hx.
  destruct (Hdec x) as [Hc | Hnc].
  - exists x. split; [apply rtc_refl | exact Hc].
  - destruct (Hprog x Hx) as [Hc | [y Hw]].
    + exists x. split; [apply rtc_refl | exact Hc].
    + assert (Hlt : M - r y < M - r x).
      { pose proof (Hr x y Hw Hnc). pose proof (Hb x). pose proof (Hb y). lia. }
      assert (Hy : ρ !! y <> None).
      { apply (waiting_target_live ρ Hlive x y Hw). }
      destruct (IH y Hlt Hy) as [z [Hpath Hz]].
      exists z. split; [| exact Hz].
      apply (rtc_l (wait_step ρ) x y z Hw Hpath).
Qed.

Definition refs_live (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i y, ρ !! i = Some y -> forall j, j ∈ obj_refs y -> ρ !! j <> None.

Lemma ctx1_expr_refs k :
  ctx1 k -> forall e, expr_refs e ⊆ expr_refs (k e).
Proof.
  intros Hk e j Hj. destruct Hk; simpl; set_solver.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_expr_refs k :
  ctx k -> forall e, expr_refs e ⊆ expr_refs (k e).
Proof.
  intros Hk. induction Hk as [| k1 k2 H1 H2 IH2]; simpl.
  - intros e j Hj. exact Hj.
  - intros e j Hj. apply (ctx1_expr_refs k1 H1). apply IH2. exact Hj.
Qed.

Lemma expr_head_waiting_ref j e :
  expr_head_waiting e j -> j ∈ expr_refs e.
Proof.
  intros H. induction H; simpl; set_solver.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_head_waiting_ref k e j :
  ctx k -> expr_head_waiting e j -> j ∈ expr_refs (k e).
Proof.
  intros Hk Hh. apply (ctx_expr_refs k Hk e).
  apply expr_head_waiting_ref in Hh. exact Hh.
Qed.

Lemma expr_waiting_ref e j : expr_waiting e j -> j ∈ expr_refs e.
Proof.
  intros [k [e' [Hk [He Hh]]]]. subst e.
  apply ctx_head_waiting_ref; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma refs_live_wait_targets_live ρ :
  refs_live ρ -> wait_targets_live ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hlive i e j He Hw.
  apply (Hlive i (Thread e) He j).
  apply expr_waiting_ref in Hw. exact Hw.
Qed.

(* Lock types are never unrestricted. *)
Lemma unr_LockT l t : unr (LockT l t) -> False.
Proof. intros H. inversion H. Qed.

Lemma disjoint_env_no_dup_lock Γ1 Γ2 x l t :
  disj Γ1 Γ2 ->
  Γ1 !! x = Some (LockT l t) ->
  Γ2 !! x = Some (LockT l t) ->
  False.
Proof.
  intros Hd H1 H2.
  destruct (Hd x (LockT l t) (LockT l t) H1 H2) as [_ Hunr].
  exact (unr_LockT l t Hunr).
Qed.

(* Every local step has its label live in the source configuration. *)
Lemma local_step_label_live i ρ ρ' : local_step i ρ ρ' -> ρ !! i <> None.
Proof.
  intros H. apply is_Some_alt.
  induction H; simpl.
  all: try (eexists; simpl;
            repeat (rewrite lookup_insert_ne by assumption);
            rewrite lookup_insert_eq; reflexivity).
Qed.

(* Parallel/source reachability is the remaining semantic work.       *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Theorem typed_full_reachability e ρ :
  typed ∅ e UnitT -> steps {[ 0 := Thread e ]} ρ -> fully_reachable ρ.

From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.

From Stdlib Require Import Classical_Prop Wellfounded Wf_nat Lia.
From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String Eqdep_dec.
Open Scope string_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Runtime typing for configurations.                                 *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* Source terms are Val-free, so [typed] cannot type configurations   *)
(* produced by reduction.  [wt] extends it with runtime values [cv].  *)
(* Values are environment-independent (they are closed).               *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Inductive wt (L : gmap nat type) : env -> expr -> type -> Prop :=
  | VarW Γ x t :
      env_var Γ x t ->
      wt L Γ (Var x) t
  | FunW Γ Γ' x e t1 t2 l :
      env_bind Γ' x t1 Γ ->
      (l = Unr -> env_unr Γ) ->
      wt L Γ' e t2 ->
      wt L Γ (Fun x e) (FunT l t1 t2)
  | AppW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 l :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (FunT l t1 t2) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 t1 ->
      wt L Γ (App e1 e2) t2
  | UnitW Γ :
      env_unr Γ ->
      wt L Γ Unit UnitT
  | PairW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 t1 ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 t2 ->
      wt L Γ (Pair e1 e2) (PairT t1 t2)
  | LetPairW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 t :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (PairT t1 t2) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 (FunT Lin t1 (FunT Lin t2 t)) ->
      wt L Γ (LetPair e1 e2) t
  | SumW Γ n (ts : fin n -> type) i e :
      wt L Γ e (ts i) ->
      wt L Γ (Sum i e) (SumT n ts)
  | MatchSumW n Γ Γ1 Γ2 t (ts : fin n -> type) es e :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      (n = 0 -> env_unr Γ2) ->
      wt L Γ1 e (SumT n ts) ->
      (forall i, wt L Γ2 (es i) (FunT Lin (ts i) t)) ->
      wt L Γ (MatchSum n e es) t
  | ForkW Γ e t1 t2 :
      wt L Γ e (FunT Lin (FunT Lin t2 t1) UnitT) ->
      wt L Γ (ForkBarrier e) (FunT Lin t1 t2)
  | NewLockW Γ e t :
      wt L Γ e t ->
      wt L Γ (NewLock e) (LockT (Owner,Closed) t)
  | ForkLockW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t l1 l2 l3 :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      lockcap_split l1 l2 l3 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (LockT l1 t) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 (FunT Lin (LockT l2 t) UnitT) ->
      wt L Γ (ForkLock e1 e2) (LockT l3 t)
  | AcquireW Γ e t lo :
      wt L Γ e (LockT (lo,Closed) t) ->
      wt L Γ (Acquire e) (PairT (LockT (lo,Opened) t) t)
  | ReleaseW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t lo :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (LockT (lo,Opened) t) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 t ->
      wt L Γ (Release e1 e2) (LockT (lo,Closed) t)
  | WaitW Γ e t :
      wt L Γ e (LockT (Owner,Closed) t) ->
      wt L Γ (Wait e) t
  | DropW Γ e t :
      wt L Γ e (LockT (Client,Closed) t) ->
      wt L Γ (Drop e) UnitT
  | ValW Γ v t :
      env_unr Γ ->
      cv L v t ->
      wt L Γ (Val v) t
with cv (L : gmap nat type) : val -> type -> Prop :=
  | FunVW x e t1 t2 l :
      wt L (<[ x := t1 ]> (∅ : env)) e t2 ->
      cv L (FunV x e) (FunT l t1 t2)
  | UnitVW : cv L UnitV UnitT
  | PairVW v1 v2 t1 t2 :
      cv L v1 t1 -> cv L v2 t2 ->
      cv L (PairV v1 v2) (PairT t1 t2)
  | SumVW n (ts : fin n -> type) i v :
      cv L v (ts i) ->
      cv L (SumV i v) (SumT n ts)
  | BarrierVW n t1 t2 :
      cv L (BarrierV n) (FunT Lin t1 t2)
  | LockVW n lc t :
      L !! n = Some t ->
      cv L (LockV n) (LockT lc t).

(* ---------- gmap / environment helpers ---------- *)

Lemma env_lookup_insert_same x (t : type) : (<[x:=t]>(∅ : env)) !! x = Some t.
Proof. unfold env in *. apply lookup_insert_eq. Qed.

Lemma env_lookup_insert_none x y (t : type) (Γ : env) : x <> y -> Γ !! y = None -> (<[x:=t]>Γ) !! y = None.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. intros Hne Hy.
  rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x y t Hne). done.
Qed.

Lemma env_unr_delete x (Γ : env) : env_unr Γ -> env_unr (delete x Γ).
Proof.
  intros H y t Hy. unfold env_unr in H. unfold env in *.
  destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_eq Γ y) in Hy. done.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ x y E) in Hy. apply H in Hy. done.
Qed.

Lemma env_unr_insert_lookup x (t : type) (Γ : env) :
  env_unr (<[x:=t]>Γ) -> unr t.
Proof. intros H. unfold env_unr in H. apply (H x t). unfold env. apply lookup_insert_eq. Qed.

Lemma env_union_empty_l (m : env) : ∅ ∪ m = m.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro x. rewrite lookup_union.
  assert (H : (∅ : gmap string type) !! x = None) by apply lookup_empty.
  rewrite H. destruct (m !! x); done.
Qed.

Lemma env_union_empty_r (m : env) : m ∪ ∅ = m.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro x. rewrite lookup_union.
  assert (H : (∅ : gmap string type) !! x = None) by apply lookup_empty.
  rewrite H. destruct (m !! x); done.
Qed.

Lemma env_split_empty (Γ1 Γ2 : env) : env_split ∅ Γ1 Γ2 -> Γ1 = ∅ /\ Γ2 = ∅.
Proof.
  unfold env in *.
  intros [Hun Hdis]. symmetry in Hun.
  apply map_positive_l in Hun as H1. subst Γ1.
  rewrite env_union_empty_l in Hun. subst Γ2. split; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma disj_delete x (Γ1 Γ2 : env) : disj Γ1 Γ2 -> disj (delete x Γ1) (delete x Γ2).
Proof.
  unfold env in *.
  intros H i t1 t2 H1 H2.
  destruct (decide (x=i)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_eq Γ1 i) in H1. done.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ1 x i E) in H1. rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ2 x i E) in H2. apply (H i t1 t2 H1 H2).
Qed.

Lemma delete_insert_none x (t : type) (Γ : env) : Γ !! x = None -> delete x (<[x:=t]>Γ) = Γ.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. intros Hx. apply map_eq. intro y. destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_eq (<[y:=t]>Γ) y). done.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_ne (<[x:=t]>Γ) x y E). rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x y t E). done.
Qed.

Lemma delete_none x (Γ : env) : Γ !! x = None -> delete x Γ = Γ.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. intros Hx. apply map_eq. intro y. destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_eq Γ y). done.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ x y E). done.
Qed.

Lemma insert_delete_same x (t : type) (Γ : env) : Γ !! x = Some t -> <[x:=t]>(delete x Γ) = Γ.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. intros Hx. apply map_eq. intro y. destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (delete y Γ) y t). symmetry. done.
  - rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (delete x Γ) x y t E). rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ x y E). done.
Qed.

Lemma insert_insert_same x (t1 t2 : type) (Γ : env) :
  <[x:=t2]>(<[x:=t1]>Γ) = <[x:=t2]>Γ.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro y. destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (<[y:=t1]>Γ) y t2). rewrite (lookup_insert_eq Γ y t2). done.
  - rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[x:=t1]>Γ) x y t2 E).
    rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x y t2 E).
    rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x y t1 E). done.
Qed.

Lemma insert_insert_comm x y (t1 t2 : type) (Γ : env) : x <> y ->
  <[x:=t1]>(<[y:=t2]>Γ) = <[y:=t2]>(<[x:=t1]>Γ).
Proof.
  intros Hne. unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro z.
  destruct (decide (z=x)) as [E1|E1].
  - subst z.
    destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E2|E2].
    + exfalso. apply Hne. done.
    + rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (<[y:=t2]>Γ) x t1).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[x:=t1]>Γ) y x t2 (fun H => E2 (eq_sym H))).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_eq Γ x t1). done.
  - destruct (decide (z=y)) as [E2|E2].
    + subst z.
      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[y:=t2]>Γ) x y t1 Hne).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_eq Γ y t2).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (<[x:=t1]>Γ) y t2). done.
    + rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[y:=t2]>Γ) x z t1 (fun H => E1 (eq_sym H))).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ y z t2 (fun H => E2 (eq_sym H))).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[x:=t1]>Γ) y z t2 (fun H => E2 (eq_sym H))).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x z t1 (fun H => E1 (eq_sym H))). done.
Qed.

Lemma env_split_delete x (E E1 E2 : env) :
  env_split E E1 E2 -> env_split (delete x E) (delete x E1) (delete x E2).
Proof.
  unfold env in *. intros [Hun Hdis]. split.
  - rewrite Hun. apply delete_union.
  - apply disj_delete. done.
Qed.

Lemma env_unr_empty : env_unr (∅ : env).
Proof. unfold env in *. intros x t H. assert (H0 : (∅ : gmap string type) !! x = None) by apply lookup_empty. setoid_rewrite H0 in H. done. Qed.

Lemma env_split_nil : env_split (∅ : env) ∅ ∅.
Proof.
  unfold env_split. split.
  - symmetry. apply env_union_empty_l.
  - intros i t1 t2 H1 H2. assert (H0 : (∅ : env) !! i = None) by (unfold env; apply lookup_empty).
    setoid_rewrite H0 in H1. done.
Qed.

(* ---------- Source typing embeds in the runtime typing ---------- *)

Lemma typed_to_wt Γ e t (H : typed Γ e t) : forall L, wt L Γ e t.
Proof.
  induction H as
    [ Γ x t Hvar
    | Γ Γ' x e t1 t2 l Hb Hunr Hty IH
    | Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 l Hsplit Hty1 IH1 Hty2 IH2
    | Γ Hunr
    | Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 Hsplit Hty1 IH1 Hty2 IH2
    | Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 t Hsplit Hty1 IH1 Hty2 IH2
    | Γ n ts i e Hty IH
    | n Γ Γ1 Γ2 t ts es e Hsplit Hn Hty IH Hf IHf
    | Γ e t1 t2 Hty IH
    | Γ e t Hty IH
    | Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t l1 l2 l3 Hsplit Hcap Hty1 IH1 Hty2 IH2
    | Γ e t lo Hty IH
    | Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t lo Hsplit Hty1 IH1 Hty2 IH2
    | Γ e t Hty IH
    | Γ e t Hty IH ];
    intros L.
  - apply VarW; exact Hvar.
  - eapply FunW; [ exact Hb | exact Hunr | apply IH ].
  - eapply AppW; [ exact Hsplit | apply IH1 | apply IH2 ].
  - apply UnitW; exact Hunr.
  - eapply PairW; [ exact Hsplit | apply IH1 | apply IH2 ].
  - eapply LetPairW; [ exact Hsplit | apply IH1 | apply IH2 ].
  - eapply SumW; apply IH.
  - eapply MatchSumW; [ exact Hsplit | exact Hn | apply IH | intros i; apply (IHf i L) ].
  - eapply ForkW; apply IH.
  - eapply NewLockW; apply IH.
  - eapply ForkLockW; [ exact Hsplit | exact Hcap | apply IH1 | apply IH2 ].
  - eapply AcquireW; apply IH.
  - eapply ReleaseW; [ exact Hsplit | apply IH1 | apply IH2 ].
  - eapply WaitW; apply IH.
  - eapply DropW; apply IH.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* A sufficient combinatorial condition for full reachability.        *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* [waiting ρ i j] is the "i depends on j" relation.  If it admits a  *)
(* rank that strictly increases along waiting edges, then reachability *)
(* propagates back along those edges from any [can_step] seed.        *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition wait_wf (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  well_founded (fun j i => waiting ρ i j).

Definition progress_or_wait (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i, ρ !! i <> None -> can_step ρ i \/ exists j, waiting ρ i j.

Definition wait_targets_live (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i e j, ρ !! i = Some (Thread e) -> expr_waiting e j -> ρ !! j <> None.

Definition rank_ok (ρ : cfg) (r : nat -> nat) (M : nat) : Prop :=
  (forall i, r i <= M) /\ (forall i j, waiting ρ i j -> r i < r j).

Lemma rank_ok_wait_wf ρ r M :
  rank_ok ρ r M -> wait_wf ρ.
Proof.
  intros [Hb Hr]. unfold wait_wf.
  apply (Wf_nat.well_founded_lt_compat
           nat (fun i => M - r i) (fun j i => waiting ρ i j)).
  intros x y Hxy. pose proof (Hr y x Hxy) as Hlt.
  pose proof (Hb x). pose proof (Hb y). lia.
Qed.

Lemma wait_wf_fully_reachable ρ :
  wait_wf ρ -> progress_or_wait ρ -> wait_targets_live ρ -> fully_reachable ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hwf Hprog Hlive i.
  apply (well_founded_ind Hwf (fun i => inactive ρ i \/ reachable ρ i)).
  intros x IH.
  destruct (ρ !! x) as [y|] eqn:E.

Theorem rank_fully_reachable ρ r M :
  rank_ok ρ r M -> progress_or_wait ρ -> wait_targets_live ρ ->
  fully_reachable ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hr Hp Hl.
  apply wait_wf_fully_reachable.
  - apply rank_ok_wait_wf with (r := r) (M := M); exact Hr.
  - exact Hp.
  - exact Hl.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Seedability: the truly relevant combinatorial condition.           *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* A global rank is too strong: [waiting] may contain cycles that     *)
(* pass through objects which can step.  The correct condition is     *)
(* that every live location reaches, along finitely many waiting      *)
(* edges, some location that can step.                                *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition wait_step (ρ : cfg) : nat -> nat -> Prop :=
  fun a b => waiting ρ a b.

Definition seeded (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i, ρ !! i <> None ->
    exists j, rtc (wait_step ρ) i j /\ can_step ρ j.

Lemma reachable_of_wait_rtc ρ a b :
  rtc (wait_step ρ) a b -> reachable ρ b -> reachable ρ a.
Proof.
  intros H. induction H as [| x y z Hxy _ IH]; intros Hb.
  - exact Hb.
  - apply Waiting_reachable with y.
    + exact Hxy.
    + apply IH; exact Hb.
Qed.

Lemma seeded_fully_reachable ρ : seeded ρ -> fully_reachable ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hseed i. destruct (ρ !! i) as [y|] eqn:E.
  - right. destruct (Hseed i ltac:(congruence)) as [j [Hpath Hstep]].
    apply (reachable_of_wait_rtc ρ i j Hpath).
    apply Can_step_reachable; exact Hstep.
  - left. exact E.
Qed.

Lemma reachable_seed ρ i : reachable ρ i ->
  exists j, rtc (wait_step ρ) i j /\ can_step ρ j.
Proof.
  induction 1 as [k Hc | a b Hw Hr IH].
  - exists k. split; [apply rtc_refl | exact Hc].
  - destruct IH as [j [Hpath Hc]].
    exists j. split; [| exact Hc].
    apply (rtc_l (wait_step ρ) a b j Hw Hpath).
Qed.

Lemma fully_reachable_seeded ρ : fully_reachable ρ -> seeded ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hfr i Hi.
  destruct (Hfr i) as [Hin | Hr].
  - exfalso. apply Hi. exact Hin.
  - exact (reachable_seed ρ i Hr).
Qed.

Lemma seeded_iff_fully_reachable ρ : seeded ρ <-> fully_reachable ρ.
Proof.
  split.
  - apply seeded_fully_reachable.
  - apply fully_reachable_seeded.
Qed.

(* A configuration with a live location and no steppable location is
   certainly not fully reachable. *)
Lemma reachable_no_can_step ρ i :
  (forall k, ~ can_step ρ k) -> reachable ρ i -> False.
Proof.
  intros Hns Hr. induction Hr as [k Hc | i j Hw Hr IH].
  - exact (Hns k Hc).
  - exact IH.
Qed.

Lemma no_can_step_not_fully_reachable ρ :
  (forall k, ~ can_step ρ k) ->
  (exists k, ρ !! k <> None) ->
  ~ fully_reachable ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hns [k Hk] Hfr.
  destruct (Hfr k) as [Hin | Hr].
  - unfold inactive in Hin. exact (Hk Hin).
  - exact (reachable_no_can_step ρ k Hns Hr).
Qed.

(* A rank is only needed on the non-steppable locations.  This is the
   exact relaxation needed because waiting cycles through steppable
   locations are harmless. *)

Definition rank_nonstep (ρ : cfg) (r : nat -> nat) (M : nat) : Prop :=
  (forall i, r i <= M) /\
  (forall i j, waiting ρ i j -> ~ can_step ρ i -> r i < r j).

Lemma waiting_target_live ρ (Hlive : wait_targets_live ρ) i j :
  waiting ρ i j -> ρ !! j <> None.
Proof.
  intros [[e [He Hw]] | [y [Hy _]]].
  - exact (Hlive i e j He Hw).
  - rewrite Hy. discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma rank_nonstep_seeded ρ r M
    (Hdec : forall i, {can_step ρ i} + {~ can_step ρ i}) :
  rank_nonstep ρ r M -> progress_or_wait ρ -> wait_targets_live ρ ->
  seeded ρ.
Proof.
  intros [Hb Hr] Hprog Hlive i Hi.
  revert Hi.
  apply (well_founded_ind
    (Wf_nat.well_founded_lt_compat nat (fun i => M - r i)
       (fun y x => M - r y < M - r x)
       (fun x y Hxy => Hxy))
    (fun i => ρ !! i <> None ->
      exists j, rtc (wait_step ρ) i j /\ can_step ρ j)).
  intros x IH Hx.
  destruct (Hdec x) as [Hc | Hnc].
  - exists x. split; [apply rtc_refl | exact Hc].
  - destruct (Hprog x Hx) as [Hc | [y Hw]].
    + exists x. split; [apply rtc_refl | exact Hc].
    + assert (Hlt : M - r y < M - r x).
      { pose proof (Hr x y Hw Hnc). pose proof (Hb x). pose proof (Hb y). lia. }
      assert (Hy : ρ !! y <> None).
      { apply (waiting_target_live ρ Hlive x y Hw). }
      destruct (IH y Hlt Hy) as [z [Hpath Hz]].
      exists z. split; [| exact Hz].
      apply (rtc_l (wait_step ρ) x y z Hw Hpath).
Qed.

(* ---------- elementary facts about references ---------- *)

Definition refs_live (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i y, ρ !! i = Some y -> forall j, j ∈ obj_refs y -> ρ !! j <> None.

Lemma ctx1_expr_refs k :
  ctx1 k -> forall e, expr_refs e ⊆ expr_refs (k e).
Proof.
  intros Hk e j Hj. destruct Hk; simpl; set_solver.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_expr_refs k :
  ctx k -> forall e, expr_refs e ⊆ expr_refs (k e).
Proof.
  intros Hk. induction Hk as [| k1 k2 H1 H2 IH2]; simpl.
  - intros e j Hj. exact Hj.
  - intros e j Hj. apply (ctx1_expr_refs k1 H1). apply IH2. exact Hj.
Qed.

Lemma expr_head_waiting_ref j e :
  expr_head_waiting e j -> j ∈ expr_refs e.
Proof.
  intros H. induction H; simpl; set_solver.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_head_waiting_ref k e j :
  ctx k -> expr_head_waiting e j -> j ∈ expr_refs (k e).
Proof.
  intros Hk Hh. apply (ctx_expr_refs k Hk e).
  apply expr_head_waiting_ref in Hh. exact Hh.
Qed.

Lemma expr_waiting_ref e j : expr_waiting e j -> j ∈ expr_refs e.
Proof.
  intros [k [e' [Hk [He Hh]]]]. subst e.
  apply ctx_head_waiting_ref; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma refs_live_wait_targets_live ρ :
  refs_live ρ -> wait_targets_live ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hlive i e j He Hw.
  apply (Hlive i (Thread e) He j).
  apply expr_waiting_ref in Hw. exact Hw.
Qed.

(* Lock types are never unrestricted. *)
Lemma unr_LockT l t : unr (LockT l t) -> False.
Proof. intros H. inversion H. Qed.

Lemma disjoint_env_no_dup_lock Γ1 Γ2 x l t :
  disj Γ1 Γ2 ->
  Γ1 !! x = Some (LockT l t) ->
  Γ2 !! x = Some (LockT l t) ->
  False.
Proof.
  intros Hd H1 H2.
  destruct (Hd x (LockT l t) (LockT l t) H1 H2) as [_ Hunr].
  exact (unr_LockT l t Hunr).
Qed.

(* Every local step has its label live in the source configuration. *)
Lemma local_step_label_live i ρ ρ' : local_step i ρ ρ' -> ρ !! i <> None.
Proof.
  intros H. induction H; simpl; intro E;
    try (rewrite lookup_singleton_eq in E; discriminate);
    try (rewrite lookup_insert_eq in E; discriminate);
    try (repeat (first [ rewrite lookup_insert_eq in E
                       | rewrite lookup_insert_ne in E by assumption ]);
         discriminate).
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Parallel/source reachability is the remaining semantic work.       *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Theorem typed_full_reachability e ρ :
  typed ∅ e UnitT -> steps {[ 0 := Thread e ]} ρ -> fully_reachable ρ.

From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.

From Stdlib Require Import Classical_Prop Wellfounded Wf_nat Lia.
From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String Eqdep_dec.
Open Scope string_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Runtime typing for configurations.                                 *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* Source terms are Val-free, so [typed] cannot type configurations   *)
(* produced by reduction.  [wt] extends it with runtime values [cv].  *)
(* Values are environment-independent (they are closed).               *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Inductive wt (L : gmap nat type) : env -> expr -> type -> Prop :=
  | VarW Γ x t :
      env_var Γ x t ->
      wt L Γ (Var x) t
  | FunW Γ Γ' x e t1 t2 l :
      env_bind Γ' x t1 Γ ->
      (l = Unr -> env_unr Γ) ->
      wt L Γ' e t2 ->
      wt L Γ (Fun x e) (FunT l t1 t2)
  | AppW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 l :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (FunT l t1 t2) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 t1 ->
      wt L Γ (App e1 e2) t2
  | UnitW Γ :
      env_unr Γ ->
      wt L Γ Unit UnitT
  | PairW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 t1 ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 t2 ->
      wt L Γ (Pair e1 e2) (PairT t1 t2)
  | LetPairW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 t :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (PairT t1 t2) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 (FunT Lin t1 (FunT Lin t2 t)) ->
      wt L Γ (LetPair e1 e2) t
  | SumW Γ n (ts : fin n -> type) i e :
      wt L Γ e (ts i) ->
      wt L Γ (Sum i e) (SumT n ts)
  | MatchSumW n Γ Γ1 Γ2 t (ts : fin n -> type) es e :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      (n = 0 -> env_unr Γ2) ->
      wt L Γ1 e (SumT n ts) ->
      (forall i, wt L Γ2 (es i) (FunT Lin (ts i) t)) ->
      wt L Γ (MatchSum n e es) t
  | ForkW Γ e t1 t2 :
      wt L Γ e (FunT Lin (FunT Lin t2 t1) UnitT) ->
      wt L Γ (ForkBarrier e) (FunT Lin t1 t2)
  | NewLockW Γ e t :
      wt L Γ e t ->
      wt L Γ (NewLock e) (LockT (Owner,Closed) t)
  | ForkLockW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t l1 l2 l3 :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      lockcap_split l1 l2 l3 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (LockT l1 t) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 (FunT Lin (LockT l2 t) UnitT) ->
      wt L Γ (ForkLock e1 e2) (LockT l3 t)
  | AcquireW Γ e t lo :
      wt L Γ e (LockT (lo,Closed) t) ->
      wt L Γ (Acquire e) (PairT (LockT (lo,Opened) t) t)
  | ReleaseW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t lo :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (LockT (lo,Opened) t) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 t ->
      wt L Γ (Release e1 e2) (LockT (lo,Closed) t)
  | WaitW Γ e t :
      wt L Γ e (LockT (Owner,Closed) t) ->
      wt L Γ (Wait e) t
  | DropW Γ e t :
      wt L Γ e (LockT (Client,Closed) t) ->
      wt L Γ (Drop e) UnitT
  | ValW Γ v t :
      env_unr Γ ->
      cv L v t ->
      wt L Γ (Val v) t

  | FunVW x e t1 t2 l :

  | UnitVW : cv L UnitV UnitT
  | PairVW v1 v2 t1 t2 :

      cv L (PairV v1 v2) (PairT t1 t2)
  | SumVW n (ts : fin n -> type) i v :

  | BarrierVW n t1 t2 :
      cv L (BarrierV n) (FunT Lin t1 t2)
  | LockVW n lc t :

Lemma env_lookup_insert_same x (t : type) : (<[x:=t]>(∅ : env)) !! x = Some t.

  - intros i t1 t2 H1 H2. assert (H0 : (∅ : env) !! i = None) by (unfold env; apply lookup_empty).
    setoid_rewrite H0 in H1. done.
Qed.

(* ---------- Source typing embeds in the runtime typing ---------- *)

Lemma typed_to_wt Γ e t (H : typed Γ e t) : forall L, wt L Γ e t.
Proof.
  induction H as
    [ Γ x t Hvar
    | Γ Γ' x e t1 t2 l Hb Hunr Hty IH
    | Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 l Hsplit Hty1 IH1 Hty2 IH2
    | Γ Hunr
    | Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 Hsplit Hty1 IH1 Hty2 IH2
    | Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 t Hsplit Hty1 IH1 Hty2 IH2
    | Γ n ts i e Hty IH
    | n Γ Γ1 Γ2 t ts es e Hsplit Hn Hty IH Hf IHf
    | Γ e t1 t2 Hty IH
    | Γ e t Hty IH
    | Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t l1 l2 l3 Hsplit Hcap Hty1 IH1 Hty2 IH2
    | Γ e t lo Hty IH
    | Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t lo Hsplit Hty1 IH1 Hty2 IH2
    | Γ e t Hty IH
    | Γ e t Hty IH ];
    intros L.
  - apply VarW; exact Hvar.
  - eapply FunW; [ exact Hb | exact Hunr | apply IH ].
  - eapply AppW; [ exact Hsplit | apply IH1 | apply IH2 ].
  - apply UnitW; exact Hunr.
  - eapply PairW; [ exact Hsplit | apply IH1 | apply IH2 ].
  - eapply LetPairW; [ exact Hsplit | apply IH1 | apply IH2 ].
  - eapply SumW; apply IH.
  - eapply MatchSumW; [ exact Hsplit | exact Hn | apply IH | intros i; apply (IHf i L) ].
  - eapply ForkW; apply IH.
  - eapply NewLockW; apply IH.
  - eapply ForkLockW; [ exact Hsplit | exact Hcap | apply IH1 | apply IH2 ].
  - eapply AcquireW; apply IH.
  - eapply ReleaseW; [ exact Hsplit | apply IH1 | apply IH2 ].
  - eapply WaitW; apply IH.
  - eapply DropW; apply IH.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* A sufficient combinatorial condition for full reachability.        *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* [waiting ρ i j] is the "i depends on j" relation.  If it admits a  *)
(* rank that strictly increases along waiting edges, then reachability *)
(* propagates back along those edges from any [can_step] seed.        *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition wait_wf (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  well_founded (fun j i => waiting ρ i j).

Definition progress_or_wait (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i, ρ !! i <> None -> can_step ρ i \/ exists j, waiting ρ i j.

Definition wait_targets_live (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i e j, ρ !! i = Some (Thread e) -> expr_waiting e j -> ρ !! j <> None.

Definition rank_ok (ρ : cfg) (r : nat -> nat) (M : nat) : Prop :=
  (forall i, r i <= M) /\ (forall i j, waiting ρ i j -> r i < r j).

Lemma rank_ok_wait_wf ρ r M :
  rank_ok ρ r M -> wait_wf ρ.
Proof.
  intros [Hb Hr]. unfold wait_wf.
  apply (Wf_nat.well_founded_lt_compat
           nat (fun i => M - r i) (fun j i => waiting ρ i j)).
  intros x y Hxy. pose proof (Hr y x Hxy) as Hlt.
  pose proof (Hb x). pose proof (Hb y). lia.
Qed.

Lemma wait_wf_fully_reachable ρ :
  wait_wf ρ -> progress_or_wait ρ -> wait_targets_live ρ -> fully_reachable ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hwf Hprog Hlive i.
  apply (well_founded_ind Hwf (fun i => inactive ρ i \/ reachable ρ i)).
  intros x IH.
  destruct (ρ !! x) as [y|] eqn:E.
  - right.
    assert (Hact : ρ !! x <> None) by congruence.
    destruct (Hprog x Hact) as [Hstep | [j Hwait]].
    + apply Can_step_reachable; exact Hstep.
    + destruct (IH j Hwait) as [Hinj | Hrj].
      * destruct Hwait as [[e [He Hw]] | [y' [Hy _]]].
        -- exfalso. exact (Hlive x e j He Hw Hinj).
        -- unfold inactive in Hinj. rewrite Hy in Hinj. discriminate.
      * apply Waiting_reachable with j; assumption.
  - left. exact E.
Qed.

Theorem rank_fully_reachable ρ r M :
  rank_ok ρ r M -> progress_or_wait ρ -> wait_targets_live ρ ->
  fully_reachable ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hr Hp Hl.
  apply wait_wf_fully_reachable.
  - apply rank_ok_wait_wf with (r := r) (M := M); exact Hr.
  - exact Hp.
  - exact Hl.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Seedability: the truly relevant combinatorial condition.           *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* A global rank is too strong: [waiting] may contain cycles that     *)
(* pass through objects which can step.  The correct condition is     *)
(* that every live location reaches, along finitely many waiting      *)
(* edges, some location that can step.                                *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition wait_step (ρ : cfg) : nat -> nat -> Prop :=
  fun a b => waiting ρ a b.

Definition seeded (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i, ρ !! i <> None ->
    exists j, rtc (wait_step ρ) i j /\ can_step ρ j.

Lemma reachable_of_wait_rtc ρ a b :
  rtc (wait_step ρ) a b -> reachable ρ b -> reachable ρ a.
Proof.
  intros H. induction H as [| x y z Hxy _ IH]; intros Hb.
  - exact Hb.
  - apply Waiting_reachable with y.
    + exact Hxy.
    + apply IH; exact Hb.
Qed.

Lemma seeded_fully_reachable ρ : seeded ρ -> fully_reachable ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hseed i. destruct (ρ !! i) as [y|] eqn:E.
  - right. destruct (Hseed i ltac:(congruence)) as [j [Hpath Hstep]].
    apply (reachable_of_wait_rtc ρ i j Hpath).
    apply Can_step_reachable; exact Hstep.
  - left. exact E.
Qed.

Lemma reachable_seed ρ i : reachable ρ i ->
  exists j, rtc (wait_step ρ) i j /\ can_step ρ j.
Proof.
  induction 1 as [k Hc | a b Hw Hr IH].
  - exists k. split; [apply rtc_refl | exact Hc].
  - destruct IH as [j [Hpath Hc]].
    exists j. split; [| exact Hc].
    apply (rtc_l (wait_step ρ) a b j Hw Hpath).
Qed.

Lemma fully_reachable_seeded ρ : fully_reachable ρ -> seeded ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hfr i Hi.
  destruct (Hfr i) as [Hin | Hr].
  - exfalso. apply Hi. exact Hin.
  - exact (reachable_seed ρ i Hr).
Qed.

Lemma seeded_iff_fully_reachable ρ : seeded ρ <-> fully_reachable ρ.
Proof.
  split.
  - apply seeded_fully_reachable.
  - apply fully_reachable_seeded.
Qed.

(* A configuration with a live location and no steppable location is
   certainly not fully reachable. *)
Lemma reachable_no_can_step ρ i :
  (forall k, ~ can_step ρ k) -> reachable ρ i -> False.
Proof.
  intros Hns Hr. induction Hr as [k Hc | i j Hw Hr IH].
  - exact (Hns k Hc).
  - exact IH.
Qed.

Lemma no_can_step_not_fully_reachable ρ :
  (forall k, ~ can_step ρ k) ->
  (exists k, ρ !! k <> None) ->
  ~ fully_reachable ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hns [k Hk] Hfr.
  destruct (Hfr k) as [Hin | Hr].
  - unfold inactive in Hin. exact (Hk Hin).
  - exact (reachable_no_can_step ρ k Hns Hr).
Qed.

(* A rank is only needed on the non-steppable locations.  This is the
   exact relaxation needed because waiting cycles through steppable
   locations are harmless. *)

Definition rank_nonstep (ρ : cfg) (r : nat -> nat) (M : nat) : Prop :=
  (forall i, r i <= M) /\
  (forall i j, waiting ρ i j -> ~ can_step ρ i -> r i < r j).

Lemma waiting_target_live ρ (Hlive : wait_targets_live ρ) i j :
  waiting ρ i j -> ρ !! j <> None.
Proof.
  intros [[e [He Hw]] | [y [Hy _]]].
  - exact (Hlive i e j He Hw).
  - rewrite Hy. discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma rank_nonstep_seeded ρ r M
    (Hdec : forall i, {can_step ρ i} + {~ can_step ρ i}) :
  rank_nonstep ρ r M -> progress_or_wait ρ -> wait_targets_live ρ ->
  seeded ρ.
Proof.
  intros [Hb Hr] Hprog Hlive i Hi.
  revert Hi.
  apply (well_founded_ind
    (Wf_nat.well_founded_lt_compat nat (fun i => M - r i)
       (fun y x => M - r y < M - r x)
       (fun x y Hxy => Hxy))
    (fun i => ρ !! i <> None ->
      exists j, rtc (wait_step ρ) i j /\ can_step ρ j)).
  intros x IH Hx.
  destruct (Hdec x) as [Hc | Hnc].
  - exists x. split; [apply rtc_refl | exact Hc].
  - destruct (Hprog x Hx) as [Hc | [y Hw]].
    + exists x. split; [apply rtc_refl | exact Hc].
    + assert (Hlt : M - r y < M - r x).
      { pose proof (Hr x y Hw Hnc). pose proof (Hb x). pose proof (Hb y). lia. }
      assert (Hy : ρ !! y <> None).
      { apply (waiting_target_live ρ Hlive x y Hw). }
      destruct (IH y Hlt Hy) as [z [Hpath Hz]].
      exists z. split; [| exact Hz].
      apply (rtc_l (wait_step ρ) x y z Hw Hpath).
Qed.

(* ---------- elementary facts about references ---------- *)

Definition refs_live (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i y, ρ !! i = Some y -> forall j, j ∈ obj_refs y -> ρ !! j <> None.

Lemma ctx1_expr_refs k :
  ctx1 k -> forall e, expr_refs e ⊆ expr_refs (k e).
Proof.
  intros Hk e j Hj. destruct Hk; simpl; set_solver.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_expr_refs k :
  ctx k -> forall e, expr_refs e ⊆ expr_refs (k e).
Proof.
  intros Hk. induction Hk as [| k1 k2 H1 H2 IH2]; simpl.
  - intros e j Hj. exact Hj.
  - intros e j Hj. apply (ctx1_expr_refs k1 H1). apply IH2. exact Hj.
Qed.

Lemma expr_head_waiting_ref j e :
  expr_head_waiting e j -> j ∈ expr_refs e.
Proof.
  intros H. induction H; simpl; set_solver.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_head_waiting_ref k e j :
  ctx k -> expr_head_waiting e j -> j ∈ expr_refs (k e).
Proof.
  intros Hk Hh. apply (ctx_expr_refs k Hk e).
  apply expr_head_waiting_ref in Hh. exact Hh.
Qed.

Lemma expr_waiting_ref e j : expr_waiting e j -> j ∈ expr_refs e.
Proof.
  intros [k [e' [Hk [He Hh]]]]. subst e.
  apply ctx_head_waiting_ref; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma refs_live_wait_targets_live ρ :
  refs_live ρ -> wait_targets_live ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hlive i e j He Hw.
  apply (Hlive i (Thread e) He j).
  apply expr_waiting_ref in Hw. exact Hw.
Qed.

(* Lock types are never unrestricted. *)
Lemma unr_LockT l t : unr (LockT l t) -> False.
Proof. intros H. inversion H. Qed.

Lemma disjoint_env_no_dup_lock Γ1 Γ2 x l t :
  disj Γ1 Γ2 ->
  Γ1 !! x = Some (LockT l t) ->
  Γ2 !! x = Some (LockT l t) ->
  False.
Proof.
  intros Hd H1 H2.
  destruct (Hd x (LockT l t) (LockT l t) H1 H2) as [_ Hunr].
  exact (unr_LockT l t Hunr).
Qed.

(* Every local step has its label live in the source configuration. *)
Lemma local_step_label_live i ρ ρ' : local_step i ρ ρ' -> ρ !! i <> None.
Proof.
  intros H. induction H; simpl; intro E.
  all: try (rewrite lookup_singleton_eq in E; discriminate).
  all: try (rewrite lookup_insert_eq in E; discriminate).
  all: try (repeat (first [ rewrite lookup_insert_eq in E
                          | rewrite lookup_insert_ne in E by assumption ]);
            discriminate).
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Parallel/source reachability is the remaining semantic work.       *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Theorem typed_full_reachability e ρ :
  typed ∅ e UnitT -> steps {[ 0 := Thread e ]} ρ -> fully_reachable ρ.

From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String.
Open Scope string_scope.
From stdpp Require Import gmap.
From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.

Definition min_expr : expr := Acquire (Val (LockV 1)).

Definition min_cfg : cfg :=
  <[ 1 := Lock 0 None ]> ({[ 0 := Thread min_expr ]}).

Lemma min_cfg_lookup0 : min_cfg !! 0 = Some (Thread min_expr).
Proof. unfold min_cfg, cfg. vm_compute. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma min_cfg_lookup1 : min_cfg !! 1 = Some (Lock 0 None).
Proof. unfold min_cfg, cfg. vm_compute. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma min_cfg_lookup_ge2 k : min_cfg !! (S (S k)) = None.
Proof.
  unfold min_cfg, cfg.
  rewrite lookup_insert_ne by discriminate.
  rewrite lookup_singleton_ne by discriminate.
  reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma min_cfg_lookup (k:nat) :
  min_cfg !! k = None \/
  (k = 0 /\ min_cfg !! k = Some (Thread min_expr)) \/
  (k = 1 /\ min_cfg !! k = Some (Lock 0 None)).
Proof.
  destruct k as [|[|k]].
  - right; left. split; [reflexivity|]. apply min_cfg_lookup0.
  - right; right. split; [reflexivity|]. apply min_cfg_lookup1.
  - left. apply min_cfg_lookup_ge2.
Qed.
---
From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.

(* If no index can step, then no index is reachable.  [reachable] has no
   base case other than can_step, and its waiting constructor only appeals to
   a smaller reachable premise, so the induction closes immediately. *)

Lemma reachable_no_can_step ρ i :
  (forall k, ~ can_step ρ k) -> reachable ρ i -> False.
Proof.
  intros Hns Hr. induction Hr as [k Hc | i j Hw Hr IH].
  - exact (Hns k Hc).
  - exact IH.
Qed.

Lemma no_can_step_not_fully_reachable ρ :
  (forall k, ~ can_step ρ k) ->
  (exists k, ρ !! k <> None) ->
  ~ fully_reachable ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hns [k Hk] Hfr.
  destruct (Hfr k) as [Hin | Hr].
  - unfold inactive in Hin. exact (Hk Hin).
  - exact (reachable_no_can_step ρ k Hns Hr).
Qed.

(* Consequently, any configuration with a live but globally stuck object is a
   counterexample shape; the whole difficulty is producing such a [rho] from a
   closed, well-typed source term. *)

From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String.

From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.

Lemma local_step_label_Some i rho rho' : local_step i rho rho' -> exists o, rho !! i = Some o.
Proof.
  intros H. induction H; simpl.
  - eexists. apply lookup_singleton_eq.
  - eexists. apply lookup_singleton_eq.
  - eexists. apply lookup_singleton_eq.
  - (* Sync *) exists Barrier.
    unfold cfg.
    rewrite lookup_insert_ne by assumption.
    rewrite lookup_insert_ne by assumption.
    apply lookup_singleton_eq.
  - eexists. apply lookup_singleton_eq.
  - (* ForkLock *) exists (Lock refcnt o).
    unfold cfg.
    rewrite lookup_insert_ne by assumption.

From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String.
From stdpp Require Import gmap.
From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.

Lemma shape_dummy i rho rho' : local_step i rho rho' ->
local_step i rho rho' ->
  (exists (k:expr->expr) (e e':expr), ctx k /\ pure_step e e' /\ rho !! i = Some (Thread (k e))) \/
  (rho !! i = Some (Thread (Val UnitV))) \/
  (exists (j n:nat) (k:expr->expr) (v:val), ctx k /\ rho !! i = Some (Thread (k (ForkBarrier (Val v))))) \/
  (rho !! i = Some Barrier) \/
  (exists (k:expr->expr) (n:nat) (v:val), ctx k /\ rho !! i = Some (Thread (k (NewLock (Val v))))) \/
  (exists (v:val) (o:option val) (k:expr->expr) (j n refcnt:nat),
      ctx k /\ rho !! n = Some (Lock refcnt o) /\
      rho !! j = Some (Thread (k (ForkLock (Val (LockV n)) (Val v))))) \/
  (exists (v:val) (k:expr->expr) (j n refcnt:nat),
      ctx k /\ rho !! n = Some (Lock refcnt (Some v)) /\
      rho !! j = Some (Thread (k (Acquire (Val (LockV n)))))) \/
  (exists (v:val) (k:expr->expr) (j n refcnt:nat),
      ctx k /\ rho !! n = Some (Lock refcnt None) /\
      rho !! j = Some (Thread (k (Release (Val (LockV n)) (Val v))))) \/
  (exists (v:val) (k:expr->expr) (j n:nat),
      ctx k /\ rho !! n = Some (Lock 0 (Some v)) /\
      rho !! j = Some (Thread (k (Wait (Val (LockV n)))))) \/
  (exists (o:option val) (k:expr->expr) (j n refcnt:nat),
      ctx k /\ rho !! n = Some (Lock (S refcnt) o) /\
      rho !! j = Some (Thread (k (Drop (Val (LockV n)))))).

6	Inductive expr :=
7	  | Val : val -> expr
8	  | Var : string -> expr
9	  | Fun : string -> expr -> expr
10	  | App : expr -> expr -> expr
11	  | Unit : expr
12	  | Pair : expr -> expr -> expr
13	  | LetPair : expr -> expr -> expr
14	  | Sum : nat -> expr -> expr
15	  | MatchSum n : expr -> (fin n -> expr) -> expr
16	
17	  | ForkBarrier : expr -> expr
18	
19	  | NewLock : expr -> expr
20	  | ForkLock : expr -> expr -> expr
21	  | Acquire : expr -> expr
22	  | Release : expr -> expr -> expr
23	  | Wait : expr -> expr
24	  | Drop : expr -> expr
25	with val :=
26	  | FunV : string -> expr -> val
27	  | UnitV : val
28	  | PairV : val -> val -> val
29	  | SumV : nat -> val -> val
30	  | BarrierV : nat -> val
31	  | LockV : nat -> val.

33	Inductive linearity := Lin | Unr.
34	
35	Inductive lockstate := Opened | Closed.
36	
37	Inductive lockownership := Owner | Client.
38	
39	Definition lockcap : Type := lockownership * lockstate.
40	
41	Inductive lockownership_split : lockownership -> lockownership -> lockownership -> Prop :=
42	  | lo_split_1 : lockownership_split Owner Client Owner
43	  | lo_split_2 : lockownership_split Owner Owner Client
44	  | lo_split_3 : lockownership_split Client Client Client.
45	
46	Inductive lockstate_split : lockstate -> lockstate -> lockstate -> Prop :=
47	  | ls_split_1 : lockstate_split Opened Closed Opened
48	  | ls_split_2 : lockstate_split Opened Opened Closed
49	  | ls_split_3 : lockstate_split Closed Closed Closed.
50	
51	Definition lockcap_split l1 l2 l3 :=
52	  lockownership_split l1.1 l2.1 l3.1 ∧ lockstate_split l1.2 l2.2 l3.2.
53	
54	CoInductive type :=
55	  | FunT : linearity -> type -> type -> type
56	  | UnitT : type
57	  | PairT : type -> type -> type
58	  | SumT n : (fin n -> type) -> type
59	  | LockT : lockcap -> type -> type.
60	
61	CoInductive unr : type -> Prop :=
62	  | Fun_unr t1 t2 : unr (FunT Unr t1 t2)
63	  | Unit_unr : unr UnitT
64	  | Pair_unr t1 t2 : unr t1 -> unr t2 -> unr (PairT t1 t2)
65	  | Sum_unr n ts : (∀ i, unr (ts i)) -> unr (SumT n ts).
66	
67	Definition env := gmap string type.
68	
69	Definition env_unr (Γ : env) :=
70	  ∀ x t, Γ !! x = Some t -> unr t.
71	
72	Definition disj (Γ1 Γ2 : env) :=
73	  ∀ i t1 t2, Γ1 !! i = Some t1 -> Γ2 !! i = Some t2 -> t1 = t2 ∧ unr t1.
74	
75	Definition env_split (Γ : env) (Γ1 : env) (Γ2 : env) :=
76	  Γ = Γ1 ∪ Γ2 ∧ disj Γ1 Γ2.
77	
78	Definition env_bind (Γ' : env) (x : string) (t : type) (Γ : env) :=
79	  Γ' = <[ x := t ]> Γ ∧ ∀ t', Γ !! x = Some t' -> unr t'.
80	
81	Definition env_var (Γ : env) (x : string) (t : type) :=
82	  ∃ Γ', Γ = <[ x := t ]> Γ' ∧ env_unr Γ'.
83	
84	Inductive typed : env -> expr -> type -> Prop :=
85	
86	  | Var_typed Γ x t :
87	    env_var Γ x t ->
88	    typed Γ (Var x) t
89	  | Fun_typed Γ Γ' x e t1 t2 l :
90	    env_bind Γ' x t1 Γ ->
91	    (l = Unr -> env_unr Γ) ->
92	    typed Γ' e t2 ->
93	    typed Γ (Fun x e) (FunT l t1 t2)
94	  | App_typed Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 l :
95	    env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
96	    typed Γ1 e1 (FunT l t1 t2) ->
97	    typed Γ2 e2 t1 ->
98	    typed Γ (App e1 e2) t2
99	  | Unit_typed Γ :
100	    env_unr Γ ->
101	    typed Γ Unit UnitT
102	  | Pair_typed Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 :
103	    env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
104	    typed Γ1 e1 t1 ->
105	    typed Γ2 e2 t2 ->
106	    typed Γ (Pair e1 e2) (PairT t1 t2)
107	  | LetPair_typed Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 t :
108	    env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
109	    typed Γ1 e1 (PairT t1 t2) ->
110	    typed Γ2 e2 (FunT Lin t1 (FunT Lin t2 t)) ->
111	    typed Γ (LetPair e1 e2) t
112	  | Sum_typed Γ n (ts : fin n -> type) i e :
113	    typed Γ e (ts i) ->
114	    typed Γ (Sum i e) (SumT n ts)
115	  | MatchSumN_typed n Γ Γ1 Γ2 t (ts : fin n -> type) es e :
116	    env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
117	    (n = 0 -> env_unr Γ2) ->
118	    typed Γ1 e (SumT n ts) ->
119	    (∀ i, typed Γ2 (es i) (FunT Lin (ts i) t)) ->
120	    typed Γ (MatchSum n e es) t
121	
122	  | Fork_typed Γ e t1 t2 :
123	    typed Γ e (FunT Lin (FunT Lin t2 t1) UnitT) ->
124	    typed Γ (ForkBarrier e) (FunT Lin t1 t2)
125	
126	  | NewLock_typed Γ e t :
127	    typed Γ e t ->
128	    typed Γ (NewLock e) (LockT (Owner,Closed) t)
129	  | ForkLock_typed Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t l1 l2 l3 :
130	    env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
131	    lockcap_split l1 l2 l3 ->
132	    typed Γ1 e1 (LockT l1 t) ->
133	    typed Γ2 e2 (FunT Lin (LockT l2 t) UnitT) ->
134	    typed Γ (ForkLock e1 e2) (LockT l3 t)
135	  | Acquire_typed Γ e t lo :
136	    typed Γ e (LockT (lo,Closed) t) ->
137	    typed Γ (Acquire e) (PairT (LockT (lo,Opened) t) t)
138	  | Release_typed Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t lo :
139	    env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
140	    typed Γ1 e1 (LockT (lo,Opened) t) ->
141	    typed Γ2 e2 t ->
142	    typed Γ (Release e1 e2) (LockT (lo,Closed) t)
143	  | Wait_typed Γ e t :
144	    typed Γ e (LockT (Owner,Closed) t) ->
145	    typed Γ (Wait e) t
146	  | Drop_typed Γ e t :
147	    typed Γ e (LockT (Client,Closed) t) ->
148	    typed Γ (Drop e) UnitT.
149	
150	Definition subst (x:string) (a:val) := fix rec e :=
151	  match e with
152	  | Val _ => e
153	  | Var x' => if decide (x = x') then Val a else e
154	  | Fun x' e => Fun x' (if decide (x = x') then e else rec e)
155	  | App e1 e2 => App (rec e1) (rec e2)
156	  | Unit => Unit
157	  | Pair e1 e2 => Pair (rec e1) (rec e2)
158	  | LetPair e1 e2 => LetPair (rec e1) (rec e2)
159	  | Sum n e => Sum n (rec e)
160	  | MatchSum n e1 e2 => MatchSum n (rec e1) (rec ∘ e2)
161	  | ForkBarrier e => ForkBarrier (rec e)
162	  | NewLock e => NewLock (rec e)
163	  | ForkLock e1 e2 => ForkLock (rec e1) (rec e2)
164	  | Acquire e => Acquire (rec e)
165	  | Release e1 e2 => Release (rec e1) (rec e2)
166	  | Wait e => Wait (rec e)
167	  | Drop e => Drop (rec e)
168	  end.
169	
170	Inductive pure_step : expr -> expr -> Prop :=
171	  | Fun_step x e :
172	    pure_step (Fun x e) (Val $ FunV x e)
173	  | App_step x e a :
174	    pure_step (App (Val $ FunV x e) (Val a)) (subst x a e)
175	  | Unit_step :
176	    pure_step Unit (Val $ UnitV)
177	  | Pair_step v1 v2 :
178	    pure_step (Pair (Val v1) (Val v2)) (Val $ PairV v1 v2)
179	  | LetPair_step v1 v2 e:
180	    pure_step (LetPair (Val $ PairV v1 v2) e) (App (App e (Val v1)) (Val v2))
181	  | Sum_step n v :
182	    pure_step (Sum n (Val v)) (Val $ SumV n v)
183	  | MatchSum_step n (i : fin n) v es :
184	    pure_step (MatchSum n (Val $ SumV i v) es) (App (es i) (Val v)).
185	
186	Inductive ctx1 : (expr -> expr) -> Prop :=
187	  | Ctx_App_l e : ctx1 (λ x, App x e)
188	  | Ctx_App_r e : ctx1 (λ x, App e x)
189	  | Ctx_Pair_l e : ctx1 (λ x, Pair x e)
190	  | Ctx_Pair_r e : ctx1 (λ x, Pair e x)
191	  | Ctx_LetPair e : ctx1 (λ x, LetPair x e)
192	  | Ctx_Sum i : ctx1 (λ x, Sum i x)
193	  | Ctx_MatchSum n es : ctx1 (λ x, MatchSum n x es)
194	  | Ctx_ForkBarrier : ctx1 (λ x, ForkBarrier x)
195	  | Ctx_NewLock : ctx1 (λ x, NewLock x)
196	  | Ctx_ForkLock_l e : ctx1 (λ x, ForkLock x e)
197	  | Ctx_ForkLock_r e : ctx1 (λ x, ForkLock e x)
198	  | Ctx_Acquire : ctx1 (λ x, Acquire x)
199	  | Ctx_Release_l e : ctx1 (λ x, Release x e)
200	  | Ctx_Release_r e : ctx1 (λ x, Release e x)
201	  | Ctx_Wait : ctx1 (λ x, Wait x)
202	  | Ctx_Drop : ctx1 (λ x, Drop x).
203	
204	Inductive ctx : (expr -> expr) -> Prop :=
205	  | Ctx_id : ctx id
206	  | Ctx_comp k1 k2 : ctx1 k1 -> ctx k2 -> ctx (k1 ∘ k2).
207	
208	Inductive obj := Thread (e : expr) | Barrier | Lock (refcnt : nat) (o : option val).
209	
210	Definition cfg := gmap nat obj.
211	
212	Inductive local_step : nat -> cfg -> cfg -> Prop :=
213	
214	  | Pure_step i k e e' :
215	    ctx k -> pure_step e e' ->
216	    local_step i {[ i := Thread (k e) ]} {[ i := Thread (k e') ]}
217	  | Exit_step i :
218	    local_step i {[ i := Thread (Val UnitV) ]} ∅
219	
220	  | Fork_step i j n k v :
221	    i ≠ j -> i ≠ n -> j ≠ n -> ctx k ->
222	    local_step i {[ i := Thread (k (ForkBarrier (Val v))) ]}
223	                 {[ i := Thread (k (Val $ BarrierV n));
224	                    j := Thread (App (Val v) (Val $ BarrierV n));
225	                    n := Barrier ]}
226	  | Sync_step i j n k1 k2 v1 v2 :
227	    i ≠ j -> i ≠ n -> j ≠ n -> ctx k1 -> ctx k2 ->
228	    local_step n {[ i := Thread (k1 (App (Val $ BarrierV n) (Val v1)));
229	                    j := Thread (k2 (App (Val $ BarrierV n) (Val v2)));
230	                    n := Barrier ]}
231	                 {[ i := Thread (k1 $ Val v2);
232	                    j := Thread (k2 $ Val v1) ]}
233	
234	  | NewLock_step v k n i:
235	    i ≠ n -> ctx k ->
236	    local_step i {[ i := Thread (k (NewLock (Val v))) ]}
237	                 {[ i := Thread (k (Val $ LockV n));
238	                    n := Lock 0 (Some v) ]}
239	  | ForkLock_step v o k i j n refcnt :
240	    i ≠ j -> i ≠ n -> j ≠ n -> ctx k ->
241	    local_step n {[ i := Thread (k (ForkLock (Val $ LockV n) (Val v)));
242	                    n := Lock refcnt o ]}
243	                 {[ i := Thread (k (Val $ LockV n));
244	                    j := Thread (App (Val v) (Val $ LockV n));
245	                    n := Lock (S refcnt) o ]}
246	  | Acquire_step v k i n refcnt :
247	    i ≠ n -> ctx k ->
248	    local_step n {[ i := Thread (k (Acquire (Val $ LockV n)));
249	                    n := Lock refcnt (Some v) ]}
250	                 {[ i := Thread (k (Val $ PairV (LockV n) v));
251	                    n := Lock refcnt None ]}
252	  | Release_step v k i n refcnt :
253	    i ≠ n -> ctx k ->
254	    local_step n {[ i := Thread (k (Release (Val $ LockV n) (Val v)));
255	                    n := Lock refcnt None ]}
256	                 {[ i := Thread (k (Val $ LockV n));
257	                    n := Lock refcnt (Some v) ]}
258	  | Wait_step v k i n :
259	    i ≠ n -> ctx k ->
260	    local_step n {[ i := Thread (k (Wait (Val $ LockV n)));
261	                    n := Lock 0 (Some v) ]}
262	                 {[ i := Thread (k (Val v)) ]}
263	  | Drop_step o k i n refcnt :
264	    i ≠ n -> ctx k ->
265	    local_step n {[ i := Thread (k (Drop (Val $ LockV n)));
266	                    n := Lock (S refcnt) o ]}
267	                 {[ i := Thread (k (Val $ UnitV));
268	                    n := Lock refcnt o ]}.
269	
270	Inductive step : nat -> cfg -> cfg -> Prop :=
271	  | Frame_step ρ ρ' ρf i :
272	    ρ ##ₘ ρf -> ρ' ##ₘ ρf ->
273	    local_step i ρ ρ' -> step i (ρ ∪ ρf) (ρ' ∪ ρf).
274	
275	Definition step' ρ ρ' := ∃ i, step i ρ ρ'.
276	
277	Definition steps := rtc step'.

3	Fixpoint expr_refs e :=
4	  match e with
5	  | Val v => val_refs v
6	  | Var x => ∅
7	  | Fun x e => expr_refs e
8	  | App e1 e2 => expr_refs e1 ∪ expr_refs e2
9	  | Unit => ∅
10	  | Pair e1 e2 => expr_refs e1 ∪ expr_refs e2
11	  | LetPair e1 e2 => expr_refs e1 ∪ expr_refs e2
12	  | Sum i e => expr_refs e
13	  | MatchSum n e es => expr_refs e ∪ fin_union n (expr_refs ∘ es)
14	  | ForkBarrier e => expr_refs e
15	  | NewLock e => expr_refs e
16	  | ForkLock e1 e2 => expr_refs e1 ∪ expr_refs e2
17	  | Acquire e => expr_refs e
18	  | Release e1 e2 => expr_refs e1 ∪ expr_refs e2
19	  | Wait e => expr_refs e
20	  | Drop e => expr_refs e
21	  end
22	with val_refs v :=
23	  match v with
24	  | FunV x e => expr_refs e
25	  | UnitV => ∅
26	  | PairV v1 v2 => val_refs v1 ∪ val_refs v2
27	  | SumV i v => val_refs v
28	  | BarrierV i => {[ i ]}
29	  | LockV i => {[ i ]}
30	  end.
31	
32	Definition obj_refs x :=
33	  match x with
34	  | Thread e => expr_refs e
35	  | Barrier => ∅
36	  | Lock refcnt o =>
37	      match o with
38	      | Some v => val_refs v
39	      | None => ∅
40	      end
41	  end.

43	Inductive expr_head_waiting : expr -> nat -> Prop :=
44	  | Barrier_waiting j v :
45	    expr_head_waiting (App (Val $ BarrierV j) (Val v)) j
46	  | ForkLock_waiting j v :
47	    expr_head_waiting (ForkLock (Val $ LockV j) (Val v)) j
48	  | Acquire_waiting j :
49	    expr_head_waiting (Acquire (Val $ LockV j)) j
50	  | Release_waiting j v :
51	    expr_head_waiting (Release (Val $ LockV j) (Val v)) j
52	  | Wait_waiting j :
53	    expr_head_waiting (Wait (Val $ LockV j)) j
54	  | Drop_waiting j :
55	    expr_head_waiting (Drop (Val $ LockV j)) j.
56	
57	Definition expr_waiting e j :=
58	  ∃ k e', ctx k ∧ e = k e' ∧ expr_head_waiting e' j.
59	
60	Definition waiting (ρ : cfg) (i j : nat) :=
61	  (∃ e, ρ !! i = Some (Thread e) ∧ expr_waiting e j) ∨
62	  (∃ y, ρ !! j = Some y ∧ i ∈ obj_refs y ∧ ∀ e, y = Thread e -> ¬ expr_waiting e i).
63	
64	Definition can_step (ρ : cfg) (i : nat) := ∃ ρ', step i ρ ρ'.
65	
66	Definition inactive (ρ : cfg) (i : nat) := ρ !! i = None.
67	
68	Inductive reachable (ρ : cfg) : nat -> Prop :=
69	  | Can_step_reachable i :
70	      can_step ρ i -> reachable ρ i
71	  | Waiting_reachable i j :
72	      waiting ρ i j -> reachable ρ j -> reachable ρ i.
73	
74	Definition fully_reachable (ρ : cfg) :=
75	  ∀ i, inactive ρ i ∨ reachable ρ i.

1	From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.

3	From Stdlib Require Import Classical_Prop Wellfounded Wf_nat Lia.
4	From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String Eqdep_dec.
5	Open Scope string_scope.

7	(* ================================================================== *)
8	(* Runtime typing for configurations.                                 *)
9	(*                                                                    *)
10	(* Source terms are Val-free, so [typed] cannot type configurations   *)
11	(* produced by reduction.  [wt] extends it with runtime values [cv].  *)
12	(* Values are environment-independent (they are closed).               *)
13	(* ================================================================== *)
14	
15	Inductive wt (L : gmap nat type) : env -> expr -> type -> Prop :=
16	  | VarW Γ x t :
17	      env_var Γ x t ->
18	      wt L Γ (Var x) t
19	  | FunW Γ Γ' x e t1 t2 l :
20	      env_bind Γ' x t1 Γ ->
21	      (l = Unr -> env_unr Γ) ->
22	      wt L Γ' e t2 ->
23	      wt L Γ (Fun x e) (FunT l t1 t2)
24	  | AppW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 l :
25	      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
26	      wt L Γ1 e1 (FunT l t1 t2) ->
27	      wt L Γ2 e2 t1 ->
28	      wt L Γ (App e1 e2) t2
29	  | UnitW Γ :
30	      env_unr Γ ->
31	      wt L Γ Unit UnitT
32	  | PairW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 :
33	      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
34	      wt L Γ1 e1 t1 ->
35	      wt L Γ2 e2 t2 ->
36	      wt L Γ (Pair e1 e2) (PairT t1 t2)
37	  | LetPairW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 t :
38	      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
39	      wt L Γ1 e1 (PairT t1 t2) ->
40	      wt L Γ2 e2 (FunT Lin t1 (FunT Lin t2 t)) ->
41	      wt L Γ (LetPair e1 e2) t
42	  | SumW Γ n (ts : fin n -> type) i e :
43	      wt L Γ e (ts i) ->
44	      wt L Γ (Sum i e) (SumT n ts)
45	  | MatchSumW n Γ Γ1 Γ2 t (ts : fin n -> type) es e :
46	      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
47	      (n = 0 -> env_unr Γ2) ->
48	      wt L Γ1 e (SumT n ts) ->
49	      (forall i, wt L Γ2 (es i) (FunT Lin (ts i) t)) ->
50	      wt L Γ (MatchSum n e es) t
51	  | ForkW Γ e t1 t2 :
52	      wt L Γ e (FunT Lin (FunT Lin t2 t1) UnitT) ->
53	      wt L Γ (ForkBarrier e) (FunT Lin t1 t2)
54	  | NewLockW Γ e t :
55	      wt L Γ e t ->
56	      wt L Γ (NewLock e) (LockT (Owner,Closed) t)
57	  | ForkLockW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t l1 l2 l3 :
58	      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
59	      lockcap_split l1 l2 l3 ->
60	      wt L Γ1 e1 (LockT l1 t) ->
61	      wt L Γ2 e2 (FunT Lin (LockT l2 t) UnitT) ->
62	      wt L Γ (ForkLock e1 e2) (LockT l3 t)
63	  | AcquireW Γ e t lo :
64	      wt L Γ e (LockT (lo,Closed) t) ->
65	      wt L Γ (Acquire e) (PairT (LockT (lo,Opened) t) t)
66	  | ReleaseW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t lo :
67	      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
68	      wt L Γ1 e1 (LockT (lo,Opened) t) ->
69	      wt L Γ2 e2 t ->
70	      wt L Γ (Release e1 e2) (LockT (lo,Closed) t)
71	  | WaitW Γ e t :
72	      wt L Γ e (LockT (Owner,Closed) t) ->
73	      wt L Γ (Wait e) t
74	  | DropW Γ e t :
75	      wt L Γ e (LockT (Client,Closed) t) ->
76	      wt L Γ (Drop e) UnitT
77	  | ValW Γ v t :
78	      env_unr Γ ->
79	      cv L v t ->
80	      wt L Γ (Val v) t
81	with cv (L : gmap nat type) : val -> type -> Prop :=
82	  | FunVW x e t1 t2 l :
83	      wt L (<[ x := t1 ]> (∅ : env)) e t2 ->
84	      cv L (FunV x e) (FunT l t1 t2)
85	  | UnitVW : cv L UnitV UnitT
86	  | PairVW v1 v2 t1 t2 :
87	      cv L v1 t1 -> cv L v2 t2 ->
88	      cv L (PairV v1 v2) (PairT t1 t2)
89	  | SumVW n (ts : fin n -> type) i v :
90	      cv L v (ts i) ->
91	      cv L (SumV i v) (SumT n ts)
92	  | BarrierVW n t1 t2 :
93	      cv L (BarrierV n) (FunT Lin t1 t2)
94	  | LockVW n lc t :
95	      L !! n = Some t ->
96	      cv L (LockV n) (LockT lc t).

98	(* ---------- gmap / environment helpers ---------- *)
99	
100	Lemma env_lookup_insert_same x (t : type) : (<[x:=t]>(∅ : env)) !! x = Some t.
101	Proof. unfold env in *. apply lookup_insert_eq. Qed.
102	
103	Lemma env_lookup_insert_none x y (t : type) (Γ : env) : x <> y -> Γ !! y = None -> (<[x:=t]>Γ) !! y = None.
104	Proof.
105	  unfold env in *. intros Hne Hy.
106	  rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x y t Hne). done.
107	Qed.

109	Lemma env_unr_delete x (Γ : env) : env_unr Γ -> env_unr (delete x Γ).
110	Proof.
111	  intros H y t Hy. unfold env_unr in H. unfold env in *.
112	  destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
113	  - rewrite (lookup_delete_eq Γ y) in Hy. done.
114	  - rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ x y E) in Hy. apply H in Hy. done.
115	Qed.
116	
117	Lemma env_unr_insert_lookup x (t : type) (Γ : env) :
118	  env_unr (<[x:=t]>Γ) -> unr t.
119	Proof. intros H. unfold env_unr in H. apply (H x t). unfold env. apply lookup_insert_eq. Qed.
120	
121	Lemma env_union_empty_l (m : env) : ∅ ∪ m = m.
122	Proof.
123	  unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro x. rewrite lookup_union.
124	  assert (H : (∅ : gmap string type) !! x = None) by apply lookup_empty.
125	  rewrite H. destruct (m !! x); done.

128	Lemma env_union_empty_r (m : env) : m ∪ ∅ = m.
129	Proof.

131	  assert (H : (∅ : gmap string type) !! x = None) by apply lookup_empty.
132	  rewrite H. destruct (m !! x); done.
133	Qed.

135	Lemma env_split_empty (Γ1 Γ2 : env) : env_split ∅ Γ1 Γ2 -> Γ1 = ∅ /\ Γ2 = ∅.
136	Proof.
137	  unfold env in *.
138	  intros [Hun Hdis]. symmetry in Hun.
139	  apply map_positive_l in Hun as H1. subst Γ1.
140	  rewrite env_union_empty_l in Hun. subst Γ2. split; reflexivity.
141	Qed.
