143	Lemma disj_delete x (Γ1 Γ2 : env) : disj Γ1 Γ2 -> disj (delete x Γ1) (delete x Γ2).
144	Proof.
145	  unfold env in *.
146	  intros H i t1 t2 H1 H2.
147	  destruct (decide (x=i)) as [E|E]; subst.
148	  - rewrite (lookup_delete_eq Γ1 i) in H1. done.
149	  - rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ1 x i E) in H1. rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ2 x i E) in H2. apply (H i t1 t2 H1 H2).
150	Qed.
151	
152	Lemma delete_insert_none x (t : type) (Γ : env) : Γ !! x = None -> delete x (<[x:=t]>Γ) = Γ.
153	Proof.
154	  unfold env in *. intros Hx. apply map_eq. intro y. destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
155	  - rewrite (lookup_delete_eq (<[y:=t]>Γ) y). done.
156	  - rewrite (lookup_delete_ne (<[x:=t]>Γ) x y E). rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x y t E). done.
157	Qed.
158	
159	Lemma delete_none x (Γ : env) : Γ !! x = None -> delete x Γ = Γ.
160	Proof.
161	  unfold env in *. intros Hx. apply map_eq. intro y. destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
162	  - rewrite (lookup_delete_eq Γ y). done.
163	  - rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ x y E). done.
164	Qed.
165	
166	Lemma insert_delete_same x (t : type) (Γ : env) : Γ !! x = Some t -> <[x:=t]>(delete x Γ) = Γ.
167	Proof.
168	  unfold env in *. intros Hx. apply map_eq. intro y. destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
169	  - rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (delete y Γ) y t). symmetry. done.
170	  - rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (delete x Γ) x y t E). rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ x y E). done.
171	Qed.
172	
173	Lemma insert_insert_same x (t1 t2 : type) (Γ : env) :
174	  <[x:=t2]>(<[x:=t1]>Γ) = <[x:=t2]>Γ.
175	Proof.
176	  unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro y. destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
177	  - rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (<[y:=t1]>Γ) y t2). rewrite (lookup_insert_eq Γ y t2). done.
178	  - rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[x:=t1]>Γ) x y t2 E).
179	    rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x y t2 E).
180	    rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x y t1 E). done.
181	Qed.
182	
183	Lemma insert_insert_comm x y (t1 t2 : type) (Γ : env) : x <> y ->
184	  <[x:=t1]>(<[y:=t2]>Γ) = <[y:=t2]>(<[x:=t1]>Γ).
185	Proof.
186	  intros Hne. unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro z.
187	  destruct (decide (z=x)) as [E1|E1].
188	  - subst z.
189	    destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E2|E2].
190	    + exfalso. apply Hne. done.
191	    + rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (<[y:=t2]>Γ) x t1).
192	      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[x:=t1]>Γ) y x t2 (fun H => E2 (eq_sym H))).
193	      rewrite (lookup_insert_eq Γ x t1). done.
194	  - destruct (decide (z=y)) as [E2|E2].
195	    + subst z.
196	      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[y:=t2]>Γ) x y t1 Hne).
197	      rewrite (lookup_insert_eq Γ y t2).
198	      rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (<[x:=t1]>Γ) y t2). done.
199	    + rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[y:=t2]>Γ) x z t1 (fun H => E1 (eq_sym H))).
200	      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ y z t2 (fun H => E2 (eq_sym H))).
201	      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[x:=t1]>Γ) y z t2 (fun H => E2 (eq_sym H))).
202	      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x z t1 (fun H => E1 (eq_sym H))). done.
203	Qed.
204	
205	Lemma env_split_delete x (E E1 E2 : env) :
206	  env_split E E1 E2 -> env_split (delete x E) (delete x E1) (delete x E2).
207	Proof.
208	  unfold env in *. intros [Hun Hdis]. split.
209	  - rewrite Hun. apply delete_union.
210	  - apply disj_delete. done.
211	Qed.
212	
213	Lemma env_unr_empty : env_unr (∅ : env).
214	Proof. unfold env in *. intros x t H. assert (H0 : (∅ : gmap string type) !! x = None) by apply lookup_empty. setoid_rewrite H0 in H. done. Qed.
215	
216	Lemma env_split_nil : env_split (∅ : env) ∅ ∅.
217	Proof.
218	  unfold env_split. split.
219	  - symmetry. apply env_union_empty_l.
220	  - intros i t1 t2 H1 H2. assert (H0 : (∅ : env) !! i = None) by (unfold env; apply lookup_empty).
221	    setoid_rewrite H0 in H1. done.
222	Qed.
223	
224	(* ---------- Source typing embeds in the runtime typing ---------- *)
225	
226	Lemma typed_to_wt Γ e t (H : typed Γ e t) : forall L, wt L Γ e t.
227	Proof.
228	  induction H as
229	    [ Γ x t Hvar
230	    | Γ Γ' x e t1 t2 l Hb Hunr Hty IH
231	    | Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 l Hsplit Hty1 IH1 Hty2 IH2
232	    | Γ Hunr
233	    | Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 Hsplit Hty1 IH1 Hty2 IH2
234	    | Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 t Hsplit Hty1 IH1 Hty2 IH2
235	    | Γ n ts i e Hty IH
236	    | n Γ Γ1 Γ2 t ts es e Hsplit Hn Hty IH Hf IHf
237	    | Γ e t1 t2 Hty IH
238	    | Γ e t Hty IH
239	    | Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t l1 l2 l3 Hsplit Hcap Hty1 IH1 Hty2 IH2
240	    | Γ e t lo Hty IH
241	    | Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t lo Hsplit Hty1 IH1 Hty2 IH2
242	    | Γ e t Hty IH
243	    | Γ e t Hty IH ];
244	    intros L.
245	  - apply VarW; exact Hvar.
246	  - eapply FunW; [ exact Hb | exact Hunr | apply IH ].
247	  - eapply AppW; [ exact Hsplit | apply IH1 | apply IH2 ].
248	  - apply UnitW; exact Hunr.
249	  - eapply PairW; [ exact Hsplit | apply IH1 | apply IH2 ].
250	  - eapply LetPairW; [ exact Hsplit | apply IH1 | apply IH2 ].
251	  - eapply SumW; apply IH.
252	  - eapply MatchSumW; [ exact Hsplit | exact Hn | apply IH | intros i; apply (IHf i L) ].
253	  - eapply ForkW; apply IH.
254	  - eapply NewLockW; apply IH.
255	  - eapply ForkLockW; [ exact Hsplit | exact Hcap | apply IH1 | apply IH2 ].
256	  - eapply AcquireW; apply IH.
257	  - eapply ReleaseW; [ exact Hsplit | apply IH1 | apply IH2 ].
258	  - eapply WaitW; apply IH.
259	  - eapply DropW; apply IH.
260	Qed.
261	
262	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
263	(* A sufficient combinatorial condition for full reachability.        *)
264	(*                                                                    *)
265	(* [waiting ρ i j] is the "i depends on j" relation.  If it admits a  *)
266	(* rank that strictly increases along waiting edges, then reachability *)
267	(* propagates back along those edges from any [can_step] seed.        *)
268	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
269	
270	Definition wait_wf (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
271	  well_founded (fun j i => waiting ρ i j).
272	
273	Definition progress_or_wait (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
274	  forall i, ρ !! i <> None -> can_step ρ i \/ exists j, waiting ρ i j.
275	
276	Definition wait_targets_live (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
277	  forall i e j, ρ !! i = Some (Thread e) -> expr_waiting e j -> ρ !! j <> None.
278	
279	Definition rank_ok (ρ : cfg) (r : nat -> nat) (M : nat) : Prop :=
280	  (forall i, r i <= M) /\ (forall i j, waiting ρ i j -> r i < r j).
281	
282	Lemma rank_ok_wait_wf ρ r M :
283	  rank_ok ρ r M -> wait_wf ρ.
284	Proof.
285	  intros [Hb Hr]. unfold wait_wf.
286	  apply (Wf_nat.well_founded_lt_compat
287	           nat (fun i => M - r i) (fun j i => waiting ρ i j)).
288	  intros x y Hxy. pose proof (Hr y x Hxy) as Hlt.
289	  pose proof (Hb x). pose proof (Hb y). lia.
290	Qed.
291	
292	Lemma wait_wf_fully_reachable ρ :
293	  wait_wf ρ -> progress_or_wait ρ -> wait_targets_live ρ -> fully_reachable ρ.
294	Proof.
295	  intros Hwf Hprog Hlive i.
296	  apply (well_founded_ind Hwf (fun i => inactive ρ i \/ reachable ρ i)).
297	  intros x IH.
298	  destruct (ρ !! x) as [y|] eqn:E.
299	  - right.
300	    assert (Hact : ρ !! x <> None) by congruence.
301	    destruct (Hprog x Hact) as [Hstep | [j Hwait]].
302	    + apply Can_step_reachable; exact Hstep.
303	    + destruct (IH j Hwait) as [Hinj | Hrj].
304	      * destruct Hwait as [[e [He Hw]] | [y' [Hy _]]].
305	        -- exfalso. exact (Hlive x e j He Hw Hinj).
306	        -- unfold inactive in Hinj. rewrite Hy in Hinj. discriminate.
307	      * apply Waiting_reachable with j; assumption.
308	  - left. exact E.
309	Qed.
310	
311	Theorem rank_fully_reachable ρ r M :
312	  rank_ok ρ r M -> progress_or_wait ρ -> wait_targets_live ρ ->
313	  fully_reachable ρ.
314	Proof.
315	  intros Hr Hp Hl.
316	  apply wait_wf_fully_reachable.
317	  - apply rank_ok_wait_wf with (r := r) (M := M); exact Hr.
318	  - exact Hp.
319	  - exact Hl.
320	Qed.
321	
322	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
323	(* Seedability: the truly relevant combinatorial condition.           *)
324	(*                                                                    *)
325	(* A global rank is too strong: [waiting] may contain cycles that     *)
326	(* pass through objects which can step.  The correct condition is     *)
327	(* that every live location reaches, along finitely many waiting      *)
328	(* edges, some location that can step.                                *)
329	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
330	
331	Definition wait_step (ρ : cfg) : nat -> nat -> Prop :=
332	  fun a b => waiting ρ a b.
333	
334	Definition seeded (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
335	  forall i, ρ !! i <> None ->
336	    exists j, rtc (wait_step ρ) i j /\ can_step ρ j.
337	
338	Lemma reachable_of_wait_rtc ρ a b :
339	  rtc (wait_step ρ) a b -> reachable ρ b -> reachable ρ a.
340	Proof.
341	  intros H. induction H as [| x y z Hxy _ IH]; intros Hb.
342	  - exact Hb.
343	  - apply Waiting_reachable with y.
344	    + exact Hxy.
345	    + apply IH; exact Hb.
346	Qed.
347	
348	Lemma seeded_fully_reachable ρ : seeded ρ -> fully_reachable ρ.
349	Proof.
350	  intros Hseed i. destruct (ρ !! i) as [y|] eqn:E.
351	  - right. destruct (Hseed i ltac:(congruence)) as [j [Hpath Hstep]].
352	    apply (reachable_of_wait_rtc ρ i j Hpath).
353	    apply Can_step_reachable; exact Hstep.
354	  - left. exact E.
355	Qed.
356	
357	Lemma reachable_seed ρ i : reachable ρ i ->
358	  exists j, rtc (wait_step ρ) i j /\ can_step ρ j.
359	Proof.
360	  induction 1 as [k Hc | a b Hw Hr IH].
361	  - exists k. split; [apply rtc_refl | exact Hc].
362	  - destruct IH as [j [Hpath Hc]].
363	    exists j. split; [| exact Hc].
364	    apply (rtc_l (wait_step ρ) a b j Hw Hpath).
365	Qed.
366	
367	Lemma fully_reachable_seeded ρ : fully_reachable ρ -> seeded ρ.
368	Proof.
369	  intros Hfr i Hi.
370	  destruct (Hfr i) as [Hin | Hr].
371	  - exfalso. apply Hi. exact Hin.
372	  - exact (reachable_seed ρ i Hr).
373	Qed.
374	
375	Lemma seeded_iff_fully_reachable ρ : seeded ρ <-> fully_reachable ρ.
376	Proof.
377	  split.
378	  - apply seeded_fully_reachable.
379	  - apply fully_reachable_seeded.
380	Qed.
381	
382	(* A configuration with a live location and no steppable location is
383	   certainly not fully reachable. *)
384	Lemma reachable_no_can_step ρ i :
385	  (forall k, ~ can_step ρ k) -> reachable ρ i -> False.
386	Proof.
387	  intros Hns Hr. induction Hr as [k Hc | i j Hw Hr IH].
388	  - exact (Hns k Hc).
389	  - exact IH.
390	Qed.
391	
392	Lemma no_can_step_not_fully_reachable ρ :
393	  (forall k, ~ can_step ρ k) ->
394	  (exists k, ρ !! k <> None) ->
395	  ~ fully_reachable ρ.
396	Proof.
397	  intros Hns [k Hk] Hfr.
398	  destruct (Hfr k) as [Hin | Hr].
399	  - unfold inactive in Hin. exact (Hk Hin).
400	  - exact (reachable_no_can_step ρ k Hns Hr).
401	Qed.
402	
403	(* A rank is only needed on the non-steppable locations.  This is the
404	   exact relaxation needed because waiting cycles through steppable
405	   locations are harmless. *)
406	
407	Definition rank_nonstep (ρ : cfg) (r : nat -> nat) (M : nat) : Prop :=
408	  (forall i, r i <= M) /\
409	  (forall i j, waiting ρ i j -> ~ can_step ρ i -> r i < r j).
410	
411	Lemma waiting_target_live ρ (Hlive : wait_targets_live ρ) i j :
412	  waiting ρ i j -> ρ !! j <> None.
413	Proof.
414	  intros [[e [He Hw]] | [y [Hy _]]].
415	  - exact (Hlive i e j He Hw).
416	  - rewrite Hy. discriminate.
417	Qed.
418	
419	Lemma rank_nonstep_seeded ρ r M
420	    (Hdec : forall i, {can_step ρ i} + {~ can_step ρ i}) :
421	  rank_nonstep ρ r M -> progress_or_wait ρ -> wait_targets_live ρ ->
422	  seeded ρ.
423	Proof.
424	  intros [Hb Hr] Hprog Hlive i Hi.
425	  revert Hi.
426	  apply (well_founded_ind
427	    (Wf_nat.well_founded_lt_compat nat (fun i => M - r i)
428	       (fun y x => M - r y < M - r x)
429	       (fun x y Hxy => Hxy))
430	    (fun i => ρ !! i <> None ->
431	      exists j, rtc (wait_step ρ) i j /\ can_step ρ j)).
432	  intros x IH Hx.
433	  destruct (Hdec x) as [Hc | Hnc].
434	  - exists x. split; [apply rtc_refl | exact Hc].
435	  - destruct (Hprog x Hx) as [Hc | [y Hw]].
436	    + exists x. split; [apply rtc_refl | exact Hc].
437	    + assert (Hlt : M - r y < M - r x).
438	      { pose proof (Hr x y Hw Hnc). pose proof (Hb x). pose proof (Hb y). lia. }
439	      assert (Hy : ρ !! y <> None).
440	      { apply (waiting_target_live ρ Hlive x y Hw). }
441	      destruct (IH y Hlt Hy) as [z [Hpath Hz]].
442	      exists z. split; [| exact Hz].
443	      apply (rtc_l (wait_step ρ) x y z Hw Hpath).
444	Qed.
445	
446	(* ---------- elementary facts about references ---------- *)
447	
448	Definition refs_live (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
449	  forall i y, ρ !! i = Some y -> forall j, j ∈ obj_refs y -> ρ !! j <> None.
450	
451	Lemma ctx1_expr_refs k :
452	  ctx1 k -> forall e, expr_refs e ⊆ expr_refs (k e).
453	Proof.
454	  intros Hk e j Hj. destruct Hk; simpl; set_solver.
455	Qed.
456	
457	Lemma ctx_expr_refs k :
458	  ctx k -> forall e, expr_refs e ⊆ expr_refs (k e).
459	Proof.
460	  intros Hk. induction Hk as [| k1 k2 H1 H2 IH2]; simpl.
461	  - intros e j Hj. exact Hj.
462	  - intros e j Hj. apply (ctx1_expr_refs k1 H1). apply IH2. exact Hj.
463	Qed.
464	
465	Lemma expr_head_waiting_ref j e :
466	  expr_head_waiting e j -> j ∈ expr_refs e.
467	Proof.
468	  intros H. induction H; simpl; set_solver.
469	Qed.
470	
471	Lemma ctx_head_waiting_ref k e j :
472	  ctx k -> expr_head_waiting e j -> j ∈ expr_refs (k e).
473	Proof.
474	  intros Hk Hh. apply (ctx_expr_refs k Hk e).
475	  apply expr_head_waiting_ref in Hh. exact Hh.
476	Qed.
477	
478	Lemma expr_waiting_ref e j : expr_waiting e j -> j ∈ expr_refs e.
479	Proof.
480	  intros [k [e' [Hk [He Hh]]]]. subst e.
481	  apply ctx_head_waiting_ref; assumption.
482	Qed.
483	
484	Lemma refs_live_wait_targets_live ρ :
485	  refs_live ρ -> wait_targets_live ρ.
486	Proof.
487	  intros Hlive i e j He Hw.
488	  apply (Hlive i (Thread e) He j).
489	  apply expr_waiting_ref in Hw. exact Hw.
490	Qed.
491	
492	(* Lock types are never unrestricted. *)
493	Lemma unr_LockT l t : unr (LockT l t) -> False.
494	Proof. intros H. inversion H. Qed.
495	
496	Lemma disjoint_env_no_dup_lock Γ1 Γ2 x l t :
497	  disj Γ1 Γ2 ->
498	  Γ1 !! x = Some (LockT l t) ->
499	  Γ2 !! x = Some (LockT l t) ->
500	  False.
501	Proof.
502	  intros Hd H1 H2.
503	  destruct (Hd x (LockT l t) (LockT l t) H1 H2) as [_ Hunr].
504	  exact (unr_LockT l t Hunr).
505	Qed.
506	
507	(* Every local step has its label live in the source configuration. *)
508	Lemma local_step_label_live i ρ ρ' : local_step i ρ ρ' -> ρ !! i <> None.
509	Proof.
510	  intros H. induction H; simpl; intro E;
511	    match goal with
512	    | E : ?M = None |- False =>
513	        assert (His : is_Some M) by (apply elem_of_dom; set_solver);
514	        destruct His as [x Hx]; rewrite E in Hx; discriminate
515	    end.
516	Qed.
517	
518	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
519	(* Parallel/source reachability is the remaining semantic work.       *)
520	(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
521	
522	Theorem typed_full_reachability e ρ :
523	  typed ∅ e UnitT -> steps {[ 0 := Thread e ]} ρ -> fully_reachable ρ.
524

=== Base.v
From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.

From Stdlib Require Import Classical_Prop Wellfounded Wf_nat Lia.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* A sufficient combinatorial condition for full reachability.        *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* [waiting ρ i j] is the "i depends on j" relation.  If it admits a  *)
(* rank that strictly increases along waiting edges, then reachability *)
(* propagates back along those edges from any [can_step] seed.        *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition wait_wf (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  well_founded (fun j i => waiting ρ i j).

Definition progress_or_wait (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i, ρ !! i <> None -> can_step ρ i \/ exists j, waiting ρ i j.

Definition wait_targets_live (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i e j, ρ !! i = Some (Thread e) -> expr_waiting e j -> ρ !! j <> None.

Definition rank_ok (ρ : cfg) (r : nat -> nat) (M : nat) : Prop :=
  (forall i, r i <= M) /\ (forall i j, waiting ρ i j -> r i < r j).

Lemma rank_ok_wait_wf ρ r M :
  rank_ok ρ r M -> wait_wf ρ.
Proof.
  intros [Hb Hr]. unfold wait_wf.
  apply (Wf_nat.well_founded_lt_compat
           nat (fun i => M - r i) (fun j i => waiting ρ i j)).
  intros x y Hxy. pose proof (Hr y x Hxy) as Hlt.
  pose proof (Hb x). pose proof (Hb y). lia.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Sufficient conditions for full reachability (constructive version). *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition wait_wf (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  well_founded (fun j i => waiting ρ i j).

Definition progress_or_wait (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i, ρ !! i <> None -> can_step ρ i \/ exists j, waiting ρ i j.

Definition wait_targets_live (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i e j, ρ !! i = Some (Thread e) -> expr_waiting e j -> ρ !! j <> None.

Definition rank_ok (ρ : cfg) (r : nat -> nat) (M : nat) : Prop :=
  (forall i, r i <= M) /\ (forall i j, waiting ρ i j -> r i < r j).

Lemma rank_ok_wait_wf ρ r M : rank_ok ρ r M -> wait_wf ρ.
Proof.
  intros [Hb Hr]. unfold wait_wf.
  apply (Wf_nat.well_founded_lt_compat
           nat (fun i => M - r i) (fun j i => waiting ρ i j)).
  intros x y Hxy. pose proof (Hr y x Hxy) as Hlt.
  pose proof (Hb x). pose proof (Hb y). lia.
Qed.

(* A constructive proof: [inactive] is decided by matching on the lookup. *)
Lemma wait_wf_fully_reachable ρ :
  wait_wf ρ -> progress_or_wait ρ -> wait_targets_live ρ -> fully_reachable ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hwf Hprog Hlive i.
  apply (well_founded_ind Hwf (fun i => inactive ρ i \/ reachable ρ i)).
  intros x IH.
  destruct (ρ !! x) as [y|] eqn:E.
  - right.
    assert (Hact : ρ !! x <> None) by congruence.
    destruct (Hprog x Hact) as [Hstep | [j Hwait]].
    + apply Can_step_reachable; exact Hstep.
    + destruct (IH j Hwait) as [Hinj | Hrj].
      * destruct Hwait as [[e [He Hw]] | [y' [Hy _]]].
        -- exfalso. exact (Hlive x e j He Hw Hinj).
        -- unfold inactive in Hinj. rewrite Hy in Hinj. discriminate.
      * apply Waiting_reachable with j; assumption.
  - left. exact E.
Qed.

Theorem rank_fully_reachable ρ r M :
  rank_ok ρ r M -> progress_or_wait ρ -> wait_targets_live ρ ->
  fully_reachable ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hr Hp Hl.
  apply wait_wf_fully_reachable.
  - apply rank_ok_wait_wf with (r := r) (M := M); exact Hr.
  - exact Hp.
  - exact Hl.

From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.
From Stdlib Require Import Relation_Operators.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* A weaker sufficient condition than a global rank: every live       *)
(* location reaches, along finitely many waiting edges, some location *)
(* that can step.                                                     *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition wait_step (ρ : cfg) : nat -> nat -> Prop :=
  fun a b => waiting ρ a b.

Lemma reachable_of_wait_rtc ρ a b :
  rtc (wait_step ρ) a b -> reachable ρ b -> reachable ρ a.
Proof.
  intros H. induction H as [| x y z Hxy _ IH]; intros Hb.
  - exact Hb.
  - apply Waiting_reachable with y.
    + exact Hxy.
    + apply IH; exact Hb.
Qed.

Definition seeded ρ : Prop :=
  forall i, ρ !! i <> None ->
    exists j, rtc (wait_step ρ) i j /\ can_step ρ j.

Lemma seeded_fully_reachable ρ :
  seeded ρ -> fully_reachable ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hseed i. destruct (ρ !! i) as [y|] eqn:E.
  - right. destruct (Hseed i ltac:(congruence)) as [j [Hpath Hstep]].
    apply (reachable_of_wait_rtc ρ i j Hpath).
    apply Can_step_reachable; exact Hstep.
  - left. exact E.
Qed.

(* Every location is trivially seeded by can_step on itself. *)
Lemma all_can_step_fully_reachable ρ :
  (forall i, ρ !! i <> None -> can_step ρ i) -> fully_reachable ρ.
Proof.
  intros H. apply seeded_fully_reachable. intros i Hi.
  exists i. split; [constructor | apply H; exact Hi].
Qed.

Print Assumptions seeded_fully_reachable.

(* Converse: [fully_reachable] fixes a finite derivation tree for each
   reachable index; following waiting edges to the leaves of that tree
   yields a waiting path to an index that really can step.  Hence
   seedability is not merely sufficient but equivalent. *)

Lemma reachable_seed ρ i : reachable ρ i ->
  exists j, rtc (wait_step ρ) i j /\ can_step ρ j.
Proof.
  induction 1 as [k Hc | a b Hw Hr IH].
  - exists k. split; [apply rtc_refl | exact Hc].
  - destruct IH as [j [Hpath Hc]].
    exists j. split; [| exact Hc].
    apply (rtc_l (wait_step ρ) a b j Hw Hpath).
Qed.

Lemma fully_reachable_seeded ρ : fully_reachable ρ -> seeded ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hfr i Hi.
  destruct (Hfr i) as [Hin | Hr].
  - exfalso. apply Hi. exact Hin.
  - exact (reachable_seed ρ i Hr).
Qed.

Lemma seeded_iff_fully_reachable ρ : seeded ρ <-> fully_reachable ρ.
Proof.
  split.
  - apply seeded_fully_reachable.
  - apply fully_reachable_seeded.
Qed.

From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.

(* If nothing can step, [reachable] is empty: its only base constructor is
   [Can_step_reachable], and the waiting constructor recurses on the same
   (empty) predicate.  Hence a configuration with a live index and no
   steppable index is not fully reachable. *)

Lemma reachable_no_can_step ρ i :
  (forall k, ~ can_step ρ k) -> reachable ρ i -> False.
Proof.
  intros Hns Hr. induction Hr as [k Hc | i j Hw Hr IH].
  - exact (Hns k Hc).
  - exact IH.
Qed.

Lemma no_can_step_not_fully_reachable ρ :
  (forall k, ~ can_step ρ k) ->
  (exists k, ρ !! k <> None) ->
  ~ fully_reachable ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hns [k Hk] Hfr.
  destruct (Hfr k) as [Hin | Hr].
  - unfold inactive in Hin. exact (Hk Hin).
  - exact (reachable_no_can_step ρ k Hns Hr).
Qed.

From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.
From Stdlib Require Import Relation_Operators Wf_nat Lia.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* A rank only on non-steppable nodes.                                *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* A global [rank_ok] is too strong: waiting cycles through           *)
(* [can_step] objects occur.  The relaxed condition below only         *)
(* constrains edges leaving nodes that cannot step.                   *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition wait_step (ρ : cfg) : nat -> nat -> Prop :=
  fun a b => waiting ρ a b.

Definition seeded (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i, ρ !! i <> None ->
    exists j, rtc (wait_step ρ) i j /\ can_step ρ j.

Definition progress_or_wait (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i, ρ !! i <> None -> can_step ρ i \/ exists j, waiting ρ i j.

Definition wait_targets_live (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i e j, ρ !! i = Some (Thread e) -> expr_waiting e j -> ρ !! j <> None.

Definition rank_nonstep (ρ : cfg) (r : nat -> nat) (M : nat) : Prop :=
  (forall i, r i <= M) /\
  (forall i j, waiting ρ i j -> ~ can_step ρ i -> r i < r j).

Lemma waiting_target_live ρ (Hlive : wait_targets_live ρ) i j :
  waiting ρ i j -> ρ !! j <> None.
Proof.
  intros [[e [He Hw]] | [y [Hy _]]].
  - exact (Hlive i e j He Hw).
  - rewrite Hy. discriminate.
Qed.

(* If [can_step] is decidable, the relaxed rank is enough.  For a node
   that can step we stop; otherwise the rank strictly increases along the
   exhibited waiting edge, so well-founded induction on [M - r i]
   constructs a waiting path to a steppable node. *)

Lemma rank_nonstep_seeded ρ r M
    (Hdec : forall i, {can_step ρ i} + {~ can_step ρ i}) :
  rank_nonstep ρ r M -> progress_or_wait ρ -> wait_targets_live ρ ->
  seeded ρ.
Proof.
  intros [Hb Hr] Hprog Hlive i Hi.
  revert Hi.
  apply (well_founded_ind
    (Wf_nat.well_founded_lt_compat nat (fun i => M - r i)
       (fun y x => M - r y < M - r x)
       (fun x y Hxy => Hxy))
    (fun i => ρ !! i <> None ->
      exists j, rtc (wait_step ρ) i j /\ can_step ρ j)).
  intros x IH Hx.
  destruct (Hdec x) as [Hc | Hnc].
  - exists x. split; [apply rtc_refl | exact Hc].
  - destruct (Hprog x Hx) as [Hc | [y Hw]].
    + exists x. split; [apply rtc_refl | exact Hc].
    + assert (Hlt : M - r y < M - r x).
      { pose proof (Hr x y Hw Hnc). pose proof (Hb x). pose proof (Hb y). lia. }
      assert (Hy : ρ !! y <> None).
      { apply (waiting_target_live ρ Hlive x y Hw). }
      destruct (IH y Hlt Hy) as [z [Hpath Hz]].
      exists z. split; [| exact Hz].
      apply (rtc_l (wait_step ρ) x y z Hw Hpath).
Qed.

Print Assumptions rank_nonstep_seeded.

Lemma insert_insert_same x (t1 t2 : type) (Γ : env) :
  <[x:=t2]>(<[x:=t1]>Γ) = <[x:=t2]>Γ.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro y. destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (<[y:=t1]>Γ) y t2). rewrite (lookup_insert_eq Γ y t2). done.
  - rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[x:=t1]>Γ) x y t2 E).
    rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x y t2 E).
    rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x y t1 E). done.
Qed.

Lemma insert_insert_comm x y (t1 t2 : type) (Γ : env) : x <> y ->
  <[x:=t1]>(<[y:=t2]>Γ) = <[y:=t2]>(<[x:=t1]>Γ).
Proof.
  intros Hne. unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro z.
  destruct (decide (z=x)) as [E1|E1].
  - subst z.
    destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E2|E2].
    + exfalso. apply Hne. done.
    + rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (<[y:=t2]>Γ) x t1).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[x:=t1]>Γ) y x t2 (fun H => E2 (eq_sym H))).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_eq Γ x t1). done.
  - destruct (decide (z=y)) as [E2|E2].
    + subst z.
      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[y:=t2]>Γ) x y t1 Hne).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_eq Γ y t2).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (<[x:=t1]>Γ) y t2). done.
    + rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[y:=t2]>Γ) x z t1 (fun H => E1 (eq_sym H))).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ y z t2 (fun H => E2 (eq_sym H))).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[x:=t1]>Γ) y z t2 (fun H => E2 (eq_sym H))).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x z t1 (fun H => E1 (eq_sym H))). done.
Qed.

Lemma env_split_delete x (E E1 E2 : env) :
  env_split E E1 E2 -> env_split (delete x E) (delete x E1) (delete x E2).
Proof.
  unfold env in *. intros [Hun Hdis]. split.
  - rewrite Hun. apply delete_union.
  - apply disj_delete. done.
Qed.

Lemma env_unr_empty : env_unr (∅ : env).
Proof. unfold env in *. intros x t H. assert (H0 : (∅ : gmap string type) !! x = None) by apply lookup_empty. setoid_rewrite H0 in H. done. Qed.

Lemma env_split_nil : env_split (∅ : env) ∅ ∅.
Proof.
  unfold env_split. split.
  - symmetry. apply env_union_empty_l.
  - intros i t1 t2 H1 H2. assert (H0 : (∅ : env) !! i = None) by (unfold env; apply lookup_empty).
    setoid_rewrite H0 in H1. done.
Qed.

(* Source terms are [Val]-free: [typed] has no rule for [Val], and every
   constructor except [Val] has a [wt] counterpart.  Hence any source term
   well typed under [typed] is also well typed under the runtime typing
   [wt], for an arbitrary store typing [L]. *)

Lemma typed_to_wt Γ e t (H : typed Γ e t) : forall L, wt L Γ e t.
Proof.
  induction H as
    [ Γ x t Hvar
    | Γ Γ' x e t1 t2 l Hb Hunr Hty IH
    | Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 l Hsplit Hty1 IH1 Hty2 IH2
    | Γ Hunr
    | Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 Hsplit Hty1 IH1 Hty2 IH2
    | Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 t Hsplit Hty1 IH1 Hty2 IH2
    | Γ n ts i e Hty IH
    | n Γ Γ1 Γ2 t ts es e Hsplit Hn Hty IH Hf IHf
    | Γ e t1 t2 Hty IH
    | Γ e t Hty IH
    | Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t l1 l2 l3 Hsplit Hcap Hty1 IH1 Hty2 IH2
    | Γ e t lo Hty IH
    | Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t lo Hsplit Hty1 IH1 Hty2 IH2
    | Γ e t Hty IH
    | Γ e t Hty IH ];
    intros L.
  - apply VarW; exact Hvar.
  - eapply FunW; [ exact Hb | exact Hunr | apply IH ].
  - eapply AppW; [ exact Hsplit | apply IH1 | apply IH2 ].
  - apply UnitW; exact Hunr.
  - eapply PairW; [ exact Hsplit | apply IH1 | apply IH2 ].
  - eapply LetPairW; [ exact Hsplit | apply IH1 | apply IH2 ].
  - eapply SumW; apply IH.
  - eapply MatchSumW; [ exact Hsplit | exact Hn | apply IH | intros i; apply (IHf i L) ].
  - eapply ForkW; apply IH.
  - eapply NewLockW; apply IH.
  - eapply ForkLockW; [ exact Hsplit | exact Hcap | apply IH1 | apply IH2 ].
  - eapply AcquireW; apply IH.
  - eapply ReleaseW; [ exact Hsplit | apply IH1 | apply IH2 ].
  - eapply WaitW; apply IH.
  - eapply DropW; apply IH.
Qed.

Print Assumptions typed_to_wt.

(* Runtime typing alone does *not* track the identity of runtime locks:
   two distinct capability values in one expression can both be [LockV 1]
   and still be typed, because [cv] only requires [L !! 1 = Some t].
   Hence any "a thread never holds two capabilities of the same runtime
   lock" invariant must come from reachability/provenance, not from [wt]
   or [cv]. *)

Definition L_alias : gmap nat type := {[ 1 := UnitT ]}.

Lemma L_alias_lookup : L_alias !! 1 = Some UnitT.
Proof. unfold L_alias. apply lookup_insert_eq. Qed.

Lemma aliased_lock_values_wt :
  wt L_alias ∅ (Val (PairV (LockV 1) (LockV 1)))
    (PairT (LockT (Owner,Closed) UnitT) (LockT (Owner,Closed) UnitT)).
Proof.
  eapply ValW.
  - apply env_unr_empty.
  - eapply PairVW.
    + eapply LockVW. exact L_alias_lookup.
    + eapply LockVW. exact L_alias_lookup.
Qed.

Print Assumptions aliased_lock_values_wt.

  fun a b => waiting ρ a b.

Lemma reachable_of_wait_rtc ρ a b :
  rtc (wait_step ρ) a b -> reachable ρ b -> reachable ρ a.
Proof.
  intros H. induction H as [| x y z Hxy _ IH]; intros Hb.
  - exact Hb.
  - apply Waiting_reachable with y.
    + exact Hxy.
    + apply IH; exact Hb.
Qed.

Definition seeded ρ : Prop :=
  forall i, ρ !! i <> None ->
    exists j, rtc (wait_step ρ) i j /\ can_step ρ j.

Lemma seeded_fully_reachable ρ : seeded ρ -> fully_reachable ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hseed i. destruct (ρ !! i) as [y|] eqn:E.
  - right. destruct (Hseed i ltac:(congruence)) as [j [Hpath Hstep]].
    apply (reachable_of_wait_rtc ρ i j Hpath).
    apply Can_step_reachable; exact Hstep.
  - left. exact E.
Qed.

Definition A0 : cfg := {[ 0 := Thread (Acquire (Val $ LockV 1)) ]}.
Definition A1 : cfg := {[ 1 := Lock 0 (Some (LockV 2)) ]}.
Definition A2 : cfg := {[ 2 := Lock 0 (Some (LockV 1)) ]}.
Definition B0 : cfg := {[ 0 := Thread (Val $ PairV (LockV 1) (LockV 2)) ]}.
Definition B1 : cfg := {[ 1 := Lock 0 None ]}.

Definition ex_cfg : cfg :=
  {[ 0 := Thread (Acquire (Val $ LockV 1));
     1 := Lock 0 (Some (LockV 2));
     2 := Lock 0 (Some (LockV 1)) ]}.

Lemma ex_wait_0_1 : waiting ex_cfg 0 1.
Proof.
  left. exists (Acquire (Val $ LockV 1)). split; [reflexivity|].
  exists id, (Acquire (Val $ LockV 1)). split; [constructor|].
  split; [reflexivity|constructor].
Qed.

Lemma ex_wait_1_2 : waiting ex_cfg 1 2.
Proof.
  right. exists (Lock 0 (Some (LockV 1))). split; [reflexivity|].
  split; [set_solver|]. intros e He. discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma ex_wait_2_1 : waiting ex_cfg 2 1.
Proof.
  right. exists (Lock 0 (Some (LockV 2))). split; [reflexivity|].
  split; [set_solver|]. intros e He. discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma ex_cfg_eq : ex_cfg = ((A0 ∪ A1) ∪ A2).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma ex_keys i : ex_cfg !! i <> None -> i = 0 \/ i = 1 \/ i = 2.
Proof.
  intros Hi.
  assert (i ∈ dom ex_cfg) as Hdom.
  { apply elem_of_dom. destruct (ex_cfg!!i) eqn:E; [eauto|].
    exfalso. apply Hi. reflexivity. }
  unfold ex_cfg in Hdom. set_solver.
Qed.

Lemma exd1 : (A0 ∪ A1) ##ₘ A2.
Proof.
  apply (proj2 (map_disjoint_alt _ _)); intros k.
  destruct k as [|[|[|k]]].
  - compute. auto.
  - compute. auto.
  - compute. auto.
  - right. unfold A2. apply lookup_singleton_ne. discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma exd2 : (B0 ∪ B1) ##ₘ A2.
Proof.
  apply (proj2 (map_disjoint_alt _ _)); intros k.
  destruct k as [|[|[|k]]].
  - compute. auto.
  - compute. auto.
  - compute. auto.
  - right. unfold A2. apply lookup_singleton_ne. discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma ex_can_step_1 : can_step ex_cfg 1.
Proof.
  exists ((B0 ∪ B1) ∪ A2).
  rewrite ex_cfg_eq.
  change (step 1 ((A0 ∪ A1) ∪ A2) ((B0 ∪ B1) ∪ A2)).
  eapply Frame_step with (ρ := A0 ∪ A1) (ρ' := B0 ∪ B1) (ρf := A2).
  - exact exd1.
  - exact exd2.
  - apply (Acquire_step (LockV 2) id 0 1 0).
    + discriminate.
    + constructor.
Qed.

Lemma ex_seeded : seeded ex_cfg.
Proof.
  intros i Hi.
  destruct i as [|[|[|i]]].
  - exists 1. split.
    + apply (rtc_l (wait_step ex_cfg) 0 1 1).
      * exact ex_wait_0_1.
      * apply rtc_refl.
    + exact ex_can_step_1.
  - exists 1. split; [apply rtc_refl|exact ex_can_step_1].
  - exists 1. split.
    + apply (rtc_l (wait_step ex_cfg) 2 1 1).
      * exact ex_wait_2_1.
      * apply rtc_refl.
    + exact ex_can_step_1.
  - exfalso. destruct (ex_keys (S (S (S i))) Hi) as [H|[H|H]]; discriminate H.
Qed.

Theorem ex_fully_reachable : fully_reachable ex_cfg.
Proof. apply seeded_fully_reachable, ex_seeded. Qed.

Definition rank_ok (ρ : cfg) (r : nat -> nat) (M : nat) : Prop :=
  (forall i, r i <= M) /\ (forall i j, waiting ρ i j -> r i < r j).

Theorem ex_no_rank : forall r M, ~ rank_ok ex_cfg r M.
Proof.
  intros r M Hr. unfold rank_ok in Hr. destruct Hr as [_ Hlt].
  pose proof (Hlt 1 2 ex_wait_1_2). pose proof (Hlt 2 1 ex_wait_2_1). lia.
Qed.

Print Assumptions ex_fully_reachable.
Print Assumptions ex_no_rank.

Lemma local_step_label_shape i rho rho' :

  (exists (j n:nat) (k:expr->expr) (v:val), ctx k /\ rho !! i = Some (Thread (k (ForkBarrier (Val v))))) \/

  (exists (k:expr->expr) (n:nat) (v:val), ctx k /\ rho !! i = Some (Thread (k (NewLock (Val v))))) \/
  (exists (v:val) (o:option val) (k:expr->expr) (j n refcnt:nat),
      ctx k /\ rho !! n = Some (Lock refcnt o) /\
      rho !! j = Some (Thread (k (ForkLock (Val (LockV n)) (Val v))))) \/
  (exists (v:val) (k:expr->expr) (j n refcnt:nat),
      ctx k /\ rho !! n = Some (Lock refcnt (Some v)) /\
      rho !! j = Some (Thread (k (Acquire (Val (LockV n)))))) \/
  (exists (v:val) (k:expr->expr) (j n refcnt:nat),
      ctx k /\ rho !! n = Some (Lock refcnt None) /\
      rho !! j = Some (Thread (k (Release (Val (LockV n)) (Val v))))) \/

    + unfold cfg. apply lookup_insert_eq.
  - right; right; right; right; right; right; right; left.

    + unfold cfg. rewrite lookup_insert_ne by assumption. apply lookup_insert_eq.

(* The semantic core of the suggested self-deadlock:

   thread 0 is stuck at [Acquire (LockV 1)] while its continuation/context
   still contains a second capability [LockV 1] for the same runtime lock;
   lock 1 has been opened (content [None]).  There is no other object.

   We show that this configuration admits no step at all.  Consequently it
   is not fully reachable (any active index is unreachable).  This isolates
   the semantic half of the attack; the missing half is a well-typed source
   term that produces two capabilities for the same runtime lock in one
   thread, which we show cannot be duplicated at the source level. *)

Definition attack_expr : expr :=
  Pair (Acquire (Val (LockV 1))) (Val (LockV 1)).

Definition attack_cfg : cfg :=
  <[ 1 := Lock 0 None ]> ({[ 0 := Thread attack_expr ]}).

Lemma attack_cfg_thread : attack_cfg !! 0 = Some (Thread attack_expr).
Proof.
  unfold attack_cfg.
  rewrite lookup_insert_ne by discriminate.
  apply lookup_singleton_eq.
Qed.

Lemma attack_cfg_lock : attack_cfg !! 1 = Some (Lock 0 None).
Proof.
  unfold attack_cfg.
  apply lookup_insert_eq.
Qed.

Lemma attack_cfg_active : attack_cfg !! 0 <> None.
Proof. rewrite attack_cfg_thread. discriminate. Qed.

Lemma no_step_attack_cfg : forall i, ~ can_step attack_cfg i.
Proof.
  intros i Hc. unfold can_step in Hc. destruct Hc as [rho' Hstep].
  unfold attack_cfg in *.
  (* inspect the frame decomposition *)
  inversion Hstep as [rho0 rho0' rhof j Hdisj0 Hdisj0' Hlocal]; subst.
  inversion Hlocal; subst; simpl in *.
Admitted.

Lemma attack_cfg_not_fully_reachable : ~ fully_reachable attack_cfg.
Proof.
  intro Hfr.
  pose proof (no_can_step_not_fully_reachable attack_cfg
                no_step_attack_cfg
                (ex_intro _ 0 attack_cfg_active)) as H.
Admitted.

From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String.
Open Scope string_scope.
From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.

(* Elementary facts showing that the two-capability attack cannot be
   duplicated at the source level: linear lock types are never [unr], and an
   environment split therefore cannot let the same lock-typed variable occur
   on both sides. *)

Lemma unr_LockT l t : unr (LockT l t) -> False.
Proof. intros H. inversion H. Qed.

Lemma not_unr_lockcap l t : ~ unr (LockT l t).
Proof. intros H. exact (unr_LockT l t H). Qed.

Lemma disj_lock_both Γ1 Γ2 x l t :
  disj Γ1 Γ2 ->
  Γ1 !! x = Some (LockT l t) ->
  Γ2 !! x = Some (LockT l t) ->
  False.
Proof.
  intros Hd H1 H2.
  destruct (Hd x (LockT l t) (LockT l t) H1 H2) as [_ Hunr].
  exact (unr_LockT l t Hunr).
Qed.

Lemma env_split_lock_both Γ Γ1 Γ2 x l t :
  env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
  Γ1 !! x = Some (LockT l t) ->
  Γ2 !! x = Some (LockT l t) ->
  False.
Proof.
  intros [Hu Hd] H1 H2.
  exact (disj_lock_both Γ1 Γ2 x l t Hd H1 H2).
Qed.

(* Complete enumeration of the nine possible ForkLock splits. *)
Lemma lockcap_split_cases l1 l2 l3 :
  lockcap_split l1 l2 l3 ->
  (exists lo1 ls1 lo2 ls2 lo3 ls3,
      l1 = (lo1,ls1) /\ l2 = (lo2,ls2) /\ l3 = (lo3,ls3)
      /\ lockownership_split lo1 lo2 lo3
      /\ lockstate_split ls1 ls2 ls3).
Proof.
  intros H. unfold lockcap_split in H. destruct H as [Ho Hs].
  destruct l1 as [lo1 ls1]. destruct l2 as [lo2 ls2]. destruct l3 as [lo3 ls3].
  exists lo1, ls1, lo2, ls2, lo3, ls3. auto.
Qed.

Lemma env_var_lookup Γ x t : env_var Γ x t -> Γ !! x = Some t.
Proof.
  intros [Γ' [Heq _]]. rewrite Heq. apply lookup_insert_eq.
Qed.

(* A single lock-typed variable cannot be used twice in a pair: its type is
   not [unr], so the required environment split is impossible.  This is the
   source-level form of the obstruction to "two capabilities for the same
   runtime lock in one thread". *)
Lemma no_dup_lock_var :
  ~ typed {[ "x" := LockT (Owner,Closed) UnitT ]}
      (Pair (Var "x") (Var "x"))
      (PairT (LockT (Owner,Closed) UnitT) (LockT (Owner,Closed) UnitT)).
Proof.
  intros H.
  inversion H; subst.
  (* Pair_typed case *)
  match goal with
  | Hsplit : env_split _ _ _,
    H1 : typed ?G1 (Var "x") _,
    H2 : typed ?G2 (Var "x") _ |- _ =>
      inversion H1; subst;
      inversion H2; subst;
      (* now both sides have an [env_var] fact for the same variable *)
      match goal with
      | Hv1 : env_var ?A "x" _,
        Hv2 : env_var ?B "x" _ |- _ =>
          destruct Hsplit as [_ Hd];
          eapply disj_lock_both;
          [ exact Hd
          | exact (env_var_lookup _ _ _ Hv1)
          | exact (env_var_lookup _ _ _ Hv2) ]
      end
  end.
Qed.

      wt L Γ (Release e1 e2) (LockT (lo,Closed) t)

      wt L Γ e (LockT (Owner,Closed) t) ->
      wt L Γ (Wait e) t
  | DropW Γ e t :
      wt L Γ e (LockT (Client,Closed) t) ->
      wt L Γ (Drop e) UnitT
  | ValW Γ v t :
      env_unr Γ ->
      cv L v t ->
      wt L Γ (Val v) t
with cv (L : gmap nat type) : val -> type -> Prop :=
  | FunVW x e t1 t2 l :
      wt L (<[ x := t1 ]> (∅ : env)) e t2 ->
      cv L (FunV x e) (FunT l t1 t2)
  | UnitVW : cv L UnitV UnitT
  | PairVW v1 v2 t1 t2 :
      cv L v1 t1 -> cv L v2 t2 ->
      cv L (PairV v1 v2) (PairT t1 t2)
  | SumVW n (ts : fin n -> type) i v :
      cv L v (ts i) ->
      cv L (SumV i v) (SumT n ts)
  | BarrierVW n t1 t2 :
      cv L (BarrierV n) (FunT Lin t1 t2)
  | LockVW n lc t :
      L !! n = Some t ->
      cv L (LockV n) (LockT lc t).

(* ---------- gmap / environment helpers ---------- *)

Lemma env_lookup_insert_same x (t : type) : (<[x:=t]>(∅ : env)) !! x = Some t.
Proof. unfold env in *. apply lookup_insert_eq. Qed.

Lemma env_lookup_insert_none x y (t : type) (Γ : env) : x <> y -> Γ !! y = None -> (<[x:=t]>Γ) !! y = None.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. intros Hne Hy.
  rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x y t Hne). done.
Qed.

Lemma env_unr_delete x (Γ : env) : env_unr Γ -> env_unr (delete x Γ).
Proof.
  intros H y t Hy. unfold env_unr in H. unfold env in *.
  destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_eq Γ y) in Hy. done.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ x y E) in Hy. apply H in Hy. done.
Qed.

Lemma env_unr_insert_lookup x (t : type) (Γ : env) :
  env_unr (<[x:=t]>Γ) -> unr t.
Proof. intros H. unfold env_unr in H. apply (H x t). unfold env. apply lookup_insert_eq. Qed.

Lemma env_union_empty_l (m : env) : ∅ ∪ m = m.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro x. rewrite lookup_union.
  assert (H : (∅ : gmap string type) !! x = None) by apply lookup_empty.
  rewrite H. destruct (m !! x); done.
Qed.

Lemma env_union_empty_r (m : env) : m ∪ ∅ = m.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro x. rewrite lookup_union.
  assert (H : (∅ : gmap string type) !! x = None) by apply lookup_empty.
  rewrite H. destruct (m !! x); done.
Qed.

Lemma env_split_empty (Γ1 Γ2 : env) : env_split ∅ Γ1 Γ2 -> Γ1 = ∅ /\ Γ2 = ∅.
Proof.
  unfold env in *.
  intros [Hun Hdis]. symmetry in Hun.
  apply map_positive_l in Hun as H1. subst Γ1.
  rewrite env_union_empty_l in Hun. subst Γ2. split; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma disj_delete x (Γ1 Γ2 : env) : disj Γ1 Γ2 -> disj (delete x Γ1) (delete x Γ2).
Proof.
  unfold env in *.
  intros H i t1 t2 H1 H2.
  destruct (decide (x=i)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_eq Γ1 i) in H1. done.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ1 x i E) in H1. rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ2 x i E) in H2. apply (H i t1 t2 H1 H2).
Qed.

Lemma delete_insert_none x (t : type) (Γ : env) : Γ !! x = None -> delete x (<[x:=t]>Γ) = Γ.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. intros Hx. apply map_eq. intro y. destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_eq (<[y:=t]>Γ) y). done.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_ne (<[x:=t]>Γ) x y E). rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x y t E). done.
Qed.

Lemma delete_none x (Γ : env) : Γ !! x = None -> delete x Γ = Γ.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. intros Hx. apply map_eq. intro y. destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_eq Γ y). done.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ x y E). done.
Qed.

Lemma insert_delete_same x (t : type) (Γ : env) : Γ !! x = Some t -> <[x:=t]>(delete x Γ) = Γ.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. intros Hx. apply map_eq. intro y. destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (delete y Γ) y t). symmetry. done.
  - rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (delete x Γ) x y t E). rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ x y E). done.
Qed.

Lemma insert_insert_same x (t1 t2 : type) (Γ : env) :
  <[x:=t2]>(<[x:=t1]>Γ) = <[x:=t2]>Γ.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro y. destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (<[y:=t1]>Γ) y t2). rewrite (lookup_insert_eq Γ y t2). done.
  - rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[x:=t1]>Γ) x y t2 E).
    rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x y t2 E).
    rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x y t1 E). done.
Qed.

Lemma insert_insert_comm x y (t1 t2 : type) (Γ : env) : x <> y ->
  <[x:=t1]>(<[y:=t2]>Γ) = <[y:=t2]>(<[x:=t1]>Γ).
Proof.
  intros Hne. unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro z.
  destruct (decide (z=x)) as [E1|E1].
  - subst z.
    destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E2|E2].
    + exfalso. apply Hne. done.
    + rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (<[y:=t2]>Γ) x t1).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[x:=t1]>Γ) y x t2 (fun H => E2 (eq_sym H))).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_eq Γ x t1). done.
  - destruct (decide (z=y)) as [E2|E2].
    + subst z.
      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[y:=t2]>Γ) x y t1 Hne).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_eq Γ y t2).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (<[x:=t1]>Γ) y t2). done.
    + rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[y:=t2]>Γ) x z t1 (fun H => E1 (eq_sym H))).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ y z t2 (fun H => E2 (eq_sym H))).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[x:=t1]>Γ) y z t2 (fun H => E2 (eq_sym H))).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x z t1 (fun H => E1 (eq_sym H))). done.
Qed.

Lemma env_split_delete x (E E1 E2 : env) :
  env_split E E1 E2 -> env_split (delete x E) (delete x E1) (delete x E2).
Proof.
  unfold env in *. intros [Hun Hdis]. split.
  - rewrite Hun. apply delete_union.
  - apply disj_delete. done.
Qed.

Lemma env_unr_empty : env_unr (∅ : env).
Proof. unfold env in *. intros x t H. assert (H0 : (∅ : gmap string type) !! x = None) by apply lookup_empty. setoid_rewrite H0 in H. done. Qed.

Lemma env_split_nil : env_split (∅ : env) ∅ ∅.
Proof.
  unfold env_split. split.
  - symmetry. apply env_union_empty_l.
  - intros i t1 t2 H1 H2. assert (H0 : (∅ : env) !! i = None) by (unfold env; apply lookup_empty).
    setoid_rewrite H0 in H1. done.
Qed.

(* ---------- Source typing embeds in the runtime typing ---------- *)

Lemma typed_to_wt Γ e t (H : typed Γ e t) : forall L, wt L Γ e t.
Proof.
  induction H as
    [ Γ x t Hvar
    | Γ Γ' x e t1 t2 l Hb Hunr Hty IH
    | Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 l Hsplit Hty1 IH1 Hty2 IH2
    | Γ Hunr
    | Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 Hsplit Hty1 IH1 Hty2 IH2
    | Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 t Hsplit Hty1 IH1 Hty2 IH2
    | Γ n ts i e Hty IH
    | n Γ Γ1 Γ2 t ts es e Hsplit Hn Hty IH Hf IHf
    | Γ e t1 t2 Hty IH
    | Γ e t Hty IH
    | Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t l1 l2 l3 Hsplit Hcap Hty1 IH1 Hty2 IH2
    | Γ e t lo Hty IH
    | Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t lo Hsplit Hty1 IH1 Hty2 IH2
    | Γ e t Hty IH
    | Γ e t Hty IH ];
    intros L.
  - apply VarW; exact Hvar.
  - eapply FunW; [ exact Hb | exact Hunr | apply IH ].
  - eapply AppW; [ exact Hsplit | apply IH1 | apply IH2 ].
  - apply UnitW; exact Hunr.
  - eapply PairW; [ exact Hsplit | apply IH1 | apply IH2 ].
  - eapply LetPairW; [ exact Hsplit | apply IH1 | apply IH2 ].
  - eapply SumW; apply IH.
  - eapply MatchSumW; [ exact Hsplit | exact Hn | apply IH | intros i; apply (IHf i L) ].
  - eapply ForkW; apply IH.
  - eapply NewLockW; apply IH.
  - eapply ForkLockW; [ exact Hsplit | exact Hcap | apply IH1 | apply IH2 ].
  - eapply AcquireW; apply IH.
  - eapply ReleaseW; [ exact Hsplit | apply IH1 | apply IH2 ].
  - eapply WaitW; apply IH.
  - eapply DropW; apply IH.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* A sufficient combinatorial condition for full reachability.        *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* [waiting ρ i j] is the "i depends on j" relation.  If it admits a  *)
(* rank that strictly increases along waiting edges, then reachability *)
(* propagates back along those edges from any [can_step] seed.        *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition wait_wf (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  well_founded (fun j i => waiting ρ i j).

Definition progress_or_wait (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i, ρ !! i <> None -> can_step ρ i \/ exists j, waiting ρ i j.

Definition wait_targets_live (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i e j, ρ !! i = Some (Thread e) -> expr_waiting e j -> ρ !! j <> None.

Definition rank_ok (ρ : cfg) (r : nat -> nat) (M : nat) : Prop :=
  (forall i, r i <= M) /\ (forall i j, waiting ρ i j -> r i < r j).

Lemma rank_ok_wait_wf ρ r M :
  rank_ok ρ r M -> wait_wf ρ.
Proof.
  intros [Hb Hr]. unfold wait_wf.
  apply (Wf_nat.well_founded_lt_compat
           nat (fun i => M - r i) (fun j i => waiting ρ i j)).
  intros x y Hxy. pose proof (Hr y x Hxy) as Hlt.
  pose proof (Hb x). pose proof (Hb y). lia.
Qed.

Lemma wait_wf_fully_reachable ρ :
  wait_wf ρ -> progress_or_wait ρ -> wait_targets_live ρ -> fully_reachable ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hwf Hprog Hlive i.
  apply (well_founded_ind Hwf (fun i => inactive ρ i \/ reachable ρ i)).
  intros x IH.
  destruct (ρ !! x) as [y|] eqn:E.
  - right.
    assert (Hact : ρ !! x <> None) by congruence.
    destruct (Hprog x Hact) as [Hstep | [j Hwait]].
    + apply Can_step_reachable; exact Hstep.
    + destruct (IH j Hwait) as [Hinj | Hrj].
      * destruct Hwait as [[e [He Hw]] | [y' [Hy _]]].
        -- exfalso. exact (Hlive x e j He Hw Hinj).
        -- unfold inactive in Hinj. rewrite Hy in Hinj. discriminate.
      * apply Waiting_reachable with j; assumption.
  - left. exact E.
Qed.

Theorem rank_fully_reachable ρ r M :
  rank_ok ρ r M -> progress_or_wait ρ -> wait_targets_live ρ ->
  fully_reachable ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hr Hp Hl.
  apply wait_wf_fully_reachable.
  - apply rank_ok_wait_wf with (r := r) (M := M); exact Hr.
  - exact Hp.
  - exact Hl.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Seedability: the truly relevant combinatorial condition.           *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* A global rank is too strong: [waiting] may contain cycles that     *)
(* pass through objects which can step.  The correct condition is     *)
(* that every live location reaches, along finitely many waiting      *)
(* edges, some location that can step.                                *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition wait_step (ρ : cfg) : nat -> nat -> Prop :=
  fun a b => waiting ρ a b.

Definition seeded (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i, ρ !! i <> None ->
    exists j, rtc (wait_step ρ) i j /\ can_step ρ j.

Lemma reachable_of_wait_rtc ρ a b :
  rtc (wait_step ρ) a b -> reachable ρ b -> reachable ρ a.
Proof.
  intros H. induction H as [| x y z Hxy _ IH]; intros Hb.
  - exact Hb.
  - apply Waiting_reachable with y.
    + exact Hxy.
    + apply IH; exact Hb.
Qed.

Lemma seeded_fully_reachable ρ : seeded ρ -> fully_reachable ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hseed i. destruct (ρ !! i) as [y|] eqn:E.
  - right. destruct (Hseed i ltac:(congruence)) as [j [Hpath Hstep]].
    apply (reachable_of_wait_rtc ρ i j Hpath).
    apply Can_step_reachable; exact Hstep.
  - left. exact E.
Qed.

Lemma reachable_seed ρ i : reachable ρ i ->
  exists j, rtc (wait_step ρ) i j /\ can_step ρ j.
Proof.
  induction 1 as [k Hc | a b Hw Hr IH].
  - exists k. split; [apply rtc_refl | exact Hc].
  - destruct IH as [j [Hpath Hc]].
    exists j. split; [| exact Hc].
    apply (rtc_l (wait_step ρ) a b j Hw Hpath).
Qed.

Lemma fully_reachable_seeded ρ : fully_reachable ρ -> seeded ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hfr i Hi.
  destruct (Hfr i) as [Hin | Hr].
  - exfalso. apply Hi. exact Hin.
  - exact (reachable_seed ρ i Hr).
Qed.

Lemma seeded_iff_fully_reachable ρ : seeded ρ <-> fully_reachable ρ.
Proof.
  split.
  - apply seeded_fully_reachable.
  - apply fully_reachable_seeded.
Qed.

(* A configuration with a live location and no steppable location is
   certainly not fully reachable. *)
Lemma reachable_no_can_step ρ i :
  (forall k, ~ can_step ρ k) -> reachable ρ i -> False.
Proof.
  intros Hns Hr. induction Hr as [k Hc | i j Hw Hr IH].
  - exact (Hns k Hc).
  - exact IH.
Qed.

Lemma no_can_step_not_fully_reachable ρ :
  (forall k, ~ can_step ρ k) ->
  (exists k, ρ !! k <> None) ->
  ~ fully_reachable ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hns [k Hk] Hfr.
  destruct (Hfr k) as [Hin | Hr].
  - unfold inactive in Hin. exact (Hk Hin).
  - exact (reachable_no_can_step ρ k Hns Hr).
Qed.

(* A rank is only needed on the non-steppable locations.  This is the
   exact relaxation needed because waiting cycles through steppable
   locations are harmless. *)

Definition rank_nonstep (ρ : cfg) (r : nat -> nat) (M : nat) : Prop :=
  (forall i, r i <= M) /\
  (forall i j, waiting ρ i j -> ~ can_step ρ i -> r i < r j).

Lemma waiting_target_live ρ (Hlive : wait_targets_live ρ) i j :
  waiting ρ i j -> ρ !! j <> None.
Proof.
  intros [[e [He Hw]] | [y [Hy _]]].
  - exact (Hlive i e j He Hw).
  - rewrite Hy. discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma rank_nonstep_seeded ρ r M
    (Hdec : forall i, {can_step ρ i} + {~ can_step ρ i}) :
  rank_nonstep ρ r M -> progress_or_wait ρ -> wait_targets_live ρ ->
  seeded ρ.
Proof.
  intros [Hb Hr] Hprog Hlive i Hi.
  revert Hi.
  apply (well_founded_ind
    (Wf_nat.well_founded_lt_compat nat (fun i => M - r i)
       (fun y x => M - r y < M - r x)
       (fun x y Hxy => Hxy))
    (fun i => ρ !! i <> None ->
      exists j, rtc (wait_step ρ) i j /\ can_step ρ j)).
  intros x IH Hx.
  destruct (Hdec x) as [Hc | Hnc].
  - exists x. split; [apply rtc_refl | exact Hc].
  - destruct (Hprog x Hx) as [Hc | [y Hw]].
    + exists x. split; [apply rtc_refl | exact Hc].
    + assert (Hlt : M - r y < M - r x).
      { pose proof (Hr x y Hw Hnc). pose proof (Hb x). pose proof (Hb y). lia. }
      assert (Hy : ρ !! y <> None).
      { apply (waiting_target_live ρ Hlive x y Hw). }
      destruct (IH y Hlt Hy) as [z [Hpath Hz]].
      exists z. split; [| exact Hz].
      apply (rtc_l (wait_step ρ) x y z Hw Hpath).
Qed.

(* ---------- elementary facts about references ---------- *)

Definition refs_live (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i y, ρ !! i = Some y -> forall j, j ∈ obj_refs y -> ρ !! j <> None.

Lemma ctx1_expr_refs k :
  ctx1 k -> forall e, expr_refs e ⊆ expr_refs (k e).
Proof.
  intros Hk e j Hj. destruct Hk; simpl; set_solver.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_expr_refs k :
  ctx k -> forall e, expr_refs e ⊆ expr_refs (k e).
Proof.
  intros Hk. induction Hk as [| k1 k2 H1 H2 IH2]; simpl.
  - intros e j Hj. exact Hj.
  - intros e j Hj. apply (ctx1_expr_refs k1 H1). apply IH2. exact Hj.
Qed.

Lemma expr_head_waiting_ref j e :
  expr_head_waiting e j -> j ∈ expr_refs e.
Proof.
  intros H. induction H; simpl; set_solver.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_head_waiting_ref k e j :
  ctx k -> expr_head_waiting e j -> j ∈ expr_refs (k e).
Proof.
  intros Hk Hh. apply (ctx_expr_refs k Hk e).
  apply expr_head_waiting_ref in Hh. exact Hh.
Qed.

Lemma expr_waiting_ref e j : expr_waiting e j -> j ∈ expr_refs e.
Proof.
  intros [k [e' [Hk [He Hh]]]]. subst e.
  apply ctx_head_waiting_ref; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma refs_live_wait_targets_live ρ :
  refs_live ρ -> wait_targets_live ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hlive i e j He Hw.
  apply (Hlive i (Thread e) He j).
  apply expr_waiting_ref in Hw. exact Hw.
Qed.

(* Lock types are never unrestricted. *)
Lemma unr_LockT l t : unr (LockT l t) -> False.
Proof. intros H. inversion H. Qed.

Lemma disjoint_env_no_dup_lock Γ1 Γ2 x l t :
  disj Γ1 Γ2 ->
  Γ1 !! x = Some (LockT l t) ->
  Γ2 !! x = Some (LockT l t) ->
  False.
Proof.
  intros Hd H1 H2.
  destruct (Hd x (LockT l t) (LockT l t) H1 H2) as [_ Hunr].
  exact (unr_LockT l t Hunr).
Qed.

(* Every local step has its label live in the source configuration. *)
Lemma local_step_label_live i ρ ρ' : local_step i ρ ρ' -> ρ !! i <> None.
Proof.
  intros H. induction H; simpl; intro E;
    match goal with
    | E : ?M = None |- False =>
        assert (His : is_Some M) by (apply elem_of_dom; set_solver);
        destruct His as [x Hx]; rewrite E in Hx; discriminate
    end.
Qed.

Theorem typed_full_reachability e ρ :
  typed ∅ e UnitT -> steps {[ 0 := Thread e ]} ρ -> fully_reachable ρ.

From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String.
Open Scope string_scope.
From stdpp Require Import gmap.
From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.
From cgraphs.cgraphs Require Import util.
From scratch Require Import Cases ShapeTest StuckTarget.

Lemma union_lookup_l_obj (m f : gmap nat obj) (g : cfg) i x :
  m ∪ f = g -> m !! i = Some x -> g !! i = Some x.
Proof.
  intros Heq Hm. rewrite <- Heq. apply lookup_union_Some_l. exact Hm.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_val k e v : ctx k -> k e = Val v -> e = Val v.
Proof.
  intros Hk. destruct Hk as [|k1 k2 H1 H2]; simpl.
  - intros H. exact H.
  - intros H. destruct H1; simpl in H; discriminate H.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_min_decomp k e :
  ctx k -> k e = Acquire (Val (LockV 1)) ->
  e = Acquire (Val (LockV 1)) \/ e = Val (LockV 1).
Proof.
  intros Hk. destruct Hk as [|k1 k2 H1 H2]; simpl.
  - intros H. left. exact H.
  - intros H. destruct H1; simpl in H; try discriminate H.
    (* only Ctx_Acquire remains *)
    injection H as Hke. right. exact (ctx_val k2 e (LockV 1) H2 Hke).
Qed.

Lemma pure_step_not_acquire e e' :
  pure_step e e' -> e = Acquire (Val (LockV 1)) -> False.
Proof. intros H Heq. subst e. inversion H. Qed.

Lemma pure_step_not_val e e' v :
  pure_step e e' -> e = Val v -> False.
Proof. intros H Heq. subst e. inversion H. Qed.

Lemma no_step_min : forall i, ~ can_step min_cfg i.
Proof.
  intros i [rho' Hstep].
  inversion Hstep as [rho0 rho0' rhof j Hdisj Hdisj' Hlocal]; subst.
  pose proof (local_step_label_shape i rho0 rho0' Hlocal) as Hshape.
  destruct Hshape as
    [ (k & e & e' & Hctx & Hpure & Hsrc)
    | [ Hexit
      | [ (j0 & n0 & kf & vf & Hctxf & Hsrcf)
        | [ Hsync
          | [ (knew & nnew & vnew & Hctxnew & Hsrcnew)
            | [ (vfk & ofk & kfk & jfk & nfk & rcfk & Hctxfk & Hlockfk & Hthreadfk)
              | [ (vacq & kacq & jacq & nacq & rcacq & Hctxacq & Hlockacq & Hthreadacq)
                | [ (vrel & krel & jrel & nrel & rcrel & Hctxrel & Hlockrel & Hthreadrel)
                  | [ (vwait & kwait & jwait & nwait & Hctxwait & Hlockwait & Hthreadwait)
                    | (odrop & kdrop & jdrop & ndrop & rcdrop & Hctxdrop & Hlockdrop & Hthreaddrop) ] ] ] ] ] ] ] ] ].
  - (* Pure *) 
    pose proof (union_lookup_l_obj rho0 rhof min_cfg i (Thread (k e)) H0 Hsrc) as Hmin.

    + rewrite Hnone in Hmin. discriminate Hmin.
    + subst i. rewrite Hc in Hmin. injection Hmin as Hke. symmetry in Hke.
      destruct (ctx_min_decomp k e Hctx Hke) as [Heq | Heq].
      * exact (pure_step_not_acquire e e' Hpure Heq).
      * exact (pure_step_not_val e e' (LockV 1) Hpure Heq).
    + subst i. rewrite Hc in Hmin. discriminate Hmin.
  - (* Exit *)
    pose proof (union_lookup_l_obj rho0 rhof min_cfg i (Thread (Val UnitV)) H0 Hexit) as Hmin.
    destruct (min_cfg_lookup i) as [Hnone | [[Hi0 Hc] | [Hi1 Hc]]].
    + rewrite Hnone in Hmin. discriminate Hmin.
    + subst i. rewrite Hc in Hmin. injection Hmin as Heq. discriminate Heq.

    pose proof (union_lookup_l_obj rho0 rhof min_cfg i (Thread (kf (ForkBarrier (Val vf)))) H0 Hsrcf) as Hmin.

    + rewrite Hnone in Hmin. discriminate Hmin.

        discriminate Heq.
    + subst i. rewrite Hc in Hmin. discriminate Hmin.
  - (* Sync *)
    pose proof (union_lookup_l_obj rho0 rhof min_cfg i Barrier H0 Hsync) as Hmin.
    destruct (min_cfg_lookup i) as [Hnone | [[Hi0 Hc] | [Hi1 Hc]]].
    + rewrite Hnone in Hmin. discriminate Hmin.
    + subst i. rewrite Hc in Hmin. discriminate Hmin.
    + subst i. rewrite Hc in Hmin. discriminate Hmin.
  - (* NewLock *)
    pose proof (union_lookup_l_obj rho0 rhof min_cfg i (Thread (knew (NewLock (Val vnew)))) H0 Hsrcnew) as Hmin.
    destruct (min_cfg_lookup i) as [Hnone | [[Hi0 Hc] | [Hi1 Hc]]].
    + rewrite Hnone in Hmin. discriminate Hmin.
    + subst i. rewrite Hc in Hmin. injection Hmin as Hke. symmetry in Hke.
      destruct (ctx_min_decomp knew (NewLock (Val vnew)) Hctxnew Hke) as [Heq | Heq];
        discriminate Heq.
    + subst i. rewrite Hc in Hmin. discriminate Hmin.
  - (* ForkLock *) 
    pose proof (union_lookup_l_obj rho0 rhof min_cfg jfk (Thread (kfk (ForkLock (Val (LockV nfk)) (Val vfk)))) H0 Hthreadfk) as Hminj.
    destruct (min_cfg_lookup jfk) as [Hnone | [[Hj0 Hc] | [Hj1 Hc]]].
    + rewrite Hnone in Hminj. discriminate Hminj.
    + subst jfk. rewrite Hc in Hminj. injection Hminj as Hke. symmetry in Hke.
      destruct (ctx_min_decomp kfk (ForkLock (Val (LockV nfk)) (Val vfk)) Hctxfk Hke) as [Heq | Heq];
        discriminate Heq.
    + subst jfk. rewrite Hc in Hminj. discriminate Hminj.
  - (* Acquire *)
    pose proof (union_lookup_l_obj rho0 rhof min_cfg nacq (Lock rcacq (Some vacq)) H0 Hlockacq) as Hminl.
    destruct (min_cfg_lookup nacq) as [Hnone | [[Hn0 Hc] | [Hn1 Hc]]].
    + rewrite Hnone in Hminl. discriminate Hminl.
    + subst nacq. rewrite Hc in Hminl. discriminate Hminl.
    + subst nacq. rewrite Hc in Hminl. injection Hminl as Hr Ho. discriminate Ho.
  - (* Release *) 
    pose proof (union_lookup_l_obj rho0 rhof min_cfg jrel (Thread (krel (Release (Val (LockV nrel)) (Val vrel)))) H0 Hthreadrel) as Hminj.
    destruct (min_cfg_lookup jrel) as [Hnone | [[Hj0 Hc] | [Hj1 Hc]]].
    + rewrite Hnone in Hminj. discriminate Hminj.
    + subst jrel. rewrite Hc in Hminj. injection Hminj as Hke. symmetry in Hke.
      destruct (ctx_min_decomp krel (Release (Val (LockV nrel)) (Val vrel)) Hctxrel Hke) as [Heq | Heq];
        discriminate Heq.
    + subst jrel. rewrite Hc in Hminj. discriminate Hminj.
  - (* Wait *)
    pose proof (union_lookup_l_obj rho0 rhof min_cfg nwait (Lock 0 (Some vwait)) H0 Hlockwait) as Hminl.
    destruct (min_cfg_lookup nwait) as [Hnone | [[Hn0 Hc] | [Hn1 Hc]]].
    + rewrite Hnone in Hminl. discriminate Hminl.
    + subst nwait. rewrite Hc in Hminl. discriminate Hminl.
    + subst nwait. rewrite Hc in Hminl. injection Hminl as Ho. discriminate Ho.
  - (* Drop *)
    pose proof (union_lookup_l_obj rho0 rhof min_cfg ndrop (Lock (S rcdrop) odrop) H0 Hlockdrop) as Hminl.
    destruct (min_cfg_lookup ndrop) as [Hnone | [[Hn0 Hc] | [Hn1 Hc]]].
    + rewrite Hnone in Hminl. discriminate Hminl.
    + subst ndrop. rewrite Hc in Hminl. discriminate Hminl.
    + subst ndrop. rewrite Hc in Hminl. injection Hminl as Hr Ho. discriminate Hr.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* A sufficient combinatorial condition for full reachability.        *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* [waiting ρ i j] is the "i depends on j" relation.  If it admits a  *)
(* rank that strictly increases along waiting edges, then reachability *)
(* propagates back along those edges from any [can_step] seed.        *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition wait_wf (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  well_founded (fun j i => waiting ρ i j).

Definition progress_or_wait (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i, ρ !! i <> None -> can_step ρ i \/ exists j, waiting ρ i j.

Definition wait_targets_live (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i e j, ρ !! i = Some (Thread e) -> expr_waiting e j -> ρ !! j <> None.

Definition rank_ok (ρ : cfg) (r : nat -> nat) (M : nat) : Prop :=
  (forall i, r i <= M) /\ (forall i j, waiting ρ i j -> r i < r j).

Lemma rank_ok_wait_wf ρ r M :
  rank_ok ρ r M -> wait_wf ρ.
Proof.
  intros [Hb Hr]. unfold wait_wf.
  apply (Wf_nat.well_founded_lt_compat
           nat (fun i => M - r i) (fun j i => waiting ρ i j)).
  intros x y Hxy. pose proof (Hr y x Hxy) as Hlt.
  pose proof (Hb x). pose proof (Hb y). lia.
Qed.

Lemma wait_wf_fully_reachable ρ :
  wait_wf ρ -> progress_or_wait ρ -> wait_targets_live ρ -> fully_reachable ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hwf Hprog Hlive i.
  apply (well_founded_ind Hwf (fun i => inactive ρ i \/ reachable ρ i)).
  intros x IH.
  destruct (ρ !! x) as [y|] eqn:E.
  - right.
    assert (Hact : ρ !! x <> None) by congruence.
    destruct (Hprog x Hact) as [Hstep | [j Hwait]].
    + apply Can_step_reachable; exact Hstep.
    + destruct (IH j Hwait) as [Hinj | Hrj].
      * destruct Hwait as [[e [He Hw]] | [y' [Hy _]]].
        -- exfalso. exact (Hlive x e j He Hw Hinj).
        -- unfold inactive in Hinj. rewrite Hy in Hinj. discriminate.
      * apply Waiting_reachable with j; assumption.
  - left. exact E.
Qed.

Theorem rank_fully_reachable ρ r M :
  rank_ok ρ r M -> progress_or_wait ρ -> wait_targets_live ρ ->
  fully_reachable ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hr Hp Hl.
  apply wait_wf_fully_reachable.
  - apply rank_ok_wait_wf with (r := r) (M := M); exact Hr.
  - exact Hp.
  - exact Hl.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Seedability: the truly relevant combinatorial condition.           *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* A global rank is too strong: [waiting] may contain cycles that     *)
(* pass through objects which can step.  The correct condition is     *)
(* that every live location reaches, along finitely many waiting      *)
(* edges, some location that can step.                                *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition wait_step (ρ : cfg) : nat -> nat -> Prop :=
  fun a b => waiting ρ a b.

Definition seeded (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i, ρ !! i <> None ->
    exists j, rtc (wait_step ρ) i j /\ can_step ρ j.

Lemma reachable_of_wait_rtc ρ a b :
  rtc (wait_step ρ) a b -> reachable ρ b -> reachable ρ a.
Proof.
  intros H. induction H as [| x y z Hxy _ IH]; intros Hb.
  - exact Hb.
  - apply Waiting_reachable with y.
    + exact Hxy.
    + apply IH; exact Hb.
Qed.

Lemma seeded_fully_reachable ρ : seeded ρ -> fully_reachable ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hseed i. destruct (ρ !! i) as [y|] eqn:E.
  - right. destruct (Hseed i ltac:(congruence)) as [j [Hpath Hstep]].
    apply (reachable_of_wait_rtc ρ i j Hpath).
    apply Can_step_reachable; exact Hstep.
  - left. exact E.
Qed.

Lemma reachable_seed ρ i : reachable ρ i ->
  exists j, rtc (wait_step ρ) i j /\ can_step ρ j.
Proof.
  induction 1 as [k Hc | a b Hw Hr IH].
  - exists k. split; [apply rtc_refl | exact Hc].
  - destruct IH as [j [Hpath Hc]].
    exists j. split; [| exact Hc].
    apply (rtc_l (wait_step ρ) a b j Hw Hpath).
Qed.

Lemma fully_reachable_seeded ρ : fully_reachable ρ -> seeded ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hfr i Hi.
  destruct (Hfr i) as [Hin | Hr].
  - exfalso. apply Hi. exact Hin.
  - exact (reachable_seed ρ i Hr).
Qed.

Lemma seeded_iff_fully_reachable ρ : seeded ρ <-> fully_reachable ρ.
Proof.
  split.
  - apply seeded_fully_reachable.
  - apply fully_reachable_seeded.
Qed.

(* A configuration with a live location and no steppable location is
   certainly not fully reachable. *)
Lemma reachable_no_can_step ρ i :
  (forall k, ~ can_step ρ k) -> reachable ρ i -> False.
Proof.
  intros Hns Hr. induction Hr as [k Hc | i j Hw Hr IH].
  - exact (Hns k Hc).
  - exact IH.
Qed.

Lemma no_can_step_not_fully_reachable ρ :
  (forall k, ~ can_step ρ k) ->
  (exists k, ρ !! k <> None) ->
  ~ fully_reachable ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hns [k Hk] Hfr.
  destruct (Hfr k) as [Hin | Hr].
  - unfold inactive in Hin. exact (Hk Hin).
  - exact (reachable_no_can_step ρ k Hns Hr).
Qed.

(* A rank is only needed on the non-steppable locations.  This is the
   exact relaxation needed because waiting cycles through steppable
   locations are harmless. *)

Definition rank_nonstep (ρ : cfg) (r : nat -> nat) (M : nat) : Prop :=
  (forall i, r i <= M) /\
  (forall i j, waiting ρ i j -> ~ can_step ρ i -> r i < r j).

Lemma waiting_target_live ρ (Hlive : wait_targets_live ρ) i j :
  waiting ρ i j -> ρ !! j <> None.
Proof.
  intros [[e [He Hw]] | [y [Hy _]]].
  - exact (Hlive i e j He Hw).
  - rewrite Hy. discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma rank_nonstep_seeded ρ r M
    (Hdec : forall i, {can_step ρ i} + {~ can_step ρ i}) :
  rank_nonstep ρ r M -> progress_or_wait ρ -> wait_targets_live ρ ->
  seeded ρ.
Proof.
  intros [Hb Hr] Hprog Hlive i Hi.
  revert Hi.
  apply (well_founded_ind
    (Wf_nat.well_founded_lt_compat nat (fun i => M - r i)
       (fun y x => M - r y < M - r x)
       (fun x y Hxy => Hxy))
    (fun i => ρ !! i <> None ->
      exists j, rtc (wait_step ρ) i j /\ can_step ρ j)).
  intros x IH Hx.
  destruct (Hdec x) as [Hc | Hnc].
  - exists x. split; [apply rtc_refl | exact Hc].
  - destruct (Hprog x Hx) as [Hc | [y Hw]].
    + exists x. split; [apply rtc_refl | exact Hc].
    + assert (Hlt : M - r y < M - r x).
      { pose proof (Hr x y Hw Hnc). pose proof (Hb x). pose proof (Hb y). lia. }
      assert (Hy : ρ !! y <> None).
      { apply (waiting_target_live ρ Hlive x y Hw). }
      destruct (IH y Hlt Hy) as [z [Hpath Hz]].
      exists z. split; [| exact Hz].
      apply (rtc_l (wait_step ρ) x y z Hw Hpath).
Qed.

(* ---------- elementary facts about references ---------- *)

Definition refs_live (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i y, ρ !! i = Some y -> forall j, j ∈ obj_refs y -> ρ !! j <> None.

Lemma ctx1_expr_refs k :
  ctx1 k -> forall e, expr_refs e ⊆ expr_refs (k e).
Proof.
  intros Hk e j Hj. destruct Hk; simpl; set_solver.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_expr_refs k :
  ctx k -> forall e, expr_refs e ⊆ expr_refs (k e).
Proof.
  intros Hk. induction Hk as [| k1 k2 H1 H2 IH2]; simpl.
  - intros e j Hj. exact Hj.
  - intros e j Hj. apply (ctx1_expr_refs k1 H1). apply IH2. exact Hj.
Qed.

Lemma expr_head_waiting_ref j e :
  expr_head_waiting e j -> j ∈ expr_refs e.
Proof.
  intros H. induction H; simpl; set_solver.
Qed.

Proof.
  intros Hk Hh. apply (ctx_expr_refs k Hk e).
  apply expr_head_waiting_ref in Hh. exact Hh.
Qed.

Lemma expr_waiting_ref e j : expr_waiting e j -> j ∈ expr_refs e.
Proof.
  intros [k [e' [Hk [He Hh]]]]. subst e.
  apply ctx_head_waiting_ref; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma refs_live_wait_targets_live ρ :
  refs_live ρ -> wait_targets_live ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hlive i e j He Hw.
  apply (Hlive i (Thread e) He j).
  apply expr_waiting_ref in Hw. exact Hw.
Qed.

Proof. intros H. inversion H. Qed.

Lemma unr_fun_lin t1 t2 : unr (FunT Lin t1 t2) -> False.
Proof. intros H. inversion H. Qed.

Lemma unr_pair_l t1 t2 : unr (PairT t1 t2) -> unr t1.
Proof. intros H. inversion H. assumption. Qed.

Lemma unr_pair_r t1 t2 : unr (PairT t1 t2) -> unr t2.

Lemma unr_unit : unr UnitT.

  disj Γ1 Γ2 ->
  Γ1 !! x = Some (LockT l t) ->
  Γ2 !! x = Some (LockT l t) ->
  False.
Proof.
  intros Hd H1 H2.
  destruct (Hd x (LockT l t) (LockT l t) H1 H2) as [_ Hunr].
  exact (unr_LockT l t Hunr).
Qed.

Proof.
  intros H. induction H; simpl; intro E;

        assert (His : is_Some M) by (apply elem_of_dom; set_solver);
        destruct His as [x Hx]; rewrite E in Hx; discriminate

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Theorem typed_full_reachability e ρ :
  typed ∅ e UnitT -> steps {[ 0 := Thread e ]} ρ -> fully_reachable ρ.

From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.

From Stdlib Require Import Classical_Prop Wellfounded Wf_nat Lia.
From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String Eqdep_dec.
Open Scope string_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Runtime typing for configurations.                                 *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* Source terms are Val-free, so [typed] cannot type configurations   *)
(* produced by reduction.  [wt] extends it with runtime values [cv].  *)
(* Values are environment-independent (they are closed).               *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Inductive wt (L : gmap nat type) : env -> expr -> type -> Prop :=
  | VarW Γ x t :
      env_var Γ x t ->
      wt L Γ (Var x) t
  | FunW Γ Γ' x e t1 t2 l :
      env_bind Γ' x t1 Γ ->
      (l = Unr -> env_unr Γ) ->
      wt L Γ' e t2 ->
      wt L Γ (Fun x e) (FunT l t1 t2)
  | AppW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 l :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (FunT l t1 t2) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 t1 ->
      wt L Γ (App e1 e2) t2
  | UnitW Γ :
      env_unr Γ ->
      wt L Γ Unit UnitT
  | PairW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 t1 ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 t2 ->
      wt L Γ (Pair e1 e2) (PairT t1 t2)
  | LetPairW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 t :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (PairT t1 t2) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 (FunT Lin t1 (FunT Lin t2 t)) ->
      wt L Γ (LetPair e1 e2) t
  | SumW Γ n (ts : fin n -> type) i e :
      wt L Γ e (ts i) ->
      wt L Γ (Sum i e) (SumT n ts)
  | MatchSumW n Γ Γ1 Γ2 t (ts : fin n -> type) es e :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      (n = 0 -> env_unr Γ2) ->
      wt L Γ1 e (SumT n ts) ->
      (forall i, wt L Γ2 (es i) (FunT Lin (ts i) t)) ->
      wt L Γ (MatchSum n e es) t
  | ForkW Γ e t1 t2 :
      wt L Γ e (FunT Lin (FunT Lin t2 t1) UnitT) ->
      wt L Γ (ForkBarrier e) (FunT Lin t1 t2)
  | NewLockW Γ e t :
      wt L Γ e t ->
      wt L Γ (NewLock e) (LockT (Owner,Closed) t)
  | ForkLockW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t l1 l2 l3 :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      lockcap_split l1 l2 l3 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (LockT l1 t) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 (FunT Lin (LockT l2 t) UnitT) ->
      wt L Γ (ForkLock e1 e2) (LockT l3 t)
  | AcquireW Γ e t lo :
      wt L Γ e (LockT (lo,Closed) t) ->
      wt L Γ (Acquire e) (PairT (LockT (lo,Opened) t) t)
  | ReleaseW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t lo :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (LockT (lo,Opened) t) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 t ->
      wt L Γ (Release e1 e2) (LockT (lo,Closed) t)
  | WaitW Γ e t :
      wt L Γ e (LockT (Owner,Closed) t) ->
      wt L Γ (Wait e) t
  | DropW Γ e t :
      wt L Γ e (LockT (Client,Closed) t) ->
      wt L Γ (Drop e) UnitT
  | ValW Γ v t :
      env_unr Γ ->
      cv L v t ->
      wt L Γ (Val v) t
with cv (L : gmap nat type) : val -> type -> Prop :=
  | FunVW x e t1 t2 l :
      wt L (<[ x := t1 ]> (∅ : env)) e t2 ->
      cv L (FunV x e) (FunT l t1 t2)
  | UnitVW : cv L UnitV UnitT
  | PairVW v1 v2 t1 t2 :
      cv L v1 t1 -> cv L v2 t2 ->
      cv L (PairV v1 v2) (PairT t1 t2)
  | SumVW n (ts : fin n -> type) i v :
      cv L v (ts i) ->
      cv L (SumV i v) (SumT n ts)
  | BarrierVW n t1 t2 :
      cv L (BarrierV n) (FunT Lin t1 t2)
  | LockVW n lc t :
      L !! n = Some t ->
      cv L (LockV n) (LockT lc t).

(* ---------- gmap / environment helpers ---------- *)

Lemma env_lookup_insert_same x (t : type) : (<[x:=t]>(∅ : env)) !! x = Some t.

2) Every local step preserves "graph is a forest" (with a maintained explicit parent/rank witness). The movement cases are the key: Acquire moves a content value v from lock n to thread i; before, thread i was already connected to n by its waiting/cap occurrence edge i-n. Remove the edges n-r for r in refs(v), then add i-r. Because in a forest n-r edges are bridges, removing them disconnects v's ref-component from i/n; adding i-r reconnects it. Similarly Release, NewLock, Wait, Drop, Fork, ForkLock, Sync; ForkLock/env moves a set of caps from parent to new child, and the new child is connected via the forked lock edge, so no cycle; Sync deletes the barrier vertex (which split the two threads into different components) then moves exchanged value refs between the threads, reconnecting across the split. You may need a source-faithful runtime typing wt2 with this no-refs-for-unr-value side condition, or carry it as an invariant.
3) Every live object has an incident edge (locks/barriers have cap/endpoint occurrences; threads that are not can_step have a waiting-head occurrence), and every waiting edge i->j between live nodes corresponds to an edge {i,j} of this multigraph: clause1 from the waiting-head occurrence in thread i; clause2 i->j from the occurrence of i in the content/expr of the live object at j. The clause2 side condition exactly prevents a directed 2-cycle that would reuse the same single occurrence edge; any other waiting cycle yields an actual multigraph cycle (closed walk using >=2 distinct edges), so forest => no waiting cycles => wait_wf/seeded (with progress_or_wait).
This forest invariant may be exactly the missing paper proof. Please try to define it and prove as much of (1)-(3) as you can, with priority on the occurrence-multiplicity + forest preservation. Checkpoint compiled code. Reply with exact definitions/lemmas and gaps.

But it never gives two caps to the parent: the second occurrence always goes to a fresh child j with i != j. Every transfer needs a channel; barrier partners are fixed at ForkBarrier time (parent and its newly forked child only, not a ForkLock child). A ForkLock child can never become the barrier partner of its parent. To give a cap to a barrier child one must put it in the forked function body, which consumes it from the parent's environment; the child cannot also receive an independent ForkLock cap from a different ForkLock child without a prior transfer.

19	  | FunW Γ Γ' x e t1 t2 l :
20	      env_bind Γ' x t1 Γ ->
21	      (l = Unr -> env_unr Γ) ->
22	      wt L Γ' e t2 ->
23	      wt L Γ (Fun x e) (FunT l t1 t2)
24	  | AppW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 l :
25	      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
26	      wt L Γ1 e1 (FunT l t1 t2) ->
27	      wt L Γ2 e2 t1 ->
28	      wt L Γ (App e1 e2) t2
29	  | UnitW Γ :
30	      env_unr Γ ->
31	      wt L Γ Unit UnitT
32	  | PairW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 :
33	      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
34	      wt L Γ1 e1 t1 ->
35	      wt L Γ2 e2 t2 ->
36	      wt L Γ (Pair e1 e2) (PairT t1 t2)
37	  | LetPairW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 t :
38	      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
39	      wt L Γ1 e1 (PairT t1 t2) ->
40	      wt L Γ2 e2 (FunT Lin t1 (FunT Lin t2 t)) ->
41	      wt L Γ (LetPair e1 e2) t
42	  | SumW Γ n (ts : fin n -> type) i e :
43	      wt L Γ e (ts i) ->
44	      wt L Γ (Sum i e) (SumT n ts)
45	  | MatchSumW n Γ Γ1 Γ2 t (ts : fin n -> type) es e :
46	      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
47	      (n = 0 -> env_unr Γ2) ->
48	      wt L Γ1 e (SumT n ts) ->
49	      (forall i, wt L Γ2 (es i) (FunT Lin (ts i) t)) ->
50	      wt L Γ (MatchSum n e es) t
51	  | ForkW Γ e t1 t2 :
52	      wt L Γ e (FunT Lin (FunT Lin t2 t1) UnitT) ->
53	      wt L Γ (ForkBarrier e) (FunT Lin t1 t2)
54	  | NewLockW Γ e t :
55	      wt L Γ e t ->
56	      wt L Γ (NewLock e) (LockT (Owner,Closed) t)
57	  | ForkLockW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t l1 l2 l3 :
58	      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
59	      lockcap_split l1 l2 l3 ->
60	      wt L Γ1 e1 (LockT l1 t) ->
61	      wt L Γ2 e2 (FunT Lin (LockT l2 t) UnitT) ->
62	      wt L Γ (ForkLock e1 e2) (LockT l3 t)
63	  | AcquireW Γ e t lo :
64	      wt L Γ e (LockT (lo,Closed) t) ->
65	      wt L Γ (Acquire e) (PairT (LockT (lo,Opened) t) t)
66	  | ReleaseW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t lo :
67	      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
68	      wt L Γ1 e1 (LockT (lo,Opened) t) ->
69	      wt L Γ2 e2 t ->
70	      wt L Γ (Release e1 e2) (LockT (lo,Closed) t)
71	  | WaitW Γ e t :
72	      wt L Γ e (LockT (Owner,Closed) t) ->
73	      wt L Γ (Wait e) t
74	  | DropW Γ e t :
75	      wt L Γ e (LockT (Client,Closed) t) ->
76	      wt L Γ (Drop e) UnitT
77	  | ValW Γ v t :
78	      env_unr Γ ->
79	      cv L v t ->
80	      wt L Γ (Val v) t
81	with cv (L : gmap nat type) : val -> type -> Prop :=
82	  | FunVW x e t1 t2 l :
83	      wt L (<[ x := t1 ]> (∅ : env)) e t2 ->
84	      cv L (FunV x e) (FunT l t1 t2)
85	  | UnitVW : cv L UnitV UnitT
86	  | PairVW v1 v2 t1 t2 :
87	      cv L v1 t1 -> cv L v2 t2 ->
88	      cv L (PairV v1 v2) (PairT t1 t2)
89	  | SumVW n (ts : fin n -> type) i v :
90	      cv L v (ts i) ->
91	      cv L (SumV i v) (SumT n ts)
92	  | BarrierVW n t1 t2 :
93	      cv L (BarrierV n) (FunT Lin t1 t2)
94	  | LockVW n lc t :
95	      L !! n = Some t ->
96	      cv L (LockV n) (LockT lc t).

173	Lemma insert_insert_same x (t1 t2 : type) (Γ : env) :
174	  <[x:=t2]>(<[x:=t1]>Γ) = <[x:=t2]>Γ.
175	Proof.
176	  unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro y. destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
177	  - rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (<[y:=t1]>Γ) y t2). rewrite (lookup_insert_eq Γ y t2). done.
178	  - rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[x:=t1]>Γ) x y t2 E).
179	    rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x y t2 E).
180	    rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x y t1 E). done.

183	Lemma insert_insert_comm x y (t1 t2 : type) (Γ : env) : x <> y ->
184	  <[x:=t1]>(<[y:=t2]>Γ) = <[y:=t2]>(<[x:=t1]>Γ).
185	Proof.
186	  intros Hne. unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro z.
187	  destruct (decide (z=x)) as [E1|E1].
188	  - subst z.
189	    destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E2|E2].
190	    + exfalso. apply Hne. done.
191	    + rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (<[y:=t2]>Γ) x t1).
192	      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[x:=t1]>Γ) y x t2 (fun H => E2 (eq_sym H))).
193	      rewrite (lookup_insert_eq Γ x t1). done.
194	  - destruct (decide (z=y)) as [E2|E2].
195	    + subst z.
196	      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[y:=t2]>Γ) x y t1 Hne).
197	      rewrite (lookup_insert_eq Γ y t2).
198	      rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (<[x:=t1]>Γ) y t2). done.
199	    + rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[y:=t2]>Γ) x z t1 (fun H => E1 (eq_sym H))).
200	      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ y z t2 (fun H => E2 (eq_sym H))).
201	      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[x:=t1]>Γ) y z t2 (fun H => E2 (eq_sym H))).
202	      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x z t1 (fun H => E1 (eq_sym H))). done.
203	Qed.
