From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String.
Open Scope string_scope.
From stdpp Require Import gmap.
From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.
From Stdlib Require Import Lists.List.
From Stdlib Require Import Arith.PeanoNat.
Import ListNotations.

(* Enumeration of [fin n], used only to count/list occurrences under MatchSum. *)
Fixpoint fin_list (n : nat) : list (fin n) :=
  match n with
  | 0 => []
  | S k => Fin.F1 :: map Fin.FS (fin_list k)
  end.

(* Syntactic reference lists, with multiplicity. *)
Fixpoint expr_refs_list (e : expr) : list nat :=
  match e with
  | Val v => val_refs_list v
  | Var _ => []
  | Fun _ e => expr_refs_list e
  | App e1 e2 => expr_refs_list e1 ++ expr_refs_list e2
  | Unit => []
  | Pair e1 e2 => expr_refs_list e1 ++ expr_refs_list e2
  | LetPair e1 e2 => expr_refs_list e1 ++ expr_refs_list e2
  | Sum _ e => expr_refs_list e
  | MatchSum n e es =>
      expr_refs_list e ++
      concat (map (fun i => expr_refs_list (es i)) (fin_list n))
  | ForkBarrier e => expr_refs_list e
  | NewLock e => expr_refs_list e
  | ForkLock e1 e2 => expr_refs_list e1 ++ expr_refs_list e2
  | Acquire e => expr_refs_list e
  | Release e1 e2 => expr_refs_list e1 ++ expr_refs_list e2
  | Wait e => expr_refs_list e
  | Drop e => expr_refs_list e
  end
with val_refs_list (v : val) : list nat :=
  match v with
  | FunV _ e => expr_refs_list e
  | UnitV => []
  | PairV v1 v2 => val_refs_list v1 ++ val_refs_list v2
  | SumV _ v => val_refs_list v
  | BarrierV i => [i]
  | LockV i => [i]
  end.

Definition occ_expr (e : expr) (b : nat) : nat :=
  count_occ Nat.eq_dec (expr_refs_list e) b.

Definition occ_val (v : val) (b : nat) : nat :=
  count_occ Nat.eq_dec (val_refs_list v) b.

Definition occ_obj (y : obj) (b : nat) : nat :=
  match y with
  | Thread e => occ_expr e b
  | Barrier => 0
  | Lock _ o =>
      match o with
      | Some v => occ_val v b
      | None => 0
      end
  end.

Definition occ (ρ : cfg) (a b : nat) : nat :=
  match ρ !! a with
  | Some y => occ_obj y b
  | None => 0
  end.

(* Kind-resolved reference lists: LockV contributes to lock refs, BarrierV to
   barrier refs, preserving multiplicity. *)
Fixpoint expr_lock_refs_list (e : expr) : list nat :=
  match e with
  | Val v => val_lock_refs_list v
  | Var _ => []
  | Fun _ e => expr_lock_refs_list e
  | App e1 e2 => expr_lock_refs_list e1 ++ expr_lock_refs_list e2
  | Unit => []
  | Pair e1 e2 => expr_lock_refs_list e1 ++ expr_lock_refs_list e2
  | LetPair e1 e2 => expr_lock_refs_list e1 ++ expr_lock_refs_list e2
  | Sum _ e => expr_lock_refs_list e
  | MatchSum n e es =>
      expr_lock_refs_list e ++
      concat (map (fun i => expr_lock_refs_list (es i)) (fin_list n))
  | ForkBarrier e => expr_lock_refs_list e
  | NewLock e => expr_lock_refs_list e
  | ForkLock e1 e2 => expr_lock_refs_list e1 ++ expr_lock_refs_list e2
  | Acquire e => expr_lock_refs_list e
  | Release e1 e2 => expr_lock_refs_list e1 ++ expr_lock_refs_list e2
  | Wait e => expr_lock_refs_list e
  | Drop e => expr_lock_refs_list e
  end
with val_lock_refs_list (v : val) : list nat :=
  match v with
  | FunV _ e => expr_lock_refs_list e
  | UnitV => []
  | PairV v1 v2 => val_lock_refs_list v1 ++ val_lock_refs_list v2
  | SumV _ v => val_lock_refs_list v
  | BarrierV _ => []
  | LockV i => [i]
  end.

Fixpoint expr_barrier_refs_list (e : expr) : list nat :=
  match e with
  | Val v => val_barrier_refs_list v
  | Var _ => []
  | Fun _ e => expr_barrier_refs_list e
  | App e1 e2 => expr_barrier_refs_list e1 ++ expr_barrier_refs_list e2
  | Unit => []
  | Pair e1 e2 => expr_barrier_refs_list e1 ++ expr_barrier_refs_list e2
  | LetPair e1 e2 => expr_barrier_refs_list e1 ++ expr_barrier_refs_list e2
  | Sum _ e => expr_barrier_refs_list e
  | MatchSum n e es =>
      expr_barrier_refs_list e ++
      concat (map (fun i => expr_barrier_refs_list (es i)) (fin_list n))
  | ForkBarrier e => expr_barrier_refs_list e
  | NewLock e => expr_barrier_refs_list e
  | ForkLock e1 e2 => expr_barrier_refs_list e1 ++ expr_barrier_refs_list e2
  | Acquire e => expr_barrier_refs_list e
  | Release e1 e2 => expr_barrier_refs_list e1 ++ expr_barrier_refs_list e2
  | Wait e => expr_barrier_refs_list e
  | Drop e => expr_barrier_refs_list e
  end
with val_barrier_refs_list (v : val) : list nat :=
  match v with
  | FunV _ e => expr_barrier_refs_list e
  | UnitV => []
  | PairV v1 v2 => val_barrier_refs_list v1 ++ val_barrier_refs_list v2
  | SumV _ v => val_barrier_refs_list v
  | BarrierV i => [i]
  | LockV _ => []
  end.

Definition obj_lock_refs_list (y : obj) : list nat :=
  match y with
  | Thread e => expr_lock_refs_list e
  | Barrier => []
  | Lock _ o =>
      match o with
      | Some v => val_lock_refs_list v
      | None => []
      end
  end.

Definition obj_barrier_refs_list (y : obj) : list nat :=
  match y with
  | Thread e => expr_barrier_refs_list e
  | Barrier => []
  | Lock _ o =>
      match o with
      | Some v => val_barrier_refs_list v
      | None => []
      end
  end.

Definition live (ρ : cfg) (a : nat) : Prop := ρ !! a <> None.

Definition F0 (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall a, live ρ a -> occ ρ a a = 0.

Definition F1 (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall a b, a <> b -> live ρ a -> live ρ b ->
    occ ρ a b + occ ρ b a <= 1.

(* Undirected simple edge of the reference graph. *)
Definition ref_edge (ρ : cfg) (a b : nat) : Prop :=
  a <> b /\ live ρ a /\ live ρ b /\
  occ ρ a b + occ ρ b a = 1.

Definition ref_uedge (ρ : cfg) (a b : nat) : Prop :=
  ref_edge ρ a b \/ ref_edge ρ b a.

(* Forest: no undirected reference edge is contained in an undirected cycle. *)
Definition F2 (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall a b, ref_uedge ρ a b -> ~ rtc (ref_uedge ρ) b a.

Definition kind_live (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  (forall a y, ρ !! a = Some y ->
     forall b, In b (obj_lock_refs_list y) ->
       exists rc o, ρ !! b = Some (Lock rc o))
  /\
  (forall a y, ρ !! a = Some y ->
     forall b, In b (obj_barrier_refs_list y) -> ρ !! b = Some Barrier).

Definition provenance_inv (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  F0 ρ /\ F1 ρ /\ F2 ρ /\ kind_live ρ.
EOF

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Additional environment lemmas needed for substitution.             *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma delete_insert_same_env x (t : type) (Γ : env) :
  delete x (<[x:=t]>Γ) = delete x Γ.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro y.
  destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_eq (<[y:=t]>Γ) y). rewrite (lookup_delete_eq Γ y). done.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_ne (<[x:=t]>Γ) x y E).
    rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x y t E).
    rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ x y E). done.
Qed.

Lemma insert_delete_same_env x (t : type) (Γ : env) :
  <[x:=t]>(delete x Γ) = <[x:=t]>Γ.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro y.
  destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (delete y Γ) y t). rewrite (lookup_insert_eq Γ y t). done.
  - rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (delete x Γ) x y t E).
    rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ x y E).
    rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x y t E). done.
Qed.

Lemma delete_insert_comm_env x y (t : type) (Γ : env) : x <> y ->
  delete x (<[y:=t]>Γ) = <[y:=t]>(delete x Γ).
Proof.
  intros Hne. unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro z.
  destruct (decide (x=z)) as [E1|E1]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_eq (<[y:=t]>Γ) z).
    rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (delete z Γ) y z t (fun H => Hne (eq_sym H))).
    rewrite (lookup_delete_eq Γ z). done.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_ne (<[y:=t]>Γ) x z E1).
    destruct (decide (y=z)) as [E2|E2]; subst.
    + rewrite (lookup_insert_eq Γ z t). rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (delete x Γ) z t). done.
    + rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ y z t E2).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (delete x Γ) y z t E2).
      rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ x z E1). done.
Qed.

Lemma delete_empty_env (x : string) : delete x (∅ : env) = ∅.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro y.
  destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_eq (∅ : gmap string type) y). apply lookup_empty.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_ne (∅ : gmap string type) x y E). apply lookup_empty.
Qed.

Lemma delete_delete_comm x y (Γ : env) :
  delete x (delete y Γ) = delete y (delete x Γ).
Proof.
  unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro z.
  destruct (decide (x=z)) as [E1|E1]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_eq (delete z Γ) z).
    rewrite (lookup_delete_ne (delete z Γ) z z (fun H => H eq_refl)). done.
  - destruct (decide (y=z)) as [E2|E2]; subst.
    + rewrite (lookup_delete_ne (delete z Γ) z z (fun H => H eq_refl)).
      rewrite (lookup_delete_eq (delete z Γ) z). done.
    + rewrite (lookup_delete_ne (delete y Γ) x z E1).
      rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ y z E2).
      rewrite (lookup_delete_ne (delete x Γ) y z E2).
      rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ x z E1). done.
Qed.

Lemma env_var_lookup Γ x t : env_var Γ x t -> Γ !! x = Some t.
Proof.
  intros [Γ' [E _]]. subst Γ. unfold env in *.
  apply lookup_insert_eq.
Qed.

Lemma env_var_unr_delete Γ x t : env_var Γ x t -> env_unr (delete x Γ).
Proof.
  intros [Γ' [E Hu]]. subst Γ.
  rewrite delete_insert_same_env.
  apply env_unr_delete. exact Hu.
Qed.

Lemma env_var_delete Γ x y t : env_var Γ y t -> y <> x -> env_var (delete x Γ) y t.
Proof.
  intros [Γ' [E Hu]] Hne. subst Γ.
  exists (delete x Γ'). split.
  - rewrite delete_insert_comm_env; [done | apply Hne].
  - apply env_unr_delete. exact Hu.
Qed.

Lemma env_var_empty x t : env_var (∅ : env) x t -> False.
Proof.
  intros H. pose proof (env_var_lookup _ _ _ H) as Hl.
  rewrite lookup_empty in Hl. discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma env_split_lookup_l Γ Γ1 Γ2 x t :
  env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 -> Γ1 !! x = Some t -> Γ !! x = Some t.
Proof.
  intros [E _] H1. subst Γ.
  apply (lookup_union_Some_l Γ1 Γ2 x t H1).
Qed.

Lemma env_split_lookup_none Γ Γ1 Γ2 x :
  env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 -> Γ !! x = None -> Γ1 !! x = None /\ Γ2 !! x = None.
Proof.
  intros [E _] H. subst Γ.
  apply (proj1 (lookup_union_None Γ1 Γ2 x)). exact H.
Qed.

Lemma env_split_lookup_r Γ Γ1 Γ2 x t :
  env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 -> Γ1 !! x = None -> Γ !! x = Some t -> Γ2 !! x = Some t.
Proof.
  intros HE Hn Hsome.
  destruct (env_split_lookup_none Γ Γ1 Γ2 x HE Hsome) as [_ H2].
  (* x is not in Γ1, so union lookup is Γ2's *)
  destruct HE as [E _]. subst Γ.
  rewrite lookup_union in Hsome.
  rewrite Hn in Hsome. simpl in Hsome. exact Hsome.
Qed.

Lemma env_split_lookup_r_some Γ Γ1 Γ2 x t :
  env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 -> Γ2 !! x = Some t -> Γ !! x = Some t.
Proof.
  intros HE H2. destruct HE as [E _]. subst Γ.
  rewrite lookup_union. rewrite H2.
  destruct (Γ1 !! x); done.
Qed.

(* A variable absent from an environment cannot occur free in a term typed
   under it.  We phrase this via [subst] preservation directly later. *)

Lemma env_unr_insert_any x (t : type) (Γ : env) :
  env_unr Γ -> (forall t', Γ !! x = Some t' -> unr t') -> env_unr (<[x:=t]>Γ).
Proof.
  intros Hu Hx y ty Hy.
  destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_insert_eq Γ y t) in Hy. injection Hy as ->. done.
  - rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x y t E) in Hy. apply Hu. exact Hy.
Qed.
EOF

From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.
From stdpp Require Import gmap finite.
From Stdlib Require Import Relation_Operators Arith Lia.

Definition wait_step (ρ : cfg) : nat -> nat -> Prop := fun a b => waiting ρ a b.
Definition seeded (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i, ρ !! i <> None -> exists j, rtc (wait_step ρ) i j /\ can_step ρ j.
Definition progress_or_wait (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i, ρ !! i <> None -> can_step ρ i \/ exists j, waiting ρ i j.
Definition wait_targets_live (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i e j, ρ !! i = Some (Thread e) -> expr_waiting e j -> ρ !! j <> None.

(* copied finite orbit lemma *)
Lemma iter_positive_clos_trans {A} (R : A -> A -> Prop) (f : A -> A)
    (Hf : forall x, R x (f x)) :
  forall (d:nat) (x:A), 0 < d -> @clos_trans A R x (@Nat.iter d A f x).
Proof.
  intros d. induction d as [|d IH]; intros x Hd.
  - lia.
  - destruct d as [|d'].
    + simpl. apply t_step. apply Hf.
    + rewrite Nat.iter_succ_r. eapply t_trans.
      * apply t_step. apply Hf.
      * apply IH. lia.
Qed.

Lemma finite_orbit_cycle {A} `{EqDecision A} `{Finite A}
    (R : A -> A -> Prop) (a0 : A) :
  (forall x, exists y, R x y) ->
  exists (f:A->A) (k d:nat) (x:A),
    0 < d /\ (forall y, R y (f y)) /\
    x = @Nat.iter k A f a0 /\
    @Nat.iter d A f x = x /\
    @clos_trans A R x x.
Proof.
  intros Htot.
  destruct (finite_choice (A := A) (B := fun _ => A)
              (fun x (y:A) => R x y) Htot) as [f Hf].
  set (n := card A).
  set (g := fun i : fin (S n) => @Nat.iter (fin_to_nat i) A f a0).
  assert (Hgt : card A < card (fin (S n))).
  { rewrite fin_card. fold n. lia. }
  destruct (finite_pigeonhole (A := fin (S n)) (B := A) g Hgt)
    as [x1 [x2 [Hne Heq]]].
  assert (Hne' : fin_to_nat x1 <> fin_to_nat x2).
  { intro E. apply Hne. apply fin_to_nat_inj. exact E. }
  destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec (fin_to_nat x1) (fin_to_nat x2))
    as [[Hlt|Heqn]|Hgtn].
  - set (d := fin_to_nat x2 - fin_to_nat x1).
    assert (Hd : 0 < d) by lia.
    assert (Hx2 : g x2 = @Nat.iter d A f (g x1)).
    { unfold g. replace (fin_to_nat x2) with (d + fin_to_nat x1) by lia.
      rewrite Nat.iter_add. reflexivity. }
    assert (Hiter : @Nat.iter d A f (g x1) = g x1).
    { rewrite <- Hx2. exact (eq_sym Heq). }
    exists f, (fin_to_nat x1), d, (g x1).
    split; [exact Hd|]. split; [exact Hf|]. split; [reflexivity|].
    split; [exact Hiter|].
    pose proof (iter_positive_clos_trans R f Hf d (g x1) Hd) as Hc.
    rewrite Hiter in Hc. exact Hc.
  - exfalso. apply Hne'. exact Heqn.
  - set (d := fin_to_nat x1 - fin_to_nat x2).
    assert (Hd : 0 < d) by lia.
    assert (Hx1 : g x1 = @Nat.iter d A f (g x2)).
    { unfold g. replace (fin_to_nat x1) with (d + fin_to_nat x2) by lia.
      rewrite Nat.iter_add. reflexivity. }
    assert (Hiter : @Nat.iter d A f (g x2) = g x2).
    { rewrite <- Hx1. exact Heq. }
    exists f, (fin_to_nat x2), d, (g x2).
    split; [exact Hd|]. split; [exact Hf|]. split; [reflexivity|].
    split; [exact Hiter|].
    pose proof (iter_positive_clos_trans R f Hf d (g x2) Hd) as Hc.
    rewrite Hiter in Hc. exact Hc.
Qed.

(* max bound of a finite domain *)
Fixpoint list_max (l : list nat) : nat :=
  match l with [] => 0 | x :: xs => Nat.max x (list_max xs) end.

Lemma in_list_max l x : x ∈ l -> x <= list_max l.
Proof.
  induction l as [|a l IH]; simpl; intros Hx.
  - set_solver.
  - apply elem_of_cons in Hx as [->|Hx].
    + apply Nat.le_max_l.
    + apply Nat.le_trans with (list_max l); [apply IH; exact Hx|apply Nat.le_max_r].
Qed.

Definition dom_max (ρ : cfg) : nat := list_max (elements (dom ρ)).
Definition dom_bound (ρ : cfg) : nat := S (dom_max ρ).

Lemma dom_live_lt ρ i : i ∈ dom ρ -> i < dom_bound ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hi. unfold dom_bound, dom_max.
  apply Nat.lt_succ_r.
  apply in_list_max.
  apply (proj1 (elem_of_elements (dom ρ) i)). exact Hi.
Qed.

Lemma dom_of_lookup ρ i : ρ !! i <> None -> i ∈ dom ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hi. apply elem_of_dom.
  destruct (ρ !! i) as [o|] eqn:E; [eexists; reflexivity|done].
Qed.

Lemma lookup_of_dom ρ i : i ∈ dom ρ -> ρ !! i <> None.
Proof.
  intros Hi. apply elem_of_dom in Hi. destruct Hi as [o Ho]. rewrite Ho. discriminate.
Qed.

(* waiting-cycle iteration *)
Lemma waiting_iter_clos_trans ρ (h : nat -> nat)
    (Hh : forall j, waiting ρ (h j) (h (S j))) :
  forall d, 0 < d -> @clos_trans nat (fun a b => waiting ρ a b) (h 0) (h d).
Proof.
  intros d. induction d as [|d IH]; intros Hd.
  - lia.
  - destruct d as [|d'].
    + simpl. apply t_step. apply Hh.
    + eapply t_trans.
      * apply t_step. apply Hh.
      * apply IH. lia.
Qed.

(* Main reduction: progress + no live waiting cycle => seeded. *)
Lemma seeded_of_progress_acyclic ρ
    (Hprog : progress_or_wait ρ)
    (Hlive : wait_targets_live ρ)
    (Hacyc : forall i, i ∈ dom ρ ->
        ~ @clos_trans nat (fun a b => waiting ρ a b) i i) :
  seeded ρ.
Proof.
  intros i0 Hi0ne.
  pose proof (dom_of_lookup ρ i0 Hi0ne) as Hi0dom.
  set (N := dom_bound ρ).
  pose proof (dom_live_lt ρ i0 Hi0dom) as Hi0lt.
  set (a0 : fin N := nat_to_fin Hi0lt).
  set (R := fun (a b : fin N) =>
    (fin_to_nat a ∈ dom ρ /\
       (waiting ρ (fin_to_nat a) (fin_to_nat b) \/
        (can_step ρ (fin_to_nat a) /\ fin_to_nat b = fin_to_nat a)))
    \/ (~ fin_to_nat a ∈ dom ρ /\ b = a)).
  assert (Htot : forall a : fin N, exists b, R a b).
  { intros a. destruct (decide (fin_to_nat a ∈ dom ρ)) as [Hla|Hna].
    - destruct (Hprog (fin_to_nat a) (lookup_of_dom ρ (fin_to_nat a) Hla))
        as [Hc|[j Hw]].
      + exists a. left. split; [exact Hla|]. right. split; [exact Hc|reflexivity].
      + assert (Hjne : ρ !! j <> None).
        { destruct Hw as [[e [He Hw']]|[y [Hy _]]].
          - exact (Hlive _ _ _ He Hw').
          - rewrite Hy. discriminate. }
        pose proof (dom_of_lookup ρ j Hjne) as Hjdom.
        pose proof (dom_live_lt ρ j Hjdom) as Hjlt.
        exists (nat_to_fin Hjlt). left. split; [exact Hla|]. left.
        replace (fin_to_nat (nat_to_fin Hjlt)) with j by
          (apply fin_to_nat_to_fin).
        exact Hw.
    - exists a. right. split; [exact Hna|reflexivity]. }
  destruct (finite_orbit_cycle R a0 Htot)
    as [f [k [d [x [Hd [Hf [Hx [Hiter Hc]]]]]]]].
  (* g_j = f^j a0; orbit properties *)
  set (g := fun j => @Nat.iter j (fin N) f a0).

From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String.
From stdpp Require Import gmap.

From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Export langtools.

Inductive expr :=
  | Val : val -> expr
  | Var : string -> expr
  | Fun : string -> expr -> expr
  | App : expr -> expr -> expr
  | Unit : expr
  | Pair : expr -> expr -> expr
  | LetPair : expr -> expr -> expr
  | Sum : nat -> expr -> expr
  | MatchSum n : expr -> (fin n -> expr) -> expr

  | ForkBarrier : expr -> expr

  | NewLock : expr -> expr
  | ForkLock : expr -> expr -> expr
  | Acquire : expr -> expr
  | Release : expr -> expr -> expr
  | Wait : expr -> expr
  | Drop : expr -> expr
with val :=
  | FunV : string -> expr -> val
  | UnitV : val
  | PairV : val -> val -> val
  | SumV : nat -> val -> val
  | BarrierV : nat -> val
  | LockV : nat -> val.

Inductive linearity := Lin | Unr.

Inductive lockstate := Opened | Closed.

Inductive lockownership := Owner | Client.

Definition lockcap : Type := lockownership * lockstate.

Inductive lockownership_split : lockownership -> lockownership -> lockownership -> Prop :=
  | lo_split_1 : lockownership_split Owner Client Owner
  | lo_split_2 : lockownership_split Owner Owner Client
  | lo_split_3 : lockownership_split Client Client Client.

Inductive lockstate_split : lockstate -> lockstate -> lockstate -> Prop :=
  | ls_split_1 : lockstate_split Opened Closed Opened
  | ls_split_2 : lockstate_split Opened Opened Closed
  | ls_split_3 : lockstate_split Closed Closed Closed.

Definition lockcap_split l1 l2 l3 :=
  lockownership_split l1.1 l2.1 l3.1 ∧ lockstate_split l1.2 l2.2 l3.2.

CoInductive type :=
  | FunT : linearity -> type -> type -> type
  | UnitT : type
  | PairT : type -> type -> type
  | SumT n : (fin n -> type) -> type
  | LockT : lockcap -> type -> type.

CoInductive unr : type -> Prop :=
  | Fun_unr t1 t2 : unr (FunT Unr t1 t2)
  | Unit_unr : unr UnitT
  | Pair_unr t1 t2 : unr t1 -> unr t2 -> unr (PairT t1 t2)
  | Sum_unr n ts : (∀ i, unr (ts i)) -> unr (SumT n ts).

Definition env := gmap string type.

Definition env_unr (Γ : env) :=
  ∀ x t, Γ !! x = Some t -> unr t.

Definition disj (Γ1 Γ2 : env) :=
  ∀ i t1 t2, Γ1 !! i = Some t1 -> Γ2 !! i = Some t2 -> t1 = t2 ∧ unr t1.

Definition env_split (Γ : env) (Γ1 : env) (Γ2 : env) :=
  Γ = Γ1 ∪ Γ2 ∧ disj Γ1 Γ2.

Definition env_bind (Γ' : env) (x : string) (t : type) (Γ : env) :=
  Γ' = <[ x := t ]> Γ ∧ ∀ t', Γ !! x = Some t' -> unr t'.

Definition env_var (Γ : env) (x : string) (t : type) :=
  ∃ Γ', Γ = <[ x := t ]> Γ' ∧ env_unr Γ'.

Inductive typed : env -> expr -> type -> Prop :=

  | Var_typed Γ x t :
    env_var Γ x t ->
    typed Γ (Var x) t
  | Fun_typed Γ Γ' x e t1 t2 l :
    env_bind Γ' x t1 Γ ->
    (l = Unr -> env_unr Γ) ->
    typed Γ' e t2 ->
    typed Γ (Fun x e) (FunT l t1 t2)
  | App_typed Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 l :
    env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
    typed Γ1 e1 (FunT l t1 t2) ->
    typed Γ2 e2 t1 ->
    typed Γ (App e1 e2) t2
  | Unit_typed Γ :
    env_unr Γ ->
    typed Γ Unit UnitT
  | Pair_typed Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 :
    env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
    typed Γ1 e1 t1 ->
    typed Γ2 e2 t2 ->
    typed Γ (Pair e1 e2) (PairT t1 t2)
  | LetPair_typed Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 t :
    env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
    typed Γ1 e1 (PairT t1 t2) ->
    typed Γ2 e2 (FunT Lin t1 (FunT Lin t2 t)) ->
    typed Γ (LetPair e1 e2) t
  | Sum_typed Γ n (ts : fin n -> type) i e :
    typed Γ e (ts i) ->
    typed Γ (Sum i e) (SumT n ts)
  | MatchSumN_typed n Γ Γ1 Γ2 t (ts : fin n -> type) es e :
    env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
    (n = 0 -> env_unr Γ2) ->
    typed Γ1 e (SumT n ts) ->
    (∀ i, typed Γ2 (es i) (FunT Lin (ts i) t)) ->
    typed Γ (MatchSum n e es) t

  | Fork_typed Γ e t1 t2 :
    typed Γ e (FunT Lin (FunT Lin t2 t1) UnitT) ->
    typed Γ (ForkBarrier e) (FunT Lin t1 t2)

  | NewLock_typed Γ e t :
    typed Γ e t ->
    typed Γ (NewLock e) (LockT (Owner,Closed) t)
  | ForkLock_typed Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t l1 l2 l3 :
    env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
    lockcap_split l1 l2 l3 ->
    typed Γ1 e1 (LockT l1 t) ->
    typed Γ2 e2 (FunT Lin (LockT l2 t) UnitT) ->
    typed Γ (ForkLock e1 e2) (LockT l3 t)
  | Acquire_typed Γ e t lo :
    typed Γ e (LockT (lo,Closed) t) ->
    typed Γ (Acquire e) (PairT (LockT (lo,Opened) t) t)
  | Release_typed Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t lo :
    env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
    typed Γ1 e1 (LockT (lo,Opened) t) ->
    typed Γ1 e1 (LockT (lo,Opened) t) ->
    typed Γ2 e2 t ->
    typed Γ (Release e1 e2) (LockT (lo,Closed) t)
  | Wait_typed Γ e t :
    typed Γ e (LockT (Owner,Closed) t) ->
    typed Γ (Wait e) t
  | Drop_typed Γ e t :
    typed Γ e (LockT (Client,Closed) t) ->
    typed Γ (Drop e) UnitT.

Definition subst (x:string) (a:val) := fix rec e :=
  match e with
  | Val _ => e
  | Var x' => if decide (x = x') then Val a else e
  | Fun x' e => Fun x' (if decide (x = x') then e else rec e)
  | App e1 e2 => App (rec e1) (rec e2)
  | Unit => Unit
  | Pair e1 e2 => Pair (rec e1) (rec e2)
  | LetPair e1 e2 => LetPair (rec e1) (rec e2)
  | Sum n e => Sum n (rec e)
  | MatchSum n e1 e2 => MatchSum n (rec e1) (rec ∘ e2)
  | ForkBarrier e => ForkBarrier (rec e)
  | NewLock e => NewLock (rec e)
  | ForkLock e1 e2 => ForkLock (rec e1) (rec e2)
  | Acquire e => Acquire (rec e)
  | Release e1 e2 => Release (rec e1) (rec e2)
  | Wait e => Wait (rec e)
  | Drop e => Drop (rec e)
  end.

Inductive pure_step : expr -> expr -> Prop :=
  | Fun_step x e :
    pure_step (Fun x e) (Val $ FunV x e)
  | App_step x e a :
    pure_step (App (Val $ FunV x e) (Val a)) (subst x a e)
  | Unit_step :
    pure_step Unit (Val $ UnitV)
  | Pair_step v1 v2 :
    pure_step (Pair (Val v1) (Val v2)) (Val $ PairV v1 v2)
  | LetPair_step v1 v2 e:
    pure_step (LetPair (Val $ PairV v1 v2) e) (App (App e (Val v1)) (Val v2))
  | Sum_step n v :
    pure_step (Sum n (Val v)) (Val $ SumV n v)
  | MatchSum_step n (i : fin n) v es :
    pure_step (MatchSum n (Val $ SumV i v) es) (App (es i) (Val v)).

Inductive ctx1 : (expr -> expr) -> Prop :=
  | Ctx_App_l e : ctx1 (λ x, App x e)
  | Ctx_App_r e : ctx1 (λ x, App e x)
  | Ctx_Pair_l e : ctx1 (λ x, Pair x e)
  | Ctx_Pair_r e : ctx1 (λ x, Pair e x)
  | Ctx_LetPair e : ctx1 (λ x, LetPair x e)
  | Ctx_Sum i : ctx1 (λ x, Sum i x)
  | Ctx_MatchSum n es : ctx1 (λ x, MatchSum n x es)
  | Ctx_ForkBarrier : ctx1 (λ x, ForkBarrier x)
  | Ctx_NewLock : ctx1 (λ x, NewLock x)
  | Ctx_ForkLock_l e : ctx1 (λ x, ForkLock x e)
  | Ctx_ForkLock_r e : ctx1 (λ x, ForkLock e x)
  | Ctx_Acquire : ctx1 (λ x, Acquire x)
  | Ctx_Release_l e : ctx1 (λ x, Release x e)
  | Ctx_Release_r e : ctx1 (λ x, Release e x)
  | Ctx_Wait : ctx1 (λ x, Wait x)
  | Ctx_Drop : ctx1 (λ x, Drop x).

Inductive ctx : (expr -> expr) -> Prop :=
  | Ctx_id : ctx id
  | Ctx_comp k1 k2 : ctx1 k1 -> ctx k2 -> ctx (k1 ∘ k2).

Inductive obj := Thread (e : expr) | Barrier | Lock (refcnt : nat) (o : option val).

Definition cfg := gmap nat obj.

Inductive local_step : nat -> cfg -> cfg -> Prop :=

  | Pure_step i k e e' :
    ctx k -> pure_step e e' ->
    local_step i {[ i := Thread (k e) ]} {[ i := Thread (k e') ]}
  | Exit_step i :
    local_step i {[ i := Thread (Val UnitV) ]} ∅

  | Fork_step i j n k v :
    i ≠ j -> i ≠ n -> j ≠ n -> ctx k ->
    local_step i {[ i := Thread (k (ForkBarrier (Val v))) ]}
                 {[ i := Thread (k (Val $ BarrierV n));
                    j := Thread (App (Val v) (Val $ BarrierV n));
                    n := Barrier ]}
  | Sync_step i j n k1 k2 v1 v2 :
    i ≠ j -> i ≠ n -> j ≠ n -> ctx k1 -> ctx k2 ->
    local_step n {[ i := Thread (k1 (App (Val $ BarrierV n) (Val v1)));
                    j := Thread (k2 (App (Val $ BarrierV n) (Val v2)));
                    n := Barrier ]}
                 {[ i := Thread (k1 $ Val v2);
                    j := Thread (k2 $ Val v1) ]}

  | NewLock_step v k n i:
    i ≠ n -> ctx k ->
    local_step i {[ i := Thread (k (NewLock (Val v))) ]}
                 {[ i := Thread (k (Val $ LockV n));
                    n := Lock 0 (Some v) ]}
  | ForkLock_step v o k i j n refcnt :

expr_head_waiting (App (Val $ BarrierV j) (Val v)) j
  | ForkLock_waiting j v :
    expr_head_waiting (ForkLock (Val $ LockV j) (Val v)) j
  | Acquire_waiting j :
    expr_head_waiting (Acquire (Val $ LockV j)) j
  | Release_waiting j v :
    expr_head_waiting (Release (Val $ LockV j) (Val v)) j
  | Wait_waiting j :
    expr_head_waiting (Wait (Val $ LockV j)) j
  | Drop_waiting j :
    expr_head_waiting (Drop (Val $ LockV j)) j.

Definition expr_waiting e j :=
  ∃ k e', ctx k ∧ e = k e' ∧ expr_head_waiting e' j.

Definition waiting (ρ : cfg) (i j : nat) :=
  (∃ e, ρ !! i = Some (Thread e) ∧ expr_waiting e j) ∨
  (∃ y, ρ !! j = Some y ∧ i ∈ obj_refs y ∧ ∀ e, y = Thread e -> ¬ expr_waiting e i).

Definition can_step (ρ : cfg) (i : nat) := ∃ ρ', step i ρ ρ'.

Definition inactive (ρ : cfg) (i : nat) := ρ !! i = None.

Inductive reachable (ρ : cfg) : nat -> Prop :=
  | Can_step_reachable i :
      can_step ρ i -> reachable ρ i
  | Waiting_reachable i j :
      waiting ρ i j -> reachable ρ j -> reachable ρ i.

Definition fully_reachable (ρ : cfg) :=
  ∀ i, inactive ρ i ∨ reachable ρ i.

From stdpp Require Import gmap.
From Stdlib Require Import List Arith Lia.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Reference-occurrence multiplicities.                               *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* [expr_refs] in definitions.v is a SET of referenced indices.  The *)
(* forest/ownership arguments need to count OCCURRENCES with          *)
(* multiplicity.  For all expression forms this is unambiguous except *)
(* [MatchSum], whose branch argument is a Gallina function            *)
(* [fin n -> expr]; we count the sum over all branches.  As shown     *)
(* below this convention makes the multiplicity invariant fail for a  *)
(* typed-reachable configuration (see [multiplicity_break]).          *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition fin_sum {n} (f : fin n -> nat) : nat :=
  fold_right (fun i acc => f i + acc) 0 (fin_enum n).

Lemma fin_sum_ext {n} (f g : fin n -> nat) :
  (forall i, f i = g i) -> fin_sum f = fin_sum g.
Proof.
  intros H. unfold fin_sum. induction (fin_enum n); simpl; [done|].
  rewrite H, IH. done.
Qed.

Lemma fin_sum_add {n} (f g : fin n -> nat) :
  fin_sum (fun i => f i + g i) = fin_sum f + fin_sum g.
Proof.
  unfold fin_sum. induction (fin_enum n); simpl; [done|].
  rewrite IH. lia.
Qed.

Lemma fin_sum_zero {n} : fin_sum (fun _ : fin n => 0) = 0.
Proof.
  unfold fin_sum. induction (fin_enum n); simpl; [done|].
  rewrite IH. done.
Qed.

Lemma fin_sum_mul {n} (f : fin n -> nat) (c : nat) :
  fin_sum (fun i => f i * c) = fin_sum f * c.
Proof.
  unfold fin_sum. induction (fin_enum n); simpl; [done|].
  rewrite IH. lia.

(* Count occurrences of a reference index [k] (a lock or barrier index);
   both [LockV] and [BarrierV] are counted. *)
Fixpoint occ_expr (k : nat) (e : expr) : nat :=
  match e with
  | Val v => occ_val k v
  | Var _ => 0
  | Fun _ e => occ_expr k e
  | App e1 e2 => occ_expr k e1 + occ_expr k e2
  | Unit => 0
  | Pair e1 e2 => occ_expr k e1 + occ_expr k e2
  | LetPair e1 e2 => occ_expr k e1 + occ_expr k e2
  | Sum _ e => occ_expr k e
  | MatchSum _ e es => occ_expr k e + fin_sum (fun i => occ_expr k (es i))
  | ForkBarrier e => occ_expr k e
  | NewLock e => occ_expr k e
  | ForkLock e1 e2 => occ_expr k e1 + occ_expr k e2
  | Acquire e => occ_expr k e
  | Release e1 e2 => occ_expr k e1 + occ_expr k e2
  | Wait e => occ_expr k e
  | Drop e => occ_expr k e

  | ForkBarrier e => var_occ x e
  | NewLock e => var_occ x e
  | ForkLock e1 e2 => var_occ x e1 + var_occ x e2
  | Acquire e => var_occ x e

content.content:
From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.
From stdpp Require Import gmap.
From Stdlib Require Import List Arith Lia.
Import ListNotations.
Open Scope string_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Reference-occurrence multiplicities.                               *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* [expr_refs] in definitions.v is a SET of referenced indices.  The *)
(* forest/ownership arguments need to count OCCURRENCES with          *)
(* multiplicity.  For all expression forms this is unambiguous except *)
(* [MatchSum], whose branch argument is a Gallina function            *)
(* [fin n -> expr]; we count the sum over all branches.  As shown     *)
(* below this convention makes the multiplicity invariant fail for a  *)
(* typed-reachable configuration (see [multiplicity_break]).          *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition fin_sum {n} (f : fin n -> nat) : nat :=
  fold_right (fun i acc => f i + acc) 0 (fin_enum n).

Lemma fin_sum_ext {n} (f g : fin n -> nat) :
  (forall i, f i = g i) -> fin_sum f = fin_sum g.
Proof.
  intros H. unfold fin_sum. induction (fin_enum n); simpl; [done|].
  rewrite H, IH. done.
Qed.

Lemma fin_sum_add {n} (f g : fin n -> nat) :
  fin_sum (fun i => f i + g i) = fin_sum f + fin_sum g.
Proof.
  unfold fin_sum. induction (fin_enum n); simpl; [done|].
  rewrite IH. lia.
Qed.

Lemma fin_sum_zero {n} : fin_sum (fun _ : fin n => 0) = 0.
Proof.
  unfold fin_sum. induction (fin_enum n); simpl; [done|].
  rewrite IH. done.
Qed.

Lemma fin_sum_mul {n} (f : fin n -> nat) (c : nat) :
  fin_sum (fun i => f i * c) = fin_sum f * c.
Proof.
  unfold fin_sum. induction (fin_enum n); simpl; [done|].
  rewrite IH. lia.
Qed.

(* Count occurrences of a reference index [k] (a lock or barrier index);
   both [LockV] and [BarrierV] are counted. *)
Fixpoint occ_expr (k : nat) (e : expr) : nat :=
  match e with
  | Val v => occ_val k v
  | Var _ => 0
  | Fun _ e => occ_expr k e
  | App e1 e2 => occ_expr k e1 + occ_expr k e2
  | Unit => 0
  | Pair e1 e2 => occ_expr k e1 + occ_expr k e2
  | LetPair e1 e2 => occ_expr k e1 + occ_expr k e2
  | Sum _ e => occ_expr k e
  | MatchSum _ e es => occ_expr k e + fin_sum (fun i => occ_expr k (es i))
  | ForkBarrier e => occ_expr k e
  | NewLock e => occ_expr k e
  | ForkLock e1 e2 => occ_expr k e1 + occ_expr k e2
  | Acquire e => occ_expr k e
  | Release e1 e2 => occ_expr k e1 + occ_expr k e2
  | Wait e => occ_expr k e
  | Drop e => occ_expr k e
  end
with occ_val (k : nat) (v : val) : nat :=
  match v with
  | FunV _ e => occ_expr k e
  | UnitV => 0
  | PairV v1 v2 => occ_val k v1 + occ_val k v2
  | SumV _ v => occ_val k v
  | BarrierV i => if decide (k = i) then 1 else 0
  | LockV i => if decide (k = i) then 1 else 0
  end.

(* Number of [Var x] occurrences that [subst x a] will replace.  Mirrors
   the recursion of [subst] exactly (no recursion under [Val], none under a
   shadowing binder). *)
Fixpoint var_occ (x : string) (e : expr) : nat :=
  match e with
  | Val _ => 0
  | Var y => if decide (x = y) then 1 else 0
  | Fun y e => if decide (x = y) then 0 else var_occ x e
  | App e1 e2 => var_occ x e1 + var_occ x e2
  | Unit => 0
  | Pair e1 e2 => var_occ x e1 + var_occ x e2
  | LetPair e1 e2 => var_occ x e1 + var_occ x e2
  | Sum _ e => var_occ x e
  | MatchSum _ e es => var_occ x e + fin_sum (fun i => var_occ x (es i))
  | ForkBarrier e => var_occ x e
  | NewLock e => var_occ x e
  | ForkLock e1 e2 => var_occ x e1 + var_occ x e2
  | Acquire e => var_occ x e
  | Release e1 e2 => var_occ x e1 + var_occ x e2
  | Wait e => var_occ x e
  | Drop e => var_occ x e
  end.

(* The exact multiplicity of [k] after substituting a value.  The binder of
   the surrounding [subst] is what matters, so this is stated for the closed
   value [a]. *)
Lemma subst_occ_expr (x : string) (a : val) (k : nat) (e : expr) :
  occ_expr k (subst x a e) = occ_expr k e + var_occ x e * occ_val k a.
Proof.
  induction e as
    [ v | y | y e IH | e1 IH1 e2 IH2 | | e1 IH1 e2 IH2
    | e1 IH1 e2 IH2 | m e IH | n e IH es IHes | e IH | e IH
    | e1 IH1 e2 IH2 | e IH | e1 IH1 e2 IH2 | e IH | e IH ];
    simpl.
  - (* Val *) simpl. rewrite Nat.mul_0_r, Nat.add_0_r. done.
  - (* Var *) destruct (decide (x = y)); simpl; lia.
  - (* Fun *) destruct (decide (x = y)).
    + subst y. simpl. rewrite Nat.mul_0_r, Nat.add_0_r. done.
    + simpl. rewrite IH. done.
  - simpl. rewrite IH1, IH2. lia.
  - done.
  - simpl. rewrite IH1, IH2. lia.
  - simpl. rewrite IH1, IH2. lia.
  - simpl. rewrite IH. done.
  - (* MatchSum *)
    simpl.
    rewrite IH, fin_sum_add, fin_sum_mul.
    (* LHS: occ e + var_occ e * o + (fin_sum occ_es + fin_sum var_es * o)
       RHS: occ e + fin_sum occ_es + (var_occ e + fin_sum var_es) * o *)
    nia.
  - simpl. rewrite IH. done.
  - simpl. rewrite IH. done.
  - simpl. rewrite IH1, IH2. lia.
  - simpl. rewrite IH. done.
  - simpl. rewrite IH1, IH2. lia.
  - simpl. rewrite IH. done.
  - simpl. rewrite IH. done.
Qed.

(* Substituting a value with no reference occurrences never changes any
   reference multiplicity. *)
Corollary subst_occ_zero x a k e :
  occ_val k a = 0 ->
  occ_expr k (subst x a e) = occ_expr k e.
Proof.
  intros H. rewrite subst_occ_expr. rewrite H. lia.
Qed.

(* Object-level and configuration-level multiplicity. *)
Definition occ_obj (k : nat) (o : obj) : nat :=
  match o with
  | Thread e => occ_expr k e
  | Barrier => 0
  | Lock _ (Some v) => occ_val k v
  | Lock _ None => 0
  end.

Definition occ_cfg (rho : cfg) (a b : nat) : nat :=
  match rho !! a with
  | Some o => occ_obj b o
  | None => 0
  end.

(* Multiplicity-based no-aliasing: no pair of distinct live objects may
   carry more than one total occurrence of each other. *)
Definition pair_occ_le1 (rho : cfg) : Prop :=
  (forall a, occ_cfg rho a a = 0) /\
  (forall a b, a <> b -> occ_cfg rho a b + occ_cfg rho b a <= 1).

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Source terms carry NO runtime references at all.                   *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma typed_expr_refs_empty (Gamma : env) (e : expr) (t : type) :
  typed Gamma e t -> expr_refs e = ∅.
Proof.
  induction 1 as
    [ Gamma x t Hvar
    | Gamma Gamma' x e t1 t2 l Hb Hunr Hty IH
    | Gamma Gamma1 Gamma2 e1 e2 t1 t2 l Hs H1 IH1 H2 IH2
    | Gamma Hunr
    | Gamma Gamma1 Gamma2 e1 e2 t1 t2 Hs H1 IH1 H2 IH2
    | Gamma Gamma1 Gamma2 e1 e2 t1 t2 t Hs H1 IH1 H2 IH2
    | Gamma n ts i e Hty IH
    | n Gamma Gamma1 Gamma2 t ts es e Hs Hn H1 IH1 Hf IHf
    | Gamma e t1 t2 Hty IH
    | Gamma e t Hty IH
    | Gamma Gamma1 Gamma2 e1 e2 t l1 l2 l3 Hs Hcap H1 IH1 H2 IH2
    | Gamma e t lo Hty IH
    | Gamma Gamma1 Gamma2 e1 e2 t lo Hs H1 IH1 H2 IH2
    | Gamma e t Hty IH
    | Gamma e t Hty IH ].

From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.
From stdpp Require Import gmap.
From Stdlib Require Import List Arith Lia.
Import ListNotations.
Open Scope string_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Reference-occurrence multiplicities.                               *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* [expr_refs] in definitions.v is a SET of referenced indices.  The *)
(* forest/ownership arguments need to count OCCURRENCES with          *)
(* multiplicity.  For all expression forms this is unambiguous except *)
(* [MatchSum], whose branch argument is a Gallina function            *)
(* [fin n -> expr]; we count the sum over all branches.  As shown     *)
(* below this convention makes the multiplicity invariant fail for a  *)
(* typed-reachable configuration (see [multiplicity_break]).          *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition fin_sum {n} (f : fin n -> nat) : nat :=
  fold_right (fun i acc => f i + acc) 0 (fin_enum n).

Lemma fin_sum_ext {n} (f g : fin n -> nat) :
  (forall i, f i = g i) -> fin_sum f = fin_sum g.
Proof.
  intros H. unfold fin_sum. induction (fin_enum n); simpl; [done|].
  rewrite H, IH. done.
Qed.

Lemma fin_sum_add {n} (f g : fin n -> nat) :
  fin_sum (fun i => f i + g i) = fin_sum f + fin_sum g.
Proof.
  unfold fin_sum. induction (fin_enum n); simpl; [done|].
  rewrite IH. lia.
Qed.

Lemma fin_sum_zero {n} : fin_sum (fun _ : fin n => 0) = 0.
Proof.
  unfold fin_sum. induction (fin_enum n); simpl; [done|].
  rewrite IH. done.
Qed.

Lemma fin_sum_mul {n} (f : fin n -> nat) (c : nat) :
  fin_sum (fun i => f i * c) = fin_sum f * c.
Proof.
  unfold fin_sum. induction (fin_enum n); simpl; [done|].
  rewrite IH. lia.
Qed.

(* Count occurrences of a reference index [k] (a lock or barrier index);
   both [LockV] and [BarrierV] are counted. *)
Fixpoint occ_expr (k : nat) (e : expr) : nat :=
  match e with
  | Val v => occ_val k v
  | Var _ => 0
  | Fun _ e => occ_expr k e
  | App e1 e2 => occ_expr k e1 + occ_expr k e2
  | Unit => 0
  | Pair e1 e2 => occ_expr k e1 + occ_expr k e2
  | LetPair e1 e2 => occ_expr k e1 + occ_expr k e2
  | Sum _ e => occ_expr k e
  | MatchSum _ e es => occ_expr k e + fin_sum (fun i => occ_expr k (es i))
  | ForkBarrier e => occ_expr k e
  | NewLock e => occ_expr k e
  | ForkLock e1 e2 => occ_expr k e1 + occ_expr k e2
  | Acquire e => occ_expr k e
  | Release e1 e2 => occ_expr k e1 + occ_expr k e2
  | Wait e => occ_expr k e
  | Drop e => occ_expr k e
  end
with occ_val (k : nat) (v : val) : nat :=
  match v with
  | FunV _ e => occ_expr k e
  | UnitV => 0
  | PairV v1 v2 => occ_val k v1 + occ_val k v2
  | SumV _ v => occ_val k v
  | BarrierV i => if decide (k = i) then 1 else 0
  | LockV i => if decide (k = i) then 1 else 0
  end.

(* Number of [Var x] occurrences that [subst x a] will replace.  Mirrors
   the recursion of [subst] exactly (no recursion under [Val], none under a
   shadowing binder). *)
Fixpoint var_occ (x : string) (e : expr) : nat :=
  match e with
  | Val _ => 0
  | Var y => if decide (x = y) then 1 else 0
  | Fun y e => if decide (x = y) then 0 else var_occ x e
  | App e1 e2 => var_occ x e1 + var_occ x e2
  | Unit => 0
  | Pair e1 e2 => var_occ x e1 + var_occ x e2
  | LetPair e1 e2 => var_occ x e1 + var_occ x e2
  | Sum _ e => var_occ x e
  | MatchSum _ e es => var_occ x e + fin_sum (fun i => var_occ x (es i))
  | ForkBarrier e => var_occ x e
  | NewLock e => var_occ x e
  | ForkLock e1 e2 => var_occ x e1 + var_occ x e2
  | Acquire e => var_occ x e
  | Release e1 e2 => var_occ x e1 + var_occ x e2
  | Wait e => var_occ x e
  | Drop e => var_occ x e
  end.

(* The exact multiplicity of [k] after substituting a value.  The binder of
   the surrounding [subst] is what matters, so this is stated for the closed
   value [a]. *)
Lemma subst_occ_expr (x : string) (a : val) (k : nat) (e : expr) :
  occ_expr k (subst x a e) = occ_expr k e + var_occ x e * occ_val k a.
Proof.
  induction e as
    [ v | y | y e IH | e1 IH1 e2 IH2 | | e1 IH1 e2 IH2
    | e1 IH1 e2 IH2 | m e IH | n e IH es IHes | e IH | e IH
    | e1 IH1 e2 IH2 | e IH | e1 IH1 e2 IH2 | e IH | e IH ];
    simpl.
  - (* Val *) simpl. rewrite Nat.mul_0_r, Nat.add_0_r. done.
  - (* Var *) destruct (decide (x = y)); simpl; lia.
  - (* Fun *) destruct (decide (x = y)).
    + subst y. simpl. rewrite Nat.mul_0_r, Nat.add_0_r. done.
    + simpl. rewrite IH. done.
  - simpl. rewrite IH1, IH2. lia.
  - done.
  - simpl. rewrite IH1, IH2. lia.
  - simpl. rewrite IH1, IH2. lia.
  - simpl. rewrite IH. done.
  - (* MatchSum *)
    simpl.
    rewrite IH, fin_sum_add, fin_sum_mul.
    (* LHS: occ e + var_occ e * o + (fin_sum occ_es + fin_sum var_es * o)
       RHS: occ e + fin_sum occ_es + (var_occ e + fin_sum var_es) * o *)
    nia.
  - simpl. rewrite IH. done.
  - simpl. rewrite IH. done.
  - simpl. rewrite IH1, IH2. lia.
  - simpl. rewrite IH. done.
  - simpl. rewrite IH1, IH2. lia.
  - simpl. rewrite IH. done.
  - simpl. rewrite IH. done.
Qed.

(* Substituting a value with no reference occurrences never changes any
   reference multiplicity. *)
Corollary subst_occ_zero x a k e :
  occ_val k a = 0 ->
  occ_expr k (subst x a e) = occ_expr k e.
Proof.
  intros H. rewrite subst_occ_expr. rewrite H. lia.
Qed.

(* Object-level and configuration-level multiplicity. *)
Definition occ_obj (k : nat) (o : obj) : nat :=
  match o with
  | Thread e => occ_expr k e
  | Barrier => 0
  | Lock _ (Some v) => occ_val k v
  | Lock _ None => 0
  end.

Definition occ_cfg (rho : cfg) (a b : nat) : nat :=
  match rho !! a with
  | Some o => occ_obj b o
  | None => 0
  end.

(* Multiplicity-based no-aliasing: no pair of distinct live objects may
   carry more than one total occurrence of each other. *)
Definition pair_occ_le1 (rho : cfg) : Prop :=
  (forall a, occ_cfg rho a a = 0) /\
  (forall a b, a <> b -> occ_cfg rho a b + occ_cfg rho b a <= 1).

From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.

From Stdlib Require Import Classical_Prop Wellfounded Wf_nat Lia.
From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String Eqdep_dec.
From Stdlib Require Import Relation_Operators Arith.

Open Scope string_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Runtime typing for configurations.                                 *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* Source terms are Val-free, so [typed] cannot type configurations   *)
(* produced by reduction.  [wt] extends it with runtime values [cv].  *)
(* Values are environment-independent (they are closed).               *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Inductive wt (L : gmap nat type) : env -> expr -> type -> Prop :=
  | VarW Γ x t :
      env_var Γ x t ->
      wt L Γ (Var x) t
  | FunW Γ Γ' x e t1 t2 l :
      env_bind Γ' x t1 Γ ->
      (l = Unr -> env_unr Γ) ->
      wt L Γ' e t2 ->
      wt L Γ (Fun x e) (FunT l t1 t2)
  | AppW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 l :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (FunT l t1 t2) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 t1 ->
      wt L Γ (App e1 e2) t2
  | UnitW Γ :
      env_unr Γ ->
      wt L Γ Unit UnitT
  | PairW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 t1 ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 t2 ->
      wt L Γ (Pair e1 e2) (PairT t1 t2)
  | LetPairW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 t :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (PairT t1 t2) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 (FunT Lin t1 (FunT Lin t2 t)) ->
      wt L Γ (LetPair e1 e2) t
  | SumW Γ n (ts : fin n -> type) i e :
      wt L Γ e (ts i) ->
      wt L Γ (Sum i e) (SumT n ts)
  | MatchSumW n Γ Γ1 Γ2 t (ts : fin n -> type) es e :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      (n = 0 -> env_unr Γ2) ->
      wt L Γ1 e (SumT n ts) ->
      (forall i, wt L Γ2 (es i) (FunT Lin (ts i) t)) ->
      wt L Γ (MatchSum n e es) t
  | ForkW Γ e t1 t2 :
      wt L Γ e (FunT Lin (FunT Lin t2 t1) UnitT) ->
      wt L Γ (ForkBarrier e) (FunT Lin t1 t2)
  | NewLockW Γ e t :
      wt L Γ e t ->
      wt L Γ (NewLock e) (LockT (Owner,Closed) t)
  | ForkLockW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t l1 l2 l3 :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      lockcap_split l1 l2 l3 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (LockT l1 t) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 (FunT Lin (LockT l2 t) UnitT) ->
      wt L Γ (ForkLock e1 e2) (LockT l3 t)
  | AcquireW Γ e t lo :
      wt L Γ e (LockT (lo,Closed) t) ->
      wt L Γ (Acquire e) (PairT (LockT (lo,Opened) t) t)
  | ReleaseW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t lo :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (LockT (lo,Opened) t) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 t ->
      wt L Γ (Release e1 e2) (LockT (lo,Closed) t)
  | WaitW Γ e t :
      wt L Γ e (LockT (Owner,Closed) t) ->
      wt L Γ (Wait e) t
  | DropW Γ e t :
      wt L Γ e (LockT (Client,Closed) t) ->
      wt L Γ (Drop e) UnitT
  | ValW Γ v t :
      env_unr Γ ->
      cv L v t ->
      wt L Γ (Val v) t
with cv (L : gmap nat type) : val -> type -> Prop :=
  | FunVW x e t1 t2 l :
      wt L (<[ x := t1 ]> (∅ : env)) e t2 ->
      cv L (FunV x e) (FunT l t1 t2)
  | UnitVW : cv L UnitV UnitT
  | PairVW v1 v2 t1 t2 :
      cv L v1 t1 -> cv L v2 t2 ->
      cv L (PairV v1 v2) (PairT t1 t2)
  | SumVW n (ts : fin n -> type) i v :
      cv L v (ts i) ->
      cv L (SumV i v) (SumT n ts)
  | BarrierVW n t1 t2 :
      cv L (BarrierV n) (FunT Lin t1 t2)
  | LockVW n lc t :
      L !! n = Some t ->
      cv L (LockV n) (LockT lc t).

(* ---------- gmap / environment helpers ---------- *)

Lemma env_lookup_insert_same x (t : type) : (<[x:=t]>(∅ : env)) !! x = Some t.
Proof. unfold env in *. apply lookup_insert_eq. Qed.

Lemma env_lookup_insert_none x y (t : type) (Γ : env) : x <> y -> Γ !! y = None -> (<[x:=t]>Γ) !! y = None.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. intros Hne Hy.
  rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x y t Hne). done.
Qed.

Lemma env_unr_delete x (Γ : env) : env_unr Γ -> env_unr (delete x Γ).
Proof.
  intros H y t Hy. unfold env_unr in H. unfold env in *.
  destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_eq Γ y) in Hy. done.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ x y E) in Hy. apply H in Hy. done.
Qed.

Lemma env_unr_insert_lookup x (t : type) (Γ : env) :
  env_unr (<[x:=t]>Γ) -> unr t.
Proof. intros H. unfold env_unr in H. apply (H x t). unfold env. apply lookup_insert_eq. Qed.

Lemma env_union_empty_l (m : env) : ∅ ∪ m = m.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro x. rewrite lookup_union.
  assert (H : (∅ : gmap string type) !! x = None) by apply lookup_empty.
  rewrite H. destruct (m !! x); done.
Qed.

Lemma env_union_empty_r (m : env) : m ∪ ∅ = m.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro x. rewrite lookup_union.
  assert (H : (∅ : gmap string type) !! x = None) by apply lookup_empty.
  rewrite H. destruct (m !! x); done.
Qed.

Lemma env_split_empty (Γ1 Γ2 : env) : env_split ∅ Γ1 Γ2 -> Γ1 = ∅ /\ Γ2 = ∅.
Proof.
  unfold env in *.
  intros [Hun Hdis]. symmetry in Hun.
  apply map_positive_l in Hun as H1. subst Γ1.
  rewrite env_union_empty_l in Hun. subst Γ2. split; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma disj_delete x (Γ1 Γ2 : env) : disj Γ1 Γ2 -> disj (delete x Γ1) (delete x Γ2).
Proof.
  unfold env in *.
  intros H i t1 t2 H1 H2.
  destruct (decide (x=i)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_eq Γ1 i) in H1. done.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ1 x i E) in H1. rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ2 x i E) in H2. apply (H i t1 t2 H1 H2).
Qed.

Lemma delete_insert_none x (t : type) (Γ : env) : Γ !! x = None -> delete x (<[x:=t]>Γ) = Γ.
Proof.

  - rewrite (lookup_delete_eq (<[y:=t]>Γ) y). done.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_ne (<[x:=t]>Γ) x y E). rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x y t E). done.
Qed.

Lemma delete_none x (Γ : env) : Γ !! x = None -> delete x Γ = Γ.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. intros Hx. apply map_eq. intro y. destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_eq Γ y). done.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ x y E). done.
Qed.

Lemma insert_delete_same x (t : type) (Γ : env) : Γ !! x = Some t -> <[x:=t]>(delete x Γ) = Γ.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. intros Hx. apply map_eq. intro y. destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (delete y Γ) y t). symmetry. done.
  - rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (delete x Γ) x y t E). rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ x y E). done.
Qed.

Lemma insert_insert_same x (t1 t2 : type) (Γ : env) :
  <[x:=t2]>(<[x:=t1]>Γ) = <[x:=t2]>Γ.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro y. destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (<[y:=t1]>Γ) y t2). rewrite (lookup_insert_eq Γ y t2). done.
  - rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[x:=t1]>Γ) x y t2 E).
    rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x y t2 E).
    rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x y t1 E). done.
Qed.

Lemma insert_insert_comm x y (t1 t2 : type) (Γ : env) : x <> y ->

Proof.
  intros Hne. unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro z.

  - subst z.
    destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E2|E2].
    + exfalso. apply Hne. done.
    + rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (<[y:=t2]>Γ) x t1).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[x:=t1]>Γ) y x t2 (fun H => E2 (eq_sym H))).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_eq Γ x t1). done.
  - destruct (decide (z=y)) as [E2|E2].
    + subst z.
      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[y:=t2]>Γ) x y t1 Hne).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_eq Γ y t2).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (<[x:=t1]>Γ) y t2). done.
    + rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[y:=t2]>Γ) x z t1 (fun H => E1 (eq_sym H))).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ y z t2 (fun H => E2 (eq_sym H))).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[x:=t1]>Γ) y z t2 (fun H => E2 (eq_sym H))).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x z t1 (fun H => E1 (eq_sym H))). done.
Qed.

Lemma env_split_delete x (E E1 E2 : env) :
  env_split E E1 E2 -> env_split (delete x E) (delete x E1) (delete x E2).
Proof.
  unfold env in *. intros [Hun Hdis]. split.
  - rewrite Hun. apply delete_union.
  - apply disj_delete. done.
Qed.

Lemma env_unr_empty : env_unr (∅ : env).
Proof. unfold env in *. intros x t H. assert (H0 : (∅ : gmap string type) !! x = None) by apply lookup_empty. setoid_rewrite H0 in H. done. Qed.

Lemma env_split_nil : env_split (∅ : env) ∅ ∅.
Proof.
  unfold env_split. split.
  - symmetry. apply env_union_empty_l.
  - intros i t1 t2 H1 H2. assert (H0 : (∅ : env) !! i = None) by (unfold env; apply lookup_empty).

Lemma typed_to_wt Γ e t (H : typed Γ e t) : forall L, wt L Γ e t.
Proof.
  induction H as
    [ Γ x t Hvar
    | Γ Γ' x e t1 t2 l Hb Hunr Hty IH
    | Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 l Hsplit Hty1 IH1 Hty2 IH2

    | Γ e t1 t2 Hty IH

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* A sufficient combinatorial condition for full reachability.        *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* [waiting ρ i j] is the "i depends on j" relation.  If it admits a  *)
(* rank that strictly increases along waiting edges, then reachability *)
(* propagates back along those edges from any [can_step] seed.        *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition wait_wf (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  well_founded (fun j i => waiting ρ i j).

Definition progress_or_wait (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i, ρ !! i <> None -> can_step ρ i \/ exists j, waiting ρ i j.

Definition wait_targets_live (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i e j, ρ !! i = Some (Thread e) -> expr_waiting e j -> ρ !! j <> None.

Definition rank_ok (ρ : cfg) (r : nat -> nat) (M : nat) : Prop :=
  (forall i, r i <= M) /\ (forall i j, waiting ρ i j -> r i < r j).

Lemma rank_ok_wait_wf ρ r M :
  rank_ok ρ r M -> wait_wf ρ.
Proof.
  intros [Hb Hr]. unfold wait_wf.
  apply (Wf_nat.well_founded_lt_compat
           nat (fun i => M - r i) (fun j i => waiting ρ i j)).
  intros x y Hxy. pose proof (Hr y x Hxy) as Hlt.
  pose proof (Hb x). pose proof (Hb y). lia.
Qed.

Lemma wait_wf_fully_reachable ρ :
  wait_wf ρ -> progress_or_wait ρ -> wait_targets_live ρ -> fully_reachable ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hwf Hprog Hlive i.
  apply (well_founded_ind Hwf (fun i => inactive ρ i \/ reachable ρ i)).
  intros x IH.
  destruct (ρ !! x) as [y|] eqn:E.
  - right.
    assert (Hact : ρ !! x <> None) by congruence.
    destruct (Hprog x Hact) as [Hstep | [j Hwait]].
    + apply Can_step_reachable; exact Hstep.
    + destruct (IH j Hwait) as [Hinj | Hrj].
      * destruct Hwait as [[e [He Hw]] | [y' [Hy _]]].
        -- exfalso. exact (Hlive x e j He Hw Hinj).
        -- unfold inactive in Hinj. rewrite Hy in Hinj. discriminate.
      * apply Waiting_reachable with j; assumption.
  - left. exact E.
Qed.

Theorem rank_fully_reachable ρ r M :
  rank_ok ρ r M -> progress_or_wait ρ -> wait_targets_live ρ ->
  fully_reachable ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hr Hp Hl.
  apply wait_wf_fully_reachable.
  - apply rank_ok_wait_wf with (r := r) (M := M); exact Hr.
  - exact Hp.
  - exact Hl.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Seedability: the truly relevant combinatorial condition.           *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* A global rank is too strong: [waiting] may contain cycles that     *)
(* pass through objects which can step.  The correct condition is     *)
(* that every live location reaches, along finitely many waiting      *)
(* edges, some location that can step.                                *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition wait_step (ρ : cfg) : nat -> nat -> Prop :=
  fun a b => waiting ρ a b.

Definition seeded (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i, ρ !! i <> None ->
    exists j, rtc (wait_step ρ) i j /\ can_step ρ j.

Lemma reachable_of_wait_rtc ρ a b :
  rtc (wait_step ρ) a b -> reachable ρ b -> reachable ρ a.
Proof.
  intros H. induction H as [| x y z Hxy _ IH]; intros Hb.
  - exact Hb.
  - apply Waiting_reachable with y.
    + exact Hxy.
    + apply IH; exact Hb.
Qed.

Lemma seeded_fully_reachable ρ : seeded ρ -> fully_reachable ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hseed i. destruct (ρ !! i) as [y|] eqn:E.
  - right. destruct (Hseed i ltac:(congruence)) as [j [Hpath Hstep]].
    apply (reachable_of_wait_rtc ρ i j Hpath).
    apply Can_step_reachable; exact Hstep.
  - left. exact E.
Qed.

Lemma reachable_seed ρ i : reachable ρ i ->
  exists j, rtc (wait_step ρ) i j /\ can_step ρ j.
Proof.
  induction 1 as [k Hc | a b Hw Hr IH].
  - exists k. split; [apply rtc_refl | exact Hc].
  - destruct IH as [j [Hpath Hc]].
    exists j. split; [| exact Hc].
    apply (rtc_l (wait_step ρ) a b j Hw Hpath).
Qed.

Lemma fully_reachable_seeded ρ : fully_reachable ρ -> seeded ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hfr i Hi.
  destruct (Hfr i) as [Hin | Hr].
  - exfalso. apply Hi. exact Hin.
  - exact (reachable_seed ρ i Hr).
Qed.

Lemma seeded_iff_fully_reachable ρ : seeded ρ <-> fully_reachable ρ.
Proof.
  split.
  - apply seeded_fully_reachable.
  - apply fully_reachable_seeded.
Qed.

(* A configuration with a live location and no steppable location is
   certainly not fully reachable. *)
Lemma reachable_no_can_step ρ i :
  (forall k, ~ can_step ρ k) -> reachable ρ i -> False.
Proof.
  intros Hns Hr. induction Hr as [k Hc | i j Hw Hr IH].
  - exact (Hns k Hc).
  - exact IH.
Qed.

Lemma no_can_step_not_fully_reachable ρ :
  (forall k, ~ can_step ρ k) ->
  (exists k, ρ !! k <> None) ->
  ~ fully_reachable ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hns [k Hk] Hfr.
  destruct (Hfr k) as [Hin | Hr].
  - unfold inactive in Hin. exact (Hk Hin).
  - exact (reachable_no_can_step ρ k Hns Hr).
Qed.

(* A rank is only needed on the non-steppable locations.  This is the
   exact relaxation needed because waiting cycles through steppable
   locations are harmless. *)

Definition rank_nonstep (ρ : cfg) (r : nat -> nat) (M : nat) : Prop :=
  (forall i, r i <= M) /\
  (forall i j, waiting ρ i j -> ~ can_step ρ i -> r i < r j).

Lemma waiting_target_live ρ (Hlive : wait_targets_live ρ) i j :
  waiting ρ i j -> ρ !! j <> None.
Proof.
  intros [[e [He Hw]] | [y [Hy _]]].
  - exact (Hlive i e j He Hw).
  - rewrite Hy. discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma rank_nonstep_seeded ρ r M
    (Hdec : forall i, {can_step ρ i} + {~ can_step ρ i}) :
  rank_nonstep ρ r M -> progress_or_wait ρ -> wait_targets_live ρ ->
  seeded ρ.
Proof.
  intros [Hb Hr] Hprog Hlive i Hi.
  revert Hi.
  apply (well_founded_ind
    (Wf_nat.well_founded_lt_compat nat (fun i => M - r i)
       (fun y x => M - r y < M - r x)
       (fun x y Hxy => Hxy))
    (fun i => ρ !! i <> None ->
      exists j, rtc (wait_step ρ) i j /\ can_step ρ j)).
  intros x IH Hx.
  destruct (Hdec x) as [Hc | Hnc].
  - exists x. split; [apply rtc_refl | exact Hc].
  - destruct (Hprog x Hx) as [Hc | [y Hw]].
    + exists x. split; [apply rtc_refl | exact Hc].
    + assert (Hlt : M - r y < M - r x).
      { pose proof (Hr x y Hw Hnc). pose proof (Hb x). pose proof (Hb y). lia. }
      assert (Hy : ρ !! y <> None).
      { apply (waiting_target_live ρ Hlive x y Hw). }
      destruct (IH y Hlt Hy) as [z [Hpath Hz]].
      exists z. split; [| exact Hz].
      apply (rtc_l (wait_step ρ) x y z Hw Hpath).
Qed.

(* ---------- elementary facts about references ---------- *)

Definition refs_live (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i y, ρ !! i = Some y -> forall j, j ∈ obj_refs y -> ρ !! j <> None.

Lemma ctx1_expr_refs k :
  ctx1 k -> forall e, expr_refs e ⊆ expr_refs (k e).
Proof.
  intros Hk e j Hj. destruct Hk; simpl; set_solver.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_expr_refs k :
  ctx k -> forall e, expr_refs e ⊆ expr_refs (k e).
Proof.
  intros Hk. induction Hk as [| k1 k2 H1 H2 IH2]; simpl.
  - intros e j Hj. exact Hj.
  - intros e j Hj. apply (ctx1_expr_refs k1 H1). apply IH2. exact Hj.
Qed.

Lemma expr_head_waiting_ref j e :
  expr_head_waiting e j -> j ∈ expr_refs e.
Proof.
  intros H. induction H; simpl; set_solver.
Qed.

Lemma ctx_head_waiting_ref k e j :
  ctx k -> expr_head_waiting e j -> j ∈ expr_refs (k e).
Proof.
  intros Hk Hh. apply (ctx_expr_refs k Hk e).
  apply expr_head_waiting_ref in Hh. exact Hh.
Qed.

Lemma expr_waiting_ref e j : expr_waiting e j -> j ∈ expr_refs e.
Proof.
  intros [k [e' [Hk [He Hh]]]]. subst e.
  apply ctx_head_waiting_ref; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma refs_live_wait_targets_live ρ :
  refs_live ρ -> wait_targets_live ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hlive i e j He Hw.
  apply (Hlive i (Thread e) He j).
  apply expr_waiting_ref in Hw. exact Hw.
Qed.

(* Lock types are never unrestricted. *)
Lemma unr_LockT l t : unr (LockT l t) -> False.
Proof. intros H. inversion H. Qed.

Lemma unr_fun_lin t1 t2 : unr (FunT Lin t1 t2) -> False.
Proof. intros H. inversion H. Qed.

Lemma unr_pair_l t1 t2 : unr (PairT t1 t2) -> unr t1.
Proof. intros H. inversion H. assumption. Qed.

Lemma unr_pair_r t1 t2 : unr (PairT t1 t2) -> unr t2.
Proof. intros H. inversion H. assumption. Qed.

Lemma unr_unit : unr UnitT.
Proof. constructor. Qed.

Lemma unr_fun_unr t1 t2 : unr (FunT Unr t1 t2).
Proof. constructor. Qed.

Lemma disjoint_env_no_dup_lock Γ1 Γ2 x l t :
  disj Γ1 Γ2 ->
  Γ1 !! x = Some (LockT l t) ->
  Γ2 !! x = Some (LockT l t) ->
  False.
Proof.
  intros Hd H1 H2.
  destruct (Hd x (LockT l t) (LockT l t) H1 H2) as [_ Hunr].
  exact (unr_LockT l t Hunr).
Qed.

(* Every local step has its label live in the source configuration. *)
Lemma local_step_label_live i ρ ρ' : local_step i ρ ρ' -> ρ !! i <> None.
Proof.
  intros H. induction H; simpl; intro E;
    match goal with
    | E : ?M = None |- False =>
        assert (His : is_Some M) by (apply elem_of_dom; set_solver);
        destruct His as [x Hx]; rewrite E in Hx; discriminate
    end.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* A finite total relation contains a directed cycle.                 *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* This is the combinatorial tool turning the fact that every live    *)
(* non-steppable node has an outgoing waiting edge, plus acyclicity,  *)
(* into seedability.  It is constructive (the stdpp finite_choice and *)
(* finite_pigeonhole are closed under the global context).            *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma iter_positive_clos_trans {A} (R : A -> A -> Prop) (f : A -> A)
    (Hf : forall x, R x (f x)) :
  forall (d:nat) (x:A), 0 < d -> @clos_trans A R x (@Nat.iter d A f x).
Proof.
  intros d. induction d as [|d IH]; intros x Hd.
  - lia.
  - destruct d as [|d'].
    + simpl. apply t_step. apply Hf.
    + rewrite Nat.iter_succ_r.
      eapply t_trans.
      * apply t_step. apply Hf.
      * apply IH. lia.
Qed.

Lemma finite_total_relation_cycle {A} `{EqDecision A} `{Finite A}
    (R : A -> A -> Prop) (a0 : A) :
  (forall x, exists y, R x y) -> exists (x:A), @clos_trans A R x x.
Proof.
  intros Htot.
  destruct (finite_choice (A := A) (B := fun _ => A)
              (fun x (y:A) => R x y) Htot) as [f Hf].
  set (n := card A).
  set (g := fun i : fin (S n) => @Nat.iter (fin_to_nat i) A f a0).
  assert (Hgt : card A < card (fin (S n))).
  { rewrite fin_card. fold n. lia. }
  destruct (finite_pigeonhole (A := fin (S n)) (B := A) g Hgt)
    as [x1 [x2 [Hne Heq]]].
  assert (Hne' : fin_to_nat x1 <> fin_to_nat x2).
  { intro E. apply Hne. apply fin_to_nat_inj. exact E. }
  destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec (fin_to_nat x1) (fin_to_nat x2))
    as [[Hlt|Heqn]|Hgtn].
  - set (d := fin_to_nat x2 - fin_to_nat x1).
    assert (Hd : 0 < d) by lia.
    assert (Hx2 : g x2 = @Nat.iter d A f (g x1)).
    { unfold g.
      replace (fin_to_nat x2) with (d + fin_to_nat x1) by lia.
      rewrite Nat.iter_add. reflexivity. }
    exists (g x1).
    pose proof (iter_positive_clos_trans R f Hf d (g x1) Hd) as Hc.
    rewrite <- Hx2 in Hc. rewrite <- Heq in Hc. exact Hc.
  - exfalso. apply Hne'. exact Heqn.
  - set (d := fin_to_nat x1 - fin_to_nat x2).
    assert (Hd : 0 < d) by lia.
    assert (Hx1 : g x1 = @Nat.iter d A f (g x2)).
    { unfold g.
      replace (fin_to_nat x1) with (d + fin_to_nat x2) by lia.
      rewrite Nat.iter_add. reflexivity. }
    exists (g x2).
    pose proof (iter_positive_clos_trans R f Hf d (g x2) Hd) as Hc.
    rewrite <- Hx1 in Hc. rewrite Heq in Hc. exact Hc.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Parallel/source reachability is the remaining semantic work.       *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma finite_orbit_cycle {A} `{EqDecision A} `{Finite A}
    (R : A -> A -> Prop) (a0 : A) :
  (forall x, exists y, R x y) ->
  exists (f:A->A) (k d:nat) (x:A),
    0 < d /\ (forall y, R y (f y)) /\
    x = @Nat.iter k A f a0 /\
    @Nat.iter d A f x = x /\
    @clos_trans A R x x.
Proof.
  intros Htot.
  destruct (finite_choice (A := A) (B := fun _ => A)
              (fun x (y:A) => R x y) Htot) as [f Hf].
  set (n := card A).
  set (g := fun i : fin (S n) => @Nat.iter (fin_to_nat i) A f a0).
  assert (Hgt : card A < card (fin (S n))).
  { rewrite fin_card. fold n. lia. }
  destruct (finite_pigeonhole (A := fin (S n)) (B := A) g Hgt)
    as [x1 [x2 [Hne Heq]]].
  assert (Hne' : fin_to_nat x1 <> fin_to_nat x2).
  { intro E. apply Hne. apply fin_to_nat_inj. exact E. }
  destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec (fin_to_nat x1) (fin_to_nat x2))
    as [[Hlt|Heqn]|Hgtn].
  - set (d := fin_to_nat x2 - fin_to_nat x1).
    assert (Hd : 0 < d) by lia.
    assert (Hx2 : g x2 = @Nat.iter d A f (g x1)).
    { unfold g. replace (fin_to_nat x2) with (d + fin_to_nat x1) by lia.
      rewrite Nat.iter_add. reflexivity. }
    assert (Hiter : @Nat.iter d A f (g x1) = g x1).
    { rewrite <- Hx2. exact (eq_sym Heq). }
    exists f, (fin_to_nat x1), d, (g x1).
    split; [exact Hd|]. split; [exact Hf|]. split; [reflexivity|].
    split; [exact Hiter|].
    pose proof (iter_positive_clos_trans R f Hf d (g x1) Hd) as Hc.
    rewrite Hiter in Hc. exact Hc.
  - exfalso. apply Hne'. exact Heqn.
  - set (d := fin_to_nat x1 - fin_to_nat x2).
    assert (Hd : 0 < d) by lia.
    assert (Hx1 : g x1 = @Nat.iter d A f (g x2)).
    { unfold g. replace (fin_to_nat x1) with (d + fin_to_nat x2) by lia.
      rewrite Nat.iter_add. reflexivity. }
    assert (Hiter : @Nat.iter d A f (g x2) = g x2).
    { rewrite <- Hx1. exact Heq. }
    exists f, (fin_to_nat x2), d, (g x2).
    split; [exact Hd|]. split; [exact Hf|]. split; [reflexivity|].
    split; [exact Hiter|].
    pose proof (iter_positive_clos_trans R f Hf d (g x2) Hd) as Hc.
    rewrite Hiter in Hc. exact Hc.
Qed.

(* max bound of a finite domain *)
Fixpoint list_max (l : list nat) : nat :=
  match l with [] => 0 | x :: xs => Nat.max x (list_max xs) end.

Lemma in_list_max (l:list nat) (x:nat) : x ∈ l -> x <= list_max l.
Proof.
  induction l as [|a l IH]; simpl; intros Hx.
  - set_solver.
  - apply elem_of_cons in Hx as [->|Hx].
    + apply Nat.le_max_l.
    + apply Nat.le_trans with (list_max l); [apply IH; exact Hx|apply Nat.le_max_r].
Qed.

Definition dom_max (ρ : cfg) : nat := list_max (elements (dom ρ)).
Definition dom_bound (ρ : cfg) : nat := S (dom_max ρ).

Lemma dom_live_lt (ρ:cfg) (i:nat) : i ∈ dom ρ -> i < dom_bound ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hi. unfold dom_bound, dom_max.
  apply Nat.lt_succ_r.
  apply in_list_max.
  rewrite elem_of_elements. exact Hi.
Qed.

Lemma dom_of_lookup (ρ:cfg) (i:nat) : ρ !! i <> None -> i ∈ dom ρ.
Proof.
  intros Hi. apply elem_of_dom.
  destruct (ρ !! i) as [o|] eqn:E; [eexists; exact E|done].
Qed.

Lemma lookup_of_dom (ρ:cfg) (i:nat) : i ∈ dom ρ -> ρ !! i <> None.
Proof.
  intros Hi E. exact ((proj2 (not_elem_of_dom ρ i) E) Hi).
Qed.

(* waiting-cycle iteration *)
Lemma waiting_iter_clos_trans ρ (h : nat -> nat)
    (Hh : forall j, waiting ρ (h j) (h (S j))) :
  forall j d, 0 < d -> @clos_trans nat (fun a b => waiting ρ a b) (h j) (h (j+d)).
Proof.
  intros j d. revert j. induction d as [|d IH]; intros j Hd.
  - lia.
  - destruct d as [|d'].
    + replace (j + 1) with (S j) by lia.
      apply t_step. apply Hh.
    + eapply t_trans.
      * replace (j + 1) with (S j) by lia. apply t_step. apply Hh.
      * replace (j + 1) with (S j) by lia.
        replace (j + S (S d')) with (S j + S d') by lia.
        apply IH. lia.
Qed.

(* Main reduction: progress + no live waiting cycle => seeded. *)
Lemma seeded_of_progress_acyclic ρ
    (Hprog : progress_or_wait ρ)
    (Hlive : wait_targets_live ρ)
    (Hacyc : forall i, i ∈ dom ρ ->
        ~ @clos_trans nat (fun a b => waiting ρ a b) i i) :
  seeded ρ.
Proof.
  intros i0 Hi0ne.
  pose proof (dom_of_lookup ρ i0 Hi0ne) as Hi0dom.
  set (N := dom_bound ρ).
  pose proof (dom_live_lt ρ i0 Hi0dom) as Hi0lt.
  pose (a0 := nat_to_fin Hi0lt).
  pose (R := fun (a b : fin N) =>
    (fin_to_nat a ∈ dom ρ /\
       (waiting ρ (fin_to_nat a) (fin_to_nat b) \/
        (can_step ρ (fin_to_nat a) /\ fin_to_nat b = fin_to_nat a)))
    \/ (~ fin_to_nat a ∈ dom ρ /\ b = a)).
  assert (Htot : forall a : fin N, exists b, R a b).
  { intros a. destruct (decide (fin_to_nat a ∈ dom ρ)) as [Hla|Hna].
    - destruct (Hprog (fin_to_nat a) (lookup_of_dom ρ (fin_to_nat a) Hla))
        as [Hc|[j Hw]].
      + exists a. left. split; [exact Hla|]. right. split; [exact Hc|reflexivity].
      + assert (Hjne : ρ !! j <> None).
        { destruct Hw as [[e [He Hw']]|[y [Hy _]]].
          - exact (Hlive _ _ _ He Hw').
          - rewrite Hy. discriminate. }
        pose proof (dom_of_lookup ρ j Hjne) as Hjdom.
        pose proof (dom_live_lt ρ j Hjdom) as Hjlt.
        exists (nat_to_fin Hjlt). left. split; [exact Hla|]. left.
        rewrite fin_to_nat_to_fin.
        exact Hw.
    - exists a. right. split; [exact Hna|reflexivity]. }
  destruct (classic (exists j, rtc (wait_step ρ) i0 j /\ can_step ρ j))
    as [Hseed|Hnotseed].
  - exact Hseed.
  - exfalso.
    destruct (finite_orbit_cycle R a0 Htot)
      as [f [k [d [x [Hd [Hf [Hx [Hiter Hc]]]]]]]].
    pose (g := fun j => @Nat.iter j (fin N) f a0).
    assert (Hga0 : g 0 = a0) by reflexivity.
    assert (Ha0 : fin_to_nat a0 = i0).
    { unfold a0. rewrite fin_to_nat_to_fin. reflexivity. }
    assert (Hedge : forall j,
      fin_to_nat (g j) ∈ dom ρ /\
      ~ can_step ρ (fin_to_nat (g j)) /\
      rtc (wait_step ρ) i0 (fin_to_nat (g j)) /\
      waiting ρ (fin_to_nat (g j)) (fin_to_nat (g (S j)))).
    { induction j as [|j IH].
      - split; [|split; [|split]].
        + rewrite Hga0. change (fin_to_nat a0 ∈ dom ρ). rewrite Ha0. exact Hi0dom.
        + intro Hcan. apply Hnotseed. exists i0.
          split; [apply rtc_refl|]. rewrite <- Ha0. exact Hcan.
        + rewrite Hga0. change (rtc (wait_step ρ) i0 (fin_to_nat a0)).
          rewrite Ha0. apply rtc_refl.
        + assert (Hg1 : g 1 = f a0) by reflexivity.
          rewrite Hg1.
          pose proof (Hf a0) as HR. unfold R in HR.
          destruct HR as [[Hla Hrest]|Hna].
          * destruct Hrest as [Hw|Hcan].
            -- rewrite Hga0. change (waiting ρ (fin_to_nat a0) (fin_to_nat (f a0))).
               exact Hw.
            -- exfalso. apply Hnotseed. exists i0.
               split; [apply rtc_refl|]. rewrite <- Ha0. exact (proj1 Hcan).
          * exfalso. apply Hna. change (fin_to_nat a0 ∈ dom ρ). rewrite Ha0. exact Hi0dom.
      - destruct IH as [Hlivej [Hncj [Hrtcj Hwj]]].
        assert (Htarget_ne : ρ !! (fin_to_nat (g (S j))) <> None).
        { destruct Hwj as [[e [He Hw']]|[y [Hy _]]].
          - exact (Hlive _ _ _ He Hw').
          - rewrite Hy. discriminate. }
        pose proof (dom_of_lookup ρ (fin_to_nat (g (S j))) Htarget_ne) as Hlivenext.
        assert (Hncnext : ~ can_step ρ (fin_to_nat (g (S j)))).
        { intro Hcan. apply Hnotseed. exists (fin_to_nat (g (S j))).
          split; [|exact Hcan].
          eapply rtc_r; [exact Hrtcj|exact Hwj]. }
        split; [exact Hlivenext|split; [exact Hncnext|split]].
        + eapply rtc_r; [exact Hrtcj|exact Hwj].
        + assert (HgSS : g (S (S j)) = f (g (S j))) by reflexivity.
          rewrite HgSS.
          pose proof (Hf (g (S j))) as HR. unfold R in HR.
          destruct HR as [[Hla Hrest]|Hna].
          * destruct Hrest as [Hw|Hcan].
            -- exact Hw.
            -- exfalso. apply Hncnext. exact (proj1 Hcan).
          * exfalso. apply Hna. exact Hlivenext. }
    (* the orbit property at k+d closes a waiting cycle *)
    assert (Hgk : x = g k) by exact Hx.
    assert (Hgadd : g (k + d) = g k).
    { unfold g. replace (k + d) with (d + k) by lia.
      rewrite Nat.iter_add.
      rewrite <- Hx. exact Hiter. }
    assert (Hh : forall j, waiting ρ (fin_to_nat (g (k + j)))
                                  (fin_to_nat (g (k + S j)))).
    { intro j. replace (k + S j) with (S (k + j)) by lia.
      exact (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (Hedge (k + j))))). }
    destruct (Hedge k) as [Hlivek _].
    pose proof (waiting_iter_clos_trans ρ
                  (fun j => fin_to_nat (g (k + j))) Hh 0 d Hd) as Hcyc.
    simpl in Hcyc.
    replace (k + 0) with k in Hcyc by lia.
    replace (0 + d) with d in Hcyc by lia.
    assert (Hend : fin_to_nat (g (k + d)) = fin_to_nat (g k)).
    { rewrite Hgadd. reflexivity. }
    rewrite Hend in Hcyc.
    exact (Hacyc (fin_to_nat (g k)) Hlivek Hcyc).
Qed.

From stdpp Require Import gmap.

From stdpp Require Export finite.

Fixpoint insert2 {T} (i : nat) (x : T) (xs : list T) : list T :=
  match i,xs with
  | 0,xs => x :: xs
  | S i',y :: xs => y :: insert2 i' x xs
  | S i',[] => [x]
  end.

Section disjoint.

Context `{Countable K}.

Context {V : Type}.

Definition disjoint (xs : list (gmap K V)) :=
    forall i j h1 h2,
        xs !! i = Some h1 -> xs !! j = Some h2 -> i ≠ j -> h1 ##ₘ h2.

End disjoint.

Definition fin_list {A} n (f : fin n -> A) : list A := vec_to_list (fun_to_vec f).

Definition fin_gset `{Countable A} n (f : fin n -> A) : gset A
  := list_to_set (fin_list n f).

Definition all_fin n := fin_gset n id.

Definition big_union `{Countable A} : gset (gset A) -> gset A := set_fold (∪) ∅.

Definition fin_union `{Countable A} n (f : fin n -> gset A) : gset A :=
  big_union (fin_gset n f).

Fixpoint list_to_mapi' {A} (xs : list A) (n : nat) : gmap nat A :=
  match xs with
  | [] => ∅
  | x::r => <[ n := x ]> (list_to_mapi' r (S n))
  end.

Definition list_to_mapi {A} (xs : list A) := list_to_mapi' xs 0.

Definition fin_gmap {T} n : (fin n -> T) -> gmap nat T := list_to_mapi ∘ fin_list n.

From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String.
Open Scope string_scope.
From stdpp Require Import gmap.
From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.
From Stdlib Require Import Lists.List.
Import ListNotations.

(* Candidate counterexample: a ForkBarrier child is left waiting forever,
   while the parent stores its barrier capability in a lock and then drops the
   lock capability.  The final configuration contains a live Barrier and a
   thread stuck at an application of that Barrier, with no matching second
   application, so neither is reachable. *)

Definition child_fun : expr :=
  Fun "b2" (App (Var "b2") Unit).

Definition lock_child_fun : expr :=
  Fun "y" (App (Wait (Var "y")) Unit).

Definition parent_body : expr :=
  App (Fun "l" (Drop (ForkLock (Var "l") lock_child_fun)))
      (NewLock (Var "b")).

Definition e : expr :=
  App (Fun "b" parent_body) (ForkBarrier child_fun).

Definition BT : type := FunT Lin UnitT UnitT.

(* ---------- environment helpers ---------- *)

Lemma env_union_empty_l (m : env) : ∅ ∪ m = m.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro x. rewrite lookup_union.
  rewrite lookup_empty. destruct (m !! x); reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma env_union_empty_r (m : env) : m ∪ ∅ = m.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro x. rewrite lookup_union.
  rewrite lookup_empty. destruct (m !! x); reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma env_split_nil : env_split (∅ : env) ∅ ∅.
Proof.
  unfold env_split, env, disj.
  split.
  - apply map_eq. intro y.
    change (((∅ : gmap string type) ∪ (∅ : gmap string type)) !! y = None).
    rewrite lookup_union, !lookup_empty. reflexivity.
  - intros i t1 t2 H1 H2.
    change ((∅ : gmap string type) !! i = Some t1) in H1.
    rewrite lookup_empty in H1. discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma env_split_singleton_r x t :
  env_split ({[ x := t ]} : env) ∅ {[ x := t ]}.
Proof.
  unfold env_split, env, disj.
  split.
  - apply map_eq. intro y.
    change (({[x:=t]} : gmap string type) !! y =
            ((∅ : gmap string type) ∪ ({[x:=t]} : gmap string type)) !! y).
    rewrite lookup_union, lookup_empty.
    destruct (({[x:=t]} : gmap string type) !! y); reflexivity.
  - intros i t1 t2 H1 H2.
    change ((∅ : gmap string type) !! i = Some t1) in H1.
    rewrite lookup_empty in H1. discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma env_split_singleton_l x t :
  env_split ({[ x := t ]} : env) {[ x := t ]} ∅.
Proof.
  unfold env_split, env, disj.
  split.
  - apply map_eq. intro y.
    change (({[x:=t]} : gmap string type) !! y =
            (({[x:=t]} : gmap string type) ∪ (∅ : gmap string type)) !! y).
    rewrite lookup_union, lookup_empty.
    destruct (({[x:=t]} : gmap string type) !! y); reflexivity.
  - intros i t1 t2 H1 H2.
    change ((∅ : gmap string type) !! i = Some t2) in H2.
    rewrite lookup_empty in H2. discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma env_unr_empty : env_unr (∅ : env).
Proof.
  unfold env_unr, env.
  intros x t H.
  change ((∅ : gmap string type) !! x = Some t) in H.
  rewrite lookup_empty in H. discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma env_unr_singleton x t : env_unr ({[ x := t ]} : env) -> unr t.
Proof.
  intros H. apply (H x t). apply lookup_singleton_eq.
Qed.

(* ---------- typing of the source term ---------- *)

Lemma typed_child_fun : typed ∅ child_fun (FunT Lin BT UnitT).
Proof.
  unfold child_fun, BT.
  eapply Fun_typed.
  - split.
    + apply map_eq. intro z. rewrite lookup_insert_eq.
      destruct (decide ("b2" = z)) as [->|H].
      * rewrite lookup_insert_eq. reflexivity.
      * rewrite lookup_insert_ne by (intro E; apply H; symmetry; exact E).
        rewrite lookup_empty. reflexivity.
    + intros t' H. unfold env in H. rewrite lookup_empty in H. discriminate.
  - intros H. discriminate H.
  - eapply App_typed with (Γ1 := {[ "b2" := FunT Lin UnitT UnitT ]}) (Γ2 := ∅).
    + apply env_split_singleton_r.
    + apply Var_typed. exists ∅. split; [reflexivity|apply env_unr_empty].
    + apply Unit_typed. apply env_unr_empty.
Qed.

(** Given a function [fin n → A], we can construct a vector. *)
Fixpoint fun_to_vec {A n} {struct n} : (fin n → A) → vec A n :=
  match n with
  | 0 => λ f, [#]
  | S n => λ f, f 0%fin ::: fun_to_vec (f ∘ FS)
  end.

Lemma lookup_fun_to_vec {A n} (f : fin n → A) i : fun_to_vec f !!! i = f i.
Proof.
  revert f. induction i as [|n i IH]; intros f; simpl; [done|]. by rewrite IH.
Qed.

(** The function [vmap f v] applies a function [f] element wise to [v]. *)
Notation vmap := Vector.map.

Require Import base.
From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.
From stdpp Require Import gmap.
From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String.
Open Scope string_scope.

Section Subst.

Context (L : gmap nat type).

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Substitution lemma.                                                *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* We substitute a *value* [a] for a variable [x] in a term [e] typed  *)
(* under [Γ].  The result is typed under [delete x Γ].                 *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* The hypothesis [(Γ !! x = Some t1 -> cv L a t1)] is vacuous when    *)
(* [x] is not bound in [Γ]; in that case no value typing is needed.    *)
(* This single uniform statement is what makes the induction go        *)
(* through without extensionality: in the "variable absent" case no    *)
(* rewriting of the substituted term is required.                     *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma wt_subst_aux :
  forall (Γ : env) (e : expr) (t : type), wt L Γ e t ->
  forall x a, (forall t1, Γ !! x = Some t1 -> cv L a t1) ->
  wt L (delete x Γ) (subst x a e) t.
Proof.
  intros Γ e t H.
  induction H as

  (* DropW *)
  - intros y b Hcv. simpl. eapply DropW. apply (IH1 y b). exact Hcv.

  (* ValW *)
  - intros y b Hcv. simpl. apply ValW.
    + apply env_unr_delete. exact Hunr.
    + exact Hcv0.
Qed.

(* The usable form. *)
Lemma wt_subst Γ e t (Hwt : wt L Γ e t) x a t1
    (Hx : Γ !! x = Some t1) (Hcv : cv L a t1) :
  wt L (delete x Γ) (subst x a e) t.
Proof.
  apply (wt_subst_aux Γ e t Hwt x a).
  intros t1' Hx'.
  pose proof Hx as H.
  rewrite Hx' in H. injection H as ->. exact Hcv.
Qed.

(* Closed instantiation: substituting into a singleton environment. *)
Lemma wt_subst_singleton x a t1 e t2
    (Hcv : cv L a t1) (Hwt : wt L (<[x:=t1]>(∅ : env)) e t2) :
  wt L ∅ (subst x a e) t2.
Proof.
  pose proof (wt_subst (<[x:=t1]>(∅ : env)) e t2 Hwt x a t1
                (env_lookup_insert_same x t1) Hcv) as H.
  rewrite delete_insert_same_env in H.
  rewrite delete_empty_env in H.
  exact H.
Qed.

Print Assumptions wt_subst.
Print Assumptions wt_subst_singleton.

End Subst.
