From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.
From stdpp Require Import gmap.
From Stdlib Require Import List Arith Lia.
From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String.
Require Import AllCombine.
Require Import KindLiveFacts.
Open Scope string_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Side conditions for the scratch6 pair/forest rewiring lemmas,       *)
(* derived from [kind_live] + [refs_live].                             *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* [PairMove.pair_move_add] needs, for a bundle [B] moved into [i]:    *)
(*     i ∉ B                                                           *)
(*     forall b, b ∈ B -> i ∉ T b                                      *)
(* [ForestMove.forest_rewire_star_at_i] additionally needs [G i n],    *)
(* [i ≠ n], [n ∉ R] and the old-source bundle to be exactly the old    *)
(* out-neighbours of [n].  The two conditions above are the ones that  *)
(* involve references of values and are supplied by kind liveness.     *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* Key fact (KindLiveFacts): under [kind_live], a live thread is never *)
(* referenced by any live object.  Thus whenever the destination of a  *)
(* move is a thread, both pair conditions follow.                      *)
(* ================================================================== *)

(* A live thread does not reference itself. *)
Lemma kind_live_thread_no_self_ref (ρ : cfg) i e
    (Hkind : kind_live ρ) (Hi : ρ !! i = Some (Thread e)) :
  i ∉ refs_at ρ i.
Proof.
  apply (kind_live_no_thread_in_refs_at ρ i e i Hkind Hi).
  rewrite Hi. discriminate.
Qed.

(* The bundle is exactly the out-neighbours of a live old holder [n]
   (Acquire and Wait: the lock content; the pre-state lock's refs are
   precisely [val_refs v]).  If the destination [i] is a live thread,
   both pair conditions hold.  [refs_live] is used to know that every
   node of the bundle is live, so that kind liveness applies to it. *)
Lemma kind_live_bundle_from_object_side
    (ρ : cfg) (i e n : nat)
    (Hkind : kind_live ρ) (Hrl : refs_live ρ)
    (Hi : ρ !! i = Some (Thread e)) (Hn : ρ !! n <> None) :
  i ∉ refs_at ρ n /\
  (forall b, b ∈ refs_at ρ n -> i ∉ refs_at ρ b).
Proof.
  split.
  - apply (kind_live_no_thread_in_refs_at ρ i e n Hkind Hi Hn).
  - intros b Hb.
    apply (kind_live_no_thread_in_refs_at ρ i e b Hkind Hi).
    destruct (ρ !! n) as [y|] eqn:En; [|done].
    exact (Hrl n y En b Hb).
Qed.

(* The bundle is [val_refs v] for a value [v] occurring in the live
   thread [s] (Sync, and the value argument of Release/NewLock/ForkLock
   when the destination is a fresh or thread object).  If the
   destination [i] is a live thread, both pair conditions hold. *)
Lemma kind_live_bundle_from_thread_side
    (ρ : cfg) (s i : nat) (e : expr) (v : val)
    (Hkind : kind_live ρ) (Hrl : refs_live ρ)
    (Hs : ρ !! s = Some (Thread e))
    (Hi : ρ !! i = Some (Thread (Var "dst")))
    (Hsub : forall b, b ∈ val_refs v -> b ∈ expr_refs e) :
  i ∉ val_refs v /\
  (forall b, b ∈ val_refs v -> i ∉ refs_at ρ b).
Proof.
  split.
  - intro Hiv.
    assert (Hin : i ∈ expr_refs e) by (apply Hsub; exact Hiv).
    assert (Hri : i ∈ refs_at ρ s).
    { unfold refs_at. rewrite Hs. exact Hin. }
    exact (kind_live_no_thread_in_refs_at ρ s e i Hkind Hs
             (by rewrite Hi; discriminate) Hri).
  - intros b Hb.
    assert (Hin : b ∈ expr_refs e) by (apply Hsub; exact Hb).
    assert (Hb_live : ρ !! b <> None).
    { unfold refs_at in *. rewrite Hs in Hin. exact (Hrl s (Thread e) Hs b Hin). }
    exact (kind_live_no_thread_in_refs_at ρ s e b Hkind Hs Hb_live).
Qed.

(* Fresh destinations (NewLock, Fork, ForkLock) never have incoming
   references: otherwise [refs_live] would make the fresh index live. *)
Lemma fresh_dest_no_backrefs (ρ : cfg) (n : nat)
    (Hrl : refs_live ρ) (Hfresh : ρ !! n = None) :
  (forall b, ρ !! b <> None -> n ∉ refs_at ρ b) /\
  (forall B, (forall b, b ∈ B -> ρ !! b <> None) -> n ∉ B).
Proof.
  split.
  - intros b Hb Hnb.
    destruct (ρ !! b) as [y|] eqn:Eb; [|done].
    exact (Hrl b y Eb n Hnb (by rewrite Hfresh; discriminate)).
  - intros B HB HnB.
    exact (HB n HnB (by rewrite Hfresh; discriminate)).
Qed.

Print Assumptions kind_live_thread_no_self_ref.
Print Assumptions kind_live_bundle_from_object_side.
Print Assumptions kind_live_bundle_from_thread_side.
Print Assumptions fresh_dest_no_backrefs.
EOF

Definition cap_inventory
    (ρ : cfg)
    (caps : nat -> lockcap -> gset nat)   (* lock n, capability state lc *)
    (bend : nat -> gset nat)              (* barrier n, endpoint holders *)
    : Prop :=
  (* every capability occurrence is in a live object which references n *)
  (forall n lc j, j ∈ caps n lc -> ρ !! j <> None) /\
  (forall n lc j, j ∈ caps n lc ->
     exists y, ρ !! j = Some y /\ n ∈ obj_refs y) /\
  (* a blocked holder of a capability for n exposes a step at n *)
  (forall n lc j e,
     j ∈ caps n lc -> ρ !! j = Some (Thread e) -> expr_waiting e n ->
     can_step ρ n) /\
  (* exactly one Opened capability when the lock content is absent *)
  (forall n rc, ρ !! n = Some (Lock rc None) ->
     exists j, caps n (Owner,Opened) ∪ caps n (Client,Opened) = {[j]}) /\
  (* no Opened capability when the lock has content *)
  (forall n rc v, ρ !! n = Some (Lock rc (Some v)) ->
     caps n (Owner,Opened) ∪ caps n (Client,Opened) = ∅) /\
  (* a lock with content has a capability holder (an owner/referencer) *)
  (forall n rc v, ρ !! n = Some (Lock rc (Some v)) ->
     exists lc j, j ∈ caps n lc) /\
  (* [refcnt] counts Client capabilities *)
  (forall n rc o, ρ !! n = Some (Lock rc o) ->
     (0 < rc <-> exists j, j ∈ caps n (Client,Closed) ∪ caps n (Client,Opened))) /\
  (* a live barrier has exactly two endpoint holders *)
  (forall n, ρ !! n = Some Barrier ->
     exists a b, a <> b /\ bend n = {[a;b]}) /\
  (* endpoints live and reference the barrier *)
  (forall n j, j ∈ bend n -> ρ !! j <> None) /\

From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.
From stdpp Require Import gmap.
From Stdlib Require Import List Arith Lia.
From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String.
Import ListNotations.
Require Import AllCombine.
Open Scope string_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* A Release-oriented obstruction to pair/forest preservation.         *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* The destination of Release is a lock, not a live thread, so the     *)
(* [kind_live] "no live object refers to a live thread" argument      *)
(* does not apply.  This file machine-checks that all the other       *)
(* invariants we have (typed threads, cap_inventory, refs_live,        *)
(* ref_pair_ok, ref_forest) do not prevent Release from creating a     *)
(* self-reference at the destination lock.                             *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* The witness deliberately uses [BarrierV 1] to reference lock 1:    *)
(* that is what makes the source NOT kind_live.  A kind-live witness   *)
(* would have to reference lock 1 via [LockV 1], which forces the      *)
(* deposited type [t = L 1] to satisfy [t = LockT _ t].  The current   *)
(* permissive [cv] has no such derivation, so this is precisely the    *)
(* extra lock-content acyclicity fact needed for the Release case.     *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition rx_t : type := FunT Lin UnitT UnitT.
Definition rx_L : gmap nat type := {[1 := rx_t]}.

Lemma rx_L1 : rx_L !! 1 = Some rx_t.
Proof. unfold rx_L. apply lookup_singleton_eq. Qed.

Definition rx_inner : expr := Release (Val (LockV 1)) (Val (BarrierV 1)).
Definition rx_e : expr := Drop rx_inner.

Lemma rx_inner_wt : wt rx_L ∅ rx_inner (LockT (Client,Closed) rx_t).
Proof.
  unfold rx_inner.
  eapply ReleaseW with (Γ1 := ∅) (Γ2 := ∅) (lo := Client).
  - apply env_split_nil.
  - apply ValW.
    + apply env_unr_empty.
    + change (cv rx_L (LockV 1) (LockT (Client,Opened) rx_t)).
      apply LockVW. exact rx_L1.
  - apply ValW.
    + apply env_unr_empty.
    + unfold rx_t. apply BarrierVW.
Qed.

Lemma rx_e_wt : wt rx_L ∅ rx_e UnitT.
Proof.
  unfold rx_e.
  eapply DropW.
  exact rx_inner_wt.
Qed.

Definition rx_src : cfg := {[0 := Thread rx_e; 1 := Lock 0 None]}.
Definition rx_tgt : cfg :=
  {[0 := Thread (Drop (Val (LockV 1)));
    1 := Lock 0 (Some (BarrierV 1))]}.

(* ---------- lookups ---------- *)

Lemma rx_src_lookup0 : rx_src !! 0 = Some (Thread rx_e).
Proof.
  unfold rx_src.
  change ((<[0 := Thread rx_e]> (<[1 := Lock 0 None]> (∅ : cfg))) !! 0
          = Some (Thread rx_e)).
  apply lookup_insert_eq.
Qed.

Lemma rx_src_lookup1 : rx_src !! 1 = Some (Lock 0 None).
Proof.
  unfold rx_src.
  change ((<[0 := Thread rx_e]> (<[1 := Lock 0 None]> (∅ : cfg))) !! 1
          = Some (Lock 0 None)).
  assert (H : (<[0 := Thread rx_e]> (<[1 := Lock 0 None]> (∅ : cfg))) !! 1
              = (<[1 := Lock 0 None]> (∅ : cfg)) !! 1).
  { apply lookup_insert_ne. lia. }
  rewrite H. apply lookup_insert_eq.
Qed.

Lemma rx_src_lookup_other n (H0 : n <> 0) (H1 : n <> 1) :
  rx_src !! n = None.
Proof.
  unfold rx_src.
  change ((<[0 := Thread rx_e]> (<[1 := Lock 0 None]> (∅ : cfg))) !! n = None).
  assert (H01 : (<[0 := Thread rx_e]> (<[1 := Lock 0 None]> (∅ : cfg))) !! n
                = (<[1 := Lock 0 None]> (∅ : cfg)) !! n).
  { apply lookup_insert_ne. congruence. }
  assert (H12 : (<[1 := Lock 0 None]> (∅ : cfg)) !! n = (∅ : cfg) !! n).
  { apply lookup_insert_ne. congruence. }
  rewrite H01, H12. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma rx_tgt_lookup0 :
  rx_tgt !! 0 = Some (Thread (Drop (Val (LockV 1)))).
Proof.
  unfold rx_tgt.
  change ((<[0 := Thread (Drop (Val (LockV 1)))]>
            (<[1 := Lock 0 (Some (BarrierV 1))]> (∅ : cfg))) !! 0
          = Some (Thread (Drop (Val (LockV 1))))).
  apply lookup_insert_eq.
Qed.

Lemma rx_tgt_lookup1 :
  rx_tgt !! 1 = Some (Lock 0 (Some (BarrierV 1))).
Proof.
  unfold rx_tgt.
  change ((<[0 := Thread (Drop (Val (LockV 1)))]>
            (<[1 := Lock 0 (Some (BarrierV 1))]> (∅ : cfg))) !! 1
          = Some (Lock 0 (Some (BarrierV 1)))).
  assert (H : (<[0 := Thread (Drop (Val (LockV 1)))]>
               (<[1 := Lock 0 (Some (BarrierV 1))]> (∅ : cfg))) !! 1
              = (<[1 := Lock 0 (Some (BarrierV 1))]> (∅ : cfg)) !! 1).
  { apply lookup_insert_ne. lia. }
  rewrite H. apply lookup_insert_eq.
Qed.

Lemma rx_tgt_lookup_other n (H0 : n <> 0) (H1 : n <> 1) :
  rx_tgt !! n = None.
Proof.
  unfold rx_tgt.
  change ((<[0 := Thread (Drop (Val (LockV 1)))]>
            (<[1 := Lock 0 (Some (BarrierV 1))]> (∅ : cfg))) !! n = None).
  assert (H01 : (<[0 := Thread (Drop (Val (LockV 1)))]>
                  (<[1 := Lock 0 (Some (BarrierV 1))]> (∅ : cfg))) !! n
                = (<[1 := Lock 0 (Some (BarrierV 1))]> (∅ : cfg)) !! n).
  { apply lookup_insert_ne. congruence. }
  assert (H12 : (<[1 := Lock 0 (Some (BarrierV 1))]> (∅ : cfg)) !! n
                = (∅ : cfg) !! n).
  { apply lookup_insert_ne. congruence. }
  rewrite H01, H12. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* ---------- reference sets ---------- *)

Lemma rx_src_refs0 : refs_at rx_src 0 = {[1]}.
Proof.
  unfold refs_at. rewrite rx_src_lookup0.
  unfold rx_e, rx_inner. simpl. set_solver.
Qed.

Lemma rx_src_refs1 : refs_at rx_src 1 = ∅.
Proof.
  unfold refs_at. rewrite rx_src_lookup1. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma rx_src_refs_other n (H0 : n <> 0) (H1 : n <> 1) :
  refs_at rx_src n = ∅.
Proof.
  unfold refs_at. rewrite rx_src_lookup_other; [reflexivity|exact H0|exact H1].
Qed.

Lemma rx_tgt_refs0 : refs_at rx_tgt 0 = {[1]}.
Proof.
  unfold refs_at. rewrite rx_tgt_lookup0. simpl. set_solver.
Qed.

Lemma rx_tgt_refs1 : refs_at rx_tgt 1 = {[1]}.
Proof.
  unfold refs_at. rewrite rx_tgt_lookup1. simpl. set_solver.
Qed.

Lemma rx_tgt_refs_other n (H0 : n <> 0) (H1 : n <> 1) :
  refs_at rx_tgt n = ∅.
Proof.
  unfold refs_at. rewrite rx_tgt_lookup_other; [reflexivity|exact H0|exact H1].
Qed.

(* ---------- the step ---------- *)

Definition rx_ctx : expr -> expr := fun x => Drop x.

Lemma rx_ctx_ctx : ctx rx_ctx.
Proof. unfold rx_ctx. apply (Ctx_comp Ctx_Drop Ctx_id). Qed.

Lemma rx_release_local : local_step 1 rx_src rx_tgt.
Proof.
  unfold rx_src, rx_tgt, rx_e, rx_inner, rx_ctx.
  apply (Release_step (BarrierV 1) (Ctx_comp Ctx_Drop Ctx_id) 0 1 0).
  lia.
Qed.

Lemma rx_union_empty_r (m : cfg) : m ∪ ∅ = m.
Proof.
  apply map_eq. intro x. apply lookup_union_l. apply lookup_empty.
Qed.

Lemma rx_step : step 1 rx_src rx_tgt.
Proof.
  assert (E1 : rx_src = rx_src ∪ ∅) by (symmetry; apply rx_union_empty_r).
  assert (E2 : rx_tgt = rx_tgt ∪ ∅) by (symmetry; apply rx_union_empty_r).
  rewrite E1, E2.
  eapply Frame_step;
    [apply map_disjoint_empty_r | apply map_disjoint_empty_r | exact rx_release_local].
Qed.

(* ---------- thread typing, source and target ---------- *)

Lemma rx_src_threads_typed : threads_typed rx_L rx_src.
Proof.
  intros i e Hi.
  destruct (decide (i = 0)) as [E|E].
  - subst i. rewrite rx_src_lookup0 in Hi. inversion Hi; subst e. exact rx_e_wt.
  - destruct (decide (i = 1)) as [E1|E1].
    + subst i. rewrite rx_src_lookup1 in Hi. discriminate.
    + rewrite rx_src_lookup_other in Hi;
        [discriminate | exact E | exact E1].
Qed.

Lemma rx_tgt_thread_wt : wt rx_L ∅ (Drop (Val (LockV 1))) UnitT.
Proof.
  eapply DropW.
  apply ValW.
  - apply env_unr_empty.
  - change (cv rx_L (LockV 1) (LockT (Client,Closed) rx_t)).
    apply LockVW. exact rx_L1.
Qed.

Lemma rx_tgt_threads_typed : threads_typed rx_L rx_tgt.
Proof.
  intros i e Hi.
  destruct (decide (i = 0)) as [E|E].
  - subst i. rewrite rx_tgt_lookup0 in Hi. inversion Hi; subst e.
    exact rx_tgt_thread_wt.
  - destruct (decide (i = 1)) as [E1|E1].
    + subst i. rewrite rx_tgt_lookup1 in Hi. discriminate.
    + rewrite rx_tgt_lookup_other in Hi;
        [discriminate | exact E | exact E1].
Qed.
EOF

From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.
From stdpp Require Import gmap.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Kind-respecting reference sets.                                    *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* [expr_refs] / [val_refs] forget whether a reference came from a    *)
(* [LockV] or a [BarrierV].  These traversals keep the two kinds       *)
(* apart, so a configuration can be required to have every [LockV n]   *)
(* point at a live [Lock] and every [BarrierV n] at a live [Barrier].  *)
(* Counts are still set-based: this is exactly the set of indices      *)
(* occurring with the given constructor, not a multiplicity.           *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint expr_lock_refs (e : expr) : gset nat :=
  match e with
  | Val v => val_lock_refs v
  | Var _ => ∅
  | Fun _ e => expr_lock_refs e
  | App e1 e2 => expr_lock_refs e1 ∪ expr_lock_refs e2
  | Unit => ∅
  | Pair e1 e2 => expr_lock_refs e1 ∪ expr_lock_refs e2
  | LetPair e1 e2 => expr_lock_refs e1 ∪ expr_lock_refs e2
  | Sum _ e => expr_lock_refs e
  | MatchSum n e es => expr_lock_refs e ∪ fin_union n (expr_lock_refs ∘ es)
  | ForkBarrier e => expr_lock_refs e
  | NewLock e => expr_lock_refs e
  | ForkLock e1 e2 => expr_lock_refs e1 ∪ expr_lock_refs e2
  | Acquire e => expr_lock_refs e
  | Release e1 e2 => expr_lock_refs e1 ∪ expr_lock_refs e2
  | Wait e => expr_lock_refs e
  | Drop e => expr_lock_refs e
  end
with val_lock_refs (v : val) : gset nat :=
  match v with
  | FunV _ e => expr_lock_refs e
  | UnitV => ∅
  | PairV v1 v2 => val_lock_refs v1 ∪ val_lock_refs v2
  | SumV _ v => val_lock_refs v
  | BarrierV _ => ∅
  | LockV n => {[n]}
  end.

Fixpoint expr_barrier_refs (e : expr) : gset nat :=
  match e with
  | Val v => val_barrier_refs v
  | Var _ => ∅
  | Fun _ e => expr_barrier_refs e
  | App e1 e2 => expr_barrier_refs e1 ∪ expr_barrier_refs e2
  | Unit => ∅
  | Pair e1 e2 => expr_barrier_refs e1 ∪ expr_barrier_refs e2
  | LetPair e1 e2 => expr_barrier_refs e1 ∪ expr_barrier_refs e2
  | Sum _ e => expr_barrier_refs e
  | MatchSum n e es => expr_barrier_refs e ∪ fin_union n (expr_barrier_refs ∘ es)
  | ForkBarrier e => expr_barrier_refs e
  | NewLock e => expr_barrier_refs e
  | ForkLock e1 e2 => expr_barrier_refs e1 ∪ expr_barrier_refs e2
  | Acquire e => expr_barrier_refs e
  | Release e1 e2 => expr_barrier_refs e1 ∪ expr_barrier_refs e2
  | Wait e => expr_barrier_refs e
  | Drop e => expr_barrier_refs e
  end
with val_barrier_refs (v : val) : gset nat :=
  match v with
  | FunV _ e => expr_barrier_refs e
  | UnitV => ∅
  | PairV v1 v2 => val_barrier_refs v1 ∪ val_barrier_refs v2
  | SumV _ v => val_barrier_refs v
  | BarrierV n => {[n]}
  | LockV _ => ∅
  end.

(* Kind liveness: every kind-specific reference in a live object points
   at a live object of that kind. *)

Definition kind_lock_live (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  (forall i e n, ρ !! i = Some (Thread e) ->
     n ∈ expr_lock_refs e -> exists rc o, ρ !! n = Some (Lock rc o)) /\
  (forall i rc (o : option val) v n, ρ !! i = Some (Lock rc (Some v)) ->
     n ∈ val_lock_refs v -> exists rc' o', ρ !! n = Some (Lock rc' o')).

Definition kind_barrier_live (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  (forall i e n, ρ !! i = Some (Thread e) ->
     n ∈ expr_barrier_refs e -> ρ !! n = Some Barrier) /\
  (forall i rc (o : option val) v n, ρ !! i = Some (Lock rc (Some v)) ->
     n ∈ val_barrier_refs v -> ρ !! n = Some Barrier).

Definition kind_live (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  kind_lock_live ρ /\ kind_barrier_live ρ.
EXIT=0

Lemma nodup_all_eq_le1 (l : list nat) (c : nat) :
  NoDup l -> (forall x, x ∈ l -> x = c) -> length l <= 1.
Proof.
  induction l as [|x xs IH]; simpl; intros Hnd Hall; [lia|].
  inversion Hnd as [|? ? Hnot Hnd']; subst.
  assert (Hxs : forall y, y ∈ xs -> y = c).
  { intros y Hy. apply Hall. right. exact Hy. }
  specialize (IH Hnd' Hxs). lia.
Qed.

Lemma nodup_two_values_le2 (l : list nat) (a b : nat) :
  NoDup l -> (forall x, x ∈ l -> x = a \/ x = b) -> length l <= 2.
Proof.
  destruct l as [|x xs]; simpl; intros Hnd Hall; [lia|].
  inversion Hnd as [|? ? Hnot Hnd']; subst.
  destruct (Hall x (or_introl eq_refl)) as [Exa|Exb].
  - subst x.
    assert (Hxs : forall y, y ∈ xs -> y = b).
    { intros y Hy.
      destruct (Hall y (or_intror Hy)) as [Ea|Eb]; [|exact Eb].
      subst y. exfalso. apply Hnot. exact Hy. }
    specialize (nodup_all_eq_le1 xs b Hnd' Hxs). lia.
  - subst x.
    assert (Hxs : forall y, y ∈ xs -> y = a).
    { intros y Hy.
      destruct (Hall y (or_intror Hy)) as [Ea|Eb]; [exact Ea|].
      subst y. exfalso. apply Hnot. exact Hy. }
    specialize (nodup_all_eq_le1 xs a Hnd' Hxs). lia.
Qed.

From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String.
From stdpp Require Import gmap.

From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Export langtools.

Inductive expr :=
  | Val : val -> expr
  | Var : string -> expr
  | Fun : string -> expr -> expr
  | App : expr -> expr -> expr
  | Unit : expr
  | Pair : expr -> expr -> expr
  | LetPair : expr -> expr -> expr
  | Sum : nat -> expr -> expr
  | MatchSum n : expr -> (fin n -> expr) -> expr

  | ForkBarrier : expr -> expr

  | NewLock : expr -> expr
  | ForkLock : expr -> expr -> expr
  | Acquire : expr -> expr
  | Release : expr -> expr -> expr
  | Wait : expr -> expr
  | Drop : expr -> expr
with val :=
  | FunV : string -> expr -> val
  | UnitV : val
  | PairV : val -> val -> val
  | SumV : nat -> val -> val
  | BarrierV : nat -> val
  | LockV : nat -> val.

Inductive linearity := Lin | Unr.

Inductive lockstate := Opened | Closed.

Inductive lockownership := Owner | Client.

Definition lockcap : Type := lockownership * lockstate.

Inductive lockownership_split : lockownership -> lockownership -> lockownership -> Prop :=
  | lo_split_1 : lockownership_split Owner Client Owner
  | lo_split_2 : lockownership_split Owner Owner Client
  | lo_split_3 : lockownership_split Client Client Client.

Inductive lockstate_split : lockstate -> lockstate -> lockstate -> Prop :=
  | ls_split_1 : lockstate_split Opened Closed Opened
  | ls_split_2 : lockstate_split Opened Opened Closed
  | ls_split_3 : lockstate_split Closed Closed Closed.

Definition lockcap_split l1 l2 l3 :=
  lockownership_split l1.1 l2.1 l3.1 ∧ lockstate_split l1.2 l2.2 l3.2.

CoInductive type :=
  | FunT : linearity -> type -> type -> type
  | UnitT : type
  | PairT : type -> type -> type
  | SumT n : (fin n -> type) -> type
  | LockT : lockcap -> type -> type.

CoInductive unr : type -> Prop :=
  | Fun_unr t1 t2 : unr (FunT Unr t1 t2)
  | Unit_unr : unr UnitT
  | Pair_unr t1 t2 : unr t1 -> unr t2 -> unr (PairT t1 t2)
  | Sum_unr n ts : (∀ i, unr (ts i)) -> unr (SumT n ts).

Definition env := gmap string type.

Definition env_unr (Γ : env) :=
  ∀ x t, Γ !! x = Some t -> unr t.

Definition disj (Γ1 Γ2 : env) :=
  ∀ i t1 t2, Γ1 !! i = Some t1 -> Γ2 !! i = Some t2 -> t1 = t2 ∧ unr t1.

Definition env_split (Γ : env) (Γ1 : env) (Γ2 : env) :=
  Γ = Γ1 ∪ Γ2 ∧ disj Γ1 Γ2.

Definition env_bind (Γ' : env) (x : string) (t : type) (Γ : env) :=

Definition env_var (Γ : env) (x : string) (t : type) :=
  ∃ Γ', Γ = <[ x := t ]> Γ' ∧ env_unr Γ'.

    (Hforest : ref_forest ρ)
    (Hab_ne : a <> b) (Hbc_ne : b <> c) (Hca_ne : c <> a)
    (Hab : ref_edge ρ a b) (Hbc : ref_edge ρ b c) (Hca : ref_edge ρ c a) :
  False.

  split.

  split.

  change (path_edges (ref_edge ρ) [a; b; c; a]).
  apply (pe_cons a b [c; a] Hab).
  apply (pe_cons b c [a] Hbc).
  apply (pe_cons c a [] Hca).
  apply pe_nil.

  False.

  { unfold refs_at. rewrite Hi. exact Hin. }

  - unfold ref_edge. split; [exact Hbn_ne|left; exact Hbn].
  - unfold ref_edge. split; [exact (fun E => Hin_ne (eq_sym E))|right; exact Hri_n].

1	From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.
2	From stdpp Require Import gmap list.
3	From Stdlib Require Import List Arith Lia.
4	From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String.
5	Import ListNotations.

9	
10	(* ================================================================== *)
11	(* Pair preservation for a bundle of edges moved from [n] to [i].     *)
12	(* This is the set-level counterpart of the forest bridge move.       *)
13	(* ================================================================== *)
14	
15	Definition self_free_fun (S : nat -> gset nat) : Prop :=
16	  forall a, a ∉ S a.
17	
18	Definition pair_ok_fun (S : nat -> gset nat) : Prop :=
19	  forall a b, a <> b -> ~ (b ∈ S a /\ a ∈ S b).
20	
21	Definition ref_pair_ok_fun (S : nat -> gset nat) : Prop :=
22	  self_free_fun S /\ pair_ok_fun S.
23	
24	Lemma pair_move_add (S T : nat -> gset nat) (i n : nat) (B : gset nat) :
25	  ref_pair_ok_fun S ->
26	  T i = S i ∪ B ->
27	  T n = ∅ ->
28	  (forall a, a <> i -> a <> n -> T a = S a) ->
29	  i ∉ B ->
30	  (forall b, b ∈ B -> i ∉ T b) ->
31	  ref_pair_ok_fun T.
32	Proof.
33	  intros [Hself Hpair] HTi HTn Hother HiB Hrev.
34	  split.
35	  - intro a. destruct (decide (a = i)) as [E|Hai].
36	    + subst a. rewrite HTi. intro Hmem.
37	      apply elem_of_union in Hmem as [Hin|Hin].
38	      * exact (Hself i Hin).
39	      * exact (HiB Hin).
40	    + destruct (decide (a = n)) as [E|Han].
41	      * subst a. rewrite HTn. set_solver.
42	      * rewrite (Hother a Hai Han). apply Hself.
43	  - intros a b Hne [Hb Ha].
44	    destruct (decide (a = i)) as [Ea|Hai].
45	    + subst a. rewrite HTi in Hb.
46	      apply elem_of_union in Hb as [HbS|HbB].
47	      * destruct (decide (b = n)) as [Eb|Hbn].
48	        -- subst b. rewrite HTn in Ha. set_solver.
49	        -- rewrite (Hother b (ne_sym Hne) Hbn) in Ha.
50	           exact (Hpair i b Hne (conj HbS Ha)).
51	      * exact (Hrev b HbB Ha).
52	    + destruct (decide (a = n)) as [Ea|Han].
53	      * subst a. rewrite HTn in Hb. set_solver.
54	      * rewrite (Hother a Hai Han) in Hb.
55	        destruct (decide (b = i)) as [Eb|Hbi].
56	        -- subst b. rewrite HTi in Ha.
57	           apply elem_of_union in Ha as [HaS|HaB].
58	           ++ exact (Hpair a i Hne (conj Hb HaS)).
59	           ++ apply (Hrev a HaB). rewrite (Hother a Hai Han). exact Hb.
60	        -- destruct (decide (b = n)) as [Eb|Hbn].
61	           ++ subst b. rewrite HTn in Ha. set_solver.
62	           ++ rewrite (Hother b Hbi Hbn) in Ha.
63	              exact (Hpair a b Hne (conj Hb Ha)).
64	Qed.
65	
66	(* Transfer between the set-function presentation and [cfg]. *)
67	Lemma ref_pair_ok_fun_iff (ρ : cfg) :
68	  ref_pair_ok_fun (refs_at ρ) <-> ref_pair_ok ρ.
69	Proof.
70	  unfold ref_pair_ok_fun, ref_pair_ok, self_free_fun, pair_ok_fun,
71	         self_ref_free, pair_ref_ok.
72	  split; intros [H1 H2]; split; assumption.
73	Qed.
74	
75	Print Assumptions pair_move_add.
76	Print Assumptions ref_pair_ok_fun_iff.

146	    intros s Hs.

154	Proof.
155	  intros Hwt Hstep.
156	  apply (wt_ctx_replace k e e' t Hk Hwt).
157	  intros s Hs. exact (wt_pure_step L e e' s Hs Hstep).
158	Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Reference sets of a disjoint union of configurations.              *)
(* These are the "Frame_step lifting" accessors: a key live in the    *)
(* core reads its references from the core, a key live only in the    *)
(* frame reads them from the frame.                                   *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma refs_at_union_l (ρ ρf : cfg) (a : nat) :
  ρ ##ₘ ρf -> ρ !! a <> None ->
  refs_at (ρ ∪ ρf) a = refs_at ρ a.
Proof.
  intros Hd Hlive.
  assert (Hf : ρf !! a = None).
  { apply map_disjoint_alt in Hd.
    destruct (Hd a) as [E|E].
    - exfalso. apply Hlive. exact E.
    - exact E. }
  unfold refs_at.
  rewrite lookup_union_l by exact Hf.
  reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma refs_at_union_r (ρ ρf : cfg) (a : nat) :
  ρ !! a = None ->
  refs_at (ρ ∪ ρf) a = refs_at ρf a.
Proof.
  intro H.
  unfold refs_at.
  rewrite lookup_union_r by exact H.
  reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma refs_at_union_frame (ρ ρf : cfg) (a : nat) :
  ρ !! a = None -> ρf !! a <> None ->
  refs_at (ρ ∪ ρf) a = refs_at ρf a.
Proof. intros H _. apply refs_at_union_r. exact H. Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Pair preservation, generalized move with a shrinking source and    *)
(* with a destination that may retain old references.                  *)
(* ================================================================== *)

(* Bundle [B] moves into destination [i]; the old holder [n] is
   emptied but the destination may retain an arbitrary subset of its
   previous references (Wait deletes the lock token from the thread,
   while Acquire keeps it).  This is [pair_move_add] with [T i] merely
   included in [S i ∪ B]. *)
Lemma pair_move_add_shrink (S T : nat -> gset nat) (i n : nat) (B : gset nat) :
  ref_pair_ok_fun S ->
  T i ⊆ S i ∪ B ->
  T n = ∅ ->
  (forall a, a <> i -> a <> n -> T a = S a) ->
  i ∉ B ->
  (forall b, b ∈ B -> i ∉ T b) ->
  ref_pair_ok_fun T.
Proof.
  intros [Hself Hpair] HTi HTn Hother HiB Hrev.
  split.
  - intro a. destruct (decide (a = i)) as [E|Hai].
    + subst a. intro Hmem. apply (HTi Hmem). apply elem_of_union in Hmem.
      rename Hmem into Hmem0.
      (* redo: we need membership in S i ∪ B *)
      admit.
    + destruct (decide (a = n)) as [E|Han].
      * subst a. rewrite HTn. set_solver.
      * rewrite (Hother a Hai Han). apply Hself.
  - intros a b Hne [Hb Ha].
    destruct (decide (a = i)) as [Ea|Hai].
    + subst a. apply elem_of_union in Hb as [HbS|HbB].
      * destruct (decide (b = n)) as [Eb|Hbn].
        -- subst b. rewrite HTn in Ha. set_solver.
        -- rewrite (Hother b (ne_sym Hne) Hbn) in Ha.
           exact (Hpair i b Hne (conj HbS Ha)).
      * exact (Hrev b HbB Ha).
    + destruct (decide (a = n)) as [Ea|Han].

Lemma refs_at_union_l (ρ ρf : cfg) (a : nat) :

(* Interface combining the per-thread lemma with the missing object-level
   accounting.  [threads_typed] is the runtime-typing invariant on live
   threads; [obj_progress] is exactly the accounting obligation for live
   objects (locks and barriers) that are not threads.  Note that
   [progress_or_wait] cannot be derived from [thread_progress] alone: a live
   [Barrier] or [Lock] is not a thread, so the per-thread lemma says nothing
   about it, and [can_step] at such an index is only available when a matching
   operation is currently observable in some thread/object. *)

Definition progress_or_wait_obj (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i, ρ !! i <> None -> can_step ρ i \/ exists j, waiting ρ i j.

Definition threads_typed (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i e, ρ !! i = Some (Thread e) -> wt L ∅ e UnitT.

Definition obj_progress (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i y, ρ !! i = Some y -> (forall e, y <> Thread e) ->
    can_step ρ i \/ exists j, waiting ρ i j.

Lemma progress_or_wait_of_typed_obj ρ

    + apply Hobj with (y := Barrier); [exact E | discriminate].
    + apply Hobj with (y := Lock rc o); [exact E | discriminate].
  - exfalso. exact (Hi eq_refl).
Qed.

From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.
From Stdlib Require Import Classical_Prop.
From stdpp Require Import gmap.
From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String.
Open Scope string_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Object-level capability inventory.                                 *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* The inventory is deliberately abstract in the maps [caps] and      *)
(* [bend]: a future annotated runtime typing (or a reachability      *)
(* invariant) is expected to provide, for every live configuration,   *)
(* the set of holders of each lock capability state and the set of    *)
(* holders of each barrier endpoint.  The fields below are the        *)
(* accounting facts; the only semantic-looking field is              *)
(* [cap_wait_step], which records that a holder of a capability that  *)
(* is itself blocked on the same lock would exhibit a local step at   *)
(* the lock index.  This is the state/ownership typing fact needed to *)
(* replace per-thread syntax, and it is exactly what avoids the       *)
(* MatchSum branch-duplication problem: capability occurrences are    *)
(* holders in live objects, not raw syntactic occurrences.            *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition cap_inventory
    (ρ : cfg)
    (caps : nat -> lockcap -> gset nat)   (* lock n, capability state lc *)
    (bend : nat -> gset nat)              (* barrier n, endpoint holders *)
    : Prop :=
  (* every capability occurrence is in a live object which references n *)
  (forall n lc j, j ∈ caps n lc -> ρ !! j <> None) /\
  (forall n lc j, j ∈ caps n lc ->
     exists y, ρ !! j = Some y /\ n ∈ obj_refs y) /\
  (* a blocked holder of a capability for n exposes a step at n *)
  (forall n lc j e,
     j ∈ caps n lc -> ρ !! j = Some (Thread e) -> expr_waiting e n ->
     can_step ρ n) /\
  (* exactly one Opened capability when the lock content is absent *)
  (forall n rc, ρ !! n = Some (Lock rc None) ->
     exists j, caps n (Owner,Opened) ∪ caps n (Client,Opened) = {[j]}) /\
  (* no Opened capability when the lock has content *)
  (forall n rc v, ρ !! n = Some (Lock rc (Some v)) ->
     caps n (Owner,Opened) ∪ caps n (Client,Opened) = ∅) /\
  (* a lock with content has a capability holder (an owner/referencer) *)
  (forall n rc v, ρ !! n = Some (Lock rc (Some v)) ->
     exists lc j, j ∈ caps n lc) /\
  (* [refcnt] counts Client capabilities *)
  (forall n rc o, ρ !! n = Some (Lock rc o) ->
     (0 < rc <-> exists j, j ∈ caps n (Client,Closed) ∪ caps n (Client,Opened))) /\
    unfold init_cfg in Hi.
    apply lookup_singleton_Some in Hi.
    destruct Hi as [Hi0 Heq].
    injection Heq as ->.
    subst i.
    exact (typed_to_wt ∅ e0 UnitT Hty ∅).
  - split.
    + exact (init_cap_inventory e).
    + split.
      * apply init_wait_targets_live. exact Hty.
      * destruct (typed_singleton_ref_inv ∅ e UnitT Hty) as [Hp Hf].
        split; assumption.
Qed.


(* ================================================================== *)
(* Bundled configuration invariant.                                    *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition config_invariants (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  exists (L : gmap nat type)
         (caps : nat -> lockcap -> gset nat)
         (bend : nat -> gset nat),
    (forall i e, ρ !! i = Some (Thread e) -> wt L ∅ e UnitT) /\
    cap_inventory ρ caps bend /\
    wait_targets_live ρ /\
    ref_pair_ok ρ /\
    ref_forest ρ.

Theorem fully_reachable_of_config_invariants ρ :
  config_invariants ρ -> fully_reachable ρ.
Proof.
  intros (L & caps & bend & Hty & Hinv & Hlive & Hpair & Hforest).
  exact (fully_reachable_of_invariants L ρ caps bend Hty Hinv Hlive Hpair Hforest).
Qed.

Theorem typed_full_reachability_of_step_preservation e ρ
    (Hpres : forall ρ1 ρ2, config_invariants ρ1 -> step' ρ1 ρ2 ->
               config_invariants ρ2)
    (Hty : typed ∅ e UnitT)
    (Hsteps : steps {[0 := Thread e]} ρ) :
  fully_reachable ρ.
Proof.
  apply fully_reachable_of_config_invariants.
  refine (@rtc_ind_r cfg step' config_invariants
            {[0 := Thread e]} _ _ ρ Hsteps).
  - change (config_invariants (init_cfg e)).
    destruct (initial_cfg_invariants e Hty) as
      (caps & bend & Hty' & Hinv & Hlive & Hpair & Hforest).
    exists ∅, caps, bend. tauto.
  - intros y z _ Hyz Hy. exact (Hpres y z Hy Hyz).
Qed.

  threads_typed L a.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Refined value typing [cvS] and runtime typing [wtS].                *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* The only change with respect to [cv] is the function-value rule:   *)
(* at an unrestricted function type, the body must be reference-free. *)
(* [wtS] is the corresponding runtime typing, using [cvS] for values. *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Inductive cvS (L : gmap nat type) : val -> type -> Prop :=
  | FunVS x e t1 t2 l :
      wt L (<[x := t1]> (∅ : env)) e t2 ->
      (l = Unr -> expr_refs e = ∅) ->
      cvS L (FunV x e) (FunT l t1 t2)
  | UnitVS : cvS L UnitV UnitT
  | PairVS v1 v2 t1 t2 :
      cvS L v1 t1 -> cvS L v2 t2 ->
      cvS L (PairV v1 v2) (PairT t1 t2)
  | SumVS n (ts : fin n -> type) i v :
      cvS L v (ts i) ->
      cvS L (SumV i v) (SumT n ts)
  | BarrierVS n t1 t2 :
      cvS L (BarrierV n) (FunT Lin t1 t2)
  | LockVS n lc t :
      L !! n = Some t ->
      cvS L (LockV n) (LockT lc t).

Inductive wtS (L : gmap nat type) : env -> expr -> type -> Prop :=
  | VarS Γ x t :
      env_var Γ x t ->
      wtS L Γ (Var x) t
  | FunS Γ Γ' x e t1 t2 l :
      env_bind Γ' x t1 Γ ->
      (l = Unr -> env_unr Γ) ->
      wtS L Γ' e t2 ->
      wtS L Γ (Fun x e) (FunT l t1 t2)
  | AppS Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 l :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wtS L Γ1 e1 (FunT l t1 t2) ->
      wtS L Γ2 e2 t1 ->
      wtS L Γ (App e1 e2) t2
  | UnitS Γ :
      env_unr Γ ->
      wtS L Γ Unit UnitT
  | PairS Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wtS L Γ1 e1 t1 ->
      wtS L Γ2 e2 t2 ->
      wtS L Γ (Pair e1 e2) (PairT t1 t2)
  | LetPairS Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 t :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wtS L Γ1 e1 (PairT t1 t2) ->
      wtS L Γ2 e2 (FunT Lin t1 (FunT Lin t2 t)) ->
      wtS L Γ (LetPair e1 e2) t
  | SumS Γ n (ts : fin n -> type) i e :
      wtS L Γ e (ts i) ->
      wtS L Γ (Sum i e) (SumT n ts)
  | MatchSumS n Γ Γ1 Γ2 t (ts : fin n -> type) es e :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      (n = 0 -> env_unr Γ2) ->
      wtS L Γ1 e (SumT n ts) ->
      (forall i, wtS L Γ2 (es i) (FunT Lin (ts i) t)) ->
      wtS L Γ (MatchSum n e es) t
  | ForkS Γ e t1 t2 :
      wtS L Γ e (FunT Lin (FunT Lin t2 t1) UnitT) ->
      wtS L Γ (ForkBarrier e) (FunT Lin t1 t2)
  | NewLockS Γ e t :
      wtS L Γ e t ->
      wtS L Γ (NewLock e) (LockT (Owner,Closed) t)
  | ForkLockS Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t l1 l2 l3 :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      lockcap_split l1 l2 l3 ->
      wtS L Γ1 e1 (LockT l1 t) ->
      wtS L Γ2 e2 (FunT Lin (LockT l2 t) UnitT) ->
      wtS L Γ (ForkLock e1 e2) (LockT l3 t)
  | AcquireS Γ e t lo :
      wtS L Γ e (LockT (lo,Closed) t) ->
      wtS L Γ (Acquire e) (PairT (LockT (lo,Opened) t) t)
  | ReleaseS Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t lo :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wtS L Γ1 e1 (LockT (lo,Opened) t) ->
      wtS L Γ2 e2 t ->
      wtS L Γ (Release e1 e2) (LockT (lo,Closed) t)
  | WaitS Γ e t :
      wtS L Γ e (LockT (Owner,Closed) t) ->
      wtS L Γ (Wait e) t
  | DropS Γ e t :
      wtS L Γ e (LockT (Client,Closed) t) ->
      wtS L Γ (Drop e) UnitT
  | ValS Γ v t :
      env_unr Γ ->
      cvS L v t ->
      wtS L Γ (Val v) t.

(* The refined value typing really does exclude references at
   unrestricted types. *)

Lemma cvS_unr_refs L v t (H : cvS L v t) : unr t -> val_refs v = ∅.
Proof.

From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.
From stdpp Require Import gmap list.
From Stdlib Require Import List Arith Lia.
From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String.
From Stdlib Require Import Relation_Operators.
Import ListNotations.
Close Scope string_scope.

Load "/tmp/scratch6/UnionFrame.v".

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Set-graph presentation as a function [nat -> gset nat].            *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition edge_fun (S : nat -> gset nat) (a b : nat) : Prop :=
  a <> b /\ (b ∈ S a \/ a ∈ S b).

Definition forest_fun (S : nat -> gset nat) : Prop :=
  forest_rel (edge_fun S).

Lemma edge_fun_sym (S : nat -> gset nat) (a b : nat) :
  edge_fun S a b -> edge_fun S b a.
Proof. intros [Hne [H|H]]; split; [exact (ne_sym Hne)|]; [right|left]; exact H. Qed.

Lemma ref_forest_iff_fun (ρ : cfg) :
  ref_forest ρ <-> forest_fun (refs_at ρ).
Proof.
  unfold ref_forest, forest_fun, forest_rel, edge_fun, ref_edge.
  split; intros H l; apply H.
Qed.

Lemma ref_pair_ok_iff_fun (ρ : cfg) :
  ref_pair_ok ρ <-> ref_pair_ok_fun (refs_at ρ).
Proof. apply ref_pair_ok_fun_iff. Qed.

(* Shrinking every reference set preserves both pair-ok and forest. *)
Lemma ref_pair_ok_shrink_fun (S T : nat -> gset nat) :
  (forall a, T a ⊆ S a) ->
  ref_pair_ok_fun S -> ref_pair_ok_fun T.
Proof.
  intros Hsub [Hself Hpair]. split.
  - intro a. intro H. apply (Hself a). apply (Hsub a). exact H.
  - intros a b Hne [Hb Ha].
    exact (Hpair a b Hne (conj (Hsub a Hb) (Hsub b Ha))).
Qed.

Lemma forest_shrink_fun (S T : nat -> gset nat) :
  (forall a, T a ⊆ S a) ->
  forest_fun S -> forest_fun T.
Proof.
  intros Hsub Hf.
  unfold forest_fun, forest_rel in *.
  intros l Hc. apply (Hf l).
  destruct Hc as [Hlen [Hnd Hp]].
  split; [exact Hlen|]. split; [exact Hnd|].
  revert Hp. apply path_edges_mono.
  intros a b [Hne [Hb|Ha]].
  - split; [exact Hne|left]. apply (Hsub a). exact Hb.
  - split; [exact Hne|right]. apply (Hsub b). exact Ha.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Forest bridge-move lemma, packaged on the function presentation.    *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma forest_star_shape (S T : nat -> gset nat) (i n : nat) (R : gset nat) :
  (forall a b, edge_fun T a b ->
     edge_fun S a b \/ (a = i /\ b ∈ R) \/ (b = i /\ a ∈ R)) ->
  forest_fun S ->
  (forall r, r ∈ R -> edge_fun S n r) ->
  edge_fun S i n ->
  (forall r, r ∈ R -> ~ edge_fun T n r) ->
  i <> n -> n ∉ R ->
  forest_fun T.
Proof.
  intros Hinc Hforest Hsrc Hbridge Hrem Hine HnR.
  unfold forest_fun.
  eapply forest_rewire_star_at_i with (R := R).
  - exact Hinc.
  - intros a b. apply edge_fun_sym.
  - intros a b. apply edge_fun_sym.
  - exact Hsrc.
  - exact Hbridge.
  - exact Hrem.
  - exact Hine.
  - exact HnR.
  - exact Hforest.
Qed.

Print Assumptions ref_forest_iff_fun.
Print Assumptions ref_pair_ok_shrink_fun.
Print Assumptions forest_shrink_fun.
Print Assumptions forest_star_shape.

From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.
From stdpp Require Import gmap.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Kind-respecting reference sets.                                    *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* [expr_refs] / [val_refs] forget whether a reference came from a    *)
(* [LockV] or a [BarrierV].  These traversals keep the two kinds       *)
(* apart, so a configuration can be required to have every [LockV n]   *)
(* point at a live [Lock] and every [BarrierV n] at a live [Barrier].  *)
(* Counts are still set-based: this is exactly the set of indices      *)
(* occurring with the given constructor, not a multiplicity.           *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Fixpoint expr_lock_refs (e : expr) : gset nat :=
  match e with
  | Val v => val_lock_refs v
  | Var _ => ∅
  | Fun _ e => expr_lock_refs e
  | App e1 e2 => expr_lock_refs e1 ∪ expr_lock_refs e2
  | Unit => ∅
  | Pair e1 e2 => expr_lock_refs e1 ∪ expr_lock_refs e2
  | LetPair e1 e2 => expr_lock_refs e1 ∪ expr_lock_refs e2
  | Sum _ e => expr_lock_refs e
  | MatchSum n e es => expr_lock_refs e ∪ fin_union n (expr_lock_refs ∘ es)
  | ForkBarrier e => expr_lock_refs e
  | NewLock e => expr_lock_refs e
  | ForkLock e1 e2 => expr_lock_refs e1 ∪ expr_lock_refs e2
  | Acquire e => expr_lock_refs e
  | Release e1 e2 => expr_lock_refs e1 ∪ expr_lock_refs e2
  | Wait e => expr_lock_refs e
  | Drop e => expr_lock_refs e
  end
with val_lock_refs (v : val) : gset nat :=
  match v with
  | FunV _ e => expr_lock_refs e
  | UnitV => ∅
  | PairV v1 v2 => val_lock_refs v1 ∪ val_lock_refs v2
  | SumV _ v => val_lock_refs v
  | BarrierV _ => ∅
  | LockV n => {[n]}
  end.

Fixpoint expr_barrier_refs (e : expr) : gset nat :=
  match e with
  | Val v => val_barrier_refs v
  | Var _ => ∅
  | Fun _ e => expr_barrier_refs e
  | App e1 e2 => expr_barrier_refs e1 ∪ expr_barrier_refs e2
  | Unit => ∅
  | Pair e1 e2 => expr_barrier_refs e1 ∪ expr_barrier_refs e2
  | LetPair e1 e2 => expr_barrier_refs e1 ∪ expr_barrier_refs e2
  | Sum _ e => expr_barrier_refs e
  | MatchSum n e es => expr_barrier_refs e ∪ fin_union n (expr_barrier_refs ∘ es)
  | ForkBarrier e => expr_barrier_refs e
  | NewLock e => expr_barrier_refs e
  | ForkLock e1 e2 => expr_barrier_refs e1 ∪ expr_barrier_refs e2
  | Acquire e => expr_barrier_refs e
  | Release e1 e2 => expr_barrier_refs e1 ∪ expr_barrier_refs e2
  | Wait e => expr_barrier_refs e
  | Drop e => expr_barrier_refs e
  end
with val_barrier_refs (v : val) : gset nat :=
  match v with
  | FunV _ e => expr_barrier_refs e
  | UnitV => ∅
  | PairV v1 v2 => val_barrier_refs v1 ∪ val_barrier_refs v2
  | SumV _ v => val_barrier_refs v
  | BarrierV n => {[n]}
  | LockV _ => ∅
  end.

(* Kind liveness: every kind-specific reference in a live object points
   at a live object of that kind. *)

Definition kind_lock_live (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  (forall i e n, ρ !! i = Some (Thread e) ->
     n ∈ expr_lock_refs e -> exists rc o, ρ !! n = Some (Lock rc o)) /\
  (forall i rc (o : option val) v n, ρ !! i = Some (Lock rc (Some v)) ->
     n ∈ val_lock_refs v -> exists rc' o', ρ !! n = Some (Lock rc' o')).

Definition kind_barrier_live (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  (forall i e n, ρ !! i = Some (Thread e) ->
     n ∈ expr_barrier_refs e -> ρ !! n = Some Barrier) /\
  (forall i rc (o : option val) v n, ρ !! i = Some (Lock rc (Some v)) ->
     n ∈ val_barrier_refs v -> ρ !! n = Some Barrier).

Definition kind_live (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  kind_lock_live ρ /\ kind_barrier_live ρ.

From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String.
From stdpp Require Import gmap.

From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Export langtools.

Inductive expr :=
  | Val : val -> expr
  | Var : string -> expr
  | Fun : string -> expr -> expr
  | App : expr -> expr -> expr
  | Unit : expr
  | Pair : expr -> expr -> expr
  | LetPair : expr -> expr -> expr
  | Sum : nat -> expr -> expr
  | MatchSum n : expr -> (fin n -> expr) -> expr

  | ForkBarrier : expr -> expr

  | NewLock : expr -> expr
  | ForkLock : expr -> expr -> expr
  | Acquire : expr -> expr
  | Release : expr -> expr -> expr
  | Wait : expr -> expr
  | Drop : expr -> expr
with val :=
  | FunV : string -> expr -> val
  | UnitV : val
  | PairV : val -> val -> val
  | SumV : nat -> val -> val
  | BarrierV : nat -> val
  | LockV : nat -> val.

Inductive linearity := Lin | Unr.

Inductive lockstate := Opened | Closed.

Inductive lockownership := Owner | Client.

Definition lockcap : Type := lockownership * lockstate.

Inductive lockownership_split : lockownership -> lockownership -> lockownership -> Prop :=
  | lo_split_1 : lockownership_split Owner Client Owner
  | lo_split_2 : lockownership_split Owner Owner Client
  | lo_split_3 : lockownership_split Client Client Client.

Inductive lockstate_split : lockstate -> lockstate -> lockstate -> Prop :=
  | ls_split_1 : lockstate_split Opened Closed Opened
  | ls_split_2 : lockstate_split Opened Opened Closed
  | ls_split_3 : lockstate_split Closed Closed Closed.

Definition lockcap_split l1 l2 l3 :=
  lockownership_split l1.1 l2.1 l3.1 ∧ lockstate_split l1.2 l2.2 l3.2.

CoInductive type :=
  | FunT : linearity -> type -> type -> type
  | UnitT : type
  | PairT : type -> type -> type
  | SumT n : (fin n -> type) -> type
  | LockT : lockcap -> type -> type.

CoInductive unr : type -> Prop :=
  | Fun_unr t1 t2 : unr (FunT Unr t1 t2)
  | Unit_unr : unr UnitT
  | Pair_unr t1 t2 : unr t1 -> unr t2 -> unr (PairT t1 t2)
  | Sum_unr n ts : (∀ i, unr (ts i)) -> unr (SumT n ts).

Definition env := gmap string type.

Definition env_unr (Γ : env) :=
  ∀ x t, Γ !! x = Some t -> unr t.

Definition disj (Γ1 Γ2 : env) :=
  ∀ i t1 t2, Γ1 !! i = Some t1 -> Γ2 !! i = Some t2 -> t1 = t2 ∧ unr t1.

Definition env_split (Γ : env) (Γ1 : env) (Γ2 : env) :=
  Γ = Γ1 ∪ Γ2 ∧ disj Γ1 Γ2.

Definition env_bind (Γ' : env) (x : string) (t : type) (Γ : env) :=
  Γ' = <[ x := t ]> Γ ∧ ∀ t', Γ !! x = Some t' -> unr t'.

Definition env_var (Γ : env) (x : string) (t : type) :=
  ∃ Γ', Γ = <[ x := t ]> Γ' ∧ env_unr Γ'.

Inductive typed : env -> expr -> type -> Prop :=

  | Var_typed Γ x t :
    env_var Γ x t ->
    typed Γ (Var x) t
  | Fun_typed Γ Γ' x e t1 t2 l :
    env_bind Γ' x t1 Γ ->
    (l = Unr -> env_unr Γ) ->
    typed Γ' e t2 ->
    typed Γ (Fun x e) (FunT l t1 t2)
  | App_typed Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 l :
    env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
    typed Γ1 e1 (FunT l t1 t2) ->
    typed Γ2 e2 t1 ->
    typed Γ (App e1 e2) t2
  | Unit_typed Γ :
    env_unr Γ ->

(* Runtime typing for configurations.                                 *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* Source terms are Val-free, so [typed] cannot type configurations   *)
(* produced by reduction.  [wt] extends it with runtime values [cv].  *)
(* Values are environment-independent (they are closed).               *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Inductive wt (L : gmap nat type) : env -> expr -> type -> Prop :=
  | VarW Γ x t :
      env_var Γ x t ->
      wt L Γ (Var x) t
  | FunW Γ Γ' x e t1 t2 l :
      env_bind Γ' x t1 Γ ->
      (l = Unr -> env_unr Γ) ->
      wt L Γ' e t2 ->
      wt L Γ (Fun x e) (FunT l t1 t2)
  | AppW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 l :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (FunT l t1 t2) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 t1 ->
      wt L Γ (App e1 e2) t2
  | UnitW Γ :
      env_unr Γ ->
      wt L Γ Unit UnitT
  | PairW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 t1 ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 t2 ->
      wt L Γ (Pair e1 e2) (PairT t1 t2)
  | LetPairW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 t :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (PairT t1 t2) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 (FunT Lin t1 (FunT Lin t2 t)) ->
      wt L Γ (LetPair e1 e2) t
  | SumW Γ n (ts : fin n -> type) i e :
      wt L Γ e (ts i) ->
      wt L Γ (Sum i e) (SumT n ts)
  | MatchSumW n Γ Γ1 Γ2 t (ts : fin n -> type) es e :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      (n = 0 -> env_unr Γ2) ->
      wt L Γ1 e (SumT n ts) ->
      (forall i, wt L Γ2 (es i) (FunT Lin (ts i) t)) ->
      wt L Γ (MatchSum n e es) t
  | ForkW Γ e t1 t2 :
      wt L Γ e (FunT Lin (FunT Lin t2 t1) UnitT) ->
      wt L Γ (ForkBarrier e) (FunT Lin t1 t2)
  | NewLockW Γ e t :
      wt L Γ e t ->
      wt L Γ (NewLock e) (LockT (Owner,Closed) t)
  | ForkLockW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t l1 l2 l3 :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      lockcap_split l1 l2 l3 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (LockT l1 t) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 (FunT Lin (LockT l2 t) UnitT) ->
      wt L Γ (ForkLock e1 e2) (LockT l3 t)
  | AcquireW Γ e t lo :
      wt L Γ e (LockT (lo,Closed) t) ->
      wt L Γ (Acquire e) (PairT (LockT (lo,Opened) t) t)
  | ReleaseW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t lo :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (LockT (lo,Opened) t) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 t ->
      wt L Γ (Release e1 e2) (LockT (lo,Closed) t)
  | WaitW Γ e t :
      wt L Γ e (LockT (Owner,Closed) t) ->
      wt L Γ (Wait e) t
  | DropW Γ e t :
      wt L Γ e (LockT (Client,Closed) t) ->
      wt L Γ (Drop e) UnitT
  | ValW Γ v t :
      env_unr Γ ->
      cv L v t ->
      wt L Γ (Val v) t
with cv (L : gmap nat type) : val -> type -> Prop :=
  | FunVW x e t1 t2 l :
      wt L (<[ x := t1 ]> (∅ : env)) e t2 ->
      cv L (FunV x e) (FunT l t1 t2)
  | UnitVW : cv L UnitV UnitT
  | PairVW v1 v2 t1 t2 :
      cv L v1 t1 -> cv L v2 t2 ->
      cv L (PairV v1 v2) (PairT t1 t2)
  | SumVW n (ts : fin n -> type) i v :
      cv L v (ts i) ->
      cv L (SumV i v) (SumT n ts)
  | BarrierVW n t1 t2 :
      cv L (BarrierV n) (FunT Lin t1 t2)
  | LockVW n lc t :
      L !! n = Some t ->
      cv L (LockV n) (LockT lc t).

(* ---------- gmap / environment helpers ---------- *)

Lemma env_lookup_insert_same x (t : type) : (<[x:=t]>(∅ : env)) !! x = Some t.
Proof. unfold env in *. apply lookup_insert_eq. Qed.

Lemma env_lookup_insert_none x y (t : type) (Γ : env) : x <> y -> Γ !! y = None -> (<[x:=t]>Γ) !! y = None.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. intros Hne Hy.
  rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x y t Hne). done.
Qed.

Lemma env_unr_delete x (Γ : env) : env_unr Γ -> env_unr (delete x Γ).
Proof.
  intros H y t Hy. unfold env_unr in H. unfold env in *.
  destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_eq Γ y) in Hy. done.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ x y E) in Hy. apply H in Hy. done.
Qed.

Lemma env_unr_insert_lookup x (t : type) (Γ : env) :
  env_unr (<[x:=t]>Γ) -> unr t.
Proof. intros H. unfold env_unr in H. apply (H x t). unfold env. apply lookup_insert_eq. Qed.

Lemma env_union_empty_l (m : env) : ∅ ∪ m = m.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro x. rewrite lookup_union.
  assert (H : (∅ : gmap string type) !! x = None) by apply lookup_empty.
  rewrite H. destruct (m !! x); done.
Qed.

Lemma env_union_empty_r (m : env) : m ∪ ∅ = m.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro x. rewrite lookup_union.
  assert (H : (∅ : gmap string type) !! x = None) by apply lookup_empty.
  rewrite H. destruct (m !! x); done.
Qed.

Lemma env_split_empty (Γ1 Γ2 : env) : env_split ∅ Γ1 Γ2 -> Γ1 = ∅ /\ Γ2 = ∅.
Proof.
  unfold env in *.
  intros [Hun Hdis]. symmetry in Hun.
  apply map_positive_l in Hun as H1. subst Γ1.
  rewrite env_union_empty_l in Hun. subst Γ2. split; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma disj_delete x (Γ1 Γ2 : env) : disj Γ1 Γ2 -> disj (delete x Γ1) (delete x Γ2).
Proof.
  unfold env in *.
  intros H i t1 t2 H1 H2.
  destruct (decide (x=i)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_eq Γ1 i) in H1. done.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ1 x i E) in H1. rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ2 x i E) in H2. apply (H i t1 t2 H1 H2).
Qed.

Lemma delete_insert_none x (t : type) (Γ : env) : Γ !! x = None -> delete x (<[x:=t]>Γ) = Γ.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. intros Hx. apply map_eq. intro y. destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_eq (<[y:=t]>Γ) y). done.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_ne (<[x:=t]>Γ) x y E). rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x y t E). done.
Qed.

Lemma delete_none x (Γ : env) : Γ !! x = None -> delete x Γ = Γ.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. intros Hx. apply map_eq. intro y. destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_eq Γ y). done.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ x y E). done.
Qed.

Lemma insert_delete_same x (t : type) (Γ : env) : Γ !! x = Some t -> <[x:=t]>(delete x Γ) = Γ.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. intros Hx. apply map_eq. intro y. destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (delete y Γ) y t). symmetry. done.
  - rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (delete x Γ) x y t E). rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ x y E). done.
Qed.

Lemma insert_insert_same x (t1 t2 : type) (Γ : env) :
  <[x:=t2]>(<[x:=t1]>Γ) = <[x:=t2]>Γ.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro y. destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (<[y:=t1]>Γ) y t2). rewrite (lookup_insert_eq Γ y t2). done.
  - rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[x:=t1]>Γ) x y t2 E).

From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Export langdef.

Fixpoint expr_refs e :=
  match e with
  | Val v => val_refs v
  | Var x => ∅
  | Fun x e => expr_refs e
  | App e1 e2 => expr_refs e1 ∪ expr_refs e2
  | Unit => ∅
  | Pair e1 e2 => expr_refs e1 ∪ expr_refs e2
  | LetPair e1 e2 => expr_refs e1 ∪ expr_refs e2
  | Sum i e => expr_refs e
  | MatchSum n e es => expr_refs e ∪ fin_union n (expr_refs ∘ es)
  | ForkBarrier e => expr_refs e
  | NewLock e => expr_refs e
  | ForkLock e1 e2 => expr_refs e1 ∪ expr_refs e2
  | Acquire e => expr_refs e
  | Release e1 e2 => expr_refs e1 ∪ expr_refs e2
  | Wait e => expr_refs e
  | Drop e => expr_refs e
  end
with val_refs v :=
  match v with
  | FunV x e => expr_refs e
  | UnitV => ∅
  | PairV v1 v2 => val_refs v1 ∪ val_refs v2
  | SumV i v => val_refs v
  | BarrierV i => {[ i ]}
  | LockV i => {[ i ]}
  end.

Definition obj_refs x :=
  match x with
  | Thread e => expr_refs e
  | Barrier => ∅
  | Lock refcnt o =>
      match o with
      | Some v => val_refs v
      | None => ∅
      end
  end.

Inductive expr_head_waiting : expr -> nat -> Prop :=
  | Barrier_waiting j v :
    expr_head_waiting (App (Val $ BarrierV j) (Val v)) j
  | ForkLock_waiting j v :
    expr_head_waiting (ForkLock (Val $ LockV j) (Val v)) j
  | Acquire_waiting j :
    expr_head_waiting (Acquire (Val $ LockV j)) j
  | Release_waiting j v :
    expr_head_waiting (Release (Val $ LockV j) (Val v)) j
  | Wait_waiting j :
    expr_head_waiting (Wait (Val $ LockV j)) j
  | Drop_waiting j :
    expr_head_waiting (Drop (Val $ LockV j)) j.

Definition expr_waiting e j :=
  ∃ k e', ctx k ∧ e = k e' ∧ expr_head_waiting e' j.

Definition waiting (ρ : cfg) (i j : nat) :=
  (∃ e, ρ !! i = Some (Thread e) ∧ expr_waiting e j) ∨
  (∃ y, ρ !! j = Some y ∧ i ∈ obj_refs y ∧ ∀ e, y = Thread e -> ¬ expr_waiting e i).

Definition can_step (ρ : cfg) (i : nat) := ∃ ρ', step i ρ ρ'.

Definition inactive (ρ : cfg) (i : nat) := ρ !! i = None.

Inductive reachable (ρ : cfg) : nat -> Prop :=
  | Can_step_reachable i :
      can_step ρ i -> reachable ρ i
  | Waiting_reachable i j :
      waiting ρ i j -> reachable ρ j -> reachable ρ i.

Definition fully_reachable (ρ : cfg) :=
  ∀ i, inactive ρ i ∨ reachable ρ i.

Inductive typed : env -> expr -> type -> Prop :=

  | Var_typed Γ x t :
    env_var Γ x t ->
    typed Γ (Var x) t
  | Fun_typed Γ Γ' x e t1 t2 l :
    env_bind Γ' x t1 Γ ->
    (l = Unr -> env_unr Γ) ->
    typed Γ' e t2 ->
    typed Γ (Fun x e) (FunT l t1 t2)
  | App_typed Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 l :
    env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
    typed Γ1 e1 (FunT l t1 t2) ->
    typed Γ2 e2 t1 ->
    typed Γ (App e1 e2) t2
  | Unit_typed Γ :
    env_unr Γ ->
    typed Γ Unit UnitT
  | Pair_typed Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 :
    env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
    typed Γ1 e1 t1 ->
    typed Γ2 e2 t2 ->
    typed Γ (Pair e1 e2) (PairT t1 t2)
  | LetPair_typed Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 t :
    env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
    typed Γ1 e1 (PairT t1 t2) ->
    typed Γ2 e2 (FunT Lin t1 (FunT Lin t2 t)) ->
    typed Γ (LetPair e1 e2) t
  | Sum_typed Γ n (ts : fin n -> type) i e :
    typed Γ e (ts i) ->
    typed Γ (Sum i e) (SumT n ts)
  | MatchSumN_typed n Γ Γ1 Γ2 t (ts : fin n -> type) es e :
    env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
    (n = 0 -> env_unr Γ2) ->
    typed Γ1 e (SumT n ts) ->
    (∀ i, typed Γ2 (es i) (FunT Lin (ts i) t)) ->
    typed Γ (MatchSum n e es) t

  | Fork_typed Γ e t1 t2 :
    typed Γ e (FunT Lin (FunT Lin t2 t1) UnitT) ->
    typed Γ (ForkBarrier e) (FunT Lin t1 t2)

  | NewLock_typed Γ e t :
    typed Γ e t ->
    typed Γ (NewLock e) (LockT (Owner,Closed) t)
  | ForkLock_typed Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t l1 l2 l3 :
    env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
    lockcap_split l1 l2 l3 ->
    typed Γ1 e1 (LockT l1 t) ->
    typed Γ2 e2 (FunT Lin (LockT l2 t) UnitT) ->
    typed Γ (ForkLock e1 e2) (LockT l3 t)
  | Acquire_typed Γ e t lo :
    typed Γ e (LockT (lo,Closed) t) ->
    typed Γ (Acquire e) (PairT (LockT (lo,Opened) t) t)
  | Release_typed Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t lo :
    env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
    typed Γ1 e1 (LockT (lo,Opened) t) ->
    typed Γ2 e2 t ->
    typed Γ (Release e1 e2) (LockT (lo,Closed) t)
  | Wait_typed Γ e t :
    typed Γ e (LockT (Owner,Closed) t) ->
    typed Γ (Wait e) t
  | Drop_typed Γ e t :
    typed Γ e (LockT (Client,Closed) t) ->
    typed Γ (Drop e) UnitT.

Definition subst (x:string) (a:val) := fix rec e :=
  match e with
  | Val _ => e
  | Var x' => if decide (x = x') then Val a else e
  | Fun x' e => Fun x' (if decide (x = x') then e else rec e)
  | App e1 e2 => App (rec e1) (rec e2)
  | Unit => Unit
  | Pair e1 e2 => Pair (rec e1) (rec e2)
  | LetPair e1 e2 => LetPair (rec e1) (rec e2)
  | Sum n e => Sum n (rec e)
  | MatchSum n e1 e2 => MatchSum n (rec e1) (rec ∘ e2)
  | ForkBarrier e => ForkBarrier (rec e)
  | NewLock e => NewLock (rec e)
  | ForkLock e1 e2 => ForkLock (rec e1) (rec e2)
  | Acquire e => Acquire (rec e)
  | Release e1 e2 => Release (rec e1) (rec e2)
  | Wait e => Wait (rec e)
  | Drop e => Drop (rec e)
  end.

Inductive pure_step : expr -> expr -> Prop :=
  | Fun_step x e :
    pure_step (Fun x e) (Val $ FunV x e)
  | App_step x e a :
    pure_step (App (Val $ FunV x e) (Val a)) (subst x a e)
  | Unit_step :
    pure_step Unit (Val $ UnitV)
  | Pair_step v1 v2 :
    pure_step (Pair (Val v1) (Val v2)) (Val $ PairV v1 v2)
  | LetPair_step v1 v2 e:
    pure_step (LetPair (Val $ PairV v1 v2) e) (App (App e (Val v1)) (Val v2))
  | Sum_step n v :
    pure_step (Sum n (Val v)) (Val $ SumV n v)
  | MatchSum_step n (i : fin n) v es :
    pure_step (MatchSum n (Val $ SumV i v) es) (App (es i) (Val v)).

Inductive ctx1 : (expr -> expr) -> Prop :=
  | Ctx_App_l e : ctx1 (λ x, App x e)
  | Ctx_App_r e : ctx1 (λ x, App e x)
  | Ctx_Pair_l e : ctx1 (λ x, Pair x e)
  | Ctx_Pair_r e : ctx1 (λ x, Pair e x)
  | Ctx_LetPair e : ctx1 (λ x, LetPair x e)
  | Ctx_Sum i : ctx1 (λ x, Sum i x)
  | Ctx_MatchSum n es : ctx1 (λ x, MatchSum n x es)
  | Ctx_ForkBarrier : ctx1 (λ x, ForkBarrier x)
  | Ctx_NewLock : ctx1 (λ x, NewLock x)
  | Ctx_ForkLock_l e : ctx1 (λ x, ForkLock x e)
  | Ctx_ForkLock_r e : ctx1 (λ x, ForkLock e x)
  | Ctx_Acquire : ctx1 (λ x, Acquire x)
  | Ctx_Release_l e : ctx1 (λ x, Release x e)
  | Ctx_Release_r e : ctx1 (λ x, Release e x)
  | Ctx_Wait : ctx1 (λ x, Wait x)
  | Ctx_Drop : ctx1 (λ x, Drop x).

Inductive ctx : (expr -> expr) -> Prop :=
  | Ctx_id : ctx id
  | Ctx_comp k1 k2 : ctx1 k1 -> ctx k2 -> ctx (k1 ∘ k2).

Inductive obj := Thread (e : expr) | Barrier | Lock (refcnt : nat) (o : option val).

Definition cfg := gmap nat obj.

Inductive local_step : nat -> cfg -> cfg -> Prop :=

  | Pure_step i k e e' :
    ctx k -> pure_step e e' ->
    local_step i {[ i := Thread (k e) ]} {[ i := Thread (k e') ]}
  | Exit_step i :
    local_step i {[ i := Thread (Val UnitV) ]} ∅

  | Fork_step i j n k v :
    i ≠ j -> i ≠ n -> j ≠ n -> ctx k ->
    local_step i {[ i := Thread (k (ForkBarrier (Val v))) ]}
                 {[ i := Thread (k (Val $ BarrierV n));
                    j := Thread (App (Val v) (Val $ BarrierV n));
                    n := Barrier ]}
  | Sync_step i j n k1 k2 v1 v2 :
    i ≠ j -> i ≠ n -> j ≠ n -> ctx k1 -> ctx k2 ->
    local_step n {[ i := Thread (k1 (App (Val $ BarrierV n) (Val v1)));
                    j := Thread (k2 (App (Val $ BarrierV n) (Val v2)));
                    n := Barrier ]}
                 {[ i := Thread (k1 $ Val v2);
                    j := Thread (k2 $ Val v1) ]}

  | NewLock_step v k n i:
    i ≠ n -> ctx k ->
    local_step i {[ i := Thread (k (NewLock (Val v))) ]}
                 {[ i := Thread (k (Val $ LockV n));
                    n := Lock 0 (Some v) ]}
  | ForkLock_step v o k i j n refcnt :
    i ≠ j -> i ≠ n -> j ≠ n -> ctx k ->
    local_step n {[ i := Thread (k (ForkLock (Val $ LockV n) (Val v)));
                    n := Lock refcnt o ]}
                 {[ i := Thread (k (Val $ LockV n));
                    j := Thread (App (Val v) (Val $ LockV n));
                    n := Lock (S refcnt) o ]}
  | Acquire_step v k i n refcnt :
    i ≠ n -> ctx k ->
    local_step n {[ i := Thread (k (Acquire (Val $ LockV n)));
                    n := Lock refcnt (Some v) ]}
                 {[ i := Thread (k (Val $ PairV (LockV n) v));
                    n := Lock refcnt None ]}
  | Release_step v k i n refcnt :
    i ≠ n -> ctx k ->
    local_step n {[ i := Thread (k (Release (Val $ LockV n) (Val v)));
                    n := Lock refcnt None ]}
                 {[ i := Thread (k (Val $ LockV n));
                    n := Lock refcnt (Some v) ]}
  | Wait_step v k i n :
    i ≠ n -> ctx k ->
    local_step n {[ i := Thread (k (Wait (Val $ LockV n)));
                    n := Lock 0 (Some v) ]}
                 {[ i := Thread (k (Val v)) ]}
  | Drop_step o k i n refcnt :
    i ≠ n -> ctx k ->
    local_step n {[ i := Thread (k (Drop (Val $ LockV n)));
                    n := Lock (S refcnt) o ]}
                 {[ i := Thread (k (Val $ UnitV));
                    n := Lock refcnt o ]}.

Inductive step : nat -> cfg -> cfg -> Prop :=
  | Frame_step ρ ρ' ρf i :
    ρ ##ₘ ρf -> ρ' ##ₘ ρf ->
    local_step i ρ ρ' -> step i (ρ ∪ ρf) (ρ' ∪ ρf).

Definition step' ρ ρ' := ∃ i, step i ρ ρ'.

Definition steps := rtc step'.

From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.

From Stdlib Require Import Classical_Prop Wellfounded Wf_nat Lia.
From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String Eqdep_dec.
From Stdlib Require Import Relation_Operators Arith.
From stdpp Require Import finite.
Open Scope string_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Runtime typing for configurations.                                 *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* Source terms are Val-free, so [typed] cannot type configurations   *)
(* produced by reduction.  [wt] extends it with runtime values [cv].  *)
(* Values are environment-independent (they are closed).               *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Inductive wt (L : gmap nat type) : env -> expr -> type -> Prop :=
  | VarW Γ x t :
      env_var Γ x t ->
      wt L Γ (Var x) t
  | FunW Γ Γ' x e t1 t2 l :
      env_bind Γ' x t1 Γ ->
      (l = Unr -> env_unr Γ) ->
      wt L Γ' e t2 ->
      wt L Γ (Fun x e) (FunT l t1 t2)
  | AppW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 l :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (FunT l t1 t2) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 t1 ->
      wt L Γ (App e1 e2) t2
  | UnitW Γ :
      env_unr Γ ->
      wt L Γ Unit UnitT
  | PairW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 t1 ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 t2 ->
      wt L Γ (Pair e1 e2) (PairT t1 t2)
  | LetPairW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 t :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (PairT t1 t2) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 (FunT Lin t1 (FunT Lin t2 t)) ->
      wt L Γ (LetPair e1 e2) t
  | SumW Γ n (ts : fin n -> type) i e :
      wt L Γ e (ts i) ->
      wt L Γ (Sum i e) (SumT n ts)
  | MatchSumW n Γ Γ1 Γ2 t (ts : fin n -> type) es e :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      (n = 0 -> env_unr Γ2) ->
      wt L Γ1 e (SumT n ts) ->
      (forall i, wt L Γ2 (es i) (FunT Lin (ts i) t)) ->
      wt L Γ (MatchSum n e es) t
  | ForkW Γ e t1 t2 :
      wt L Γ e (FunT Lin (FunT Lin t2 t1) UnitT) ->
      wt L Γ (ForkBarrier e) (FunT Lin t1 t2)
  | NewLockW Γ e t :
      wt L Γ e t ->
      wt L Γ (NewLock e) (LockT (Owner,Closed) t)
  | ForkLockW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t l1 l2 l3 :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      lockcap_split l1 l2 l3 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (LockT l1 t) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 (FunT Lin (LockT l2 t) UnitT) ->
      wt L Γ (ForkLock e1 e2) (LockT l3 t)
  | AcquireW Γ e t lo :
      wt L Γ e (LockT (lo,Closed) t) ->
      wt L Γ (Acquire e) (PairT (LockT (lo,Opened) t) t)
  | ReleaseW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t lo :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (LockT (lo,Opened) t) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 t ->
      wt L Γ (Release e1 e2) (LockT (lo,Closed) t)
  | WaitW Γ e t :
      wt L Γ e (LockT (Owner,Closed) t) ->
      wt L Γ (Wait e) t
  | DropW Γ e t :
      wt L Γ e (LockT (Client,Closed) t) ->
      wt L Γ (Drop e) UnitT
  | ValW Γ v t :
      env_unr Γ ->
      cv L v t ->
      wt L Γ (Val v) t
with cv (L : gmap nat type) : val -> type -> Prop :=
  | FunVW x e t1 t2 l :
      wt L (<[ x := t1 ]> (∅ : env)) e t2 ->
      cv L (FunV x e) (FunT l t1 t2)
  | UnitVW : cv L UnitV UnitT
  | PairVW v1 v2 t1 t2 :
      cv L v1 t1 -> cv L v2 t2 ->
      cv L (PairV v1 v2) (PairT t1 t2)
  | SumVW n (ts : fin n -> type) i v :
      cv L v (ts i) ->
      cv L (SumV i v) (SumT n ts)
  | BarrierVW n t1 t2 :
      cv L (BarrierV n) (FunT Lin t1 t2)
  | LockVW n lc t :
      L !! n = Some t ->
      cv L (LockV n) (LockT lc t).

(* ---------- gmap / environment helpers ---------- *)

Lemma env_lookup_insert_same x (t : type) : (<[x:=t]>(∅ : env)) !! x = Some t.
Proof. unfold env in *. apply lookup_insert_eq. Qed.

Lemma env_lookup_insert_none x y (t : type) (Γ : env) : x <> y -> Γ !! y = None -> (<[x:=t]>Γ) !! y = None.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. intros Hne Hy.
  rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x y t Hne). done.
Qed.

Lemma env_unr_delete x (Γ : env) : env_unr Γ -> env_unr (delete x Γ).
Proof.
  intros H y t Hy. unfold env_unr in H. unfold env in *.
  destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_eq Γ y) in Hy. done.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ x y E) in Hy. apply H in Hy. done.
Qed.

Lemma env_unr_insert_lookup x (t : type) (Γ : env) :
  env_unr (<[x:=t]>Γ) -> unr t.
Proof. intros H. unfold env_unr in H. apply (H x t). unfold env. apply lookup_insert_eq. Qed.

Lemma env_union_empty_l (m : env) : ∅ ∪ m = m.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro x. rewrite lookup_union.
  assert (H : (∅ : gmap string type) !! x = None) by apply lookup_empty.
  rewrite H. destruct (m !! x); done.
Qed.

Lemma env_union_empty_r (m : env) : m ∪ ∅ = m.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro x. rewrite lookup_union.
  assert (H : (∅ : gmap string type) !! x = None) by apply lookup_empty.
  rewrite H. destruct (m !! x); done.
Qed.

Lemma env_split_empty (Γ1 Γ2 : env) : env_split ∅ Γ1 Γ2 -> Γ1 = ∅ /\ Γ2 = ∅.
Proof.
  unfold env in *.
  intros [Hun Hdis]. symmetry in Hun.
  apply map_positive_l in Hun as H1. subst Γ1.
  rewrite env_union_empty_l in Hun. subst Γ2. split; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma disj_delete x (Γ1 Γ2 : env) : disj Γ1 Γ2 -> disj (delete x Γ1) (delete x Γ2).
Proof.
  unfold env in *.
  intros H i t1 t2 H1 H2.
  destruct (decide (x=i)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_eq Γ1 i) in H1. done.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ1 x i E) in H1. rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ2 x i E) in H2. apply (H i t1 t2 H1 H2).
Qed.

Lemma delete_insert_none x (t : type) (Γ : env) : Γ !! x = None -> delete x (<[x:=t]>Γ) = Γ.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. intros Hx. apply map_eq. intro y. destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_eq (<[y:=t]>Γ) y). done.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_ne (<[x:=t]>Γ) x y E). rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x y t E). done.
Qed.

Lemma delete_none x (Γ : env) : Γ !! x = None -> delete x Γ = Γ.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. intros Hx. apply map_eq. intro y. destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_eq Γ y). done.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ x y E). done.
Qed.

Lemma insert_delete_same x (t : type) (Γ : env) : Γ !! x = Some t -> <[x:=t]>(delete x Γ) = Γ.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. intros Hx. apply map_eq. intro y. destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (delete y Γ) y t). symmetry. done.
  - rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (delete x Γ) x y t E). rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ x y E). done.
Qed.

Lemma insert_insert_same x (t1 t2 : type) (Γ : env) :
  <[x:=t2]>(<[x:=t1]>Γ) = <[x:=t2]>Γ.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro y. destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (<[y:=t1]>Γ) y t2). rewrite (lookup_insert_eq Γ y t2). done.
  - rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[x:=t1]>Γ) x y t2 E).
    rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x y t2 E).
    rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x y t1 E). done.
Qed.

Lemma insert_insert_comm x y (t1 t2 : type) (Γ : env) : x <> y ->
  <[x:=t1]>(<[y:=t2]>Γ) = <[y:=t2]>(<[x:=t1]>Γ).
Proof.
  intros Hne. unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro z.
  destruct (decide (z=x)) as [E1|E1].
  - subst z.
    destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E2|E2].
    + exfalso. apply Hne. done.
    + rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (<[y:=t2]>Γ) x t1).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[x:=t1]>Γ) y x t2 (fun H => E2 (eq_sym H))).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_eq Γ x t1). done.
  - destruct (decide (z=y)) as [E2|E2].
    + subst z.
      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[y:=t2]>Γ) x y t1 Hne).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_eq Γ y t2).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (<[x:=t1]>Γ) y t2). done.
    + rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[y:=t2]>Γ) x z t1 (fun H => E1 (eq_sym H))).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ y z t2 (fun H => E2 (eq_sym H))).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[x:=t1]>Γ) y z t2 (fun H => E2 (eq_sym H))).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x z t1 (fun H => E1 (eq_sym H))). done.
Qed.

Lemma env_split_delete x (E E1 E2 : env) :
  env_split E E1 E2 -> env_split (delete x E) (delete x E1) (delete x E2).
Proof.
  unfold env in *. intros [Hun Hdis]. split.
  - rewrite Hun. apply delete_union.
  - apply disj_delete. done.
Qed.

Lemma env_unr_empty : env_unr (∅ : env).
Proof. unfold env in *. intros x t H. assert (H0 : (∅ : gmap string type) !! x = None) by apply lookup_empty. setoid_rewrite H0 in H. done. Qed.

Lemma env_split_nil : env_split (∅ : env) ∅ ∅.
Proof.
  unfold env_split. split.
  - symmetry. apply env_union_empty_l.
  - intros i t1 t2 H1 H2. assert (H0 : (∅ : env) !! i = None) by (unfold env; apply lookup_empty).
    setoid_rewrite H0 in H1. done.
Qed.

(* ---------- Source typing embeds in the runtime typing ---------- *)

Lemma typed_to_wt Γ e t (H : typed Γ e t) : forall L, wt L Γ e t.
Proof.
  induction H as
    [ Γ x t Hvar
    | Γ Γ' x e t1 t2 l Hb Hunr Hty IH
    | Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 l Hsplit Hty1 IH1 Hty2 IH2
    | Γ Hunr
    | Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 Hsplit Hty1 IH1 Hty2 IH2
    | Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 t Hsplit Hty1 IH1 Hty2 IH2
    | Γ n ts i e Hty IH
    | n Γ Γ1 Γ2 t ts es e Hsplit Hn Hty IH Hf IHf
    | Γ e t1 t2 Hty IH
    | Γ e t Hty IH
    | Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t l1 l2 l3 Hsplit Hcap Hty1 IH1 Hty2 IH2
    | Γ e t lo Hty IH
    | Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t lo Hsplit Hty1 IH1 Hty2 IH2
    | Γ e t Hty IH
    | Γ e t Hty IH ];
    intros L.
  - apply VarW; exact Hvar.
  - eapply FunW; [ exact Hb | exact Hunr | apply IH ].
  - eapply AppW; [ exact Hsplit | apply IH1 | apply IH2 ].
  - apply UnitW; exact Hunr.
  - eapply PairW; [ exact Hsplit | apply IH1 | apply IH2 ].
  - eapply LetPairW; [ exact Hsplit | apply IH1 | apply IH2 ].
  - eapply SumW; apply IH.
  - eapply MatchSumW; [ exact Hsplit | exact Hn | apply IH | intros i; apply (IHf i L) ].
  - eapply ForkW; apply IH.
  - eapply NewLockW; apply IH.
  - eapply ForkLockW; [ exact Hsplit | exact Hcap | apply IH1 | apply IH2 ].
  - eapply AcquireW; apply IH.
  - eapply ReleaseW; [ exact Hsplit | apply IH1 | apply IH2 ].

(* Interface combining the per-thread lemma with the missing object-level
   accounting.  [threads_typed] is the runtime-typing invariant on live
   threads; [obj_progress] is exactly the accounting obligation for live
   objects (locks and barriers) that are not threads.  Note that
   [progress_or_wait] cannot be derived from [thread_progress] alone: a live
   [Barrier] or [Lock] is not a thread, so the per-thread lemma says nothing
   about it, and [can_step] at such an index is only available when a matching
   operation is currently observable in some thread/object. *)

Definition progress_or_wait_obj (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i, ρ !! i <> None -> can_step ρ i \/ exists j, waiting ρ i j.

Definition threads_typed (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i e, ρ !! i = Some (Thread e) -> wt L ∅ e UnitT.

Definition obj_progress (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i y, ρ !! i = Some y -> (forall e, y <> Thread e) ->
    can_step ρ i \/ exists j, waiting ρ i j.

Lemma progress_or_wait_of_typed_obj ρ
    (Hty : threads_typed ρ) (Hobj : obj_progress ρ) :
  progress_or_wait_obj ρ.
Proof.
  intros i Hi.
  destruct (ρ !! i) as [y|] eqn:E.
  - destruct y as [e | | rc o].
    + exact (thread_progress ρ i e E (Hty i e E)).
    + apply Hobj with (y := Barrier); [exact E | discriminate].
    + apply Hobj with (y := Lock rc o); [exact E | discriminate].
  - exfalso. exact (Hi eq_refl).
Qed.

From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.
From Stdlib Require Import Classical_Prop.
From stdpp Require Import gmap.
From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String.
Open Scope string_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Object-level capability inventory.                                 *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* The inventory is deliberately abstract in the maps [caps] and      *)
(* [bend]: a future annotated runtime typing (or a reachability      *)
(* invariant) is expected to provide, for every live configuration,   *)
(* the set of holders of each lock capability state and the set of    *)
(* holders of each barrier endpoint.  The fields below are the        *)
(* accounting facts; the only semantic-looking field is              *)
(* [cap_wait_step], which records that a holder of a capability that  *)
(* is itself blocked on the same lock would exhibit a local step at   *)
(* the lock index.  This is the state/ownership typing fact needed to *)
(* replace per-thread syntax, and it is exactly what avoids the       *)
(* MatchSum branch-duplication problem: capability occurrences are    *)
(* holders in live objects, not raw syntactic occurrences.            *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition cap_inventory
    (ρ : cfg)
    (caps : nat -> lockcap -> gset nat)   (* lock n, capability state lc *)
    (bend : nat -> gset nat)              (* barrier n, endpoint holders *)
    : Prop :=
  (* every capability occurrence is in a live object which references n *)
  (forall n lc j, j ∈ caps n lc -> ρ !! j <> None) /\
  (forall n lc j, j ∈ caps n lc ->
     exists y, ρ !! j = Some y /\ n ∈ obj_refs y) /\
  (* a blocked holder of a capability for n exposes a step at n *)
  (forall n lc j e,
     j ∈ caps n lc -> ρ !! j = Some (Thread e) -> expr_waiting e n ->
     can_step ρ n) /\
  (* exactly one Opened capability when the lock content is absent *)
  (forall n rc, ρ !! n = Some (Lock rc None) ->
     exists j, caps n (Owner,Opened) ∪ caps n (Client,Opened) = {[j]}) /\
  (* no Opened capability when the lock has content *)
  (forall n rc v, ρ !! n = Some (Lock rc (Some v)) ->
     caps n (Owner,Opened) ∪ caps n (Client,Opened) = ∅) /\
  (* a lock with content has a capability holder (an owner/referencer) *)
  (forall n rc v, ρ !! n = Some (Lock rc (Some v)) ->
     exists lc j, j ∈ caps n lc) /\
  (* [refcnt] counts Client capabilities *)
  (forall n rc o, ρ !! n = Some (Lock rc o) ->
     (0 < rc <-> exists j, j ∈ caps n (Client,Closed) ∪ caps n (Client,Opened))) /\
  (* a live barrier has exactly two endpoint holders *)
  (forall n, ρ !! n = Some Barrier ->
     exists a b, a <> b /\ bend n = {[a;b]}) /\
  (* endpoints live and reference the barrier *)
  (forall n j, j ∈ bend n -> ρ !! j <> None) /\
  (forall n j, j ∈ bend n ->
     exists y, ρ !! j = Some y /\ n ∈ obj_refs y) /\
  (* at most one endpoint can be a thread blocked on the barrier; two
     blocked endpoints would be a synchronisation redex *)
  (forall n j k e e',
     j ∈ bend n -> k ∈ bend n ->
     ρ !! j = Some (Thread e) -> expr_waiting e n ->
     ρ !! k = Some (Thread e') -> expr_waiting e' n -> j = k).

(* A holder that is not itself blocked on n gives a clause-2 waiting
   edge to n. *)

Lemma waiting_of_inventory_ref ρ n j y
    (Hj : ρ !! j = Some y) (Href : n ∈ obj_refs y)
    (Hnotwait : forall e, y = Thread e -> ~ expr_waiting e n) :
  waiting ρ n j.
Proof.
  right. exists y. split; [exact Hj|split; [exact Href|exact Hnotwait]].
Qed.

Lemma kind_live_no_thread_in_refs_at (ρ : cfg) i e b

      * pose proof (Hbar_val b rc (Some v) v i Eb Hbarr) as Hbar.

Lemma threads_typed_frame L (a a' ρf : cfg) :
  a ##ₘ ρf -> a' ##ₘ ρf ->
  threads_typed L (a ∪ ρf) ->
  threads_typed L a' ->
  threads_typed L (a' ∪ ρf).
Proof.
  intros Ha Haa Hsrc Hloc j e Hj.
  apply (proj1 (lookup_union_Some a' ρf j (Thread e) Haa)) in Hj.
