From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.
From stdpp Require Import gmap decidable.
From Stdlib Require Import List Arith Lia.
From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String.
Import ListNotations.
Require Import AllCombine.
Require Import CapCex.
Require Import KindRefs.
Open Scope string_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* A Release-oriented obstruction to pair/forest preservation.         *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* The destination of Release is a lock, not a live thread, so the     *)
(* [kind_live] "no live object refers to a live thread" argument      *)
(* does not apply.  This file machine-checks that all the other       *)
(* invariants we have (typed threads, cap_inventory, refs_live,        *)
(* ref_pair_ok, ref_forest) do not prevent Release from creating a     *)
(* self-reference at the destination lock.                             *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* The witness deliberately uses [BarrierV 1] to reference lock 1:    *)
(* that is what makes the source NOT kind_live.  A kind-live witness   *)
(* would have to reference lock 1 via [LockV 1], which forces the      *)
(* deposited type [t = L 1] to satisfy [t = LockT _ t].  The current   *)
(* permissive [cv] has no such derivation, so this is precisely the    *)
(* extra lock-content acyclicity fact needed for the Release case.     *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition rx_t : type := FunT Lin UnitT UnitT.
Definition rx_L : gmap nat type := {[1 := rx_t]}.

Lemma rx_L1 : rx_L !! 1 = Some rx_t.
Proof. unfold rx_L. apply lookup_singleton_eq. Qed.

Definition rx_inner : expr := Release (Val (LockV 1)) (Val (BarrierV 1)).
Definition rx_e : expr := Drop rx_inner.

Lemma rx_inner_wt : wt rx_L ∅ rx_inner (LockT (Client,Closed) rx_t).
Proof.
  unfold rx_inner.
  eapply ReleaseW with (Γ1 := ∅) (Γ2 := ∅) (lo := Client).
  - apply env_split_nil.
  - apply ValW.
    + apply env_unr_empty.
    + change (cv rx_L (LockV 1) (LockT (Client,Opened) rx_t)).
      apply LockVW. exact rx_L1.
  - apply ValW.
    + apply env_unr_empty.
    + unfold rx_t. apply BarrierVW.
Qed.

Lemma rx_e_wt : wt rx_L ∅ rx_e UnitT.
Proof.
  unfold rx_e.
  eapply DropW.
  exact rx_inner_wt.
Qed.

Definition rx_src : cfg := {[0 := Thread rx_e; 1 := Lock 0 None]}.
Definition rx_tgt : cfg :=
  {[0 := Thread (Drop (Val (LockV 1)));
    1 := Lock 0 (Some (BarrierV 1))]}.

(* ---------- lookups ---------- *)

Lemma rx_src_lookup0 : rx_src !! 0 = Some (Thread rx_e).
Proof.
  unfold rx_src.
  change ((<[0 := Thread rx_e]> (<[1 := Lock 0 None]> (∅ : cfg))) !! 0
          = Some (Thread rx_e)).
  apply lookup_insert_eq.
Qed.

Lemma rx_src_lookup1 : rx_src !! 1 = Some (Lock 0 None).
Proof.
  unfold rx_src.
  change ((<[0 := Thread rx_e]> (<[1 := Lock 0 None]> (∅ : cfg))) !! 1
          = Some (Lock 0 None)).
  assert (H : (<[0 := Thread rx_e]> (<[1 := Lock 0 None]> (∅ : cfg))) !! 1
              = (<[1 := Lock 0 None]> (∅ : cfg)) !! 1).
  { apply lookup_insert_ne. lia. }
  rewrite H. apply lookup_insert_eq.
Qed.

Lemma rx_src_lookup_other n (H0 : n <> 0) (H1 : n <> 1) :
  rx_src !! n = None.
Proof.
  unfold rx_src.
  change ((<[0 := Thread rx_e]> (<[1 := Lock 0 None]> (∅ : cfg))) !! n = None).
  assert (H01 : (<[0 := Thread rx_e]> (<[1 := Lock 0 None]> (∅ : cfg))) !! n
                = (<[1 := Lock 0 None]> (∅ : cfg)) !! n).
  { apply lookup_insert_ne. congruence. }
  assert (H12 : (<[1 := Lock 0 None]> (∅ : cfg)) !! n = (∅ : cfg) !! n).
  { apply lookup_insert_ne. congruence. }
  rewrite H01, H12. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma rx_tgt_lookup0 :
  rx_tgt !! 0 = Some (Thread (Drop (Val (LockV 1)))).
Proof.
  unfold rx_tgt.
  change ((<[0 := Thread (Drop (Val (LockV 1)))]>
            (<[1 := Lock 0 (Some (BarrierV 1))]> (∅ : cfg))) !! 0
          = Some (Thread (Drop (Val (LockV 1))))).
  apply lookup_insert_eq.
Qed.

Lemma rx_tgt_lookup1 :
  rx_tgt !! 1 = Some (Lock 0 (Some (BarrierV 1))).
Proof.
  unfold rx_tgt.
  change ((<[0 := Thread (Drop (Val (LockV 1)))]>
            (<[1 := Lock 0 (Some (BarrierV 1))]> (∅ : cfg))) !! 1
          = Some (Lock 0 (Some (BarrierV 1)))).
  assert (H : (<[0 := Thread (Drop (Val (LockV 1)))]>
               (<[1 := Lock 0 (Some (BarrierV 1))]> (∅ : cfg))) !! 1
              = (<[1 := Lock 0 (Some (BarrierV 1))]> (∅ : cfg)) !! 1).
  { apply lookup_insert_ne. lia. }
  rewrite H. apply lookup_insert_eq.
Qed.

Lemma rx_tgt_lookup_other n (H0 : n <> 0) (H1 : n <> 1) :
  rx_tgt !! n = None.
Proof.
  unfold rx_tgt.
  change ((<[0 := Thread (Drop (Val (LockV 1)))]>
            (<[1 := Lock 0 (Some (BarrierV 1))]> (∅ : cfg))) !! n = None).
  assert (H01 : (<[0 := Thread (Drop (Val (LockV 1)))]>
                  (<[1 := Lock 0 (Some (BarrierV 1))]> (∅ : cfg))) !! n
                = (<[1 := Lock 0 (Some (BarrierV 1))]> (∅ : cfg)) !! n).
  { apply lookup_insert_ne. congruence. }
  assert (H12 : (<[1 := Lock 0 (Some (BarrierV 1))]> (∅ : cfg)) !! n
                = (∅ : cfg) !! n).
  { apply lookup_insert_ne. congruence. }
  rewrite H01, H12. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* ---------- reference sets ---------- *)

Lemma rx_src_refs0 : refs_at rx_src 0 = {[1]}.
Proof.
  unfold refs_at. rewrite rx_src_lookup0.
  unfold rx_e, rx_inner. simpl. set_solver.
Qed.

Lemma rx_src_refs1 : refs_at rx_src 1 = ∅.
Proof.
  unfold refs_at. rewrite rx_src_lookup1. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma rx_src_refs_other n (H0 : n <> 0) (H1 : n <> 1) :
  refs_at rx_src n = ∅.
Proof.
  unfold refs_at. rewrite rx_src_lookup_other; [reflexivity|exact H0|exact H1].
Qed.

Lemma rx_tgt_refs0 : refs_at rx_tgt 0 = {[1]}.
Proof.
  unfold refs_at. rewrite rx_tgt_lookup0. simpl. set_solver.
Qed.

Lemma rx_tgt_refs1 : refs_at rx_tgt 1 = {[1]}.
Proof.
  unfold refs_at. rewrite rx_tgt_lookup1. simpl. set_solver.
Qed.

Lemma rx_tgt_refs_other n (H0 : n <> 0) (H1 : n <> 1) :
  refs_at rx_tgt n = ∅.
Proof.
  unfold refs_at. rewrite rx_tgt_lookup_other; [reflexivity|exact H0|exact H1].
Qed.

(* ---------- the step ---------- *)

Definition rx_ctx : expr -> expr := fun x => Drop x.

Lemma rx_ctx_ctx : ctx rx_ctx.
Proof.
  unfold rx_ctx.
  change (ctx ((fun x => Drop x) ∘ id)).
  apply (@Ctx_comp (fun x => Drop x) id Ctx_Drop Ctx_id).
Qed.

Lemma rx_release_local : local_step 1 rx_src rx_tgt.
Proof.
  unfold rx_src, rx_tgt, rx_e, rx_inner, rx_ctx.
  apply (Release_step (BarrierV 1) (fun x => Drop x) 0 1 0).
  - lia.
  - apply rx_ctx_ctx.
Qed.

Lemma rx_union_empty_r (m : cfg) : m ∪ ∅ = m.
Proof.
  apply map_eq. intro x. apply lookup_union_l. apply lookup_empty.
Qed.

Lemma rx_step : step 1 rx_src rx_tgt.
Proof.
  assert (E1 : rx_src = rx_src ∪ ∅) by (symmetry; apply rx_union_empty_r).
  assert (E2 : rx_tgt = rx_tgt ∪ ∅) by (symmetry; apply rx_union_empty_r).
  rewrite E1, E2.
  eapply Frame_step;
    [apply map_disjoint_empty_r | apply map_disjoint_empty_r | exact rx_release_local].
Qed.

(* ---------- thread typing, source and target ---------- *)

Lemma rx_src_threads_typed : threads_typed rx_L rx_src.
Proof.
  intros i e Hi.
  destruct (decide (i = 0)) as [E|E].
  - subst i. rewrite rx_src_lookup0 in Hi. inversion Hi; subst e. exact rx_e_wt.
  - destruct (decide (i = 1)) as [E1|E1].
    + subst i. rewrite rx_src_lookup1 in Hi. discriminate.
    + rewrite rx_src_lookup_other in Hi;
        [discriminate | exact E | exact E1].
Qed.

Lemma rx_tgt_thread_wt : wt rx_L ∅ (Drop (Val (LockV 1))) UnitT.
Proof.
  eapply DropW with (t := rx_t).
  apply ValW.
  - apply env_unr_empty.
  - change (cv rx_L (LockV 1) (LockT (Client,Closed) rx_t)).
    apply LockVW. exact rx_L1.
Qed.

Lemma rx_tgt_threads_typed : threads_typed rx_L rx_tgt.
Proof.
  intros i e Hi.
  destruct (decide (i = 0)) as [E|E].
  - subst i. rewrite rx_tgt_lookup0 in Hi. inversion Hi; subst e.
    exact rx_tgt_thread_wt.
  - destruct (decide (i = 1)) as [E1|E1].
    + subst i. rewrite rx_tgt_lookup1 in Hi. discriminate.
    + rewrite rx_tgt_lookup_other in Hi;
        [discriminate | exact E | exact E1].
Qed.

(* ---------- capability inventory at the source ---------- *)

Definition rx_caps : nat -> lockcap -> gset nat :=
  fun n lc => if decide (n = 1 /\ lc = (Owner,Opened)) then {[0]} else ∅.

Definition rx_bend : nat -> gset nat := fun _ => ∅.

Lemma rx_caps_mem n lc j (Hj : j ∈ rx_caps n lc) :
  n = 1 /\ lc = (Owner,Opened) /\ j = 0.
Proof.
  unfold rx_caps in Hj.
  destruct (decide (n = 1 /\ lc = (Owner,Opened))) as [[Hn Hlc]|H].
  - apply elem_of_singleton in Hj. subst j. auto.
  - exfalso. set_solver.
Qed.

Lemma rx_caps_union_1_opened :
  rx_caps 1 (Owner,Opened) ∪ rx_caps 1 (Client,Opened) = {[0]}.
Proof.
  unfold rx_caps.
  destruct (decide (1 = 1 /\ (Owner,Opened) = (Owner,Opened))) as [_|H].

Lemma env_unr_singleton_unr x (t : type) (Ht : unr t) :
  env_unr (<[x := t]> (∅ : env)).
Proof.
  intros y s Hy.

    assert (Hx : (<[x := t]> (∅ : env)) !! x = Some t).
    { unfold env. apply lookup_insert_eq. }
    rewrite Hx in Hy. injection Hy as ->. exact Ht.
  - assert (Hne : (<[x := t]> (∅ : env)) !! y = (∅ : env) !! y).
    { unfold env. apply lookup_insert_ne. congruence. }
    rewrite Hne in Hy.
    assert (Hnone : (∅ : env) !! y = None) by apply lookup_empty.
    rewrite Hnone in Hy. discriminate.
Qed.

(* Auxiliary: a context cannot turn a non-value into a value. *)
Lemma ctx_val_inv k e v (Hk : ctx k) (H : k e = Val v) : e = Val v.
Proof.
  induction Hk as [| k1 k2 H1 H2 IH]; simpl in H.
  - exact H.
  - destruct H1; simpl in H; discriminate.
Qed.

(* A context applied to e' cannot produce an application whose operator
   is a function value unless e' is the function value or the argument. *)
Lemma ctx_app_funv_inv k x b a (Hk : ctx k) :
  forall e', k e' = App (Val (FunV x b)) (Val a) ->
    e' = App (Val (FunV x b)) (Val a) \/
    e' = Val (FunV x b) \/ e' = Val a.
Proof.
  induction Hk as [| k1 k2 H1 H2 IH]; intros e' He.
  - simpl in He. left. exact He.
  - simpl in He. destruct H1; simpl in He; try discriminate.
    + inversion He; subst.
      assert (Hval : k2 e' = Val (FunV x b)) by congruence.
      exact (or_intror (or_introl
        (eq_trans (ctx_val_inv k2 e' (FunV x b) H2 Hval) (eq_sym Hval)))).
    + inversion He; subst.
      assert (Hval : k2 e' = Val a) by congruence.
      exact (or_intror (or_intror
        (eq_trans (ctx_val_inv k2 e' a H2 Hval) (eq_sym Hval)))).
Qed.

From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.
From stdpp Require Import gmap list.
From Stdlib Require Import List Arith Lia.
From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String.
Import ListNotations.
Close Scope string_scope.

Load "/tmp/scratch6/FunGraph.v".

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Pair preservation for the individual local-step reference shapes.  *)
(* ================================================================== *)

(* Attaching a fresh leaf [n] (with no out-references) below [i]. *)
Lemma pair_add_fresh_leaf (S T : nat -> gset nat) (i n : nat) :
  ref_pair_ok_fun S ->
  n <> i ->
  (forall a, n ∉ S a) ->
  T n = ∅ ->
  T i = S i ∪ {[n]} ->
  (forall a, a <> i -> a <> n -> T a = S a) ->
  ref_pair_ok_fun T.
Proof.
  intros [Hself Hpair] Hni Hfresh HTn HTi Hother.
  split.
  - intro a. destruct (decide (a = i)) as [E|Hai].
    + subst a. intro Hmem. rewrite HTi in Hmem.
      apply elem_of_union in Hmem as [Hin|Hin].
      * exact (Hself i Hin).
      * apply elem_of_singleton in Hin. apply Hni. symmetry. exact Hin.
    + destruct (decide (a = n)) as [E|Han].
      * subst a. rewrite HTn. set_solver.
      * rewrite (Hother a Hai Han). apply Hself.
  - intros a b Hne [Hb Ha].
    destruct (decide (a = i)) as [Ea|Hai].
    + subst a. rewrite HTi in Hb.
      apply elem_of_union in Hb as [HbS|HbN].
      * destruct (decide (b = n)) as [Eb|Hbn].
        -- subst b. rewrite HTn in Ha. set_solver.
        -- rewrite (Hother b (ne_sym Hne) Hbn) in Ha.
           exact (Hpair i b Hne (conj HbS Ha)).
      * apply elem_of_singleton in HbN. subst b.
        rewrite HTn in Ha. set_solver.
    + destruct (decide (a = n)) as [Ea|Han].
      * subst a. rewrite HTn in Hb. set_solver.
      * rewrite (Hother a Hai Han) in Hb.
        destruct (decide (b = i)) as [Eb|Hbi].
        -- subst b. rewrite HTi in Ha.
           apply elem_of_union in Ha as [HaS|HaN].
           ++ exact (Hpair a i Hne (conj Hb HaS)).
           ++ apply elem_of_singleton in HaN. subst a. apply Hni. reflexivity.
        -- destruct (decide (b = n)) as [Eb|Hbn].
           ++ subst b. rewrite HTn in Ha. set_solver.
           ++ rewrite (Hother b Hbi Hbn) in Ha.
              exact (Hpair a b Hne (conj Hb Ha)).
Qed.

(* Acquire / Wait: the lock content bundle moves into the thread. *)
Lemma acquire_pair_shape (S T : nat -> gset nat) (i n : nat) (B : gset nat) :
  ref_pair_ok_fun S ->
  T i ⊆ S i ∪ B ->
  T n = ∅ ->
  (forall a, a <> i -> a <> n -> T a = S a) ->
  i ∉ B ->
  (forall b, b ∈ B -> i ∉ T b) ->
  ref_pair_ok_fun T.
Proof.
  intros. eapply pair_move_add_shrink; eauto.
Qed.

(* Release: the thread's value bundle moves into the lock.  This is
   exactly where the destination-backreference invariant is needed. *)
Lemma release_pair_shape (S T : nat -> gset nat) (n i : nat) (B : gset nat) :
  ref_pair_ok_fun S ->
  n <> i ->
  T n = S n ∪ B ->
  T i ⊆ S i ->
  (forall a, a <> n -> a <> i -> T a = S a) ->
  n ∉ B ->
  (forall b, b ∈ B -> n ∉ T b) ->
  ref_pair_ok_fun T.
Proof.
  intros. eapply pair_move_to_dest; eauto.
Qed.

(* NewLock: fresh lock [n] becomes the destination, the thread loses its
   value bundle [B] and gains the fresh token [n]. *)
Lemma newlock_pair_shape (S T : nat -> gset nat) (i n : nat) (B : gset nat) :
  ref_pair_ok_fun S ->
  n <> i ->
  (forall a, n ∉ S a) ->
  B ⊆ S i ->
  T n = B ->
  T i ⊆ S i ∪ {[n]} ->
  (forall a, a <> i -> a <> n -> T a = S a) ->
  ref_pair_ok_fun T.
Proof.
  intros Hpair Hni Hfresh HB HTn HTi Hother.
  destruct Hpair as [Hself Hpair0].
  set (T1 := fun a => if decide (a = i) then S i ∪ {[n]}
                      else if decide (a = n) then ∅ else S a).
  assert (HT1n : T1 n = ∅).
  { unfold T1. destruct (decide (n = i)) as [E|H].
    - exfalso. apply Hni. symmetry. exact E.
    - destruct (decide (n = n)) as [E|H]; [reflexivity|exfalso; apply H; reflexivity]. }
  assert (HT1i : T1 i = S i ∪ {[n]}).
  { unfold T1. destruct (decide (i = i)) as [E|H]; [reflexivity|exfalso; apply H; reflexivity]. }
  assert (HT1other : forall a, a <> i -> a <> n -> T1 a = S a).
  { intros a Hai Han. unfold T1.
    destruct (decide (a = i)) as [E|H]; [exfalso; apply Hai; exact E|].
    destruct (decide (a = n)) as [E|H]; [exfalso; apply Han; exact E|]. reflexivity. }
  assert (Hpair1 : ref_pair_ok_fun T1).
  { apply pair_add_fresh_leaf with (i := i) (n := n); auto. }
  assert (HnB : n ∉ B).
  { intro Hn. apply (Hfresh i). apply HB in Hn. exact Hn. }
  assert (Hrev : forall b, b ∈ B -> n ∉ T b).
  { intros b Hb HnT.
    assert (Hbi : b <> i).
    { intro E. subst b. exact (Hself i (HB Hb)). }
    assert (Hbn : b <> n).
    { intro E. subst b. exact (HnB Hb). }
    apply (Hfresh b). rewrite <- (Hother b Hbi Hbn). exact HnT. }
  eapply pair_move_to_dest with (S := T1) (T := T) (d := n) (s := i) (B := B).
  - exact Hpair1.
  - exact Hni.
  - rewrite HTn. rewrite HT1n. set_solver.
  - rewrite HT1i. exact HTi.
  - intros a Han Hai. rewrite (HT1other a Hai Han). apply Hother; assumption.
  - exact HnB.
  - exact Hrev.
Qed.

(* ForkLock: [B] moves to the fresh forked thread [j], which also gets
   the lock token [n]. *)
Lemma forklock_pair_shape (S T : nat -> gset nat) (i j n : nat) (B : gset nat) :
  ref_pair_ok_fun S ->
  i <> j -> i <> n -> j <> n ->
  (forall a, j ∉ S a) ->
  S j = ∅ ->
  B ⊆ S i ->
  i ∉ B ->
  T j = B ∪ {[n]} ->
  T i ⊆ S i ->
  T n = S n ->
  (forall a, a <> i -> a <> j -> a <> n -> T a = S a) ->
  ref_pair_ok_fun T.
Proof.
  intros Hpair Hij Hin Hjn Hfresh HSj HB HiB HTj HTi HTn Hother.
  destruct Hpair as [Hself Hpair0].
  change (ref_pair_ok_fun T).
  eapply pair_move_to_dest with (S := S) (T := T) (d := j) (s := i)
                                 (B := B ∪ {[n]}).
  - split; assumption.
  - apply (ne_sym Hij).
  - rewrite HTj, HSj. set_solver.
  - exact HTi.
  - intros a Haj Hai. destruct (decide (a = n)) as [E|Hn].
    + subst a. exact HTn.
    + apply Hother; assumption.
  - (* j ∉ B ∪ {[n]} *)
    apply elem_of_union.
    assert (HjB : j ∉ B).
    { intro Hj. apply (Hfresh i). apply HB in Hj. exact Hj. }
    assert (Hjn' : j <> n) by (apply (ne_sym Hjn)).
    set_solver.
  - (* forall b in B ∪ {[n]}, j ∉ T b *)
    intros b Hb HjT.
    apply elem_of_union in Hb as [HbB|HbN].
    + destruct (decide (b = n)) as [E|Hbn].
      * subst b. rewrite <- HTn in HjT. apply (Hfresh n). exact HjT.
      * assert (Hbi : b <> i).
        { intro E. subst b. exact (Hself i (HB HbB)). }
        assert (Hbj : b <> j).
        { intro E. subst b. apply (Hfresh i). exact (HB HbB). }
        rewrite <- (Hother b Hbi Hbj Hbn) in HjT.
        exact (Hfresh b HjT).
    + apply elem_of_singleton in HbN. subst b.
      rewrite <- HTn in HjT. exact (Hfresh n HjT).
Qed.

(* Fork: [B] moves to the fresh forked thread [j]; barrier [n] is a
   second fresh leaf attached to both [i] and [j]. *)
Lemma fork_pair_shape (S T : nat -> gset nat) (i j n : nat) (B : gset nat) :
  ref_pair_ok_fun S ->
  i <> j -> i <> n -> j <> n ->
  (forall a, n ∉ S a) ->
  (forall a, j ∉ S a) ->
  S j = ∅ ->
  B ⊆ S i ->
  i ∉ B ->
  T j = B ∪ {[n]} ->
  T i ⊆ S i ∪ {[n]} ->
  T n = ∅ ->
  (forall a, a <> i -> a <> j -> a <> n -> T a = S a) ->
  ref_pair_ok_fun T.
Proof.
  intros Hpair Hij Hin Hjn Hfreshn Hfreshj HSj HB HiB HTj HTi HTn Hother.
  destruct Hpair as [Hself Hpair0].
  set (T1 := fun a => if decide (a = i) then S i ∪ {[n]}
                      else if decide (a = n) then ∅ else S a).
  assert (HT1n : T1 n = ∅).
  { unfold T1. destruct (decide (n = i)) as [E|H].
    - exfalso. apply Hin. symmetry. exact E.
    - destruct (decide (n = n)) as [E|H]; [reflexivity|exfalso; apply H; reflexivity]. }
  assert (HT1i : T1 i = S i ∪ {[n]}).
  { unfold T1. destruct (decide (i = i)) as [E|H]; [reflexivity|exfalso; apply H; reflexivity]. }
  assert (HT1other : forall a, a <> i -> a <> n -> T1 a = S a).
  { intros a Hai Han. unfold T1.
    destruct (decide (a = i)) as [E|H]; [exfalso; apply Hai; exact E|].
    destruct (decide (a = n)) as [E|H]; [exfalso; apply Han; exact E|]. reflexivity. }
  assert (Hpair1 : ref_pair_ok_fun T1).
  { apply pair_add_fresh_leaf with (i := i) (n := n); auto. }
  assert (HnB : n ∉ B).
  { intro Hn. apply (Hfreshn i). apply HB in Hn. exact Hn. }
  assert (HjB : j ∉ B).
  { intro Hj. apply (Hfreshj i). apply HB in Hj. exact Hj. }
  eapply pair_move_to_dest with (S := T1) (T := T) (d := j) (s := i)
                                 (B := B ∪ {[n]}).
  - exact Hpair1.
  - apply (ne_sym Hij).
  - (* T j = T1 j ∪ (B ∪ {[n]}) *)
    assert (HT1j : T1 j = S j).
    { rewrite HT1other; [reflexivity| apply (ne_sym Hij) | exact Hjn]. }
    rewrite HTj, HT1j, HSj. set_solver.
  - rewrite HT1i. exact HTi.
  - intros a Haj Hai. destruct (decide (a = n)) as [E|Hn].
    + subst a. rewrite HTn. rewrite HT1n. reflexivity.
    + rewrite (HT1other a Hai Hn). apply Hother; assumption.
  - (* j ∉ B ∪ {[n]} *)
    assert (Hjn' : j <> n) by (apply (ne_sym Hjn)).
    set_solver.
  - intros b Hb HjT.
    apply elem_of_union in Hb as [HbB|HbN].
    + destruct (decide (b = n)) as [E|Hbn].
      * subst b. rewrite HTn in HjT. set_solver.
      * assert (Hbi : b <> i).
        { intro E. subst b. exact (Hself i (HB HbB)). }
        assert (Hbj : b <> j) by exact HjB.
        rewrite <- (Hother b Hbi Hbj Hbn) in HjT.
        exact (Hfreshj b HjT).
    + apply elem_of_singleton in HbN. subst b.
      rewrite HTn in HjT. set_solver.
Qed.

(* Sync: only one of the two exchanged bundles is needed to check the
   pair condition; it moves into the live thread [i]. *)
Lemma sync_pair_shape (S T : nat -> gset nat) (i j : nat) (B2 : gset nat) :
  ref_pair_ok_fun S ->
  i <> j ->
  i ∉ B2 ->
  (forall b, b ∈ B2 -> i ∉ S b) ->
  T i ⊆ S i ∪ B2 ->
  (forall a, a <> i -> T a ⊆ S a) ->
  ref_pair_ok_fun T.
Proof.
  intros Hpair Hij HiB Hside HTi Hsub.
  set (T1 := fun a => if decide (a = i) then S i ∪ B2 else S a).
  assert (HT1i : T1 i = S i ∪ B2).
  { unfold T1. destruct (decide (i = i)) as [E|H]; [reflexivity|exfalso; apply H; reflexivity]. }
  assert (HT1other : forall a, a <> i -> T1 a = S a).
  { intros a Hai. unfold T1. destruct (decide (a = i)) as [E|H]; [exfalso; apply Hai; exact E|reflexivity]. }
  assert (Hpair1 : ref_pair_ok_fun T1).
  { eapply pair_move_to_dest with (S := S) (T := T1) (d := i) (s := j) (B := B2).
    - exact Hpair.
    - exact Hij.
    - exact HT1i.
    - rewrite HT1other; [reflexivity| apply (ne_sym Hij)].
    - intros a Hai Haj. apply HT1other. exact Hai.
    - exact HiB.
    - intros b Hb.
      rewrite HT1other; [exact (Hside b Hb)| exact (fun E => HiB (E ▸ Hb))]. }
  eapply ref_pair_ok_shrink_fun with (S := T1).
  - intros a. destruct (decide (a = i)) as [E|Hai].
    + subst a. rewrite HT1i. exact HTi.
    + rewrite HT1other; [apply Hsub; exact Hai| exact Hai].
  - exact Hpair1.
Qed.

Print Assumptions acquire_pair_shape.
Print Assumptions release_pair_shape.
Print Assumptions newlock_pair_shape.
Print Assumptions forklock_pair_shape.
Print Assumptions fork_pair_shape.
Print Assumptions sync_pair_shape.

  - rewrite option_union_none_l. exact H2.

destruct (decide (1 = 1 /\ (Owner,Opened) = (Owner,Opened))) as [_|H].
  - destruct (decide (1 = 1 /\ (Client,Opened) = (Owner,Opened))) as [H'|_].
    + destruct H' as [_ E]. discriminate E.
    + set_solver.
  - exfalso. apply H. auto.
Qed.

Lemma rx_caps_1_client_closed : rx_caps 1 (Client,Closed) = ∅.
Proof.
  unfold rx_caps.
  destruct (decide (1 = 1 /\ (Client,Closed) = (Owner,Opened))) as [H|_].
  - destruct H as [_ E]. discriminate E.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma rx_caps_1_client_opened : rx_caps 1 (Client,Opened) = ∅.
Proof.
  unfold rx_caps.
  destruct (decide (1 = 1 /\ (Client,Opened) = (Owner,Opened))) as [H|_].
  - destruct H as [_ E]. discriminate E.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma rx_src_lock_inv n rc o (H : rx_src !! n = Some (Lock rc o)) :
  n = 1 /\ rc = 0 /\ o = None.
Proof.
  destruct (decide (n = 0)) as [E|E].
  - subst n. rewrite rx_src_lookup0 in H. discriminate.
  - destruct (decide (n = 1)) as [E1|E1].
    + subst n. rewrite rx_src_lookup1 in H. inversion H; subst.
      split; [reflexivity|split; reflexivity].
    + rewrite rx_src_lookup_other in H;
        [discriminate | exact E | exact E1].
Qed.

Lemma rx_e_waiting : expr_waiting rx_e 1.
Proof.
  unfold rx_e.
  exists rx_ctx, rx_inner. split; [exact rx_ctx_ctx|].
  split; [reflexivity| apply Release_waiting].
Qed.

Lemma rx_src_inventory : cap_inventory rx_src rx_caps rx_bend.
Proof.
  unfold cap_inventory.
  split.
  { intros n lc j Hj.
    destruct (rx_caps_mem n lc j Hj) as [Hn [Hlc Hj0]].
    subst n. subst j. rewrite rx_src_lookup0. discriminate. }
  split.
  { intros n lc j Hj.
    destruct (rx_caps_mem n lc j Hj) as [Hn [Hlc Hj0]].
    subst n. subst j. exists (Thread rx_e). split; [apply rx_src_lookup0|].
    unfold obj_refs. simpl. unfold rx_e, rx_inner. simpl. set_solver. }
  split.
  { intros n lc j e Hj Hje Hw.
    destruct (rx_caps_mem n lc j Hj) as [Hn [Hlc Hj0]].
    subst n. subst j.
    assert (e = rx_e).
    { rewrite rx_src_lookup0 in Hje. inversion Hje. reflexivity. }
    subst e.
    exists rx_tgt. apply rx_step. }
  split.
  { intros n rc Hlock.
    destruct (rx_src_lock_inv n rc None Hlock) as [Hn [Hrc Ho]].
    subst n.
    exists 0. apply rx_caps_union_1_opened. }
  split.
  { intros n rc v Hlock.
    destruct (rx_src_lock_inv n rc (Some v) Hlock) as [_ [_ Ho]].
    discriminate Ho. }
  split.
  { intros n rc v Hlock.
    destruct (rx_src_lock_inv n rc (Some v) Hlock) as [_ [_ Ho]].
    discriminate Ho. }
  split.
  { intros n rc o Hlock.
    destruct (rx_src_lock_inv n rc o Hlock) as [Hn [Hrc Ho]].
    subst n. subst rc.
    rewrite rx_caps_1_client_closed, rx_caps_1_client_opened.
    split; [intro H; lia|]. intros [j Hj]. set_solver. }
  split.
  { intros n Hbar.
    destruct (decide (n = 0)) as [E|E].
    - subst n. rewrite rx_src_lookup0 in Hbar. discriminate.
    - destruct (decide (n = 1)) as [E1|E1].
      + subst n. rewrite rx_src_lookup1 in Hbar. discriminate.
      + rewrite rx_src_lookup_other in Hbar;
          [discriminate | exact E | exact E1]. }
  split.
  { intros n j Hj. unfold rx_bend in Hj. set_solver. }
  split.
  { intros n j Hj. unfold rx_bend in Hj. set_solver. }
  intros n j k e e' Hj. unfold rx_bend in Hj. set_solver.
Qed.

(* ---------- reference liveness ---------- *)

Lemma rx_src_refs_live : refs_live rx_src.
Proof.
  intros i y Hi j Hj.
  destruct (decide (i = 0)) as [E|E].
  - subst i. rewrite rx_src_lookup0 in Hi. inversion Hi; subst y.
    unfold rx_e, rx_inner in Hj. simpl in Hj.
    assert (Hj1 : j = 1) by set_solver. subst j.
    rewrite rx_src_lookup1. discriminate.
  - destruct (decide (i = 1)) as [E1|E1].
    + subst i. rewrite rx_src_lookup1 in Hi. inversion Hi; subst y.
      simpl in Hj. set_solver.
    + rewrite rx_src_lookup_other in Hi;
        [discriminate | exact E | exact E1].
Qed.

(* ---------- pair condition at the source ---------- *)

Lemma rx_src_self_ref_free : self_ref_free rx_src.
Proof.
  intros a.
  destruct (decide (a = 0)) as [E|E].
  - subst a. rewrite rx_src_refs0. set_solver.
  - destruct (decide (a = 1)) as [E1|E1].
    + subst a. rewrite rx_src_refs1. set_solver.
    + rewrite rx_src_refs_other;
        [set_solver | exact E | exact E1].
Qed.

Lemma rx_src_pair_ref_ok : pair_ref_ok rx_src.
Proof.
  intros a b Hne [Hb Ha].
  destruct (decide (a = 0)) as [Ea|Ea].
  - subst a.
    destruct (decide (b = 0)) as [Eb|Eb].
    + exfalso. apply Hne. symmetry. exact Eb.
    + destruct (decide (b = 1)) as [Eb1|Eb1].
      * subst b. rewrite rx_src_refs1 in Ha. set_solver.
      * rewrite rx_src_refs0 in Hb. set_solver.
  - destruct (decide (a = 1)) as [Ea1|Ea1].
    + subst a. rewrite rx_src_refs1 in Hb. set_solver.
    + rewrite (rx_src_refs_other a Ea Ea1) in Hb. set_solver.
Qed.

Lemma rx_src_ref_pair_ok : ref_pair_ok rx_src.
Proof. split; [exact rx_src_self_ref_free|exact rx_src_pair_ref_ok]. Qed.

(* ---------- source forest ---------- *)

Lemma rx_src_mem_edge a b (Hb : b ∈ refs_at rx_src a) :
  a = 0 /\ b = 1.
Proof.
  destruct (decide (a = 0)) as [E|E].
  - subst a. rewrite rx_src_refs0 in Hb. apply elem_of_singleton in Hb. auto.
  - destruct (decide (a = 1)) as [E1|E1].
    + subst a. rewrite rx_src_refs1 in Hb. set_solver.
    + rewrite rx_src_refs_other in Hb;
        [set_solver | exact E | exact E1].
Qed.

Lemma rx_src_ref_edge a b (H : ref_edge rx_src a b) :
  (a = 0 /\ b = 1) \/ (a = 1 /\ b = 0).
Proof.
  destruct H as [Hne [Hb|Ha]].
  - left. apply rx_src_mem_edge. exact Hb.
  - right. destruct (rx_src_mem_edge b a Ha) as [Hb0 Ha1].
    subst b. subst a. split; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma path_cycle_vertex_has_edge (R : nat -> nat -> Prop) :
  forall l z, path_edges R (l ++ (z :: nil)) -> l <> nil ->
  forall x, x ∈ l -> exists y, R x y \/ R y x.
Proof.
  induction l as [|u rest IH]; intros z Hp Hne.
  - intros x Hx. destruct Hne. reflexivity.
  - destruct rest as [|v rest'].
    + simpl in Hp. inversion Hp as [| |a b l' Hr Hrest]; subst.
      intros x Hx. apply elem_of_cons in Hx as [E|Hx]; [|set_solver].
      subst x. exists z. left. exact Hr.
    + simpl in Hp. inversion Hp as [| |a b l' Hr Hrest]; subst.
      intros x Hx. apply elem_of_cons in Hx as [E|Hx].
      * subst x. exists v. left. exact Hr.
      * apply elem_of_cons in Hx as [E|Hx].
        -- subst x. exists u. right. exact Hr.
        -- change (path_edges R ((v :: rest') ++ (z :: nil))) in Hrest.
           assert (Hnn : v :: rest' <> nil) by discriminate.
           assert (Hx' : x ∈ v :: rest') by (apply elem_of_cons; right; exact Hx).
           exact (IH z Hrest Hnn x Hx').
Qed.

Lemma nodup_all_eq_le1 (l : list nat) (c : nat) :
  NoDup l -> (forall x, x ∈ l -> x = c) -> List.length l <= 1.
Proof.
  destruct l as [|x xs]; simpl; intros Hnd Hall; [lia|].
  inversion Hnd as [|? ? Hnot Hnd']; subst.
  assert (Hxc : x = c) by (apply Hall; left; reflexivity).
  destruct xs as [|y ys]; simpl; [lia|].
  exfalso.
  assert (Hy : y ∈ y :: ys) by (apply elem_of_cons; left; reflexivity).
  assert (Hyc : y = c) by (apply Hall; right; exact Hy).
  subst c. subst y. set_solver.
Qed.

Lemma nodup_two_values_le2 (l : list nat) (a b : nat) :
  NoDup l -> (forall x, x ∈ l -> x = a \/ x = b) -> List.length l <= 2.
Proof.
  destruct l as [|x xs]; simpl; intros Hnd Hall; [lia|].
  inversion Hnd as [|? ? Hnot Hnd']; subst.
  assert (Hx : x ∈ x :: xs) by (apply elem_of_cons; left; reflexivity).
  destruct (Hall x Hx) as [Exa|Exb].
  - subst x.
    assert (Hxs : forall y, y ∈ xs -> y = b).
    { intros y Hy.
      assert (Hy' : y ∈ a :: xs) by (apply elem_of_cons; right; exact Hy).
      destruct (Hall y Hy') as [Ea|Eb]; [|exact Eb].
      subst y. exfalso. apply Hnot.
      exact (proj1 (@list_elem_of_In nat xs a) Hy). }
    pose proof (nodup_all_eq_le1 xs b Hnd' Hxs). lia.
  - subst x.
    assert (Hxs : forall y, y ∈ xs -> y = a).
    { intros y Hy.
      assert (Hy' : y ∈ b :: xs) by (apply elem_of_cons; right; exact Hy).
      destruct (Hall y Hy') as [Ea|Eb]; [exact Ea|].
      subst y. exfalso. apply Hnot.
      exact (proj1 (@list_elem_of_In nat xs b) Hy). }
    pose proof (nodup_all_eq_le1 xs a Hnd' Hxs). lia.
Qed.

Lemma rx_src_ref_forest : ref_forest rx_src.
Proof.
  intros l [Hlen [Hnd Hpath]].
  assert (Hlne : l <> nil).
  { intro E. subst l. simpl in Hlen. lia. }
  pose proof (path_cycle_vertex_has_edge (ref_edge rx_src) l (hd 0 l)
                Hpath Hlne) as Hvert.
  assert (Hall : forall x, x ∈ l -> x = 0 \/ x = 1).
  { intros x Hx.
    destruct (Hvert x Hx) as [y [Hxy|Hyx]].
    - destruct (rx_src_ref_edge x y Hxy) as [[Ey Ex]|[Ey Ex]].
      + subst x. left. reflexivity.
      + subst x. right. reflexivity.
    - destruct (rx_src_ref_edge y x Hyx) as [[Ey Ex]|[Ey Ex]].
      + subst x. right. reflexivity.
      + subst x. left. reflexivity. }
  pose proof (nodup_two_values_le2 l 0 1 Hnd Hall). lia.
Qed.

Lemma rx_tgt_refs_live : refs_live rx_tgt.
Proof.

    rewrite rx_tgt_lookup1. discriminate.

      rewrite rx_tgt_lookup1. discriminate.
    + rewrite rx_tgt_lookup_other in Hi;

Lemma rx_tgt_mem a b (Hb : b ∈ refs_at rx_tgt a) :
  (a = 0 /\ b = 1) \/ (a = 1 /\ b = 1).

    rewrite rx_tgt_refs0 in Hb. set_solver.
  - destruct (decide (a = 1)) as [E1|E1].

    + left. split; assumption.
    + exfalso. apply Hne. subst a. subst b. reflexivity.
  - destruct (rx_tgt_mem b a Ha) as [[Eb Ea]|[Eb Ea]].
    + right. subst b. subst a. split; reflexivity.
    + exfalso. apply Hne. subst a. subst b. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma forest_of_edges_01 (ρ : cfg)
    (Hedge : forall a b, ref_edge ρ a b -> (a = 0 /\ b = 1) \/ (a = 1 /\ b = 0)) :
  ref_forest ρ.
Proof.
  intros l [Hlen [Hnd Hpath]].
  assert (Hlne : l <> nil).
  { intro E. subst l. simpl in Hlen. lia. }
  pose proof (path_cycle_vertex_has_edge (ref_edge ρ) l (hd 0 l)

  assert (Hall : forall x, x ∈ l -> x = 0 \/ x = 1).
  { intros x Hx.
    destruct (Hvert x Hx) as [y [Hxy|Hyx]].
    - destruct (Hedge x y Hxy) as [[Ey Ex]|[Ey Ex]].
      + subst x. left. reflexivity.
      + subst x. right. reflexivity.
    - destruct (Hedge y x Hyx) as [[Ey Ex]|[Ey Ex]].
      + subst x. right. reflexivity.
      + subst x. left. reflexivity. }
  pose proof (nodup_two_values_le2 l 0 1 Hnd Hall). lia.
Qed.

Lemma rx_src_not_kind_live : ~ kind_live rx_src.
Proof.
  intros H. destruct H as [Hlock Hbar].
  destruct Hbar as [Hbar_thr Hbar_val].
  specialize (Hbar_thr 0 rx_e 1 rx_src_lookup0).
  assert (Hin : 1 ∈ expr_barrier_refs rx_e).
  { unfold rx_e, rx_inner. simpl. set_solver. }

  rewrite rx_src_lookup1 in Hbar_thr. discriminate.
Qed.

(* Main counterexample.                                               *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* [kind_live] is the only source invariant that fails.  Hence the    *)

From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.
From stdpp Require Import gmap decidable.
From Stdlib Require Import List Arith Lia.
From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String.
Import ListNotations.
Require Import AllCombine.
Require Import CapCex.
Require Import KindRefs.
Open Scope string_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* A [cvS]-typed self-deposit.                                        *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* The Release destination is only covered by a typing argument if a  *)
(* value of the lock-content type can mention the same lock.  It can:  *)
(* the lock reference sits in a *dead argument* of a closure body.    *)
(* The "dead argument" is typed at [LockT (Client,Closed) t] and is    *)
(* discarded by the closure; its type is unrelated to the closure's   *)
(* result type [t].  Consequently there is no recursive type equation  *)
(* [t = LockT _ t] to rule out.  This is a machine-checked failure of  *)
(* any no-self-deposit argument based on occurrence/type size, even    *)
(* for the *refined* typing [cvS]/[wtS].                               *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* The witness below is runtime-typed and has all the object-level     *)
(* invariants except the new lock-content invariant.  It is not yet    *)
(* claimed to be reachable from a [typed] source; see the final note.  *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition sd_t : type := FunT Lin UnitT UnitT.
Definition sd_L : gmap nat type := {[1 := sd_t]}.

Lemma sd_L1 : sd_L !! 1 = Some sd_t.
Proof. unfold sd_L. apply lookup_singleton_eq. Qed.

Definition sd_client_t : type := LockT (Client,Closed) sd_t.
Definition sd_fun : val := FunV "y" (Drop (Var "y")).
Definition sd_body : expr := App (Val sd_fun) (Val (LockV 1)).
Definition sd_payload : val := FunV "x" sd_body.

(* ---------- environment helpers ---------- *)

Lemma sd_env_split_singleton x (t : type) :
  env_split (<[x := t]> (∅ : env)) (<[x := t]> (∅ : env)) ∅.
Proof.
  unfold env_split. split.
  - symmetry. apply env_union_empty_r.
  - unfold disj. intros i t1 t2 H1 H2.
    assert (Hnone : (∅ : env) !! i = None) by apply lookup_empty.
    rewrite Hnone in H2. discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma sd_env_var_self x (t : type) :
  env_var (<[x := t]> (∅ : env)) x t.
Proof.
  unfold env_var. exists ∅. split; [reflexivity|apply env_unr_empty].
Qed.

(* ---------- refined value typings ---------- *)

Lemma sd_fun_cvS : cvS sd_L sd_fun (FunT Lin sd_client_t UnitT).
Proof.
  unfold sd_fun.
  eapply FunVS with (l := Lin).
  - eapply DropS with (t := sd_t).
    eapply VarS. apply sd_env_var_self.
  - intros H. discriminate H.
Qed.

Lemma sd_lock_cvS : cvS sd_L (LockV 1) sd_client_t.
Proof.
  change (cvS sd_L (LockV 1) (LockT (Client,Closed) sd_t)).
  apply LockVS. exact sd_L1.
Qed.

Lemma sd_body_wtS : wtS sd_L (<[ "x" := UnitT ]> (∅ : env)) sd_body UnitT.
Proof.
  unfold sd_body.
  eapply AppS with (Γ1 := <[ "x" := UnitT ]> (∅ : env)) (Γ2 := ∅)
                   (l := Lin) (t1 := sd_client_t) (t2 := UnitT).
  - apply sd_env_split_singleton.
  - apply ValS.
    + apply env_unr_singleton_unr. apply Unit_unr.
    + exact sd_fun_cvS.
  - apply ValS.
    + apply env_unr_empty.
    + exact sd_lock_cvS.
Qed.

Lemma sd_payload_cvS : cvS sd_L sd_payload sd_t.
Proof.
  unfold sd_payload, sd_t.
  eapply FunVS with (l := Lin).
  - exact sd_body_wtS.
  - intros H. discriminate H.
Qed.

(* The payload mentions lock 1 although its type is exactly [L 1]. *)

Lemma sd_payload_self : 1 ∈ val_refs sd_payload.
Proof.
  unfold sd_payload, sd_body, sd_fun.
  simpl. set_solver.
Qed.

Lemma sd_payload_lockref_self : 1 ∈ val_lock_refs sd_payload.
Proof.
  unfold sd_payload, sd_body, sd_fun.
  simpl. set_solver.
Qed.

(* ---------- the Release-oriented thread ---------- *)

Definition sd_inner : expr := Release (Val (LockV 1)) (Val sd_payload).
Definition sd_e : expr := Drop sd_inner.

Definition sd_src : cfg := {[0 := Thread sd_e; 1 := Lock 1 None]}.
Definition sd_tgt : cfg :=
  {[0 := Thread (Drop (Val (LockV 1)));
    1 := Lock 1 (Some sd_payload)]}.

Lemma sd_inner_wtS : wtS sd_L ∅ sd_inner (LockT (Client,Closed) sd_t).
Proof.
  unfold sd_inner.
  eapply ReleaseS with (Γ1 := ∅) (Γ2 := ∅) (lo := Client).
  - apply env_split_nil.
  - apply ValS.
    + apply env_unr_empty.
    + change (cvS sd_L (LockV 1) (LockT (Client,Opened) sd_t)).
      apply LockVS. exact sd_L1.
  - apply ValS.
    + apply env_unr_empty.
    + exact sd_payload_cvS.
Qed.

Lemma sd_e_wtS : wtS sd_L ∅ sd_e UnitT.
Proof.
  unfold sd_e.
  eapply DropS with (t := sd_t).
  exact sd_inner_wtS.
Qed.

(* ---------- lookups ---------- *)

Lemma sd_src_lookup0 : sd_src !! 0 = Some (Thread sd_e).
Proof.
  unfold sd_src.
  change ((<[0 := Thread sd_e]> (<[1 := Lock 1 None]> (∅ : cfg))) !! 0
          = Some (Thread sd_e)).
  apply lookup_insert_eq.
Qed.

Lemma sd_src_lookup1 : sd_src !! 1 = Some (Lock 1 None).
Proof.
  unfold sd_src.
  change ((<[0 := Thread sd_e]> (<[1 := Lock 1 None]> (∅ : cfg))) !! 1
          = Some (Lock 1 None)).
  assert (H : (<[0 := Thread sd_e]> (<[1 := Lock 1 None]> (∅ : cfg))) !! 1
              = (<[1 := Lock 1 None]> (∅ : cfg)) !! 1).
  { apply lookup_insert_ne. lia. }
  rewrite H. apply lookup_insert_eq.
Qed.

Lemma sd_src_lookup_other n (H0 : n <> 0) (H1 : n <> 1) : sd_src !! n = None.
Proof.
  unfold sd_src.
  change ((<[0 := Thread sd_e]> (<[1 := Lock 1 None]> (∅ : cfg))) !! n = None).
  assert (H01 : (<[0 := Thread sd_e]> (<[1 := Lock 1 None]> (∅ : cfg))) !! n
                = (<[1 := Lock 1 None]> (∅ : cfg)) !! n).
  { apply lookup_insert_ne. congruence. }
  assert (H12 : (<[1 := Lock 1 None]> (∅ : cfg)) !! n = (∅ : cfg) !! n).
  { apply lookup_insert_ne. congruence. }
  rewrite H01, H12. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma sd_tgt_lookup0 :
  sd_tgt !! 0 = Some (Thread (Drop (Val (LockV 1)))).
Proof.
  unfold sd_tgt.
  change ((<[0 := Thread (Drop (Val (LockV 1)))]>
            (<[1 := Lock 1 (Some sd_payload)]> (∅ : cfg))) !! 0
          = Some (Thread (Drop (Val (LockV 1))))).
  apply lookup_insert_eq.
Qed.

Lemma sd_tgt_lookup1 :
  sd_tgt !! 1 = Some (Lock 1 (Some sd_payload)).
Proof.
  unfold sd_tgt.
  change ((<[0 := Thread (Drop (Val (LockV 1)))]>
            (<[1 := Lock 1 (Some sd_payload)]> (∅ : cfg))) !! 1
          = Some (Lock 1 (Some sd_payload))).
  assert (H : (<[0 := Thread (Drop (Val (LockV 1)))]>
               (<[1 := Lock 1 (Some sd_payload)]> (∅ : cfg))) !! 1
              = (<[1 := Lock 1 (Some sd_payload)]> (∅ : cfg)) !! 1).
  { apply lookup_insert_ne. lia. }
  rewrite H. apply lookup_insert_eq.
Qed.

Lemma sd_tgt_lookup_other n (H0 : n <> 0) (H1 : n <> 1) :
  sd_tgt !! n = None.
Proof.
  unfold sd_tgt.
  change ((<[0 := Thread (Drop (Val (LockV 1)))]>
            (<[1 := Lock 1 (Some sd_payload)]> (∅ : cfg))) !! n = None).
  assert (H01 : (<[0 := Thread (Drop (Val (LockV 1)))]>
                  (<[1 := Lock 1 (Some sd_payload)]> (∅ : cfg))) !! n
                = (<[1 := Lock 1 (Some sd_payload)]> (∅ : cfg)) !! n).
  { apply lookup_insert_ne. congruence. }
  assert (H12 : (<[1 := Lock 1 (Some sd_payload)]> (∅ : cfg)) !! n
                = (∅ : cfg) !! n).
  { apply lookup_insert_ne. congruence. }
  rewrite H01, H12. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* ---------- the step ---------- *)

Definition sd_ctx : expr -> expr := fun x => Drop x.

Lemma sd_ctx_ctx : ctx sd_ctx.
Proof.
  unfold sd_ctx.
  change (ctx ((fun x => Drop x) ∘ id)).
  apply (@Ctx_comp (fun x => Drop x) id Ctx_Drop Ctx_id).
Qed.

Lemma sd_release_local : local_step 1 sd_src sd_tgt.
Proof.
  unfold sd_src, sd_tgt, sd_e, sd_inner, sd_ctx.
  apply (Release_step sd_payload (fun x => Drop x) 0 1 1).
  - lia.
  - apply sd_ctx_ctx.
Qed.

Lemma sd_union_empty_r (m : cfg) : m ∪ ∅ = m.
Proof.
  apply map_eq. intro x. apply lookup_union_l. apply lookup_empty.
Qed.

Lemma sd_step : step 1 sd_src sd_tgt.
Proof.
  assert (E1 : sd_src = sd_src ∪ ∅) by (symmetry; apply sd_union_empty_r).
  assert (E2 : sd_tgt = sd_tgt ∪ ∅) by (symmetry; apply sd_union_empty_r).
  rewrite E1, E2.
  eapply Frame_step;
    [apply map_disjoint_empty_r | apply map_disjoint_empty_r | exact sd_release_local].
Qed.

(* ---------- thread typing ---------- *)

Lemma sd_src_threads_typed : threads_typed sd_L sd_src.
Proof.
  intros i e Hi.
  destruct (decide (i = 0)) as [E|E].
  - subst i. rewrite sd_src_lookup0 in Hi. inversion Hi; subst e. exact sd_e_wtS.
  - destruct (decide (i = 1)) as [E1|E1].
    + subst i. rewrite sd_src_lookup1 in Hi. discriminate.
    + rewrite sd_src_lookup_other in Hi; [discriminate | exact E | exact E1].
Qed.

Lemma sd_tgt_thread_wtS : wtS sd_L ∅ (Drop (Val (LockV 1))) UnitT.
Proof.
  eapply DropS with (t := sd_t).
  apply ValS.
  - apply env_unr_empty.
  - change (cvS sd_L (LockV 1) (LockT (Client,Closed) sd_t)).
    apply LockVS. exact sd_L1.
Qed.

Lemma sd_tgt_threads_typed : threads_typed sd_L sd_tgt.
Proof.
  intros i e Hi.
  destruct (decide (i = 0)) as [E|E].
  - subst i. rewrite sd_tgt_lookup0 in Hi. inversion Hi; subst e.
    exact sd_tgt_thread_wtS.
  - destruct (decide (i = 1)) as [E1|E1].
    + subst i. rewrite sd_tgt_lookup1 in Hi. discriminate.
    + rewrite sd_tgt_lookup_other in Hi; [discriminate | exact E | exact E1].
Qed.

(* ---------- kind liveness at the source ---------- *)

Lemma sd_src_kind_live : kind_live sd_src.
Proof.
  unfold kind_live, kind_lock_live, kind_barrier_live.
  split.
  - split.
    + intros i e n Hi Hn.
      destruct (decide (i = 0)) as [E|E].
      * subst i. rewrite sd_src_lookup0 in Hi. inversion Hi; subst e.
        unfold sd_e, sd_inner, sd_payload, sd_body, sd_fun in Hn.
        simpl in Hn. assert (Hn1 : n = 1) by set_solver. subst n.
        rewrite sd_src_lookup1. exists 1, None. reflexivity.
      * destruct (decide (i = 1)) as [E1|E1].
        -- subst i. rewrite sd_src_lookup1 in Hi. discriminate.
        -- rewrite sd_src_lookup_other in Hi; [discriminate | exact E | exact E1].
    + intros i rc o v n Hi Hn.
      destruct (decide (i = 0)) as [E|E].
      * subst i. rewrite sd_src_lookup0 in Hi. discriminate.
      * destruct (decide (i = 1)) as [E1|E1].
        -- subst i. rewrite sd_src_lookup1 in Hi. inversion Hi; subst o.
           simpl in Hn. set_solver.
        -- rewrite sd_src_lookup_other in Hi; [discriminate | exact E | exact E1].
  - split.
    + intros i e n Hi Hn.
      destruct (decide (i = 0)) as [E|E].
      * subst i. rewrite sd_src_lookup0 in Hi. inversion Hi; subst e.
        unfold sd_e, sd_inner, sd_payload, sd_body, sd_fun in Hn.
        simpl in Hn. set_solver.
      * destruct (decide (i = 1)) as [E1|E1].
        -- subst i. rewrite sd_src_lookup1 in Hi. discriminate.
        -- rewrite sd_src_lookup_other in Hi; [discriminate | exact E | exact E1].
    + intros i rc o v n Hi Hn.
      destruct (decide (i = 0)) as [E|E].
      * subst i. rewrite sd_src_lookup0 in Hi. discriminate.
      * destruct (decide (i = 1)) as [E1|E1].
        -- subst i. rewrite sd_src_lookup1 in Hi. inversion Hi; subst o.
           simpl in Hn. set_solver.
        -- rewrite sd_src_lookup_other in Hi; [discriminate | exact E | exact E1].
Qed.

(* ---------- target: a genuine self-deposit ---------- *)

Definition no_self_lock_content (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall n rc v, ρ !! n = Some (Lock rc (Some v)) -> n ∉ val_refs v.

Lemma sd_tgt_not_no_self : ~ no_self_lock_content sd_tgt.
Proof.
  intros H.
  specialize (H 1 1 sd_payload sd_tgt_lookup1).
  exact (H sd_payload_self).

(* The old kind-based argument also fails: the target is kind-live. *)

    + intros i e n Hi Hn.
      destruct (decide (i = 0)) as [E|E].
      * subst i. rewrite sd_tgt_lookup0 in Hi. inversion Hi; subst e.
        simpl in Hn. assert (Hn1 : n = 1) by set_solver. subst n.
        rewrite sd_tgt_lookup1. exists 1, (Some sd_payload). reflexivity.
      * destruct (decide (i = 1)) as [E1|E1].
        -- subst i. rewrite sd_tgt_lookup1 in Hi. discriminate.
        -- rewrite sd_tgt_lookup_other in Hi; [discriminate | exact E | exact E1].
    + intros i rc o v n Hi Hn.
      destruct (decide (i = 0)) as [E|E].
      * subst i. rewrite sd_tgt_lookup0 in Hi. discriminate.

           simpl in Hn. assert (Hn1 : n = 1) by set_solver. subst n.
           rewrite sd_tgt_lookup1. exists 1, (Some sd_payload). reflexivity.
        -- rewrite sd_tgt_lookup_other in Hi; [discriminate | exact E | exact E1].
  - split.

From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.
From stdpp Require Import gmap decidable.
From Stdlib Require Import List Arith Lia.
From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String.
Import ListNotations.
Require Import AllCombine.
Require Import CapCex.
Require Import KindRefs.
Open Scope string_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* A [cvS]-typed self-deposit.                                        *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* The Release destination is only covered by a typing argument if a  *)
(* value of the lock-content type can mention the same lock.  It can:  *)
(* the lock reference sits in a *dead argument* of a closure body.    *)
(* The "dead argument" is typed at [LockT (Client,Closed) t] and is    *)
(* discarded by the closure; its type is unrelated to the closure's   *)
(* result type [t].  Consequently there is no recursive type equation  *)
(* [t = LockT _ t] to rule out.  This is a machine-checked failure of  *)
(* any no-self-deposit argument based on occurrence/type size, even    *)
(* for the *refined* typing [cvS]/[wtS].                               *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* The witness below is runtime-typed and has all the object-level     *)
(* invariants except the new lock-content invariant.  It is not yet    *)
(* claimed to be reachable from a [typed] source; see the final note.  *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition sd_t : type := FunT Lin UnitT UnitT.
Definition sd_L : gmap nat type := {[1 := sd_t]}.

Lemma sd_L1 : sd_L !! 1 = Some sd_t.
Proof. unfold sd_L. apply lookup_singleton_eq. Qed.

Definition sd_client_t : type := LockT (Client,Closed) sd_t.
Definition sd_fun : val := FunV "y" (Drop (Var "y")).
Definition sd_body : expr := App (Val sd_fun) (Val (LockV 1)).
Definition sd_payload : val := FunV "x" sd_body.

(* ---------- environment helpers ---------- *)

Lemma sd_env_split_singleton x (t : type) :
  env_split (<[x := t]> (∅ : env)) (<[x := t]> (∅ : env)) ∅.
Proof.
  unfold env_split. split.
  - symmetry. apply env_union_empty_r.
  - unfold disj. intros i t1 t2 H1 H2.
    assert (Hnone : (∅ : env) !! i = None) by apply lookup_empty.
    rewrite Hnone in H2. discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma sd_env_var_self x (t : type) :
  env_var (<[x := t]> (∅ : env)) x t.
Proof.
  unfold env_var. exists ∅. split; [reflexivity|apply env_unr_empty].
Qed.

(* ---------- refined value typings ---------- *)

Lemma sd_fun_cvS : cvS sd_L sd_fun (FunT Lin sd_client_t UnitT).
Proof.
  unfold sd_fun.
  eapply FunVS with (l := Lin).
  - eapply DropS with (t := sd_t).
    eapply VarS. apply sd_env_var_self.
  - intros H. discriminate H.
Qed.

Lemma sd_lock_cvS : cvS sd_L (LockV 1) sd_client_t.
Proof.
  change (cvS sd_L (LockV 1) (LockT (Client,Closed) sd_t)).
  apply LockVS. exact sd_L1.
Qed.

Lemma sd_body_wtS : wtS sd_L (<[ "x" := UnitT ]> (∅ : env)) sd_body UnitT.
Proof.
  unfold sd_body.
  eapply AppS with (Γ1 := <[ "x" := UnitT ]> (∅ : env)) (Γ2 := ∅)
                   (l := Lin) (t1 := sd_client_t) (t2 := UnitT).
  - apply sd_env_split_singleton.
  - apply ValS.
    + apply env_unr_singleton_unr. apply Unit_unr.
    + exact sd_fun_cvS.
  - apply ValS.
    + apply env_unr_empty.
    + exact sd_lock_cvS.
Qed.

Lemma sd_payload_cvS : cvS sd_L sd_payload sd_t.
Proof.
  unfold sd_payload, sd_t.
  eapply FunVS with (l := Lin).
  - exact sd_body_wtS.
  - intros H. discriminate H.
Qed.

(* The payload mentions lock 1 although its type is exactly [L 1]. *)

Lemma sd_payload_self : 1 ∈ val_refs sd_payload.
Proof.
  unfold sd_payload, sd_body, sd_fun.
  simpl. set_solver.
Qed.

Lemma sd_payload_lockref_self : 1 ∈ val_lock_refs sd_payload.
Proof.
  unfold sd_payload, sd_body, sd_fun.
  simpl. set_solver.
Qed.

(* ---------- the Release-oriented thread ---------- *)

Definition sd_inner : expr := Release (Val (LockV 1)) (Val sd_payload).
Definition sd_e : expr := Drop sd_inner.

Definition sd_src : cfg := {[0 := Thread sd_e; 1 := Lock 1 None]}.
Definition sd_tgt : cfg :=
  {[0 := Thread (Drop (Val (LockV 1)));
    1 := Lock 1 (Some sd_payload)]}.


(* ---------- target: a genuine self-deposit ---------- *)

Definition no_self_lock_content (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall n rc v, ρ !! n = Some (Lock rc (Some v)) -> n ∉ val_refs v.

Lemma sd_tgt_not_no_self : ~ no_self_lock_content sd_tgt.
Proof.
  intros H.
  specialize (H 1 1 sd_payload sd_tgt_lookup1).
  exact (H sd_payload_self).
Qed.

(* The old kind-based argument also fails: the target is kind-live. *)
Lemma sd_tgt_kind_live : kind_live sd_tgt.
Proof.

    + intros i e n Hi Hn.
      destruct (decide (i = 0)) as [E|E].
      * subst i. rewrite sd_tgt_lookup0 in Hi. inversion Hi; subst e.
        simpl in Hn. assert (Hn1 : n = 1) by set_solver. subst n.
        rewrite sd_tgt_lookup1. exists 1, (Some sd_payload). reflexivity.
      * destruct (decide (i = 1)) as [E1|E1].
        -- subst i. rewrite sd_tgt_lookup1 in Hi. discriminate.
        -- rewrite sd_tgt_lookup_other in Hi; [discriminate | exact E | exact E1].
    + intros i rc o v n Hi Hn.
      destruct (decide (i = 0)) as [E|E].
      * subst i. rewrite sd_tgt_lookup0 in Hi. discriminate.
      * destruct (decide (i = 1)) as [E1|E1].
        -- subst i. rewrite sd_tgt_lookup1 in Hi. inversion Hi; subst o.
           simpl in Hn. assert (Hn1 : n = 1) by set_solver. subst n.
           rewrite sd_tgt_lookup1. exists 1, (Some sd_payload). reflexivity.
        -- rewrite sd_tgt_lookup_other in Hi; [discriminate | exact E | exact E1].
  - split.
    + intros i e n Hi Hn.
      destruct (decide (i = 0)) as [E|E].
      * subst i. rewrite sd_tgt_lookup0 in Hi. inversion Hi; subst e.
        simpl in Hn. set_solver.
      * destruct (decide (i = 1)) as [E1|E1].
        -- subst i. rewrite sd_tgt_lookup1 in Hi. discriminate.
        -- rewrite sd_tgt_lookup_other in Hi; [discriminate | exact E | exact E1].
    + intros i rc o v n Hi Hn.
      destruct (decide (i = 0)) as [E|E].
      * subst i. rewrite sd_tgt_lookup0 in Hi. discriminate.
      * destruct (decide (i = 1)) as [E1|E1].
        -- subst i. rewrite sd_tgt_lookup1 in Hi. inversion Hi; subst o.
           simpl in Hn. unfold sd_payload, sd_body, sd_fun in Hn. simpl in Hn.
           set_solver.
        -- rewrite sd_tgt_lookup_other in Hi; [discriminate | exact E | exact E1].
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Main theorem: refined typing plus kind liveness does not give      *)
(* no-self-deposit.  The missing information is provenance/linear     *)
(* ownership of the two capabilities, not type size.                  *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Theorem cvS_typed_self_deposit :
  wtS sd_L ∅ sd_e UnitT /\
  cvS sd_L sd_payload sd_t /\
  sd_L !! 1 = Some sd_t /\
  1 ∈ val_refs sd_payload /\
  local_step 1 sd_src sd_tgt /\
  kind_live sd_src /\ kind_live sd_tgt /\
  ~ no_self_lock_content sd_tgt.
Proof.
  split; [exact sd_e_wtS|].
  split; [exact sd_payload_cvS|].
  split; [exact sd_L1|].
  split; [exact sd_payload_self|].
  split; [exact sd_release_local|].
  split; [exact sd_src_kind_live|].
  split; [exact sd_tgt_kind_live|].
  exact sd_tgt_not_no_self.
Qed.

Print Assumptions cvS_typed_self_deposit.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Why [cap_unique_holder] alone is not enough.                       *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* The abstract [caps] map records chosen holders, not the actual     *)
(* [LockV] occurrences in thread syntax.  For the target of the       *)
(* self-deposit we can choose an [Owner,Closed] holder; the runtime   *)
(* thread's own [LockV 1] can be typed [Client,Closed] and the payload *)
(* duplicate is simply not recorded.  Thus holder uniqueness holds    *)
(* at both ends of the Release while the target still has a lock      *)
(* content self-reference.  A usable invariant must tie every         *)
(* occurrence/state in [LockV] values to the linear context, not just *)
(* existentially choose cap holders.                                  *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition cap_unique_holder
    (caps : nat -> lockcap -> gset nat) : Prop :=
  forall n lc1 lc2 j,
    j ∈ caps n lc1 -> j ∈ caps n lc2 -> lc1 = lc2.

Definition sd_caps_src : nat -> lockcap -> gset nat :=
  fun n lc =>
    if decide (n = 1 /\ lc = (Owner,Opened)) then {[0]} else ∅.

Definition sd_caps_tgt : nat -> lockcap -> gset nat :=
  fun n lc =>
    if decide (n = 1 /\ lc = (Owner,Closed)) then {[0]} else ∅.

Definition sd_bend : nat -> gset nat := fun _ => ∅.

Lemma sd_caps_src_mem n lc j (Hj : j ∈ sd_caps_src n lc) :
  n = 1 /\ lc = (Owner,Opened) /\ j = 0.
Proof.
  unfold sd_caps_src in Hj.
  destruct (decide (n = 1 /\ lc = (Owner,Opened))) as [[Hn Hlc]|H].
  - apply elem_of_singleton in Hj. subst j. auto.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Forest preservation for Acquire / Wait / Release.                  *)
(* ================================================================== *)

(* Acquire-shaped move: the bundle [B] is exactly the old lock content,
   the source lock is emptied, and the destination thread may keep the
   lock token (Acquire) or drop it (Wait). *)
Lemma acquire_forest_shape (S T : nat -> gset nat) (i n : nat) (B : gset nat) :
  ref_pair_ok_fun S ->
  forest_fun S ->
  T i ⊆ S i ∪ B ->
  T n = ∅ ->
  (forall a, a <> i -> a <> n -> T a = S a) ->
  i ∉ B ->
  B ⊆ S n ->
  n ∈ S i ->
  i <> n ->
  forest_fun T.
Proof.
  intros [Hself Hpair] Hforest HTi HTn Hother HiB HB HnSi Hine.
  assert (HnB : n ∉ B).
  { intro Hn. apply (Hself n). apply HB in Hn. exact Hn. }
  eapply forest_star_shape with (S := S) (T := T) (i := i) (n := n) (R := B).
  - (* edge inclusion *)
    intros a b [Hne [Hb|Ha]].
    destruct (decide (a = i)) as [Ea|Hai].
    + subst a. assert (HbU : b ∈ S i ∪ B) by (apply HTi; exact Hb).
      apply elem_of_union in HbU as [HbS|HbB].
      * left. split; [exact Hne|left; exact HbS].
      * right. left. split; [reflexivity|exact HbB].
    + destruct (decide (a = n)) as [Ea|Han].
      * subst a. rewrite HTn in Hb. set_solver.
      * destruct (decide (b = i)) as [Eb|Hbi].
        -- subst b. assert (HaU : a ∈ S i ∪ B) by (apply HTi; exact Ha).
           apply elem_of_union in HaU as [HaS|HaB].
           ++ left. split; [exact Hne|right; exact HaS].
           ++ right. right. split; [reflexivity|exact HaB].
        -- destruct (decide (b = n)) as [Eb|Hbn].
           ++ subst b. rewrite HTn in Ha. set_solver.
           ++ left. rewrite (Hother a Hai Han) in Hb.
              rewrite (Hother b Hbi Hbn) in Ha.
              split; [exact Hne|left; exact Hb].
  - exact Hforest.
  - (* source bundle *)
    intros r Hr. split.
    + apply (ne_sym (Hself n)); intro E; subst r; exact (Hself n (HB Hr)).
      (* goal n <> r *)
    + left. apply HB. exact Hr.
  - (* bridge *)
    split; [exact Hine|right; exact HnSi].
  - (* removed edges *)
    intros r Hr [Hne [HrTn|HnTr]].
    + rewrite HTn in HrTn. set_solver.
    + assert (Hri : r <> i) by (intro E; subst r; exact (HiB Hr)).
      assert (Hrn : r <> n) by (intro E; subst r; exact (HnB Hr)).
      rewrite (Hother r Hri Hrn) in HnTr.
      exact (Hpair n r Hne (conj (HB Hr) HnTr)).
  - exact Hine.
  - exact HnB.
Qed.

(* Release-shaped move: the thread's value bundle [B] moves into the
   lock [n].  For the forest no destination-backreference condition is
   needed: a self-reference of the lock contributes no graph edge. *)
Lemma release_forest_shape (S T : nat -> gset nat) (n i : nat) (B : gset nat) :
  ref_pair_ok_fun S ->
  forest_fun S ->
  n <> i ->
  T n = S n ∪ B ->
  T i ⊆ S i ->
  (forall a, a <> n -> a <> i -> T a = S a) ->
  (forall r, r ∈ B -> r <> n -> r ∉ T i) ->
  S n = ∅ ->
  i ∉ B ->
  B ⊆ S i ->
  n ∈ S i ->
  forest_fun T.
Proof.
  intros [Hself Hpair] Hforest Hni HTn HTi Hother Hdisj HSn HiB HB HnSi.
  eapply forest_star_shape with (S := S) (T := T)
          (i := n) (n := i) (R := B ∖ {[n]}).
  - (* edge inclusion *)
    intros a b [Hne [Hb|Ha]].
    destruct (decide (a = n)) as [Ea|Han].
    + subst a. rewrite HTn in Hb. rewrite HSn in Hb. set_solver.
    + destruct (decide (b = n)) as [Eb|Hbn].
      * subst b. rewrite HTn in Ha. rewrite HSn in Ha. set_solver.
      * destruct (decide (a = i)) as [Ea|Hai].
        -- subst a. assert (HbS : b ∈ S i) by (apply HTi; exact Hb).
           left. split; [exact Hne|left; exact HbS].
        -- destruct (decide (b = i)) as [Eb|Hbi].
           ++ subst b. assert (HaS : a ∈ S i) by (apply HTi; exact Ha).
              left. split; [exact Hne|right; exact HaS].
           ++ left. rewrite (Hother a Han Hai) in Hb.
              rewrite (Hother b Hbn Hbi) in Ha.
              split; [exact Hne|left; exact Hb].
  - exact Hforest.
  - (* source: old thread-out edges to the bundle *)
    intros r Hr. apply elem_of_difference in Hr as [HrB Hrn].
    assert (Hri : r <> i) by (intro E; subst r; exact (HiB HrB)).
    split; [exact (ne_sym Hri)|left; apply HB; exact HrB].
  - (* bridge *)
    split; [exact Hni|right; exact HnSi].
  - (* removed source edges *)
    intros r Hr [Hne [HrTi|HiTr]].
    + apply elem_of_difference in Hr as [HrB Hrn].
      exact (Hdisj r HrB Hrn HrTi).
    + apply elem_of_difference in Hr as [HrB Hrn].
      assert (Hri : r <> i) by (intro E; subst r; exact (HiB HrB)).
      rewrite (Hother r Hrn Hri) in HiTr.
      exact (Hpair i r Hne (conj (HB HrB) HiTr)).
  - exact Hni.
  - (* i not in the moved bundle *)
    intro HiR. apply elem_of_difference in HiR as [HiB' _]. exact (HiB HiB').
Qed.

(* Wait uses the Acquire-shaped forest bound for the enlarged
   configuration and then shrinks the deleted lock token. *)
Lemma wait_forest_shape (S T : nat -> gset nat) (i n : nat) (B : gset nat) :
  ref_pair_ok_fun S ->
  forest_fun S ->
  T i ⊆ S i ∪ B ->
  T n = ∅ ->
  (forall a, a <> i -> a <> n -> T a = S a) ->
  i ∉ B ->
  B ⊆ S n ->
  n ∈ S i ->
  i <> n ->
  forest_fun T.
Proof.
  intros. eapply acquire_forest_shape; eauto.
Qed.

(* Wait pair: the same subset-shaped pair lemma as Acquire. *)
Lemma wait_pair_shape (S T : nat -> gset nat) (i n : nat) (B : gset nat) :
  ref_pair_ok_fun S ->
  T i ⊆ S i ∪ B ->
  T n = ∅ ->
  (forall a, a <> i -> a <> n -> T a = S a) ->
  i ∉ B ->
  (forall b, b ∈ B -> i ∉ T b) ->
  ref_pair_ok_fun T.
Proof. intros. eapply acquire_pair_shape; eauto. Qed.

(* Drop only deletes the lock token from the thread; the lock itself is
   unchanged, so all reference sets shrink. *)
Lemma drop_pair_shape (S T : nat -> gset nat) :
  ref_pair_ok_fun S ->
  (forall a, T a ⊆ S a) ->
  ref_pair_ok_fun T.
Proof. intros. eapply ref_pair_ok_shrink_fun; eauto. Qed.

Lemma drop_forest_shape (S T : nat -> gset nat) :
  forest_fun S ->
  (forall a, T a ⊆ S a) ->
  forest_fun T.
Proof. intros. eapply forest_shrink_fun; eauto. Qed.

Print Assumptions acquire_forest_shape.
Print Assumptions release_forest_shape.
Print Assumptions wait_forest_shape.
Print Assumptions wait_pair_shape.
Print Assumptions drop_pair_shape.
Print Assumptions drop_forest_shape.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Why [cap_unique_holder] alone is not enough.                       *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* The abstract [caps] map records chosen holders, not the actual     *)
(* [LockV] occurrences and their states in thread syntax.  For the    *)
(* target of the self-deposit we choose a [Client,Closed] holder,     *)
(* even though the target also contains the payload's duplicate       *)
(* [LockV 1] and (before the Drop) the thread still carries a         *)
(* [Client,Opened] value in general.  The point is that [caps] is an  *)
(* existential summary; it never says that every [LockV] occurrence   *)
(* is recorded.  Hence holder uniqueness holds at both ends of the    *)
(* Release while the target still has lock-content self-reference.    *)
(* A usable invariant must tie every occurrence/state in [LockV]      *)
(* values to the linear context, not just choose cap holders.         *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition cap_unique_holder
    (caps : nat -> lockcap -> gset nat) : Prop :=
  forall n lc1 lc2 j,
    j ∈ caps n lc1 -> j ∈ caps n lc2 -> lc1 = lc2.

Definition sd_caps_src : nat -> lockcap -> gset nat :=
  fun n lc =>
    if decide (n = 1 /\ lc = (Client,Opened)) then {[0]} else ∅.

Definition sd_caps_tgt : nat -> lockcap -> gset nat :=
  fun n lc =>
    if decide (n = 1 /\ lc = (Client,Closed)) then {[0]} else ∅.

Definition sd_bend : nat -> gset nat := fun _ => ∅.

Lemma sd_caps_src_mem n lc j (Hj : j ∈ sd_caps_src n lc) :
  n = 1 /\ lc = (Client,Opened) /\ j = 0.
Proof.
  unfold sd_caps_src in Hj.
  destruct (decide (n = 1 /\ lc = (Client,Opened))) as [[Hn Hlc]|H].
  - apply elem_of_singleton in Hj. subst j. auto.
  - exfalso. set_solver.
Qed.

Lemma sd_caps_tgt_mem n lc j (Hj : j ∈ sd_caps_tgt n lc) :
  n = 1 /\ lc = (Client,Closed) /\ j = 0.
Proof.
  unfold sd_caps_tgt in Hj.
  destruct (decide (n = 1 /\ lc = (Client,Closed))) as [[Hn Hlc]|H].
  - apply elem_of_singleton in Hj. subst j. auto.
  - exfalso. set_solver.
Qed.

Lemma sd_caps_src_unique : cap_unique_holder sd_caps_src.
Proof.
  intros n lc1 lc2 j H1 H2.
  destruct (sd_caps_src_mem n lc1 j H1) as [_ [E1 _]].
  destruct (sd_caps_src_mem n lc2 j H2) as [_ [E2 _]].
  rewrite E1, E2. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma sd_caps_tgt_unique : cap_unique_holder sd_caps_tgt.
Proof.
  intros n lc1 lc2 j H1 H2.
  destruct (sd_caps_tgt_mem n lc1 j H1) as [_ [E1 _]].
  destruct (sd_caps_tgt_mem n lc2 j H2) as [_ [E2 _]].
  rewrite E1, E2. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma sd_caps_src_client_opened_eq :
  sd_caps_src 1 (Client,Opened) = {[0]}.
Proof.
  unfold sd_caps_src.
  destruct (decide (1 = 1 /\ (Client,Opened) = (Client,Opened))) as [_|H].
  - reflexivity.
  - exfalso. apply H. auto.
Qed.

Lemma sd_caps_src_owner_opened_empty :
  sd_caps_src 1 (Owner,Opened) = ∅.
Proof.
  unfold sd_caps_src.
  destruct (decide (1 = 1 /\ (Owner,Opened) = (Client,Opened))) as [H|_].
  - destruct H as [_ E]. discriminate E.
  - reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma sd_caps_src_opened_eq :
  sd_caps_src 1 (Owner,Opened) ∪ sd_caps_src 1 (Client,Opened) = {[0]}.
Proof.
  rewrite sd_caps_src_owner_opened_empty, sd_caps_src_client_opened_eq.
  set_solver.
Qed.

Lemma sd_caps_src_client_nonempty :
  exists j, j ∈ sd_caps_src 1 (Client,Closed) ∪ sd_caps_src 1 (Client,Opened).
Proof.
  exists 0. right. rewrite sd_caps_src_client_opened_eq. set_solver.
Qed.

Lemma sd_caps_tgt_client_closed_eq :
  sd_caps_tgt 1 (Client,Closed) = {[0]}.
Proof.
  unfold sd_caps_tgt.
  destruct (decide (1 = 1 /\ (Client,Closed) = (Client,Closed))) as [_|H].
  - reflexivity.
  - exfalso. apply H. auto.
Qed.

Lemma sd_caps_tgt_owner_opened_empty :
  sd_caps_tgt 1 (Owner,Opened) = ∅.
Proof.

  destruct (decide (1 = 1 /\ (Owner,Opened) = (Client,Closed))) as [H|_].
  - destruct H as [_ E]. discriminate E.

Qed.

Lemma sd_caps_tgt_client_opened_empty :

Proof.

  - destruct H as [_ E]. discriminate E.

Lemma sd_src_lock_inv n rc o (H : sd_src !! n = Some (Lock rc o)) :
  n = 1 /\ rc = 1 /\ o = None.
Proof.
  destruct (decide (n = 0)) as [E|E].
  - subst n. rewrite sd_src_lookup0 in H. discriminate.
  - destruct (decide (n = 1)) as [E1|E1].
    + subst n. rewrite sd_src_lookup1 in H. inversion H; subst.
      split; [reflexivity|split; reflexivity].
    + rewrite sd_src_lookup_other in H; [discriminate | exact E | exact E1].
Qed.

Lemma sd_tgt_lock_inv n rc o (H : sd_tgt !! n = Some (Lock rc o)) :
  n = 1 /\ rc = 1 /\ o = Some sd_payload.
Proof.
  destruct (decide (n = 0)) as [E|E].
  - subst n. rewrite sd_tgt_lookup0 in H. discriminate.
  - destruct (decide (n = 1)) as [E1|E1].
    + subst n. rewrite sd_tgt_lookup1 in H. inversion H; subst.
      split; [reflexivity|split; reflexivity].
    + rewrite sd_tgt_lookup_other in H; [discriminate | exact E | exact E1].
Qed.

Lemma sd_e_waiting : expr_waiting sd_e 1.
Proof.
  unfold sd_e.
  exists sd_ctx, sd_inner. split; [exact sd_ctx_ctx|].
  split; [reflexivity| apply Release_waiting].
Qed.

Lemma sd_tgt_waiting : expr_waiting (Drop (Val (LockV 1))) 1.
Proof.
  exists id, (Drop (Val (LockV 1))). split; [apply Ctx_id|].
  split; [reflexivity| apply Drop_waiting].
Qed.

Definition sd_tgt2 : cfg :=
  {[0 := Thread (Val UnitV); 1 := Lock 0 (Some sd_payload)]}.

Lemma sd_tgt_drop_local : local_step 1 sd_tgt sd_tgt2.
Proof.
  unfold sd_tgt, sd_tgt2.
  apply (Drop_step (Some sd_payload) id 0 1 0).
  - lia.
  - apply Ctx_id.
Qed.

Lemma sd_tgt_step : step 1 sd_tgt sd_tgt2.
Proof.
  assert (E1 : sd_tgt = sd_tgt ∪ ∅) by (symmetry; apply sd_union_empty_r).
  assert (E2 : sd_tgt2 = sd_tgt2 ∪ ∅) by (symmetry; apply sd_union_empty_r).
  rewrite E1, E2.
  eapply Frame_step;
    [apply map_disjoint_empty_r | apply map_disjoint_empty_r | exact sd_tgt_drop_local].
Qed.

Lemma sd_src_inventory :
  cap_inventory sd_src sd_caps_src sd_bend.
Proof.
  unfold cap_inventory.
  split.
  { intros n lc j Hj. destruct (sd_caps_src_mem n lc j Hj) as [Hn [Hlc Hj0]].
    subst n. subst j. rewrite sd_src_lookup0. discriminate. }
  split.
  { intros n lc j Hj. destruct (sd_caps_src_mem n lc j Hj) as [Hn [Hlc Hj0]].
    subst n. subst j. exists (Thread sd_e). split; [apply sd_src_lookup0|].
    unfold obj_refs. simpl. unfold sd_e, sd_inner, sd_payload, sd_body, sd_fun.
    simpl. set_solver. }
  split.
  { intros n lc j e Hj Hje Hw.
    destruct (sd_caps_src_mem n lc j Hj) as [Hn [Hlc Hj0]].
    subst n. subst j.
    exists sd_tgt. exact sd_step. }
  split.
  { intros n rc Hlock.
    destruct (sd_src_lock_inv n rc None Hlock) as [Hn [Hrc Ho]].
    subst n. exists 0. apply sd_caps_src_opened_eq. }
  split.
  { intros n rc v Hlock.
    destruct (sd_src_lock_inv n rc (Some v) Hlock) as [_ [_ Ho]].
    discriminate Ho. }
  split.
  { intros n rc v Hlock.
    destruct (sd_src_lock_inv n rc (Some v) Hlock) as [_ [_ Ho]].
    discriminate Ho. }
  split.
  { intros n rc o Hlock.
    destruct (sd_src_lock_inv n rc o Hlock) as [Hn [Hrc Ho]].
    subst n. subst rc.
    split.
    - intro H. exact sd_caps_src_client_nonempty.
    - intros [j Hj]. lia. }
  split.
  { intros n Hbar.
    destruct (decide (n = 0)) as [E|E].
    - subst n. rewrite sd_src_lookup0 in Hbar. discriminate.
    - destruct (decide (n = 1)) as [E1|E1].
      + subst n. rewrite sd_src_lookup1 in Hbar. discriminate.
      + rewrite sd_src_lookup_other in Hbar; [discriminate | exact E | exact E1]. }
  split.
  { intros n j Hj. unfold sd_bend in Hj. set_solver. }
  split.
  { intros n j Hj. unfold sd_bend in Hj. set_solver. }
  intros n j k e e' Hj. unfold sd_bend in Hj. set_solver.
Qed.

Lemma sd_tgt_inventory :
  cap_inventory sd_tgt sd_caps_tgt sd_bend.
Proof.
  unfold cap_inventory.
  split.
  { intros n lc j Hj. destruct (sd_caps_tgt_mem n lc j Hj) as [Hn [Hlc Hj0]].
    subst n. subst j. rewrite sd_tgt_lookup0. discriminate. }
  split.
  { intros n lc j Hj. destruct (sd_caps_tgt_mem n lc j Hj) as [Hn [Hlc Hj0]].
    subst n. subst j. exists (Thread (Drop (Val (LockV 1)))).
    split; [apply sd_tgt_lookup0|].
    unfold obj_refs. simpl. set_solver. }
  split.
  { intros n lc j e Hj Hje Hw.
    destruct (sd_caps_tgt_mem n lc j Hj) as [Hn [Hlc Hj0]].
    subst n. subst j.
    exists sd_tgt2. exact sd_tgt_step. }
  split.
  { intros n rc Hlock.
    destruct (sd_tgt_lock_inv n rc None Hlock) as [_ [_ Ho]].
    discriminate Ho. }
  split.
  { intros n rc v Hlock.
    destruct (sd_tgt_lock_inv n rc (Some v) Hlock) as [Hn [Hrc Hv]].
    subst n. rewrite sd_caps_tgt_owner_opened_empty, sd_caps_tgt_client_opened_empty.
    reflexivity. }
  split.
  { intros n rc v Hlock.
    destruct (sd_tgt_lock_inv n rc (Some v) Hlock) as [Hn [Hrc Hv]].
    subst n. exists (Client,Closed), 0.
    rewrite sd_caps_tgt_client_closed_eq. set_solver. }
  split.
  { intros n rc o Hlock.
    destruct (sd_tgt_lock_inv n rc o Hlock) as [Hn [Hrc Ho]].
    subst n. subst rc.
    split.
    - intro H. exists 0. left. rewrite sd_caps_tgt_client_closed_eq. set_solver.
    - intros [j Hj]. lia. }
  split.
  { intros n Hbar.
    destruct (decide (n = 0)) as [E|E].
    - subst n. rewrite sd_tgt_lookup0 in Hbar. discriminate.
    - destruct (decide (n = 1)) as [E1|E1].
      + subst n. rewrite sd_tgt_lookup1 in Hbar. discriminate.
      + rewrite sd_tgt_lookup_other in Hbar; [discriminate | exact E | exact E1]. }
  split.
  { intros n j Hj. unfold sd_bend in Hj. set_solver. }
  split.
  { intros n j Hj. unfold sd_bend in Hj. set_solver. }
  intros n j k e e' Hj. unfold sd_bend in Hj. set_solver.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Set-based reference graph.                                         *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition refs_at (ρ : cfg) (a : nat) : gset nat :=
  match ρ !! a with
  | Some o => obj_refs o
  | None => ∅
  end.

Definition socc (ρ : cfg) (a b : nat) : nat :=
  if decide (b ∈ refs_at ρ a) then 1 else 0.

Definition self_ref_free (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall a, a ∉ refs_at ρ a.

Definition pair_ref_ok (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall a b, a <> b -> ~ (b ∈ refs_at ρ a /\ a ∈ refs_at ρ b).

Definition ref_pair_ok (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  self_ref_free ρ /\ pair_ref_ok ρ.

(* The coordinator's multiplicity=1 formulation at the set level. *)
Definition pair_socc_le1 (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  (forall a, socc ρ a a = 0) /\
  (forall a b, a <> b -> socc ρ a b + socc ρ b a <= 1).

Lemma socc_le1 ρ a b : socc ρ a b <= 1.
Proof. unfold socc. destruct (decide (b ∈ refs_at ρ a)); lia. Qed.

Lemma socc_pos ρ a b : 0 < socc ρ a b <-> b ∈ refs_at ρ a.
Proof.
  unfold socc. destruct (decide (b ∈ refs_at ρ a)) as [H|H]; simpl.
  - split; intros; [exact H|lia].
Proof.
  intros [k [e' [Hk [He Hh]]]]. subst e.
  apply ctx_head_waiting_ref; assumption.
Qed.

Definition refs_live (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i y, ρ !! i = Some y -> forall j, j ∈ obj_refs y -> ρ !! j <> None.

Lemma thread_waiting_ref ρ i j e :
  ρ !! i = Some (Thread e) -> expr_waiting e j -> j ∈ refs_at ρ i.
Proof.
  intros Hi Hw. unfold refs_at. rewrite Hi. simpl.
  apply expr_waiting_ref in Hw. exact Hw.
Qed.

Lemma obj_refs_at ρ j i y :
  ρ !! j = Some y -> i ∈ obj_refs y -> i ∈ refs_at ρ j.
Proof.
  intros Hj Hi. unfold refs_at. rewrite Hj. exact Hi.
Qed.

Lemma waiting_ref ρ i j :
  waiting ρ i j -> j ∈ refs_at ρ i \/ i ∈ refs_at ρ j.
Proof.
  intros [[e [Hi Hw]]|[y [Hj [Hi _]]]].
  - left. apply (thread_waiting_ref ρ i j e); assumption.
  - right. apply (obj_refs_at ρ j i y); assumption.
Qed.

Lemma waiting_neq ρ i j :
  self_ref_free ρ -> waiting ρ i j -> i <> j.
Proof.
  intros Hsf Hw E. subst j. destruct (waiting_ref ρ i i Hw) as [H|H];
  exact (Hsf i H).
Qed.

(* Two mutual waiting edges force references in both directions, which the
   set-based pair condition forbids. *)
Lemma no_waiting_2cycle ρ i j :
  ref_pair_ok ρ -> waiting ρ i j -> waiting ρ j i -> False.
Proof.
  intros [Hsf Hpair] Hwij Hwji.
  assert (Hne : i <> j) by (apply (waiting_neq ρ i j Hsf Hwij)).
  destruct Hwij as [[e [Hi Hw]]|[y [Hj [Hy Hside]]]];
  destruct Hwji as [[e2 [Hj2 Hw2]]|[y2 [Hi2 [Hy2 Hside2]]]].
  - apply (Hpair i j Hne). split.
    + apply (thread_waiting_ref ρ i j e); assumption.
    + apply (thread_waiting_ref ρ j i e2); assumption.
  - (* the object at i cannot be both a waiting thread and exempt *)
    rewrite Hi in Hi2. injection Hi2 as Ey. subst y2.
    exact (Hside2 e eq_refl Hw).
  - (* dually, the object at j cannot be both a waiting thread and exempt *)
    rewrite Hj2 in Hj. injection Hj as Ey. subst y.
    exact (Hside e2 eq_refl Hw2).
  - apply (Hpair i j Hne). split.
    + apply (obj_refs_at ρ i j y2); assumption.
    + apply (obj_refs_at ρ j i y); assumption.
Qed.

(* A self waiting edge is excluded by self-reference freedom. *)
Lemma no_waiting_self ρ i :
  self_ref_free ρ -> ~ waiting ρ i i.
Proof.
  intros Hsf Hw. destruct (waiting_ref ρ i i Hw) as [H|H]; exact (Hsf i H).
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Undirected simple graph and forests.                               *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition ref_edge (ρ : cfg) (a b : nat) : Prop :=
  a <> b /\ (b ∈ refs_at ρ a \/ a ∈ refs_at ρ b).

Lemma ref_edge_sym ρ a b : ref_edge ρ a b <-> ref_edge ρ b a.
Proof.
  unfold ref_edge. split; intros [Hne [H|H]]; split; auto; tauto.
Qed.

Inductive path_edges (R : nat -> nat -> Prop) : list nat -> Prop :=
  | pe_nil : path_edges R []
  | pe_one a : path_edges R [a]
  | pe_cons a b l : R a b -> path_edges R (b :: l) -> path_edges R (a :: b :: l).

Definition list_cycle (R : nat -> nat -> Prop) (l : list nat) : Prop :=
  3 <= List.length l /\ NoDup l /\
  path_edges R (l ++ [List.hd 0 l]).

Definition ref_forest (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall l, ~ list_cycle (ref_edge ρ) l.

Lemma waiting_path_edges_ref ρ l :
  ref_pair_ok ρ ->
  path_edges (waiting ρ) l -> path_edges (ref_edge ρ) l.
Proof.
  intros [Hsf Hpair] Hp. induction Hp as [|a|a b l Hw Hrest IH].
  - constructor.
  - constructor.
  - apply pe_cons.
    + split.
      * apply (waiting_neq ρ a b Hsf Hw).
      * apply (waiting_ref ρ a b Hw).

lookup_insert_Some
     : ∀ (m : pmap.Pmap ?A) (i j : positive) (x y : ?A),
         <[i:=x]> m !! j = Some y ↔ i = j ∧ x = y ∨ i ≠ j ∧ m !! j = Some y
where
?A : [ |- Type]
lookup_insert_is_Some
     : ∀ (m : pmap.Pmap ?A) (i j : positive) (x : ?A),
         is_Some (<[i:=x]> m !! j) ↔ i = j ∨ i ≠ j ∧ is_Some (m !! j)
where
?A : [ |- Type]
lookup_singleton_Some
     : ∀ (i j : positive) (x y : ?A),
         {[i := x]} !! j = Some y ↔ i = j ∧ x = y
where
?A : [ |- Type]
lookup_union_Some
     : ∀ (m1 m2 : pmap.Pmap ?A) (i : positive) (x : ?A),
         m1 ##ₘ m2
         → (m1 ∪ m2) !! i = Some x ↔ m1 !! i = Some x ∨ m2 !! i = Some x
where
?A : [ |- Type]

(* Release-shaped move: the thread's value bundle [B] moves into the
   lock [n].  For the forest no destination-backreference condition is
   needed: a self-reference of the lock contributes no graph edge. *)
Lemma release_forest_shape (S T : nat -> gset nat) (n i : nat) (B : gset nat) :
  ref_pair_ok_fun S ->
  forest_fun S ->
  n <> i ->
  T n = S n ∪ B ->
  T i ⊆ S i ->
  (forall a, a <> n -> a <> i -> T a = S a) ->
  (forall r, r ∈ B -> r <> n -> r ∉ T i) ->
  S n = ∅ ->
  i ∉ B ->
  B ⊆ S i ->
  n ∈ S i ->
  forest_fun T.
Proof.
  intros [Hself Hpair] Hforest Hni HTn HTi Hother Hdisj HSn HiB HB HnSi.
  eapply forest_star_shape with (S := S) (T := T)
          (i := n) (n := i) (R := B ∖ {[n]}).
  - (* edge inclusion *)
    intros a b [Hne Hedge].
    destruct Hedge as [Hb|Ha].
    + (* b ∈ T a *)
      destruct (decide (a = n)) as [Ea|Han].
      * subst a. rewrite HTn in Hb. rewrite HSn in Hb.
        assert (HbB : b ∈ B) by set_solver.
        right. left. split; [reflexivity|].
        apply elem_of_difference. split; [exact HbB|].
        intro E. apply elem_of_singleton in E. exact (Hne (eq_sym E)).
      * destruct (decide (b = n)) as [Eb|Hbn].
        -- subst b. destruct (decide (a = i)) as [Ea|Hai].
           ++ subst a. assert (HbS : n ∈ S i) by (apply HTi; exact Hb).
              left. split; [exact Hne|left; exact HbS].
           ++ left. rewrite (Hother a Han Hai) in Hb.
              split; [exact Hne|left; exact Hb].
        -- destruct (decide (a = i)) as [Ea|Hai].
           ++ subst a. assert (HbS : b ∈ S i) by (apply HTi; exact Hb).
              left. split; [exact Hne|left; exact HbS].
           ++ left. rewrite (Hother a Han Hai) in Hb.
              split; [exact Hne|left; exact Hb].
    + (* a ∈ T b *)
      destruct (decide (b = n)) as [Eb|Hbn].
      * subst b. rewrite HTn in Ha. rewrite HSn in Ha.
        assert (HaB : a ∈ B) by set_solver.
        right. right. split; [reflexivity|].
        apply elem_of_difference. split; [exact HaB|].
        intro E. apply elem_of_singleton in E. exact (Hne E).
      * destruct (decide (a = n)) as [Ea|Han].
        -- subst a. destruct (decide (b = i)) as [Eb|Hbi].
           ++ subst b. assert (HaS : n ∈ S i) by (apply HTi; exact Ha).
              left. split; [exact Hne|right; exact HaS].
           ++ left. rewrite (Hother b Hbn Hbi) in Ha.
              split; [exact Hne|right; exact Ha].
        -- destruct (decide (b = i)) as [Eb|Hbi].
           ++ subst b. assert (HaS : a ∈ S i) by (apply HTi; exact Ha).
              left. split; [exact Hne|right; exact HaS].
           ++ left. rewrite (Hother b Hbn Hbi) in Ha.
              split; [exact Hne|right; exact Ha].
  - exact Hforest.
  - (* source: old thread-out edges to the bundle *)
    intros r Hr. apply elem_of_difference in Hr as [HrB Hrn].
    assert (Hri : r <> i) by (intro E; subst r; exact (HiB HrB)).
    split; [exact (ne_sym Hri)|left; apply HB; exact HrB].
  - (* bridge *)
    split; [exact Hni|right; exact HnSi].

    intros r Hr [Hne [HrTi|HiTr]].
    + apply elem_of_difference in Hr as [HrB Hrn].
      assert (Hrn' : r <> n) by

    + apply elem_of_difference in Hr as [HrB Hrn].
      assert (Hrn' : r <> n) by
        (intro E; apply Hrn; apply elem_of_singleton; exact E).
      assert (Hri : r <> i) by (intro E; subst r; exact (HiB HrB)).
      rewrite (Hother r Hrn' Hri) in HiTr.
      assert (HrS : r ∈ S i) by (apply HB; exact HrB).

   configuration and then shrinks the deleted lock token. *)
Lemma wait_forest_shape (S T : nat -> gset nat) (i n : nat) (B : gset nat) :

  forest_fun S ->
  T i ⊆ S i ∪ B ->
  T n = ∅ ->
  (forall a, a <> i -> a <> n -> T a = S a) ->
  i ∉ B ->
  B ⊆ S n ->
  n ∈ S i ->
  i <> n ->
  forest_fun T.
Proof.
  intros. eapply acquire_forest_shape; eauto.
Qed.

(* Wait pair: the same subset-shaped pair lemma as Acquire. *)
Lemma wait_pair_shape (S T : nat -> gset nat) (i n : nat) (B : gset nat) :
  ref_pair_ok_fun S ->
  T i ⊆ S i ∪ B ->
  T n = ∅ ->
  (forall a, a <> i -> a <> n -> T a = S a) ->
  i ∉ B ->
  (forall b, b ∈ B -> i ∉ T b) ->
  ref_pair_ok_fun T.
Proof. intros. eapply acquire_pair_shape; eauto. Qed.

  ref_pair_ok_fun S ->

  forest_fun T.
Proof. intros. eapply forest_shrink_fun; eauto. Qed.
