From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.
From stdpp Require Import gmap decidable.
From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String Arith Lia.
Require Import SelfDepositCex.
Open Scope string_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Lock-content self-reference: local preservation.                   *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* [SelfDepositCex] shows that typing, kind liveness and holder        *)
(* uniqueness do not exclude a Release whose payload mentions the      *)
(* destination lock.  This file isolates the exact remaining proof     *)
(* obligation: [release_payload_safe].  For every local step except    *)
(* Release and NewLock, lock contents are unchanged; NewLock is safe   *)
(* because the destination is fresh and [refs_live] is assumed; only   *)
(* Release needs a payload condition.                                  *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition release_payload_safe (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i k n v,
    ρ !! i = Some (Thread (k (Release (Val (LockV n)) (Val v)))) ->
    n ∉ val_refs v.

(* The target maps of the lock-free steps contain only threads/barriers. *)

Ltac solve_no_lock H :=
  first
    [ apply lookup_singleton_Some in H;
      let E := fresh "E" in let V := fresh "V" in
      destruct H as [E V]; discriminate V
    | apply lookup_insert_Some in H;
      let E := fresh "E" in let V := fresh "V" in
      destruct H as [[E V]|[E H]];
      [discriminate V | solve_no_lock H]
    | simpl in H; discriminate H
    | apply lookup_empty in H; discriminate H ].

(* Every newly present lock content comes from the executed thread. *)

Lemma local_step_content_origin i ρ ρ' (Hstep : local_step i ρ ρ') :
  forall n rc v,
    ρ' !! n = Some (Lock rc (Some v)) ->
    (exists rc0, ρ !! n = Some (Lock rc0 (Some v))) \/
    (exists k, ρ !! i = Some
       (Thread (k (Release (Val (LockV n)) (Val v))))) \/
    (exists k, ρ !! i = Some (Thread (k (NewLock (Val v))))).
Proof.
  intros n rc v Ht.
  destruct Hstep as
    [ i k e e' Hk Hpure
    | i
    | i j n0 k v0 Hne1 Hne2 Hne3 Hk
    | i j n0 k1 k2 v1 v2 Hne1 Hne2 Hne3 Hk1 Hk2
    | v0 k n0 i0 Hne Hk
    | v0 o k i0 j n0 refcnt Hne1 Hne2 Hne3 Hk
    | v0 k i0 n0 refcnt Hne Hk
    | v0 k i0 n0 refcnt Hne Hk
    | v0 k i0 n0 Hne Hk
    | o k i0 n0 refcnt Hne Hk ].
  - (* Pure *) solve_no_lock Ht.
  - (* Exit *) solve_no_lock Ht.
  - (* Fork *) solve_no_lock Ht.
  - (* Sync *) solve_no_lock Ht.
  - (* NewLock *) simpl in Ht.
    destruct (decide (n = n0)) as [E|E].
    + subst n0. left. right. exists k. 
    + right. right. exists k. 
  - (* ForkLock *) simpl in Ht.
    destruct (decide (n = n0)) as [E|E].
    + subst n0. left. 
    + left. 
  - (* Acquire *) solve_no_lock Ht.
  - (* Release *) simpl in Ht.
    destruct (decide (n = n0)) as [E|E].
    + subst n0. left. right. exists k.
    + left. 
  - (* Wait *) solve_no_lock Ht.
  - (* Drop *) simpl in Ht.
    destruct (decide (n = n0)) as [E|E].
    + subst n0. left.
    + left.
Qed.

refs_at =
fun (ρ : langdef.cfg) (a : nat) =>
match base.lookup a ρ with
| Some o => definitions.obj_refs o
| None => base.empty
end
     : langdef.cfg -> nat -> gmap.gset nat

Arguments refs_at ρ a%_nat_scope
self_ref_free =
fun ρ : langdef.cfg => forall a : nat, ~ base.elem_of a (refs_at ρ a)
     : langdef.cfg -> Prop

Arguments self_ref_free ρ
pair_ref_ok =
fun ρ : langdef.cfg =>
forall a b : nat,
a <> b -> ~ (base.elem_of b (refs_at ρ a) /\ base.elem_of a (refs_at ρ b))
     : langdef.cfg -> Prop

Arguments pair_ref_ok ρ
ref_forest =
fun ρ : langdef.cfg => forall l : list nat, ~ list_cycle (ref_edge ρ) l
     : langdef.cfg -> Prop

Arguments ref_forest ρ
refs_live =
fun ρ : langdef.cfg =>
forall (i : nat) (y : langdef.obj),
base.lookup i ρ = Some y ->
forall j : nat,
base.elem_of j (definitions.obj_refs y) -> base.lookup j ρ <> None
     : langdef.cfg -> Prop

Arguments refs_live ρ

From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.
From stdpp Require Import gmap decidable.
From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String Arith Lia.
Require Import SelfDepositCex.
Open Scope string_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Lock-content self-reference: local preservation.                   *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* [SelfDepositCex] shows that typing, kind liveness and holder        *)
(* uniqueness do not exclude a Release whose payload mentions the      *)
(* destination lock.  This file isolates the exact remaining proof     *)
(* obligation: [release_payload_safe].  For every local step except    *)
(* Release and NewLock, lock contents are unchanged (only refcounts    *)
(* change); NewLock is safe because the destination is fresh and       *)
(* [refs_live] is assumed; only Release needs a payload condition.     *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition release_payload_safe (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i k n v,
    ρ !! i = Some (Thread (k (Release (Val (LockV n)) (Val v)))) ->
    n ∉ val_refs v.

(* ---------- lookup helpers for the explicit one/two/three-object cfgs ---------- *)

Lemma lookup_single_thread i (k : expr -> expr) e :
  ({[ i := Thread (k e) ]} : cfg) !! i = Some (Thread (k e)).
Proof. apply lookup_singleton_eq. Qed.

Lemma lookup_thread_lock_i i n (k : expr -> expr) e rc o (Hin : i <> n) :
  ({[ i := Thread (k e) ; n := Lock rc o ]} : cfg) !! i = Some (Thread (k e)).
Proof.
  change ((<[i:=Thread(k e)]> (<[n:=Lock rc o]> (∅:cfg))) !! i = Some(Thread(k e))).
  apply lookup_insert_eq.
Qed.

Lemma lookup_thread_lock_n i n (k : expr -> expr) e rc o (Hin : i <> n) :
  ({[ i := Thread (k e) ; n := Lock rc o ]} : cfg) !! n = Some (Lock rc o).
Proof.
  change ((<[i:=Thread(k e)]> (<[n:=Lock rc o]> (∅:cfg))) !! n = Some(Lock rc o)).
  rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[n:=Lock rc o]> (∅:cfg)) i n (Thread(k e)) Hin).
  apply lookup_insert_eq.
Qed.

Lemma lookup_three_n i j n (k : expr -> expr) e (k2 : expr -> expr) e2 rc o
    (Hin : i <> n) (Hjn : j <> n) :
  ({[ i := Thread (k e) ; j := Thread (k2 e2) ; n := Lock rc o ]}:cfg) !! n
    = Some(Lock rc o).
Proof.
  change ((<[i:=Thread(k e)]> (<[j:=Thread(k2 e2)]> (<[n:=Lock rc o]> (∅:cfg)))) !! n
          = Some(Lock rc o)).
  rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[j:=Thread(k2 e2)]> (<[n:=Lock rc o]> (∅:cfg)))
             i n (Thread(k e)) Hin).
  rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[n:=Lock rc o]> (∅:cfg)) j n (Thread(k2 e2)) Hjn).
  apply lookup_insert_eq.
Qed.

Ltac solve_no_lock_other H E :=
  first
    [ apply lookup_singleton_Some in H;
      let Eeq := fresh "Eeq" in let V := fresh "V" in
      destruct H as [Eeq V];
      first [ discriminate V
            | exfalso; apply E; symmetry; exact Eeq ]
    | apply lookup_insert_Some in H;
      let Eeq := fresh "Eeq" in let V := fresh "V" in
      destruct H as [[Eeq V]|[Eeq H]];
      [discriminate V | solve_no_lock_other H E]
    | simpl in H; discriminate H ].

Ltac solve_no_lock H :=
  first
    [ apply lookup_singleton_Some in H;
      let E := fresh "E" in let V := fresh "V" in
      destruct H as [E V]; discriminate V
    | apply lookup_insert_Some in H;
      let E := fresh "E" in let V := fresh "V" in
      destruct H as [[E V]|[E H]];
      [discriminate V | solve_no_lock H]
    | simpl in H; discriminate H ].

(* Every newly present lock content comes from the executed thread.
   Refcounts may change (ForkLock/Drop), so only the payload is fixed. *)

Lemma local_step_content_origin i ρ ρ' (Hstep : local_step i ρ ρ') :
  forall n rc v,
    ρ' !! n = Some (Lock rc (Some v)) ->
    (exists rc0, ρ !! n = Some (Lock rc0 (Some v))) \/
    (exists k, ρ !! i = Some
       (Thread (k (Release (Val (LockV n)) (Val v))))) \/
    (exists k, ρ !! i = Some (Thread (k (NewLock (Val v))))).
Proof.
  intros n rc v Ht.
  destruct Hstep as
    [ i k e e' Hk Hpure
    | i
    | i j n0 k v0 Hne1 Hne2 Hne3 Hk
    | i j n0 k1 k2 v1 v2 Hne1 Hne2 Hne3 Hk1 Hk2
    | v0 k n0 i0 Hne Hk
    | v0 o k i0 j n0 refcnt Hne1 Hne2 Hne3 Hk
    | v0 k i0 n0 refcnt Hne Hk
    | v0 k i0 n0 refcnt Hne Hk
    | v0 k i0 n0 Hne Hk
    | o k i0 n0 refcnt Hne Hk ].
  - (* Pure *) solve_no_lock Ht.
  - (* Exit *) solve_no_lock Ht.
  - (* Fork *) solve_no_lock Ht.
  - (* Sync *) solve_no_lock Ht.
  - (* NewLock *)
    destruct (decide (n = n0)) as [E|E].
    + subst n0.
      apply lookup_singleton_Some in Ht as [Eeq Hval].
      inversion Hval as [[Hrc Hv]]; subst rc; subst v0.
      right. right. exists k.
      rewrite <- Eeq. apply lookup_single_thread.
    + right. right. exists k.
      solve_no_lock_other Ht E.
  - (* ForkLock *)
    destruct (decide (n = n0)) as [E|E].
    + subst n0.
      assert (Hlook : ({[ i0 := Thread (k (Val (LockV n))) ;
                          j := Thread (App (Val v0) (Val (LockV n))) ;
                          n := Lock (S refcnt) o ]}:cfg) !! n
                      = Some (Lock (S refcnt) o))
        by (apply lookup_three_n; [exact Hne2 | exact Hne3]).
      rewrite Hlook in Ht. injection Ht as Hrc Hv.
      left. exists refcnt.
      assert (Hsrc : ({[ i0 := Thread (k (ForkLock (Val (LockV n)) (Val v0))) ;
                          n := Lock refcnt o ]}:cfg) !! n
                    = Some (Lock refcnt o))
        by (apply lookup_thread_lock_n; exact Hne2).
      rewrite Hsrc. rewrite Hv. reflexivity.
    + left.
      solve_no_lock_other Ht E.
  - (* Acquire *) solve_no_lock Ht.
  - (* Release *)
    destruct (decide (n = n0)) as [E|E].
    + subst n0.
      assert (Hlook : ({[ i0 := Thread (k (Val (LockV n))) ;
                          n := Lock refcnt (Some v0) ]}:cfg) !! n
                      = Some (Lock refcnt (Some v0)))
        by (apply lookup_thread_lock_n; exact Hne).
      rewrite Hlook in Ht. injection Ht as Hrc Hv.
      injection Hv as Hv0.
      right. left. exists k.
      assert (Hsrc : ({[ i0 := Thread (k (Release (Val (LockV n)) (Val v0))) ;
                          n := Lock refcnt None ]}:cfg) !! i0
                    = Some (Thread (k (Release (Val (LockV n)) (Val v0)))))
        by (apply lookup_thread_lock_i; exact Hne).
      rewrite Hsrc. rewrite Hv0. reflexivity.
    + right. left. exists k.
      solve_no_lock_other Ht E.
  - (* Wait *) solve_no_lock Ht.
  - (* Drop *)
    destruct (decide (n = n0)) as [E|E].
    + subst n0.
      assert (Hlook : ({[ i0 := Thread (k (Drop (Val (LockV n)))) ;
                          n := Lock refcnt o ]}:cfg) !! n
                      = Some (Lock refcnt o))
        by (apply lookup_thread_lock_n; exact Hne).
      rewrite Hlook in Ht. injection Ht as Hrc Hv.
      left. exists (S refcnt).
      assert (Hsrc : ({[ i0 := Thread (k (Drop (Val (LockV n)))) ;
                          n := Lock (S refcnt) o ]}:cfg) !! n
                    = Some (Lock (S refcnt) o))
        by (apply lookup_thread_lock_n; exact Hne).
      rewrite Hsrc. rewrite Hv. reflexivity.
    + left.
      solve_no_lock_other Ht E.
Qed.

Print Assumptions local_step_content_origin.

From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.
From stdpp Require Import gmap list.
From Stdlib Require Import List Arith Lia.
From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String.
Import ListNotations.
Close Scope string_scope.

Load "/tmp/scratch6/RuleForest.v".
Require Import KindRefs.
Require Import ForestSide.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Instantiating the abstract pair/forest shapes with the side        *)
(* conditions supplied by scratch7 (kind_live + refs_live).           *)
(* [refs_at] below denotes the current file's copy, which is          *)
(* definitionally the same as AllCombine.refs_at.                     *)
(* ================================================================== *)

(* Acquire/Wait: content bundle [B] is exactly the old lock refs. *)
Lemma kind_object_bundle_rev (S T : nat -> gset nat) (i n : nat) (B : gset nat) :
  ref_pair_ok_fun S ->
  B = S n ->
  T n = ∅ ->
  (forall a, a <> i -> a <> n -> T a = S a) ->
  i ∉ B ->
  (forall b, b ∈ B -> i ∉ S b) ->
  (forall b, b ∈ B -> i ∉ T b).
Proof.
  intros Hpair HBS HTn Hother HiB Hside b Hb.
  destruct Hpair as [Hself _].
  assert (Hbi : b <> i) by (intro E; subst b; exact (HiB Hb)).
  assert (Hbn : b <> n).
  { intro E. subst b.
    apply (Hself n). rewrite <- HBS. exact Hb. }
  rewrite (Hother b Hbi Hbn).
  apply Hside. exact Hb.
Qed.

Lemma kind_acquire_pair (ρ : cfg) (i n : nat) (e : expr) (B : gset nat)
    (T : nat -> gset nat) :
  ref_pair_ok_fun (refs_at ρ) ->
  kind_live ρ ->
  refs_live ρ ->
  ρ !! i = Some (Thread e) ->
  ρ !! n <> None ->
  B = refs_at ρ n ->
  T i ⊆ refs_at ρ i ∪ B ->
  T n = ∅ ->
  (forall a, a <> i -> a <> n -> T a = refs_at ρ a) ->
  ref_pair_ok_fun T.
Proof.
  intros Hpair Hkind Hrl Hi Hn HBS HTi HTn Hother.
  destruct (kind_live_bundle_from_object_side ρ i e n Hkind Hrl Hi Hn)
    as [HiB Hside].
  assert (HiB' : i ∉ B) by (rewrite HBS; exact HiB).
  assert (Hside' : forall b, b ∈ B -> i ∉ refs_at ρ b).
  { intros b Hb. apply Hside. rewrite HBS in Hb. exact Hb. }
  assert (Hrev : forall b, b ∈ B -> i ∉ T b).
  { eapply kind_object_bundle_rev; eauto. }
  eapply acquire_pair_shape with (S := refs_at ρ); eauto.
Qed.

Lemma kind_acquire_forest (ρ : cfg) (i n : nat) (e : expr) (B : gset nat)
    (T : nat -> gset nat) :
  ref_pair_ok_fun (refs_at ρ) ->
  forest_fun (refs_at ρ) ->
  kind_live ρ ->
  refs_live ρ ->
  ρ !! i = Some (Thread e) ->
  ρ !! n <> None ->
  B = refs_at ρ n ->
  T i ⊆ refs_at ρ i ∪ B ->
  T n = ∅ ->
  (forall a, a <> i -> a <> n -> T a = refs_at ρ a) ->
  n ∈ refs_at ρ i ->
  i <> n ->
  forest_fun T.
Proof.
  intros Hpair Hforest Hkind Hrl Hi Hn HBS HTi HTn Hother HnSi Hine.
  destruct (kind_live_bundle_from_object_side ρ i e n Hkind Hrl Hi Hn)
    as [HiB _].
  assert (HiB' : i ∉ B) by (rewrite HBS; exact HiB).
  assert (HB : B ⊆ refs_at ρ n) by (rewrite HBS; apply subseteq_refl).
  eapply acquire_forest_shape with (S := refs_at ρ); eauto.
Qed.

(* Sync pair: the value [v2] sent by thread [j] is the moved bundle. *)
Lemma kind_sync_pair (ρ : cfg) (i j : nat) (ei ej : expr) (v2 : val)
    (B2 : gset nat) (T : nat -> gset nat) :
  ref_pair_ok_fun (refs_at ρ) ->
  kind_live ρ ->
  refs_live ρ ->
  ρ !! i = Some (Thread ei) ->
  ρ !! j = Some (Thread ej) ->
  (forall b, b ∈ val_refs v2 -> b ∈ expr_refs ej) ->
  B2 = val_refs v2 ->
  T i ⊆ refs_at ρ i ∪ B2 ->
  (forall a, a <> i -> T a ⊆ refs_at ρ a) ->
  i <> j ->
  ref_pair_ok_fun T.
Proof.
  intros Hpair Hkind Hrl Hi Hj Hsub HB2 HTi HsubT Hij.
  destruct (kind_live_bundle_from_thread_side ρ j i ej ei v2
              Hkind Hrl Hj Hi Hsub) as [HiB Hside].
  assert (HiB' : i ∉ B2) by (rewrite HB2; exact HiB).
  assert (Hside' : forall b, b ∈ B2 -> i ∉ refs_at ρ b).
  { intros b Hb. apply Hside. rewrite HB2 in Hb. exact Hb. }
  eapply sync_pair_shape with (S := refs_at ρ) (j := j); eauto.
Qed.

(* The exact extra invariant needed at Release into a lock [n]. *)
Definition lock_store_safe (ρ : cfg) (n : nat) (v : val) : Prop :=
  n ∉ val_refs v /\ (forall b, b ∈ val_refs v -> n ∉ refs_at ρ b).

Lemma lock_store_safe_gives_release_rev
    (S : nat -> gset nat) (T : nat -> gset nat) (n i : nat) (B : gset nat) :
  B = val_refs_dummy ->
  True.
Proof.
  intros _. exact I.
Qed.

Print Assumptions kind_acquire_pair.
Print Assumptions kind_acquire_forest.
Print Assumptions kind_sync_pair.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Pair preservation for a bundle of edges moved from [n] to [i].     *)
(* This is the set-level counterpart of the forest bridge move.       *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition self_free_fun (S : nat -> gset nat) : Prop :=
  forall a, a ∉ S a.

Definition pair_ok_fun (S : nat -> gset nat) : Prop :=
  forall a b, a <> b -> ~ (b ∈ S a /\ a ∈ S b).

Definition ref_pair_ok_fun (S : nat -> gset nat) : Prop :=
  self_free_fun S /\ pair_ok_fun S.

Lemma pair_move_add (S T : nat -> gset nat) (i n : nat) (B : gset nat) :
  ref_pair_ok_fun S ->
  T i = S i ∪ B ->
  T n = ∅ ->
  (forall a, a <> i -> a <> n -> T a = S a) ->
  i ∉ B ->
  (forall b, b ∈ B -> i ∉ T b) ->
  ref_pair_ok_fun T.
Proof.
  intros [Hself Hpair] HTi HTn Hother HiB Hrev.
  split.
  - intro a. destruct (decide (a = i)) as [E|Hai].
    + subst a. rewrite HTi. intro Hmem.
      apply elem_of_union in Hmem as [Hin|Hin].
      * exact (Hself i Hin).
      * exact (HiB Hin).
    + destruct (decide (a = n)) as [E|Han].
      * subst a. rewrite HTn. set_solver.
      * rewrite (Hother a Hai Han). apply Hself.
  - intros a b Hne [Hb Ha].
    destruct (decide (a = i)) as [Ea|Hai].
    + subst a. rewrite HTi in Hb.

From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.
From stdpp Require Import gmap list.
From Stdlib Require Import List Arith Lia.
From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String.
Import ListNotations.
Close Scope string_scope.

Load "/tmp/scratch6/KindSide.v".

(* ================================================================== *)
(* A configuration-level refutation of Release preservation from       *)
(* [kind_live] + [refs_live] + old [ref_pair_ok].                     *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* The source is a live thread holding lock 1 (unlocked) and an       *)
(* expression that releases lock 1 with a value which is itself the    *)
(* capability [LockV 1].  The stored value therefore mentions its own *)
(* lock.  The source satisfies every typing-shaped invariant we have   *)
(* (kind-liveness, live references, pair-freeness), but the target     *)
(* lock has a self-reference, so pair-freeness is destroyed.           *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* This is not a typed source state ([Val] is not a source typing     *)
(* rule), but it shows that no argument from [kind_live]/[refs_live]  *)
(* alone can establish the missing Release side condition.            *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition cex_expr : expr :=
  Release (Val (LockV 1)) (Val (LockV 1)).

Definition cex_rho : cfg :=
  {[0 := Thread cex_expr; 1 := Lock 0 None]}.

Definition cex_rho' : cfg :=
  {[0 := Thread (Val (LockV 1)); 1 := Lock 0 (Some (LockV 1))]}.

Lemma cex_step : local_step 1 cex_rho cex_rho'.
Proof.
  unfold cex_rho, cex_rho', cex_expr.
  eapply Release_step with (i := 0) (n := 1) (refcnt := 0) (k := id)
                            (v := LockV 1).
  - lia.
  - apply Ctx_id.
Qed.

(* Source reference sets. *)
Lemma cex_src0 : refs_at cex_rho 0 = {[1]}.
Proof.
  unfold cex_rho, cex_expr.
  rewrite Release_src_refs by lia.
  simpl. set_solver.
Qed.

Lemma cex_src1 : refs_at cex_rho 1 = ∅.
Proof.
  unfold cex_rho, cex_expr.
  rewrite Release_src_refs by lia.
  simpl. decide_all.
Qed.

Lemma cex_src_other a : a <> 0 -> a <> 1 -> refs_at cex_rho a = ∅.
Proof.
  intros Ha0 Ha1.
  unfold cex_rho, cex_expr.
  rewrite Release_src_refs by lia.
  destruct (decide (a = 0)) as [E|H0]; [exfalso; exact (Ha0 E)|].
  destruct (decide (a = 1)) as [E|H1]; [exfalso; exact (Ha1 E)|].
  reflexivity.
Qed.

(* Target reference sets. *)
Lemma cex_tgt0 : refs_at cex_rho' 0 = {[1]}.
Proof.
  unfold cex_rho'.
  rewrite Release_tgt_refs by lia.
  simpl. set_solver.
Qed.

Lemma cex_tgt1 : refs_at cex_rho' 1 = {[1]}.
Proof.
  unfold cex_rho'.
  rewrite Release_tgt_refs by lia.
  simpl. set_solver.
Qed.

Lemma cex_tgt_other a : a <> 0 -> a <> 1 -> refs_at cex_rho' a = ∅.
Proof.
  intros Ha0 Ha1.
  unfold cex_rho'.
  rewrite Release_tgt_refs by lia.
  destruct (decide (a = 0)) as [E|H0]; [exfalso; exact (Ha0 E)|].
  destruct (decide (a = 1)) as [E|H1]; [exfalso; exact (Ha1 E)|].
  reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma cex_src_pair : ref_pair_ok_fun (refs_at cex_rho).
Proof.
  split.
  - intro a. destruct (decide (a = 0)) as [E|Ha0].
    + subst a. rewrite cex_src0. set_solver.
    + destruct (decide (a = 1)) as [E|Ha1].
      * subst a. rewrite cex_src1. set_solver.
      * rewrite cex_src_other by assumption. set_solver.
  - intros a b Hne [Hb Ha].
    destruct (decide (a = 0)) as [E|Ha0].
    + subst a.
      destruct (decide (b = 1)) as [E|Hb1].
      * subst b. rewrite cex_src1 in Ha. set_solver.
      * rewrite cex_src_other in Hb by (auto; intro E; apply Hb1; symmetry; exact E).
        set_solver.
    + destruct (decide (a = 1)) as [E|Ha1].
      * subst a. rewrite cex_src1 in Hb. set_solver.
      * rewrite cex_src_other in Hb by auto. set_solver.
Qed.

Lemma cex_tgt_not_pair : ~ ref_pair_ok_fun (refs_at cex_rho').
Proof.
  intro H. destruct H as [Hself _].
  apply (Hself 1). rewrite cex_tgt1. set_solver.
Qed.

(* kind_live of the source. *)
Lemma cex_src_kind : kind_live cex_rho.
Proof.
  unfold kind_live, kind_lock_live, kind_barrier_live.
  split.
  - split.
    + intros i e n Hi Hin.
      destruct (decide (i = 0)) as [E|H0].
      * subst i. simpl in Hi. injection Hi as He. subst e.
        simpl in Hin.
        assert (n = 1) by set_solver. subst n.
        exists 0, None. reflexivity.
      * destruct (decide (i = 1)) as [E|H1].
        -- subst i. simpl in Hi. discriminate Hi.
        -- unfold cex_rho in Hi.
           rewrite lookup_insert_ne in Hi by (intro E; apply H0; symmetry; exact E).
           rewrite lookup_insert_ne in Hi by (intro E; apply H1; symmetry; exact E).
           simpl in Hi. discriminate Hi.
    + intros i rc o v n Hi Hin.
      destruct (decide (i = 0)) as [E|H0].
      * subst i. simpl in Hi. discriminate Hi.
      * destruct (decide (i = 1)) as [E|H1].
        -- subst i. simpl in Hi. injection Hi as _ Ho. subst o.
           simpl in Hin. exists 0, None. reflexivity.
        -- unfold cex_rho in Hi.
           rewrite lookup_insert_ne in Hi by (intro E; apply H0; symmetry; exact E).
           rewrite lookup_insert_ne in Hi by (intro E; apply H1; symmetry; exact E).
           simpl in Hi. discriminate Hi.
  - split.
    + intros i e n Hi Hin.
      destruct (decide (i = 0)) as [E|H0].
      * subst i. simpl in Hi. injection Hi as He. subst e.
        simpl in Hin. set_solver.
      * destruct (decide (i = 1)) as [E|H1].
        -- subst i. simpl in Hi. discriminate Hi.
        -- unfold cex_rho in Hi.
           rewrite lookup_insert_ne in Hi by (intro E; apply H0; symmetry; exact E).
           rewrite lookup_insert_ne in Hi by (intro E; apply H1; symmetry; exact E).
           simpl in Hi. discriminate Hi.
    + intros i rc o v n Hi Hin.
      destruct (decide (i = 0)) as [E|H0].
      * subst i. simpl in Hi. discriminate Hi.
      * destruct (decide (i = 1)) as [E|H1].
        -- subst i. simpl in Hi. injection Hi as _ Ho. subst o.
           simpl in Hin. set_solver.
        -- unfold cex_rho in Hi.
           rewrite lookup_insert_ne in Hi by (intro E; apply H0; symmetry; exact E).
           rewrite lookup_insert_ne in Hi by (intro E; apply H1; symmetry; exact E).
           simpl in Hi. discriminate Hi.
Qed.

Lemma cex_src_refs_live : refs_live cex_rho.
Proof.
  intros i y Hi j Hj.
  destruct (decide (i = 0)) as [E|H0].
  - subst i. simpl in Hi. injection Hi as He. subst y.
    simpl in Hj. assert (j = 1) by set_solver. subst j. simpl. discriminate.
  - destruct (decide (i = 1)) as [E|H1].
    + subst i. simpl in Hi. injection Hi as _ Ho. subst y.
      simpl in Hj. set_solver.
    + unfold cex_rho in Hi.
      rewrite lookup_insert_ne in Hi by (intro E; apply H0; symmetry; exact E).
      rewrite lookup_insert_ne in Hi by (intro E; apply H1; symmetry; exact E).
      simpl in Hi. discriminate Hi.
Qed.

(* The same kind/liveness invariants hold in the target; only pair-     *)
(* freeness fails.                                                      *)
Lemma cex_tgt_kind : kind_live cex_rho'.
Proof.
  unfold kind_live, kind_lock_live, kind_barrier_live.
  split.
  - split.
    + intros i e n Hi Hin.
      destruct (decide (i = 0)) as [E|H0].
      * subst i. simpl in Hi. injection Hi as He. subst e.
        simpl in Hin. assert (n = 1) by set_solver. subst n.
        exists 0, None. reflexivity.
      * destruct (decide (i = 1)) as [E|H1].
        -- subst i. simpl in Hi. discriminate Hi.
        -- unfold cex_rho' in Hi.
           rewrite lookup_insert_ne in Hi by (intro E; apply H0; symmetry; exact E).
           rewrite lookup_insert_ne in Hi by (intro E; apply H1; symmetry; exact E).
           simpl in Hi. discriminate Hi.
    + intros i rc o v n Hi Hin.
      destruct (decide (i = 0)) as [E|H0].
      * subst i. simpl in Hi. discriminate Hi.
      * destruct (decide (i = 1)) as [E|H1].
        -- subst i. simpl in Hi. injection Hi as _ Ho. subst o.
           simpl in Hin. exists 0, None. reflexivity.
        -- unfold cex_rho' in Hi.
           rewrite lookup_insert_ne in Hi by (intro E; apply H0; symmetry; exact E).
           rewrite lookup_insert_ne in Hi by (intro E; apply H1; symmetry; exact E).
           simpl in Hi. discriminate Hi.
  - split.
    + intros i e n Hi Hin.
      destruct (decide (i = 0)) as [E|H0].
      * subst i. simpl in Hi. injection Hi as He. subst e.
        simpl in Hin. set_solver.
      * destruct (decide (i = 1)) as [E|H1].
        -- subst i. simpl in Hi. discriminate Hi.
        -- unfold cex_rho' in Hi.
           rewrite lookup_insert_ne in Hi by (intro E; apply H0; symmetry; exact E).
           rewrite lookup_insert_ne in Hi by (intro E; apply H1; symmetry; exact E).
           simpl in Hi. discriminate Hi.
    + intros i rc o v n Hi Hin.
      destruct (decide (i = 0)) as [E|H0].
      * subst i. simpl in Hi. discriminate Hi.
      * destruct (decide (i = 1)) as [E|H1].
        -- subst i. simpl in Hi. injection Hi as _ Ho. subst o.
           simpl in Hin. set_solver.
        -- unfold cex_rho' in Hi.
           rewrite lookup_insert_ne in Hi by (intro E; apply H0; symmetry; exact E).
           rewrite lookup_insert_ne in Hi by (intro E; apply H1; symmetry; exact E).
           simpl in Hi. discriminate Hi.
Qed.

Lemma cex_tgt_refs_live : refs_live cex_rho'.
Proof.
  intros i y Hi j Hj.
  destruct (decide (i = 0)) as [E|H0].
  - subst i. simpl in Hi. injection Hi as He. subst y.
    simpl in Hj. assert (j = 1) by set_solver. subst j. simpl. discriminate.
  - destruct (decide (i = 1)) as [E|H1].
    + subst i. simpl in Hi. injection Hi as _ Ho. subst y.
      simpl in Hj. assert (j = 1) by set_solver. subst j. simpl. discriminate.
    + unfold cex_rho' in Hi.
      rewrite lookup_insert_ne in Hi by (intro E; apply H0; symmetry; exact E).
      rewrite lookup_insert_ne in Hi by (intro E; apply H1; symmetry; exact E).
      simpl in Hi. discriminate Hi.
Qed.

(* Summary: source and target are kind-live and reference-live, but the *)
(* pair invariant is not preserved.                                     *)
Theorem release_pair_not_from_kind :
  ref_pair_ok_fun (refs_at cex_rho) /\
  kind_live cex_rho /\ refs_live cex_rho /\
  local_step 1 cex_rho cex_rho' /\
  kind_live cex_rho' /\ refs_live cex_rho' /\
  ~ ref_pair_ok_fun (refs_at cex_rho').
Proof.
  repeat split;
    auto using cex_src_pair, cex_src_kind, cex_src_refs_live,
              cex_step, cex_tgt_kind, cex_tgt_refs_live, cex_tgt_not_pair.
Qed.

From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.
From stdpp Require Import gmap decidable.
From Stdlib Require Import List Arith Lia.
From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String.
Import ListNotations.
Require Import AllCombine.
Require Import CapCex.
Require Import KindRefs.
Open Scope string_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* A [cvS]-typed self-deposit.                                        *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* The Release destination is only covered by a typing argument if a  *)
(* value of the lock-content type can mention the same lock.  It can:  *)
(* the lock reference sits in a *dead argument* of a closure body.    *)
(* The "dead argument" is typed at [LockT (Client,Closed) t] and is    *)
(* discarded by the closure; its type is unrelated to the closure's   *)
(* result type [t].  Consequently there is no recursive type equation  *)
(* [t = LockT _ t] to rule out.  This is a machine-checked failure of  *)
(* any no-self-deposit argument based on occurrence/type size, even    *)
(* for the *refined* typing [cvS]/[wtS].                               *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* The witness below is runtime-typed and has all the object-level     *)
(* invariants except the new lock-content invariant.  It is not yet    *)
(* claimed to be reachable from a [typed] source; see the final note.  *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition sd_t : type := FunT Lin UnitT UnitT.
Definition sd_L : gmap nat type := {[1 := sd_t]}.

Lemma sd_L1 : sd_L !! 1 = Some sd_t.
Proof. unfold sd_L. apply lookup_singleton_eq. Qed.

Definition sd_client_t : type := LockT (Client,Closed) sd_t.
Definition sd_fun : val := FunV "y" (Drop (Var "y")).
Definition sd_body : expr := App (Val sd_fun) (Val (LockV 1)).
Definition sd_payload : val := FunV "x" sd_body.

(* ---------- environment helpers ---------- *)

Lemma sd_env_split_singleton x (t : type) :
  env_split (<[x := t]> (∅ : env)) (<[x := t]> (∅ : env)) ∅.
Proof.
  unfold env_split. split.
  - symmetry. apply env_union_empty_r.
  - unfold disj. intros i t1 t2 H1 H2.
    assert (Hnone : (∅ : env) !! i = None) by apply lookup_empty.
    rewrite Hnone in H2. discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma sd_env_var_self x (t : type) :
  env_var (<[x := t]> (∅ : env)) x t.
Proof.
  unfold env_var. exists ∅. split; [reflexivity|apply env_unr_empty].
Qed.

(* ---------- refined value typings ---------- *)

Lemma sd_fun_cv : cv sd_L sd_fun (FunT Lin sd_client_t UnitT).
Proof.
  unfold sd_fun.
  eapply FunVW.
  eapply DropW with (t := sd_t).
  eapply VarW. apply sd_env_var_self.
Qed.

Lemma sd_lock_cv : cv sd_L (LockV 1) sd_client_t.
Proof.
  change (cv sd_L (LockV 1) (LockT (Client,Closed) sd_t)).
  apply LockVW. exact sd_L1.
Qed.

Lemma sd_lock_cvS : cvS sd_L (LockV 1) sd_client_t.
Proof.
  change (cvS sd_L (LockV 1) (LockT (Client,Closed) sd_t)).
  apply LockVS. exact sd_L1.
Qed.

Lemma sd_body_wt : wt sd_L (<[ "x" := UnitT ]> (∅ : env)) sd_body UnitT.
Proof.
  unfold sd_body.
  eapply AppW with (Γ1 := <[ "x" := UnitT ]> (∅ : env)) (Γ2 := ∅)
                   (l := Lin) (t1 := sd_client_t) (t2 := UnitT).
  - apply sd_env_split_singleton.
  - apply ValW.
    + apply env_unr_singleton_unr. apply Unit_unr.
    + exact sd_fun_cv.
  - apply ValW.
    + apply env_unr_empty.
    + exact sd_lock_cv.
Qed.

Lemma sd_payload_cv : cv sd_L sd_payload sd_t.
Proof.
  unfold sd_payload, sd_t.
  apply FunVW. exact sd_body_wt.
Qed.

Lemma sd_payload_cvS : cvS sd_L sd_payload sd_t.
Proof.
  unfold sd_payload, sd_t.
  eapply FunVS with (l := Lin).
  - exact sd_body_wt.
  - intros H. discriminate H.
Qed.

(* The payload mentions lock 1 although its type is exactly [L 1]. *)

Lemma sd_payload_self : 1 ∈ val_refs sd_payload.
Proof.
  unfold sd_payload, sd_body, sd_fun.
  simpl. set_solver.
Qed.

Lemma sd_payload_lockref_self : 1 ∈ val_lock_refs sd_payload.
Proof.
  unfold sd_payload, sd_body, sd_fun.
  simpl. set_solver.
Qed.
====
From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.
From stdpp Require Import gmap decidable.
From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String Arith Lia.
Require Import SelfDepositCex.
Require Import AllCombine.
Open Scope string_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Lock-content self-reference: local preservation.                   *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* [SelfDepositCex] shows that typing, kind liveness and holder        *)
(* uniqueness do not exclude a Release whose payload mentions the      *)
(* destination lock.  This file isolates the exact remaining proof     *)
(* obligation: [release_payload_safe].  For every local step except    *)
(* Release and NewLock, lock contents are unchanged (only refcounts    *)
(* change); NewLock is safe because the destination is fresh and       *)
(* [refs_live] is assumed; only Release needs a payload condition.     *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition release_payload_safe (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i k n v,
    ρ !! i = Some (Thread (k (Release (Val (LockV n)) (Val v)))) ->
    n ∉ val_refs v.

(* ---------- lookup helpers for the explicit one/two/three-object cfgs ---------- *)

Lemma lookup_single_thread i (k : expr -> expr) e :
  ({[ i := Thread (k e) ]} : cfg) !! i = Some (Thread (k e)).
Proof. apply lookup_singleton_eq. Qed.

Lemma lookup_thread_lock_i i n (k : expr -> expr) e rc o (Hin : i <> n) :
  ({[ i := Thread (k e) ; n := Lock rc o ]} : cfg) !! i = Some (Thread (k e)).
Proof.
  change ((<[i:=Thread(k e)]> (<[n:=Lock rc o]> (∅:cfg))) !! i = Some(Thread(k e))).
  apply lookup_insert_eq.
Qed.

Lemma lookup_thread_lock_n i n (k : expr -> expr) e rc o (Hin : i <> n) :
  ({[ i := Thread (k e) ; n := Lock rc o ]} : cfg) !! n = Some (Lock rc o).
Proof.
  change ((<[i:=Thread(k e)]> (<[n:=Lock rc o]> (∅:cfg))) !! n = Some(Lock rc o)).
  rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[n:=Lock rc o]> (∅:cfg)) i n (Thread(k e)) Hin).
  apply lookup_insert_eq.
Qed.

Lemma lookup_three_n i j n (k : expr -> expr) e (k2 : expr -> expr) e2 rc o
    (Hin : i <> n) (Hjn : j <> n) :
  ({[ i := Thread (k e) ; j := Thread (k2 e2) ; n := Lock rc o ]}:cfg) !! n
    = Some(Lock rc o).
Proof.
  change ((<[i:=Thread(k e)]> (<[j:=Thread(k2 e2)]> (<[n:=Lock rc o]> (∅:cfg)))) !! n
          = Some(Lock rc o)).
  rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[j:=Thread(k2 e2)]> (<[n:=Lock rc o]> (∅:cfg)))
             i n (Thread(k e)) Hin).
  rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (<[n:=Lock rc o]> (∅:cfg)) j n (Thread(k2 e2)) Hjn).
  apply lookup_insert_eq.
Qed.

Ltac solve_no_lock_other H E :=
  first
    [ apply lookup_singleton_Some in H;
      let Eeq := fresh "Eeq" in let V := fresh "V" in
      destruct H as [Eeq V];
      first [ discriminate V
            | exfalso; apply E; symmetry; exact Eeq ]
    | apply lookup_insert_Some in H;
      let Eeq := fresh "Eeq" in let V := fresh "V" in
      destruct H as [[Eeq V]|[Eeq H]];
      [discriminate V | solve_no_lock_other H E]
    | simpl in H; discriminate H ].

Ltac solve_no_lock H :=
  first
    [ apply lookup_singleton_Some in H;
      let E := fresh "E" in let V := fresh "V" in
      destruct H as [E V]; discriminate V
    | apply lookup_insert_Some in H;
      let E := fresh "E" in let V := fresh "V" in
      destruct H as [[E V]|[E H]];
      [discriminate V | solve_no_lock H]

From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.

From Stdlib Require Import Classical_Prop Wellfounded Wf_nat Lia.
From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String Eqdep_dec.
From Stdlib Require Import Relation_Operators Arith.
From stdpp Require Import finite.
Open Scope string_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Runtime typing for configurations.                                 *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* Source terms are Val-free, so [typed] cannot type configurations   *)
(* produced by reduction.  [wt] extends it with runtime values [cv].  *)
(* Values are environment-independent (they are closed).               *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Inductive wt (L : gmap nat type) : env -> expr -> type -> Prop :=
  | VarW Γ x t :
      env_var Γ x t ->
      wt L Γ (Var x) t
  | FunW Γ Γ' x e t1 t2 l :
      env_bind Γ' x t1 Γ ->
      (l = Unr -> env_unr Γ) ->
      wt L Γ' e t2 ->
      wt L Γ (Fun x e) (FunT l t1 t2)
  | AppW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 l :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (FunT l t1 t2) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 t1 ->
      wt L Γ (App e1 e2) t2
  | UnitW Γ :
      env_unr Γ ->

From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.

From Stdlib Require Import Classical_Prop Wellfounded Wf_nat Lia.
From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String Eqdep_dec.
From Stdlib Require Import Relation_Operators Arith.
From stdpp Require Import finite.
Open Scope string_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Runtime typing for configurations.                                 *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* Source terms are Val-free, so [typed] cannot type configurations   *)
(* produced by reduction.  [wt] extends it with runtime values [cv].  *)
(* Values are environment-independent (they are closed).               *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Inductive wt (L : gmap nat type) : env -> expr -> type -> Prop :=
  | VarW Γ x t :
      env_var Γ x t ->
      wt L Γ (Var x) t
  | FunW Γ Γ' x e t1 t2 l :
      env_bind Γ' x t1 Γ ->
      (l = Unr -> env_unr Γ) ->
      wt L Γ' e t2 ->
      wt L Γ (Fun x e) (FunT l t1 t2)
  | AppW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 l :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (FunT l t1 t2) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 t1 ->
      wt L Γ (App e1 e2) t2
  | UnitW Γ :
      env_unr Γ ->
      wt L Γ Unit UnitT
  | PairW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 t1 ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 t2 ->
      wt L Γ (Pair e1 e2) (PairT t1 t2)
  | LetPairW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 t :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (PairT t1 t2) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 (FunT Lin t1 (FunT Lin t2 t)) ->
      wt L Γ (LetPair e1 e2) t
  | SumW Γ n (ts : fin n -> type) i e :
      wt L Γ e (ts i) ->
      wt L Γ (Sum i e) (SumT n ts)
  | MatchSumW n Γ Γ1 Γ2 t (ts : fin n -> type) es e :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      (n = 0 -> env_unr Γ2) ->
      wt L Γ1 e (SumT n ts) ->
      (forall i, wt L Γ2 (es i) (FunT Lin (ts i) t)) ->
      wt L Γ (MatchSum n e es) t
  | ForkW Γ e t1 t2 :
      wt L Γ e (FunT Lin (FunT Lin t2 t1) UnitT) ->
      wt L Γ (ForkBarrier e) (FunT Lin t1 t2)
  | NewLockW Γ e t :
      wt L Γ e t ->
      wt L Γ (NewLock e) (LockT (Owner,Closed) t)
  | ForkLockW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t l1 l2 l3 :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      lockcap_split l1 l2 l3 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (LockT l1 t) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 (FunT Lin (LockT l2 t) UnitT) ->
      wt L Γ (ForkLock e1 e2) (LockT l3 t)
  | AcquireW Γ e t lo :
      wt L Γ e (LockT (lo,Closed) t) ->
      wt L Γ (Acquire e) (PairT (LockT (lo,Opened) t) t)
  | ReleaseW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t lo :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (LockT (lo,Opened) t) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 t ->
      wt L Γ (Release e1 e2) (LockT (lo,Closed) t)
  | WaitW Γ e t :
      wt L Γ e (LockT (Owner,Closed) t) ->
      wt L Γ (Wait e) t
  | DropW Γ e t :
      wt L Γ e (LockT (Client,Closed) t) ->
      wt L Γ (Drop e) UnitT
  | ValW Γ v t :
      env_unr Γ ->
      cv L v t ->
      wt L Γ (Val v) t
with cv (L : gmap nat type) : val -> type -> Prop :=
  | FunVW x e t1 t2 l :
      wt L (<[ x := t1 ]> (∅ : env)) e t2 ->
      cv L (FunV x e) (FunT l t1 t2)
  | UnitVW : cv L UnitV UnitT
  | PairVW v1 v2 t1 t2 :
      cv L v1 t1 -> cv L v2 t2 ->
      cv L (PairV v1 v2) (PairT t1 t2)
  | SumVW n (ts : fin n -> type) i v :
      cv L v (ts i) ->
      cv L (SumV i v) (SumT n ts)
  | BarrierVW n t1 t2 :
      cv L (BarrierV n) (FunT Lin t1 t2)
  | LockVW n lc t :
      L !! n = Some t ->
      cv L (LockV n) (LockT lc t).

Lemma env_lookup_insert_same x (t : type) : (<[x:=t]>(∅ : env)) !! x = Some t.

Lemma env_lookup_insert_none x y (t : type) (Γ : env) : x <> y -> Γ !! y = None -> (<[x:=t]>Γ) !! y = None.
Proof.

Lemma env_unr_delete x (Γ : env) : env_unr Γ -> env_unr (delete x Γ).
Proof.

Lemma env_unr_insert_lookup x (t : type) (Γ : env) :

Lemma env_union_empty_l (m : env) : ∅ ∪ m = m.

Proof.

  unfold env in *. intros Hx. apply map_eq. intro y. destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.

  - rewrite (lookup_delete_ne (<[x:=t]>Γ) x y E). rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x y t E). done.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Refined value typing [cvS] and runtime typing [wtS].                *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* The only change with respect to [cv] is the function-value rule:   *)
(* at an unrestricted function type, the body must be reference-free. *)
(* [wtS] is the corresponding runtime typing, using [cvS] for values. *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Inductive cvS (L : gmap nat type) : val -> type -> Prop :=
  | FunVS x e t1 t2 l :
      wt L (<[x := t1]> (∅ : env)) e t2 ->
      (l = Unr -> expr_refs e = ∅) ->
      cvS L (FunV x e) (FunT l t1 t2)
  | UnitVS : cvS L UnitV UnitT
  | PairVS v1 v2 t1 t2 :
      cvS L v1 t1 -> cvS L v2 t2 ->
      cvS L (PairV v1 v2) (PairT t1 t2)
  | SumVS n (ts : fin n -> type) i v :
      cvS L v (ts i) ->
      cvS L (SumV i v) (SumT n ts)
  | BarrierVS n t1 t2 :
      cvS L (BarrierV n) (FunT Lin t1 t2)
  | LockVS n lc t :
      L !! n = Some t ->
      cvS L (LockV n) (LockT lc t).

Inductive wtS (L : gmap nat type) : env -> expr -> type -> Prop :=
  | VarS Γ x t :
      env_var Γ x t ->
      wtS L Γ (Var x) t
  | FunS Γ Γ' x e t1 t2 l :
      env_bind Γ' x t1 Γ ->
      (l = Unr -> env_unr Γ) ->
      wtS L Γ' e t2 ->
      wtS L Γ (Fun x e) (FunT l t1 t2)
  | AppS Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 l :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wtS L Γ1 e1 (FunT l t1 t2) ->
      wtS L Γ2 e2 t1 ->
      wtS L Γ (App e1 e2) t2
  | UnitS Γ :
      env_unr Γ ->
      wtS L Γ Unit UnitT
  | PairS Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wtS L Γ1 e1 t1 ->
      wtS L Γ2 e2 t2 ->
      wtS L Γ (Pair e1 e2) (PairT t1 t2)
  | LetPairS Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 t :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wtS L Γ1 e1 (PairT t1 t2) ->
      wtS L Γ2 e2 (FunT Lin t1 (FunT Lin t2 t)) ->
      wtS L Γ (LetPair e1 e2) t
  | SumS Γ n (ts : fin n -> type) i e :
      wtS L Γ e (ts i) ->
      wtS L Γ (Sum i e) (SumT n ts)
  | MatchSumS n Γ Γ1 Γ2 t (ts : fin n -> type) es e :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      (n = 0 -> env_unr Γ2) ->
      wtS L Γ1 e (SumT n ts) ->
      (forall i, wtS L Γ2 (es i) (FunT Lin (ts i) t)) ->
      wtS L Γ (MatchSum n e es) t
  | ForkS Γ e t1 t2 :
      wtS L Γ e (FunT Lin (FunT Lin t2 t1) UnitT) ->
      wtS L Γ (ForkBarrier e) (FunT Lin t1 t2)
  | NewLockS Γ e t :
      wtS L Γ e t ->
      wtS L Γ (NewLock e) (LockT (Owner,Closed) t)
  | ForkLockS Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t l1 l2 l3 :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      lockcap_split l1 l2 l3 ->
      wtS L Γ1 e1 (LockT l1 t) ->
      wtS L Γ2 e2 (FunT Lin (LockT l2 t) UnitT) ->
      wtS L Γ (ForkLock e1 e2) (LockT l3 t)
  | AcquireS Γ e t lo :
      wtS L Γ e (LockT (lo,Closed) t) ->
      wtS L Γ (Acquire e) (PairT (LockT (lo,Opened) t) t)
  | ReleaseS Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t lo :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wtS L Γ1 e1 (LockT (lo,Opened) t) ->
      wtS L Γ2 e2 t ->
      wtS L Γ (Release e1 e2) (LockT (lo,Closed) t)
  | WaitS Γ e t :
      wtS L Γ e (LockT (Owner,Closed) t) ->
      wtS L Γ (Wait e) t
  | DropS Γ e t :
      wtS L Γ e (LockT (Client,Closed) t) ->
      wtS L Γ (Drop e) UnitT
  | ValS Γ v t :
      env_unr Γ ->
      cvS L v t ->
      wtS L Γ (Val v) t.

(* Interface combining the per-thread lemma with the missing object-level
   accounting.  [threads_typed] is the runtime-typing invariant on live
   threads; [obj_progress] is exactly the accounting obligation for live
   objects (locks and barriers) that are not threads.  Note that
   [progress_or_wait] cannot be derived from [thread_progress] alone: a live
   [Barrier] or [Lock] is not a thread, so the per-thread lemma says nothing
   about it, and [can_step] at such an index is only available when a matching
   operation is currently observable in some thread/object. *)

Definition progress_or_wait_obj (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i, ρ !! i <> None -> can_step ρ i \/ exists j, waiting ρ i j.

Definition threads_typed (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i e, ρ !! i = Some (Thread e) -> wt L ∅ e UnitT.

Definition obj_progress (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i y, ρ !! i = Some y -> (forall e, y <> Thread e) ->
    can_step ρ i \/ exists j, waiting ρ i j.

Lemma progress_or_wait_of_typed_obj ρ
    (Hty : threads_typed ρ) (Hobj : obj_progress ρ) :
  progress_or_wait_obj ρ.
Proof.
  intros i Hi.
  destruct (ρ !! i) as [y|] eqn:E.
  - destruct y as [e | | rc o].
    + exact (thread_progress ρ i e E (Hty i e E)).
    + apply Hobj with (y := Barrier); [exact E | discriminate].
    + apply Hobj with (y := Lock rc o); [exact E | discriminate].
  - exfalso. exact (Hi eq_refl).
Qed.

Print Assumptions progress_or_wait_of_typed_obj.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Object-level capability inventory.                                 *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* The inventory is deliberately abstract in the maps [caps] and      *)
(* [bend]: a future annotated runtime typing (or a reachability      *)
(* invariant) is expected to provide, for every live configuration,   *)
(* the set of holders of each lock capability state and the set of    *)
(* holders of each barrier endpoint.  The fields below are the        *)
(* accounting facts; the only semantic-looking field is              *)
(* [cap_wait_step], which records that a holder of a capability that  *)
(* is itself blocked on the same lock would exhibit a local step at   *)
(* the lock index.  This is the state/ownership typing fact needed to *)
(* replace per-thread syntax, and it is exactly what avoids the       *)
(* MatchSum branch-duplication problem: capability occurrences are    *)
(* holders in live objects, not raw syntactic occurrences.            *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition cap_inventory
    (ρ : cfg)
    (caps : nat -> lockcap -> gset nat)   (* lock n, capability state lc *)
    (bend : nat -> gset nat)              (* barrier n, endpoint holders *)
    : Prop :=
  (* every capability occurrence is in a live object which references n *)
  (forall n lc j, j ∈ caps n lc -> ρ !! j <> None) /\
  (forall n lc j, j ∈ caps n lc ->
     exists y, ρ !! j = Some y /\ n ∈ obj_refs y) /\
  (* a blocked holder of a capability for n exposes a step at n *)
  (forall n lc j e,
     j ∈ caps n lc -> ρ !! j = Some (Thread e) -> expr_waiting e n ->
     can_step ρ n) /\
  (* exactly one Opened capability when the lock content is absent *)
  (forall n rc, ρ !! n = Some (Lock rc None) ->
     exists j, caps n (Owner,Opened) ∪ caps n (Client,Opened) = {[j]}) /\
  (* no Opened capability when the lock has content *)
  (forall n rc v, ρ !! n = Some (Lock rc (Some v)) ->
     caps n (Owner,Opened) ∪ caps n (Client,Opened) = ∅) /\
  (* a lock with content has a capability holder (an owner/referencer) *)
  (forall n rc v, ρ !! n = Some (Lock rc (Some v)) ->
     exists lc j, j ∈ caps n lc) /\
  (* [refcnt] counts Client capabilities *)
  (forall n rc o, ρ !! n = Some (Lock rc o) ->
     (0 < rc <-> exists j, j ∈ caps n (Client,Closed) ∪ caps n (Client,Opened))) /\
  (* a live barrier has exactly two endpoint holders *)
  (forall n, ρ !! n = Some Barrier ->
     exists a b, a <> b /\ bend n = {[a;b]}) /\
  (* endpoints live and reference the barrier *)
  (forall n j, j ∈ bend n -> ρ !! j <> None) /\
  (forall n j, j ∈ bend n ->
     exists y, ρ !! j = Some y /\ n ∈ obj_refs y) /\
  (* at most one endpoint can be a thread blocked on the barrier; two
     blocked endpoints would be a synchronisation redex *)
  (forall n j k e e',
     j ∈ bend n -> k ∈ bend n ->
     ρ !! j = Some (Thread e) -> expr_waiting e n ->
     ρ !! k = Some (Thread e') -> expr_waiting e' n -> j = k).

From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Export langdef.

Fixpoint expr_refs e :=
  match e with
  | Val v => val_refs v
  | Var x => ∅
  | Fun x e => expr_refs e
  | App e1 e2 => expr_refs e1 ∪ expr_refs e2
  | Unit => ∅
  | Pair e1 e2 => expr_refs e1 ∪ expr_refs e2
  | LetPair e1 e2 => expr_refs e1 ∪ expr_refs e2
  | Sum i e => expr_refs e
  | MatchSum n e es => expr_refs e ∪ fin_union n (expr_refs ∘ es)
  | ForkBarrier e => expr_refs e
  | NewLock e => expr_refs e
  | ForkLock e1 e2 => expr_refs e1 ∪ expr_refs e2
  | Acquire e => expr_refs e
  | Release e1 e2 => expr_refs e1 ∪ expr_refs e2
  | Wait e => expr_refs e
  | Drop e => expr_refs e
  end
with val_refs v :=
  match v with
  | FunV x e => expr_refs e
  | UnitV => ∅
  | PairV v1 v2 => val_refs v1 ∪ val_refs v2
  | SumV i v => val_refs v
  | BarrierV i => {[ i ]}
  | LockV i => {[ i ]}
  end.

Definition obj_refs x :=
  match x with
  | Thread e => expr_refs e
  | Barrier => ∅
  | Lock refcnt o =>
      match o with
      | Some v => val_refs v
      | None => ∅
      end
  end.

Inductive expr_head_waiting : expr -> nat -> Prop :=
  | Barrier_waiting j v :
    expr_head_waiting (App (Val $ BarrierV j) (Val v)) j
  | ForkLock_waiting j v :
    expr_head_waiting (ForkLock (Val $ LockV j) (Val v)) j
  | Acquire_waiting j :
    expr_head_waiting (Acquire (Val $ LockV j)) j
  | Release_waiting j v :
    expr_head_waiting (Release (Val $ LockV j) (Val v)) j
  | Wait_waiting j :
    expr_head_waiting (Wait (Val $ LockV j)) j
  | Drop_waiting j :
    expr_head_waiting (Drop (Val $ LockV j)) j.

Definition expr_waiting e j :=
  ∃ k e', ctx k ∧ e = k e' ∧ expr_head_waiting e' j.

Definition waiting (ρ : cfg) (i j : nat) :=
  (∃ e, ρ !! i = Some (Thread e) ∧ expr_waiting e j) ∨
  (∃ y, ρ !! j = Some y ∧ i ∈ obj_refs y ∧ ∀ e, y = Thread e -> ¬ expr_waiting e i).

Definition can_step (ρ : cfg) (i : nat) := ∃ ρ', step i ρ ρ'.

Definition inactive (ρ : cfg) (i : nat) := ρ !! i = None.

Inductive reachable (ρ : cfg) : nat -> Prop :=
  | Can_step_reachable i :
      can_step ρ i -> reachable ρ i
  | Waiting_reachable i j :
      waiting ρ i j -> reachable ρ j -> reachable ρ i.

Definition fully_reachable (ρ : cfg) :=
  ∀ i, inactive ρ i ∨ reachable ρ i.

From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String.
From stdpp Require Import gmap.

From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Export langtools.

Inductive expr :=
  | Val : val -> expr
  | Var : string -> expr
  | Fun : string -> expr -> expr
  | App : expr -> expr -> expr
  | Unit : expr
  | Pair : expr -> expr -> expr
  | LetPair : expr -> expr -> expr
  | Sum : nat -> expr -> expr
  | MatchSum n : expr -> (fin n -> expr) -> expr

  | ForkBarrier : expr -> expr

  | NewLock : expr -> expr
  | ForkLock : expr -> expr -> expr
  | Acquire : expr -> expr
  | Release : expr -> expr -> expr
  | Wait : expr -> expr
  | Drop : expr -> expr
with val :=
  | FunV : string -> expr -> val
  | UnitV : val
  | PairV : val -> val -> val
  | SumV : nat -> val -> val
  | BarrierV : nat -> val
  | LockV : nat -> val.

Inductive linearity := Lin | Unr.

Inductive lockstate := Opened | Closed.

Inductive lockownership := Owner | Client.

Definition lockcap : Type := lockownership * lockstate.

Inductive lockownership_split : lockownership -> lockownership -> lockownership -> Prop :=
  | lo_split_1 : lockownership_split Owner Client Owner
  | lo_split_2 : lockownership_split Owner Owner Client
  | lo_split_3 : lockownership_split Client Client Client.

Inductive lockstate_split : lockstate -> lockstate -> lockstate -> Prop :=
  | ls_split_1 : lockstate_split Opened Closed Opened
  | ls_split_2 : lockstate_split Opened Opened Closed
  | ls_split_3 : lockstate_split Closed Closed Closed.

Definition lockcap_split l1 l2 l3 :=
  lockownership_split l1.1 l2.1 l3.1 ∧ lockstate_split l1.2 l2.2 l3.2.

CoInductive type :=
  | FunT : linearity -> type -> type -> type
  | UnitT : type
  | PairT : type -> type -> type
  | SumT n : (fin n -> type) -> type
  | LockT : lockcap -> type -> type.

CoInductive unr : type -> Prop :=
  | Fun_unr t1 t2 : unr (FunT Unr t1 t2)
  | Unit_unr : unr UnitT
  | Pair_unr t1 t2 : unr t1 -> unr t2 -> unr (PairT t1 t2)
  | Sum_unr n ts : (∀ i, unr (ts i)) -> unr (SumT n ts).

Definition env := gmap string type.

Definition env_unr (Γ : env) :=
  ∀ x t, Γ !! x = Some t -> unr t.

Definition disj (Γ1 Γ2 : env) :=
  ∀ i t1 t2, Γ1 !! i = Some t1 -> Γ2 !! i = Some t2 -> t1 = t2 ∧ unr t1.

Definition env_split (Γ : env) (Γ1 : env) (Γ2 : env) :=
  Γ = Γ1 ∪ Γ2 ∧ disj Γ1 Γ2.

Definition env_bind (Γ' : env) (x : string) (t : type) (Γ : env) :=
  Γ' = <[ x := t ]> Γ ∧ ∀ t', Γ !! x = Some t' -> unr t'.

Definition env_var (Γ : env) (x : string) (t : type) :=
  ∃ Γ', Γ = <[ x := t ]> Γ' ∧ env_unr Γ'.

Inductive typed : env -> expr -> type -> Prop :=

  | Var_typed Γ x t :
    env_var Γ x t ->
    typed Γ (Var x) t
  | Fun_typed Γ Γ' x e t1 t2 l :
    env_bind Γ' x t1 Γ ->
    (l = Unr -> env_unr Γ) ->
    typed Γ' e t2 ->
    typed Γ (Fun x e) (FunT l t1 t2)
  | App_typed Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 l :
    env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
    typed Γ1 e1 (FunT l t1 t2) ->
    typed Γ2 e2 t1 ->
    typed Γ (App e1 e2) t2
  | Unit_typed Γ :
    env_unr Γ ->
    typed Γ Unit UnitT
  | Pair_typed Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 :
    env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
    typed Γ1 e1 t1 ->
    typed Γ2 e2 t2 ->
    typed Γ (Pair e1 e2) (PairT t1 t2)
  | LetPair_typed Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 t :
    env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
    typed Γ1 e1 (PairT t1 t2) ->
    typed Γ2 e2 (FunT Lin t1 (FunT Lin t2 t)) ->
    typed Γ (LetPair e1 e2) t
  | Sum_typed Γ n (ts : fin n -> type) i e :
    typed Γ e (ts i) ->
    typed Γ (Sum i e) (SumT n ts)
  | MatchSumN_typed n Γ Γ1 Γ2 t (ts : fin n -> type) es e :
    env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
    (n = 0 -> env_unr Γ2) ->
    typed Γ1 e (SumT n ts) ->
    (∀ i, typed Γ2 (es i) (FunT Lin (ts i) t)) ->
    typed Γ (MatchSum n e es) t

  | Fork_typed Γ e t1 t2 :
    typed Γ e (FunT Lin (FunT Lin t2 t1) UnitT) ->
    typed Γ (ForkBarrier e) (FunT Lin t1 t2)

  | NewLock_typed Γ e t :
    typed Γ e t ->
    typed Γ (NewLock e) (LockT (Owner,Closed) t)
  | ForkLock_typed Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t l1 l2 l3 :
    env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
    lockcap_split l1 l2 l3 ->
    typed Γ1 e1 (LockT l1 t) ->
    typed Γ2 e2 (FunT Lin (LockT l2 t) UnitT) ->
    typed Γ (ForkLock e1 e2) (LockT l3 t)
  | Acquire_typed Γ e t lo :
    typed Γ e (LockT (lo,Closed) t) ->
    typed Γ (Acquire e) (PairT (LockT (lo,Opened) t) t)
  | Release_typed Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t lo :
    env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
    typed Γ1 e1 (LockT (lo,Opened) t) ->
    typed Γ2 e2 t ->
    typed Γ (Release e1 e2) (LockT (lo,Closed) t)
  | Wait_typed Γ e t :
    typed Γ e (LockT (Owner,Closed) t) ->
    typed Γ (Wait e) t
  | Drop_typed Γ e t :
    typed Γ e (LockT (Client,Closed) t) ->
    typed Γ (Drop e) UnitT.

Definition subst (x:string) (a:val) := fix rec e :=
  match e with
  | Val _ => e
  | Var x' => if decide (x = x') then Val a else e
  | Fun x' e => Fun x' (if decide (x = x') then e else rec e)
  | App e1 e2 => App (rec e1) (rec e2)
  | Unit => Unit
  | Pair e1 e2 => Pair (rec e1) (rec e2)
  | LetPair e1 e2 => LetPair (rec e1) (rec e2)
  | Sum n e => Sum n (rec e)
  | MatchSum n e1 e2 => MatchSum n (rec e1) (rec ∘ e2)
  | ForkBarrier e => ForkBarrier (rec e)
  | NewLock e => NewLock (rec e)
  | ForkLock e1 e2 => ForkLock (rec e1) (rec e2)
  | Acquire e => Acquire (rec e)
  | Release e1 e2 => Release (rec e1) (rec e2)
  | Wait e => Wait (rec e)
  | Drop e => Drop (rec e)
  end.

Inductive pure_step : expr -> expr -> Prop :=
  | Fun_step x e :
    pure_step (Fun x e) (Val $ FunV x e)
  | App_step x e a :
    pure_step (App (Val $ FunV x e) (Val a)) (subst x a e)
  | Unit_step :
    pure_step Unit (Val $ UnitV)
  | Pair_step v1 v2 :
    pure_step (Pair (Val v1) (Val v2)) (Val $ PairV v1 v2)
  | LetPair_step v1 v2 e:
    pure_step (LetPair (Val $ PairV v1 v2) e) (App (App e (Val v1)) (Val v2))

From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.
From stdpp Require Import gmap.
From Stdlib Require Import List Arith Lia.
From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String.
Require Import AllCombine.
Require Import CapCex.
Open Scope string_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Sync breaks permissive thread typing.                              *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* Both endpoints are [wt]-typed at UnitT, but with unrelated argument *)
(* types: one sends [UnitV], the other a pair.  [BarrierVW] places no  *)
(* constraint relating the two endpoint types, so Sync exchanges the  *)
(* values and thread 0 becomes [Val (PairV UnitV UnitV)] at UnitT,     *)
(* which is not [wt].                                                 *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* Consequently thread-typing preservation needs a barrier store      *)
(* typing recording the two endpoint types (or an annotated runtime   *)
(* typing), not just lock-store typing plus [wt].                     *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition sg_e0 : expr := App (Val (BarrierV 7)) (Val UnitV).
Definition sg_e1 : expr :=
  App (Val (BarrierV 7)) (Val (PairV UnitV UnitV)).

Definition sg_src : cfg :=
  {[0 := Thread sg_e0; 1 := Thread sg_e1; 7 := Barrier]}.
Definition sg_tgt : cfg :=
  {[0 := Thread (Val (PairV UnitV UnitV)); 1 := Thread (Val UnitV)]}.

Lemma sg_src_lookup0 : sg_src !! 0 = Some (Thread sg_e0).
Proof. unfold sg_src. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma sg_src_lookup1 : sg_src !! 1 = Some (Thread sg_e1).
Proof. unfold sg_src. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma sg_src_lookup7 : sg_src !! 7 = Some Barrier.
Proof. unfold sg_src. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma sg_src_lookup_other i (H0 : i <> 0) (H1 : i <> 1) (H7 : i <> 7) :
  sg_src !! i = None.
Proof.
  unfold sg_src.
  change ((<[0 := Thread sg_e0]>
            (<[1 := Thread sg_e1]>
             (<[7 := Barrier]> (∅ : cfg)))) !! i = None).
  assert (H01 : (<[0 := Thread sg_e0]>
                  (<[1 := Thread sg_e1]>
                   (<[7 := Barrier]> (∅ : cfg)))) !! i
                = (<[1 := Thread sg_e1]>
                    (<[7 := Barrier]> (∅ : cfg))) !! i).
  { apply lookup_insert_ne. congruence. }
  assert (H12 : (<[1 := Thread sg_e1]>
                  (<[7 := Barrier]> (∅ : cfg))) !! i
                = (<[7 := Barrier]> (∅ : cfg)) !! i).
  { apply lookup_insert_ne. congruence. }
  assert (H27 : (<[7 := Barrier]> (∅ : cfg)) !! i = (∅ : cfg) !! i).
  { apply lookup_insert_ne. congruence. }
  rewrite H01, H12, H27. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma sg_src_threads_typed :
  threads_typed (∅ : gmap nat type) sg_src.
Proof.
  intros i e Hi.
  destruct (decide (i = 0)) as [E|E].
  - subst i. rewrite sg_src_lookup0 in Hi. inversion Hi; subst e.
    unfold sg_e0.
    eapply AppW with (Γ1 := ∅) (Γ2 := ∅) (l := Lin)
                     (t1 := UnitT) (t2 := UnitT).
    + apply env_split_nil.
    + apply ValW; [apply env_unr_empty | apply BarrierVW].
    + apply ValW; [apply env_unr_empty | apply UnitVW].
  - destruct (decide (i = 1)) as [E1|E1].
    + subst i. rewrite sg_src_lookup1 in Hi. inversion Hi; subst e.
      unfold sg_e1.
      eapply AppW with (Γ1 := ∅) (Γ2 := ∅) (l := Lin)
                       (t1 := PairT UnitT UnitT) (t2 := UnitT).
      * apply env_split_nil.
      * apply ValW; [apply env_unr_empty | apply BarrierVW].
      * apply ValW.
        -- apply env_unr_empty.
        -- eapply PairVW; apply UnitVW.
    + destruct (decide (i = 7)) as [E7|E7].
      * subst i. rewrite sg_src_lookup7 in Hi. discriminate.
      * rewrite sg_src_lookup_other in Hi;
          [discriminate | exact E | exact E1 | exact E7].
Qed.

Lemma sg_tgt_lookup0 :
  sg_tgt !! 0 = Some (Thread (Val (PairV UnitV UnitV))).
Proof. unfold sg_tgt. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma sg_pair_not_unit :
  ~ wt (∅ : gmap nat type) ∅ (Val (PairV UnitV UnitV)) UnitT.
Proof.
  intros Hwt.
  destruct (wt_val_view (∅ : gmap nat type) ∅ _ _ Hwt) as [_ Hcv].
  pose proof (cv_unit_inv (∅ : gmap nat type) _ Hcv) as E.
  discriminate E.
Qed.

Lemma sg_tgt_not_threads_typed :
  ~ threads_typed (∅ : gmap nat type) sg_tgt.
Proof.
  intros Hty.
  exact (sg_pair_not_unit (Hty 0 (Val (PairV UnitV UnitV)) sg_tgt_lookup0)).
Qed.

Lemma sg_sync : local_step 7 sg_src sg_tgt.
Proof.
  unfold sg_src, sg_tgt, sg_e0, sg_e1.
  apply (Sync_step 0 1 7 id id UnitV (PairV UnitV UnitV));
    try lia; apply Ctx_id.
Qed.

Lemma sg_union_empty_r (m : cfg) : m ∪ ∅ = m.
Proof.
  apply map_eq. intro x. apply lookup_union_l. apply lookup_empty.
Qed.

Lemma sg_step : step 7 sg_src sg_tgt.
Proof.
  assert (E1 : sg_src = sg_src ∪ ∅) by (symmetry; apply sg_union_empty_r).
  assert (E2 : sg_tgt = sg_tgt ∪ ∅) by (symmetry; apply sg_union_empty_r).
  rewrite E1, E2.
  eapply Frame_step;
    [apply map_disjoint_empty_r | apply map_disjoint_empty_r | exact sg_sync].
Qed.

Theorem threads_typed_not_preserved :
  exists L (i : nat) ρ ρ',
    step i ρ ρ' /\ threads_typed L ρ /\ ~ threads_typed L ρ'.
Proof.
  exists (∅ : gmap nat type), 7, sg_src, sg_tgt.
  split; [exact sg_step|]. split; [exact sg_src_threads_typed|].
  exact sg_tgt_not_threads_typed.
Qed.

Print Assumptions sg_src_threads_typed.
Print Assumptions threads_typed_not_preserved.

From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.
From stdpp Require Import gmap.
From Stdlib Require Import List Arith Lia.
From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String.
Require Import AllCombine.
Open Scope string_scope.

(* A singleton environment is unrestricted whenever its type is. *)
Lemma env_unr_singleton_unr x (t : type) (Ht : unr t) :
  env_unr (<[x := t]> (∅ : env)).
Proof.
  intros y s Hy.
  destruct (decide (y = x)) as [E|E].
  - subst y.
    assert (Hx : (<[x := t]> (∅ : env)) !! x = Some t).
    { unfold env. apply lookup_insert_eq. }
    rewrite Hx in Hy. injection Hy as ->. exact Ht.
  - assert (Hne : (<[x := t]> (∅ : env)) !! y = (∅ : env) !! y).
    { unfold env. apply lookup_insert_ne. congruence. }
    rewrite Hne in Hy.
    assert (Hnone : (∅ : env) !! y = None) by apply lookup_empty.
    rewrite Hnone in Hy. discriminate.
Qed.

(* Auxiliary: a context cannot turn a non-value into a value. *)
Lemma ctx_val_inv k e v (Hk : ctx k) (H : k e = Val v) : e = Val v.
Proof.
  induction Hk as [| k1 k2 H1 H2 IH]; simpl in H.
  - exact H.
  - destruct H1; simpl in H; discriminate.
Qed.

(* A context applied to e' cannot produce an application whose operator
   is a function value unless e' is the function value or the argument. *)
Lemma ctx_app_funv_inv k x b a (Hk : ctx k) :
  forall e', k e' = App (Val (FunV x b)) (Val a) ->
    e' = App (Val (FunV x b)) (Val a) \/
    e' = Val (FunV x b) \/ e' = Val a.
Proof.
  induction Hk as [| k1 k2 H1 H2 IH]; intros e' He.
  - simpl in He. left. exact He.
  - simpl in He. destruct H1; simpl in He; try discriminate.
    + inversion He; subst.
      assert (Hval : k2 e' = Val (FunV x b)) by congruence.
      exact (or_intror (or_introl
        (eq_trans (ctx_val_inv k2 e' (FunV x b) H2 Hval) (eq_sym Hval)))).

(* Framing for [threads_typed].                                        *)

Lemma threads_typed_frame L (a a' ρf : cfg) :
  a ##ₘ ρf -> a' ##ₘ ρf ->
  threads_typed L (a ∪ ρf) ->
  threads_typed L a' ->
  threads_typed L (a' ∪ ρf).
Proof.
  intros Ha Haa Hsrc Hloc j e Hj.
  apply (proj1 (lookup_union_Some a' ρf j (Thread e) Haa)) in Hj.
  destruct Hj as [Hj|Hj].
  - exact (Hloc j e Hj).
  - exact (Hsrc j e (proj2 (lookup_union_Some a ρf j (Thread e) Ha) (or_intror Hj))).
Qed.

(* Extract the typing of the non-framed part.  Disjointness is not
   needed: a [Some] lookup in the left component survives the union. *)
Lemma threads_typed_frame_inv L (a ρf : cfg) :
  threads_typed L (a ∪ ρf) ->
  threads_typed L a.
Proof.
  intros Hty j e Hj.
  exact (Hty j e (lookup_union_Some_l a ρf j (Thread e) Hj)).
Qed.

(* A Release-oriented obstruction to pair/forest preservation.         *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* The destination of Release is a lock, not a live thread, so the     *)
(* [kind_live] "no live object refers to a live thread" argument      *)
(* does not apply.  This file machine-checks that all the other       *)
(* invariants we have (typed threads, cap_inventory, refs_live,        *)
(* ref_pair_ok, ref_forest) do not prevent Release from creating a     *)
(* self-reference at the destination lock.                             *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* The witness deliberately uses [BarrierV 1] to reference lock 1:    *)
(* that is what makes the source NOT kind_live.  A kind-live witness   *)
(* would have to reference lock 1 via [LockV 1], which forces the      *)
(* deposited type [t = L 1] to satisfy [t = LockT _ t].  The current   *)
(* permissive [cv] has no such derivation, so this is precisely the    *)
(* extra lock-content acyclicity fact needed for the Release case.     *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition rx_t : type := FunT Lin UnitT UnitT.
Definition rx_L : gmap nat type := {[1 := rx_t]}.

Lemma rx_L1 : rx_L !! 1 = Some rx_t.
Proof. unfold rx_L. apply lookup_singleton_eq. Qed.

Definition rx_inner : expr := Release (Val (LockV 1)) (Val (BarrierV 1)).
Definition rx_e : expr := Drop rx_inner.

Lemma rx_inner_wt : wt rx_L ∅ rx_inner (LockT (Client,Closed) rx_t).
Proof.
  unfold rx_inner.
  eapply ReleaseW with (Γ1 := ∅) (Γ2 := ∅) (lo := Client).
  - apply env_split_nil.
  - apply ValW.
    + apply env_unr_empty.
    + change (cv rx_L (LockV 1) (LockT (Client,Opened) rx_t)).
      apply LockVW. exact rx_L1.
  - apply ValW.
    + apply env_unr_empty.
    + unfold rx_t. apply BarrierVW.
Qed.

Lemma rx_e_wt : wt rx_L ∅ rx_e UnitT.
Proof.
  unfold rx_e.
  eapply DropW.
  exact rx_inner_wt.
Qed.

Definition rx_src : cfg := {[0 := Thread rx_e; 1 := Lock 0 None]}.
Definition rx_tgt : cfg :=
  {[0 := Thread (Drop (Val (LockV 1)));
    1 := Lock 0 (Some (BarrierV 1))]}.

(* ---------- lookups ---------- *)

Lemma rx_src_lookup0 : rx_src !! 0 = Some (Thread rx_e).
Proof.
  unfold rx_src.
  change ((<[0 := Thread rx_e]> (<[1 := Lock 0 None]> (∅ : cfg))) !! 0
          = Some (Thread rx_e)).
  apply lookup_insert_eq.
Qed.

Lemma rx_src_lookup1 : rx_src !! 1 = Some (Lock 0 None).
Proof.
  unfold rx_src.
  change ((<[0 := Thread rx_e]> (<[1 := Lock 0 None]> (∅ : cfg))) !! 1
          = Some (Lock 0 None)).
  assert (H : (<[0 := Thread rx_e]> (<[1 := Lock 0 None]> (∅ : cfg))) !! 1
              = (<[1 := Lock 0 None]> (∅ : cfg)) !! 1).
  { apply lookup_insert_ne. lia. }
  rewrite H. apply lookup_insert_eq.
Qed.

Lemma rx_src_lookup_other n (H0 : n <> 0) (H1 : n <> 1) :
  rx_src !! n = None.
Proof.
  unfold rx_src.
  change ((<[0 := Thread rx_e]> (<[1 := Lock 0 None]> (∅ : cfg))) !! n = None).
  assert (H01 : (<[0 := Thread rx_e]> (<[1 := Lock 0 None]> (∅ : cfg))) !! n
                = (<[1 := Lock 0 None]> (∅ : cfg)) !! n).
  { apply lookup_insert_ne. congruence. }
  assert (H12 : (<[1 := Lock 0 None]> (∅ : cfg)) !! n = (∅ : cfg) !! n).
  { apply lookup_insert_ne. congruence. }
  rewrite H01, H12. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma rx_tgt_lookup0 :
  rx_tgt !! 0 = Some (Thread (Drop (Val (LockV 1)))).
Proof.
  unfold rx_tgt.
  change ((<[0 := Thread (Drop (Val (LockV 1)))]>
            (<[1 := Lock 0 (Some (BarrierV 1))]> (∅ : cfg))) !! 0
          = Some (Thread (Drop (Val (LockV 1))))).
  apply lookup_insert_eq.
Qed.

Lemma rx_tgt_lookup1 :
  rx_tgt !! 1 = Some (Lock 0 (Some (BarrierV 1))).
Proof.
  unfold rx_tgt.
  change ((<[0 := Thread (Drop (Val (LockV 1)))]>
            (<[1 := Lock 0 (Some (BarrierV 1))]> (∅ : cfg))) !! 1
          = Some (Lock 0 (Some (BarrierV 1)))).
  assert (H : (<[0 := Thread (Drop (Val (LockV 1)))]>
               (<[1 := Lock 0 (Some (BarrierV 1))]> (∅ : cfg))) !! 1
              = (<[1 := Lock 0 (Some (BarrierV 1))]> (∅ : cfg)) !! 1).
  { apply lookup_insert_ne. lia. }
  rewrite H. apply lookup_insert_eq.
Qed.

Lemma rx_tgt_lookup_other n (H0 : n <> 0) (H1 : n <> 1) :
  rx_tgt !! n = None.
Proof.
  unfold rx_tgt.
  change ((<[0 := Thread (Drop (Val (LockV 1)))]>
            (<[1 := Lock 0 (Some (BarrierV 1))]> (∅ : cfg))) !! n = None).
  assert (H01 : (<[0 := Thread (Drop (Val (LockV 1)))]>
                  (<[1 := Lock 0 (Some (BarrierV 1))]> (∅ : cfg))) !! n
                = (<[1 := Lock 0 (Some (BarrierV 1))]> (∅ : cfg)) !! n).
  { apply lookup_insert_ne. congruence. }
  assert (H12 : (<[1 := Lock 0 (Some (BarrierV 1))]> (∅ : cfg)) !! n
                = (∅ : cfg) !! n).
  { apply lookup_insert_ne. congruence. }
  rewrite H01, H12. reflexivity.
Qed.

Require Import AllCombine.
Require Import CtxWt.
From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.
From stdpp Require Import gmap.
From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String.
Open Scope string_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Thread-typing preservation for a framed Pure step.                 *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* The only changed thread is the one under the evaluation context;    *)
(* all other framed threads keep their typing because the singleton    *)
(* map has no key there.  The changed thread is retyped by            *)
(* [wt_ctx_pure_step].                                                 *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Section ThreadTypedPureSec.

Context (L : gmap nat type).

Lemma threads_typed_pure_frame i k e e' (ρf : cfg) :
  ctx k -> pure_step e e' ->
  threads_typed L (({[i := Thread (k e)]} : cfg) ∪ ρf) ->
  threads_typed L (({[i := Thread (k e')]} : cfg) ∪ ρf).
Proof.
  intros Hk Hps Hty j e0 Hj.
  destruct (decide (j = i)) as [E|E].
  - subst j.
    assert (Hsingle_src :
      ({[i := Thread (k e)]} : cfg) !! i = Some (Thread (k e)))
      by apply lookup_singleton_eq.
    assert (Hsingle_tgt :
      ({[i := Thread (k e')]} : cfg) !! i = Some (Thread (k e')))
      by apply lookup_singleton_eq.
    assert (Htgt :
      (({[i := Thread (k e')]} : cfg) ∪ ρf) !! i = Some (Thread (k e')))
      by (apply (lookup_union_Some_l _ _ _ _ Hsingle_tgt)).
    rewrite Htgt in Hj. inversion Hj; subst e0.
    assert (Hsrc :
      (({[i := Thread (k e)]} : cfg) ∪ ρf) !! i = Some (Thread (k e)))
      by (apply (lookup_union_Some_l _ _ _ _ Hsingle_src)).
    exact (wt_ctx_pure_step L k e e' UnitT Hk (Hty i (k e) Hsrc) Hps).
  - assert (Hleft : ({[i := Thread (k e')]} : cfg) !! j = None)
      by (apply lookup_singleton_ne; congruence).
    assert (Hright : ρf !! j = Some (Thread e0)).
    { exact (lookup_union_Some_inv_r
        ({[i := Thread (k e')]} : cfg) ρf j (Thread e0) Hj Hleft). }
    assert (Hleft_src : ({[i := Thread (k e)]} : cfg) !! j = None)
      by (apply lookup_singleton_ne; congruence).
    assert (Hsrc :
      (({[i := Thread (k e)]} : cfg) ∪ ρf) !! j = Some (Thread e0)).
    { rewrite (lookup_union_r _ _ _ Hleft_src). exact Hright. }
    exact (Hty j e0 Hsrc).
Qed.

Print Assumptions threads_typed_pure_frame.

End ThreadTypedPureSec.

Require Import AllCombine.
From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.
From stdpp Require Import gmap.
From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String.
Open Scope string_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Replacing the hole of a closed evaluation context.                 *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* The hole always sits in the empty environment, so the replacement   *)
(* only has to be well typed at the same type as the original hole.    *)
(* This is the context-congruence principle for [wt] used by runtime    *)
(* subject reduction.  It is proved by the constructor views; the      *)
(* [env_split ∅] facts identify the two sub-environments with [∅].     *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Section CtxWtSec.

Context (L : gmap nat type).

Lemma wt_ctx1_replace k E E' t (Hk : ctx1 k) :
  wt L ∅ (k E) t ->
  (forall s, wt L ∅ E s -> wt L ∅ E' s) ->
  wt L ∅ (k E') t.
Proof.
  intros Hwt Hrepl.
  destruct Hk; cbn in Hwt.

  (* App left *)
  - destruct (wt_app_view L ∅ _ _ _ Hwt)
      as (Γ1 & Γ2 & t1 & l & Hsplit & H1 & H2).
    destruct (env_split_empty Γ1 Γ2 Hsplit) as [E1 E2]; subst Γ1 Γ2.
    eapply AppW; [apply env_split_nil | apply (Hrepl _ H1) | exact H2].

  (* App right *)
  - destruct (wt_app_view L ∅ _ _ _ Hwt)
      as (Γ1 & Γ2 & t1 & l & Hsplit & H1 & H2).
    destruct (env_split_empty Γ1 Γ2 Hsplit) as [E1 E2]; subst Γ1 Γ2.
    eapply AppW; [apply env_split_nil | exact H1 | apply (Hrepl _ H2)].

  (* Pair left *)
  - destruct (wt_pair_view L ∅ _ _ _ Hwt)
      as (Γ1 & Γ2 & t1 & t2 & Ht & Hsplit & H1 & H2).
    destruct (env_split_empty Γ1 Γ2 Hsplit) as [E1 E2]; subst Γ1 Γ2.
    subst t. eapply PairW; [apply env_split_nil | apply (Hrepl _ H1) | exact H2].

  (* Pair right *)
  - destruct (wt_pair_view L ∅ _ _ _ Hwt)
      as (Γ1 & Γ2 & t1 & t2 & Ht & Hsplit & H1 & H2).
    destruct (env_split_empty Γ1 Γ2 Hsplit) as [E1 E2]; subst Γ1 Γ2.
    subst t. eapply PairW; [apply env_split_nil | exact H1 | apply (Hrepl _ H2)].

  (* LetPair *)
  - destruct (wt_letpair_view L ∅ _ _ _ Hwt)
      as (Γ1 & Γ2 & t1 & t2 & Hsplit & H1 & H2).
    destruct (env_split_empty Γ1 Γ2 Hsplit) as [E1 E2]; subst Γ1 Γ2.
    eapply LetPairW; [apply env_split_nil | apply (Hrepl _ H1) | exact H2].

  (* Sum *)
  - destruct (wt_sum_view L ∅ _ _ _ Hwt)
      as (n' & ts & j & Ht & Hn & H1).
    subst t. subst i.
    eapply SumW with (i := j). apply (Hrepl _ H1).

  (* MatchSum *)
  - destruct (wt_matchsum_view L ∅ _ _ _ _ Hwt)
      as (Γ1 & Γ2 & ts & Hsplit & Hn0 & H1 & Hf).
    destruct (env_split_empty Γ1 Γ2 Hsplit) as [E1 E2]; subst Γ1 Γ2.
    eapply MatchSumW with (Γ1 := ∅) (Γ2 := ∅) (ts := ts).
    + apply env_split_nil.
    + exact Hn0.
    + apply (Hrepl _ H1).
    + exact Hf.

  (* ForkBarrier *)
  - destruct (wt_fork_view L ∅ _ _ Hwt) as (t1 & t2 & Ht & H1).
    subst t. eapply ForkW. apply (Hrepl _ H1).

  (* NewLock *)
  - destruct (wt_newlock_view L ∅ _ _ Hwt) as (t0 & Ht & H1).
    subst t. eapply NewLockW. apply (Hrepl _ H1).

  (* ForkLock left *)
  - destruct (wt_forklock_view L ∅ _ _ _ Hwt)
      as (Γ1 & Γ2 & t0 & l1 & l2 & l3 & Ht & Hsplit & Hcap & H1 & H2).
    destruct (env_split_empty Γ1 Γ2 Hsplit) as [E1 E2]; subst Γ1 Γ2.
    subst t. eapply ForkLockW with (Γ1 := ∅) (Γ2 := ∅)
      (l1 := l1) (l2 := l2) (l3 := l3).
    + apply env_split_nil.
    + exact Hcap.
    + apply (Hrepl _ H1).
    + exact H2.

  (* ForkLock right *)
  - destruct (wt_forklock_view L ∅ _ _ _ Hwt)
      as (Γ1 & Γ2 & t0 & l1 & l2 & l3 & Ht & Hsplit & Hcap & H1 & H2).
    destruct (env_split_empty Γ1 Γ2 Hsplit) as [E1 E2]; subst Γ1 Γ2.
    subst t. eapply ForkLockW with (Γ1 := ∅) (Γ2 := ∅)
      (l1 := l1) (l2 := l2) (l3 := l3).
    + apply env_split_nil.
    + exact Hcap.
    + exact H1.
    + apply (Hrepl _ H2).

  (* Acquire *)
  - destruct (wt_acquire_view L ∅ _ _ Hwt) as (t0 & lo & Ht & H1).
    subst t. eapply AcquireW. apply (Hrepl _ H1).

  (* Release left *)
  - destruct (wt_release_view L ∅ _ _ _ Hwt)
      as (Γ1 & Γ2 & t0 & lo & Ht & Hsplit & H1 & H2).
    destruct (env_split_empty Γ1 Γ2 Hsplit) as [E1 E2]; subst Γ1 Γ2.
    subst t. eapply ReleaseW with (Γ1 := ∅) (Γ2 := ∅) (lo := lo).
    + apply env_split_nil.
    + apply (Hrepl _ H1).
    + exact H2.

  (* Release right *)
  - destruct (wt_release_view L ∅ _ _ _ Hwt)
      as (Γ1 & Γ2 & t0 & lo & Ht & Hsplit & H1 & H2).
    destruct (env_split_empty Γ1 Γ2 Hsplit) as [E1 E2]; subst Γ1 Γ2.
    subst t. eapply ReleaseW with (Γ1 := ∅) (Γ2 := ∅) (lo := lo).
    + apply env_split_nil.
    + exact H1.
    + apply (Hrepl _ H2).

  (* Wait *)
  - pose proof (wt_wait_view L ∅ _ _ Hwt) as H1.
    eapply WaitW. apply (Hrepl _ H1).

  (* Drop *)
  - destruct (wt_drop_view L ∅ _ _ Hwt) as [Ht [t0 H1]].
    subst t. eapply DropW. apply (Hrepl _ H1).
Qed.

Lemma wt_ctx_replace k E E' t (Hk : ctx k) :
  wt L ∅ (k E) t ->
  (forall s, wt L ∅ E s -> wt L ∅ E' s) ->
  wt L ∅ (k E') t.
Proof.
  revert E E' t.
  induction Hk as [| k1 k2 H1 H2 IH]; intros E E' t Hwt Hrepl.
  - cbn in Hwt |- *. apply Hrepl. exact Hwt.
  - cbn in Hwt |- *.
    apply (wt_ctx1_replace k1 (k2 E) (k2 E') t H1 Hwt).
    intros s Hs.
    exact (IH E E' s Hs Hrepl).
Qed.

(* Specialisation to a pure step at the hole. *)

Lemma wt_ctx_pure_step k e e' t (Hk : ctx k) :
  wt L ∅ (k e) t -> pure_step e e' -> wt L ∅ (k e') t.
Proof.
  intros Hwt Hstep.
  apply (wt_ctx_replace k e e' t Hk Hwt).
  intros s Hs. exact (wt_pure_step L e e' s Hs Hstep).
Qed.

Print Assumptions wt_ctx1_replace.
Print Assumptions wt_ctx_replace.
Print Assumptions wt_ctx_pure_step.
