From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.
From stdpp Require Import gmap decidable.
From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String Arith Lia.
From Stdlib Require Import Vectors.Fin.
Require Import AllCombine.
Require Import TokenTyping.
Require Import TokenCtx.
Open Scope string_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* A redesigned token grammar.                                        *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* The original [TE_MatchSum] rule gave every alternative the same     *)
(* branch context [Cb].  In particular, [MatchSum 0] could carry an    *)
(* arbitrary token even though it has no branch at all.  We now use a  *)
(* per-alternative context plus a common upper bound, and force the    *)
(* upper bound to be empty when there are no alternatives.             *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Inductive tokEL (beta : nat -> option (type * type)) :
    tenv -> expr -> token_ctx -> Prop :=
  | TLE_Var Delta x C :
      Delta x = C ->
      tokEL beta Delta (Var x) C
  | TLE_Val Delta v C :
      tokVL beta v C ->
      tokEL beta Delta (Val v) C
  | TLE_Fun Delta x e C :
      tokEL beta (tenv_bind Delta x) e C ->
      tokEL beta Delta (Fun x e) C
  | TLE_App Delta e1 e2 C1 C2 :
      tokEL beta Delta e1 C1 -> tokEL beta Delta e2 C2 ->
      tokEL beta Delta (App e1 e2) (tc_add C1 C2)
  | TLE_Unit Delta :
      tokEL beta Delta Unit tc_zero
  | TLE_Pair Delta e1 e2 C1 C2 :
      tokEL beta Delta e1 C1 -> tokEL beta Delta e2 C2 ->
      tokEL beta Delta (Pair e1 e2) (tc_add C1 C2)
  | TLE_LetPair Delta e1 e2 C1 C2 :
      tokEL beta Delta e1 C1 -> tokEL beta Delta e2 C2 ->
      tokEL beta Delta (LetPair e1 e2) (tc_add C1 C2)
  | TLE_Sum Delta n e C :
      tokEL beta Delta e C ->
      tokEL beta Delta (Sum n e) C
  | TLE_MatchSum Delta n e es Cs Cb Cbs :
      tokEL beta Delta e Cs ->
      (forall i, tokEL beta Delta (es i) (Cbs i)) ->
      (forall i, tc_le (Cbs i) Cb) ->
      (n = 0 -> Cb = tc_zero) ->
      tokEL beta Delta (MatchSum n e es) (tc_add Cs Cb)
  | TLE_ForkBarrier Delta e C :
      tokEL beta Delta e C ->
      tokEL beta Delta (ForkBarrier e) C
  | TLE_NewLock Delta e C :
      tokEL beta Delta e C ->
      tokEL beta Delta (NewLock e) C
  | TLE_ForkLock Delta e1 e2 C1 C2 :
      tokEL beta Delta e1 C1 -> tokEL beta Delta e2 C2 ->
      tokEL beta Delta (ForkLock e1 e2) (tc_add C1 C2)
  | TLE_Acquire Delta e C :
      tokEL beta Delta e C ->
      tokEL beta Delta (Acquire e) C
  | TLE_Release Delta e1 e2 C1 C2 :
      tokEL beta Delta e1 C1 -> tokEL beta Delta e2 C2 ->
      tokEL beta Delta (Release e1 e2) (tc_add C1 C2)
  | TLE_Wait Delta e C :
      tokEL beta Delta e C ->
      tokEL beta Delta (Wait e) C
  | TLE_Drop Delta e C :
      tokEL beta Delta e C ->
      tokEL beta Delta (Drop e) C
with tokVL (beta : nat -> option (type * type)) : val -> token_ctx -> Prop :=
  | TVL_FunV x e C :
      tokEL beta tenv_zero e C ->
      tokVL beta (FunV x e) C
  | TVL_Unit :
      tokVL beta UnitV tc_zero
  | TVL_Pair v1 v2 C1 C2 :
      tokVL beta v1 C1 -> tokVL beta v2 C2 ->
      tokVL beta (PairV v1 v2) (tc_add C1 C2)
  | TVL_Sum n v C :
      tokVL beta v C ->
      tokVL beta (SumV n v) C
  | TVL_Barrier n t1 t2 :
      beta n = Some (t1, t2) ->
      tokVL beta (BarrierV n) (tc_bar_one n)
  | TVL_Lock n lc :
      tokVL beta (LockV n) (tc_lock_one n lc).

Scheme tokEL_mut := Induction for tokEL Sort Prop
  with tokVL_mut := Induction for tokVL Sort Prop.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Alternative-aware occurrence counting.                             *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* At a [MatchSum], only one alternative is executed.  The amount of   *)
(* token context needed by the alternatives is therefore the maximum   *)
(* over the alternatives, not their sum.                              *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition fin_max {n} (f : fin n -> nat) : nat :=
  fold_right (fun i acc => max (f i) acc) 0 (fin_enum n).

Lemma fin_max_ge {n} (f : fin n -> nat) (i : fin n) :
  f i <= fin_max f.
Proof.
  unfold fin_max.
  induction (fin_enum n) as [|a l IH]; simpl.
  - exfalso. pose proof (fin_enum_complete i). rewrite H. inversion 1.
  - assert (Hmem : i = a \/ i ∈ l).
    { pose proof (fin_enum_complete i). simpl in H. set_solver. }
    destruct Hmem as [->|Hin].
    + lia.
    + pose proof (IH Hin). lia.
Qed.

Lemma fin_max_empty (f : fin 0 -> nat) : fin_max f = 0.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma fin_max_zero {n} (f : fin n -> nat) :
  fin_max f = 0 -> forall i, f i = 0.
Proof.
  intros H i. pose proof (fin_max_ge f i). lia.
Qed.

Lemma fin_max_le {n} (f : fin n -> nat) (k : nat) :
  (forall i, f i <= k) -> fin_max f <= k.
Proof.
  intros H. unfold fin_max.
  induction (fin_enum n) as [|a l IH]; simpl.
  - lia.
  - apply IH. intros x Hx. apply H.
Qed.

Fixpoint var_budget (x : string) (e : expr) : nat :=
  match e with
  | Val _ => 0
  | Var y => if decide (x = y) then 1 else 0
  | Fun y e => if decide (x = y) then 0 else var_budget x e
  | App e1 e2 => var_budget x e1 + var_budget x e2
  | Unit => 0
  | Pair e1 e2 => var_budget x e1 + var_budget x e2
  | LetPair e1 e2 => var_budget x e1 + var_budget x e2
  | Sum _ e => var_budget x e
  | MatchSum _ e es =>
      var_budget x e + fin_max (fun i => var_budget x (es i))
  | ForkBarrier e => var_budget x e
  | NewLock e => var_budget x e
  | ForkLock e1 e2 => var_budget x e1 + var_budget x e2
  | Acquire e => var_budget x e
  | Release e1 e2 => var_budget x e1 + var_budget x e2
  | Wait e => var_budget x e
  | Drop e => var_budget x e
  end.

Definition tokE_linear (beta : nat -> option (type * type))
    (Delta : tenv) (e : expr) (C : token_ctx) : Prop :=
  tokEL beta Delta e C /\
  forall x, has_index_token (Delta x) -> var_budget x e <= 1.

Definition tokV_linear (beta : nat -> option (type * type))
    (v : val) (C : token_ctx) : Prop :=
  tokVL beta v C.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Environment manipulation.                                          *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition tenv_update (Delta : tenv) (x : string) (C : token_ctx) : tenv :=
  fun y => if decide (y = x) then C else Delta y.

Definition tenv_eqv (D1 D2 : tenv) : Prop := forall x, D1 x = D2 x.

Lemma tenv_eqv_refl D : tenv_eqv D D.
Proof. intro x. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma tenv_eqv_sym D1 D2 : tenv_eqv D1 D2 -> tenv_eqv D2 D1.
Proof. intros H x. symmetry. apply H. Qed.

Lemma tenv_eqv_trans D1 D2 D3 :
  tenv_eqv D1 D2 -> tenv_eqv D2 D3 -> tenv_eqv D1 D3.
Proof. intros H1 H2 x. rewrite H1. apply H2. Qed.

Lemma tenv_update_same Delta x C : tenv_update Delta x C x = C.
Proof. unfold tenv_update. destruct (decide (x = x)); [reflexivity|exfalso; apply n; reflexivity]. Qed.

Lemma tenv_update_neq Delta x y C (H : y <> x) :
  tenv_update Delta x C y = Delta y.
Proof.
  unfold tenv_update. destruct (decide (y = x)); [exfalso; apply H; exact e|reflexivity].
Qed.

Lemma tenv_eqv_bind Delta1 Delta2 x :
  tenv_eqv Delta1 Delta2 -> tenv_eqv (tenv_bind Delta1 x) (tenv_bind Delta2 x).
Proof.
  intros H y. unfold tenv_bind.
  destruct (decide (y = x)); [reflexivity|apply H].
Qed.

Lemma tenv_bind_update_same Delta x C :
  tenv_eqv (tenv_bind (tenv_update Delta x C) x) (tenv_bind Delta x).
Proof.
  intro y. unfold tenv_bind.
  destruct (decide (y = x)) as [->|H].
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite tenv_update_neq by exact H. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma tenv_bind_update_neq Delta x y C (H : y <> x) :
  tenv_eqv (tenv_bind (tenv_update Delta x C) y)
           (tenv_update (tenv_bind Delta y) x C).
Proof.
  intro z. unfold tenv_bind, tenv_update.
  destruct (decide (z = y)) as [->|Hy].
  - destruct (decide (y = x)); [contradiction|reflexivity].
  - destruct (decide (z = x)) as [->|Hx]; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma tokEL_tenv_eqv beta D1 D2 e C
    (Heq : tenv_eqv D1 D2) (H : tokEL beta D1 e C) :
  tokEL beta D2 e C.
Proof.
  induction H; try (econstructor; eauto; fail).
  - econstructor. apply Heq. exact H.
  - eapply TLE_Fun. apply IHtokEL. apply tenv_eqv_bind. exact Heq.
  - eapply TLE_MatchSum; eauto.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Source-initial terms have the empty token context in the new       *)
(* grammar as well.                                                   *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma has_index_token_zero C (H : has_index_token tc_zero C) : False.
Proof.
  destruct H as [[lc Hl]|Hb].
  - unfold tc_zero in Hl. simpl in Hl. lia.
  - unfold tc_zero in Hb. simpl in Hb. lia.
Qed.

Lemma tenv_zero_zeroish : tenv_zeroish tenv_zero.
Proof. intro x. reflexivity. Qed.

Ltac tokL_zero_rec H :=
  match goal with
  | IH : forall D : tenv, tenv_zeroish D -> tokEL ?b D _ tc_zero
      |- tokEL ?b ?D _ tc_zero => apply IH; exact H
  end.

Lemma tokEL_zero_of_val_free beta e (H : val_free e) :
  forall Delta, tenv_zeroish Delta -> tokEL beta Delta e tc_zero.
Proof.
  induction H; intros Delta Hzero.
  - apply TLE_Var. apply Hzero.
  - apply TLE_Fun. apply IHval_free. apply tenv_bind_zeroish. exact Hzero.
  - apply TLE_App with (C1 := tc_zero) (C2 := tc_zero); tokL_zero_rec Hzero.
  - apply TLE_Unit.
  - apply TLE_Pair with (C1 := tc_zero) (C2 := tc_zero); tokL_zero_rec Hzero.
  - apply TLE_LetPair with (C1 := tc_zero) (C2 := tc_zero); tokL_zero_rec Hzero.
  - apply TLE_Sum. tokL_zero_rec Hzero.
  - eapply TLE_MatchSum with (Cs := tc_zero) (Cb := tc_zero)
      (Cbs := fun _ => tc_zero).
    + tokL_zero_rec Hzero.
    + intro i.
      match goal with
      | IH : forall i : fin _, forall D : tenv,
                 tenv_zeroish D -> tokEL beta D (_ i) tc_zero
          |- tokEL beta Delta (_ i) tc_zero =>
          exact (IH i Delta Hzero)
      end.
    + intros i. apply tc_le_refl.
    + intro. reflexivity.
  - apply TLE_ForkBarrier. tokL_zero_rec Hzero.
  - apply TLE_NewLock. tokL_zero_rec Hzero.
  - apply TLE_ForkLock with (C1 := tc_zero) (C2 := tc_zero); tokL_zero_rec Hzero.
  - apply TLE_Acquire. tokL_zero_rec Hzero.
  - apply TLE_Release with (C1 := tc_zero) (C2 := tc_zero); tokL_zero_rec Hzero.
  - apply TLE_Wait. tokL_zero_rec Hzero.
  - apply TLE_Drop. tokL_zero_rec Hzero.
Qed.

Theorem typed_to_tokEL_linear Gamma e t (H : typed Gamma e t)
    (beta : nat -> option (type * type)) :
  tokE_linear beta tenv_zero e tc_zero.
Proof.
  split.
  - apply (tokEL_zero_of_val_free beta e (typed_val_free Gamma e t H)
             tenv_zero tenv_zero_zeroish).
  - intros x Hx. exfalso. exact (has_index_token_zero 0 Hx).
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Token soundness for the redesigned grammar.                        *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma tc_le_has_index C D n (Hle : tc_le C D) :
  has_index_token C n -> has_index_token D n.
Proof.
  destruct Hle as [Hl Hb]. intros [[lc Hc]|Hc].
  - left. exists lc. pose proof (Hl n lc). lia.
  - right. pose proof (Hb n). lia.
Qed.

Lemma tc_le_add_mono C1 C2 D1 D2 :
  tc_le C1 D1 -> tc_le C2 D2 -> tc_le (tc_add C1 C2) (tc_add D1 D2).
Proof.
  intros [Hl1 Hb1] [Hl2 Hb2]. split.
  - intros n lc. rewrite !tc_add_lock. lia.
  - intros n. rewrite !tc_add_bar. lia.
Qed.

Ltac tokL_sound_apply :=
  match goal with
  | IH : (forall m : nat, m ∈ expr_refs _ -> has_index_token _ m)
      |- has_index_token _ _ => eapply IH; eassumption
  | IH : (forall m : nat, m ∈ val_refs _ -> has_index_token _ m)
      |- has_index_token _ _ => eapply IH; eassumption
  end.

Lemma tokEL_sound beta Delta e C (H : tokEL beta Delta e C) :
  forall n, n ∈ expr_refs e -> has_index_token C n.
Proof.
  induction H using tokEL_mut with
    (P0 := fun v C (Hv : tokVL beta v C) =>
             forall n, n ∈ val_refs v -> has_index_token C n).
  - intros k Hk. simpl in Hk. set_solver.
  - intros k Hk.
    match goal with
    | IHv : (forall m, m ∈ val_refs _ -> has_index_token _ m) |- _ =>
        exact (IHv k Hk)
    end.
  - intros k Hk. simpl in Hk. tokL_sound_apply.
  - intros k Hk. simpl in Hk. apply elem_of_union in Hk.
    destruct Hk as [Hk|Hk].
    + apply tc_add_has_index_l. tokL_sound_apply.
    + apply tc_add_has_index_r. tokL_sound_apply.
  - intros k Hk. simpl in Hk. set_solver.
  - intros k Hk. simpl in Hk. apply elem_of_union in Hk.
    destruct Hk as [Hk|Hk].
    + apply tc_add_has_index_l. tokL_sound_apply.
    + apply tc_add_has_index_r. tokL_sound_apply.
  - intros k Hk. simpl in Hk. apply elem_of_union in Hk.
    destruct Hk as [Hk|Hk].
    + apply tc_add_has_index_l. tokL_sound_apply.
    + apply tc_add_has_index_r. tokL_sound_apply.
  - intros k Hk. simpl in Hk. tokL_sound_apply.
  - intros k Hk. simpl in Hk. apply elem_of_union in Hk.
    destruct Hk as [Hk|Hk].
    + apply tc_add_has_index_l. tokL_sound_apply.
    + apply tc_add_has_index_r.
      apply elem_of_fin_union in Hk. destruct Hk as [i Hi].
      match goal with
      | Hbr : (forall i : fin _, forall m : nat,
                  m ∈ expr_refs _ -> has_index_token _ m) |- _ =>
          exact (tc_le_has_index _ _ _ (H1 i) (Hbr i k Hi))
      end.
  - intros k Hk. simpl in Hk. tokL_sound_apply.
  - intros k Hk. simpl in Hk. tokL_sound_apply.
  - intros k Hk. simpl in Hk. apply elem_of_union in Hk.
    destruct Hk as [Hk|Hk].
    + apply tc_add_has_index_l. tokL_sound_apply.
    + apply tc_add_has_index_r. tokL_sound_apply.
  - intros k Hk. simpl in Hk. tokL_sound_apply.
  - intros k Hk. simpl in Hk. apply elem_of_union in Hk.
    destruct Hk as [Hk|Hk].
    + apply tc_add_has_index_l. tokL_sound_apply.
    + apply tc_add_has_index_r. tokL_sound_apply.
  - intros k Hk. simpl in Hk. tokL_sound_apply.
  - intros k Hk. simpl in Hk. tokL_sound_apply.
  - intros k Hk. simpl in Hk. tokL_sound_apply.
  - intros k Hk. simpl in Hk. set_solver.
  - intros k Hk. simpl in Hk. apply elem_of_union in Hk.
    destruct Hk as [Hk|Hk].
    + apply tc_add_has_index_l. tokL_sound_apply.
    + apply tc_add_has_index_r. tokL_sound_apply.
  - intros k Hk. simpl in Hk. tokL_sound_apply.
  - intros k Hk. simpl in Hk. apply elem_of_singleton in Hk. subst k.
    right. rewrite tc_bar_one_same. lia.
  - intros k Hk. simpl in Hk. apply elem_of_singleton in Hk. subst k.
    left. exists lc. rewrite tc_lock_one_same. lia.
Qed.

(* Inversion helpers. *)
Lemma tokEL_val_inv beta Delta v C (H : tokEL beta Delta (Val v) C) :
  tokVL beta v C.
Proof. inversion H; subst; assumption. Qed.

Lemma tokEL_release_inv beta Delta e1 e2 C
    (H : tokEL beta Delta (Release e1 e2) C) :
  exists C1 C2, C = tc_add C1 C2 /\
    tokEL beta Delta e1 C1 /\ tokEL beta Delta e2 C2.
Proof. inversion H; subst; eauto. Qed.

Lemma tokVL_lock_inv beta n C (H : tokVL beta (LockV n) C) :
  exists lc, C = tc_lock_one n lc.
Proof. inversion H; subst; eauto. Qed.

Lemma index_single_add_left_L C1 C2 :
  index_single (tc_add C1 C2) -> index_single C1.
Proof.
  intros H n. pose proof (H n) as Hle.
  rewrite tc_add_lock_count, tc_add_bar in Hle.
  unfold lock_count in *. lia.
Qed.

Lemma index_single_split_lock_zero_L C1 C2 n lc
    (Hsingle : index_single (tc_add C1 C2))
    (Hpos : 0 < tok_lock C1 n lc) :
  (forall lc', tok_lock C2 n lc' = 0) /\ tok_bar C2 n = 0.
Proof.
  assert (Hsum : lock_count (tc_add C1 C2) n + tok_bar (tc_add C1 C2) n
                 = (lock_count C1 n + tok_bar C1 n)
                   + (lock_count C2 n + tok_bar C2 n)).
  { rewrite tc_add_lock_count, tc_add_bar. lia. }
  assert (Hle : lock_count (tc_add C1 C2) n + tok_bar (tc_add C1 C2) n <= 1)
    by apply Hsingle.
  assert (Hc2 : lock_count C2 n = 0).
  { pose proof (lock_count_le_sum C1 n lc). rewrite Hsum in Hle. lia. }
  split.
  - intro lc'. pose proof (lock_count_le_sum C2 n lc'). lia.
  - rewrite Hsum in Hle. lia.
Qed.

Theorem release_payload_token_free_L beta Delta n v C1 C2
    (Htok : tokEL beta Delta (Release (Val (LockV n)) (Val v))
              (tc_add C1 C2))
    (Hsingle : index_single (tc_add C1 C2)) :
  n ∉ val_refs v.
Proof.
  destruct (tokEL_release_inv beta Delta (Val (LockV n)) (Val v)
              (tc_add C1 C2) Htok) as (C1' & C2' & HC & H1 & H2).
  pose proof (tokEL_val_inv beta Delta (LockV n) C1' H1) as Hv1.
  destruct (tokVL_lock_inv beta n C1' Hv1) as (lc & HC1).
  subst C1'.
  assert (Hsingle' : index_single (tc_add (tc_lock_one n lc) C2')).
  { rewrite <- HC. exact Hsingle. }
  assert (Hlock : 0 < tok_lock (tc_lock_one n lc) n lc).
  { rewrite tc_lock_one_same. lia. }
  destruct (index_single_split_lock_zero_L (tc_lock_one n lc) C2' n lc
              Hsingle' Hlock) as [Hzero Hbar].
  intro Hn.
  pose proof (tokEL_sound beta Delta (Val v) C2' H2 n) as Hs.
  simpl in Hs. specialize (Hs Hn).
  destruct Hs as [[lc' Hlc']|Hb].
  - rewrite Hzero in Hlc'. lia.
  - rewrite Hbar in Hb. lia.
Qed.

(* arbitrary token even though it has no branch at all.  We now use a  *)

    tenv -> expr -> token_ctx -> Prop :=
  | TLE_Var Delta x C :

      tokEL beta Delta (Var x) C
  | TLE_Val Delta v C :

      tokEL beta Delta (Val v) C
  | TLE_Fun Delta x e C :
      tokEL beta (tenv_bind Delta x) e C ->
      tokEL beta Delta (Fun x e) C
  | TLE_App Delta e1 e2 C1 C2 :
      tokEL beta Delta e1 C1 -> tokEL beta Delta e2 C2 ->
      tokEL beta Delta (App e1 e2) (tc_add C1 C2)
  | TLE_Unit Delta :
      tokEL beta Delta Unit tc_zero
  | TLE_Pair Delta e1 e2 C1 C2 :
      tokEL beta Delta e1 C1 -> tokEL beta Delta e2 C2 ->
      tokEL beta Delta (Pair e1 e2) (tc_add C1 C2)
  | TLE_LetPair Delta e1 e2 C1 C2 :
      tokEL beta Delta e1 C1 -> tokEL beta Delta e2 C2 ->
      tokEL beta Delta (LetPair e1 e2) (tc_add C1 C2)
  | TLE_Sum Delta n e C :
      tokEL beta Delta e C ->
      tokEL beta Delta (Sum n e) C
  | TLE_MatchSum Delta n e es Cs Cb Cbs :
      tokEL beta Delta e Cs ->
      (forall i, tokEL beta Delta (es i) (Cbs i)) ->
      (forall i, tc_le (Cbs i) Cb) ->
      (n = 0 -> Cb = tc_zero) ->
      tokEL beta Delta (MatchSum n e es) (tc_add Cs Cb)

From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.
From stdpp Require Import gmap list.
From Stdlib Require Import List Arith Lia.
From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String.
Import ListNotations.
Close Scope string_scope.

Load "/tmp/scratch6/FunGraph.v".

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Pair preservation for the individual local-step reference shapes.  *)
(* ================================================================== *)

(* Attaching a fresh leaf [n] (with no out-references) below [i]. *)
Lemma pair_add_fresh_leaf (S T : nat -> gset nat) (i n : nat) :
  ref_pair_ok_fun S ->
  n <> i ->
  (forall a, n ∉ S a) ->
  T n = ∅ ->
  T i = S i ∪ {[n]} ->
  (forall a, a <> i -> a <> n -> T a = S a) ->
  ref_pair_ok_fun T.
Proof.
  intros [Hself Hpair] Hni Hfresh HTn HTi Hother.
  split.
  - intro a. destruct (decide (a = i)) as [E|Hai].
    + subst a. intro Hmem. rewrite HTi in Hmem.
      apply elem_of_union in Hmem as [Hin|Hin].
      * exact (Hself i Hin).
      * apply elem_of_singleton in Hin. apply Hni. symmetry. exact Hin.
    + destruct (decide (a = n)) as [E|Han].
      * subst a. rewrite HTn. set_solver.
      * rewrite (Hother a Hai Han). apply Hself.
  - intros a b Hne [Hb Ha].
    destruct (decide (a = i)) as [Ea|Hai].
    + subst a. rewrite HTi in Hb.
      apply elem_of_union in Hb as [HbS|HbN].
      * destruct (decide (b = n)) as [Eb|Hbn].
        -- subst b. rewrite HTn in Ha. set_solver.
        -- rewrite (Hother b (ne_sym Hne) Hbn) in Ha.
           exact (Hpair i b Hne (conj HbS Ha)).
      * apply elem_of_singleton in HbN. subst b.
        rewrite HTn in Ha. set_solver.
    + destruct (decide (a = n)) as [Ea|Han].
      * subst a. rewrite HTn in Hb. set_solver.
      * rewrite (Hother a Hai Han) in Hb.
        destruct (decide (b = i)) as [Eb|Hbi].
        -- subst b. rewrite HTi in Ha.
           apply elem_of_union in Ha as [HaS|HaN].
           ++ exact (Hpair a i Hne (conj Hb HaS)).
           ++ apply elem_of_singleton in HaN. exfalso. exact (Han HaN).
        -- destruct (decide (b = n)) as [Eb|Hbn].
           ++ subst b. rewrite HTn in Ha. set_solver.
           ++ rewrite (Hother b Hbi Hbn) in Ha.
              exact (Hpair a b Hne (conj Hb Ha)).
Qed.

(* Acquire / Wait: the lock content bundle moves into the thread. *)
Lemma acquire_pair_shape (S T : nat -> gset nat) (i n : nat) (B : gset nat) :
  ref_pair_ok_fun S ->
  T i ⊆ S i ∪ B ->
  T n = ∅ ->
  (forall a, a <> i -> a <> n -> T a = S a) ->
  i ∉ B ->
  (forall b, b ∈ B -> i ∉ T b) ->
  ref_pair_ok_fun T.
Proof.
  intros. eapply pair_move_add_shrink; eauto.
Qed.

(* Release: the thread's value bundle moves into the lock.  This is
   exactly where the destination-backreference invariant is needed. *)
Lemma release_pair_shape (S T : nat -> gset nat) (n i : nat) (B : gset nat) :
  ref_pair_ok_fun S ->
  n <> i ->
  T n = S n ∪ B ->
  T i ⊆ S i ->
  (forall a, a <> n -> a <> i -> T a = S a) ->
  n ∉ B ->
  (forall b, b ∈ B -> n ∉ T b) ->
  ref_pair_ok_fun T.
Proof.
  intros. eapply pair_move_to_dest; eauto.
Qed.

(* NewLock: fresh lock [n] becomes the destination, the thread loses its
   value bundle [B] and gains the fresh token [n]. *)
Lemma newlock_pair_shape (S T : nat -> gset nat) (i n : nat) (B : gset nat) :
  ref_pair_ok_fun S ->
  n <> i ->
  (forall a, n ∉ S a) ->
  B ⊆ S i ->
  T n = B ->
  T i ⊆ S i ∪ {[n]} ->
  (forall a, a <> i -> a <> n -> T a = S a) ->
  ref_pair_ok_fun T.
Proof.
  intros Hpair Hni Hfresh HB HTn HTi Hother.
  destruct Hpair as [Hself Hpair0].
  set (T1 := fun a => if decide (a = i) then S i ∪ {[n]}
                      else if decide (a = n) then ∅ else S a).
  assert (HT1n : T1 n = ∅).
  { unfold T1. destruct (decide (n = i)) as [E1|H1].
    - exfalso. exact (Hni E1).
    - destruct (decide (n = n)) as [E2|H2]; [reflexivity|exfalso; apply H2; reflexivity]. }
  assert (HT1i : T1 i = S i ∪ {[n]}).
  { unfold T1. destruct (decide (i = i)) as [E3|H3]; [reflexivity|exfalso; apply H3; reflexivity]. }
  assert (HT1other : forall a, a <> i -> a <> n -> T1 a = S a).
  { intros a Hai Han. unfold T1.
    destruct (decide (a = i)) as [E4|H4]; [exfalso; apply Hai; exact E4|].
    destruct (decide (a = n)) as [E5|H5]; [exfalso; apply Han; exact E5|]. reflexivity. }
  assert (Hpair1 : ref_pair_ok_fun T1).
  { apply (pair_add_fresh_leaf S T1 i n).
    - split; assumption.
    - exact Hni.
    - exact Hfresh.
    - exact HT1n.
    - exact HT1i.
    - exact HT1other. }
  assert (HnB : n ∉ B).
  { intro Hn. apply (Hfresh i). apply HB in Hn. exact Hn. }
  assert (Hrev : forall b, b ∈ B -> n ∉ T b).
  { intros b Hb HnT.
    assert (Hbi : b <> i).
    { intro E. subst b.
      assert (HiS : i ∈ S i) by (apply HB; exact Hb).
      exact (Hself i HiS). }
    assert (Hbn : b <> n).
    { intro E. subst b. exact (HnB Hb). }
    apply (Hfresh b). rewrite <- (Hother b Hbi Hbn). exact HnT. }
  eapply pair_move_to_dest with (S := T1) (T := T) (d := n) (s := i) (B := B).
  - exact Hpair1.
  - exact Hni.
  - rewrite HTn. rewrite HT1n. set_solver.
  - rewrite HT1i. exact HTi.
  - intros a Han Hai. rewrite (HT1other a Hai Han). apply Hother; assumption.
  - exact HnB.
  - exact Hrev.
Qed.

(* ForkLock: [B] moves to the fresh forked thread [j], which also gets
   the lock token [n]. *)
Lemma forklock_pair_shape (S T : nat -> gset nat) (i j n : nat) (B : gset nat) :
  ref_pair_ok_fun S ->
  i <> j -> i <> n -> j <> n ->
  (forall a, j ∉ S a) ->
  S j = ∅ ->
  B ⊆ S i ->
  i ∉ B ->
  T j = B ∪ {[n]} ->
  T i ⊆ S i ->
  T n = S n ->
  (forall a, a <> i -> a <> j -> a <> n -> T a = S a) ->
  ref_pair_ok_fun T.
Proof.
  intros Hpair Hij Hin Hjn Hfresh HSj HB HiB HTj HTi HTn Hother.
  destruct Hpair as [Hself Hpair0].
  change (ref_pair_ok_fun T).
  eapply pair_move_to_dest with (S := S) (T := T) (d := j) (s := i)
                                 (B := B ∪ {[n]}).
  - split; assumption.
  - apply (ne_sym Hij).
  - rewrite HTj, HSj. set_solver.
  - exact HTi.
  - intros a Haj Hai. destruct (decide (a = n)) as [E|Hn].
    + subst a. exact HTn.
    + apply Hother; assumption.
  - (* j ∉ B ∪ {[n]} *)
    intro HjU.
    apply elem_of_union in HjU as [HjB|HjN].
    + assert (HjB' : j ∉ B).
      { intro Hj. assert (HjS : j ∈ S i) by (apply HB; exact Hj).
        exact (Hfresh i HjS). }
      exact (HjB' HjB).
    + apply elem_of_singleton in HjN. exact (Hjn HjN).
  - (* forall b in B ∪ {[n]}, j ∉ T b *)
    intros b Hb HjT.
    apply elem_of_union in Hb as [HbB|HbN].
    + destruct (decide (b = n)) as [E|Hbn].
      * subst b. rewrite HTn in HjT. apply (Hfresh n). exact HjT.
      * assert (Hbi : b <> i).
        { intro E. subst b.
          assert (HiS : i ∈ S i) by (apply HB; exact HbB).
          exact (Hself i HiS). }
        assert (Hbj : b <> j).
        { intro E. subst b.
          assert (HjS : j ∈ S i) by (apply HB; exact HbB).
          exact (Hfresh i HjS). }
        rewrite (Hother b Hbi Hbj Hbn) in HjT.
        exact (Hfresh b HjT).
    + apply elem_of_singleton in HbN. subst b.
      rewrite HTn in HjT. exact (Hfresh n HjT).
Qed.

(* Fork: [B] moves to the fresh forked thread [j]; barrier [n] is a
   second fresh leaf attached to both [i] and [j]. *)
Lemma fork_pair_shape (S T : nat -> gset nat) (i j n : nat) (B : gset nat) :
  ref_pair_ok_fun S ->
  i <> j -> i <> n -> j <> n ->
  (forall a, n ∉ S a) ->
  (forall a, j ∉ S a) ->
  S j = ∅ ->
  B ⊆ S i ->
  i ∉ B ->
  T j = B ∪ {[n]} ->
  T i ⊆ S i ∪ {[n]} ->
  T n = ∅ ->
  (forall a, a <> i -> a <> j -> a <> n -> T a = S a) ->
  ref_pair_ok_fun T.
Proof.
  intros Hpair Hij Hin Hjn Hfreshn Hfreshj HSj HB HiB HTj HTi HTn Hother.
  destruct Hpair as [Hself Hpair0].
  set (T1 := fun a => if decide (a = i) then S i ∪ {[n]}
                      else if decide (a = n) then ∅ else S a).
  assert (HT1n : T1 n = ∅).
  { unfold T1. destruct (decide (n = i)) as [D1|J1].
    - exfalso. apply Hin. symmetry. exact D1.
    - destruct (decide (n = n)) as [D2|J2]; [reflexivity|exfalso; apply J2; reflexivity]. }
  assert (HT1i : T1 i = S i ∪ {[n]}).
  { unfold T1. destruct (decide (i = i)) as [D3|J3]; [reflexivity|exfalso; apply J3; reflexivity]. }

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Forest preservation for Acquire / Wait / Release.                  *)
(* ================================================================== *)

(* Acquire-shaped move: the bundle [B] is exactly the old lock content,
   the source lock is emptied, and the destination thread may keep the
   lock token (Acquire) or drop it (Wait). *)
Lemma acquire_forest_shape (S T : nat -> gset nat) (i n : nat) (B : gset nat) :
  ref_pair_ok_fun S ->
  forest_fun S ->
  T i ⊆ S i ∪ B ->
  T n = ∅ ->
  (forall a, a <> i -> a <> n -> T a = S a) ->
  i ∉ B ->
  B ⊆ S n ->
  n ∈ S i ->
  i <> n ->
  forest_fun T.
Proof.
  intros [Hself Hpair] Hforest HTi HTn Hother HiB HB HnSi Hine.
  assert (HnB : n ∉ B).
  { intro Hn. apply (Hself n). apply HB in Hn. exact Hn. }
  eapply forest_star_shape with (S := S) (T := T) (i := i) (n := n) (R := B).
  - (* edge inclusion *)
    intros a b [Hne Hdisj].
    destruct Hdisj as [Hb|Ha].
    + (* b ∈ T a *)
      destruct (decide (a = i)) as [Ea|Hai].
      * subst a. assert (HbU : b ∈ S i ∪ B) by (apply HTi; exact Hb).
        apply elem_of_union in HbU as [HbS|HbB].
        -- left. split; [exact Hne|left; exact HbS].
        -- right. left. split; [reflexivity|exact HbB].
      * destruct (decide (a = n)) as [Ea|Han].
        -- subst a. rewrite HTn in Hb. set_solver.
        -- destruct (decide (b = i)) as [Eb|Hbi].
           ++ subst b. rewrite (Hother a Hai Han) in Hb.
              left. split; [exact Hne|left; exact Hb].
           ++ destruct (decide (b = n)) as [Eb|Hbn].
              ** subst b. rewrite (Hother a Hai Han) in Hb.
                 left. split; [exact Hne|left; exact Hb].
              ** left. rewrite (Hother a Hai Han) in Hb.
                 split; [exact Hne|left; exact Hb].
    + (* a ∈ T b *)
      destruct (decide (b = i)) as [Eb|Hbi].
      * subst b. assert (HaU : a ∈ S i ∪ B) by (apply HTi; exact Ha).
        apply elem_of_union in HaU as [HaS|HaB].
        -- left. split; [exact Hne|right; exact HaS].
        -- right. right. split; [reflexivity|exact HaB].
      * destruct (decide (b = n)) as [Eb|Hbn].
        -- subst b. rewrite HTn in Ha. set_solver.
        -- destruct (decide (a = i)) as [Ea|Hai].
           ++ subst a. rewrite (Hother b Hbi Hbn) in Ha.
              left. split; [exact Hne|right; exact Ha].
           ++ destruct (decide (a = n)) as [Ea|Han].
              ** subst a. rewrite (Hother b Hbi Hbn) in Ha.
                 left. split; [exact Hne|right; exact Ha].
              ** left. rewrite (Hother b Hbi Hbn) in Ha.
                 split; [exact Hne|right; exact Ha].
  - exact Hforest.
  - (* source bundle *)
    intros r Hr. split.
    + assert (HrS : r ∈ S n) by (apply HB; exact Hr).
      assert (Hrn : r <> n) by (intro E; subst r; exact (Hself n HrS)).
      exact (ne_sym Hrn).
    + left. apply HB. exact Hr.
  - (* bridge *)
    split.
    + exact Hine.
    + left. exact HnSi.
  - (* removed edges *)
    intros r Hr [Hne [HrTn|HnTr]].
    + rewrite HTn in HrTn. set_solver.
    + assert (Hri : r <> i) by (intro E; subst r; exact (HiB Hr)).
      assert (Hrn : r <> n) by (intro E; subst r; exact (HnB Hr)).
      rewrite (Hother r Hri Hrn) in HnTr.
      assert (HrS : r ∈ S n) by (apply HB; exact Hr).
      exact (Hpair n r Hne (conj HrS HnTr)).
  - exact Hine.
  - exact HnB.
Qed.

(* Release-shaped move: the thread's value bundle [B] moves into the
   lock [n].  For the forest no destination-backreference condition is
   needed: a self-reference of the lock contributes no graph edge. *)
Lemma release_forest_shape (S T : nat -> gset nat) (n i : nat) (B : gset nat) :
  ref_pair_ok_fun S ->
  forest_fun S ->
  n <> i ->
  T n = S n ∪ B ->
  T i ⊆ S i ->
  (forall a, a <> n -> a <> i -> T a = S a) ->
  (forall r, r ∈ B -> r <> n -> r ∉ T i) ->
  S n = ∅ ->
  i ∉ B ->
  B ⊆ S i ->
  n ∈ S i ->
  forest_fun T.
Proof.
  intros [Hself Hpair] Hforest Hni HTn HTi Hother Hdisj HSn HiB HB HnSi.
  eapply forest_star_shape with (S := S) (T := T)
          (i := n) (n := i) (R := B ∖ {[n]}).
  - (* edge inclusion *)
    intros a b [Hne Hedge].
    destruct Hedge as [Hb|Ha].
    + (* b ∈ T a *)
      destruct (decide (a = n)) as [Ea|Han].
      * subst a. rewrite HTn in Hb. rewrite HSn in Hb.
        assert (HbB : b ∈ B) by set_solver.
        right. left. split; [reflexivity|].
        apply elem_of_difference. split; [exact HbB|].
        intro E. apply elem_of_singleton in E. exact (Hne (eq_sym E)).
      * destruct (decide (b = n)) as [Eb|Hbn].
        -- subst b. destruct (decide (a = i)) as [Ea|Hai].
           ++ subst a. assert (HbS : n ∈ S i) by (apply HTi; exact Hb).
              left. split; [exact Hne|left; exact HbS].
           ++ left. rewrite (Hother a Han Hai) in Hb.
              split; [exact Hne|left; exact Hb].
        -- destruct (decide (a = i)) as [Ea|Hai].
           ++ subst a. assert (HbS : b ∈ S i) by (apply HTi; exact Hb).
              left. split; [exact Hne|left; exact HbS].
           ++ left. rewrite (Hother a Han Hai) in Hb.
              split; [exact Hne|left; exact Hb].
    + (* a ∈ T b *)
      destruct (decide (b = n)) as [Eb|Hbn].
      * subst b. rewrite HTn in Ha. rewrite HSn in Ha.
        assert (HaB : a ∈ B) by set_solver.
        right. right. split; [reflexivity|].
        apply elem_of_difference. split; [exact HaB|].
        intro E. apply elem_of_singleton in E. exact (Hne E).
      * destruct (decide (a = n)) as [Ea|Han].
        -- subst a. destruct (decide (b = i)) as [Eb|Hbi].
           ++ subst b. assert (HaS : n ∈ S i) by (apply HTi; exact Ha).
              left. split; [exact Hne|right; exact HaS].
           ++ left. rewrite (Hother b Hbn Hbi) in Ha.
              split; [exact Hne|right; exact Ha].
        -- destruct (decide (b = i)) as [Eb|Hbi].
           ++ subst b. assert (HaS : a ∈ S i) by (apply HTi; exact Ha).
              left. split; [exact Hne|right; exact HaS].
           ++ left. rewrite (Hother b Hbn Hbi) in Ha.
              split; [exact Hne|right; exact Ha].
  - exact Hforest.
  - (* source: old thread-out edges to the bundle *)
    intros r Hr. apply elem_of_difference in Hr as [HrB Hrn].
    assert (Hri : r <> i) by (intro E; subst r; exact (HiB HrB)).
    split; [exact (ne_sym Hri)|left; apply HB; exact HrB].
  - (* bridge *)
    split; [exact Hni|right; exact HnSi].
  - (* removed source edges *)
    intros r Hr [Hne [HrTi|HiTr]].
    + apply elem_of_difference in Hr as [HrB Hrn].
      assert (Hrn' : r <> n) by
        (intro E; apply Hrn; apply elem_of_singleton; exact E).
      exact (Hdisj r HrB Hrn' HrTi).
    + apply elem_of_difference in Hr as [HrB Hrn].
      assert (Hrn' : r <> n) by
        (intro E; apply Hrn; apply elem_of_singleton; exact E).
      assert (Hri : r <> i) by (intro E; subst r; exact (HiB HrB)).
      rewrite (Hother r Hrn' Hri) in HiTr.
      assert (HrS : r ∈ S i) by (apply HB; exact HrB).
      exact (Hpair i r Hne (conj HrS HiTr)).
  - exact Hni.
  - (* i not in the moved bundle *)
    intro HiR. apply elem_of_difference in HiR as [HiB' _]. exact (HiB HiB').
Qed.

(* Wait uses the Acquire-shaped forest bound for the enlarged
   configuration and then shrinks the deleted lock token. *)
Lemma wait_forest_shape (S T : nat -> gset nat) (i n : nat) (B : gset nat) :
  ref_pair_ok_fun S ->
  forest_fun S ->
  T i ⊆ S i ∪ B ->
  T n = ∅ ->
  (forall a, a <> i -> a <> n -> T a = S a) ->
  i ∉ B ->
  B ⊆ S n ->
  n ∈ S i ->
  i <> n ->
  forest_fun T.
Proof.
  intros. eapply acquire_forest_shape; eauto.
Qed.

(* Wait pair: the same subset-shaped pair lemma as Acquire. *)
Lemma wait_pair_shape (S T : nat -> gset nat) (i n : nat) (B : gset nat) :
  ref_pair_ok_fun S ->
  T i ⊆ S i ∪ B ->
  T n = ∅ ->
  (forall a, a <> i -> a <> n -> T a = S a) ->
  i ∉ B ->
  (forall b, b ∈ B -> i ∉ T b) ->
  ref_pair_ok_fun T.
Proof. intros. eapply acquire_pair_shape; eauto. Qed.

(* Drop only deletes the lock token from the thread; the lock itself is
   unchanged, so all reference sets shrink. *)
Lemma drop_pair_shape (S T : nat -> gset nat) :
  ref_pair_ok_fun S ->
  (forall a, T a ⊆ S a) ->
  ref_pair_ok_fun T.
Proof. intros. eapply ref_pair_ok_shrink_fun; eauto. Qed.

Lemma drop_forest_shape (S T : nat -> gset nat) :
  forest_fun S ->
  (forall a, T a ⊆ S a) ->
  forest_fun T.
Proof. intros. eapply forest_shrink_fun; eauto. Qed.

Print Assumptions acquire_forest_shape.
Print Assumptions release_forest_shape.
Print Assumptions wait_forest_shape.
Print Assumptions wait_pair_shape.

From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Export langdef.

Fixpoint expr_refs e :=
  match e with
  | Val v => val_refs v
  | Var x => ∅
  | Fun x e => expr_refs e
  | App e1 e2 => expr_refs e1 ∪ expr_refs e2
  | Unit => ∅
  | Pair e1 e2 => expr_refs e1 ∪ expr_refs e2
  | LetPair e1 e2 => expr_refs e1 ∪ expr_refs e2
  | Sum i e => expr_refs e
  | MatchSum n e es => expr_refs e ∪ fin_union n (expr_refs ∘ es)
  | ForkBarrier e => expr_refs e
  | NewLock e => expr_refs e
  | ForkLock e1 e2 => expr_refs e1 ∪ expr_refs e2
  | Acquire e => expr_refs e
  | Release e1 e2 => expr_refs e1 ∪ expr_refs e2
  | Wait e => expr_refs e
  | Drop e => expr_refs e
  end
with val_refs v :=
  match v with
  | FunV x e => expr_refs e
  | UnitV => ∅
  | PairV v1 v2 => val_refs v1 ∪ val_refs v2
  | SumV i v => val_refs v
  | BarrierV i => {[ i ]}
  | LockV i => {[ i ]}
  end.

Definition obj_refs x :=
  match x with
  | Thread e => expr_refs e
  | Barrier => ∅
  | Lock refcnt o =>
      match o with
      | Some v => val_refs v
      | None => ∅
      end
  end.

Inductive expr_head_waiting : expr -> nat -> Prop :=
  | Barrier_waiting j v :
    expr_head_waiting (App (Val $ BarrierV j) (Val v)) j
  | ForkLock_waiting j v :
    expr_head_waiting (ForkLock (Val $ LockV j) (Val v)) j
  | Acquire_waiting j :
    expr_head_waiting (Acquire (Val $ LockV j)) j
  | Release_waiting j v :
    expr_head_waiting (Release (Val $ LockV j) (Val v)) j
  | Wait_waiting j :
    expr_head_waiting (Wait (Val $ LockV j)) j
  | Drop_waiting j :
    expr_head_waiting (Drop (Val $ LockV j)) j.

Definition expr_waiting e j :=
  ∃ k e', ctx k ∧ e = k e' ∧ expr_head_waiting e' j.

Definition waiting (ρ : cfg) (i j : nat) :=
  (∃ e, ρ !! i = Some (Thread e) ∧ expr_waiting e j) ∨
  (∃ y, ρ !! j = Some y ∧ i ∈ obj_refs y ∧ ∀ e, y = Thread e -> ¬ expr_waiting e i).

Definition can_step (ρ : cfg) (i : nat) := ∃ ρ', step i ρ ρ'.

Definition inactive (ρ : cfg) (i : nat) := ρ !! i = None.

Inductive reachable (ρ : cfg) : nat -> Prop :=
  | Can_step_reachable i :
      can_step ρ i -> reachable ρ i
  | Waiting_reachable i j :
      waiting ρ i j -> reachable ρ j -> reachable ρ i.

Definition fully_reachable (ρ : cfg) :=
  ∀ i, inactive ρ i ∨ reachable ρ i.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* The linear substitution lemma.                                     *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* If the variable occurs at most once (counting alternatives by      *)
(* their maximum), substituting a value [a] with context [Ca] gives a *)
(* term whose token context is bounded by [C + Ca].  We deliberately  *)
(* state an upper bound rather than [C - Cx + Ca]: this is exactly    *)
(* what is needed for the single-index invariant, while avoiding a    *)
(* subtraction that would be wrong for shared branch contexts.        *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma tokEL_subst_linear beta x a Ca (Ha : tokVL beta a Ca) :
  forall e Delta C,
    var_budget x e <= 1 ->
    tokEL beta Delta e C ->
    exists C',
      tokEL beta (tenv_update Delta x Ca) (subst x a e) C' /\
      (var_budget x e = 0 -> tc_le C' C) /\
      (var_budget x e = 1 -> tc_le C' (tc_add C Ca)).
Proof.
  induction e; intros Delta C Hvb Htok; pose (Csrc := C); inversion Htok; subst; simpl.
  - (* Val *)
    exists Csrc. split; [econstructor; assumption|].
    split; [intro; apply tc_le_refl|intro H; simpl in H; lia].
           eapply tc_le_trans.
           ++ apply tc_le_add_mono; [apply HB10; exact H1z|apply HB21; exact H2o].
           ++ apply tc_le_add_rearrange_r.
        -- assert (H2z : var_budget x e2 = 0) by lia.
           eapply tc_le_trans.
           ++ apply tc_le_add_mono; [apply HB11; exact H1o|apply HB20; exact H2z].
           ++ apply tc_le_add_rearrange_l.
  - (* Wait *)
    destruct (IHe Delta C Hvb H2) as (C' & Ht & HB0 & HB1).
    exists C'. split; [econstructor; assumption|]. split; assumption.
  - (* Drop *)
    destruct (IHe Delta C Hvb H2) as (C' & Ht & HB0 & HB1).
    exists C'. split; [econstructor; assumption|]. split; assumption.
Qed.
           eapply tc_le_trans.
           ++ apply tc_le_add_mono; [apply HB11; exact H1o|apply HB20; exact H2z].
           ++ apply tc_le_add_rearrange_l.
  - (* Wait *)
    destruct (IHe Delta C Hvb H2) as (C' & Ht & HB0 & HB1).
    exists C'. split; [econstructor; assumption|]. split; assumption.
  - (* Drop *)
    destruct (IHe Delta C Hvb H2) as (C' & Ht & HB0 & HB1).
    exists C'. split; [econstructor; assumption|]. split; assumption.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Frame lifting helpers: refs at all keys untouched by the local rule *)
(* agree between [ρ ∪ ρf] and [ρ' ∪ ρf], using the UnionFrame          *)
(* accessors.  Keys [i] and [n] are the only keys a single-focus rule *)
(* may change.                                                        *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma refs_at_union_eq_off (ρ ρ' ρf : cfg) (i n : nat) :
  ρ ##ₘ ρf -> ρ' ##ₘ ρf ->
  (forall a, a <> i -> a <> n -> ρ' !! a = ρ !! a) ->
  forall a, a <> i -> a <> n ->
    refs_at (ρ' ∪ ρf) a = refs_at (ρ ∪ ρf) a.
Proof.
  intros Hd Hd' Hsame a Hai Han.
  destruct (ρ !! a) as [o|] eqn:E.
  - assert (E' : ρ' !! a = Some o).
    { rewrite Hsame by assumption. exact E. }
    rewrite (refs_at_union_l ρ ρf a Hd) by (rewrite E; discriminate).
    rewrite (refs_at_union_l ρ' ρf a Hd') by (rewrite E'; discriminate).
    unfold refs_at. rewrite E, E'. reflexivity.
  - assert (E' : ρ' !! a = None).
    { rewrite Hsame by assumption. exact E. }
    rewrite (refs_at_union_r ρ ρf a E).
    rewrite (refs_at_union_r ρ' ρf a E').
    reflexivity.
Qed.

(* If every key off [i,n] is literally unchanged and [i,n] are the only
   keys where the local rule acts, this is the exact equality needed as
   the "other" hypothesis of all the rule-shape lemmas. *)
Lemma refs_at_union_eq_off_live (ρ ρ' ρf : cfg) (i n : nat) :
  ρ ##ₘ ρf -> ρ' ##ₘ ρf ->
  (forall a, a <> i -> a <> n -> ρ' !! a = ρ !! a) ->
  (forall a, a <> i -> a <> n ->
    refs_at (ρ' ∪ ρf) a = refs_at (ρ ∪ ρf) a).
Proof. intros. eapply refs_at_union_eq_off; eauto. Qed.

Print Assumptions refs_at_union_eq_off.
Print Assumptions refs_at_union_eq_off_live.
EOF

Instance tt_lockstate_eq_dec : EqDecision lockstate.
Proof. intros x y. unfold Decision. decide equality. Defined.

Record token_ctx := {
  tok_lock : nat -> lockcap -> nat;
  tok_bar  : nat -> nat
}.

Definition tc_zero : token_ctx :=
  {| tok_lock := fun _ _ => 0; tok_bar := fun _ => 0 |}.

Definition tc_add (C1 C2 : token_ctx) : token_ctx :=
  {| tok_lock := fun n lc => tok_lock C1 n lc + tok_lock C2 n lc;
     tok_bar  := fun n => tok_bar C1 n + tok_bar C2 n |}.

Definition tc_lock_one (n : nat) (lc : lockcap) : token_ctx :=
  {| tok_lock := fun n' lc' => if decide (n' = n /\ lc' = lc) then 1 else 0;
     tok_bar  := fun _ => 0 |}.

Definition tc_bar_one (n : nat) : token_ctx :=
  {| tok_lock := fun _ _ => 0;
     tok_bar  := fun n' => if decide (n' = n) then 1 else 0 |}.

Definition lock_count (C : token_ctx) (n : nat) : nat :=
  tok_lock C n (Owner,Opened) +
  tok_lock C n (Owner,Closed) +
  tok_lock C n (Client,Opened) +
  tok_lock C n (Client,Closed).

(* At most one token for an index, counting lock and barrier tokens
   together.  This is the invariant that rules out a Release whose
   payload mentions its own destination lock. *)
Definition index_single (C : token_ctx) : Prop :=
  forall n, lock_count C n + tok_bar C n <= 1.

Definition has_index_token (C : token_ctx) (n : nat) : Prop :=
  (exists lc, 0 < tok_lock C n lc) \/ 0 < tok_bar C n.

Lemma lock_count_nonneg C n lc : 0 <= tok_lock C n lc.
Proof. lia. Qed.

Lemma lock_count_le_sum C n lc :
  tok_lock C n lc <= lock_count C n.
Proof.
  unfold lock_count. destruct lc as [lo st]; destruct lo; destruct st; lia.
Qed.

Lemma tc_add_lock_count C1 C2 n :
  lock_count (tc_add C1 C2) n = lock_count C1 n + lock_count C2 n.
Proof. unfold lock_count, tc_add. simpl. lia. Qed.

Lemma tc_add_bar C1 C2 n :
  tok_bar (tc_add C1 C2) n = tok_bar C1 n + tok_bar C2 n.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

(* resources are not duplicated across alternatives.  For syntactic  *)
(* safety we take the branch context as an upper bound (the union of  *)
(* all alternatives' tokens).                                         *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition tenv := string -> token_ctx.

Inductive tokEL (beta : nat -> option (type * type)) :

Fixpoint var_budget (x : string) (e : expr) : nat :=
  match e with
  | Val _ => 0
  | Var y => if decide (x = y) then 1 else 0
  | Fun y e => if decide (x = y) then 0 else var_budget x e
  | App e1 e2 => var_budget x e1 + var_budget x e2
  | Unit => 0
  | Pair e1 e2 => var_budget x e1 + var_budget x e2
  | LetPair e1 e2 => var_budget x e1 + var_budget x e2
  | Sum _ e => var_budget x e
  | MatchSum _ e es =>
      var_budget x e + fin_max (fun i => var_budget x (es i))
  | ForkBarrier e => var_budget x e
  | NewLock e => var_budget x e
  | ForkLock e1 e2 => var_budget x e1 + var_budget x e2
  | Acquire e => var_budget x e
  | Release e1 e2 => var_budget x e1 + var_budget x e2
  | Wait e => var_budget x e

  end.

Inductive tokEL (beta : nat -> option (type * type)) :
    tenv -> expr -> token_ctx -> Prop :=
  | TLE_Var Delta x C :
      Delta x = C ->
      tokEL beta Delta (Var x) C
  | TLE_Val Delta v C :
      tokVL beta v C ->
      tokEL beta Delta (Val v) C
  | TLE_Fun Delta x e C :
      tokEL beta (tenv_bind Delta x) e C ->
      tokEL beta Delta (Fun x e) C
  | TLE_App Delta e1 e2 C1 C2 :
      tokEL beta Delta e1 C1 -> tokEL beta Delta e2 C2 ->
      tokEL beta Delta (App e1 e2) (tc_add C1 C2)
  | TLE_Unit Delta :
      tokEL beta Delta Unit tc_zero
  | TLE_Pair Delta e1 e2 C1 C2 :
      tokEL beta Delta e1 C1 -> tokEL beta Delta e2 C2 ->
      tokEL beta Delta (Pair e1 e2) (tc_add C1 C2)
  | TLE_LetPair Delta e1 e2 C1 C2 :
      tokEL beta Delta e1 C1 -> tokEL beta Delta e2 C2 ->
      tokEL beta Delta (LetPair e1 e2) (tc_add C1 C2)
  | TLE_Sum Delta n e C :
      tokEL beta Delta e C ->
      tokEL beta Delta (Sum n e) C
  | TLE_MatchSum Delta n e es Cs Cb Cbs :
      tokEL beta Delta e Cs ->
      (forall i, tokEL beta Delta (es i) (Cbs i)) ->
      (forall i, tc_le (Cbs i) Cb) ->
      (n = 0 -> Cb = tc_zero) ->
      tokEL beta Delta (MatchSum n e es) (tc_add Cs Cb)
  | TLE_ForkBarrier Delta e C :
      tokEL beta Delta e C ->
      tokEL beta Delta (ForkBarrier e) C
  | TLE_NewLock Delta e C :
      tokEL beta Delta e C ->
      tokEL beta Delta (NewLock e) C
  | TLE_ForkLock Delta e1 e2 C1 C2 :
      tokEL beta Delta e1 C1 -> tokEL beta Delta e2 C2 ->
      tokEL beta Delta (ForkLock e1 e2) (tc_add C1 C2)
  | TLE_Acquire Delta e C :
      tokEL beta Delta e C ->
      tokEL beta Delta (Acquire e) C
  | TLE_Release Delta e1 e2 C1 C2 :
      tokEL beta Delta e1 C1 -> tokEL beta Delta e2 C2 ->
      tokEL beta Delta (Release e1 e2) (tc_add C1 C2)
  | TLE_Wait Delta e C :
      tokEL beta Delta e C ->
      tokEL beta Delta (Wait e) C
  | TLE_Drop Delta e C :
      tokEL beta Delta e C ->
      tokEL beta Delta (Drop e) C

      tokVL beta v1 C1 -> tokVL beta v2 C2 ->
      tokVL beta (PairV v1 v2) (tc_add C1 C2)
  | TVL_Sum n v C :
      tokVL beta v C ->
      tokVL beta (SumV n v) C
  | TVL_Barrier n t1 t2 :
      beta n = Some (t1, t2) ->
      tokVL beta (BarrierV n) (tc_bar_one n)
  | TVL_Lock n lc :
      tokVL beta (LockV n) (tc_lock_one n lc).

Definition tenv_update (Delta : tenv) (x : string) (C : token_ctx) : tenv :=
  fun y => if decide (y = x) then C else Delta y.

Definition tenv_eqv (D1 D2 : tenv) : Prop := forall x, D1 x = D2 x.

Lemma tenv_eqv_refl D : tenv_eqv D D.
Proof. intro x. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma tenv_eqv_sym D1 D2 : tenv_eqv D1 D2 -> tenv_eqv D2 D1.
Proof. intros H x. symmetry. apply H. Qed.

Lemma tenv_eqv_trans D1 D2 D3 :
  tenv_eqv D1 D2 -> tenv_eqv D2 D3 -> tenv_eqv D1 D3.
Proof. intros H1 H2 x. rewrite H1. apply H2. Qed.

Lemma tenv_update_same Delta x C : tenv_update Delta x C x = C.
Proof. unfold tenv_update. destruct (decide (x = x)); [reflexivity|exfalso; apply n; reflexivity]. Qed.

Lemma tenv_update_neq Delta x y C (H : y <> x) :
  tenv_update Delta x C y = Delta y.
Proof.
  unfold tenv_update. destruct (decide (y = x)); [exfalso; apply H; exact e|reflexivity].
Qed.

Lemma tenv_eqv_bind Delta1 Delta2 x :
  tenv_eqv Delta1 Delta2 -> tenv_eqv (tenv_bind Delta1 x) (tenv_bind Delta2 x).
Proof.
  intros H y. unfold tenv_bind.
  destruct (decide (y = x)); [reflexivity|apply H].
Qed.

Lemma tenv_bind_update_same Delta x C :
  tenv_eqv (tenv_bind (tenv_update Delta x C) x) (tenv_bind Delta x).
Proof.
  intro y. unfold tenv_bind.
  destruct (decide (y = x)) as [->|H].
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite tenv_update_neq by exact H. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma tenv_bind_update_neq Delta x y C (H : y <> x) :
  tenv_eqv (tenv_bind (tenv_update Delta x C) y)

Proof.

  destruct (decide (z = y)) as [->|Hy].
  - destruct (decide (y = x)); [contradiction|reflexivity].
  - destruct (decide (z = x)) as [->|Hx]; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma var_budget_subst_same x a e :
  var_budget x (subst x a e) = 0.

Lemma forest_fresh_hub_move (S T : nat -> gset nat) (i n : nat) (B : gset nat) :
  pair_ok_fun S ->
  forest_fun S ->
  (forall a, n ∉ S a) ->
  i <> n -> i ∉ B ->
  (forall r, r ∈ B -> r ∈ S i) ->
  T n = B ->
  (forall a, a ∈ T i -> a ∈ S i \/ a = n) ->
  (forall a, a <> i -> a <> n -> forall b, b ∈ T a -> b ∈ S a) ->
  (forall r, r ∈ B -> r ∉ T i) ->
  forest_fun T.
Proof.
  intros Hpair Hforest Hfresh Hin HiB HB HTn HTi Hother HnoDup.
  assert (HnB : n ∉ B).
  { intro HnB. apply (Hfresh i). exact (HB n HnB). }
  assert (HV : forest_fun (fresh_hub_vertex S i n)).
  { apply forest_attach_leaf; assumption. }
  eapply (forest_star_shape (fresh_hub_vertex S i n) T n i B).
  - (* edge inclusion: target edges are source edges or star edges at [n]. *)
    intros a b [Hne [Hb|Ha]].

Lemma refs_at_union_eq_off (ρ ρ' ρf : cfg) (i n : nat) :
  ρ ##ₘ ρf -> ρ' ##ₘ ρf ->
  (forall a, a <> i -> a <> n -> ρ' !! a = ρ !! a) ->
  forall a, a <> i -> a <> n ->
    refs_at (ρ' ∪ ρf) a = refs_at (ρ ∪ ρf) a.
Proof.
  intros Hd Hd' Hsame a Hai Han.
  destruct (ρ !! a) as [o|] eqn:E.
  - assert (E' : ρ' !! a = Some o).
    { rewrite Hsame by assumption. exact E. }
    rewrite (refs_at_union_l ρ ρf a Hd) by (rewrite E; discriminate).
    rewrite (refs_at_union_l ρ' ρf a Hd') by (rewrite E'; discriminate).
    unfold refs_at. rewrite E, E'. reflexivity.
  - assert (E' : ρ' !! a = None).
    { rewrite Hsame by assumption. exact E. }
    rewrite (refs_at_union_r ρ ρf a E).
    rewrite (refs_at_union_r ρ' ρf a E').
    reflexivity.
Qed.

(* If every key off [i,n] is literally unchanged and [i,n] are the only
   keys where the local rule acts, this is the exact equality needed as
   the "other" hypothesis of all the rule-shape lemmas. *)
Lemma refs_at_union_eq_off_live (ρ ρ' ρf : cfg) (i n : nat) :
  ρ ##ₘ ρf -> ρ' ##ₘ ρf ->
  (forall a, a <> i -> a <> n -> ρ' !! a = ρ !! a) ->
  (forall a, a <> i -> a <> n ->
    refs_at (ρ' ∪ ρf) a = refs_at (ρ ∪ ρf) a).
Proof. intros. eapply refs_at_union_eq_off; eauto. Qed.

Theorem NewLock_pair_preserve v k i n :
  i <> n -> ctx k ->
  ref_pair_ok_fun (refs_at ({[i := Thread (k (NewLock (Val v)))]} : cfg)) ->
  n ∉ refs_at ({[i := Thread (k (NewLock (Val v)))]} : cfg) i ->
  ref_pair_ok_fun
    (refs_at ({[i := Thread (k (Val (LockV n)));
                 n := Lock 0 (Some v)]} : cfg)).
Proof.
  intros Hin Hk Hpair Hfreshn.
  eapply newlock_pair_shape with
    (S := refs_at ({[i := Thread (k (NewLock (Val v)))]} : cfg))
    (T := refs_at ({[i := Thread (k (Val (LockV n)));
                       n := Lock 0 (Some v)]} : cfg))
    (i := i) (n := n) (B := val_refs v).
  - exact Hpair.
  - intro E. apply Hin. symmetry. exact E.
  - intros a. destruct (decide (a = i)) as [E|Hai].
    + subst a. exact Hfreshn.
    + destruct (decide (a = n)) as [E|Han].
      * subst a. rewrite newlock_src_refs_other with (v:=v) (k:=k) (i:=i) (n:=n) by assumption.
        set_solver.
      * rewrite newlock_src_refs_other with (v:=v) (k:=k) (i:=i) (n:=n) by assumption.
        set_solver.
  - (* B ⊆ S i *)
    rewrite newlock_src_refs_i with (n := n) by exact Hin.
    change (expr_refs (NewLock (Val v)) ⊆ expr_refs (k (NewLock (Val v)))).
    apply ctx_expr_refs. exact Hk.
  - (* T n = B *)
    rewrite newlock_tgt_refs_n by exact Hin. reflexivity.
  - (* T i ⊆ S i ∪ {[n]} *)
    rewrite newlock_tgt_refs_i by exact Hin.
    rewrite newlock_src_refs_i with (n := n) by exact Hin.
    rewrite (ctx_expr_refs_eq k Hk (Val (LockV n))).
    rewrite (ctx_expr_refs_eq k Hk (NewLock (Val v))).
    simpl. set_solver.
  - (* other keys are unchanged: both sides are empty *)
    intros a Hai Han.
    rewrite newlock_tgt_refs_other with (v:=v) (k:=k) (i:=i) (n:=n) by assumption.
    rewrite newlock_src_refs_other with (v:=v) (k:=k) (i:=i) (n:=n) by assumption.
    reflexivity.
Qed.

Print Assumptions NewLock_pair_preserve.

Theorem NewLock_forest_preserve v k i n :
  i <> n -> ctx k ->
  ref_pair_ok_fun (refs_at ({[i := Thread (k (NewLock (Val v)))]} : cfg)) ->
  forest_fun (refs_at ({[i := Thread (k (NewLock (Val v)))]} : cfg)) ->
  (forall a, n ∉ refs_at ({[i := Thread (k (NewLock (Val v)))]} : cfg) a) ->
  (forall b, b ∈ val_refs v ->
     b ∉ refs_at ({[i := Thread (k (Val (LockV n)));
                      n := Lock 0 (Some v)]} : cfg) i) ->
  forest_fun
    (refs_at ({[i := Thread (k (Val (LockV n)));
                 n := Lock 0 (Some v)]} : cfg)).
Proof.
  intros Hin Hk Hpair Hforest Hfresh HnoDup.
  eapply forest_fresh_hub_move with
    (S := refs_at ({[i := Thread (k (NewLock (Val v)))]} : cfg))
---
Lemma ref_pair_ok_union (ρ ρf : cfg) :
  ρ ##ₘ ρf ->
  ref_pair_ok ρ -> ref_pair_ok ρf ->
  (forall a b, ρ !! a <> None -> ρf !! b <> None ->
     ~ (b ∈ refs_at ρ a /\ a ∈ refs_at ρf b)) ->
  ref_pair_ok (ρ ∪ ρf).
Proof.
  intros Hd [Hself Hpair] [Hselff Hpairf] Hcross.
  split.
  - (* self-freeness *)
    unfold self_ref_free in *.

Lemma sync_pair_shape (S T : nat -> gset nat) (i j : nat) (B2 : gset nat) :
  ref_pair_ok_fun S ->
  i <> j ->
  i ∉ B2 ->
  (forall b, b ∈ B2 -> i ∉ S b) ->
  T i ⊆ S i ∪ B2 ->
  (forall a, a <> i -> T a ⊆ S a) ->
  ref_pair_ok_fun T.
Proof.
  intros Hpair Hij HiB Hside HTi Hsub.
  set (T1 := fun a => if decide (a = i) then S i ∪ B2 else S a).
  assert (HT1i : T1 i = S i ∪ B2).
  { unfold T1. destruct (decide (i = i)) as [E|H]; [reflexivity|exfalso; apply H; reflexivity]. }
  assert (HT1other : forall a, a <> i -> T1 a = S a).
  { intros a Hai. unfold T1. destruct (decide (a = i)) as [E|H]; [exfalso; apply Hai; exact E|reflexivity]. }
  assert (Hpair1 : ref_pair_ok_fun T1).
  { eapply pair_move_to_dest with (S := S) (T := T1) (d := i) (s := j) (B := B2).
    - exact Hpair.
    - exact Hij.
    - exact HT1i.
    - rewrite HT1other; [reflexivity| apply (ne_sym Hij)].
    - intros a Hai Haj. apply HT1other. exact Hai.
    - exact HiB.
    - intros b Hb.
      assert (Hbne : b <> i) by (intro E; subst b; exact (HiB Hb)).
      rewrite (HT1other b Hbne). exact (Hside b Hb). }
  eapply ref_pair_ok_shrink_fun with (S := T1).
  - intros a. destruct (decide (a = i)) as [E|Hai].
    + subst a. rewrite HT1i. exact HTi.
    + rewrite HT1other; [apply Hsub; exact Hai| exact Hai].
  - exact Hpair1.
Qed.

Lemma kind_sync_pair (ρ : cfg) (i j : nat) (ei ej : expr) (v2 : val)
    (B2 : gset nat) (T : nat -> gset nat) :
  ref_pair_ok_fun (refs_at ρ) ->
  kind_live ρ ->
  refs_live ρ ->
  ρ !! i = Some (Thread ei) ->
  ρ !! j = Some (Thread ej) ->
  (forall b, b ∈ val_refs v2 -> b ∈ expr_refs ej) ->
  B2 = val_refs v2 ->
  T i ⊆ refs_at ρ i ∪ B2 ->
  (forall a, a <> i -> T a ⊆ refs_at ρ a) ->
  i <> j ->
  ref_pair_ok_fun T.
Proof.
  intros Hpair Hkind Hrl Hi Hj Hsub HB2 HTi HsubT Hij.
  destruct (kind_live_bundle_from_thread_side ρ j i ej ei v2
              Hkind Hrl Hj Hi Hsub) as [HiB Hside].
  assert (HiB' : i ∉ B2) by (rewrite HB2; exact HiB).
  assert (Hside' : forall b, b ∈ B2 -> i ∉ refs_at ρ b).
  { intros b Hb. apply Hside. rewrite HB2 in Hb. exact Hb. }
  eapply sync_pair_shape with (S := refs_at ρ) (j := j); eauto.
Qed.

(* The exact extra invariant needed at Release into a lock [n]. *)
Definition lock_store_safe (ρ : cfg) (n : nat) (v : val) : Prop :=
  n ∉ val_refs v /\ (forall b, b ∈ val_refs v -> n ∉ refs_at ρ b).

(* Release shape, with the exact extra invariant as an explicit input. *)
Lemma kind_release_pair (ρ : cfg) (i n : nat) (v : val) (B : gset nat)
    (T : nat -> gset nat) :
  ref_pair_ok_fun (refs_at ρ) ->
  i <> n ->
  B = val_refs v ->
  i ∉ B ->
  lock_store_safe ρ n v ->
  T n = refs_at ρ n ∪ B ->
  T i ⊆ refs_at ρ i ->
  (forall a, a <> n -> a <> i -> T a = refs_at ρ a) ->
  ref_pair_ok_fun T.
Proof.
  intros Hpair Hin HB HiB [HnB Hside] HTn HTi Hother.
  assert (HnB' : n ∉ B) by (rewrite HB; exact HnB).
  assert (Hrev : forall b, b ∈ B -> n ∉ T b).
  { intros b Hb HnT.
    assert (Hbn : b <> n) by (intro E; subst b; exact (HnB' Hb)).
    assert (Hbi : b <> i) by (intro E; subst b; exact (HiB Hb)).
    rewrite (Hother b Hbn Hbi) in HnT.
    apply (Hside b); [rewrite HB in Hb; exact Hb|exact HnT]. }
  eapply release_pair_shape with (S := refs_at ρ) (n := n) (i := i); eauto.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Context decomposition and contextual replacement.                  *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* The continuation carried by [tokEL_ctx1_hole] is essential: the    *)
(* token grammar is not context-deterministic (the MatchSum upper     *)
(* bound may be enlarged), so we must rebuild against the very hole   *)
(* context that occurs in the given derivation, not an arbitrary one. *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma tokEL_forklock_inv beta Delta e1 e2 C
    (H : tokEL beta Delta (ForkLock e1 e2) C) :
  exists C1 C2, C = tc_add C1 C2 /\
    tokEL beta Delta e1 C1 /\ tokEL beta Delta e2 C2.
Proof. inversion H; subst; eauto. Qed.

Lemma tokEL_forkbarrier_inv beta Delta e C
    (H : tokEL beta Delta (ForkBarrier e) C) : tokEL beta Delta e C.
Proof. inversion H; subst; assumption. Qed.

Lemma tokEL_newlock_inv beta Delta e C
    (H : tokEL beta Delta (NewLock e) C) : tokEL beta Delta e C.
Proof. inversion H; subst; assumption. Qed.

Lemma tokEL_acquire_inv beta Delta e C
    (H : tokEL beta Delta (Acquire e) C) : tokEL beta Delta e C.
Proof. inversion H; subst; assumption. Qed.

Lemma tokEL_wait_inv beta Delta e C
    (H : tokEL beta Delta (Wait e) C) : tokEL beta Delta e C.
Proof. inversion H; subst; assumption. Qed.

Lemma tokEL_drop_inv beta Delta e C
    (H : tokEL beta Delta (Drop e) C) : tokEL beta Delta e C.
Proof. inversion H; subst; assumption. Qed.

Lemma tokEL_ctx1_hole beta Delta k (Hk : ctx1 k) e C
    (H : tokEL beta Delta (k e) C) :
  exists Ce,
    tokEL beta Delta e Ce /\
    tc_le Ce C /\
    (forall e' Ce', tokEL beta Delta e' Ce' -> tc_le Ce' Ce ->
       exists C', tokEL beta Delta (k e') C' /\ tc_le C' C).
Proof.
  revert e C H.
  induction Hk; intros ee C H; simpl in H.
  - (* App left *)
    destruct (tokEL_app_inv beta Delta ee e C H) as (C1 & C2 & E & H1 & H2).
    subst C. exists C1. split; [exact H1|]. split; [apply tc_le_add_l|].
    intros e' Ce' He' Hle'. exists (tc_add Ce' C2). split.
    + econstructor; [exact He'|exact H2].
    + apply tc_le_add_mono; [exact Hle'|apply tc_le_refl].
  - (* App right *)
    destruct (tokEL_app_inv beta Delta e ee C H) as (C1 & C2 & E & H1 & H2).
    subst C. exists C2. split; [exact H2|]. split; [apply tc_le_add_r|].
    intros e' Ce' He' Hle'. exists (tc_add C1 Ce'). split.
    + econstructor; [exact H1|exact He'].
    + apply tc_le_add_mono; [apply tc_le_refl|exact Hle'].
  - (* Pair left *)
    destruct (tokEL_pair_inv beta Delta ee e C H) as (C1 & C2 & E & H1 & H2).
    subst C. exists C1. split; [exact H1|]. split; [apply tc_le_add_l|].
    intros e' Ce' He' Hle'. exists (tc_add Ce' C2). split.
    + econstructor; [exact He'|exact H2].
    + apply tc_le_add_mono; [exact Hle'|apply tc_le_refl].
  - (* Pair right *)
    destruct (tokEL_pair_inv beta Delta e ee C H) as (C1 & C2 & E & H1 & H2).
    subst C. exists C2. split; [exact H2|]. split; [apply tc_le_add_r|].
    intros e' Ce' He' Hle'. exists (tc_add C1 Ce'). split.
    + econstructor; [exact H1|exact He'].
    + apply tc_le_add_mono; [apply tc_le_refl|exact Hle'].
  - (* LetPair *)
    destruct (tokEL_letpair_inv beta Delta ee e C H) as (C1 & C2 & E & H1 & H2).
    subst C. exists C1. split; [exact H1|]. split; [apply tc_le_add_l|].
    intros e' Ce' He' Hle'. exists (tc_add Ce' C2). split.
    + econstructor; [exact He'|exact H2].
    + apply tc_le_add_mono; [exact Hle'|apply tc_le_refl].
  - (* Sum *) exists C. split.
    + apply (tokEL_sum_inv beta Delta i ee C H).
    + split; [apply tc_le_refl|].
      intros e' Ce' He' Hle'. exists Ce'. split.
      * econstructor. exact He'.
      * exact Hle'.
  - (* MatchSum *)
    destruct (tokEL_matchsum_inv beta Delta n ee es C H)
      as (Cs & Cb & Cbs & E & Hs & Hbranches & Hle & Hzero).
    subst C. exists Cs. split; [exact Hs|]. split; [apply tc_le_add_l|].
    intros e' Ce' He' Hle'. exists (tc_add Ce' Cb). split.
    + eapply TLE_MatchSum with (Cs := Ce') (Cb := Cb) (Cbs := Cbs).
      * exact He'.
      * exact Hbranches.
      * exact Hle.
      * exact Hzero.
    + apply tc_le_add_mono; [exact Hle'|apply tc_le_refl].
  - (* ForkBarrier *) exists C. split.
    + apply (tokEL_forkbarrier_inv beta Delta ee C H).
    + split; [apply tc_le_refl|].
      intros e' Ce' He' Hle'. exists Ce'. split.
      * econstructor. exact He'.
      * exact Hle'.
  - (* NewLock *) exists C. split.
    + apply (tokEL_newlock_inv beta Delta ee C H).
    + split; [apply tc_le_refl|].
      intros e' Ce' He' Hle'. exists Ce'. split.
      * econstructor. exact He'.
      * exact Hle'.
  - (* ForkLock left *)
    destruct (tokEL_forklock_inv beta Delta ee e C H) as (C1 & C2 & E & H1 & H2).
    subst C. exists C1. split; [exact H1|]. split; [apply tc_le_add_l|].
    intros e' Ce' He' Hle'. exists (tc_add Ce' C2). split.
    + econstructor; [exact He'|exact H2].
    + apply tc_le_add_mono; [exact Hle'|apply tc_le_refl].
  - (* ForkLock right *)
    destruct (tokEL_forklock_inv beta Delta e ee C H) as (C1 & C2 & E & H1 & H2).
    subst C. exists C2. split; [exact H2|]. split; [apply tc_le_add_r|].
    intros e' Ce' He' Hle'. exists (tc_add C1 Ce'). split.
    + econstructor; [exact H1|exact He'].
    + apply tc_le_add_mono; [apply tc_le_refl|exact Hle'].
  - (* Acquire *) exists C. split.
    + apply (tokEL_acquire_inv beta Delta ee C H).
    + split; [apply tc_le_refl|].
      intros e' Ce' He' Hle'. exists Ce'. split.
      * econstructor. exact He'.
      * exact Hle'.
  - (* Release left *)
    destruct (tokEL_release_inv beta Delta ee e C H) as (C1 & C2 & E & H1 & H2).
    subst C. exists C1. split; [exact H1|]. split; [apply tc_le_add_l|].
    intros e' Ce' He' Hle'. exists (tc_add Ce' C2). split.
    + econstructor; [exact He'|exact H2].
    + apply tc_le_add_mono; [exact Hle'|apply tc_le_refl].
  - (* Release right *)
    destruct (tokEL_release_inv beta Delta e ee C H) as (C1 & C2 & E & H1 & H2).
    subst C. exists C2. split; [exact H2|]. split; [apply tc_le_add_r|].
    intros e' Ce' He' Hle'. exists (tc_add C1 Ce'). split.
    + econstructor; [exact H1|exact He'].
    + apply tc_le_add_mono; [apply tc_le_refl|exact Hle'].
  - (* Wait *) exists C. split.
    + apply (tokEL_wait_inv beta Delta ee C H).
    + split; [apply tc_le_refl|].
      intros e' Ce' He' Hle'. exists Ce'. split.
      * econstructor. exact He'.
      * exact Hle'.
  - (* Drop *) exists C. split.
    + apply (tokEL_drop_inv beta Delta ee C H).
    + split; [apply tc_le_refl|].
      intros e' Ce' He' Hle'. exists Ce'. split.
      * econstructor. exact He'.
      * exact Hle'.
Qed.

Lemma tokEL_ctx_hole beta Delta k (Hk : ctx k) e C
    (H : tokEL beta Delta (k e) C) :
  exists Ce,
    tokEL beta Delta e Ce /\
    tc_le Ce C /\
    (forall e' Ce', tokEL beta Delta e' Ce' -> tc_le Ce' Ce ->
       exists C', tokEL beta Delta (k e') C' /\ tc_le C' C).
Proof.
  revert e C H.
  induction Hk as [| k1 k2 Hk1 Hk2 IH2].
  - (* id *) intros e C H. exists C. split; [exact H|].
    split; [apply tc_le_refl|].
    intros e' Ce' He' Hle'. exists Ce'. split; assumption.
  - (* composition *) intros e C H. simpl in H.
    destruct (IH2 (k2 e) C H) as
      (Ck2 & Hk2e & Hle1 & Reb1).
    assert (Hk2' : ctx k2) by exact Hk2.
    destruct (tokEL_ctx_hole beta Delta k2 Hk2 e Ck2 Hk2e) as
      (Ce & He & Hle2 & Reb2).
    exists Ce. split; [exact He|]. split.
    + eapply tc_le_trans; [exact Hle2|exact Hle1].
    + intros e' Ce' He' Hle'.
      destruct (Reb2 e' Ce' He' Hle') as (C2' & Hk2e' & Hle2').
      destruct (Reb1 (k2 e') C2' Hk2e' Hle2') as (C' & Hk1e' & Hle1').
      exists C'. split; [exact Hk1e'|exact Hle1'].
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Pure-step preservation through an arbitrary evaluation context.    *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma tokEL_pure_step_ctx beta k e e' C
    (Hk : ctx k)
    (Htok : tokEL beta tenv_zero (k e) C)
    (Hstep : pure_step e e')
    (Hbeta : forall x body a C1 C2,
        e = App (Val (FunV x body)) (Val a) ->
        tokEL beta tenv_zero body C1 ->
        tokVL beta a C2 ->
        var_budget x body <= 1 \/ C2 = tc_zero) :
  exists C', tokEL beta tenv_zero (k e') C' /\ tc_le C' C.
Proof.
  destruct (tokEL_ctx_hole beta tenv_zero k Hk e C Htok) as
    (Ce & He & HleC & Reb).
  destruct (tokEL_pure_step_direct beta e e' Ce He Hstep Hbeta) as
    (Ce' & He' & Hle).
  destruct (Reb e' Ce' He' Hle) as (C' & Hk' & Hle').
  exists C'. split; [exact Hk'|].
  eapply tc_le_trans; [exact Hle'|exact HleC].
Qed.

Inductive expr :=

  | Pair : expr -> expr -> expr
  | LetPair : expr -> expr -> expr
  | Sum : nat -> expr -> expr
  | MatchSum n : expr -> (fin n -> expr) -> expr

  | ForkBarrier : expr -> expr

  | Acquire : expr -> expr
  | Release : expr -> expr -> expr
  | Wait : expr -> expr

with val :=

  | UnitV : val
  | PairV : val -> val -> val
  | SumV : nat -> val -> val
  | BarrierV : nat -> val
  | LockV : nat -> val.

Inductive linearity := Lin | Unr.

Inductive lockstate := Opened | Closed.

Inductive lockownership := Owner | Client.

Definition lockcap : Type := lockownership * lockstate.

Inductive lockownership_split : lockownership -> lockownership -> lockownership -> Prop :=
  | lo_split_1 : lockownership_split Owner Client Owner
  | lo_split_2 : lockownership_split Owner Owner Client
  | lo_split_3 : lockownership_split Client Client Client.

Inductive lockstate_split : lockstate -> lockstate -> lockstate -> Prop :=
  | ls_split_1 : lockstate_split Opened Closed Opened
  | ls_split_2 : lockstate_split Opened Opened Closed
  | ls_split_3 : lockstate_split Closed Closed Closed.

Definition lockcap_split l1 l2 l3 :=
  lockownership_split l1.1 l2.1 l3.1 ∧ lockstate_split l1.2 l2.2 l3.2.

CoInductive type :=
  | FunT : linearity -> type -> type -> type
  | UnitT : type
  | PairT : type -> type -> type
  | SumT n : (fin n -> type) -> type
  | LockT : lockcap -> type -> type.

CoInductive unr : type -> Prop :=
  | Fun_unr t1 t2 : unr (FunT Unr t1 t2)
  | Unit_unr : unr UnitT
  | Pair_unr t1 t2 : unr t1 -> unr t2 -> unr (PairT t1 t2)
  | Sum_unr n ts : (∀ i, unr (ts i)) -> unr (SumT n ts).

Definition env := gmap string type.

Definition env_unr (Γ : env) :=
  ∀ x t, Γ !! x = Some t -> unr t.

Definition disj (Γ1 Γ2 : env) :=
  ∀ i t1 t2, Γ1 !! i = Some t1 -> Γ2 !! i = Some t2 -> t1 = t2 ∧ unr t1.

Definition env_bind (Γ' : env) (x : string) (t : type) (Γ : env) :=

Definition env_var (Γ : env) (x : string) (t : type) :=
  ∃ Γ', Γ = <[ x := t ]> Γ' ∧ env_unr Γ'.

Inductive typed : env -> expr -> type -> Prop :=

    env_var Γ x t ->

  | Fun_typed Γ Γ' x e t1 t2 l :

From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Export langdef.

Fixpoint expr_refs e :=
  match e with
  | Val v => val_refs v
  | Var x => ∅
  | Fun x e => expr_refs e
  | App e1 e2 => expr_refs e1 ∪ expr_refs e2
  | Unit => ∅
  | Pair e1 e2 => expr_refs e1 ∪ expr_refs e2
  | LetPair e1 e2 => expr_refs e1 ∪ expr_refs e2
  | Sum i e => expr_refs e
  | MatchSum n e es => expr_refs e ∪ fin_union n (expr_refs ∘ es)
  | ForkBarrier e => expr_refs e
  | NewLock e => expr_refs e
  | ForkLock e1 e2 => expr_refs e1 ∪ expr_refs e2
  | Acquire e => expr_refs e
  | Release e1 e2 => expr_refs e1 ∪ expr_refs e2
  | Wait e => expr_refs e
  | Drop e => expr_refs e
  end
with val_refs v :=
  match v with
  | FunV x e => expr_refs e
  | UnitV => ∅
  | PairV v1 v2 => val_refs v1 ∪ val_refs v2
  | SumV i v => val_refs v
  | BarrierV i => {[ i ]}
  | LockV i => {[ i ]}
  end.

Definition obj_refs x :=
  match x with
  | Thread e => expr_refs e
  | Barrier => ∅
  | Lock refcnt o =>
      match o with
      | Some v => val_refs v
      | None => ∅
      end
  end.

Inductive expr_head_waiting : expr -> nat -> Prop :=
  | Barrier_waiting j v :
    expr_head_waiting (App (Val $ BarrierV j) (Val v)) j
  | ForkLock_waiting j v :
    expr_head_waiting (ForkLock (Val $ LockV j) (Val v)) j
  | Acquire_waiting j :
    expr_head_waiting (Acquire (Val $ LockV j)) j
  | Release_waiting j v :
    expr_head_waiting (Release (Val $ LockV j) (Val v)) j
  | Wait_waiting j :
    expr_head_waiting (Wait (Val $ LockV j)) j
  | Drop_waiting j :
    expr_head_waiting (Drop (Val $ LockV j)) j.

Definition expr_waiting e j :=
  ∃ k e', ctx k ∧ e = k e' ∧ expr_head_waiting e' j.

Definition waiting (ρ : cfg) (i j : nat) :=
  (∃ e, ρ !! i = Some (Thread e) ∧ expr_waiting e j) ∨
  (∃ y, ρ !! j = Some y ∧ i ∈ obj_refs y ∧ ∀ e, y = Thread e -> ¬ expr_waiting e i).

Definition can_step (ρ : cfg) (i : nat) := ∃ ρ', step i ρ ρ'.

Definition inactive (ρ : cfg) (i : nat) := ρ !! i = None.

Inductive reachable (ρ : cfg) : nat -> Prop :=
  | Can_step_reachable i :
      can_step ρ i -> reachable ρ i
  | Waiting_reachable i j :
      waiting ρ i j -> reachable ρ j -> reachable ρ i.

Definition fully_reachable (ρ : cfg) :=
  ∀ i, inactive ρ i ∨ reachable ρ i.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Barrier endpoint typing, and Sync preservation.                     *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* Plain [wt] allows a [BarrierV n] to be used at ANY function type.   *)
(* Therefore two threads can synchronise on n with unrelated endpoint  *)
(* types and the result of Sync is not [wt] (see                   *)
(* ThreadTypedSyncCex.v).  The repair is to record, for every barrier  *)
(* endpoint occurrence, the oriented pair of endpoint types.           *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* [sync_endpoint_typing] below is the exact interface that such an    *)
(* oriented store must provide for one Sync redex:                     *)
(*   - the values carried by the two endpoints have the two endpoint   *)
(*     types;                                                          *)
(*   - the barrier occurrence in thread i has result type [t2];        *)
(*   - the barrier occurrence in thread j has result type [t1].        *)
(* The last two clauses say that the occurrences use the two opposite  *)
(* orientations of the same barrier AND that no other result type is   *)
(* possible for the occurrence.  The uniqueness part is essential:     *)
(* plain [BarrierVW] allows [BarrierV n] at every function type, so    *)
(* plain [wt] can never establish it (see ThreadTypedSyncCex.v).       *)
(* Consequently a store-backed / annotated typing relation, whose      *)
(* barrier rule consults the oriented store, must replace plain [wt]   *)
(* on barrier occurrences.  The lemma below is sound for any such      *)
(* store and is the local Sync-preservation step that store has to     *)
(* discharge.  Constructing the store invariant and preserving it      *)
(* across all local rules remains open; see the report.                *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition sync_src i j n k1 k2 v1 v2 : cfg :=
  {[ i := Thread (k1 (App (Val (BarrierV n)) (Val v1)));
     j := Thread (k2 (App (Val (BarrierV n)) (Val v2)));
     n := Barrier ]}.

Definition sync_tgt i j k1 k2 v1 v2 : cfg :=
  {[ i := Thread (k1 (Val v2));
     j := Thread (k2 (Val v1)) ]}.

Definition sync_endpoint_typing L n v1 v2 t1 t2 : Prop :=
  wt L ∅ (Val v1) t1 /\
  wt L ∅ (Val v2) t2 /\
  (forall s, wt L ∅ (App (Val (BarrierV n)) (Val v1)) s -> s = t2) /\
  (forall s, wt L ∅ (App (Val (BarrierV n)) (Val v2)) s -> s = t1).

Lemma sync_src_i i j n k1 k2 v1 v2 :
  sync_src i j n k1 k2 v1 v2 !! i =
  Some (Thread (k1 (App (Val (BarrierV n)) (Val v1)))).
Proof. unfold sync_src. apply lookup_insert_eq. Qed.

Lemma sync_src_j i j n k1 k2 v1 v2 (Hji : j <> i) (Hjn : j <> n) :
  sync_src i j n k1 k2 v1 v2 !! j =
  Some (Thread (k2 (App (Val (BarrierV n)) (Val v2)))).
Proof.
  unfold sync_src.
  change ((<[i := Thread (k1 (App (Val (BarrierV n)) (Val v1)))]>
            (<[j := Thread (k2 (App (Val (BarrierV n)) (Val v2)))]>
             (<[n := Barrier]> (∅ : cfg)))) !! j
          = Some (Thread (k2 (App (Val (BarrierV n)) (Val v2))))).

               (<[j := Thread (k2 (App (Val (BarrierV n)) (Val v2)))]>
                (<[n := Barrier]> (∅ : cfg)))) !! j
            = (<[j := Thread (k2 (App (Val (BarrierV n)) (Val v2)))]>
               (<[n := Barrier]> (∅ : cfg))) !! j).
  { apply lookup_insert_ne. congruence. }
  rewrite H. apply lookup_insert_eq.
Qed.

  sync_tgt i j k1 k2 v1 v2 !! i = Some (Thread (k1 (Val v2))).
Proof. unfold sync_tgt. apply lookup_insert_eq. Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* The per-thread token invariant, and its preservation by a pure     *)
(* step.  The extra [pure_beta_safe] premise is exactly the missing    *)
(* beta condition; see the report.                                    *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition pure_beta_safe beta (e : expr) : Prop :=
  forall x body a C1 C2,
    e = App (Val (FunV x body)) (Val a) ->
    tokEL beta tenv_zero body C1 ->
    tokVL beta a C2 ->
    var_budget x body <= 1 \/ C2 = tc_zero.

Definition token_single_threads_L beta (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i e, ρ !! i = Some (Thread e) ->
    exists C, tokEL beta tenv_zero e C /\ index_single C.

Lemma pure_step_token_single_threads_L beta i k e e'
    (Hk : ctx k)
    (Hstep : pure_step e e')
    (Hbeta : pure_beta_safe beta e)
    (Hinv : token_single_threads_L beta {[ i := Thread (k e) ]}) :
  token_single_threads_L beta {[ i := Thread (k e') ]}.
Proof.
  intros j e' Hlook.
  rewrite lookup_insert in Hlook.
  destruct (decide (j = i)) as [->|Hne].
  - rewrite lookup_insert_eq in Hlook. injection Hlook as ->.
    destruct (Hinv i (k e) lookup_insert_eq) as (C & Htok & Hsingle).
    destruct (tokEL_pure_step_ctx beta k e e' C Hk Htok Hstep Hbeta)
      as (C' & Htok' & Hle).
    exists C'. split; [exact Htok'|].
    apply (index_single_mono C' C Hle Hsingle).
  - rewrite lookup_insert_ne in Hlook by exact Hne.
    rewrite lookup_empty in Hlook. discriminate.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Source-initial configurations satisfy the token invariant.         *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition source_typed_threads_L (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=

Theorem token_single_threads_L_of_source_typed beta ρ

Proof.

              (∅ : gmap nat type) beta) as [Hwt Htok].
  exists tc_zero. split; [exact Htok | exact index_single_zero].
Qed.

Lemma release_payload_safe_of_token_single_L beta k n v C
    (Hk : ctx k)

```

```

Assumption hygiene: `Print Assumptions` on the new/merged blocks (`forest_attach_leaf`, `forest_fresh_hub_move`, `NewLock_pair_preserve`, `NewLock_forest_preserve`, `refs_at_union_eq_off`, `ref_pair_ok_union`, all RulePair/RuleForest shape lemmas) reports closed. Three `Axioms: classic` lines appear during `Load AllCombine`, belonging to pre-existing AllCombine lemmas; no new ForestFinal lemma depends on them.

## Invariant

The graph invariant is set-based (AllCombine names):

```coq
refs_at ρ a := match ρ !! a with
               | Some o => obj_refs o
               | None   => ∅
               end.

self_ref_free ρ := forall a, a ∉ refs_at ρ a.
pair_ref_ok ρ   := forall a b, a <> b ->
                     ~ (b ∈ refs_at ρ a /\ a ∈ refs_at ρ b).
ref_pair_ok ρ   := self_ref_free ρ /\ pair_ref_ok ρ.

ref_edge ρ a b := a <> b /\ (b ∈ refs_at ρ a \/ a ∈ refs_at ρ b).
list_cycle R l := 3 <= length l /\ NoDup l /\
                  path_edges R (l ++ [hd 0 l]).
ref_forest ρ := forall l, ~ list_cycle (ref_edge ρ) l.
```

The shape lemmas work on the equivalent function presentation:

```coq
edge_fun S a b  := a <> b /\ (b ∈ S a \/ a ∈ S b).
forest_fun S    := forall l, ~ list_cycle (edge_fun S) l.
self_free_fun S := forall a, a ∉ S a.
pair_ok_fun S   := forall a b, a <> b -> ~ (b ∈ S a /\ a ∈ S b).
ref_pair_ok_fun S := self_free_fun S /\ pair_ok_fun S.
```

The intended full invariant for typed configurations is therefore

```coq
kind_live ρ /\ refs_live ρ /\
ref_pair_ok_fun (refs_at ρ) /\ forest_fun (refs_at ρ)
```

with `kind_live`/`refs_live` exactly as in `/tmp/scratch7/KindRefs.v` and `/tmp/scratch7/KindLiveFacts.v`. The graph part alone is not preserved by Release; the counterexample below proves that.

## New compiled forest results

All in `/tmp/scratch6/ForestFinal.v`:

- Line 2394 `NoDup_hd_last_ne`
- Line 2408 `path_edges_away_n`
- Line 2430 `fresh_hub_vertex S i n`
- Line 2473 `edge_fun_fresh_hub_away`
- Line 2497 `forest_attach_leaf`:
  ```coq
  forest_fun S ->
  (forall a, n ∉ S a) ->
  i <> n ->
  forest_fun (fresh_hub_vertex S i n)
  ```
- Line 2553 `forest_fresh_hub_move`:
  ```coq
  pair_ok_fun S ->
  forest_fun S ->
  (forall a, n ∉ S a) ->
  i <> n -> i ∉ B ->
  (forall r, r ∈ B -> r ∈ S i) ->
  T n = B ->
  (forall a, a ∈ T i -> a ∈ S i \/ a = n) ->
  (forall a, a <> i -> a <> n -> forall b, b ∈ T a -> b ∈ S a) ->
  (forall r, r ∈ B -> r ∉ T i) ->
  forest_fun T
  ```
  This is the fresh-hub lemma requested. The critical side condition is `B ∩ T i = ∅`, encoded as `forall r ∈ B, r ∉ T i`. `pair_ok_fun S` rules out the symmetric retained edge `i ∈ T r`.

Config-level NewLock consequences (singleton rule configurations, no frame yet):

- Line 2762 `NewLock_pair_preserve`:
  ```coq
  i <> n -> ctx k ->
  ref_pair_ok_fun (refs_at {[i := Thread (k (NewLock (Val v)))]}) ->
  n ∉ refs_at {[i := Thread (k (NewLock (Val v)))]} i ->

    (refs_at {[i := Thread (k (Val (LockV n)));
                 n := Lock 0 (Some v)]})
  ```
- Line 2806 `NewLock_forest_preserve`: same pair/forest source assumptions, plus
  `forall b, b ∈ val_refs v -> b ∉ refs_at target i`, concluding `forest_fun` of the target.

## Other compiled shape lemmas

`/tmp/scratch6/RulePair.v` (15-311):

- `pair_add_fresh_leaf`
- `acquire_pair_shape`, `release_pair_shape`

Key side conditions:
- Acquire/Wait pair: `T i ⊆ S i ∪ B`, `T n = ∅`, off-`{i,n}` equality, `i ∉ B`, `forall b ∈ B, i ∉ T b`.
- Release pair: `T n = S n ∪ B`, `T i ⊆ S i`, off-`{n,i}` equality, `n ∉ B`, `forall b ∈ B, n ∉ T b`.
- NewLock pair: fresh `n`, `B ⊆ S i`, `T n = B`, `T i ⊆ S i ∪ {[n]}`, off-`{i,n}` equality. Pair does not need `B ∩ T i = ∅`; forest does.
- ForkLock pair: fresh `j`, `T j = B ∪ {[n]}`, `T i ⊆ S i`, `T n = S n`, off-`{i,j,n}` equality, `B ⊆ S i`, `i ∉ B`.
- Fork pair: fresh `j`, fresh `n`, `T j = B ∪ {[n]}`, `T i ⊆ S i ∪ {[n]}`, `T n = ∅`.
