From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.
From stdpp Require Import gmap decidable.
From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String Arith Lia Eqdep_dec.
From Stdlib Require Import Vectors.Fin.
Require Import AllCombine.
Require Import TokenLinear.
Open Scope string_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Converse soundness / occurrence exactness for the redesigned       *)
(* token grammar.                                                     *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* [tokEL] is an upper-bound grammar: the MatchSum upper bound [Cb]   *)
(* may contain tokens that no branch uses.  The exact converse        *)
(*                                                                    *)
(*   tokEL beta tenv_zero e C -> expr_refs e = empty -> C = tc_zero   *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* is therefore FALSE for arbitrary derivations (see the explicit     *)
(* counterexample below).  What is true, and what beta substitution    *)
(* actually needs, is the existence of a canonical zero-context       *)
(* derivation for every reference-free expression/value.              *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma union_empty_l {A} `{Countable A} (X Y : gset A) :
  X ∪ Y = ∅ -> X = ∅.
Proof. intros Hemp. set_solver. Qed.

Lemma union_empty_r {A} `{Countable A} (X Y : gset A) :
  X ∪ Y = ∅ -> Y = ∅.
Proof. intros Hemp. set_solver. Qed.

Lemma fin_union_eq_empty_member {A} `{Countable A}
    n (f : fin n -> gset A) (H : fin_union n f = ∅) (i : fin n) :
  f i = ∅.
Proof.
  apply set_eq. intros x. split.
  - intro Hx.
    exfalso.
    assert (Hfin : x ∈ fin_union n f).
    { apply elem_of_fin_union. exists i. exact Hx. }
    rewrite H in Hfin. set_solver.
  - intro Hx. rewrite Hx. set_solver.
Qed.

Lemma tc_le_zero_l C : tc_le tc_zero C.
Proof. split; intros; simpl; lia. Qed.

Lemma tc_add_zero_r C : tc_le (tc_add C tc_zero) C.
Proof. split; intros; simpl; lia. Qed.

Scheme expr_mut_zero := Induction for expr Sort Prop
with val_mut_zero := Induction for val Sort Prop.

(* Canonical derivation for every reference-free expression and value. *)

Lemma tokEL_zero_of_refs_empty_mut :
  (forall e, expr_refs e = ∅ ->
     forall (beta : nat -> option (type * type)) Delta,
       tenv_zeroish Delta -> tokEL beta Delta e tc_zero) /\
  (forall v, val_refs v = ∅ ->
     forall (beta : nat -> option (type * type)),
       tokVL beta v tc_zero).
Proof.
  set (P := fun e =>
    expr_refs e = ∅ ->
    forall (beta : nat -> option (type * type)) Delta,
      tenv_zeroish Delta -> tokEL beta Delta e tc_zero).
  set (Q := fun v =>
    val_refs v = ∅ ->
    forall (beta : nat -> option (type * type)),
      tokVL beta v tc_zero).

  (* Reusable value cases. *)
  assert (Q_FunV : forall s e, P e -> Q (FunV s e)).
  { intros s e HPe Hrefs beta. apply TVL_FunV.
    unfold P in HPe.
    exact (HPe Hrefs beta tenv_zero tenv_zero_zeroish). }
  assert (Q_UnitV : Q UnitV).
  { intros Hrefs beta. apply TVL_Unit. }
  assert (Q_PairV : forall v1, Q v1 -> forall v2, Q v2 -> Q (PairV v1 v2)).
  { intros v1 HQ1 v2 HQ2 Hrefs beta. apply TVL_Pair.
    - apply HQ1. apply (union_empty_l (val_refs v1) (val_refs v2)).
      exact Hrefs.
    - apply HQ2. apply (union_empty_r (val_refs v1) (val_refs v2)).
      exact Hrefs. }
  assert (Q_SumV : forall n v, Q v -> Q (SumV n v)).
  { intros n v HQ Hrefs beta. apply TVL_Sum. apply HQ. exact Hrefs. }
  assert (Q_BarrierV : forall n, Q (BarrierV n)).
  { intros n Hrefs beta. exfalso.
    assert (Hin : n ∈ val_refs (BarrierV n)) by (simpl; set_solver).
    rewrite Hrefs in Hin. set_solver. }
  assert (Q_LockV : forall n, Q (LockV n)).
  { intros n Hrefs beta. exfalso.
    assert (Hin : n ∈ val_refs (LockV n)) by (simpl; set_solver).
    rewrite Hrefs in Hin. set_solver. }

  assert (He : forall e, P e).
  { apply (expr_mut_zero P Q).
    - (* Val *) intros v HQ Hrefs beta Delta Hzero.
      apply TLE_Val. apply HQ. exact Hrefs.
    - (* Var *) intros s Hrefs beta Delta Hzero.
      apply TLE_Var. apply Hzero.
    - (* Fun *) intros s e IH Hrefs beta Delta Hzero.
      apply TLE_Fun.
      + apply IH. exact Hrefs.
      + apply tenv_bind_zeroish. exact Hzero.
    - (* App *) intros e1 IH1 e2 IH2 Hrefs beta Delta Hzero.
      simpl in Hrefs.
      apply TLE_App.
      + apply IH1. apply (union_empty_l (expr_refs e1) (expr_refs e2)).
        exact Hrefs.
      + apply IH2. apply (union_empty_r (expr_refs e1) (expr_refs e2)).
        exact Hrefs.
      + exact Hzero.
      + exact Hzero.
    - (* Unit *) intros Hrefs beta Delta Hzero. apply TLE_Unit.
    - (* Pair *) intros e1 IH1 e2 IH2 Hrefs beta Delta Hzero.
      simpl in Hrefs.
      apply TLE_Pair.
      + apply IH1. apply (union_empty_l (expr_refs e1) (expr_refs e2)).
        exact Hrefs.
      + apply IH2. apply (union_empty_r (expr_refs e1) (expr_refs e2)).
        exact Hrefs.
      + exact Hzero.
      + exact Hzero.
    - (* LetPair *) intros e1 IH1 e2 IH2 Hrefs beta Delta Hzero.
      simpl in Hrefs.
      apply TLE_LetPair.
      + apply IH1. apply (union_empty_l (expr_refs e1) (expr_refs e2)).
        exact Hrefs.
      + apply IH2. apply (union_empty_r (expr_refs e1) (expr_refs e2)).
        exact Hrefs.
      + exact Hzero.
      + exact Hzero.
    - (* Sum *) intros n e IH Hrefs beta Delta Hzero.
      apply TLE_Sum. apply IH. exact Hrefs. exact Hzero.
    - (* MatchSum *) intros n e IH es IHf Hrefs beta Delta Hzero.
      simpl in Hrefs.
      assert (He0 : expr_refs e = ∅).
      { apply (union_empty_l (expr_refs e)
                 (fin_union n (expr_refs ∘ es))). exact Hrefs. }
      assert (Hfin : fin_union n (expr_refs ∘ es) = ∅).
      { apply (union_empty_r (expr_refs e)
                 (fin_union n (expr_refs ∘ es))). exact Hrefs. }
      eapply TLE_MatchSum with (Cs := tc_zero) (Cb := tc_zero)
                                  (Cbs := fun _ => tc_zero).
      + exact (IH He0 beta Delta Hzero).
      + intro i. apply IHf.
        * apply (fin_union_eq_empty_member n (expr_refs ∘ es) Hfin i).
        * exact Hzero.
      + intros i. apply tc_le_refl.
      + intro Hn0. reflexivity.
    - (* ForkBarrier *) intros e IH Hrefs beta Delta Hzero.
      apply TLE_ForkBarrier. apply IH. exact Hrefs. exact Hzero.
    - (* NewLock *) intros e IH Hrefs beta Delta Hzero.
      apply TLE_NewLock. apply IH. exact Hrefs. exact Hzero.
    - (* ForkLock *) intros e1 IH1 e2 IH2 Hrefs beta Delta Hzero.
      simpl in Hrefs.
      apply TLE_ForkLock.
      + apply IH1. apply (union_empty_l (expr_refs e1) (expr_refs e2)).
        exact Hrefs.
      + apply IH2. apply (union_empty_r (expr_refs e1) (expr_refs e2)).
        exact Hrefs.
      + exact Hzero.
      + exact Hzero.
    - (* Acquire *) intros e IH Hrefs beta Delta Hzero.
      apply TLE_Acquire. apply IH. exact Hrefs. exact Hzero.
    - (* Release *) intros e1 IH1 e2 IH2 Hrefs beta Delta Hzero.
      simpl in Hrefs.
      apply TLE_Release.
      + apply IH1. apply (union_empty_l (expr_refs e1) (expr_refs e2)).
        exact Hrefs.
      + apply IH2. apply (union_empty_r (expr_refs e1) (expr_refs e2)).
        exact Hrefs.
      + exact Hzero.
      + exact Hzero.
    - (* Wait *) intros e IH Hrefs beta Delta Hzero.
      apply TLE_Wait. apply IH. exact Hrefs. exact Hzero.
    - (* Drop *) intros e IH Hrefs beta Delta Hzero.
      apply TLE_Drop. apply IH. exact Hrefs. exact Hzero.
    - (* FunV *) exact Q_FunV.
    - (* UnitV *) exact Q_UnitV.
    - (* PairV *) exact Q_PairV.
    - (* SumV *) exact Q_SumV.
    - (* BarrierV *) exact Q_BarrierV.
    - (* LockV *) exact Q_LockV. }

  assert (Hv : forall v, Q v).
  { apply (val_mut_zero P Q).
    - intros; exact (He _).
    - intros; exact (He _).
    - intros; exact (He _).
    - intros; exact (He _).
    - intros; exact (He _).
    - intros; exact (He _).
    - intros; exact (He _).
    - intros; exact (He _).
    - intros; exact (He _).
    - intros; exact (He _).
    - intros; exact (He _).
    - intros; exact (He _).
    - intros; exact (He _).
    - intros; exact (He _).
    - intros; exact (He _).
    - intros; exact (He _).
    - exact Q_FunV.
    - exact Q_UnitV.
    - exact Q_PairV.
    - exact Q_SumV.
    - exact Q_BarrierV.
    - exact Q_LockV. }

  split; [exact He|exact Hv].
Qed.

Lemma tokEL_zero_of_refs_empty beta Delta e
    (Hrefs : expr_refs e = ∅) (Hzero : tenv_zeroish Delta) :
  tokEL beta Delta e tc_zero.
Proof.
  exact (proj1 tokEL_zero_of_refs_empty_mut e Hrefs beta Delta Hzero).
Qed.

Lemma tokVL_zero_of_refs_empty beta v
    (Hrefs : val_refs v = ∅) :
  tokVL beta v tc_zero.
Proof.
  exact (proj2 tokEL_zero_of_refs_empty_mut v Hrefs beta).
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* The exact converse is false, even for closed reference-free terms. *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma matchsum_unit_refs n :
  expr_refs (MatchSum n Unit (fun _ : fin n => Unit)) = ∅.
Proof.

Lemma index_single_add_left_L C1 C2 :
  index_single (tc_add C1 C2) -> index_single C1.
Proof.
  intros H n. pose proof (H n) as Hle.
  rewrite tc_add_lock_count, tc_add_bar in Hle.
  unfold lock_count in *. lia.
Qed.

Lemma index_single_split_lock_zero_L C1 C2 n lc
    (Hsingle : index_single (tc_add C1 C2))
    (Hpos : 0 < tok_lock C1 n lc) :
  (forall lc', tok_lock C2 n lc' = 0) /\ tok_bar C2 n = 0.
Proof.
  assert (Hsum : lock_count (tc_add C1 C2) n + tok_bar (tc_add C1 C2) n
                 = (lock_count C1 n + tok_bar C1 n)
                   + (lock_count C2 n + tok_bar C2 n)).
  { rewrite tc_add_lock_count, tc_add_bar. lia. }
  assert (Hle : lock_count (tc_add C1 C2) n + tok_bar (tc_add C1 C2) n <= 1)
    by apply Hsingle.
  assert (Hc1pos : 1 <= lock_count C1 n).
  { pose proof (lock_count_le_sum C1 n lc). lia. }
  assert (Hc2 : lock_count C2 n = 0).
  { rewrite Hsum in Hle. lia. }
  split.
  - intro lc'. pose proof (lock_count_le_sum C2 n lc'). lia.
  - rewrite Hsum in Hle. lia.
Qed.

Theorem release_payload_token_free_L beta Delta n v C1 C2
    (Htok : tokEL beta Delta (Release (Val (LockV n)) (Val v))
              (tc_add C1 C2))
    (Hsingle : index_single (tc_add C1 C2)) :
  n ∉ val_refs v.
Proof.
  destruct (tokEL_release_inv beta Delta (Val (LockV n)) (Val v)
              (tc_add C1 C2) Htok) as (C1' & C2' & HC & H1 & H2).
  pose proof (tokEL_val_inv beta Delta (LockV n) C1' H1) as Hv1.
  destruct (tokVL_lock_inv beta n C1' Hv1) as (lc & HC1).
  subst C1'.
  assert (Hsingle' : index_single (tc_add (tc_lock_one n lc) C2')).
  { rewrite <- HC. exact Hsingle. }
  assert (Hlock : 0 < tok_lock (tc_lock_one n lc) n lc).
  { rewrite tc_lock_one_same. lia. }
  destruct (index_single_split_lock_zero_L (tc_lock_one n lc) C2' n lc
              Hsingle' Hlock) as [Hzero Hbar].
  intro Hn.
  pose proof (tokEL_sound beta Delta (Val v) C2' H2 n) as Hs.
  simpl in Hs. specialize (Hs Hn).
  destruct Hs as [[lc' Hlc']|Hb].
  - rewrite Hzero in Hlc'. lia.
  - rewrite Hbar in Hb. lia.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Finite choice for branch contexts.                                 *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma fin_choice {n} (P : fin n -> token_ctx -> Prop) :
  (forall i, exists C, P i C) ->
  exists f, forall i, P i (f i).
Proof.
  revert P. induction n as [|n IH]; intros P H.
  - exists (fun i => Fin.case0 (fun _ => token_ctx) i).
    intro i. exfalso. exact (Fin.case0 (fun _ => False) i).
  - destruct (H 0%fin) as (c0 & Hc0).
    destruct (IH (fun i => P (Fin.FS i))) as (f & Hf).
    + intro i. apply H.
    + exists (fun i => Fin.caseS' i (fun _ => token_ctx) c0 f).
      intro i.
      refine (Fin.caseS' i
                (fun j => P j (Fin.caseS' j (fun _ => token_ctx) c0 f))
                _ _).
      * exact Hc0.
      * intro p. simpl. apply Hf.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Substitution by a token-free value.                                *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* This is the zero-context case: if the argument consumes no token,  *)
(* it can be duplicated arbitrarily often and the surrounding token    *)
(* context does not change at all.                                    *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma tokEL_subst_zero beta x a e :
  tokVL beta a tc_zero ->
  forall Delta C, Delta x = tc_zero -> tokEL beta Delta e C ->
    tokEL beta (tenv_update Delta x tc_zero) (subst x a e) C.
Proof.
  intros Ha.
  induction e; intros Delta C Hx0 Htok; inversion Htok; subst; simpl.
  - (* Val *) econstructor. assumption.
  - (* Var *) destruct (decide (x = s)) as [E|E].
    + subst s. rewrite Hx0. econstructor. exact Ha.
    + econstructor.
      rewrite tenv_update_neq by (intro H; apply E; symmetry; exact H).
      reflexivity.
  - (* Fun *) destruct (decide (x = s)) as [E|E].
    + subst s. econstructor.
      apply (tokEL_tenv_eqv beta (tenv_bind Delta x)
               (tenv_bind (tenv_update Delta x tc_zero) x) e C).
      * apply tenv_eqv_sym. apply tenv_bind_update_same.
      * exact H3.
    + econstructor.
      apply (tokEL_tenv_eqv beta
               (tenv_update (tenv_bind Delta s) x tc_zero)
               (tenv_bind (tenv_update Delta x tc_zero) s)
               (subst x a e) C).
      * apply tenv_eqv_sym. apply tenv_bind_update_neq.
        intro H. exact (E (eq_sym H)).
      * apply IHe.
        -- unfold tenv_bind. destruct (decide (x = s)); [reflexivity|exact Hx0].
        -- exact H3.
  - (* App *) econstructor; [apply IHe1; assumption|apply IHe2; assumption].
  - (* Unit *) econstructor.
  - (* Pair *) econstructor; [apply IHe1; assumption|apply IHe2; assumption].
  - (* LetPair *) econstructor; [apply IHe1; assumption|apply IHe2; assumption].
  - (* Sum *) econstructor. apply IHe; assumption.
  - (* MatchSum *)
    apply (inj_pair2_eq_dec nat Nat.eq_dec) in H2. subst es0.
    eapply TLE_MatchSum with (Cs := Cs) (Cb := Cb) (Cbs := Cbs).
    + exact (IHe Delta Cs Hx0 H3).
    + intro i. exact (H i Delta (Cbs i) Hx0 (H5 i)).
    + exact H7.
    + exact H8.
  - (* ForkBarrier *) econstructor. apply IHe; assumption.
  - (* NewLock *) econstructor. apply IHe; assumption.
  - (* ForkLock *) econstructor; [apply IHe1; assumption|apply IHe2; assumption].
  - (* Acquire *) econstructor. apply IHe; assumption.
  - (* Release *) econstructor; [apply IHe1; assumption|apply IHe2; assumption].
  - (* Wait *) econstructor. apply IHe; assumption.
  - (* Drop *) econstructor. apply IHe; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma tc_le_add_rearrange_l C1 Ca C2 :
  tc_le (tc_add (tc_add C1 Ca) C2) (tc_add (tc_add C1 C2) Ca).
Proof.
  unfold tc_le, tc_add. simpl. split; intros; lia.
Qed.

Lemma tc_le_add_rearrange_r C1 C2 Ca :
  tc_le (tc_add C1 (tc_add C2 Ca)) (tc_add (tc_add C1 C2) Ca).
Proof.
  unfold tc_le, tc_add. simpl. split; intros; lia.
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* The linear substitution lemma.                                     *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* If the variable occurs at most once (counting alternatives by      *)
(* their maximum), substituting a value [a] with context [Ca] gives a *)
(* term whose token context is bounded by [C + Ca].  We deliberately  *)
(* state an upper bound rather than [C - Cx + Ca]: this is exactly    *)
(* what is needed for the single-index invariant, while avoiding a    *)
(* subtraction that would be wrong for shared branch contexts.        *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma tokEL_subst_linear beta x a Ca (Ha : tokVL beta a Ca) :
  forall e Delta C,
    var_budget x e <= 1 ->
    tokEL beta Delta e C ->
    exists C',
      tokEL beta (tenv_update Delta x Ca) (subst x a e) C' /\
      (var_budget x e = 0 -> tc_le C' C) /\
      (var_budget x e = 1 -> tc_le C' (tc_add C Ca)).
Proof.
  induction e; intros Delta C Hvb Htok; pose (Csrc := C); inversion Htok; subst; simpl.
  - (* Val *)
    exists Csrc. split; [econstructor; assumption|].
    split; [intro; apply tc_le_refl|intro H; simpl in H; lia].
  - (* Var *)
    destruct (decide (x = s)) as [E|E].
    + subst s. exists Ca. split.
      * econstructor. exact Ha.
      * split.
        -- intro H; simpl in H; lia.
        -- intros _. apply tc_le_add_r.
    + exists Csrc. split.
      * econstructor. rewrite tenv_update_neq.
        { reflexivity. }
        { intro H; apply E; symmetry; exact H. }
      * split.
        -- intros _. apply tc_le_refl.
        -- intro H; simpl in H; lia.
  - (* Fun *)
    destruct (decide (x = s)) as [E|E].
    + subst s. exists Csrc. split.
      * econstructor.
        apply (tokEL_tenv_eqv beta (tenv_bind Delta x)
                 (tenv_bind (tenv_update Delta x Ca) x) e C).
        { apply tenv_eqv_sym. apply tenv_bind_update_same. }
        { exact H3. }
      * split.
        -- intros _. apply tc_le_refl.
        -- intro H; simpl in H; lia.
    + destruct (IHe (tenv_bind Delta s) C) as (C' & Hbody & HB0 & HB1).
      { change (var_budget x (Fun s e) <= 1) in Hvb.
        rewrite (var_budget_fun_neq x s e E) in Hvb. exact Hvb. }
      { exact H3. }
      exists C'. split.
      * econstructor.
        apply (tokEL_tenv_eqv beta
                 (tenv_update (tenv_bind Delta s) x Ca)
                 (tenv_bind (tenv_update Delta x Ca) s)
                 (subst x a e) C').
        -- apply tenv_eqv_sym. apply tenv_bind_update_neq.
           intro H; apply E; symmetry; exact H.
        -- exact Hbody.
      * split.
        -- intro H; simpl in H. apply HB0. exact H.
        -- intro H; simpl in H. apply HB1. exact H.
  - (* App *)
    simpl in Hvb.
    destruct (IHe1 Delta C1) as (C1' & Ht1 & HB10 & HB11).
    { lia. }
    { exact H2. }
    destruct (IHe2 Delta C2) as (C2' & Ht2 & HB20 & HB21).
    { lia. }
    { exact H4. }
    exists (tc_add C1' C2'). split.

From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.
From stdpp Require Import gmap decidable.
From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String Arith Lia Eqdep_dec.
From Stdlib Require Import Vectors.Fin.
Require Import AllCombine.
Require Import TokenTyping.
Require Import TokenCtx.
Require Import TokenLinear.
Open Scope string_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Converse soundness / occurrence exactness for the redesigned       *)
(* token grammar.                                                     *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* [tokEL] is an upper-bound grammar: the MatchSum upper bound [Cb]   *)
(* may contain tokens that no branch uses, and composite constructors *)
(* produce [tc_add] trees rather than a literal [tc_zero].  The exact *)
(* converse                                                          *)
(*                                                                    *)
(*   tokEL beta tenv_zero e C -> expr_refs e = empty -> C = tc_zero   *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* is therefore FALSE (see the explicit counterexample below).  What  *)
(* is true, and what beta substitution actually needs, is that every  *)
(* reference-free expression/value has a derivation whose context is  *)
(* token-free up to [tc_le], i.e. [tc_le C tc_zero].                  *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma union_empty_l {A} `{Countable A} (X Y : gset A) :
  X ∪ Y = ∅ -> X = ∅.
Proof. intros Hemp. set_solver. Qed.

Lemma union_empty_r {A} `{Countable A} (X Y : gset A) :
  X ∪ Y = ∅ -> Y = ∅.
Proof. intros Hemp. set_solver. Qed.

Lemma fin_union_eq_empty_member {A} `{Countable A}
    n (f : fin n -> gset A) (Hemp : fin_union n f = ∅) (i : fin n) :
  f i = ∅.
Proof.
  apply set_eq. intros x. split.
  - intro Hx.
    exfalso.
    assert (Hfin : x ∈ fin_union n f).
    { apply elem_of_fin_union. exists i. exact Hx. }
    rewrite Hemp in Hfin. set_solver.
  - intro Hx. set_solver.
Qed.

Lemma tc_le_zero_l C : tc_le tc_zero C.
Proof. split; intros; simpl; lia. Qed.

Lemma tc_le_add_zero_zero : tc_le (tc_add tc_zero tc_zero) tc_zero.
Proof. split; intros; simpl; lia. Qed.

Lemma tc_le_add_mono_L C1 C2 D1 D2 :
  tc_le C1 D1 -> tc_le C2 D2 -> tc_le (tc_add C1 C2) (tc_add D1 D2).
Proof.
  intros [Hl1 Hb1] [Hl2 Hb2]. split; intros; simpl; lia.
Qed.

Lemma tc_le_zeroish_add C1 C2
    (H1 : tc_le C1 tc_zero) (H2 : tc_le C2 tc_zero) :
  tc_le (tc_add C1 C2) tc_zero.
Proof.
  eapply tc_le_trans.
  - apply tc_le_add_mono_L; assumption.
  - apply tc_le_add_zero_zero.
Qed.

Lemma tc_le_any_l_of_zeroish C D (H : tc_le C tc_zero) : tc_le C D.
Proof.
  destruct H as [Hl Hb]. split.
  - intros n lc. pose proof (Hl n lc). pose proof (lock_count_nonneg D n lc). lia.
  - intros n. pose proof (Hb n). lia.
Qed.

Scheme expr_mut_zero := Induction for expr Sort Prop
with val_mut_zero := Induction for val Sort Prop.

(* Canonical token-free derivation for every reference-free expression. *)

Lemma tokEL_zeroish_of_refs_empty_mut :
  (forall e, expr_refs e = ∅ ->
     forall (beta : nat -> option (type * type)) Delta,
       tenv_zeroish Delta ->
       exists C, tokEL beta Delta e C /\ tc_le C tc_zero) /\
  (forall v, val_refs v = ∅ ->
     forall (beta : nat -> option (type * type)),
       exists C, tokVL beta v C /\ tc_le C tc_zero).
Proof.
  set (P := fun e =>
    expr_refs e = ∅ ->
    forall (beta : nat -> option (type * type)) Delta,
      tenv_zeroish Delta ->
      exists C, tokEL beta Delta e C /\ tc_le C tc_zero).
  set (Q := fun v =>
    val_refs v = ∅ ->
    forall (beta : nat -> option (type * type)),
      exists C, tokVL beta v C /\ tc_le C tc_zero).

  (* Reusable value cases. *)
  assert (Q_FunV : forall s e, P e -> Q (FunV s e)).
  { intros s e HPe Hrefs beta.
    destruct (HPe Hrefs beta tenv_zero tenv_zero_zeroish) as (C & Ht & Hle).
    exists C. split; [apply TVL_FunV; exact Ht|exact Hle]. }
  assert (Q_UnitV : Q UnitV).
  { intros Hrefs beta. exists tc_zero. split.
    - apply TVL_Unit.
    - apply tc_le_refl. }
  assert (Q_PairV : forall v1, Q v1 -> forall v2, Q v2 -> Q (PairV v1 v2)).
  { intros v1 HQ1 v2 HQ2 Hrefs beta.
    destruct (HQ1 (union_empty_l _ _ Hrefs) beta) as (C1 & Ht1 & Hle1).
    destruct (HQ2 (union_empty_r _ _ Hrefs) beta) as (C2 & Ht2 & Hle2).
    exists (tc_add C1 C2). split.
    - apply TVL_Pair; assumption.
    - apply tc_le_zeroish_add; assumption. }
  assert (Q_SumV : forall n v, Q v -> Q (SumV n v)).
  { intros n v HQ Hrefs beta.
    destruct (HQ Hrefs beta) as (C & Ht & Hle).
    exists C. split; [apply TVL_Sum; exact Ht|exact Hle]. }

  { intros n Hrefs beta. exfalso.
    assert (Hin : n ∈ val_refs (BarrierV n)) by (simpl; set_solver).
    rewrite Hrefs in Hin. set_solver. }
  assert (Q_LockV : forall n, Q (LockV n)).
  { intros n Hrefs beta. exfalso.
    assert (Hin : n ∈ val_refs (LockV n)) by (simpl; set_solver).
    rewrite Hrefs in Hin. set_solver. }

  assert (He : forall e, P e).
  { apply (expr_mut_zero P Q).
    - (* Val *) intros v HQ Hrefs beta Delta Hzero.
      destruct (HQ Hrefs beta) as (C & Ht & Hle).
      exists C. split; [apply TLE_Val; exact Ht|exact Hle].
    - (* Var *) intros s Hrefs beta Delta Hzero.
      exists (Delta s). split.
      + apply TLE_Var. reflexivity.
      + apply Hzero.
    - (* Fun *) intros s e IH Hrefs beta Delta Hzero.
      destruct (IH Hrefs beta (tenv_bind Delta s)
                  (tenv_bind_zeroish Delta s Hzero)) as (C & Ht & Hle).
      exists C. split; [apply TLE_Fun; exact Ht|exact Hle].
    - (* App *) intros e1 IH1 e2 IH2 Hrefs beta Delta Hzero.
      simpl in Hrefs.
      destruct (IH1 (union_empty_l _ _ Hrefs) beta Delta Hzero)
        as (C1 & Ht1 & Hle1).
      destruct (IH2 (union_empty_r _ _ Hrefs) beta Delta Hzero)
        as (C2 & Ht2 & Hle2).
      exists (tc_add C1 C2). split.
      + apply TLE_App; assumption.
      + apply tc_le_zeroish_add; assumption.
    - (* Unit *) intros Hrefs beta Delta Hzero.
      exists tc_zero. split; [apply TLE_Unit|apply tc_le_refl].
    - (* Pair *) intros e1 IH1 e2 IH2 Hrefs beta Delta Hzero.
      simpl in Hrefs.
      destruct (IH1 (union_empty_l _ _ Hrefs) beta Delta Hzero)
        as (C1 & Ht1 & Hle1).
      destruct (IH2 (union_empty_r _ _ Hrefs) beta Delta Hzero)
        as (C2 & Ht2 & Hle2).
      exists (tc_add C1 C2). split.
      + apply TLE_Pair; assumption.
      + apply tc_le_zeroish_add; assumption.
    - (* LetPair *) intros e1 IH1 e2 IH2 Hrefs beta Delta Hzero.
      simpl in Hrefs.
      destruct (IH1 (union_empty_l _ _ Hrefs) beta Delta Hzero)
        as (C1 & Ht1 & Hle1).
      destruct (IH2 (union_empty_r _ _ Hrefs) beta Delta Hzero)
        as (C2 & Ht2 & Hle2).
      exists (tc_add C1 C2). split.
      + apply TLE_LetPair; assumption.
      + apply tc_le_zeroish_add; assumption.
    - (* Sum *) intros n e IH Hrefs beta Delta Hzero.
      destruct (IH Hrefs beta Delta Hzero) as (C & Ht & Hle).
      exists C. split; [apply TLE_Sum; exact Ht|exact Hle].
    - (* MatchSum *) intros n e IH es IHf Hrefs beta Delta Hzero.
      simpl in Hrefs.
      assert (He0 : expr_refs e = ∅).
      { apply (union_empty_l (expr_refs e)
                 (fin_union n (expr_refs ∘ es))). exact Hrefs. }
      assert (Hfin : fin_union n (expr_refs ∘ es) = ∅).
      { apply (union_empty_r (expr_refs e)
                 (fin_union n (expr_refs ∘ es))). exact Hrefs. }
      destruct (IH He0 beta Delta Hzero) as (Cs & Hs & HleCs).
      destruct (fin_choice (fun i C =>
          tokEL beta Delta (es i) C /\ tc_le C tc_zero)) as (Cbs & HCbs).
      { intro i.
        apply IHf.
        - apply (fin_union_eq_empty_member n (expr_refs ∘ es) Hfin i).
        - exact Hzero. }
      exists (tc_add Cs tc_zero). split.
      + eapply TLE_MatchSum with (Cs := Cs) (Cb := tc_zero) (Cbs := Cbs).
        * exact Hs.
        * intro i. exact (proj1 (HCbs i)).
        * intros i. exact (proj2 (HCbs i)).
        * intro Hn0. reflexivity.
      + apply tc_le_zeroish_add.
        * exact HleCs.
        * apply tc_le_refl.
    - (* ForkBarrier *) intros e IH Hrefs beta Delta Hzero.
      destruct (IH Hrefs beta Delta Hzero) as (C & Ht & Hle).
      exists C. split; [apply TLE_ForkBarrier; exact Ht|exact Hle].
    - (* NewLock *) intros e IH Hrefs beta Delta Hzero.
      destruct (IH Hrefs beta Delta Hzero) as (C & Ht & Hle).
      exists C. split; [apply TLE_NewLock; exact Ht|exact Hle].
    - (* ForkLock *) intros e1 IH1 e2 IH2 Hrefs beta Delta Hzero.
      simpl in Hrefs.
      destruct (IH1 (union_empty_l _ _ Hrefs) beta Delta Hzero)
        as (C1 & Ht1 & Hle1).
      destruct (IH2 (union_empty_r _ _ Hrefs) beta Delta Hzero)
        as (C2 & Ht2 & Hle2).
      exists (tc_add C1 C2). split.
      + apply TLE_ForkLock; assumption.
      + apply tc_le_zeroish_add; assumption.
    - (* Acquire *) intros e IH Hrefs beta Delta Hzero.
      destruct (IH Hrefs beta Delta Hzero) as (C & Ht & Hle).
      exists C. split; [apply TLE_Acquire; exact Ht|exact Hle].
    - (* Release *) intros e1 IH1 e2 IH2 Hrefs beta Delta Hzero.
      simpl in Hrefs.
      destruct (IH1 (union_empty_l _ _ Hrefs) beta Delta Hzero)
        as (C1 & Ht1 & Hle1).
      destruct (IH2 (union_empty_r _ _ Hrefs) beta Delta Hzero)
        as (C2 & Ht2 & Hle2).
      exists (tc_add C1 C2). split.
      + apply TLE_Release; assumption.
      + apply tc_le_zeroish_add; assumption.
    - (* Wait *) intros e IH Hrefs beta Delta Hzero.
      destruct (IH Hrefs beta Delta Hzero) as (C & Ht & Hle).
      exists C. split; [apply TLE_Wait; exact Ht|exact Hle].
    - (* Drop *) intros e IH Hrefs beta Delta Hzero.
      destruct (IH Hrefs beta Delta Hzero) as (C & Ht & Hle).
      exists C. split; [apply TLE_Drop; exact Ht|exact Hle].
    - (* FunV *) exact Q_FunV.
    - (* UnitV *) exact Q_UnitV.
    - (* PairV *) exact Q_PairV.
    - (* SumV *) exact Q_SumV.
    - (* BarrierV *) exact Q_BarrierV.
    - (* LockV *) exact Q_LockV. }

  assert (Hv : forall v, Q v).
  { apply (val_mut_zero P Q).
    - intros; exact (He _).
    - intros; exact (He _).
    - intros; exact (He _).
    - intros; exact (He _).
    - intros; exact (He _).
    - intros; exact (He _).
    - intros; exact (He _).
    - intros; exact (He _).
    - intros; exact (He _).
    - intros; exact (He _).
    - intros; exact (He _).
    - intros; exact (He _).
    - intros; exact (He _).
    - intros; exact (He _).
    - intros; exact (He _).
    - intros; exact (He _).
    - exact Q_FunV.
    - exact Q_UnitV.
    - exact Q_PairV.
    - exact Q_SumV.
    - exact Q_BarrierV.
    - exact Q_LockV. }

Lemma tokEL_zeroish_of_refs_empty beta Delta e
    (Hrefs : expr_refs e = ∅) (Hzero : tenv_zeroish Delta) :
  exists C, tokEL beta Delta e C /\ tc_le C tc_zero.
Proof.
  exact (proj1 tokEL_zeroish_of_refs_empty_mut e Hrefs beta Delta Hzero).
Qed.

Lemma tokVL_zeroish_of_refs_empty beta v
    (Hrefs : val_refs v = ∅) :
  exists C, tokVL beta v C /\ tc_le C tc_zero.
Proof.
  exact (proj2 tokEL_zeroish_of_refs_empty_mut v Hrefs beta).
Qed.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* The exact converse is false, even for closed reference-free terms. *)
(* In particular an upper bound [Cb] at MatchSum may carry a token    *)

(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma matchsum_unit_refs n :
  expr_refs (MatchSum n Unit (fun _ : fin n => Unit)) = ∅.
Proof.
  simpl. apply fin_union_empty. intro i. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* Refined value typing [cvS] and runtime typing [wtS].                *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* The only change with respect to [cv] is the function-value rule:   *)
(* at an unrestricted function type, the body must be reference-free. *)
(* [wtS] is the corresponding runtime typing, using [cvS] for values. *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Inductive cvS (L : gmap nat type) : val -> type -> Prop :=
  | FunVS x e t1 t2 l :
      wt L (<[x := t1]> (∅ : env)) e t2 ->
      (l = Unr -> expr_refs e = ∅) ->
      cvS L (FunV x e) (FunT l t1 t2)
  | UnitVS : cvS L UnitV UnitT
  | PairVS v1 v2 t1 t2 :
      cvS L v1 t1 -> cvS L v2 t2 ->
      cvS L (PairV v1 v2) (PairT t1 t2)
  | SumVS n (ts : fin n -> type) i v :
      cvS L v (ts i) ->
      cvS L (SumV i v) (SumT n ts)
  | BarrierVS n t1 t2 :
      cvS L (BarrierV n) (FunT Lin t1 t2)
  | LockVS n lc t :
      L !! n = Some t ->
      cvS L (LockV n) (LockT lc t).

Inductive wtS (L : gmap nat type) : env -> expr -> type -> Prop :=
  | VarS Γ x t :
      env_var Γ x t ->
      wtS L Γ (Var x) t
  | FunS Γ Γ' x e t1 t2 l :
      env_bind Γ' x t1 Γ ->
      (l = Unr -> env_unr Γ) ->
      wtS L Γ' e t2 ->
      wtS L Γ (Fun x e) (FunT l t1 t2)
  | AppS Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 l :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wtS L Γ1 e1 (FunT l t1 t2) ->
      wtS L Γ2 e2 t1 ->
      wtS L Γ (App e1 e2) t2
  | UnitS Γ :
      env_unr Γ ->
      wtS L Γ Unit UnitT
  | PairS Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wtS L Γ1 e1 t1 ->
      wtS L Γ2 e2 t2 ->
      wtS L Γ (Pair e1 e2) (PairT t1 t2)
  | LetPairS Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 t :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wtS L Γ1 e1 (PairT t1 t2) ->
      wtS L Γ2 e2 (FunT Lin t1 (FunT Lin t2 t)) ->
      wtS L Γ (LetPair e1 e2) t
  | SumS Γ n (ts : fin n -> type) i e :
      wtS L Γ e (ts i) ->
      wtS L Γ (Sum i e) (SumT n ts)
  | MatchSumS n Γ Γ1 Γ2 t (ts : fin n -> type) es e :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      (n = 0 -> env_unr Γ2) ->
      wtS L Γ1 e (SumT n ts) ->
      (forall i, wtS L Γ2 (es i) (FunT Lin (ts i) t)) ->
      wtS L Γ (MatchSum n e es) t
  | ForkS Γ e t1 t2 :
      wtS L Γ e (FunT Lin (FunT Lin t2 t1) UnitT) ->
      wtS L Γ (ForkBarrier e) (FunT Lin t1 t2)
  | NewLockS Γ e t :
      wtS L Γ e t ->
      wtS L Γ (NewLock e) (LockT (Owner,Closed) t)
  | ForkLockS Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t l1 l2 l3 :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      lockcap_split l1 l2 l3 ->
      wtS L Γ1 e1 (LockT l1 t) ->
      wtS L Γ2 e2 (FunT Lin (LockT l2 t) UnitT) ->
      wtS L Γ (ForkLock e1 e2) (LockT l3 t)
  | AcquireS Γ e t lo :
      wtS L Γ e (LockT (lo,Closed) t) ->
      wtS L Γ (Acquire e) (PairT (LockT (lo,Opened) t) t)
      wtS L Γ (Acquire e) (PairT (LockT (lo,Opened) t) t)
  | ReleaseS Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t lo :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wtS L Γ1 e1 (LockT (lo,Opened) t) ->
      wtS L Γ2 e2 t ->
      wtS L Γ (Release e1 e2) (LockT (lo,Closed) t)
  | WaitS Γ e t :
      wtS L Γ e (LockT (Owner,Closed) t) ->
      wtS L Γ (Wait e) t
  | DropS Γ e t :
      wtS L Γ e (LockT (Client,Closed) t) ->
      wtS L Γ (Drop e) UnitT
  | ValS Γ v t :
      env_unr Γ ->
      cvS L v t ->
      wtS L Γ (Val v) t.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Pair preservation for a bundle of edges moved from [n] to [i].     *)
(* This is the set-level counterpart of the forest bridge move.       *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition self_free_fun (S : nat -> gset nat) : Prop :=
  forall a, a ∉ S a.

Definition pair_ok_fun (S : nat -> gset nat) : Prop :=
  forall a b, a <> b -> ~ (b ∈ S a /\ a ∈ S b).

Definition ref_pair_ok_fun (S : nat -> gset nat) : Prop :=
  self_free_fun S /\ pair_ok_fun S.

Lemma pair_move_add (S T : nat -> gset nat) (i n : nat) (B : gset nat) :
  ref_pair_ok_fun S ->
  T i = S i ∪ B ->
  T n = ∅ ->
  (forall a, a <> i -> a <> n -> T a = S a) ->
  i ∉ B ->
  (forall b, b ∈ B -> i ∉ T b) ->
  ref_pair_ok_fun T.
Proof.
  intros [Hself Hpair] HTi HTn Hother HiB Hrev.
  split.
  - intro a. destruct (decide (a = i)) as [E|Hai].
    + subst a. rewrite HTi. intro Hmem.
      apply elem_of_union in Hmem as [Hin|Hin].
      * exact (Hself i Hin).
      * exact (HiB Hin).
    + destruct (decide (a = n)) as [E|Han].
      * subst a. rewrite HTn. set_solver.
      * rewrite (Hother a Hai Han). apply Hself.
  - intros a b Hne [Hb Ha].
    destruct (decide (a = i)) as [Ea|Hai].
    + subst a. rewrite HTi in Hb.
      apply elem_of_union in Hb as [HbS|HbB].
      * destruct (decide (b = n)) as [Eb|Hbn].
        -- subst b. rewrite HTn in Ha. set_solver.
        -- rewrite (Hother b (ne_sym Hne) Hbn) in Ha.
           exact (Hpair i b Hne (conj HbS Ha)).
      * exact (Hrev b HbB Ha).
    + destruct (decide (a = n)) as [Ea|Han].
      * subst a. rewrite HTn in Hb. set_solver.
      * rewrite (Hother a Hai Han) in Hb.
        destruct (decide (b = i)) as [Eb|Hbi].
        -- subst b. rewrite HTi in Ha.
           apply elem_of_union in Ha as [HaS|HaB].
           ++ exact (Hpair a i Hne (conj Hb HaS)).
           ++ apply (Hrev a HaB). rewrite (Hother a Hai Han). exact Hb.
        -- destruct (decide (b = n)) as [Eb|Hbn].
           ++ subst b. rewrite HTn in Ha. set_solver.
           ++ rewrite (Hother b Hbi Hbn) in Ha.
              exact (Hpair a b Hne (conj Hb Ha)).
Qed.

(* Transfer between the set-function presentation and [cfg]. *)
Lemma ref_pair_ok_fun_iff (ρ : cfg) :
  ref_pair_ok_fun (refs_at ρ) <-> ref_pair_ok ρ.
Proof.
  unfold ref_pair_ok_fun, ref_pair_ok, self_free_fun, pair_ok_fun,
         self_ref_free, pair_ref_ok.
  split; intros [H1 H2]; split; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma delete_insert_same_env x (t : type) (Γ : env) :
  delete x (<[x:=t]>Γ) = delete x Γ.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro y.
  destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_eq (<[y:=t]>Γ) y). rewrite (lookup_delete_eq Γ y). done.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_ne (<[x:=t]>Γ) x y E).
    rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x y t E).
    rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ x y E). done.
Qed.

Lemma insert_delete_same_env x (t : type) (Γ : env) :
  <[x:=t]>(delete x Γ) = <[x:=t]>Γ.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro y.
  destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (delete y Γ) y t). rewrite (lookup_insert_eq Γ y t). done.
  - rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (delete x Γ) x y t E).
    rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ x y E).
    rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x y t E). done.
Qed.

Lemma delete_insert_comm_env x y (t : type) (Γ : env) : x <> y ->
  delete x (<[y:=t]>Γ) = <[y:=t]>(delete x Γ).
Proof.
  intros Hne. unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro z.
  destruct (decide (x=z)) as [E1|E1]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_eq (<[y:=t]>Γ) z).
    rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (delete z Γ) y z t (fun H => Hne (eq_sym H))).
    rewrite (lookup_delete_eq Γ z). done.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_ne (<[y:=t]>Γ) x z E1).
    destruct (decide (y=z)) as [E2|E2]; subst.
    + rewrite (lookup_insert_eq Γ z t). rewrite (lookup_insert_eq (delete x Γ) z t). done.
    + rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ y z t E2).
      rewrite (lookup_insert_ne (delete x Γ) y z t E2).
      rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ x z E1). done.
Qed.

Lemma delete_empty_env (x : string) : delete x (∅ : env) = ∅.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro y.
  destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_eq (∅ : gmap string type) y). symmetry. apply lookup_empty.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_ne (∅ : gmap string type) x y E). symmetry. apply lookup_empty.
Qed.


Lemma env_var_lookup Γ x t : env_var Γ x t -> Γ !! x = Some t.
Proof.
  intros [Γ' [E _]]. subst Γ. unfold env in *.
  apply lookup_insert_eq.
Qed.

Lemma env_var_unr_delete Γ x t : env_var Γ x t -> env_unr (delete x Γ).
Proof.
  intros [Γ' [E Hu]]. subst Γ.
  rewrite delete_insert_same_env.
  apply env_unr_delete. exact Hu.
Qed.

Lemma env_var_delete Γ x y t : env_var Γ y t -> y <> x -> env_var (delete x Γ) y t.
Proof.
  intros [Γ' [E Hu]] Hne. subst Γ.
  exists (delete x Γ'). split.
  - rewrite delete_insert_comm_env; [done | intros H; exact (Hne (eq_sym H))].
  - apply env_unr_delete. exact Hu.
Qed.

Lemma env_var_empty x t : env_var (∅ : env) x t -> False.
Proof.
  intros [Γ' [E _]].
  assert (Hl : (<[x:=t]>Γ') !! x = Some t) by apply lookup_insert_eq.
  symmetry in E. rewrite E in Hl. cbn in Hl. discriminate Hl.
Qed.

CoInductive unr : type -> Prop :=
  | Fun_unr t1 t2 : unr (FunT Unr t1 t2)
  | Unit_unr : unr UnitT
  | Pair_unr t1 t2 : unr t1 -> unr t2 -> unr (PairT t1 t2)
  | Sum_unr n ts : (∀ i, unr (ts i)) -> unr (SumT n ts).

Definition env := gmap string type.

Definition env_unr (Γ : env) :=
  ∀ x t, Γ !! x = Some t -> unr t.

Definition disj (Γ1 Γ2 : env) :=
  ∀ i t1 t2, Γ1 !! i = Some t1 -> Γ2 !! i = Some t2 -> t1 = t2 ∧ unr t1.

Definition env_split (Γ : env) (Γ1 : env) (Γ2 : env) :=
  Γ = Γ1 ∪ Γ2 ∧ disj Γ1 Γ2.

Definition env_bind (Γ' : env) (x : string) (t : type) (Γ : env) :=
  Γ' = <[ x := t ]> Γ ∧ ∀ t', Γ !! x = Some t' -> unr t'.

Definition env_var (Γ : env) (x : string) (t : type) :=
  ∃ Γ', Γ = <[ x := t ]> Γ' ∧ env_unr Γ'.

Inductive typed : env -> expr -> type -> Prop :=

  | Var_typed Γ x t :
    env_var Γ x t ->
    typed Γ (Var x) t
  | Fun_typed Γ Γ' x e t1 t2 l :
    env_bind Γ' x t1 Γ ->
    (l = Unr -> env_unr Γ) ->
    typed Γ' e t2 ->
    typed Γ (Fun x e) (FunT l t1 t2)
  | App_typed Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 l :
    env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
    typed Γ1 e1 (FunT l t1 t2) ->
    typed Γ2 e2 t1 ->
    typed Γ (App e1 e2) t2
  | Unit_typed Γ :
    env_unr Γ ->
    typed Γ Unit UnitT
  | Pair_typed Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 :
    env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
    typed Γ1 e1 t1 ->
    typed Γ2 e2 t2 ->
    typed Γ (Pair e1 e2) (PairT t1 t2)
  | LetPair_typed Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 t :
    env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
    typed Γ1 e1 (PairT t1 t2) ->
    typed Γ2 e2 (FunT Lin t1 (FunT Lin t2 t)) ->
    typed Γ (LetPair e1 e2) t
  | Sum_typed Γ n (ts : fin n -> type) i e :
    typed Γ e (ts i) ->
    typed Γ (Sum i e) (SumT n ts)
  | MatchSumN_typed n Γ Γ1 Γ2 t (ts : fin n -> type) es e :
    env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
    (n = 0 -> env_unr Γ2) ->
    typed Γ1 e (SumT n ts) ->
    (∀ i, typed Γ2 (es i) (FunT Lin (ts i) t)) ->
    typed Γ (MatchSum n e es) t

  | Fork_typed Γ e t1 t2 :
    typed Γ e (FunT Lin (FunT Lin t2 t1) UnitT) ->
    typed Γ (ForkBarrier e) (FunT Lin t1 t2)

  | NewLock_typed Γ e t :
    typed Γ e t ->
    typed Γ (NewLock e) (LockT (Owner,Closed) t)
  | ForkLock_typed Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t l1 l2 l3 :
    env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->

Lemma tokEL_subst_zeroish beta x a Ca
    (Ha : tokVL beta a Ca) (Haz : tc_le Ca tc_zero) :
  forall e Delta C,
    tokEL beta Delta e C ->
    exists C',

      tc_le C' C.
Proof.

    exists (tc_add C1' C2'). split.

  - (* NewLock *)

(* Interface combining the per-thread lemma with the missing object-level
   accounting.  [threads_typed] is the runtime-typing invariant on live
   threads; [obj_progress] is exactly the accounting obligation for live
   objects (locks and barriers) that are not threads.  Note that
   [progress_or_wait] cannot be derived from [thread_progress] alone: a live
   [Barrier] or [Lock] is not a thread, so the per-thread lemma says nothing
   about it, and [can_step] at such an index is only available when a matching
   operation is currently observable in some thread/object. *)

Definition progress_or_wait_obj (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i, ρ !! i <> None -> can_step ρ i \/ exists j, waiting ρ i j.

Definition threads_typed (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i e, ρ !! i = Some (Thread e) -> wt L ∅ e UnitT.

Definition obj_progress (ρ : cfg) : Prop :=
  forall i y, ρ !! i = Some y -> (forall e, y <> Thread e) ->
    can_step ρ i \/ exists j, waiting ρ i j.

Lemma progress_or_wait_of_typed_obj ρ
    (Hty : threads_typed ρ) (Hobj : obj_progress ρ) :
  progress_or_wait_obj ρ.
Proof.

    + apply Hobj with (y := Barrier); [exact E | discriminate].
    + apply Hobj with (y := Lock rc o); [exact E | discriminate].
  - exfalso. exact (Hi eq_refl).
Qed.

Lemma forkbar_src_lookup_i v k i j n (Hij : i <> j) (Hin : i <> n) :
  ({[i := Thread (k (ForkBarrier (Val v)))]} : cfg) !! i =
  Some (Thread (k (ForkBarrier (Val v)))).
Proof.
  change ((<[i := Thread (k (ForkBarrier (Val v)))]> (∅ : cfg)) !! i =
          Some (Thread (k (ForkBarrier (Val v))))).
  apply lookup_insert_eq.
Qed.

Lemma forkbar_src_lookup_j_none v k i j n (Hij : i <> j) (Hin : i <> n) :
  ({[i := Thread (k (ForkBarrier (Val v)))]} : cfg) !! j = None.
Proof.
  change ((<[i := Thread (k (ForkBarrier (Val v)))]> (∅ : cfg)) !! j = None).
  assert (E : (<[i := Thread (k (ForkBarrier (Val v)))]> (∅ : cfg)) !! j =
               (∅ : cfg) !! j).
  { apply lookup_insert_ne. intro E. apply Hij. symmetry. exact E. }
  rewrite E. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma forkbar_src_lookup_n_none v k i j n (Hij : i <> j) (Hin : i <> n) :
  ({[i := Thread (k (ForkBarrier (Val v)))]} : cfg) !! n = None.
Proof.
  change ((<[i := Thread (k (ForkBarrier (Val v)))]> (∅ : cfg)) !! n = None).
  assert (E : (<[i := Thread (k (ForkBarrier (Val v)))]> (∅ : cfg)) !! n =
               (∅ : cfg) !! n).
  { apply lookup_insert_ne. intro E. apply Hin. symmetry. exact E. }
  rewrite E. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma forkbar_src_refs_i v k i (Hk : ctx k) :
  refs_at ({[i := Thread (k (ForkBarrier (Val v)))]} : cfg) i =
  expr_refs (k (ForkBarrier (Val v))).
Proof.
  rewrite Fork_src_refs.
  destruct (decide (i = i)) as [E|H]; [reflexivity|exfalso; apply H; reflexivity].
Qed.

Lemma forkbar_src_refs_other v k i a (Hai : a <> i) :
  refs_at ({[i := Thread (k (ForkBarrier (Val v)))]} : cfg) a = ∅.
Proof.
  rewrite Fork_src_refs.
  destruct (decide (a = i)) as [E|H]; [exfalso; apply Hai; exact E|reflexivity].
Qed.

Lemma forkbar_tgt_refs_i v k i j n
    (Hij : i <> j) (Hin : i <> n) (Hjn : j <> n) :
  refs_at ({[i := Thread (k (Val (BarrierV n)));
              j := Thread (App (Val v) (Val (BarrierV n)));
              n := Barrier]} : cfg) i =
  expr_refs (k (Val (BarrierV n))).
Proof.
  rewrite Fork_tgt_refs by assumption.
  destruct (decide (i = i)) as [E|H]; [reflexivity|exfalso; apply H; reflexivity].
Qed.

Lemma forkbar_tgt_refs_j v k i j n
    (Hij : i <> j) (Hin : i <> n) (Hjn : j <> n) :
  refs_at ({[i := Thread (k (Val (BarrierV n)));
              j := Thread (App (Val v) (Val (BarrierV n)));
              n := Barrier]} : cfg) j =
  val_refs v ∪ {[n]}.
Proof.
  rewrite Fork_tgt_refs by assumption.
  destruct (decide (j = i)) as [E|H]; [exfalso; apply Hij; symmetry; exact E|].
  destruct (decide (j = j)) as [E|H']; [|exfalso; apply H'; reflexivity].
  simpl. set_solver.
Qed.

Lemma forkbar_tgt_refs_n v k i j n
    (Hij : i <> j) (Hin : i <> n) (Hjn : j <> n) :
  refs_at ({[i := Thread (k (Val (BarrierV n)));
              j := Thread (App (Val v) (Val (BarrierV n)));
              n := Barrier]} : cfg) n = ∅.
Proof.
  rewrite Fork_tgt_refs by assumption.
  destruct (decide (n = i)) as [E|H]; [exfalso; apply Hin; symmetry; exact E|].
  destruct (decide (n = j)) as [E|H']; [exfalso; apply Hjn; symmetry; exact E|].
  destruct (decide (n = n)) as [E|H'']; [reflexivity|exfalso; apply H''; reflexivity].
Qed.

Lemma forkbar_tgt_refs_other v k i j n a
    (Hij : i <> j) (Hin : i <> n) (Hjn : j <> n)
    (Hai : a <> i) (Haj : a <> j) (Han : a <> n) :
  refs_at ({[i := Thread (k (Val (BarrierV n)));
              j := Thread (App (Val v) (Val (BarrierV n)));
              n := Barrier]} : cfg) a = ∅.
Proof.
  rewrite Fork_tgt_refs by assumption.
  destruct (decide (a = i)) as [E|H]; [exfalso; apply Hai; exact E|].
  destruct (decide (a = j)) as [E|H']; [exfalso; apply Haj; exact E|].
  destruct (decide (a = n)) as [E|H'']; [exfalso; apply Han; exact E|reflexivity].
Qed.

Theorem Fork_pair_preserve v k i j n :
  i <> j -> i <> n -> j <> n -> ctx k ->
  ref_pair_ok_fun (refs_at ({[i := Thread (k (ForkBarrier (Val v)))]} : cfg)) ->
  refs_live ({[i := Thread (k (ForkBarrier (Val v)))]} : cfg) ->
  ref_pair_ok_fun
    (refs_at ({[i := Thread (k (Val (BarrierV n)));
                 j := Thread (App (Val v) (Val (BarrierV n)));
                 n := Barrier]} : cfg)).
Proof.
  intros Hij Hin Hjn Hk Hpair Hrl.
  set (src := ({[i := Thread (k (ForkBarrier (Val v)))]} : cfg)).
  set (tgt := ({[i := Thread (k (Val (BarrierV n)));
                  j := Thread (App (Val v) (Val (BarrierV n)));
                  n := Barrier]} : cfg)).
  change (ref_pair_ok_fun (refs_at tgt)).
  eapply kind_fork_pair with (ρ := src)
    (e := k (ForkBarrier (Val v))) (B := val_refs v) (T := refs_at tgt).
  - exact Hpair.
  - exact Hrl.
  - apply (forkbar_src_lookup_j_none v k i j n Hij Hin).
  - apply (forkbar_src_lookup_n_none v k i j n Hij Hin).
  - apply (forkbar_src_lookup_i v k i j n Hij Hin).
  - intros r Hr.
    apply (ctx_expr_refs k Hk (ForkBarrier (Val v))).
    simpl. set_solver.
  - exact Hin.
  - exact Hjn.
  - unfold tgt. rewrite forkbar_tgt_refs_j by assumption. reflexivity.
  - unfold tgt, src. rewrite forkbar_tgt_refs_i by assumption.
    rewrite forkbar_src_refs_i by exact Hk.
    rewrite (ctx_expr_refs_eq k Hk (Val (BarrierV n))).
    rewrite (ctx_expr_refs_eq k Hk (ForkBarrier (Val v))).
    simpl. set_solver.
  - unfold tgt. rewrite forkbar_tgt_refs_n by assumption. reflexivity.
  - intros a Hai Haj Han.
    unfold tgt, src.
    rewrite forkbar_tgt_refs_other with (v:=v) (k:=k) (i:=i) (j:=j) (n:=n)
      by assumption.
    rewrite forkbar_src_refs_other with (v:=v) (k:=k) (i:=i) by assumption.
    reflexivity.
Qed.

However the task asks step 2 "Try to maintain this as a syntactic runtime invariant `unr_args_ref_free` on configurations, or via `cvS`/`wtS` plus a refined typed-value invariant."

Maybe a purely syntactic invariant suffices for preservation through local steps without subject reduction: `unr_args_ref_free` says every `FunV x body` reached at beta has argument refs empty; but how prove preserved through arbitrary local steps? Could make it *very* strong: every value `FunV x body` in the configuration with `var_budget x body >1` has body's **all substituted arguments**? Wait beta reduction consumes the function value and argument, replacing with body; after reduction, new functions may appear from body that duplicate x (now substituted). If body contained `FunV y body2` with high budget and substitution y:=a creates refs in body2, the newly introduced function value may be unsafe. Could happen if body2 uses y multiple times and a ref-carrying, while the **outer** function body was typed? But if outer function is well-typed and y's type linear? The syntactic invariant would need to account for all values in all bodies and environments.

Alternatively define syntactic invariant based on `expr_refs`:
```
all_fun_bodies_unr_safe e :=
 forall x body, FunV x body occurs in e ->
   var_budget x body <=1 \/ expr_refs body = ∅ ??? 
```
This doesn't prevent beta with ref-carrying argument when budget>1: counterexample body Pair(Var x)(Var x) has refs empty, but argument LockV refs nonempty. However after beta it becomes Pair(LockV n)(LockV n) with refs nonempty, violating index_single. So need forbid function bodies that duplicate variables unless argument ref-free. A syntactic invariant "if budget>1 then body's type for x is unr" is typing-based.

Maybe the intended solution: use `wtS` preservation for **threads**, which might be derivable from existing subject reduction work? Let's check if `wtS` is preserved by pure step/local step in files. Search all scratch.

From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.

From Stdlib Require Import Classical_Prop Wellfounded Wf_nat Lia.
From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String Eqdep_dec.
From Stdlib Require Import Relation_Operators Arith.
From stdpp Require Import finite.
From Stdlib Require Import FunctionalExtensionality.
Open Scope string_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Runtime typing for configurations.                                 *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* Source terms are Val-free, so [typed] cannot type configurations   *)
(* produced by reduction.  [wt] extends it with runtime values [cv].  *)
(* Values are environment-independent (they are closed).               *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Inductive wt (L : gmap nat type) : env -> expr -> type -> Prop :=
  | VarW Γ x t :
      env_var Γ x t ->
      wt L Γ (Var x) t
  | FunW Γ Γ' x e t1 t2 l :
      env_bind Γ' x t1 Γ ->
      (l = Unr -> env_unr Γ) ->
      wt L Γ' e t2 ->
      wt L Γ (Fun x e) (FunT l t1 t2)
  | AppW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 l :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (FunT l t1 t2) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 t1 ->
      wt L Γ (App e1 e2) t2
  | UnitW Γ :
      env_unr Γ ->
      wt L Γ Unit UnitT
  | PairW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 t1 ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 t2 ->
      wt L Γ (Pair e1 e2) (PairT t1 t2)
  | LetPairW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 t :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (PairT t1 t2) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 (FunT Lin t1 (FunT Lin t2 t)) ->
      wt L Γ (LetPair e1 e2) t
  | SumW Γ n (ts : fin n -> type) i e :
      wt L Γ e (ts i) ->
      wt L Γ (Sum i e) (SumT n ts)
  | MatchSumW n Γ Γ1 Γ2 t (ts : fin n -> type) es e :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      (n = 0 -> env_unr Γ2) ->
      wt L Γ1 e (SumT n ts) ->
      (forall i, wt L Γ2 (es i) (FunT Lin (ts i) t)) ->
      wt L Γ (MatchSum n e es) t
  | ForkW Γ e t1 t2 :
      wt L Γ e (FunT Lin (FunT Lin t2 t1) UnitT) ->
      wt L Γ (ForkBarrier e) (FunT Lin t1 t2)
  | NewLockW Γ e t :
      wt L Γ e t ->
      wt L Γ (NewLock e) (LockT (Owner,Closed) t)
  | ForkLockW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t l1 l2 l3 :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      lockcap_split l1 l2 l3 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (LockT l1 t) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 (FunT Lin (LockT l2 t) UnitT) ->
      wt L Γ (ForkLock e1 e2) (LockT l3 t)
  | AcquireW Γ e t lo :
      wt L Γ e (LockT (lo,Closed) t) ->
      wt L Γ (Acquire e) (PairT (LockT (lo,Opened) t) t)
  | ReleaseW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t lo :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (LockT (lo,Opened) t) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 t ->
      wt L Γ (Release e1 e2) (LockT (lo,Closed) t)
  | WaitW Γ e t :
      wt L Γ e (LockT (Owner,Closed) t) ->
      wt L Γ (Wait e) t
  | DropW Γ e t :
      wt L Γ e (LockT (Client,Closed) t) ->
      wt L Γ (Drop e) UnitT
  | ValW Γ v t :
      env_unr Γ ->
      cv L v t ->
      wt L Γ (Val v) t
with cv (L : gmap nat type) : val -> type -> Prop :=
  | FunVW x e t1 t2 l :
      wt L (<[ x := t1 ]> (∅ : env)) e t2 ->
      cv L (FunV x e) (FunT l t1 t2)
  | UnitVW : cv L UnitV UnitT
  | PairVW v1 v2 t1 t2 :
      cv L v1 t1 -> cv L v2 t2 ->
      cv L (PairV v1 v2) (PairT t1 t2)
  | SumVW n (ts : fin n -> type) i v :
      cv L v (ts i) ->
      cv L (SumV i v) (SumT n ts)
  | BarrierVW n t1 t2 :
      cv L (BarrierV n) (FunT Lin t1 t2)
  | LockVW n lc t :
      L !! n = Some t ->
      cv L (LockV n) (LockT lc t).

(* ---------- gmap / environment helpers ---------- *)

Lemma env_lookup_insert_same x (t : type) : (<[x:=t]>(∅ : env)) !! x = Some t.
Proof. unfold env in *. apply lookup_insert_eq. Qed.

Lemma rotate_closed_path_at_i
  (H : nat -> nat -> Prop) (l : list nat) (i : nat) :
  NoDup l -> 3 <= List.length l -> In i l ->
  path_edges H (l ++ [List.hd 0 l]) ->
  exists r, NoDup (i :: r)%list /\ 2 <= List.length r /\
    ~ In i r /\ path_edges H (i :: (r ++ [i]))%list.
Proof.
  intros Hnd Hlen Hin Hpath.
  destruct (list_split_at l i Hin) as [pre [rest E]].
  rewrite E in Hnd, Hlen, Hpath.
  assert (Hnd_ir : NoDup (i :: rest)%list).
  { exact (NoDup_app_remove_l pre (i :: rest)%list Hnd). }
  assert (Hir : ~ In i rest).
  { exact (proj1 (proj1 (NoDup_cons_iff i rest) Hnd_ir)). }
  destruct pre as [|a pre'].
  - simpl in Hpath.
    exists rest. split; [exact Hnd_ir|]. split.
    + simpl in Hlen. lia.
    + split; [exact Hir|].
      change (path_edges H (i :: (rest ++ [i]))%list). exact Hpath.
  - assert (Hhd : List.hd 0 ((a :: pre') ++ i :: rest)%list = List.hd 0 (a :: pre')%list).
    { apply hd_prefix_cons. discriminate. }
    rewrite Hhd in Hpath.
    rewrite <- app_assoc in Hpath.
    pose proof (path_edges_rotate_at H (a :: pre')%list (i :: rest)%list
                  (cons_not_nil a pre') (cons_not_nil i rest) Hpath) as Hrot.
    assert (Hnd_rot : NoDup (i :: (rest ++ (a :: pre')))%list).
    { change (NoDup ((i :: rest) ++ (a :: pre'))%list).
      exact (NoDup_rotate (a :: pre')%list rest i Hnd). }
    exists (rest ++ (a :: pre'))%list. split; [exact Hnd_rot|]. split.
    + rewrite List.length_app. simpl.
      rewrite List.length_app in Hlen. simpl in Hlen. lia.
    + split.
      * exact (proj1 (proj1 (NoDup_cons_iff i (rest ++ (a :: pre'))%list) Hnd_rot)).
      * rewrite <- app_assoc. exact Hrot.
Qed.

Lemma last_cons_nonempty (i : nat) (r : list nat) :
  r <> [] -> List.last (i :: r)%list 0 = List.last r 0.
Proof.
Lemma path_edges_head_edge (R : nat -> nat -> Prop) (i : nat) (l : list nat) :
  l <> [] -> path_edges R (i :: l) -> R i (List.hd 0 l).
Proof.
  intros Hne Hp. destruct l as [|a l'].
  - contradiction.
  - simpl in Hp. inversion Hp as [| |a0 b0 l0 Hr Hrest]; subst.
    exact Hr.
Qed.

Lemma path_edges_last_edge_cons (R : nat -> nat -> Prop) (i : nat) (l : list nat) :
  l <> [] -> path_edges R (i :: (l ++ [i])) -> R (List.last l 0) i.
Proof.
  intros Hne Hp.
  assert (Hpath : path_edges R ((i :: l) ++ [i])%list).
  { simpl. exact Hp. }
  assert (Hlast : List.last (i :: l) 0 = List.last l 0).
  { destruct l as [|a l'].
    - contradiction.
    - simpl. reflexivity. }
  assert (HE : R (List.last (i :: l) 0) i).
  { apply path_edges_last_edge; [exact Hpath|discriminate]. }
  rewrite Hlast in HE. exact HE.
Qed.

(* The internal path [l] of a path [i :: l ++ [i]] is a path. *)
Lemma path_edges_head_edge_closed (R : nat -> nat -> Prop) (i : nat) (r : list nat) :

Proof.

  assert (Hne : (r ++ [i])%list <> []).
  { destruct r; [contradiction|discriminate]. }
  pose proof (path_edges_head_edge R i (r ++ [i])%list Hne Hp) as Hh.
  rewrite hd_snoc in Hh by exact Hr_ne. exact Hh.
Qed.

Lemma env_var_lookup Γ x t : env_var Γ x t -> Γ !! x = Some t.
Proof.
  intros [Γ' [E _]]. subst Γ. unfold env in *.
  apply lookup_insert_eq.
Qed.

Lemma env_var_unr_delete Γ x t : env_var Γ x t -> env_unr (delete x Γ).
Proof.
  intros [Γ' [E Hu]]. subst Γ.
  rewrite delete_insert_same_env.
  apply env_unr_delete. exact Hu.
Qed.

Lemma env_var_delete Γ x y t : env_var Γ y t -> y <> x -> env_var (delete x Γ) y t.
Proof.
  intros [Γ' [E Hu]] Hne. subst Γ.
  exists (delete x Γ'). split.
  - rewrite delete_insert_comm_env; [done | intros H; exact (Hne (eq_sym H))].
  - apply env_unr_delete. exact Hu.
Qed.

Lemma env_var_empty x t : env_var (∅ : env) x t -> False.
Proof.
  intros [Γ' [E _]].
  assert (Hl : (<[x:=t]>Γ') !! x = Some t) by apply lookup_insert_eq.
  symmetry in E. rewrite E in Hl. cbn in Hl. discriminate Hl.
Qed.

Lemma env_split_lookup_l Γ Γ1 Γ2 x t :
  env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 -> Γ1 !! x = Some t -> Γ !! x = Some t.
Proof.
  intros [E _] H1. subst Γ.
  apply (lookup_union_Some_l Γ1 Γ2 x t H1).
Qed.

Lemma env_split_lookup_none Γ Γ1 Γ2 x :
  env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 -> Γ !! x = None -> Γ1 !! x = None /\ Γ2 !! x = None.
Proof.
  intros [E _] H. subst Γ.
  apply (proj1 (lookup_union_None Γ1 Γ2 x)). exact H.
Qed.

Lemma env_split_lookup_r Γ Γ1 Γ2 x t :
  env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 -> Γ1 !! x = None -> Γ !! x = Some t -> Γ2 !! x = Some t.
Proof.
  intros [E _] Hn Hsome.
  unfold env in *.
  rewrite E in Hsome.
  rewrite lookup_union in Hsome.
  destruct (Γ1 !! x) as [t1|] eqn:E1.
  - discriminate Hn.
  - rewrite option_union_none_l in Hsome. exact Hsome.
Qed.

Lemma env_split_lookup_r_some Γ Γ1 Γ2 x t :
  env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 -> Γ2 !! x = Some t -> Γ !! x = Some t.
Proof.
  intros [E Hd] H2. unfold env in *. rewrite E. rewrite lookup_union.
  destruct (Γ1 !! x) as [t0|] eqn:E1.
  - destruct (Hd x t0 t E1 H2) as [-> _]. rewrite option_union_some_l. reflexivity.
  - rewrite option_union_none_l. exact H2.
Qed.

  | Fun_unr t1 t2 : unr (FunT Unr t1 t2)

Definition env := gmap string type.

Definition env_unr (Γ : env) :=
  ∀ x t, Γ !! x = Some t -> unr t.

  ∀ i t1 t2, Γ1 !! i = Some t1 -> Γ2 !! i = Some t2 -> t1 = t2 ∧ unr t1.

  Γ = Γ1 ∪ Γ2 ∧ disj Γ1 Γ2.

  ∃ Γ', Γ = <[ x := t ]> Γ' ∧ env_unr Γ'.

Lemma env_split_lookup_r Γ Γ1 Γ2 x t :
  env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 -> Γ1 !! x = None -> Γ !! x = Some t -> Γ2 !! x = Some t.
Proof.
  intros [E _] Hn Hsome.
  unfold env in *.
  rewrite E in Hsome.
  rewrite lookup_union in Hsome.
  destruct (Γ1 !! x) as [t1|] eqn:E1.
  - discriminate Hn.
  - rewrite option_union_none_l in Hsome. exact Hsome.
Qed.

Lemma env_split_lookup_r_some Γ Γ1 Γ2 x t :
  env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 -> Γ2 !! x = Some t -> Γ !! x = Some t.
Proof.
  intros [E Hd] H2. unfold env in *. rewrite E. rewrite lookup_union.
  destruct (Γ1 !! x) as [t0|] eqn:E1.
  - destruct (Hd x t0 t E1 H2) as [-> _]. rewrite option_union_some_l. reflexivity.
  - rewrite option_union_none_l. exact H2.
Qed.

From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.

From Stdlib Require Import Classical_Prop Wellfounded Wf_nat Lia.
From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String Eqdep_dec.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Runtime typing for configurations.                                 *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* Source terms are Val-free, so [typed] cannot type configurations   *)
(* produced by reduction.  [wt] extends it with runtime values [cv].  *)
(* Values are environment-independent (they are closed).               *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Inductive wt (L : gmap nat type) : env -> expr -> type -> Prop :=
  | VarW Γ x t :
      env_var Γ x t ->
      wt L Γ (Var x) t
From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Export langdef.

Fixpoint expr_refs e :=
  match e with
  | Val v => val_refs v
  | Var x => ∅
  | Fun x e => expr_refs e
  | App e1 e2 => expr_refs e1 ∪ expr_refs e2
  | Unit => ∅
  | Pair e1 e2 => expr_refs e1 ∪ expr_refs e2
  | LetPair e1 e2 => expr_refs e1 ∪ expr_refs e2
  | Sum i e => expr_refs e
  | MatchSum n e es => expr_refs e ∪ fin_union n (expr_refs ∘ es)
  | ForkBarrier e => expr_refs e
  | NewLock e => expr_refs e
  | ForkLock e1 e2 => expr_refs e1 ∪ expr_refs e2
  | Acquire e => expr_refs e
  | Release e1 e2 => expr_refs e1 ∪ expr_refs e2
  | Wait e => expr_refs e
  | Drop e => expr_refs e
  end
with val_refs v :=
  match v with
  | FunV x e => expr_refs e
  | UnitV => ∅

p='/tmp/scratch6/ForestFinal.v'
s=open(p).read()
idx=s.index('Theorem Sync_pair_preserve')
prefix=s[:idx]
new=r'''Lemma sync_src_bundle1_subset v1 v2 k1 k2 i j n
    (Hij : i <> j) (Hin : i <> n) (Hjn : j <> n) (Hk1 : ctx k1) :
  val_refs v1 ⊆ refs_at ({[i := Thread (k1 (App (Val (BarrierV n)) (Val v1)));
                              j := Thread (k2 (App (Val (BarrierV n)) (Val v2)));
                              n := Barrier]} : cfg) i.
Proof.
  rewrite sync_src_refs_i by assumption.
  rewrite (ctx_expr_refs_eq k1 Hk1 (App (Val (BarrierV n)) (Val v1))).
  simpl. set_solver.
Qed.

Lemma sync_src_bundle2_subset v1 v2 k1 k2 i j n
    (Hij : i <> j) (Hin : i <> n) (Hjn : j <> n) (Hk2 : ctx k2) :
  val_refs v2 ⊆ refs_at ({[i := Thread (k1 (App (Val (BarrierV n)) (Val v1)));
                              j := Thread (k2 (App (Val (BarrierV n)) (Val v2)));
                              n := Barrier]} : cfg) j.
Proof.
  rewrite sync_src_refs_j by assumption.
  rewrite (ctx_expr_refs_eq k2 Hk2 (App (Val (BarrierV n)) (Val v2))).
  simpl. set_solver.
Qed.

Lemma sync_src_lookup_j_live v1 v2 k1 k2 i j n
    (Hij : i <> j) (Hjn : j <> n) :
  ({[i := Thread (k1 (App (Val (BarrierV n)) (Val v1)));
     j := Thread (k2 (App (Val (BarrierV n)) (Val v2)));
     n := Barrier]} : cfg) !! j <> None.
Proof.
  apply lookup_live_of_eq with
    (o := Thread (k2 (App (Val (BarrierV n)) (Val v2)))).
  apply (sync_src_lookup_j v1 v2 k1 k2 i j n Hij Hjn).
Qed.

Lemma sync_src_lookup_i_live v1 v2 k1 k2 i j n (Hij : i <> j) :
  ({[i := Thread (k1 (App (Val (BarrierV n)) (Val v1)));
     j := Thread (k2 (App (Val (BarrierV n)) (Val v2)));
     n := Barrier]} : cfg) !! i <> None.
Proof.
  apply lookup_live_of_eq with
    (o := Thread (k1 (App (Val (BarrierV n)) (Val v1)))).
  apply sync_src_lookup_i. exact Hij.
Qed.

Theorem Sync_pair_preserve v1 v2 k1 k2 i j n :
  i <> j -> i <> n -> j <> n -> ctx k1 -> ctx k2 ->
  ref_pair_ok_fun (refs_at ({[i := Thread (k1 (App (Val (BarrierV n)) (Val v1)));
                               j := Thread (k2 (App (Val (BarrierV n)) (Val v2)));
                               n := Barrier]} : cfg)) ->
  kind_live ({[i := Thread (k1 (App (Val (BarrierV n)) (Val v1)));
                j := Thread (k2 (App (Val (BarrierV n)) (Val v2)));
                n := Barrier]} : cfg) ->
  refs_live ({[i := Thread (k1 (App (Val (BarrierV n)) (Val v1)));
                j := Thread (k2 (App (Val (BarrierV n)) (Val v2)));
                n := Barrier]} : cfg) ->
  ref_pair_ok_fun
    (refs_at ({[i := Thread (k1 (Val v2));
                 j := Thread (k2 (Val v1))]} : cfg)).
Proof.
  intros Hij Hin Hjn Hk1 Hk2 Hpair Hkind Hrl.
  set (src := ({[i := Thread (k1 (App (Val (BarrierV n)) (Val v1)));
                  j := Thread (k2 (App (Val (BarrierV n)) (Val v2)));
                  n := Barrier]} : cfg)).
  set (tgt := ({[i := Thread (k1 (Val v2));
                  j := Thread (k2 (Val v1))]} : cfg)).
  set (S := refs_at src).
  set (T := refs_at tgt).
  set (B1 := val_refs v1).
  set (B2 := val_refs v2).
  set (M := fun a => if decide (a = j) then S j ∪ B1
                     else if decide (a = i) then expr_refs (k1 (Var "ctx_hole"))
                     else S a).
  change (ref_pair_ok_fun T).
  assert (HpairM : ref_pair_ok_fun M).
  { eapply pair_move_to_dest with (S := S) (T := M)
      (d := j) (s := i) (B := B1).
    - exact Hpair.
    - exact Hij.
    - unfold M. destruct (decide (j = j)) as [E|H]; [reflexivity|exfalso; apply H; reflexivity].
    - unfold M. intro x Hx.
      destruct (decide (i = j)) as [E|H].
      + exfalso. apply Hij. exact E.
      + destruct (decide (i = i)) as [E|H']; [|exfalso; apply H'; reflexivity].
        rewrite <- (ctx_expr_refs k1 Hk1 (App (Val (BarrierV n)) (Val v1))) in Hx.
        exact Hx.
    - intros a Haj Hai. unfold M.
      destruct (decide (a = j)) as [E|H]; [exfalso; apply Haj; exact E|].
      destruct (decide (a = i)) as [E|H']; [exfalso; apply Hai; exact E|reflexivity].
    - (* j ∉ B1 *)
      intro HjB.
      assert (HjSi : j ∈ S i).
      { unfold S. apply (sync_src_bundle1_subset v1 v2 k1 k2 i j n); assumption. exact HjB. }
      exact (kind_live_no_thread_in_refs_at src j
               (k2 (App (Val (BarrierV n)) (Val v2))) i Hkind
               (sync_src_lookup_j_live v1 v2 k1 k2 i j n Hij Hjn)
               (sync_src_lookup_i_live v1 v2 k1 k2 i j n Hij) HjSi).
    - (* for b in B1, j is not a backward reference of M b *)
      intros b Hb HjMb.
      assert (HbSi : b ∈ S i).
      { unfold S. apply (sync_src_bundle1_subset v1 v2 k1 k2 i j n); assumption. exact Hb. }
      assert (Hblive : src !! b <> None)
        by (apply (Hrl i; exact HbSi)).
      exact (kind_live_no_thread_in_refs_at src j
               (k2 (App (Val (BarrierV n)) (Val v2))) b Hkind
               (sync_src_lookup_j_live v1 v2 k1 k2 i j n Hij Hjn) Hblive HjMb). }
  eapply pair_move_to_dest with (S := M) (T := T)
    (d := i) (s := j) (B := B2).
  - exact HpairM.
  - apply ne_sym. exact Hij.
  - (* T i = M i ∪ B2 *)
    unfold T, M, B2, S.
    rewrite sync_tgt_refs_i by exact Hij.
    rewrite (ctx_expr_refs_eq k1 Hk1 (Val v2)).
    destruct (decide (i = j)) as [E|H]; [exfalso; apply Hij; exact E|].
    destruct (decide (i = i)) as [E|H']; [|exfalso; apply H'; reflexivity].
    set_solver.
  - (* T j ⊆ M j *)
    unfold T, M, B1, S.
    rewrite sync_tgt_refs_j by exact Hij.
    rewrite (ctx_expr_refs_eq k2 Hk2 (Val v1)).
    rewrite sync_src_refs_j by assumption.
    rewrite (ctx_expr_refs_eq k2 Hk2 (App (Val (BarrierV n)) (Val v2))).
    destruct (decide (j = j)) as [E|H]; [|exfalso; apply H; reflexivity].
    simpl. set_solver.
  - (* all other keys *)
    intros a Hai Haj. unfold T, M.
    rewrite sync_tgt_refs_other with (v1:=v1) (v2:=v2) (k1:=k1) (k2:=k2)
      (i:=i) (j:=j) by assumption.
    unfold S.
    rewrite sync_src_refs_other with (v1:=v1) (v2:=v2) (k1:=k1) (k2:=k2)
      (i:=i) (j:=j) (n:=n) by assumption.
    destruct (decide (a = j)) as [E|H]; [exfalso; apply Haj; exact E|].
    destruct (decide (a = i)) as [E|H']; [exfalso; apply Hai; exact E|reflexivity].
  - (* i ∉ B2 *)
    intro HiB.
    assert (HiSj : i ∈ S j).
    { unfold S. apply (sync_src_bundle2_subset v1 v2 k1 k2 i j n); assumption. exact HiB. }
    exact (kind_live_no_thread_in_refs_at src i
             (k1 (App (Val (BarrierV n)) (Val v1))) j Hkind
             (sync_src_lookup_i_live v1 v2 k1 k2 i j n Hij)
             (sync_src_lookup_j_live v1 v2 k1 k2 i j n Hij Hjn) HiSj).
  - (* for b in B2, i is not a backward reference of T b *)
    intros b Hb HiTb.
    assert (HbSj : b ∈ S j).
    { unfold S. apply (sync_src_bundle2_subset v1 v2 k1 k2 i j n); assumption. exact Hb. }
    assert (Hblive : src !! b <> None)
      by (apply (Hrl j HbSj)).
    exact (kind_live_no_thread_in_refs_at src i
             (k1 (App (Val (BarrierV n)) (Val v1))) b Hkind
             (sync_src_lookup_i_live v1 v2 k1 k2 i j n Hij) Hblive HiTb).
Qed.

Print Assumptions Sync_pair_preserve.
'''
open(p,'w').write(prefix+new)

(* Values are environment-independent (they are closed).               *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Inductive wt (L : gmap nat type) : env -> expr -> type -> Prop :=
  | VarW Γ x t :
      env_var Γ x t ->
      wt L Γ (Var x) t
  | FunW Γ Γ' x e t1 t2 l :
      env_bind Γ' x t1 Γ ->
      (l = Unr -> env_unr Γ) ->
      wt L Γ' e t2 ->
      wt L Γ (Fun x e) (FunT l t1 t2)
  | AppW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 l :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (FunT l t1 t2) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 t1 ->
      wt L Γ (App e1 e2) t2
  | UnitW Γ :
      env_unr Γ ->
      wt L Γ Unit UnitT
  | PairW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 t1 ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 t2 ->
      wt L Γ (Pair e1 e2) (PairT t1 t2)
  | LetPairW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 t :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (PairT t1 t2) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 (FunT Lin t1 (FunT Lin t2 t)) ->
      wt L Γ (LetPair e1 e2) t
  | SumW Γ n (ts : fin n -> type) i e :
      wt L Γ e (ts i) ->
      wt L Γ (Sum i e) (SumT n ts)
  | MatchSumW n Γ Γ1 Γ2 t (ts : fin n -> type) es e :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      (n = 0 -> env_unr Γ2) ->
      wt L Γ1 e (SumT n ts) ->
      (forall i, wt L Γ2 (es i) (FunT Lin (ts i) t)) ->
      wt L Γ (MatchSum n e es) t
  | ForkW Γ e t1 t2 :
      wt L Γ e (FunT Lin (FunT Lin t2 t1) UnitT) ->
      wt L Γ (ForkBarrier e) (FunT Lin t1 t2)
  | NewLockW Γ e t :
      wt L Γ e t ->
      wt L Γ (NewLock e) (LockT (Owner,Closed) t)
  | ForkLockW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t l1 l2 l3 :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      lockcap_split l1 l2 l3 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (LockT l1 t) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 (FunT Lin (LockT l2 t) UnitT) ->
      wt L Γ (ForkLock e1 e2) (LockT l3 t)
  | AcquireW Γ e t lo :
      wt L Γ e (LockT (lo,Closed) t) ->
      wt L Γ (Acquire e) (PairT (LockT (lo,Opened) t) t)
  | ReleaseW Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t lo :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wt L Γ1 e1 (LockT (lo,Opened) t) ->
      wt L Γ2 e2 t ->
      wt L Γ (Release e1 e2) (LockT (lo,Closed) t)
  | WaitW Γ e t :
      wt L Γ e (LockT (Owner,Closed) t) ->
      wt L Γ (Wait e) t
  | DropW Γ e t :
      wt L Γ e (LockT (Client,Closed) t) ->
      wt L Γ (Drop e) UnitT
  | ValW Γ v t :
      env_unr Γ ->
      cv L v t ->
      wt L Γ (Val v) t
with cv (L : gmap nat type) : val -> type -> Prop :=
  | FunVW x e t1 t2 l :
      wt L (<[ x := t1 ]> (∅ : env)) e t2 ->
      cv L (FunV x e) (FunT l t1 t2)
  | UnitVW : cv L UnitV UnitT
  | PairVW v1 v2 t1 t2 :
      cv L v1 t1 -> cv L v2 t2 ->
      cv L (PairV v1 v2) (PairT t1 t2)
  | SumVW n (ts : fin n -> type) i v :
      cv L v (ts i) ->
      cv L (SumV i v) (SumT n ts)
  | BarrierVW n t1 t2 :
      cv L (BarrierV n) (FunT Lin t1 t2)
  | LockVW n lc t :
      L !! n = Some t ->
      cv L (LockV n) (LockT lc t).

(* ---------- gmap / environment helpers ---------- *)

Lemma env_lookup_insert_same x (t : type) : (<[x:=t]>(∅ : env)) !! x = Some t.
Proof. unfold env in *. apply lookup_insert_eq. Qed.

Lemma env_lookup_insert_none x y (t : type) (Γ : env) : x <> y -> Γ !! y = None -> (<[x:=t]>Γ) !! y = None.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. intros Hne Hy.
  rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x y t Hne). done.
Qed.

Lemma env_unr_delete x (Γ : env) : env_unr Γ -> env_unr (delete x Γ).
Proof.
  intros H y t Hy. unfold env_unr in H. unfold env in *.
  destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_eq Γ y) in Hy. done.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ x y E) in Hy. apply H in Hy. done.
Qed.

Lemma env_unr_insert_lookup x (t : type) (Γ : env) :
  env_unr (<[x:=t]>Γ) -> unr t.
Proof. intros H. unfold env_unr in H. apply (H x t). unfold env. apply lookup_insert_eq. Qed.

Lemma env_union_empty_l (m : env) : ∅ ∪ m = m.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro x. rewrite lookup_union.
  assert (H : (∅ : gmap string type) !! x = None) by apply lookup_empty.
  rewrite H. destruct (m !! x); done.
Qed.

Lemma env_union_empty_r (m : env) : m ∪ ∅ = m.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. apply map_eq. intro x. rewrite lookup_union.
  assert (H : (∅ : gmap string type) !! x = None) by apply lookup_empty.
  rewrite H. destruct (m !! x); done.
Qed.

Lemma env_split_empty (Γ1 Γ2 : env) : env_split ∅ Γ1 Γ2 -> Γ1 = ∅ /\ Γ2 = ∅.
Proof.
  unfold env in *.
  intros [Hun Hdis]. symmetry in Hun.
  apply map_positive_l in Hun as H1. subst Γ1.
  rewrite env_union_empty_l in Hun. subst Γ2. split; reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma disj_delete x (Γ1 Γ2 : env) : disj Γ1 Γ2 -> disj (delete x Γ1) (delete x Γ2).
Proof.
  unfold env in *.
  intros H i t1 t2 H1 H2.
  destruct (decide (x=i)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_eq Γ1 i) in H1. done.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ1 x i E) in H1. rewrite (lookup_delete_ne Γ2 x i E) in H2. apply (H i t1 t2 H1 H2).
Qed.

Lemma delete_insert_none x (t : type) (Γ : env) : Γ !! x = None -> delete x (<[x:=t]>Γ) = Γ.
Proof.
  unfold env in *. intros Hx. apply map_eq. intro y. destruct (decide (x=y)) as [E|E]; subst.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_eq (<[y:=t]>Γ) y). done.
  - rewrite (lookup_delete_ne (<[x:=t]>Γ) x y E). rewrite (lookup_insert_ne Γ x y t E). done.
Qed.
