From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.
From stdpp Require Import gmap decidable.
From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String Arith Lia Eqdep_dec.
From Stdlib Require Import Vectors.Fin.
Require Import AllCombine.
Require Import TokenCtx.
Require Import TokenLinear.
Open Scope string_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Linearity of variable occurrence in the runtime typing [wt].       *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* Environments split linearly: if a variable is present in a term's  *)
(* environment then either its type is unrestricted, or the variable  *)
(* is used at most once.  This is exactly the fact that turns a       *)
(* duplicated [Pair (Var x) (Var x)] into an [Unr]-typed parameter,   *)
(* and therefore (via [cvS_unr_refs]) into a reference-free argument. *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma env_bind_lookup_self Γ Γ' y t (Hb : env_bind Γ' y t Γ) :
  Γ' !! y = Some t.
Proof.
  destruct Hb as [E _]. subst Γ'.
  unfold env in *. apply lookup_insert_eq.
Qed.

Lemma env_bind_lookup_other Γ Γ' y t x (Hb : env_bind Γ' y t Γ)
    (Hxy : x <> y) :
  Γ' !! x = Γ !! x.
Proof.
  destruct Hb as [E _]. subst Γ'.
  unfold env in *. rewrite lookup_insert_ne; [reflexivity|].
  intro H; apply Hxy; symmetry; exact H.
Qed.

Lemma env_split_lookup_l_eq Γ Γ1 Γ2 x t tz
    (Hs : env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2)
    (H1 : Γ1 !! x = Some t) (HG : Γ !! x = Some tz) :
  tz = t.
Proof.
  pose proof (env_split_lookup_l Γ Γ1 Γ2 x t Hs H1) as Hl.
  rewrite Hl in HG. injection HG as ->. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma env_split_lookup_r_eq Γ Γ1 Γ2 x t tz
    (Hs : env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2)
    (H2 : Γ2 !! x = Some t) (HG : Γ !! x = Some tz) :
  tz = t.
Proof.
  pose proof (env_split_lookup_r_some Γ Γ1 Γ2 x t Hs H2) as Hr.
  rewrite Hr in HG. injection HG as ->. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma env_split_lookup_none_false Γ Γ1 Γ2 x tz
    (Hs : env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2)
    (H1 : Γ1 !! x = None) (H2 : Γ2 !! x = None)
    (HG : Γ !! x = Some tz) :
  False.
Proof.
  destruct Hs as [E _]. unfold env in *.
  assert (Hn : Γ !! x = None).
  { rewrite E. apply (proj2 (lookup_union_None Γ1 Γ2 x)).
    split; assumption. }
  rewrite Hn in HG. discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma wt_var_budget_mut L :
  forall Γ e t (H : wt L Γ e t),
    (forall x, Γ !! x = None -> var_budget x e = 0) /\
    (forall x tx, Γ !! x = Some tx -> var_budget x e <= 1 \/ unr tx).
Proof.
  set (P := fun (Γ : env) (e : expr) (t : type) =>
    (forall x, Γ !! x = None -> var_budget x e = 0) /\
    (forall x tx, Γ !! x = Some tx ->
       var_budget x e <= 1 \/ unr tx)).
  assert (P_bin : forall (e : expr) Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 t,
      (forall x, var_budget x e = var_budget x e1 + var_budget x e2) ->
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      P Γ1 e1 t1 -> P Γ2 e2 t2 -> P Γ e t).
  { intros e Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 t Hbud Hs H1 H2.
    unfold P in *. destruct Hs as [Eunion Hdisj]. split.
    - intros z Hnone.
      destruct (env_split_lookup_none Γ Γ1 Γ2 z (conj Eunion Hdisj) Hnone)
        as [Hn1 Hn2].
      destruct H1 as [H1a _]. destruct H2 as [H2a _].
      specialize (H1a z Hn1). specialize (H2a z Hn2).
      rewrite Hbud. lia.
    - intros z tz Hsome.
      destruct (Γ1 !! z) as [ta|] eqn:E1;
      destruct (Γ2 !! z) as [tb|] eqn:E2.
      + right.
        assert (Htz : tz = ta)
          by (apply (env_split_lookup_l_eq Γ Γ1 Γ2 z ta tz
                       (conj Eunion Hdisj) E1 Hsome)).
        subst tz.
        destruct (Hdisj z ta tb E1 E2) as [_ Hunr]. exact Hunr.
      + left.
        assert (Htz : tz = ta)
          by (apply (env_split_lookup_l_eq Γ Γ1 Γ2 z ta tz
                       (conj Eunion Hdisj) E1 Hsome)).
        subst tz.
        destruct (proj2 H1 z ta E1) as [Hb1|Hu1].
        * assert (Hv2 : var_budget z e2 = 0) by (apply (proj1 H2 z E2)).
          rewrite Hbud. lia.
        * right. exact Hu1.
      + left.
        assert (Htz : tz = tb)
          by (apply (env_split_lookup_r_eq Γ Γ1 Γ2 z tb tz
                       (conj Eunion Hdisj) E2 Hsome)).
        subst tz.
        destruct (proj2 H2 z tb E2) as [Hb2|Hu2].
        * assert (Hv1 : var_budget z e1 = 0) by (apply (proj1 H1 z E1)).
          rewrite Hbud. lia.
        * right. exact Hu2.
      + exfalso.
        exact (env_split_lookup_none_false Γ Γ1 Γ2 z tz
                 (conj Eunion Hdisj) E1 E2 Hsome). }
  assert (P_unary : forall (e : expr) Γ e' t' t,
      (forall x, var_budget x e = var_budget x e') ->
      P Γ e' t' -> P Γ e t).
  { intros e Γ e' t' t Hbud HP. unfold P in *. destruct HP as [Ha Hu].
    split.
    - intros z Hnone. rewrite Hbud. apply Ha, Hnone.
    - intros z tz Hsome. rewrite Hbud. apply Hu, Hsome. }
  assert (P_fun : forall Γ Γ' y e t1 t2 l,
      env_bind Γ' y t1 Γ -> P Γ' e t2 -> P Γ (Fun y e) (FunT l t1 t2)).
  { intros Γ Γ' y e t1 t2 l Hb HP. unfold P in *. destruct HP as [Ha Hu].
    split.
    - intros z Hnone. simpl.
      destruct (decide (z = y)) as [E|E].
      + subst z. reflexivity.
      + apply Ha. rewrite (env_bind_lookup_other Γ Γ' y t1 z Hb E).
        exact Hnone.
    - intros z tz Hsome. simpl.
      destruct (decide (z = y)) as [E|E].
      + subst z. left. lia.
      + apply Hu. rewrite (env_bind_lookup_other Γ Γ' y t1 z Hb E).
        exact Hsome. }
  assert (P_match : forall n Γ Γ1 Γ2 e es t (ts : fin n -> type),
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      P Γ1 e (SumT n ts) ->
      (forall i, P Γ2 (es i) (FunT Lin (ts i) t)) ->
      P Γ (MatchSum n e es) t).
  { intros n Γ Γ1 Γ2 e es t ts Hs HP1 HPf.
    unfold P in *. destruct Hs as [Eunion Hdisj].
    destruct HP1 as [H1a H1b]. split.
    - intros z Hnone.
      destruct (env_split_lookup_none Γ Γ1 Γ2 z (conj Eunion Hdisj) Hnone)
        as [Hn1 Hn2].
      specialize (H1a z Hn1) as Hv1.
      assert (Hvf : forall i, var_budget z (es i) = 0)
        by (intro i; apply (proj1 (HPf i) z Hn2)).
      assert (Hmax : fin_max (fun i => var_budget z (es i)) = 0).
      { assert (Hle : fin_max (fun i => var_budget z (es i)) <= 0)
          by (apply fin_max_le; intro i; rewrite Hvf; lia).
        lia. }
      simpl. rewrite Hv1, Hmax. reflexivity.
    - intros z tz Hsome.
      destruct (Γ1 !! z) as [ta|] eqn:E1;
      destruct (Γ2 !! z) as [tb|] eqn:E2.
      + right.
        assert (Htz : tz = ta)
          by (apply (env_split_lookup_l_eq Γ Γ1 Γ2 z ta tz
                       (conj Eunion Hdisj) E1 Hsome)).
        subst tz.
        destruct (Hdisj z ta tb E1 E2) as [_ Hunr]. exact Hunr.
      + left.
        assert (Htz : tz = ta)
          by (apply (env_split_lookup_l_eq Γ Γ1 Γ2 z ta tz
                       (conj Eunion Hdisj) E1 Hsome)).
        subst tz.
        destruct (proj2 HP1 z ta E1) as [Hb1|Hu1].
        * assert (Hvf : forall i, var_budget z (es i) = 0)
            by (intro i; apply (proj1 (HPf i) z E2)).
          assert (Hmax : fin_max (fun i => var_budget z (es i)) = 0).
          { assert (Hle : fin_max (fun i => var_budget z (es i)) <= 0)
              by (apply fin_max_le; intro i; rewrite Hvf; lia).
            lia. }
          simpl. rewrite Hb1, Hmax. lia.
        * right. exact Hu1.
      + left.
        assert (Htz : tz = tb)
          by (apply (env_split_lookup_r_eq Γ Γ1 Γ2 z tb tz
                       (conj Eunion Hdisj) E2 Hsome)).
        subst tz.
        assert (Hv1 : var_budget z e = 0) by (apply H1a, E1).
        assert (Hmax : fin_max (fun i => var_budget z (es i)) <= 1).
        { apply fin_max_le. intro i.
          destruct (proj2 (HPf i) z tb E2) as [Hb|Hu]; [exact Hb|].
          exfalso. exact (unr_fun_lin (ts i) t Hu). }
        simpl. rewrite Hv1. lia.
      + exfalso.
        exact (env_split_lookup_none_false Γ Γ1 Γ2 z tz
                 (conj Eunion Hdisj) E1 E2 Hsome). }
  assert (Hall : forall Γ e t, wt L Γ e t -> P Γ e t).
  { apply (wt_ind L P).
    - (* VarW *) intros Γ x t Hvar. unfold P. split.
      + intros z Hnone. simpl.
        destruct (decide (z = x)) as [E|E]; [|reflexivity].
        subst z. pose proof (env_var_lookup Γ x t Hvar) as Hsome.
        rewrite Hsome in Hnone. discriminate.
      + intros z tz Hsome. simpl.
        destruct (decide (z = x)); lia.
    - (* FunW *) intros Γ Γ' y e t1 t2 l Hb Hunr Hbody IH.
      exact (P_fun Γ Γ' y e t1 t2 l Hb IH).
    - (* AppW *) intros Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 l Hsplit H1 IH1 H2 IH2.
      exact (P_bin (App e1 e2) Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 t2
               (fun x => reflexivity) Hsplit IH1 IH2).
    - (* UnitW *) intros Γ Hunr. unfold P. split.
      + intros z Hnone. reflexivity.
      + intros z tz Hsome. left. simpl. lia.
    - (* PairW *) intros Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 Hsplit H1 IH1 H2 IH2.
      exact (P_bin (Pair e1 e2) Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 (PairT t1 t2)
               (fun x => reflexivity) Hsplit IH1 IH2).
    - (* LetPairW *) intros Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 t Hsplit H1 IH1 H2 IH2.
      exact (P_bin (LetPair e1 e2) Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 t
               (fun x => reflexivity) Hsplit IH1 IH2).
    - (* SumW *) intros Γ n ts i e H IH.
      exact (P_unary (Sum i e) Γ e (ts i) (SumT n ts)
               (fun x => reflexivity) IH).
    - (* MatchSumW *) intros n Γ Γ1 Γ2 t ts es e Hsplit Hn H1 IH1 Hf IHf.
      exact (P_match n Γ Γ1 Γ2 e es t ts Hsplit IH1 IHf).
    - (* ForkW *) intros Γ e t1 t2 H IH.
      exact (P_unary (ForkBarrier e) Γ e
               (FunT Lin (FunT Lin t2 t1) UnitT) (FunT Lin t1 t2)
               (fun x => reflexivity) IH).
    - (* NewLockW *) intros Γ e t H IH.
      exact (P_unary (NewLock e) Γ e t (LockT (Owner,Closed) t)
               (fun x => reflexivity) IH).
    - (* ForkLockW *) intros Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t l1 l2 l3 Hsplit Hcap H1 IH1 H2 IH2.
      exact (P_bin (ForkLock e1 e2) Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2
               (LockT l1 t) (FunT Lin (LockT l2 t) UnitT) (LockT l3 t)
               (fun x => reflexivity) Hsplit IH1 IH2).
    - (* AcquireW *) intros Γ e t lo H IH.
      exact (P_unary (Acquire e) Γ e (LockT (lo,Closed) t)
               (PairT (LockT (lo,Opened) t) t)
               (fun x => reflexivity) IH).
    - (* ReleaseW *) intros Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t lo Hsplit H1 IH1 H2 IH2.
      exact (P_bin (Release e1 e2) Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2
               (LockT (lo,Opened) t) t (LockT (lo,Closed) t)
               (fun x => reflexivity) Hsplit IH1 IH2).
    - (* WaitW *) intros Γ e t H IH.
      exact (P_unary (Wait e) Γ e (LockT (Owner,Closed) t) t
               (fun x => reflexivity) IH).
    - (* DropW *) intros Γ e t H IH.
      exact (P_unary (Drop e) Γ e (LockT (Client,Closed) t) UnitT
               (fun x => reflexivity) IH).
    - (* ValW *) intros Γ v t Hunr Hcv. unfold P. split.
      + intros z Hnone. reflexivity.
      + intros z tz Hsome. left. simpl. lia. }
  intros Γ e t H. exact (Hall Γ e t H).
Qed.

Lemma wt_var_budget_zero_of_absent L Γ e t x
    (H : wt L Γ e t) (Hnone : Γ !! x = None) :
  var_budget x e = 0.
Proof.
  exact (proj1 (wt_var_budget_mut L Γ e t H) x Hnone).
Qed.

Lemma wt_var_budget_linear_or_unr L Γ e t x tx
    (H : wt L Γ e t) (Hsome : Γ !! x = Some tx) :
  var_budget x e <= 1 \/ unr tx.
Proof.
  exact (proj2 (wt_var_budget_mut L Γ e t H) x tx Hsome).
Qed.

(* Names used in the beta-safety argument. *)
Lemma wt_var_absent_budget_zero L Γ e t x :
  wt L Γ e t -> Γ !! x = None -> var_budget x e = 0.
Proof. intros. apply (wt_var_budget_zero_of_absent L Γ e t x); assumption. Qed.

Lemma wt_var_budget_unr L Γ e t x tx :

Proof. intros. apply (wt_var_budget_linear_or_unr L Γ e t x tx); assumption. Qed.

From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.
From stdpp Require Import gmap decidable.
From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String Arith Lia Eqdep_dec.
From Stdlib Require Import Vectors.Fin.
Require Import AllCombine.
Require Import TokenCtx.
Require Import TokenLinear.
Open Scope string_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Linearity of variable occurrence in the runtime typing [wt].       *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* Environments split linearly: if a variable is present in a term's  *)
(* environment then either its type is unrestricted, or the variable  *)
(* is used at most once.  This is exactly the fact that turns a       *)
(* duplicated [Pair (Var x) (Var x)] into an [Unr]-typed parameter,   *)
(* and therefore (via [cvS_unr_refs]) into a reference-free argument. *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma env_bind_lookup_self Γ Γ' y t (Hb : env_bind Γ' y t Γ) :
  Γ' !! y = Some t.
Proof.
  destruct Hb as [E _]. subst Γ'.
  unfold env in *. apply lookup_insert_eq.
Qed.

Lemma env_bind_lookup_other Γ Γ' y t x (Hb : env_bind Γ' y t Γ)
    (Hxy : x <> y) :
  Γ' !! x = Γ !! x.
Proof.
  destruct Hb as [E _]. subst Γ'.
  unfold env in *. rewrite lookup_insert_ne; [reflexivity|].
  intro H; apply Hxy; symmetry; exact H.
Qed.

Lemma env_split_lookup_l_eq Γ Γ1 Γ2 x t tz
    (Hs : env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2)
    (H1 : Γ1 !! x = Some t) (HG : Γ !! x = Some tz) :
  tz = t.
Proof.
  pose proof (env_split_lookup_l Γ Γ1 Γ2 x t Hs H1) as Hl.
  rewrite Hl in HG. injection HG as ->. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma env_split_lookup_r_eq Γ Γ1 Γ2 x t tz
    (Hs : env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2)
    (H2 : Γ2 !! x = Some t) (HG : Γ !! x = Some tz) :
  tz = t.
Proof.
  pose proof (env_split_lookup_r_some Γ Γ1 Γ2 x t Hs H2) as Hr.
  rewrite Hr in HG. injection HG as ->. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma env_split_lookup_none_false Γ Γ1 Γ2 x tz
    (Hs : env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2)
    (H1 : Γ1 !! x = None) (H2 : Γ2 !! x = None)
    (HG : Γ !! x = Some tz) :
  False.
Proof.
  destruct Hs as [E _]. unfold env in *.
  assert (Hn : Γ !! x = None).
  { rewrite E. apply (proj2 (lookup_union_None Γ1 Γ2 x)).
    split; assumption. }
  rewrite Hn in HG. discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma wt_var_budget_mut L :
  forall Γ e t (H : wt L Γ e t),
    (forall x, Γ !! x = None -> var_budget x e = 0) /\
    (forall x tx, Γ !! x = Some tx -> var_budget x e <= 1 \/ unr tx).
Proof.
  set (P := fun (Γ : env) (e : expr) (t : type) =>
    (forall x, Γ !! x = None -> var_budget x e = 0) /\
    (forall x tx, Γ !! x = Some tx ->
       var_budget x e <= 1 \/ unr tx)).
  assert (P_bin : forall (e : expr) Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 t,
      (forall x, var_budget x e = var_budget x e1 + var_budget x e2) ->
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      P Γ1 e1 t1 -> P Γ2 e2 t2 -> P Γ e t).
  { intros e Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 t Hbud Hs H1 H2.
    unfold P in *. destruct Hs as [Eunion Hdisj]. split.
    - intros z Hnone.
      destruct (env_split_lookup_none Γ Γ1 Γ2 z (conj Eunion Hdisj) Hnone)
        as [Hn1 Hn2].
      destruct H1 as [H1a _]. destruct H2 as [H2a _].
      specialize (H1a z Hn1). specialize (H2a z Hn2).
      rewrite Hbud. lia.
    - intros z tz Hsome.
      destruct (Γ1 !! z) as [ta|] eqn:E1;
      destruct (Γ2 !! z) as [tb|] eqn:E2.
      + right.
        assert (Htz : tz = ta)
          by (apply (env_split_lookup_l_eq Γ Γ1 Γ2 z ta tz
                       (conj Eunion Hdisj) E1 Hsome)).
        subst tz.
        destruct (Hdisj z ta tb E1 E2) as [_ Hunr]. exact Hunr.
      + left.
        assert (Htz : tz = ta)
          by (apply (env_split_lookup_l_eq Γ Γ1 Γ2 z ta tz
                       (conj Eunion Hdisj) E1 Hsome)).
        subst tz.
        destruct (proj2 H1 z ta E1) as [Hb1|Hu1].
        * assert (Hv2 : var_budget z e2 = 0) by (apply (proj1 H2 z E2)).
          rewrite Hbud. lia.
        * right. exact Hu1.
      + left.
        assert (Htz : tz = tb)
          by (apply (env_split_lookup_r_eq Γ Γ1 Γ2 z tb tz
                       (conj Eunion Hdisj) E2 Hsome)).
        subst tz.
        destruct (proj2 H2 z tb E2) as [Hb2|Hu2].
        * assert (Hv1 : var_budget z e1 = 0) by (apply (proj1 H1 z E1)).
          rewrite Hbud. lia.
        * right. exact Hu2.
      + exfalso.
        exact (env_split_lookup_none_false Γ Γ1 Γ2 z tz
                 (conj Eunion Hdisj) E1 E2 Hsome). }
  assert (P_unary : forall (e : expr) Γ e' t' t,
      (forall x, var_budget x e = var_budget x e') ->
      P Γ e' t' -> P Γ e t).
  { intros e Γ e' t' t Hbud HP. unfold P in *. destruct HP as [Ha Hu].
    split.
    - intros z Hnone. rewrite Hbud. apply Ha, Hnone.
    - intros z tz Hsome. rewrite Hbud. apply Hu, Hsome. }
  assert (P_fun : forall Γ Γ' y e t1 t2 l,
      env_bind Γ' y t1 Γ -> P Γ' e t2 -> P Γ (Fun y e) (FunT l t1 t2)).
  { intros Γ Γ' y e t1 t2 l Hb HP. unfold P in *. destruct HP as [Ha Hu].
    split.
    - intros z Hnone. simpl.
      destruct (decide (z = y)) as [E|E].
      + subst z. reflexivity.
      + apply Ha. rewrite (env_bind_lookup_other Γ Γ' y t1 z Hb E).
        exact Hnone.
    - intros z tz Hsome. simpl.
      destruct (decide (z = y)) as [E|E].
      + subst z. left. lia.
      + apply Hu. rewrite (env_bind_lookup_other Γ Γ' y t1 z Hb E).
        exact Hsome. }
  assert (P_match : forall n Γ Γ1 Γ2 e es t (ts : fin n -> type),
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      P Γ1 e (SumT n ts) ->
      (forall i, P Γ2 (es i) (FunT Lin (ts i) t)) ->
      P Γ (MatchSum n e es) t).
  { intros n Γ Γ1 Γ2 e es t ts Hs HP1 HPf.
    unfold P in *. destruct Hs as [Eunion Hdisj].
    destruct HP1 as [H1a H1b]. split.
    - intros z Hnone.
      destruct (env_split_lookup_none Γ Γ1 Γ2 z (conj Eunion Hdisj) Hnone)
        as [Hn1 Hn2].
      specialize (H1a z Hn1) as Hv1.
      assert (Hvf : forall i, var_budget z (es i) = 0)
        by (intro i; apply (proj1 (HPf i) z Hn2)).
      assert (Hmax : fin_max (fun i => var_budget z (es i)) = 0).
      { assert (Hle : fin_max (fun i => var_budget z (es i)) <= 0)
          by (apply fin_max_le; intro i; rewrite Hvf; lia).
        lia. }
      simpl. rewrite Hv1, Hmax. reflexivity.
    - intros z tz Hsome.
      destruct (Γ1 !! z) as [ta|] eqn:E1;
      destruct (Γ2 !! z) as [tb|] eqn:E2.
      + right.
        assert (Htz : tz = ta)
          by (apply (env_split_lookup_l_eq Γ Γ1 Γ2 z ta tz
                       (conj Eunion Hdisj) E1 Hsome)).
        subst tz.
        destruct (Hdisj z ta tb E1 E2) as [_ Hunr]. exact Hunr.
      + left.
        assert (Htz : tz = ta)
          by (apply (env_split_lookup_l_eq Γ Γ1 Γ2 z ta tz
                       (conj Eunion Hdisj) E1 Hsome)).
        subst tz.
        destruct (proj2 HP1 z ta E1) as [Hb1|Hu1].
        * assert (Hvf : forall i, var_budget z (es i) = 0)
            by (intro i; apply (proj1 (HPf i) z E2)).
          assert (Hmax : fin_max (fun i => var_budget z (es i)) = 0).
          { assert (Hle : fin_max (fun i => var_budget z (es i)) <= 0)
              by (apply fin_max_le; intro i; rewrite Hvf; lia).
            lia. }
          simpl. rewrite Hb1, Hmax. lia.
        * right. exact Hu1.
      + left.
        assert (Htz : tz = tb)
          by (apply (env_split_lookup_r_eq Γ Γ1 Γ2 z tb tz
                       (conj Eunion Hdisj) E2 Hsome)).
        subst tz.
        assert (Hv1 : var_budget z e = 0) by (apply H1a, E1).
        assert (Hmax : fin_max (fun i => var_budget z (es i)) <= 1).
        { apply fin_max_le. intro i.
          destruct (proj2 (HPf i) z tb E2) as [Hb|Hu]; [exact Hb|].
          exfalso. exact (unr_fun_lin (ts i) t Hu). }
        simpl. rewrite Hv1. lia.
      + exfalso.
        exact (env_split_lookup_none_false Γ Γ1 Γ2 z tz
                 (conj Eunion Hdisj) E1 E2 Hsome). }
  assert (Hall : forall Γ e t, wt L Γ e t -> P Γ e t).
  { apply (wt_ind L P).
    - (* VarW *) intros Γ x t Hvar. unfold P. split.
      + intros z Hnone. simpl.
        destruct (decide (z = x)) as [E|E]; [|reflexivity].
        subst z. pose proof (env_var_lookup Γ x t Hvar) as Hsome.
        rewrite Hsome in Hnone. discriminate.
      + intros z tz Hsome. simpl.
        destruct (decide (z = x)); lia.
    - (* FunW *) intros Γ Γ' y e t1 t2 l Hb Hunr Hbody IH.
      exact (P_fun Γ Γ' y e t1 t2 l Hb IH).
    - (* AppW *) intros Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 l Hsplit H1 IH1 H2 IH2.
      exact (P_bin (App e1 e2) Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 t2
               (fun x => reflexivity) Hsplit IH1 IH2).
    - (* UnitW *) intros Γ Hunr. unfold P. split.
      + intros z Hnone. reflexivity.
      + intros z tz Hsome. left. simpl. lia.
    - (* PairW *) intros Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 Hsplit H1 IH1 H2 IH2.
      exact (P_bin (Pair e1 e2) Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 (PairT t1 t2)
               (fun x => reflexivity) Hsplit IH1 IH2).
    - (* LetPairW *) intros Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 t Hsplit H1 IH1 H2 IH2.
      exact (P_bin (LetPair e1 e2) Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 t
               (fun x => reflexivity) Hsplit IH1 IH2).
    - (* SumW *) intros Γ n ts i e H IH.
      exact (P_unary (Sum i e) Γ e (ts i) (SumT n ts)
               (fun x => reflexivity) IH).
    - (* MatchSumW *) intros n Γ Γ1 Γ2 t ts es e Hsplit Hn H1 IH1 Hf IHf.
      exact (P_match n Γ Γ1 Γ2 e es t ts Hsplit IH1 IHf).
    - (* ForkW *) intros Γ e t1 t2 H IH.
      exact (P_unary (ForkBarrier e) Γ e
               (FunT Lin (FunT Lin t2 t1) UnitT) (FunT Lin t1 t2)
               (fun x => reflexivity) IH).
    - (* NewLockW *) intros Γ e t H IH.
      exact (P_unary (NewLock e) Γ e t (LockT (Owner,Closed) t)
               (fun x => reflexivity) IH).
    - (* ForkLockW *) intros Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t l1 l2 l3 Hsplit Hcap H1 IH1 H2 IH2.
      exact (P_bin (ForkLock e1 e2) Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2
               (LockT l1 t) (FunT Lin (LockT l2 t) UnitT) (LockT l3 t)
               (fun x => reflexivity) Hsplit IH1 IH2).
    - (* AcquireW *) intros Γ e t lo H IH.
      exact (P_unary (Acquire e) Γ e (LockT (lo,Closed) t)
               (PairT (LockT (lo,Opened) t) t)
               (fun x => reflexivity) IH).
    - (* ReleaseW *) intros Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t lo Hsplit H1 IH1 H2 IH2.
      exact (P_bin (Release e1 e2) Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2
               (LockT (lo,Opened) t) t (LockT (lo,Closed) t)
               (fun x => reflexivity) Hsplit IH1 IH2).
    - (* WaitW *) intros Γ e t H IH.
      exact (P_unary (Wait e) Γ e (LockT (Owner,Closed) t) t
               (fun x => reflexivity) IH).
    - (* DropW *) intros Γ e t H IH.
      exact (P_unary (Drop e) Γ e (LockT (Client,Closed) t) UnitT
               (fun x => reflexivity) IH).
    - (* ValW *) intros Γ v t Hunr Hcv. unfold P. split.
      + intros z Hnone. reflexivity.
      + intros z tz Hsome. left. simpl. lia. }
  intros Γ e t H. exact (Hall Γ e t H).
Qed.

Lemma wt_var_budget_zero_of_absent L Γ e t x
    (H : wt L Γ e t) (Hnone : Γ !! x = None) :
  var_budget x e = 0.
Proof.
  exact (proj1 (wt_var_budget_mut L Γ e t H) x Hnone).
Qed.

Lemma wt_var_budget_linear_or_unr L Γ e t x tx
    (H : wt L Γ e t) (Hsome : Γ !! x = Some tx) :
  var_budget x e <= 1 \/ unr tx.
Proof.
  exact (proj2 (wt_var_budget_mut L Γ e t H) x tx Hsome).
Qed.

(* Names used in the beta-safety argument. *)
Lemma wt_var_absent_budget_zero L Γ e t x :
  wt L Γ e t -> Γ !! x = None -> var_budget x e = 0.
Proof. intros. apply (wt_var_budget_zero_of_absent L Γ e t x); assumption. Qed.

Lemma wt_var_budget_unr L Γ e t x tx :
  wt L Γ e t -> Γ !! x = Some tx -> var_budget x e <= 1 \/ unr tx.
Proof. intros. apply (wt_var_budget_linear_or_unr L Γ e t x tx); assumption. Qed.

(*                                                                    *)
(* The only change with respect to [cv] is the function-value rule:   *)
(* at an unrestricted function type, the body must be reference-free. *)
(* [wtS] is the corresponding runtime typing, using [cvS] for values. *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Inductive cvS (L : gmap nat type) : val -> type -> Prop :=
  | FunVS x e t1 t2 l :
      wt L (<[x := t1]> (∅ : env)) e t2 ->
      (l = Unr -> expr_refs e = ∅) ->
      cvS L (FunV x e) (FunT l t1 t2)
  | UnitVS : cvS L UnitV UnitT
  | PairVS v1 v2 t1 t2 :
      cvS L v1 t1 -> cvS L v2 t2 ->
      cvS L (PairV v1 v2) (PairT t1 t2)
  | SumVS n (ts : fin n -> type) i v :
      cvS L v (ts i) ->
      cvS L (SumV i v) (SumT n ts)
  | BarrierVS n t1 t2 :
      cvS L (BarrierV n) (FunT Lin t1 t2)
  | LockVS n lc t :
      L !! n = Some t ->
      cvS L (LockV n) (LockT lc t).

Inductive wtS (L : gmap nat type) : env -> expr -> type -> Prop :=
  | VarS Γ x t :
      env_var Γ x t ->
      wtS L Γ (Var x) t
  | FunS Γ Γ' x e t1 t2 l :
      env_bind Γ' x t1 Γ ->
      (l = Unr -> env_unr Γ) ->
      wtS L Γ' e t2 ->
      wtS L Γ (Fun x e) (FunT l t1 t2)
  | AppS Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 l :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wtS L Γ1 e1 (FunT l t1 t2) ->
      wtS L Γ2 e2 t1 ->
      wtS L Γ (App e1 e2) t2
  | UnitS Γ :
      env_unr Γ ->
      wtS L Γ Unit UnitT
  | PairS Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wtS L Γ1 e1 t1 ->
      wtS L Γ2 e2 t2 ->
      wtS L Γ (Pair e1 e2) (PairT t1 t2)
  | LetPairS Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 t :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wtS L Γ1 e1 (PairT t1 t2) ->
      wtS L Γ2 e2 (FunT Lin t1 (FunT Lin t2 t)) ->
      wtS L Γ (LetPair e1 e2) t
  | SumS Γ n (ts : fin n -> type) i e :
      wtS L Γ e (ts i) ->
      wtS L Γ (Sum i e) (SumT n ts)
  | MatchSumS n Γ Γ1 Γ2 t (ts : fin n -> type) es e :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      (n = 0 -> env_unr Γ2) ->
      wtS L Γ1 e (SumT n ts) ->
      (forall i, wtS L Γ2 (es i) (FunT Lin (ts i) t)) ->
      wtS L Γ (MatchSum n e es) t
  | ForkS Γ e t1 t2 :
      wtS L Γ e (FunT Lin (FunT Lin t2 t1) UnitT) ->
      wtS L Γ (ForkBarrier e) (FunT Lin t1 t2)
  | NewLockS Γ e t :
      wtS L Γ e t ->
      wtS L Γ (NewLock e) (LockT (Owner,Closed) t)
  | ForkLockS Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t l1 l2 l3 :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      lockcap_split l1 l2 l3 ->
      wtS L Γ1 e1 (LockT l1 t) ->
      wtS L Γ2 e2 (FunT Lin (LockT l2 t) UnitT) ->
      wtS L Γ (ForkLock e1 e2) (LockT l3 t)
  | AcquireS Γ e t lo :
      wtS L Γ e (LockT (lo,Closed) t) ->
      wtS L Γ (Acquire e) (PairT (LockT (lo,Opened) t) t)
  | ReleaseS Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t lo :
      env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
      wtS L Γ1 e1 (LockT (lo,Opened) t) ->
      wtS L Γ2 e2 t ->
      wtS L Γ (Release e1 e2) (LockT (lo,Closed) t)
  | WaitS Γ e t :
      wtS L Γ e (LockT (Owner,Closed) t) ->
      wtS L Γ (Wait e) t
  | DropS Γ e t :
      wtS L Γ e (LockT (Client,Closed) t) ->
      wtS L Γ (Drop e) UnitT
  | ValS Γ v t :
      env_unr Γ ->
      cvS L v t ->
      wtS L Γ (Val v) t.

(* The refined value typing really does exclude references at
   unrestricted types. *)

Lemma cvS_unr_refs L v t (H : cvS L v t) : unr t -> val_refs v = ∅.
Proof.
  induction H as
    [ x e t1 t2 l Hbody Hrefs
    |
    | v1 v2 t1 t2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2
    | n ts i v H1 IH1
    | n t1 t2
    | n lc t Hlookup ].
  - intro Hty. inversion Hty; subst.
    simpl. apply Hrefs. reflexivity.
  - intro. simpl. reflexivity.
  - intro Hty. simpl.
    rewrite (IH1 (unr_pair_l t1 t2 Hty)).
    rewrite (IH2 (unr_pair_r t1 t2 Hty)).
    apply union_empty_l_L.
  - intro Hty. simpl.
    apply (IH1 (unr_sum_inv n ts Hty i)).
  - intro Hty. exfalso. exact (unr_fun_lin t1 t2 Hty).
  - intro Hty. exfalso. exact (unr_LockT lc t Hty).
Qed.

Print Assumptions cvS_unr_refs.

(* Source terms contain no [Val] constructor, so the refined runtime
   typing [wtS] types every source term.  The [ValS] constructor is
   never needed. *)

Lemma typed_to_wtS Γ e t (H : typed Γ e t) : forall L, wtS L Γ e t.
Proof.
  induction H as
    [ Γ x t Hvar
    | Γ Γ' x e t1 t2 l Hb Hunr Hty IH
    | Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 l Hsplit Hty1 IH1 Hty2 IH2
    | Γ Hunr
    | Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 Hsplit Hty1 IH1 Hty2 IH2
    | Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 t Hsplit Hty1 IH1 Hty2 IH2
    | Γ n ts i e Hty IH
    | n Γ Γ1 Γ2 t ts es e Hsplit Hn Hty IH Hf IHf
    | Γ e t1 t2 Hty IH
    | Γ e t Hty IH
    | Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t l1 l2 l3 Hsplit Hcap Hty1 IH1 Hty2 IH2
    | Γ e t lo Hty IH
    | Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t lo Hsplit Hty1 IH1 Hty2 IH2
    | Γ e t Hty IH
    | Γ e t Hty IH ];
    intros L.
  - apply VarS; exact Hvar.
  - eapply FunS; [ exact Hb | exact Hunr | apply IH ].
  - eapply AppS; [ exact Hsplit | apply IH1 | apply IH2 ].
  - apply UnitS; exact Hunr.
  - eapply PairS; [ exact Hsplit | apply IH1 | apply IH2 ].
  - eapply LetPairS; [ exact Hsplit | apply IH1 | apply IH2 ].
  - eapply SumS; apply IH.
  - eapply MatchSumS; [ exact Hsplit | exact Hn | apply IH | intros i; apply (IHf i L) ].
  - eapply ForkS; apply IH.
  - eapply NewLockS; apply IH.
  - eapply ForkLockS; [ exact Hsplit | exact Hcap | apply IH1 | apply IH2 ].
  - eapply AcquireS; apply IH.
  - eapply ReleaseS; [ exact Hsplit | apply IH1 | apply IH2 ].
  - eapply WaitS; apply IH.
  - eapply DropS; apply IH.
Qed.

Print Assumptions typed_to_wtS.

(* ===== end of values ===== *)

Lemma wt_ctx_hole_empty k E t (Hk : ctx k)

  forall i y, ρ !! i = Some y -> (forall e, y <> Thread e) ->
    can_step ρ i \/ exists j, waiting ρ i j.

  progress_or_wait_obj ρ.

    + exact (thread_progress ρ i e E (Hty i e E)).

(H : tokEL beta Delta (k e) C) :
  exists Ce,
    tokEL beta Delta e Ce /\
    tc_le Ce C /\
    (forall e' Ce', tokEL beta Delta e' Ce' -> tc_le Ce' Ce ->
       exists C', tokEL beta Delta (k e') C' /\ tc_le C' C).
Proof.
  revert e C H.
  induction Hk as [| k1 k2 Hk1 Hk2 IH2].
  - (* id *) intros e C H. exists C. split; [exact H|].
    split; [apply tc_le_refl|].
    intros e' Ce' He' Hle'. exists Ce'. split; assumption.
  - (* composition *) intros e C H. simpl in H.
    destruct (tokEL_ctx1_hole beta Delta k1 Hk1 (k2 e) C H) as
      (Ck2 & Hk2e & Hle1 & Reb1).
    destruct (IH2 e Ck2 Hk2e) as

    exists Ce. split; [exact He|]. split.

    + intros e' Ce' He' Hle'.

Definition env_var (Γ : env) (x : string) (t : type) :=
  ∃ Γ', Γ = <[ x := t ]> Γ' ∧ env_unr Γ'.

Inductive typed : env -> expr -> type -> Prop :=

  | Var_typed Γ x t :
    env_var Γ x t ->
    typed Γ (Var x) t
  | Fun_typed Γ Γ' x e t1 t2 l :
    env_bind Γ' x t1 Γ ->
    (l = Unr -> env_unr Γ) ->
    typed Γ' e t2 ->
    typed Γ (Fun x e) (FunT l t1 t2)
  | App_typed Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 l :
    env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
    typed Γ1 e1 (FunT l t1 t2) ->
    typed Γ2 e2 t1 ->
    typed Γ (App e1 e2) t2
  | Unit_typed Γ :
    env_unr Γ ->
    typed Γ Unit UnitT
  | Pair_typed Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 :
    env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
    typed Γ1 e1 t1 ->
    typed Γ2 e2 t2 ->
    typed Γ (Pair e1 e2) (PairT t1 t2)
  | LetPair_typed Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 t :
    env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
    typed Γ1 e1 (PairT t1 t2) ->
    typed Γ2 e2 (FunT Lin t1 (FunT Lin t2 t)) ->
    typed Γ (LetPair e1 e2) t
  | Sum_typed Γ n (ts : fin n -> type) i e :
    typed Γ e (ts i) ->
    typed Γ (Sum i e) (SumT n ts)
  | MatchSumN_typed n Γ Γ1 Γ2 t (ts : fin n -> type) es e :
    env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
    (n = 0 -> env_unr Γ2) ->
    typed Γ1 e (SumT n ts) ->
    (∀ i, typed Γ2 (es i) (FunT Lin (ts i) t)) ->
    typed Γ (MatchSum n e es) t

  | Fork_typed Γ e t1 t2 :
    typed Γ e (FunT Lin (FunT Lin t2 t1) UnitT) ->
    typed Γ (ForkBarrier e) (FunT Lin t1 t2)

  | NewLock_typed Γ e t :
    typed Γ e t ->
    typed Γ (NewLock e) (LockT (Owner,Closed) t)
  | ForkLock_typed Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t l1 l2 l3 :
    env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
    lockcap_split l1 l2 l3 ->
    typed Γ1 e1 (LockT l1 t) ->
    typed Γ2 e2 (FunT Lin (LockT l2 t) UnitT) ->
    typed Γ (ForkLock e1 e2) (LockT l3 t)
  | Acquire_typed Γ e t lo :
    typed Γ e (LockT (lo,Closed) t) ->
    typed Γ (Acquire e) (PairT (LockT (lo,Opened) t) t)
  | Release_typed Γ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t lo :
    env_split Γ Γ1 Γ2 ->
    typed Γ1 e1 (LockT (lo,Opened) t) ->
    typed Γ2 e2 t ->
    typed Γ (Release e1 e2) (LockT (lo,Closed) t)
  | Wait_typed Γ e t :
    typed Γ e (LockT (Owner,Closed) t) ->
    typed Γ (Wait e) t
  | Drop_typed Γ e t :
    typed Γ e (LockT (Client,Closed) t) ->
    typed Γ (Drop e) UnitT.

Definition subst (x:string) (a:val) := fix rec e :=
  match e with
  | Val _ => e
  | Var x' => if decide (x = x') then Val a else e
  | Fun x' e => Fun x' (if decide (x = x') then e else rec e)
  | App e1 e2 => App (rec e1) (rec e2)
  | Unit => Unit
  | Pair e1 e2 => Pair (rec e1) (rec e2)
  | LetPair e1 e2 => LetPair (rec e1) (rec e2)
  | Sum n e => Sum n (rec e)
  | MatchSum n e1 e2 => MatchSum n (rec e1) (rec ∘ e2)
  | ForkBarrier e => ForkBarrier (rec e)
  | NewLock e => NewLock (rec e)
  | ForkLock e1 e2 => ForkLock (rec e1) (rec e2)
  | Acquire e => Acquire (rec e)
  | Release e1 e2 => Release (rec e1) (rec e2)
  | Wait e => Wait (rec e)
  | Drop e => Drop (rec e)
  end.

Inductive pure_step : expr -> expr -> Prop :=
  | Fun_step x e :
    pure_step (Fun x e) (Val $ FunV x e)
  | App_step x e a :
    pure_step (App (Val $ FunV x e) (Val a)) (subst x a e)
  | Unit_step :

From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.
From stdpp Require Import gmap decidable.
From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String Arith Lia Eqdep_dec.
From Stdlib Require Import Vectors.Fin.
Require Import AllCombine.
Require Import TokenTyping.
Require Import TokenCtx.
Require Import TokenLinear.
Require Import TokenExact.
Require Import TokenPure.
Require Import TokenBeta.
Require Import WtLinear.
Open Scope string_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* The refined typing [wtS] and the source-faithful Unr invariant.    *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* A closed thread typed by [wtS] has the following property: at any *)
(* beta redex [App (Val (FunV x body)) (Val a)], the body is typed by *)
(* [wt] under [<[x:=t1]> ∅], so linearity gives either a single use  *)
(* of [x] or [unr t1]; in the latter case [cvS_unr_refs] on the       *)
(* argument gives [val_refs a = ∅].  Hence [pure_beta_refs_safe].      *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma wtS_ctx1_hole_empty L k E t (Hk : ctx1 k)
    (Hwt : wtS L ∅ (k E) t) :
  exists s, wtS L ∅ E s.
Proof.
  destruct Hk; cbn in Hwt; inversion Hwt; subst;
    try match goal with
        | Hs : env_split ∅ ?Γ1 ?Γ2 |- _ =>
            destruct (env_split_empty Γ1 Γ2 Hs) as [E1 E2];
            subst Γ1 Γ2
        end;
    eauto.
Qed.

Lemma wtS_ctx_hole_empty L k E t (Hk : ctx k)
    (Hwt : wtS L ∅ (k E) t) :
  exists s, wtS L ∅ E s.
Proof.
  revert E t Hwt.
  induction Hk as [| k1 k2 H1 H2 IH2]; intros E t Hwt.
  - cbn in Hwt. exists t. exact Hwt.
  - cbn in Hwt.
    destruct (wtS_ctx1_hole_empty L k1 (k2 E) t H1 Hwt) as [s Hs].
    exact (IH2 E s Hs).
Qed.

Print Assumptions wtS_ctx1_hole_empty.
Print Assumptions wtS_ctx_hole_empty.

Lemma pure_beta_refs_safe_of_wtS_ctx L beta k e t
    (Hk : ctx k)
    (Hwt : wtS L ∅ (k e) t) :
  pure_beta_refs_safe beta e.
Proof.
  destruct (wtS_ctx_hole_empty L k e t Hk Hwt) as [te He].
  intros x body a C1 Heq Htok.
  rewrite Heq in He.
  inversion He; subst.
  match goal with
  | H1 : wtS L ?Γ1 (Val (FunV x body)) (FunT ?l ?t1 ?t2),
    H2 : wtS L ?Γ2 (Val a) ?t1 |- _ =>
      inversion H1; subst;
      inversion H2; subst
  end.
  match goal with
  | Hbody : wt L (<[x := ?t1]> (∅ : env)) body ?t2,
    Hcv : cvS L a ?t1 |- _ =>
      destruct (wt_var_budget_unr L (<[x := t1]> (∅ : env))
                  body t2 x t1 Hbody
                  (env_lookup_insert_same x t1)) as [Hb|Hu];
      [ left; exact Hb
      | right; exact (cvS_unr_refs L a t1 Hcv Hu) ]
  end.
Qed.

Print Assumptions pure_beta_refs_safe_of_wtS_ctx.

(* The pure-step token preservation lemma, with the beta-safety premise
   discharged by the refined closed-thread typing.  [wtS] preservation
   through the pure step is deliberately not asserted here; that is the
   remaining typing-refinement obligation. *)

Lemma pure_step_token_single_threads_L_refs_of_wtS beta L i k e e' t
    (Hk : ctx k)
    (Hstep : pure_step e e')
    (Hwt : wtS L ∅ (k e) t)
    (Hinv : token_single_threads_L beta {[ i := Thread (k e) ]}) :
  token_single_threads_L beta {[ i := Thread (k e') ]}.
Proof.
  apply (pure_step_token_single_threads_L_refs beta i k e e' Hk Hstep).
  - exact (pure_beta_refs_safe_of_wtS_ctx L beta k e t Hk Hwt).
  - exact Hinv.
Qed.

Print Assumptions pure_step_token_single_threads_L_refs_of_wtS.

(* resources are not duplicated across alternatives.  For syntactic  *)
(* safety we take the branch context as an upper bound (the union of  *)
(* all alternatives' tokens).                                         *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition tenv := string -> token_ctx.

Definition tenv_zero : tenv := fun _ => tc_zero.

Definition tenv_bind (Delta : tenv) (x : string) : tenv :=
  fun y => if decide (y = x) then tc_zero else Delta y.

Inductive tokE (beta : nat -> option (type * type)) :
    tenv -> expr -> token_ctx -> Prop :=
  | TE_Var Delta x C :
      Delta x = C ->
      tokE beta Delta (Var x) C
  | TE_Val Delta v C :
      tokV beta v C ->
      tokE beta Delta (Val v) C
  | TE_Fun Delta x e C :
      tokE beta (tenv_bind Delta x) e C ->
      tokE beta Delta (Fun x e) C
  | TE_App Delta e1 e2 C1 C2 :
      tokE beta Delta e1 C1 -> tokE beta Delta e2 C2 ->
      tokE beta Delta (App e1 e2) (tc_add C1 C2)
  | TE_Unit Delta :
      tokE beta Delta Unit tc_zero
  | TE_Pair Delta e1 e2 C1 C2 :
      tokE beta Delta e1 C1 -> tokE beta Delta e2 C2 ->
      tokE beta Delta (Pair e1 e2) (tc_add C1 C2)
  | TE_LetPair Delta e1 e2 C1 C2 :
      tokE beta Delta e1 C1 -> tokE beta Delta e2 C2 ->
      tokE beta Delta (LetPair e1 e2) (tc_add C1 C2)
  | TE_Sum Delta n e C :
      tokE beta Delta e C ->
      tokE beta Delta (Sum n e) C
  | TE_MatchSum Delta n e es Cs Cb :
      tokE beta Delta e Cs ->
      (forall i, tokE beta Delta (es i) Cb) ->
      tokE beta Delta (MatchSum n e es) (tc_add Cs Cb)
  | TE_ForkBarrier Delta e C :
      tokE beta Delta e C ->
      tokE beta Delta (ForkBarrier e) C
  | TE_NewLock Delta e C :
      tokE beta Delta e C ->
      tokE beta Delta (NewLock e) C
  | TE_ForkLock Delta e1 e2 C1 C2 :
      tokE beta Delta e1 C1 -> tokE beta Delta e2 C2 ->
      tokE beta Delta (ForkLock e1 e2) (tc_add C1 C2)
  | TE_Acquire Delta e C :
      tokE beta Delta e C ->
      tokE beta Delta (Acquire e) C
  | TE_Release Delta e1 e2 C1 C2 :
      tokE beta Delta e1 C1 -> tokE beta Delta e2 C2 ->
      tokE beta Delta (Release e1 e2) (tc_add C1 C2)
  | TE_Wait Delta e C :
      tokE beta Delta e C ->
      tokE beta Delta (Wait e) C
  | TE_Drop Delta e C :
      tokE beta Delta e C ->
      tokE beta Delta (Drop e) C
with tokV (beta : nat -> option (type * type)) : val -> token_ctx -> Prop :=
  | TV_FunV x e C :
      tokE beta tenv_zero e C ->
      tokV beta (FunV x e) C
  | TV_Unit :
      tokV beta UnitV tc_zero
  | TV_Pair v1 v2 C1 C2 :
      tokV beta v1 C1 -> tokV beta v2 C2 ->
      tokV beta (PairV v1 v2) (tc_add C1 C2)
  | TV_Sum n v C :
      tokV beta v C ->
      tokV beta (SumV n v) C
  | TV_Barrier n t1 t2 :
      beta n = Some (t1, t2) ->
      tokV beta (BarrierV n) (tc_bar_one n)
  | TV_Lock n lc :
      tokV beta (LockV n) (tc_lock_one n lc).

Scheme tokE_mut := Induction for tokE Sort Prop
  with tokV_mut := Induction for tokV Sort Prop.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Token soundness: every syntactic reference occurrence is covered  *)
(* by a token of the same index.                                      *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Lemma tc_add_has_index_l_rev C1 C2 n :
  has_index_token (tc_add C1 C2) n ->
  has_index_token C1 n \/ has_index_token C2 n.
Proof.
  intros [[lc H]|H].
  - rewrite tc_add_lock in H.
    destruct (Nat.eq_0_gt_0_cases (tok_lock C1 n lc)) as [E|Gt].
    + right. left. exists lc. rewrite E in H. lia.
    + left. left. exists lc. lia.
  - rewrite tc_add_bar in H.
    destruct (Nat.eq_0_gt_0_cases (tok_bar C1 n)) as [E|Gt].
    + right. right. rewrite E in H. lia.
    + left. right. lia.
Qed.

Ltac tok_sound_apply :=
  match goal with
  | IH : (forall m : nat, m ∈ expr_refs _ -> has_index_token _ m)
      |- has_index_token _ _ => eapply IH; eassumption
  | IH : (forall m : nat, m ∈ val_refs _ -> has_index_token _ m)
      |- has_index_token _ _ => eapply IH; eassumption
  end.

Lemma tokE_sound beta Delta e C (H : tokE beta Delta e C) :
  forall n, n ∈ expr_refs e -> has_index_token C n.
Proof.
  induction H using tokE_mut with
    (P0 := fun v C (Hv : tokV beta v C) =>
             forall n, n ∈ val_refs v -> has_index_token C n).
  - (* Var *) intros k Hk. simpl in Hk. set_solver.
  - (* Val *) intros k Hk.
    match goal with
    | IHv : (forall m, m ∈ val_refs _ -> has_index_token _ m) |- _ =>
        exact (IHv k Hk)
    end.
  - (* Fun *) intros k Hk. simpl in Hk. tok_sound_apply.
  - (* App *) intros k Hk. simpl in Hk. apply elem_of_union in Hk.
    destruct Hk as [Hk|Hk].
    + apply tc_add_has_index_l. tok_sound_apply.
    + apply tc_add_has_index_r. tok_sound_apply.
  - (* Unit *) intros k Hk. simpl in Hk. set_solver.
  - (* Pair *) intros k Hk. simpl in Hk. apply elem_of_union in Hk.
    destruct Hk as [Hk|Hk].
    + apply tc_add_has_index_l. tok_sound_apply.
    + apply tc_add_has_index_r. tok_sound_apply.
  - (* LetPair *) intros k Hk. simpl in Hk. apply elem_of_union in Hk.
    destruct Hk as [Hk|Hk].
    + apply tc_add_has_index_l. tok_sound_apply.
    + apply tc_add_has_index_r. tok_sound_apply.
  - (* Sum *) intros k Hk. simpl in Hk. tok_sound_apply.
  - (* MatchSum *) intros k Hk. simpl in Hk. apply elem_of_union in Hk.
    destruct Hk as [Hk|Hk].
    + apply tc_add_has_index_l. tok_sound_apply.

From cgraphs.locks.lambdalock Require Import definitions.
From stdpp Require Import gmap decidable.
From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String Arith Lia Eqdep_dec.
From Stdlib Require Import Vectors.Fin.
Require Import AllCombine.
Require Import TokenTyping.
Require Import TokenCtx.
Open Scope string_scope.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* A redesigned token grammar.                                        *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* The original [TE_MatchSum] rule gave every alternative the same     *)
(* branch context [Cb].  In particular, [MatchSum 0] could carry an    *)
(* arbitrary token even though it has no branch at all.  We now use a  *)
(* per-alternative context plus a common upper bound, and force the    *)
(* upper bound to be empty when there are no alternatives.             *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Inductive tokEL (beta : nat -> option (type * type)) :
    tenv -> expr -> token_ctx -> Prop :=
  | TLE_Var Delta x C :
      Delta x = C ->
      tokEL beta Delta (Var x) C
  | TLE_Val Delta v C :
      tokVL beta v C ->
      tokEL beta Delta (Val v) C
  | TLE_Fun Delta x e C :
      tokEL beta (tenv_bind Delta x) e C ->
      tokEL beta Delta (Fun x e) C
  | TLE_App Delta e1 e2 C1 C2 :
      tokEL beta Delta e1 C1 -> tokEL beta Delta e2 C2 ->
      tokEL beta Delta (App e1 e2) (tc_add C1 C2)
  | TLE_Unit Delta :
      tokEL beta Delta Unit tc_zero
  | TLE_Pair Delta e1 e2 C1 C2 :
      tokEL beta Delta e1 C1 -> tokEL beta Delta e2 C2 ->
      tokEL beta Delta (Pair e1 e2) (tc_add C1 C2)
  | TLE_LetPair Delta e1 e2 C1 C2 :
      tokEL beta Delta e1 C1 -> tokEL beta Delta e2 C2 ->
      tokEL beta Delta (LetPair e1 e2) (tc_add C1 C2)
  | TLE_Sum Delta n e C :
      tokEL beta Delta e C ->
      tokEL beta Delta (Sum n e) C
  | TLE_MatchSum Delta n e es Cs Cb Cbs :
      tokEL beta Delta e Cs ->
      (forall i, tokEL beta Delta (es i) (Cbs i)) ->
      (forall i, tc_le (Cbs i) Cb) ->
      (n = 0 -> Cb = tc_zero) ->
      tokEL beta Delta (MatchSum n e es) (tc_add Cs Cb)
  | TLE_ForkBarrier Delta e C :
      tokEL beta Delta e C ->
      tokEL beta Delta (ForkBarrier e) C
  | TLE_NewLock Delta e C :
      tokEL beta Delta e C ->
      tokEL beta Delta (NewLock e) C
  | TLE_ForkLock Delta e1 e2 C1 C2 :
      tokEL beta Delta e1 C1 -> tokEL beta Delta e2 C2 ->
      tokEL beta Delta (ForkLock e1 e2) (tc_add C1 C2)
  | TLE_Acquire Delta e C :
      tokEL beta Delta e C ->
      tokEL beta Delta (Acquire e) C
  | TLE_Release Delta e1 e2 C1 C2 :
      tokEL beta Delta e1 C1 -> tokEL beta Delta e2 C2 ->
      tokEL beta Delta (Release e1 e2) (tc_add C1 C2)
  | TLE_Wait Delta e C :
      tokEL beta Delta e C ->
      tokEL beta Delta (Wait e) C
  | TLE_Drop Delta e C :
      tokEL beta Delta e C ->
      tokEL beta Delta (Drop e) C
with tokVL (beta : nat -> option (type * type)) : val -> token_ctx -> Prop :=
  | TVL_FunV x e C :
      tokEL beta tenv_zero e C ->
      tokVL beta (FunV x e) C
  | TVL_Unit :
      tokVL beta UnitV tc_zero
  | TVL_Pair v1 v2 C1 C2 :
      tokVL beta v1 C1 -> tokVL beta v2 C2 ->
      tokVL beta (PairV v1 v2) (tc_add C1 C2)
  | TVL_Sum n v C :
      tokVL beta v C ->
      tokVL beta (SumV n v) C
  | TVL_Barrier n t1 t2 :
      beta n = Some (t1, t2) ->
      tokVL beta (BarrierV n) (tc_bar_one n)
  | TVL_Lock n lc :
      tokVL beta (LockV n) (tc_lock_one n lc).

Scheme tokEL_mut := Induction for tokEL Sort Prop
  with tokVL_mut := Induction for tokVL Sort Prop.

(* ================================================================== *)
(* Alternative-aware occurrence counting.                             *)
(*                                                                    *)
(* At a [MatchSum], only one alternative is executed.  The amount of   *)
(* token context needed by the alternatives is therefore the maximum   *)
(* over the alternatives, not their sum.                              *)
(* ================================================================== *)

Definition fin_max {n} (f : fin n -> nat) : nat :=
  fold_right (fun i acc => max (f i) acc) 0 (fin_enum n).

Lemma fold_max_ge {A} (g : A -> nat) (l : list A) (b : nat) :
  forall x, x ∈ l -> g x <= fold_right (fun a acc => max (g a) acc) b l.
Proof.
  induction l as [|a l IH]; intros x Hx; simpl.
  - apply not_elem_of_nil in Hx. contradiction.
  - apply elem_of_cons in Hx. destruct Hx as [->|Hx].
    + lia.
    + pose proof (IH x Hx). lia.
Qed.

Lemma fold_max_le {A} (g : A -> nat) (l : list A) (b k : nat) :
  b <= k ->
  (forall x, x ∈ l -> g x <= k) ->
  fold_right (fun a acc => max (g a) acc) b l <= k.
Proof.
  intros Hb Hall. induction l as [|a l IH]; simpl.
  - exact Hb.
  - apply Nat.max_lub.
    + apply Hall. set_solver.
    + apply IH. intros x Hx. apply Hall. set_solver.
Qed.

Lemma fin_max_ge {n} (f : fin n -> nat) (i : fin n) :
  f i <= fin_max f.
Proof.
  unfold fin_max.
  apply (fold_max_ge f (fin_enum n) 0 i). apply fin_enum_complete.
Qed.

Lemma fin_max_empty (f : fin 0 -> nat) : fin_max f = 0.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma fin_max_zero {n} (f : fin n -> nat) :
  fin_max f = 0 -> forall i, f i = 0.
Proof.
  intros H i. pose proof (fin_max_ge f i). lia.
Qed.

Lemma fin_max_le {n} (f : fin n -> nat) (k : nat) :
  (forall i, f i <= k) -> fin_max f <= k.
Proof.
  intros H. unfold fin_max.
  apply (fold_max_le f (fin_enum n) 0 k); [lia|].
  intros x _. apply H.
Qed.
